tei:div.tei:p: ོ ba ban/ —ra —sa — rte/ / / da / shā / ༄ ོ na rangathol ma sanga'abam/ 47 ༄ ༅ /(go brgyad ba/) 4 sngon mi rib/sa dpe san khang /
༅ shā༅rdzo bla(01ba)mtshozatha༅maza(zakhrizo༅zobakro+o jokhrotshoḥmalornye 2002 4 132ma7—5420—0874—9—ma1 zlosadī9dhū 6 /3sgo//lomoskomojo mazasgodzalor+ṣazagoyo 1thamatshoṣ+ṭhazo(2002)sgom28123bhe

dkar chagachos bshad gzhan phan zla ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so// (1)mi shes mun pa mthug po sel ba'i lam rim gsal ba'i sgon me bzhugs so// (285)dag snang sprul ba'i glegs bam zhes bya ba bzhugs so// (427)rdzogs rim 'od gsal mngon du byed pa'i thabs bde ba chen po bskyed tshul 'dod yon lha mo'i dga' ston cesathag /ste/ /ba /ba(1rngan05 〈〈// (670)ye shes kyi phyag rgya ma la brten nas bde stong gi ye shes bsgyed tshul dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs cen05 (1 /ba /ba(1rnganapeg res// (674)

༄༅ //chos bshad gzhan phan zla ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so//phun tshogs rgyal srid mchil snabs bzhin du dor/ /dben pa'i nags khrod rgyal sa bzhin du bzung / /dka' spyad mdzad nas bsgoms pas rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /thub dbang sras dang bcas la gus pas 'dud/ /chos brgyad blos btang dur khrod brgyad sogs su/ /rig 'dzin brgyad bsten bka' brgyad sgrub pa mdzad/ /dngos grub brgyad thob gu ru mtshan brgyad grags/ /pad 'byung yab sras brgyud par bcas la 'dud/ /rgyal srid spangs nas bla ma mang po bsten/ /zab dang rgya che'i gdams pa mang po gsan/ /bsgoms pas mchog thun dngos grub mang po brnyes/ /jo bo yab sras brgyud par bcas la 'dud/ /tshe 'di'i bya ba thams cad rtswa ltar dor/ /dka' spyad drag pos brag phug zhwa ltar bsten/ /rtse gcig bsgoms pas tshe gcig sangs rgyas pa'i/ /mi la yab sras brgyud par bcas la 'dud/ /bla ma bsten nas thos bsam rgya chen mdzad/ /dben pa bsten nas yun ring 1

nyams su bzhes/ /lung dang rtogs pa'i yon tan kun mnga' ba'i/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma yongs la gus pas 'dud/ /yun ring 'khor bar 'khyams pas 'gro kun gyi/ /don med tshe 'di'i bya ba blo yis btang / /bla ma'i bka' bzhin dben par sgrub pa byas/ /thar pa'i lam sna zin par byen gyis rlobs/ /dang po 'khor ba'i bya ba thams cad dor/ /bar du bla ma bsten nas thos bsam byas/ /tha ma ri khrod dben par bsgom dgos tshul/ /bla ma dam pa'i gsung bzhin bshad par bya/ /'o de yang ma gyur nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du thob bya bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che ci nas kyang myur bar myur du thob par bya/ de'i phyir du dam pa'i lha chos gsan nas/ phyin chad nyams su len par bya'o snyam pa'i sems kyi kun slong legs po dang / lus kyi kun spyod ni/ skyes rabs las/ rab tu dma' ba'i stan la 'dug /dul ba'i dpal ni rnam par bskyed/ /dga' dang ldan pa'i mig gis blta/ /tshig gi bdud rtsi 'thung ba bzhin/ /gus pa bskyed cing rtse gcig btud/ /rab tu dwangs la dri med yid/ /nad pas sman pa'i tshig nyan bzhin/ /rim gro bskyed la chos nyon cig /gsungs pa 2

ltar gsan par 'tshal/ 'o skol rnams kyis da res dal 'byor gyi gru chen rnyed pa'i dus 'dir 'jigs rung 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las thar pa zhig bya dgos te/ de'i rgyu mtshan rang re rnams sngon gyi dge ba'i mthu gcig la brten nas stabs ka yag pa tsam 'phrod de/ da res mi lus rin po che thob/ dbang po sgo lnga tshang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis zin/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa dang mjal/ chos byed dbang yod byed thabs shes pa'i dus 'dir 'khor ba las thar nges pa'i chos rnal ma zhig ma byas na/ phyis 'di lta bu'i rten shin tu rnyed par dka' ste/slob dpon zhi ba lha'i zhal nas/ dal 'byor 'di ni shin tu rnyed par dka'/ /skyes bu'i don 'grub thob par 'gyur ba la/ /gal te 'di la phan pa ma sgrub na/ /phyi nas yang dag 'byor bar ga la 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs/ 'o na dal 'byor zhes bya de gang yin zhe na/ dal ba brgyad dang 'byor ba bcu ste/ dal ba brgyad ni/ mi khom pa brgyad du ma skyes par/ da res 'o skol rnams kyis chos sgrub rgyu yin na khom pa'i skal ba byung nas ga le sos dal du bsdad yod pas na dal ba brgyad zer/ mi khom brgyad ni/ las 'bras dang dkon mchog gsum med par 'dzin pa'i phyi rol pa sogs log lta can dang / rgya mtsho chen po 3

dang / mi'i yul na gnas pa'i dud 'gro dang / phyi sgrib can dang / nang sgrib can dang zas skom gnyis kyi sgrib pa can sogs kyi yi dwags dang / tsha dmyal grang dmyal nyi tshe nye 'khor ba'i dmyal ba dang / sangs rgyas 'byung ba med pa'i gnas su sgyes pa'i chos kyi sgra yang mi grags pa'i rgyal ba'i bka' med pa dang /dge slong pa sogs 'khor rnam bzhi gcig tsam yang mi rgyu ba'i yul mtha' 'khob dang / lkugs pa yan lag mig rna ba sogs ma tshang ba'i dbang po ma tshang ba dang / 'du shes med pa'i lha tshe ring po dang 'dod pas rtag tu g.yeng ba'i 'dod lha/ gzugs med khams kyi lha dang brgyad po 'di yin te/ bshes springs las/log par lta ba 'dzin dang dud 'gro nyid/ /yi dwags nyid dang dmyal bar skye ba dang / /rgyal ba'i bka' med pa dang mtha' 'khob tu/ /kla klor skye ba glen cing lkugs pa nyid/ /tshe ring lha nyid gang yang rung ba ni/ /skye ba zhes bya mi khom skyon brgyad do/ /de dag dang bral khom pa brnyes nas ni/ /skye ba zlog pa'i slad du 'bad par mdzod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ /'byor ba bcu gang yin zhe na/ rang 'byor lnga ni dam pa'i lha chos sgrub pa'i rten mi lus rin po che thob pa dang / zab rgyas chos dar ba'i yul dbus su skyes pa dang / thos bsam byed pa'i rten dbang 4

111rtes (11 /bye/ste / /ste/ /ste//rje/ lnga nga ba dang / la mu gas pa sa su ma zhugs/mtshams med lnga'i las byas sam byed du ma bcug pa'i las mtha' ma log pa dang / dad pa'i gnas ma nor ba bla ma dkon mchog gsum gye gnas la dad pa dang lnga yin te/ mi nyid dbus skyes dbang po tshang / /las mtha' ma log gnas la dad/ /ces dang / mdo las/ mi nyid thob pa dang / 'phags pa'i yul du skyes pa dang / dbang po tshang ba dang / las kyi mtha' ma log pa dang / gnas la dad pa ste/ lnga ni bdag phun sum tshogs pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gzhan 'byor lnga ni/ sangs rgyas 'jig rten du byon pa u dum wa ra'i me tog las dkon na yang / da res sangs rgyas 'jig rten du byon pa dang / tshig re tsam yang bskal brgyar thos dka' ba'i zab pa dang rgya che ba'i dam pa'i chos gsungs pa dang / gsung ba'i bstan pa rin po che yang ma nub par gnas pa dang / de'i rjes 'jug bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang po yod pa dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen de rnams kyis/ gdul bya gzhan la thugs brtse bas gang 'dod kyi chos gsung zhing / dad can sbyin bdag rnams kyis snying brtse bas chos kyi mthun rkyen zas gos sogs ster ba dang lnga ste/ sangs rgyas byon dang de chos gsungs/ /bstan pa gnas dang de rjes 5

'jug /gzhan phyir snying nas brtse ba'o/ /zhes dang / mdo las sangs rgyas byon pa dang / chos gsungs pa dang / dam pa'i chos gnas pa dang / gzhan dag kyang de la spyod pa dang / chos byed pa la gzhan brtse ba ste/ lnga ni gzhan phun sum tshogs pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de lta bu'i dal 'byor gyi chos bco brgyad tshang ba'i mi lus rin po che thob pa'i dus 'dir chos bsgrubs na mngon mtho lha mi'i go 'phang / nges legs thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang yang snyigs dus kyi tshe thung gcig la thob pas don che des na lha rnams kyis kyang /dal 'byor gyi rten bzang zhig thob na ci ma rung snyam pa'i yid sgon byed pa yin zhes mngal 'jug gi mdo las gsungs/ 'gro ba kun kyis smon pa'i gnas lha bas lhag pa'i lus dal 'byor gyi rten bzang 'di lta bu nam yang rnyed dka' ste/ rgyu yi sgo nas rnyed dka' tshul ni/ spyir bde 'gro tsam zhig thob pa la'ang /tshul khrims la sogs pa'i dge ba rnam dag sna gcig byed dgos/ khyad par dal 'byor tshang ba zhig thob pa la/ tshul khrims rnam par dag pas gzhi bzung / sbyin sogs dge ba rnam par dag pas grogs byas/ smon lam dri ma med pas mtshams sbyor ba sogs dge rtsa mang po gcig sgrub dgos na/ da lta skye bo 6

khri phrag ma nga po tshogs pa'i khrod na yang rgyu de lta bu sgrub pa shin tu dkon/ blo la tshur log nas rang la bltas na yang rgyu de rnams phar zhog nyin gcig gi mchod sbyin sogs dge ba gtsang sang nge 'di byas zhes dran rgyu cig mi 'dug na/ phyin chad mi lus mi thob/ thob tu re ba'i blo de dper na/ dpyid sa bon ma btab pa ston lo tog 'ong bar re ba dang 'dra bas don dag spu tsam med/ dpe yi sgo nas rnyed dka' tshul ni/ sangs rgyas kyis dper na/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po chus gang ba lta bu'i rgya mtsho chen po'i kha na gser gyi gnya' shing bu ga gcig pa cig shar gyi rlung gis ded nas nub tu 'phyo/ de bzhin du phyogs mtshams kun tu rlung gis ded nas nges med 'khyer ba dang / rgya mtsho de'i zhabs na rus sbal mig long ba lo brgya brgya na mgo mtsho steng du thon pa re re byed pa de'i mgrin pa gser gyi gnya' shing bye gar e chud ces 'khor rnams la dris pas/ 'khor rnams kyis rgya mtsho kha chung zhing gser gyi gnya' shing bu ga mang phyogs gcig tu ma bsdad rus sbal la mig yod/ rgyun du mtsho khar 'ong na chud srid kyi/ rgya mtsho kha che gser gyi gnya' shing la bu ga gcig min med/ phyogs kun tu 'phyo rus sbal la mig med cing lo brgya'i 'phro lan re ma gtogs mtsho khar mi 'ong bas na/7

ye mi chud ces zhus pas/ sangs rgyas kyis mi khom pa'i gnas brgyad nas dal 'byor thob pa'ang de dang mtshungs so zhes gsungs/ de bzhin du bshes springs las/ rgya mtsho cher gnas gnya' shing bu ga dang / /rus sbal 'phrad pa bas kyang dud 'gro las/ /mi nyid ches thob dka' bas mi'i dbang gis/ /dam chos spyad pas de 'bras mchis par mdzod/ /ces dang / spyod 'jug las/ de nyid phyir na bcom ldan gyis/ /rgya mtsho cher g.yeng gnya' shing gi/ bu gar rus sbal mgrin chud ltar/ /mi nyid shin tu thob dkar gsungs/ /zhes gsungs/ gzhan yang dpe gsal ba/ gyang log gi ngos la sran ma gtor ba dang / rnga'i steng du nam mkha' nas mar sran ma 'phangs pa re re tsam chags pa/ dal 'byor gyi mi lus thob pa'i tshod dang / sa la lhung ba rnams mi khom pa'i gnas brgyad du skyes pa'i tshod tsam yin ces bla ma dam pa 'ga' res gsungs/ grangs sam ngo bo'am 'bras bu'i sgo nas rnyed dka' tshul ni/ sangs rgyas kyi zhal nas/ dmyal ba ni sa chen po'i rdul tsam mo/ /yi dwags ni bye ma'i grangs tsam mo/ /dud 'gro chang gi sbang ma tsam mo/ /lha dang lha min ni kha ba bu yug tsam mo/ /mi ni sen mo'i steng gi rdul tsam mo/ /zhes gsungs/ lung gzhi las/ ngan 'gro nas shi 8

'phos te der skyes pa ni sa chen po'i rdul dang / de nas bde 'gror skyes pa ni/ sen mo'i rtse mos blangs pa'i rdul dang 'dra zhing / bde 'gro gnyis nas shi 'phos te ngan 'gror 'gro ba ni sa chen po'i rdul dang / de nas bde 'gror skye ba ni phyag sen gyi rtse mos bzhes pa'i rdul dang 'dra bar gsungs pas/ bde 'gro dang ngan 'gro gnyis ga nas rnyed par dka'o/ /de nas da res skye dka' ba lho rgyal 'dzam gling du skyes/ thob par dka' ba'i mi lus rin po che thob/ mjal bar dka' ba'i theg pa chen po'i chos dang mjal ba 'di ni/ sngon tshul khrims bsrung zhing /bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags smon lam rnam par dag pa btab pa las byung ba yin pas/ da lan tsam ma gtogs shin tu rnyed dka' zhes rgyal ba sras bcas kyis mgrin gcig tu yang yang gsungs te/ sangs rgyas kyis/ 'jig rten khams ni grangs mang yang / /'dzam gling sog khar skye ba dkon/ /gtsang ma'i mi lus shin tu dka'/ /zhes dang / rnam snang mngon byang las/'jig rten dag na kun mkhyen dag /u dum wa ra'i me tog bzhin/ /brgya lam nang na re 'ga' tsam/ /'byung 'gyur yang ni mi 'byung ste/ /gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul 'di ni/ /de bas kyang ni dkon pa ste/ /gang gis sems can mnyam med don/ /bla 9

med byed par nus pa yin/ /zhes dang / o rgyan rin po che'i zhal nas/ yang yang rnyed dka' u dum wa ra 'dra/ /rnyed pa don che yid bzhin nor bu 'dra/ /zhes dang / slob dpon klu sgrub kyis/ thob dka' 'dzam gling mi yi lus/ /de thob dus su ngan song rgyu/ /rab tu sgrim ste bcad par bya/ /zhes dang / rje rin po che'i zhal nas/ dal ba'i rten 'di yid bzhin nor las lhag /'di 'dra rnyed pa da res tsam zhig yin/ /zhes dang / klong chen rab 'byams pas/ dal 'byor 'di ni thob pa brgya lam tsam/ /de bas chos dang 'phrad pa nyin skar tsam/ /theg mchog chos dang mjal ba srid mtha' tsam/ /snying nas dam pa'i chos shig mdzad re ran/ /zhes dang / pha dam pa'i zhal nas/ spyir sems can tsam gyi lus mthong na/ /mi lus thob pa med pa tsam/ /sgos kha 'thor ba yi lus mthong na/ /mi lus thob pa srid pa tsam/ /zhes dang / rje mi las/ mi khom brgyad po spangs pa yi/ /dal 'byor tshang ba'i mi lus dka'/ /tshe 'di'i bde skyid blos btang nas/ /dal 'byor snying po len pa dka'/ /'khor ba'i chos kyi skyon mthong nas/ /mya ngan 'das pa sgrub pa dka'/ /zhes dang / rgyal ba bskal bzang rgya mtshos/ sngon legs byas brgya yis 'phangs pa'i lus/ /rten chos dang mjal 10

ba'i dal 'byor 'di/ /lha tshangs dbang gtsug gi nor bu bzhin/ /gsungs/ chos rje ba'i zhal nas/ sngon bsags bsod nams brgya las grub pa'i lus/ /dal 'byor rten 'di phyi nas rnyed dka' bas/ /sdug bsngal rgya mtsho che las sgol ba'i gru/ /don med chud zos ma byed rin chen grub/ /ces dang / rig 'dzin gang shar rang grol gyis/ /dal 'byor tshang ba'i mi lus lan cig 'di/ /dbul bos yid bzhin nor bu rnyed pa ltar/ /yang yang rnyed par dka' ba thob dus 'dir/ /'bad pas dam chos gyis shig mched grogs lags/ /zhes dang / kun bzang snying thig las/ dal 'byor rnyed dka' thob pa da res tsam/ /myur du ngan 'gro'i gnas su lhung la khad/ /da res 'di la don chen ma bsgrubs na/ /phyi nas mi lus shin tu rnyed par dka'/ /zhes dang / rje skal ldan rgya mtsho'i mgur las/ 'o 'o dal 'byor tshang ba'i mi lus/ /a'u shin tu rnyed par dka' ya/ /kho re chos kyi snying po longs dang / /he te blo bde dpal yin e go /ya yi ya yi/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ mi lus rin po che 'di ni yang yang rnyed par dka' ba nyin bar gyi skar ma dang 'dra'o/ /'di'i steng nas yar 'gro mar 'gro'i sa mtshams 'byed pas lam kha phrag dang 'dra'o/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba mtha' dag 11

gi rten byed pas sa gzhi dang 'dra'o/ /mtho ris thar par bgrod pa'i them skas dang 'dra'o/ /de bas na dbul bos yid bzhin gyi nor bu lam nang nas rnyed pa ltar da res mi lus rin po che thob cing / bla ma dam pa la brten nas zab mo'i gdams pa nyams su blangs na/ thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang thob pa 'di a re dga' snyam du shin tu dga' zhing spro bzhin/ tshe 'di'i gnyen bshes longs spyod gang la'ang ma chags par da res thar pa'i lam sna zin thabs dam chos kho na la 'bad dgos/ don med chud zos su gtang mi rung ste/'phags pa dpa' bos/ gang zhig thob na 'khor ba yi/ /pha rol phyin pa'i sa bon bskrun/ /byang chub dpal gye sa bon mchog /yid bzhin nor bu las lhag pa'i/ /yon tan rgyun gyi mi rnams ni/ /su zhig 'dir de 'bras med byed/ /ces dang / slob springs las/ gang zhig thob nas skye ba'i rgya mtsho'i mthar phyin cing / /byang chub mchog gi dge ba'i sa bon 'debs gyur pa/ /yid bzhin nor bu bas kyang yon tan ches lhag pa'i/ /mi nyid de ni su zhig 'bras bu med par byed/ /ces gsungs/ gal te chos kyi snying po ma blangs na/ /rin chen gling du phyin nas lag stong du phyir log pa dang / mi dge ba bsags na gser snod rin po che 12

du ma'i phras mdzes pa zhig mi gtsang ngan skyug gi snod byas pa dang 'dra bas ches shin tu blun zhes mkhas pa thams cad kyis smad pa'i gnas yin te/ rig 'dzin gang shar rang grol gyi zhal nas/ da res lan cig rnyed pa'i rten 'di la/ /snying nas dam chos sgrub la mi brtson na/ /rin chen gling phyin stong log byed pa ltar/ /mi tshe stong zad yin no mched grogs lags/ /zhes dang / 'phags pa dpa' bos/ gang zhig dge bas phyug pa'i mi/ /bskal ba grangs med kyis thob nas/ /'dir ni rmongs pa bsod nams gter/ /cung zad tsam yang mi bsog pa/ /de dag 'jig rten pha rol tu/ /mi zad mya ngan khang par 'jug /rin chen gling phyin tshong pa ni/ /lag pa stong bas rang khyim bzhin/ /dge bcu'i las kyi lam med par/ /phyi nas yang ni thob ma yin/ /mi ma thob par bde ba ni/ /ji ltar de bde sdug bsngal nyid/ /de bas pha rol bslus yon min/ /de las mchog tu rmongs pa med/ /ces dang / bshes springs las/ gang zhig gser snod rin chen spras pa yi/ /ngan skyug 'phyag par bgyid pa de bas kyang / /gang zhig mi ru skyes nas sdig pa'i 'a/sa/ /bgyid pa de ni ches rab blun pa lags/ /zhes dang / slob dpon zhi ba lha'i zhal nas/ 'di 'dra'i dal ba rnyed gyur nas/ /bdag gis 13

dge goms ma byas na/ /'di las bslus pa gzhan med de/ /'di las rmongs pa'ang gzhan med do/ /zhes dang / rgyal dbang lnga pas/ da ni phan bde legs tshogs sgrub pa'i gzhi/ /dal 'byor gru gzings lan cig rnyed pa 'dis/ /nges legs rin chen gling du ma phyin par/ /'khor bar stong log byas na snying rtsa rul/ /zhes dang / rgyal ba bskal bzang rgya mtshos/ sngon bsags bsod nams brgya yis bskrun pa'i lus/ /tshe 'di kho na'i don la bskul gyur na/ /phugs kyi mdun ma cha tsam mi sems pa/ /phyugs dang khyad par med do snying gtam yin/ /gsungs/da res dge ba ma byas sdig pa mi dge ba zhar zhor la bsags na/ phyin chad mi lus thob pa phar zhog bskal ba mang por bde 'gro'i sgra tsam yang thos dka' ste/ slob dbon zhi ba lha'i zhal nas/bdag gi spyod pa 'di 'dras ni/ /mi yi lus kyang thob mi 'gyur/ /mi lus 'thob par ma gyur na/ /sdig pa 'ba' zhig dge ba med/ /gang tshe dge spyad skal ldan yang / /dge ba bdag gis ma byas na/ /ngan song sdug bsngal kun rmongs pa/ /de tshe bdag gis ci byar yod/ /dge ba dag kyang ma byas la/ /sdig pa dag kyang nyer bsags pa/ /bskal ba bye ba brgyar yang ni/ /bde 'gro'i sgra yang thos mi 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs/ dper na gru dang 14

gru pa yod dus chu bo las brgal dgos pa dang / da res mi lus gru lta bu la brten nas/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal chu bo lta bu las ci sgol byed dgos te/ slob dpon zhi ba lhas/ mi yi gru la brten nas ni/ /sdug bsngal chu bo che las sgol/ /gru 'di phyi nas rnyed dka' bas/ /rmongs pa dus su gnyid ma log /ces dang / o rgyan rin po ches da res phun tshogs rkyen kun 'byor skabs 'dir/ /brtson 'grus drag pos srid lam 'da' bar mdzod/ /ces dang / slob springs las/ mi yi dngos po shin tu rnyed dka' rnyed gyur na/ /don du brnag pa gang yin de nyid bstun te sgrubs/ /zhes gsungs/ da mdor na/ pha dam pa'i zhal nas/ pho mo mdo don che chung da res shes/ /tshe la stong log ma byed ding ri pa/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ skyes pho mo su yin yang bsam mno yod mod/ grung mi grung / spyang mi spyang / pho rgod mo rgod thams cad da res shes/ da res mi lus rin po che chud zos dang stong log tu mi btang bar dam pa'i chos shig byas na/grung po yin spyang po yin/ rgod po yin/ da res chos bzhin ma mdzad na/ khog pa na don snying med pa'am/ smyo tshabs rang che ba yin/ rang gis rang bslus/ rang gis rang phung ba yin pas/rin chen gling du phyin nas lag stong du mi 'ong ba ltar/ da res 15

chos kyi yul dbus su skyes nas chos shig mdzad pa gal che/ de yang ga le sos dal byas sang bya gnangs bya'i ngang la phyi bshol du mi 'jog par myur du byed dgos te/ de yi rgyu mchen rang re rnams kyis da res rnyed dka'i rten 'di thob tu zin kyang /yun ring mi sdod par myur du 'chi ste/ sangs rgyas kyis/ skye ba yod na 'chi ba yod/ /dar ba yod na rgud pa yod/ /lang tsho de yang mi rtag ste/ /dar pa'i mdog kyang nad kyis 'phrogs/ /'tsho ba'i tshe yang 'chi bas 'phrog /rtag pa'i chos ni gang yang med/ /ces dang / o rgyan rin po che'i zhal nas/ skyes nas 'chi bar snang gi dam chos myur du spyod/ /'dus nas 'phral bar snang gi smon lam bzang du thob/ /yod pa med par yin gyi sbyin pa myur du thongs/ /yang dag pa yi don la goms par gyis/ /zhes dang /mi rtag blo gtad med par ma shes na/ /da dung 'khor ba 'di la zhen cing chags/ /skyid 'dod ngang la mi tshe sdug gis 'da'/ /g.yeng ma lam du dal 'byor mi tshe 'dzad/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ /skyes phan chad ma shi ba tshe thar du lus pa'i sems can gcig kyang med la/ yod dam med dam snyam pa'i the tshom gyi blo 'jug pa tsam mi srid de/ mi rtag pa'i tshoms las/ gang yang sangs rgyas rang sangs rgyas/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi nyan thos 16

kyang / /sku lus 'di ni spong mdzad na/ /skye bo phal pa smos ci dgos/ /zhes dang / slob dpon rta dbyangs kyis/ sa'am 'on te mtho ris na/ /skyes nas gang zhig ma shi ba/ /'ga' zhig khyod kyis mthong ba'am/ /thos sam 'on te the tshom za/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ che ba dge ba'i bshes gnyen man chad nas bzang ba sa bdag rgyal po yan chad/ phyug po 'khor los bsgyur rgyal man chad nas/ ltogs pa sprang slong yan chad/ rgan po lo lon brgyad cu man chad nas/ chung ngu ma las skyes phran yan chad 'chi bdag gi dbang du ma song ba gcig kyang med/ de yang rang re rnams kyi yul mi khyim mtshes pha spun gnyen nye rigs/ bla ma mched grogs/ pha ma spun zla bza' tshang sgo phyugs sogs 'chi ba sleb nas song ba thams cad kyis sdod rtsis mang du byas kyang 'dug dbang ma byung ba yin pas/ 'o skol thams cad de yi rang bzhin las ma 'das pas/ sa phyogs gang du bsdad kyang 'chi bas mi tshugs pa med de/ mi rtag pa'i tshoms las/ gang du gnas kyang 'chi bas mi tshugs pa'i/ /sa phyogs de ni yod pa ma yin te/ /bar snang na med rgya mtsho'i nang du med/ /ri bo rnams kyi gseb tu zhugs na'ang min/ /zhes gsungs/ 'chi bdag la bros pas mi thar zhing / rdzas sngags sogs kyis zlog tu med de/17

rgyal por gdams pa'i mdo las/ rgyal po chen po/ rga bas ni dar la bab pa 'joms shing 'ong / na bas ni nad med pa 'joms shing 'ong / rgud pas ni phun sum tshogs pa thams cad 'joms shing 'ong / 'chi bas ni srog 'joms shing 'ong ste/ de dag las ni mgyogs pas bros pa'am/ stobs kyis zlog pa'am/nor gyis zlog pa'am/ rdzas dang sngags dang sman rnams kyis zhi bar sla ba ma yin no/ /zhes gsungs so/ /tshe la snon pa med cing 'brid pa bar ma chad du yod pas/ ltag chu bcad pa'i rdzing bu'i mthil rdol pa ltar tshe 'dzad/ nyi ma nub kha'i grib so ltar tshe 'grib/ gsod sar khrid pas sems can gyi gom pa spos pa ltar lo zla zhag dang / snga dro phyi dro tsam gyis 'ching la thag je nyer je nyer 'gro tshul sogs dpe du ma'i sgo nas rgyal ba sras bcas kyis yang yang gsungs te/ slob dpon zhi ba lhas mdzad pa'i spyod 'jug las/ nyir mtshan sdod pa yong med par/ /tshe 'di rtag tu god 'gyur zhing / /snon pa gud nas 'ong med na/ /bdag lta 'chi bar cis mi 'gyur/ /ces dang / mi rtag srin bus ma zos pa'i/ /'gro ba 'di ni dga' ma byung / /da dung de bzhin kho nar bas/ /sems khyod ci'i phyir dal bar 'dug /ces dang / mi rtag pa'i gtam las/ ltag chu bcad pa'i rdzing bzhin 18

du/ /snon med 'drid pa dang bcas pa/ /kun kyang 'chi ba'i lam zhugs na/ /glo bur tshe la su yid rton/ /zhes dang / rgyal ba bskal bzang rgya mtsho'i zhal nas/ skyes nas skad cig tsam zhig sdod dbang yang med par/ /'chi bdag gshin rje'i drung du bang rtsal gyis rgyugs pas/ /gson po zer yang 'chi ba'i lam chen la chas 'dug /nyes can gsod sar 'khrid pa'i snang tshul 'di skyo ba/ /zhes dang / tshoms las/ dper na thags ni brkyangs pa las/ /spun ni gang dang gang bcug pa/ /spun gyi gting la gtugs pa ltar/ /mi rnams srog kyang de bzhin no/ /dper na nges par gsod pa dag /gom pa gang dang gang bor ba/ /gsod pa'i drung du bsnyegs pa ltar/ /mi rnams srog kyang de bzhin no/ /chu klung drag tu 'bab pa'i rgyun/ /ldog pa med par ji ltar bar/ /de bzhin mi yi tshe 'gro ba/ /slar ni ldog par 'gyur ba med/ /ces dang / dper na phyugs dzi dbyug thogs kyis/ /phyugs rnams rang gnas phyin byed ltar/ /de bzhin na dang rga ba yis/ /mi rnams 'chi bdag drung du skyel/ /zhes dang / byang chu da sems dpa'i sde snod las/ rtswa mchog kha yi zil pa'i thigs/ /nyi ma yongs su babs pa na/ /yun tsam zhig gis med pa bzhin/ /mi rnams tshe yang de bzhin no/ /ji ltar shing gi yal ga yi/ /lo 19

ma me tog 'bras bu rnams/ /thams cad ltung ba'i chos nyid bzhin/ /mi rnams tshe yang de bzhin no/ /zhes dang / ljon shing gi mdo las/ byes pa gzhon nu'i bsam pa la/ /gzhon nu rtag par 'dug snyam ste/ /byes pa gzhon nu yongs mi rtag /zhag zla zad kyi rgas la nye/ /gsod sar 'khrid pa'i btson bzhin du/ /gom re bor bzhin 'chi la nye zhes dang / ting 'dzin rgyal po las ji ltar char pa'i tshogs chen babs pa na/ /chu yi chu lbur dag kyang tha dad 'byung / /byung nas zhig ste chu yi chu lbur med/ /chos rnams thams cad de bzhin shes par gyis/ /zhes dang / rgya cher rol pa las/ srid gsum mi rtag ston ga'i sprin dang 'dra/ /'gro ba'i skye 'chi gar la blta dang mtshungs/ /skyes bu'i tshe 'gro nam mkha'i glog dang 'dra/ /ri gzar 'bab chu bzhin du myur mgyogs 'gro/ /zhes dang / mya ngan med pa'i gling gi gtam rgyud las/ dper na ljon shing phung bo la/ /bya bye'u mang po'i gnas bcas te/ /srod la tshogs shing tho rangs gyes/ /chos rnams mi rtag de dang 'dra/ /zhes dang / rje btsun mi la'i zhal nas/ sgyu ma lus kyi khang rul la/ /lo dang zla ba'i thigs pas brdung / /zhag dang za ma'i char pa babs/ /sgyu lus kyi khang rul 'jig las che/ /'chi brod kyi thigs tshags byed re ran/ /zhes dang / klong 20

chen rab 'byams pas/ 'chi bdag nub ga'i grib ma 'dra/ /skad cig mi sdod tshur tshur 'ong / /da res 'chi med gnyug ma'i don/ /bde chen btsan sa bzung na legs/ /zhes dang / bu mo sa le 'od kyis/ tshe sngon bsod nams bsags pa'i mthus/ /dus lan cig thob pa'i mi lus 'di/ /lo dang zla bas rgyab nas ded/ /zhag dang za mas mdun nas 'khrid/ /skad cig res kyang 'chi la nye/ /lus sdong rul 'dra ste 'gyel dang snyam/ /dbugs na bun 'dra ste yal la khad/ /sems bsam mno btang bas blo ma bde/ /yid yang yang 'gyus pas gnyid ma khug ces dang / bu mo dpal 'byung gis/ lang tsho rgyas pa'i dkyil 'khor la/ /'dzum zhing sgeg pa'i ri dwags mdzes/ /sna tshogs rgyan gyis zer 'phro yang / /'chi bdag sgra gcan 'ong mod kyis/ /'chi bdag 'gal me'i 'khor lo ltar/ /rgyun du 'khor mod ci ltar bya/ /zhes dang /bu mo bdun gyi rtogs brjod las/ 'dor bar 'gyur ba'i lus srog la/ /chu dang rtswa yi zil ltar ltos/ /zhes dang / sku gsum don thugs las/ kye ma kye ma mi rtag 'jig pa'i rgyu/ /chu yi lbu ba sdom gyi ba thags dang / /sgyu ma'i mkhar dpe dri za'i grong khyer bzhin/ /thams cad mi rtag 'jig pa'i chos can te/ /zhes dang / rje btsun 'jam dbyangs rgya mtshos/ dper na sna 21

tshogs tshogs bya'i mgron khang du/ /mgron po mang po 'tshogs shing so sor gyes/ /mjug tu gcig kyang mi sdod 'gro ba ltar/ /mdza' bshes gnyen grogs mi rtag de dang 'dra/ /zhes dang /rig 'dzin gang shar rang grol gyis/ tshe srog 'di snum zad mar me 'dra/ /brtan brtan 'dra 'dug kyang myur du 'jig /lang tsho 'di me tog mgul rgyan bzhin/ /yun ring du mi gnas nyams par 'gyur/ /stobs 'byor 'di chu yi chu lbur 'dra/ /skad cig gis mi rtag 'gyur ba'i chos/ /zhes pa la sogs rgya cher gsungs so/ /mdor na tshe ston ga'i na bun las kyang yun thung / mdza' bshes gnyen 'dun tshong 'dus mgron po las kyang gyes sla/'chi bdag bdud po kho dgong kha'i grib so bas kyang mgyogs par 'ong ste/ zhe re 'jigs/ slob dbon chen po'i zhal nas/tshe mi rtag ston ga'i sprin dang 'dra/ /mdza' bshes gnyen tshong 'dus mgron po 'dra/ /'chi bdag bdud ni dgong kha'i grib so 'dra/ /zhes gsungs/ gson pa'i tshe yang / tshe phyed gnyid la zad/ phyed la chung dus chos mi dran/ rgas dus ma nus/ gzhon dus dgra 'dul gnyen skyong / bza' btung long gtam sogs kyi dbang du song nas/ chos bya long med par nges par 'chi ste/phyin ci log bzhi 'gog pa'i gtam las/ 'di na mi rnams tshe 22

ni mchog tu ring yang lo brgya kho nar zad/ /de las kyang ni dang po byes pa tha ma rgas pas don med byed/ /gnyid dang nad sogs dag gis de dus med par kun nas re ba 'joms/ /bde bar gnas pa'i mi nang 'gro ba'i tshe na lhag ma ci tsam yod/ /ces dang / o rgyan rin po che'i zhal nas/ yun thung tshe yi phyed tsam gti mug gnyid/ /phyed kyang sum gnyis rnam g.yeng 'du 'dzi ste/ /sum cha gcig la bar chad rkyen dbang mang de phyir 'du byed ston ga'i sprin bzhin g.yo/ /lang tsho ldan pa'i lus kyang myur du 'jig /de tshe phan pa'i thabs la brtson pa gces/ /zhes dang / 'chad ka pa'i zhal nas kyang / lo drug cu la lto rgyab dang gnyid dang na tshas bcad pa'i shul na/ chos su 'gro ba lo lnga yang med gsung / des na 'chi ba'i dgra 'di dgag tu med par nges par myur du 'ong na ci'i phyir tshe 'di'i blo brid la dga' snyam du bsam ste/ gang la ma chag par chos byed pa la blo thag rbad kyis bcad nas chos byed dgos te/ ka ni ga'i springs yig las/ 'chi bdag brtse ba med pa can/ /skyes tshad don med gsod 'gyur ba/ /gsod pa mngon du 'ong bzhin du/ /mkhas pa su zhig bag yang spyod/ /de'i slad dpa' chen bzod med de/ /mda' ni mi zad 'chor med pa/ /de ni ji srid ma 23

'phangs pa/ /de srid rang gi don la 'bod/ /ces dang / jo bo rje'i zhal nas/ tshe 'di yun thung shes bya rnam pa mang tshe yi tshad ni ci tsam mi shes pas/ /ngang bas chu las 'o ma len pa ltar/ /rang gi 'dod pa dang du blang bar gyis/ /zhes gsungs/de yang nam zhig 'chi ba 'ong ba kun gyis go shes kyang / nga da rung mi 'chi da rung 'dug snyam/ rgan rgon bla rgan rnams kyis kyang blos mi 'chi ba'i phyogs bzung nas/ tshe 'di'i dgra 'dul gnyen skyong so nam byas byas/ chos gang yang ma byas pa'i bar der 'chi bdag gis btsir gyis bzung dus/ a ho chos shig byed ma thub zer smre sngags mya ngan dang bcas 'chi dgos pas na/ blo ngan de 'gog pa la nam 'chi cha med 'di bsgom pa gal che/ dper na rang la gnod pa drag po byed pa'i dgra ma rungs pa zhig lo gcig gi bar la 'ong bar thag chod la/ zhag gang la 'ong bar ma shes na/ zhag re re nas des dogs zon byas go mtshon gsog pa ltar/ 'chi ba lo brgyad cu tshun la 'ong bar thag chod la/ de'i bar gyi zhag gang la 'ong ma nges pas/ nyin re bzhin 'chi brod dam pa'i lha chos byed dgos te/ de yi rgyu mtshan/ gling gzhan dang 'gro ba gzhan gye tshe la nges pa yod kyang / lho 'dzam bu gling gi mi rnams kyi tshe la/ dang po tshe lo 24

dpag med thub pa nas bzung / tha ma tshe lo bcu pa la thug gi bar du nges pa ci yang ma mchis te/ mdzod las/ 'di na ma nges tha mar ni/ /lo bcu dang po dpag tu med/ /ces gsungs pas na/ de ring tsam yang mi 'chi ba'i blo gtad med de/ spyod 'jug las/ de ring kho na mi 'chi zhes/ /bde bar 'dug pa rigs ma yin/ /zhes dang / sku gsum don thugs las/ sang dgong do nub 'chi'am mi shes pas/ /phyi tshis blo sna mang pos ci zhig bya/ /zhes dang / tshoms las/ sang dang 'jig rten phyi ma gnyis/ /sngon du gang 'ong gtol med pas/ /sang gi rtsis la mi 'bad par/ /phyi ma'i don la 'bad par rigs/ /zhes dang / snga dro skye bo mang mthong ba/ /phyi dro kha cig mthong mi 'gyur/ /phyi dro skye bo mang mthong ba/ /snga dro kha cig mthong mi 'gyur/ /zhes dang /skyes pa bud med mang po dang / /dar la bab pa 'chi 'gyur na/ /de la mi 'di gzhon zhes te/ /gson pa'i gdengs brod ci zhig yod/ /ces dang / rgyal ba bskal bzang rgya mtshos/ nar son pa'i pha mas rang gi bu/ /skyes tsam nas dur du sba bar snang / /de mthong nas bdag kyang gzhon no zhes/ /'chi bdag la bshol 'debs re ba chad/ /dus da nang dgra 'dul gnyen skyong gi /gros byed dus lus bde sems kyang rgod/ /dgung srod 25

la bab dus dur khrod du/ /lus bya khyes za ba cang bden nam/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ de ring kha bkrag yal le ba'i mi 'chi ba zhig 'ong snyam pa med pa rnams kyang / sang gnangs lta bu shi ba mang bas/ des na 'byung bzhi 'dus pa'i lus 'di mi 'jig snyam pa'i blo gtad zan rdog gcig za ba'i yun tsam yang med/ dbugs rlangs pa tsam/ drod me stag tsam pa 'di skad cig la 'chad nyen yod/ nad bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi gdon stong phrag brgyad cu sogs 'chi ba'i rkyen byed pa grangs med de/ sku gsum don thugs las/ 'chi ba'i rkyen ni bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad/ /stong phrag brgyad cu dus min rnam brgyad sogs/ /ma nges 'chi ba'i rkyen mang a tsa ma/ /zhes dang / jo bo rje'i zhal nas/tha ma'i dus su gyur pa na/ /tshe thung nad mang longs spyod dman/ /rkyen ngan bar chad mang ba yis/ /yun ring sdod pa'i mthu med pas/ /zhes dang / slob springs las/ mar me me lce shugs drag rlung gis bskyod pa lta'i/ /tshe ni skad cig gnas pa'i gdeng yang yod ma yin/ /zhes dang / rin chen phreng ba las/'chi bdag rkyen gyi nang gnas pa/ /rlung dmar nang 'dug mar me bzhin/ /zhes dang / bshes springs las/ tshe la gnod mang rlung gis btab pa yi/ /chu yi chu bur bas kyang mi rtag na/ /26

dbugs rngub dbugs 'byung gnyid kyis log pa las/ /sang khom gang lags de ni ngo mtshar che/ /zhes gsungs/ gson pa'i rkyen ni zas gos sogs yin kyang / zas gos sgrub phyir 'chi ba byes pa gos kyis sbubs pa/ zas ma zhu ba/ sman log par song ba/ gnas khang rdib pa/ mdza' bos bslus pa sogs phyi'i 'chi rkyen du 'gyur ba mang bas na/ gson rkyen nyung ste/ rin chen phreng ba las/ 'chi ba'i rkyen ni mang ba ste/ /gson pa'i rkyen ni nyung zad cig /de dag rnams kyang 'chi bas na/ /de bas rtag tu chos mdzod cig /ces gsungs/ lus chu'i lbu ba ltar shin tu nyam chung bas na/ gnod pa chen po mi dgos par/ tsher ma zug pa lta bu'i gnod pa la snyad btags nas kyang srog 'jig par 'gyur bas na/ 'chi rkyen thams cad kyis 'jig par sla ba yin te/ bshes springs las/ sa dang lhun po rgya mtsho nyi ma bdun/ /'bar bas bsregs pa'i lus can 'di dag kyang / /thal ba yang ni lus par mi 'gyur na/ /shin tu nyam chung mi lta smos ci 'tshal/ /zhes dang / rgyal ba bskal bzang rgya mtshos/lus sha khrag pags pas g.yogs pa 'di/ /'jig nges pa chu yi wu ba 'dra/ /zhes gsungs/ des na 'chi bdag gis lus srog nam 'joms nges pa med pas na/ long yod mi bya bar da lta 27

nyid du chos bya snyam du thag bcad nas bya dgos te/ ka ni ga'i springs yig las/ 'chi bdag su dang mi bshes pas/ /glo bur dag tu 'bab 'gyur bas/ /sang dag bya zhes ma bzhes par/ /dam pa'i chos la bsnyur te mdzod/ /ces dang / rje rin po ches/rnyed dka' 'jig sla nam mkhu'i glog dang 'dra/ /tshul 'di bsam nas 'jig rten bya ba kun/ /sbun pa 'phyar ba bzhin du rtogs gyur nas/ /nyin mtshan kun tu snying po len pa dgos/ /zhes dang / grub chen mi tra dzo ga'i zhal nas/ sa bdag ji ltar g.yar bo'i lus/ /nad med rgud med bder gnas pa/ /de nyid tshe na snying po blangs/ /na 'chi'i rgud pas 'jigs med gyis/ /zhes gsungs/ 'chi ba zer ba'i yongs la 'brug bzhin grags pa/ 'chi bdag bzlog med thog dang 'dra ba ste glo bur thog tu babs tshe/ chos ma gtogs gzhan gang gis kyang phan pa med de/pha dang ma drin can bu dang chung ma gzugs mdzes/ grwa rogs grogs mched thugs mthun nyin gcig gi 'bral glags mi phod pa mang pos mtha' bskor nas bsdad kyang yud tsam 'grogs dbang dang gcig tsam 'khrid dbang med de/ 'jam dpal rnam par rol pa las/ pha ma khyod kyi skyabs ma yin/ /mdza' bshes rtsa lag rnams kyang min/ /de dag gis kyang khyod bor 28

nas/ /rang nyid gcig bur phyi mar 'gro/ /zhes dang / slob dpon zhi ba lha'i zhal nas/ skyes na gcig bur skyes 'gyur zhing / /'chi na de nyid gcig 'chi ste/ /sdug bsngal skal gzhan mi len na/ /bgegs byed mdza' bas ci zhig bya/ /zhes gsungs/brtsigs pa'i khang khyem/ bsags pa'i nor rdzas ji snyed yod kyang / rdul phran tsam zhig 'khyer du med/ o rgyan rin po ches/zas nor bro zan gcig dang 'grogs dbang med/ /mar gyi dkyil nas spu bton bzhin du 'gro/ /zhes dang / zhang g.yu brag 'gro mgon rin po che'i zhal nas/ bla ma mdang grong zer tsa na/ /'bral mi phod pa'i phun tshogs de/ /rang dbang med par lings kyis bor/ /rmi lam bzhin du phyod kyis song / /zhes gsungs/ tha na zas dang gos kyis gces par bskyangs pa'i lhan cig skyes pa'i sha rus kyang mal du bskyur nas 'gro dgos te/ slob dpon zhi ba lhas/ lus 'di gcig bu byung ba yang /lhan cig skyes pa'i sha rus dag /zhig ste so sor 'gyes 'gyur na/ /mdza' ba gzhan dag ci zhig smos/ /zhes dang / rgyal ba bskal bzang rgya mtshos/ khu khrag gzhan gyis rdzas la/ /bdag bzung lus 'di 'chor yang / /nam zhig mi gtsang rdzas bzhin/ /'brel med 'dor bar 'gyur bas/ /zhes/ gsungs/29

des na 'chi ba'i tshe chos ma gtogs gang gis kyang mi phan par 'dug ste 'jig rten phun tshogs rnams kyis bdag 'dor/bdag gis kyang 'di rnams 'dor nam 'dor cha mi 'dugad ni don med tshe 'di'i bya ba yun ring sdod shoms byed pa'i blo rgya thams cad cham gyis bskyur nas/ da lta nyid du myur ba myur du 'chi brod tshags su tshud pa'i chos rnam dag gang zhig mi byed par sdod ri shi snyam du/ dam pa'i lha chos byed pa la blo thag rbad kyis bcad nas chos kho na byed dgos te/ ka ni ga'i springs yig las/ 'chi bdag gis ni drangs pa na/ /dge dang sdig pa ma gtogs par/ /'gro ba thams cad phyir log nas/ /'ga' yang khyod rjes mi 'brang bar/ /mkhyen par mdzod la legs par spyod/ /ces dang / o rgyan rin po che'i zhal nas/ 'chi ba 'ong snyam med pa'i blo ring po/ /don med tshe 'di'i bya ba sgrub sgrub nas/ /da res stong log byas na mdun ma 'khrul/ /dgos ngo shes pa dam pa'i chos yin pas/ /da lta nyid du lha chos mi byed dam/ /drin can bla ma'i zhal nas 'di skad gsung / /bla ma'i gdams ngag sems la ma bzhag na/ /rang gis rang nyid bslus par mi 'gyur ram/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar da res gtan du bde ba'i btsan sa zin pa zhig ci nas kyang byed dgos/ ma 30

byas na shi ba'i 'og tu rtswa phung mes bsregs pa ltar rgyun chad nas mi 'gro/ skye ba zhig len dgos skyes pa len pa de yang las la rag las pas/ 'khor ba 'phen byed kyi las dang nyon mongs ba'i dbang gis 'khor ba'i gnas 'dir skyes phyin chad sdug bsngal ma gtogs bde ba'i go skabs skad cig tsam yang med de/ 'khor ba'i sems can spyi la skye ba'i sdug bsngal/ rga ba'i sdug bsngal/ na ba'i sdug bsngal/ 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal/ dgra mi sdug pa dang 'phrad pa'i sdug bsngal/ gnyen sdug pa dang bral ba'i sdug bsngal/ 'dod pa btsal na mi rnyed pa'i sdug bsngal/nyer len gyi phung po sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin du grub pa'i sdug bsngal/ dgra gnyen la nges pa med pa'i sdug bsngal/ 'khor ba'i phun tshogs ji tsam spyad kyang mi ngoms pa'i sdug bsngal/lus yang dang yang du 'dor ba'i sdug bsngal/ yang nas yang du nying mtshams sbyor dgos pa'i sdug bsngal/ yang nas yang du mtho dman du 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal/ grogs la yid brtan med pa'i sdug bsngal/ sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal/ 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal/ 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal sogs sdug bsngal du mas dus rtag tu mnar ba yin te/ bshes springs las/ des pa 'dod pas phongs dang 'chi ba dang / /na dang rga sogs sdug 31

bsngal du ma yi/ /'byung gnas 'khor ba 'di la skyo mdzad cing / /zhes dang / 'khor ba de 'dra lags pas lha mi dang / /dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro rnams dag tu/ /skye ba bzang po ma lags skye ba ni/ /gnod pa du ma'i gnod gyur legs mkhyen mdzod/ /ces gsungs/ bye brag dmyal ba la tsha grang gi sdug bsngal dpag tu med de/ bshes springs las/ sdig can dbugs 'byung 'gag pa tsam zhig gi /dus kyis bar du chod rnams dmyal ba yi/ /sdug bsngal gzhal yas thos nas rnam stong du/ /mi 'jig gang lags rdo rje'i rang bzhin ni/ /dmyal ba bris pa mthong dang thos pa dang / /dran dang bklag dang gzugs su bgyis rnams kyang / /'jigs pa bskyed par 'gyur na mi bzad pa'i/ /rnam smin nyams su myong na smos ci 'tshal/ /zhes dang /'di na nyin gcig mdung thung sum brgya yis/ /rab tu drag btab sdug bsngal gang lags pa/ /des ni dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal chung ngu la'ang / /'ol yang mi phyin char yang mi phod do/ /zhes dang / slob springs las/ lhag pa dpe med rus pa la yang thang pa yi/ /lus sbrebs 'dar zhing rgud nas kum kum por 'dug pa/ /chu lbur brgya 'byung rdol ba las skyes srog chags kyis/ /zos shing 'brad nas zhag dang chu ser rkang bcas 32

'jig /dkos thag so tham skra dang spu rnams g.yengs 'gyur ba/ /mig dang rna ba lkog ma gnod pas kun gzir zhing / /lus dang sems kyi bar dag rab tu slong gyur nas/ /grang ba'i dmyal bar gnas shing shin tu 'o dod 'bod/ /ces dang / skyes rabs las/ med par blta ba tshe rabs phyi ma la/ /gnas pa de na mun nag rlung grang ldang / /des ni rus pa'ang 'jig pa'i nad slong na/ /bdag la phan 'dod su zhig de ru 'jug /ces gsungs/yi dwags la bkres skom grang dro ngal dub 'jigs skrag gi sdug bsngal dpag tu med de/ bshes springs las/ yi dwags na yang 'dod pas phongs pa yis/ /bskyed pa'i sdug bsngal rgyun chags mi 'chos pa/ /bkres skom grang dro ngal dang 'jigs pa yis /bskyed pa shin tu mi bzad bsten 'tshal lo/ /kha cig kha ni khab kyi mig tsam la/ /lto ba ri yi gtos tsam bkres pas nyen/ /mi gtsang gyi nar bor ba cung zad kyang / /tshal ba'i mthu dang ldan pa ma lags so/ /kha cig pags rus lus shing gcer bu ste/ /ta la sa thog skams pa lta bu lags/ /kha cig mtshan zhing kha nas 'bar ba ste/ /zas su 'bar bas khar 'bab byed pa 'tshal/ /dmangs rigs 'ga' ni rnag dang phyi sa dang / /khrag dang mi gtsang ba yang mi rnyed de/ /phan tshun gdong du 'tshogs shing 33

mgrin pa nas/ /sba ba byung ba smin pa'i rnag la 'tshal yi dwags rnams la sos ga'i dus su ni/ /zla ba tsha la dgun ni nyi ma'ang grang/ /ljon shing 'bras bu med 'gyur 'di dag gis/ /bltas pa tsam gyis rlung yang bskems par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs/ dud 'gro la gsod za bkol spyod glen rmongs kyi sdug bsngal dpag tu med de/ bshes springs las/ dud 'gro'i skye gnas na yang gsod pa dang / /bcings dang brdeg sogs sdug bsngal sna tshogs pa/ /zhi 'gyur dge ba spangs pa rnams la ni/ /gcig la gcig za shin tu mi bzad pa/ /kha cig mu tig bal dang rus pa dang / /sha dang pags pa'i ched du 'chi bar 'gyur/ /dbang med gzhan dag rdog pa lag pa dang / /lcags dang lcags kyu gdab pas btab ste bkol/ /zhes dang / pad+ma bka' thang las/ mi la brten pa'i dud 'gro 'di dag ni/ /las su khal 'gel rmos rmo 'o zho dang / /spu 'breg sha 'byen khrag 'don btsog pa dang / /zho sha mi bsri rgal ba rdol rdol 'khur/ /khol tse ma lus ra co byad byad 'drad/ /pags pa bshu bar 'dug kyang na tsha sran/ /lus po rgas par 'dug kyang snying rus bskyed/ /skrod gzer gsod pa'i sdug bsngal dpag med yod/ /ces gsungs/ mtho ris su skyes na yang / mi la skye ba'i sdug 34

bsngal ni/ slob springs las/ shin tu mi bzad dri nga mi gtsang gcer bas 'gag /rab tu dog pa mun nag 'thib por 'dug pa yi/ /mngal gnas dmyal ba lta bu'i nang du de zhugs nas/ /lus yongs bskums la sdug bsngal chen po brnag dgos so/ /de ni rim gyis til mar bcir spyad sra ba yis/ /btsir ba ltar byas de nas ci zhig ltar te btsas/ /'on kyang mod la de srog mi 'dor gang yin pa/ /sdug bsngal nye bar spyad pas rnam par mtho mtshams mod/ /ces gsungs/ rgas pa'i sdug bsngal ni/ mdo sde rgya cher rol pa las/ bud med skyes pa'i tshogs rnams rga bas skems/ /'khri shing sa la'i nags la rlung dmar bzhin/ /rga bas brtson 'grus rtsal dang shugs 'phrog ste/ /dper na skyes bu 'dam du bying ba bzhin/ /rga bas gzugs sdug gzugs ni mi sdug byed/ /rga bas gzi brjid 'phrog cing mthu stobs 'phrog /rga bas bde ba 'phrog cing brnyas par byed/ /rga bas 'chi byed rga bas mdangs kyang 'phrog /ces gsungs/ na ba'i sdug bsngal ni/ rgya cher rol ba las/ nad brgya mang dang nad thibs sdug bsngal gyis/ /'gro ba gtses te mi yi ri dwags bzhin/ /rga dang na bas bcom pas 'gro ltos la/ /sdug bsngal las ni 'byung ba myur shog cig /dper na dgun smad rlung dang 35

kha ba che/ /rtswa shing gel ba nags sman mdangs kyang 'phrog /de ltar nad 'dis 'gro ba'i mdangs 'phrog cing / /dbang po gzugs dang stobs ni nyams pa byed/ /ces gsungs/ 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal ni/ rgya cher rol pa las/ 'chi dang 'pho dang 'chi 'pho'i dus byed pa/ /'phangs shing sdug pa'i skye bo rtag tu 'bral/ /phyir mi 'ong zhing 'phrad par 'gyur ma yin/ /shing las lo 'brul 'dra zhing rlung rgyun mtshungs/ /'chi ba dbang yod pa dag dbang med byed/ /'chi bas 'phrog byed chu bos shing ded bzhin/ /mi ni gnyis min grogs med gcig pur 'gro/ /rang las 'bras bu ldan pa'i dbang yang med/ /ces gsungs/ gzhan yang / tsha grang bkres skom ngal dub kyi sdug bsngal sogs ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal dang cha mthun yod de/ tshogs kyi gtam las/ ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal ma lus pa/ /mi rnams la yang yod par snang / /sdug bsngal gzir bas dmyal bar mtshungs/ /dbul bas gshin rje'i 'jig rten pa/ /'di yis dud 'gro'i sdug bsngal yang / /mthu ldan stobs kyis mthu med pa/ /rnam par gnod cing 'tshe ba dag /chu bo lta bu nyid yin no/ /kha cig dbul ba las gyur dang / /gzhan dag chog mi shes las 'byung / /yongs tshol sdug bsngal mi bzad dang / /thams 36

cad 'khu zhing gsod pa yin gsung / /bzhi brgya pa las/ mchog la yid kyi sdug bsngal te/ /tha mal rnams la lus kyis so/ /sdug bsngal gnyis kyis 'jig rten 'di/ /nyin re bzhin du 'joms par byed/ /ces gsungs/ lha ma yin la phrag dog gi dbang gis 'thab rtsod kyi sdug bsngal yod de/ bshes springs las/ lha min dag na'ang rang bzhin gyis lha yi/ /dpal la sdang phyir yid kyi sdug bsngal che/ /de dag blo dang ldan na'ang 'gro ba yi/ /sgrib pas bden pa mthong ba ma mchis so/ /zhes dang / pad+ma bka' thang las/ lha rnams bsod nams longs spyod che ba la/ /lha ma yin rnams phrag dog skyes nas 'thab/ /lha dang lha min g.yul bshams 'khrugs pa'i dus/ /phan tshun 'thab rtsod las su go mtshon bsten/ /mtshon cha'i 'khor los gnod pa 'ba' zhig skyel/ /lus 'di rmas nas 'drad dang shi ba dang / /ngag tu mi snyan rgyob sod sgra mang sgrog /ma shi'i bar la mer bsreg chu la bskyur/ /mgo 'breg snying 'don nang khrol blug pa dang / /nyin 'khrug mtshan 'khrug las ka dmag la byed/ /'thab rtsod sdug bsngal mi bzad dpag med yod/ /ces gsungs/ lha la 'chi 'pho ltung ba'i sdug bsngal yod de/ bshes springs las/ mtho ris na yang bde chen de dag gi/ 'chi 'pho'i sdug bsngal nyid 37

ni de bas che/ /de ltar bsam nas mkhas pa rnams kyis ni/ /zad 'gyur mtho ris slad du sred mi brgya/ /zhes dang / lha yi 'jig rten dag nas 'phos pa la/ /gal te dge ba'i lhag ma 'ga' med na/ /de nas dbang med dud 'gro yi dwags dang / /dmyal bar gnas pa gang yang rung bar 'gyur/ /zhes dang /mtho ris bu mo'i nu ma rked pa la/ /reg pa'i bde ba yun ring myong nas slar/ /dmyal bar 'thag chod 'brad pa'i 'khrul 'khor gyes/ /reg pa shin tu mi bzad bsten 'tshal lo/ /rkang pas reg pa'i nem pa bde bzod pa/ /lhun po'i spo la yun ring gnas nas ni/ /slar yang me mur ro myags rgyu ba yi/ /sdug bsngal mi bzod phog snyam bgyid 'tshal lo/ /mtho ris bu mos 'brongs shing dga' ba dang / /rnam par mdzes tshal son par brtses nas slar/ /'dab ma ral gri 'dra tshal gnas rnams kyi/ /rkang lag rna ba sna gcod thob par 'gyur/ /dal gyis 'bab pa'i lha yi bu mo ni/ /gdong mdzes gser gyi pad+ma ldan zhugs nas/ /slar yang dmyal ba'i chu bo rab med la/ /tsha rgos bzod glags chu tshan 'jug 'tshal lo/ /lha yul 'dod bde shin tu chen po dang / /tshangs nyid chags bral bde ba thob nas slar/ /mnar med me yi bud shing gyur pa yi/ /sdug bsngal rgyun mi chad pa 38

bsten 'tshal lo/ /zhes dang / tshogs kyi gtam las/ 'dod spyod lha ni gang yin pa/ /de la'ang bde ba'i sems med de/ /'dod pa'i 'dod chags rims btab pa'i/ /nang ni me yis bsreg gyur pa/ /gang zhig sems g.yeng gyur pa dag /de la bde ba ga la yod/ /ces dang / gang zhig gzugs can gzugs med pa'i/ /sdug bsngal sdug bsngal las 'das shing / /ting 'dzin bde ba'i bdag nyid can/ /bskal bar g.yo ba med par gnas/ /de yang shin tu nges grol min/ /de nas slar yang ltung bar 'gyu ra/ /zhes gsungs/ mdor na rgya mtsho chen po'i kha gting gang du bying yang sdug bsngal 'byung ba ltar/ 'khor ba'i gnas 'di'i mtho dman gang du skyes kyang sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin las ma 'das te/ mdo dran pa nyer gzhag las/ sems can dmyal ba dmyal mes nyams/ /yi dwags bkres shing skom pa sha nyams/ /dud 'gro gcig la gcig zas nyams/ /mi dag 'tsho ba thung bas nyams/ /lha min 'thab cing rtsod pas nyams/ /lha rnams bag med pa yis nyams/ /'khor ba khab kyi rtse tsam na/ /bde ba nam yang yod ma yin/ /zhes dang / sku gsum don thugs las/ kye ma rigs drug gang du skyes kyang duḥ kha'i ngang / /dmyal bar btso bsreg sdug bsngal bzod par dka'/ /bar 39

dor gshin rje'i dngangs skrag glo snying 'dar/ /dud 'gro bkol spyod sdug bsngal ya re nga / /yi dwags bkres skom sdug bsngal yi re mug /lha min 'thab rtsod sdug bsngal dbal re tsha/ /lha ru skyes na 'pho ltung snying re 'dar/ /'gro ba'i gtso gyur mi lus thob na yang / /skye ba'i sdug bsngal mthong na su yis bzod/ /rga ba'i sdug bsngal mthong na yun ring skrag /na ba'i sdug bsngal mthong na blo re ngal/ /'chi ba'i sdug bsngal bsam na ngu re bro/ /zhes dang / rje btsun byams pas/ mi gtsang ba la dri zhim med bzhin 'gro lnga dag na bde ba med/ /ces dang / po to bas/'khor ba'i sdug bsngal mthar ma phyin na/ /bde ba'i sa ni gang na yang med/ /ces dang / gzhon nu ma'i rtogs brjod las/srid mtsho tshang tshing nang na gnas pa'i byis pa rnams/ /'dir bde yin zhes pa de log par btags tsam ste/ /gang du srid pa ma lus sdug bsngal kun skyed ces/ /yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis gsungs pas so/ /zhes dang / rje skal ldan rgya mtsho'i zhal nas/ reb gong gtan gyi pha yul min/ /rong bo gtan gye yul pa min/ /khams gsum 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho 'dir/ /gnas 'dir ma skyes bya ba med/ /sngar yang skyes la da yang skye/ /skyes tshe sdug bsngal dpag med myangs/ /da res 40

btsan sa ma zin na/ /skal ldan khyod la 'o brgyal yod/ /gsungs/ lho brag mar pa'i zhal nas/ bu yis 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal soms/ /'khor ba'i rang bzhin 'di 'dra zhes/ /bdag gis lce brgyar rab sprul nas/ /bskal pa bye ba bsam yas su/ /bshad na brjod kyis mi langs pas/ /ngas bshad dam chos chud ma gsan/ /zhes dang / bzhi brgya pa las/ sdug bsngal rgya mtsho 'di las mtha'/ /rnam pa kun tu yod min na/ /byis khyod 'dir ni byeng ba la/ /'jigs pa cis na skyes mi 'gyur/ /zhes dang / mkhas pa rnams la mtho ris dang / /dmyal ba dang mtshungs 'jigs skyes 'gyur/ /rnam pa kun tu de rnams la/ /srid gang 'jigs pa mi bskyed dkon/ /zhes dang / jo bo rje'i zhal nas/ kyi hud srid pa'i lam gyis dub pa'i mgron po rnams/ /sdug bsngal bde bar mthong nas mi skyo bar/ /khyod kyang de la rtag tu chags byed pa/ /phyugs dang khyad par med par bla mas gsungs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ 'khor ba'i gnas na bde ba'i go skabs skad cig tsam yang med pa zug gzer rgyun mi chad pa'i nad pa dang 'dra'o/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal 'di las thar par dka' ba me'i 'obs chen po dang 'dra'o/ /'khor ba'i phun tshogs la zhen cing chags pa phag mi gtsang ba la zhen cing 41

chags pa dang 'dra'o/ /des na 'khor ba 'di me'i 'obs/ srin mo'i gling / dug sbrul gyi tshang lta bur bltas nas/ lha tshangs dbang gi bde ba la yang yid smon skad cig tsam yang mi byed par/ nag can btson dong nas 'bros pa ltar/ da res 'khor ba'i btson khang nang du las nyon gyi lcags sgog gis bsdams/na rga 'byor rgud 'du 'bral brdeg brdung / bkres skom grang dro ngal dub sogs sdug bsngal du ma'i chad pa nyin re bzhin gcod pa 'di las thar thabs shig ci nas myur du byed dgos te/ rgyal ba bskal bzang rgya mtshos/ khams gsum gyi gnas lus gang la'ang / /blo thub pa'i bde ba cang ma mchis/ /sdug sna dgu 'dzoms pa'i btson ra la/ /zhe blo bder sdod pa shin tu 'khrul/ /sems cang shes kha lo gyen du bsgyur/ /chos bslab pa gsum gyi srab kyis bcings/ /'bad brtson pa drag po'i lcags bzhu nus/ /da thar pa'i lam du dkyus thog chod/ /ces dang /kun mkhyen klong chen rab 'byams pas/ 'khor ba rgyal po'i btson ra 'dra/ /'khrul snang sdug bsngal dpag tu med/ /da res bde chen byang chub gling / /gtan gyi mdun ma bu zan 'ong / /zhes dang / jo bo rjes/ grogs dag 'khor ba'i 'dam rdzab 'di na skyid med pas na thar pa'i skam sar gshegs/ /bla ma'i 42

gdams ngag tshul bzhin sgoms la 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal chu bo skoms/ /zhes gsungs/ de yang rang nyid gcig pu thar pa tsam gyis mi chog ste/ de'i rgyu mtshan rang re rnams kyi tshe 'khor ba thog ma ma mchis pas na/ sems can thams cad tshe sngon rang gi pha ma sogs gnyen du ma gyur pa gcig med de/ sa'i dngos gzhi drangs pa las/ yun ring po 'das pa na/ sems can gang khyed kyi pha'am ma'am phu nu'am sring mo'am/ blon po'am/ mkhan po'am/ bla ma'am/ bla ma'i gnas lta bur ma gyur pa de ni ngas mthong ba dka'o/ /zhes dang / slob springs las/ skye ba yongs su 'dzin pa'i 'khor ba rgya chen 'dir/ /bde dang sdug bsngal rtag tu lan mang 'gras ldog pa'i/ /'gro ba gnyen ma gyur pa'i skye bo de gang med/ /ces gsungs/ khyad par sems can re res ma byas pa grangs kyis mi chod de/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyis/ sems can gcig gis ma byas pa/ /nu zho 'thung ba gang yin pa/ /rgya mtsho chen po bzhi la yang / /de yi tshad tsam yod ma yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ ma sogs gnyen du gyur dus phan tshad med pa btags/ gnod pa tshad med pa las bskyabs pa'i drin can sha stag yin pas/ dper na pha ma bu gsum mtsho chen po zhig tu lhung na/ bu mtsho nang nas tshur skam sar bud nas/ pha ma 43

gnyis ka nang na cho nge 'debs pa go/ shes bzhin du ma blangs par bskyur nas bde sa zhig tu bzhud song ba de bas khrel med pa zhig med pa bzhin rang gzhan sems can thams cad 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor lhung ba 'di las rang nyid ci thar byas pha ma sems can sdug bsngal myong ba shes bzhin yal bar dor nas/rang nyid gcig bu bde chen thar pa'i zhing du bud song na de bas khrel gzhung chung ba zhig gzhan nas med de/ slob springs las/ gang dang lhan cig 'dus nas rgod cing brtses pa dang / /glu blangs dga' mthun byas shing zas 'thung dang / /dus kyi rim pas me tog rna rgyan dngas bcas dang / /gnas skabs tsam zhig ltar mnyam mi mnyam byas pa yi/ /nye du 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho'i khongs su chud gyur pa/ /klong gi nang du lhung ba lta bur snang bzhin du/ /skye shi 'phos pas ngo ma shes pas de bor nas/ /gal te rang nyid ci thar byed na de las khrel bor med/ /byes pa bang na btsas pa ci yang mi nus pa/ /gang gi nu zho byams pa'i shugs kyis gzag 'thung ba/ /ngal ba mang bsten byams la brten pa 'di dag 'dir/ /shin tu ma rabs shig na'ang spong bar su zhig spro/ /gsungs/ rgyal ba bskal bzang rgya mtshos/ tshe 'di'i mngal du bzung ba'i ma rgan la/ /drin du rtsi 44

na skye ba grangs med cig /phan pa kho nas bskyangs pa'i sems can rnams/ /blo yis 'dor bar nus sam snying gtam yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yal bar 'dor mi rung / dper na bu mtsho 'gram du bud de rang nyid sdug bsngal ba bzhin pha ma gnyis kyang sdug bsngal gyis mnar tshul drin che tshul bsam nas mchi ma g.yo ba'i snying rje shugs drag po'i sgo nas pha ma len pa'i thabs la brtson pa ltar/ rang nyid 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyis mnar ba ji bzhin ma gyur 'gro ba kun kyang de dang 'dra/ sdug bsngal gyis rtag tu mnar ba'i 'gro ba rnams kyis rang gi tshe sngon pha dang ma byas dus drin che tshul bsam nas mchi ma g.yo ba'i snying rje chen po'i sgo nas sems can thams cad 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las sgrol ba'i 'khur rang nyid gcig pus 'khyer dgos te/ rgyal ba bskal bzang rgya mtshos/ bdag drin gyis bskyangs pa'i ma rgan rnams/ /gnas 'jigs rung 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor lhung / /sdug nyam thag ngang tshul mi bsam na/ /bu don snying gting nas rul bas na/ /rang skyid 'dod blo sna lings kyis bor/ /gzhan phan bde thabs dgu snying la bcangs/ /zhes dang / sku gsum don thugs las/ 'gro ba drug gi sems can thams cad ni/ /bdag gi pha mar ma gyur gcig 45

kyang med/ /pha ma 'di dag 'khor 'khyams snying re rje/ /brtse sems bu gcig shi ba'i ma bzhin du/ /rjekhor ba'i mtsho las sgrol bar dam bca' zhing / /zhes dang / rje rin po ches/ rang nyid srid mtshor lhung ba ji bzhin du/ /ma gyur 'gro ba kun kyang de 'dra ba/ /mthong nas 'gro ba sgol ba'i 'khur khyer ba'i/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sems can thams cad 'khor ba las sgrol bar dam bca' dgos/ 'o na da lta'i gnas skabs su sems can thams cad phar zhog sems can gcig kyang sgol ba'i nus pa ma mchis pas na/ sems can 'khor ba las sgol bar 'dod pa'i byang chub sems dpas rang nyid las nyon gyis bcings pa las grol ba'i nyan rang dgra bcom gyi go 'phang lta bu'i thar pa tsam zhig don du gnyer bas mi chog par/ thar pa bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang 'thob par bya dgos te/ sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob na yon tan ci tsam yod zer na/ sku'i yon tan ni/ mtshan bzang sum cu dang / dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus spras pa/ blta bas chog mi shes te/ dpe la bstod pa las/ khyed sku mtshan dpes spras gyur pa/ /mdzes gyur mig gi bdud rtsi ni/ /sprin med ston gyi nam mkha' la/ /skar ma'i tshogs kyis spras pa 'dra/ /thub pa 46

gser gyi mdog ldan pa/ /chos gos kyis g.yogs mdzes gyur pa/ /gser gyi ri bo'i rtse mo ni/ /mtshams kyi sprin gyis dkris pa 'dra/ /mgon khyod rgyan gyis ma brgyan kyang / /zhal gyi dkyil 'khor mdangs gang yin/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor rgyas gyur pa/ /sprin dang bral la'ang de ma mchis/ /khyod kyi zhal gyi pad+ma dang / /pad+ma nyi mas kha bye ba/ /bung bas mthong nas pad+ma ni/ /the tshom dpyang thag la 'jug 'gyur/ /khyed zhal gser gyi mdog ldan par/ /tshems dkar mjes par gyur pa ni/ /gser gyi ri gseb ston ka yi/ /zla zer dri med zhugs pa 'dra/ /mchod 'os khyod kyi phyag g.yas ni/ /'khor lo'i mtshan gyis mdzes gyur pa/ /'khor bas skrag pa'i mi rnams la/ /phyag gis dbugs 'byin mdzad pa lags/ /thub khyod gshegs par gyur pa'i tshe/ /zhabs gnyis dpal gyi pad+ma 'dra/ /sa gzhi 'di ni bris gyur pa/ /pad+ma can gyis ji ltar mdzes/ /zhes gsungs/ gsung gi yon tan ni/ 'jig rten gyi khams kyi sems can gang yod kyis dus gcig tu dri ba mi 'dra ba kho na re re nas dris kyang /sems kyis skad cig gcig dang ldan pa'i shes rab kyis bzung nas/ gsung gcig gis dri ba thams cad kyi lan mdzad cing / de rnams kyis kyang rang rang gi skad du go bar 'gyur ba 47

shin tu rmad du byung ste/ bden pa po'i le'u las/ 'di ltar sems can kun gye nges pa'i tshig /mang po dag gis dus gcig zhu zhus na/ /sems kyi skad cig gcig la thugs chud nas/ /gsung dbyangs gcig gis so sor lan kyang 'debs/ /de lta bas na 'dren pa 'jig rten na/ /tshangs pa'i sgra dbyangs gsung sgrog mkhyen par mdzod/ /de ni lha mi'i sdug bsngal mthar 'byen pa'i/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor bar mdzad/ /ces gsungs/ gzhan yang brgya lnga bcu pa las/ khyod zhal lta na rab sdug pa/ /de las nyan na snyan pa yi/ /gsung 'di dag ni zla ba las/ /bdud rtsi 'dzag pa bzhin du 'byung / /khyod kyi gsung ni 'dod chags kyi/ /rdul rab zhi mdzad char sprin 'dra/ /zhe sdang sbrul ni dbyung ba la/ /nam mkha' lding dang 'dra ba la/ /yang dang yang du mi shes pas/ /rab rib 'joms pa'i gdugs dang 'dra/ /nga rgyal ri bo mngon 'joms pa/ /rdo rje dang yang 'dra ba lags/ /don gzigs pas ni mi bslu ba/ /nor mi mnga' phyir rjes su mthun/ /legs par sbyar bas go sla ste/ /khyod kyi gsung ni legs gsung ldan/ /re zhig dang por khyed kyi gsung / /nyan pa rnams kyi yid 'phrog mdzad/ /de nas yid la sems bgyis na/ /'dod chags gti mug rnams kyang sel/ /phongs pa rnams 48

kyi dbugs 'byen cing / /bag med rnams kyi skyabs kyang mdzad/ /bde ba can dag skyo bgyid pas/ /khyod gsung kun dang 'tshams par 'jug /mkhas pa rnams kyis dga' ba bskyed/ /bar ma rnams kyi blo yang spel/ /tha ma'i rab rib rnam 'joms pas/ /gsung 'di skye bo kun la sman/ /zhes gsungs/ thugs kyi mkhyen pa'i yon tan ni/ shes bya ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa thams cad la lag mthil du skyu ru ra bzhag pa ltar/ mkhyen pa thogs pa mi mnga' bar 'jug pas/ shes bya mtha' dag mkhyen pas khyab pa yin te/ bsngags 'os bsngags bstod las/ khyod 'ba' zhig gi ye shes kyis/ /shes bya mtha' dag khyab lags kyi/ /khyod las gzhan pa thams cad kyi/ /shes bya kho na lhag pa lags/ /zhes dang / bcom ldan dus kun gtogs pa'i chos/ /rnam kun 'byung gnas thams cad ni/ /lag mthil sgyu ru ra lta bur/ /khyod kyi thugs kyi spyod yul gyur/ /chos rnams g.yo dang mi g.yo bcas/ /gcig dang sna tshogs so so la/ /mkha' la rlung ni rgyu ba bzhin/ /khyod kyi thugs dag thogs mi mnga'/ /zhes gsungs/ brtse ba'i yon tan ni/ sems can thams cad nyon mongs kyis rang dbang med par bcing ba bzhin du/ sangs rgyas kyang snying rje chen pos rang dbang med par bcings pas/49

'gro ba rnams sdug bsngal bar gzigs pa na/ thugs rje chen po rgyun chad med par skye ste/ brgya lnga bcu pa las/ 'gro ba 'di dag thams cad ni/ /khyad med nyon mongs rnams kyis bcings/ /khyod ni 'gro ba'i nyon mongs dag /dgrol slad yun ring thugs rjes bsdams/ /zhes dang / bden pa po'i le'u las/ gti mug mun pa mun nag gis rtag tu/ /sems ni 'grib par gyur pa'i skye dgu dang / /'khor ba'i btson rar tshud pa rnams gzigs na/ /drang srong dam pa de ni thugs rje skye/ /zhes dang / thub pa'i thugs rje chen po rtags 'byung ste/ /de mi 'byung ba nam yang srid mi 'gyur/ /'gro ba kun gyi bsam par gnas pa ste/ /de bas sangs rgyas de la skyon mi mnga'/ /zhes dang / 'jug pa las/ gti mug skyon gyis 'jig rten kha zas dug bcas za ba yi/ /skye bo nyid kyi nang mi de la khyod brtse ji lta ba/ /de ltar dug zos nyen pa'i bu la ma yi sdug bsngal min/ /zhes gsungs/'phrin las kyi yon tan ni/ sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi 'phrin las lhun gyes grub cing / rgyun mi chad pa gnyis kyis sems can thams cad la phan 'dogs mdzad nas phun sum tshogs pa dang ma sprad pa dang / rgud pa las ma drangs pa med pas bgyi bar 'os pa thams cad nges par mdzad pa yin te/ brgya lnga 50

bcu pa las/ khyod kyi nyon mongs gzhom pa bshad/ /bdud kyi g.yo dag bstan par mdzad/ /'khor ba'i rang bzhin mi bzang brjod/ /'jigs pa med pa'i phyogs kyang bstan/ /phan dgongs thugs rje can gyi ni/ /sems can rnams la bgyid 'tshal ba/ /gang zhig khyod kyis ma mdzad pa/ /gzhan ko ci zhig mchis lags kye/ /zhes dang / bsngags 'os bsngags bstod las/ khyod kyis gang la 'gro ba dag /ma drangs rgud pa de gang mchis/ /gang dang 'jig rten ma sprad pa'i/ /phun tshogs de yang gang zhig mchis/ /zhes gsungs/ rgyas par bshad rgyu yin na/sangs rgyas ni skyon kun zad/ yon tan kun ldan yin pas/sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dpag tu med pa 'tshogs nas sangs rgyas kyi yon tan bskal pa grangs med par brjod kyang rdzogs pa'i yul las 'das te/'jug pa las/ nam mkha' med pas 'dab chags ldog par mi 'gyur gyi/ /'di ni rang mthu zad pas ldog par 'gyur de bzhin/ /slob ma dang bcas sangs rgyas sras rnams sangs rgyas kyi/ /yon tan mkha' ltar mtha' yas ma brjod ldog par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / rje bdag nyid chen po'i zhal nas/ khyed kyi sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba yi/ /tshul 'di rgyal sras rang rgyal 51

rnams kyis kyang / /ci tsam rtogs kyang blo yi yul min na/ /tshangs dang dbang po sogs kyis smos ci 'tshal/ /mkha' lding dbang po mkha' la bgrod bgrod nas/ /nam zhig rang stobs bri bas ldog 'gyur gye/ /nam mkha' zad pas ldog par mi 'gyur bzhin/ /khyod kyi yon tan brjod pa'ang de ltar lags/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dper na 'dod 'byung nor bur yon tan mang po yod tshul blo ldan rnams kyis go na yid 'phrog nas pha yul nor rdzas sgyur/ pha ma gnyen bshes bzhag lus dang srog la mi blta bar bdag gi lag tu dbul phongs kun sel ba'i nor bu de lta bu zhig myur du 'ong ba'i phyir ded dpon rgyus yod bsten gru gzings bsdams nas rgya mtshor zhugs nas gser gling du song nas len pa ltar/ de lta bu'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob na yon tan yod tshul gyis yid rang dbang med par 'phrog nas/ skal ldan dbang po yang rab rnams kyi pha yul khang zhing / pha ma bu dang chung ma nor rdzas sogs tshe 'di'i bya ba thams cad blos btang nas/ ma sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che de lta bu zhig myur du thob pa'i phyir du/ mtshan ldan bla ma bsten mdo sngags kyi chos la thos bsam byas/ de nas ri khrod dben pa'i dga' tshal 52

bsten nas tshul bzhin bsgom dgos/de ltar byed pa la thog mar tshe blos thongs pa 'di shin tu gal che/ bye tshang rin chen dpal 'byor gyis/ mi lus rin chen lan cig thob pa 'di'i steng nas/ thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang sgrub dgos pa lags so/ /de bsgrub par byed pa la dam pa'i chos byed dgos/ chos byed pa la 'jig rten gyi bya ba thams cad blos lings kyis gtong dgos pa gda'/ gsungs/ dper na pha yul bskyur nas rgya mtsho'i gling du ma song na nor bu mi lon pa ltar/ tshe 'di'i bya ba thams cad blos ma btang na/ chos rnam dag cig 'ong ba rgyal dang sras bcas rnams kyis ma gsungs te/ skyes rabs las/ gal te chos spyod khyim gyi so nam 'chor/ /khyim la phyogs na chos kyang ga la 'grub/ /chos kyi las ni rab tu zhi ba yin/ /khyim gyi don ni drag shul can gyis 'grub/ /de bas chos dang 'gal ba'i skyon yod phyir/ /bdag la phan 'dod su zhig khyim na gnas/ /zhes dang / gsang ba spyi rgyud las/ 'jig rten pha rol don gnyer bas/ /dad pa mang du byed pa yis/ /blo ldan dkyil 'khor 'jug bya yi/ /tshe 'di'i 'bras bu 'dod mi bya/ /tshe 'di 'dod par gyur pa la/ /'jig rten pha rol don mi 'gyur/ /'jig 53

rten pha rol don gnyer skyes/ /'jig rten 'di yi 'bras bu rgyas/ /zhes dang / zla ba sgon ma'i mdo las/ 'dod pa dag ni rab tu bsten byed cing / /yul dang nye 'brel dag la sred bskyed nas/ /smad par byas pa'i khyim la gnas pa de/ /nam yang bla med byang chub mchog mi thob/ /ces dang / sgra sgyur chen po mar pa lo tsa'i zhal nas/ bu 'jig rten blos ma thongs par 'di yi bya ba dang / dam pa'i chos bsres na chos shor zin pa de rang yin gsungs/ sa skya paṇa chen rin po che'i zhal nas/tshe 'di'i phun tshogs che thabs ma shor bar/ /gtan gyi phan bde thar pa re ba de/ /rmongs pa'i zhe 'dod gzu lum nyid yin pas/ /tshe 'di blos thongs 'bad pas byang chub sgrubs/ /zhes dang / chos rje rgyal sras pas kyang / dam pa'i chos dang tshe 'di'i mdun ma gnyis/ /mnyam du sgrub pa su zhig yod ma yin/ /sgrub par 'dod pa de dag rang nyid kyis/ /rang nyid bslu ba nyid la the tshom med ces dang / khro phu lo tsā ba'i zhal nas/ tshe srog lbu bar ma shes shing / /shes nas 'chi ba ma dran na/ /dge phyogs mang po byas gyur kyang / /da dung tshe 'di'i lag cha yin/ /rnyed grags sgyu mar ma shes shing / /che 'dod khe grags ma bor na/ /mi yi dam par bzung gyur kyang / /da dung chos 54

brgyad khol po yin/ /tshe 'di thed la ma bor na/ /ji tsam dge la 'bad byas kyang / /phyi mar lag stong gcer bur 'gro/ /phyi ma ci 'khyer a tsa ma/ /'khor ba'i nyes dmigs ma go zhing / /'dod yon tshim pa ma mchis na/ /kha lta'i rbad kham che na yang / /da dung zog po dzun can yin/ /zhes dang / 'ba' ra bas tshe 'di don du gnyer ba la/ /sangs rgyas thob pa mi srid pas/ /tshe 'di'i bsam pa kun bor nas/ /bya ba thongs shig rgyal mtshan dpal/ /gsungs/ rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa'i zhal nas/srid pa'i bya bzhag 'jig rten mi chos dang / /gtan gyi bde ba sgrub pa'i lha chos gnyis/ /'gal med zung du 'brel ba'i byed chos ni/ /tsha grang lta bur gcig tu 'gal chos min/ /'on te rje btsun seng ge dbang phyug dang / /rje btsun mi la me long rdo rje sogs/ /chos brgyad gtan spangs sngon byon rnam thar la/ /snying nas thar 'dod su zhig cis mi mos/ /gsungs/ bla ma zhang gis/lar chos pa kun gyis tshe 'di dang phyi ma gnyis ka mi 'grig ste/gang yang med pa gcig las mi 'ong gsungs/ yang / mda' gcig gis sha ba gnyis mi gsod/ khye gcig gis gla ba gnyis mi zin/ khab rtse gnyis kyis tshem bu mi btub/ rkang pa ya gcig yar la bor/ ya gcig mar la bor bas rang 'dod sar mi sleb/55

de bzhin tshe 'di dang phyi ma gnyis ma 'grub gsungs/ bye tshang pas/ lto skyid skyid mo/ gos dro dro mo/ mi rjes snyog snyog mo/ rang la za rgyu yod pa/ gzhan la ster rgyu yod pa/ bun skyed gtong rgyu yod pa gcig 'dod na/ chos rnam dag 'ong ba'i re thag chad pa yin gsungs/ po to bas gsung thog ma'i blo sbyong du drangs pa las/ shi spar rtod phur chu rdug 'khyer/ /g.yag med i dka' ko rlon bstums/ /gzhu 'phong rgyang mda' khas brgya smra/ /zhes pa/mi 'chi kha ma'i spar bar khab skud lta bu tshud na shi nas 'bral thabs med de/ de bzhin du tshe 'di'i bde skyid la shi spar 'tham pa de 'bral thabs mi rnyed/ chos yong sa med be'u rtod phur la btags pa de rang gis ma mthong bar rgyug pas/ dang po thag 'dom gang la breng gis 'gro/ de nas thag pas 'then pa dang skor skor byas pas/ thag pa ring po rtod phur la dkris nas/ol ko phur ba la bkal sdod pa min pa 'khyog thabs med pa 'ong / de bzhin du dang po chos shig byed snyam rgyugs kyang / tshe 'di'i zas gos sogs la zhen pa'i rtod phur ma phyin pas/'khyong thabs med pa re yong bar snang / dge bshes gsal shes zer ba zhig gis sde 'khrugs byas pas shi bas/ dge bshes ston pa'i zhal nas/ nga'i gsal shes lo gsum gyi gong du shi na/ sde 56

snod gsum pa zhig shi ba yin pa la/ lo gsum gyis shi ba phyis gsungs/ kho'i rtod phur dgon pa des byas/ rtod phur che 'bring chung gsum po 'di spong nus na chos mi yong ba'i don rang med/ rtsid bu so rnyis zin pa la/ mdzo rgod kyi 'ur byas pas chag ba thag gi thag pa la re'u rgyags thog don med gsungs/ rta phyugs sogs chu la sgrol ba la/ dang po nas tsham tshom med par ma btang na/ chu rdug 'khyer nas/ 'gror mi nyan par 'phul yang tshur phul yong / rtsid bu chu mi 'dod pa la kha chur bcug kyang 'gos pa tshun chad sprug tu 'ong / de bzhin du tshe 'di'i zhen pa btsan thabs su bcad nas chos shig ma byas na/ de nas zhen pa mi spong bar phar bskul yang tshur smrar ru 'ong / sngar bslab pa tshun chad kyang med par byed gsungs/g.yag rmed de dam na rma 'chos kha la mi brtan/ de bzhin du tshe 'di la glod ma thon pas/ rang gzhan yo rdug la sbyor/ tshe 'di la glod shes pa zhig byung na yong ste nyan du mi btub gsungs/ i dka' zhes pa/ dbyangs la sogs pa 'then pa la dang po i zer ba de 'thon pa dka'/ 'go de rgyang rgyang 'then thub byung na de nas sla/ de bzhin du chos byed pa la dang por tshe 'di blos thongs pa rang dka' ba yin/ 'di lan cig thongs na de nas 57

las sla/ sdug pa rang de yang 'dod yon 'di rang yin/ de min na tshur thongs dang / rang re kham pa nang dzu'i kha na med kyi gsungs/ skyes bu dam pa rnams tshe blos thongs na chos mi 'ong ba'i don med/ 'di dka' ba yin 'di la gcig sgril dang zhes nan tan gyis gsungs par gda' yang / rang re ni 'di chos kha dmas nas/ mthon po rang zhig 'tshol/ ma thar gang yang min pa re 'ong bar gda'/ yang mi ko rlon gyis btums pa de dang po lhod lhod 'dra yang bskams nas 'khyog thabs med par bsdams nas na tsha bskyed/ gri rnon gcig gis de trol na skyed lhan gyis 'gro /de bzhin du tshoms las/ nor bu rna cha bu dang bu mo la/ /yongs su chags sems gang yin la bltas na/ /lcags shing dres ma la byas 'ching ma gang / /de dag dam po min zhes 'phags pa gsungs/ /'dod pas 'ching ma gang yin de lhod kyang / /rab tu grol bar dka' zhes 'phags pa gsungs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ tshe 'di'i 'dod yon la chags pa zhig yod phyin chad/ dang po lhod lhod 'dra yang gal la thug na ye rang mi spong bar rang gi sdom pa tshun chad blos gtong nus pa re yong bar snang / de na tshe 'di'i zhen chags 'di trol ba la shes rab kyi gri rnon po/ dad pa'i ltag mtshan 58

yod pa zhig rang gis byed dgos/ spyir 'dod yon lnga/ de'i nang nas lto gos gnyis/ de yang gos bzhi cha lnga cha yin/ lto'i zhen pa 'di yang trol bar dka' gsungs/ dmag 'thab pa'i dus gzhu 'phongs byed du rmog gis ma bde ba la/ rkang chas phud pas mi phan/ rmog gcig rang ci phud byed gos/ 'ben drung du bzhag nas mda' rgyang du 'phen/ rkun ma nags la song ba'i rjes spang la gcod/ 'dre shar dang glud nub/ chos ma byung tshad tshe 'di ma spangs pas lan 'dug pa las/ mthon po zhig gi lan pa skad gsungs/ shin tu mad par snang / da lta mtshan nyid pa'am/ sgom chen nam bka' gdams pa phal che ba zhig rlung dbu mar thim pa'i gegs gang gis byas pa dang / de 'dra ba'i mtho mtho mo zhig gis rtsad gcod/ 'di 'dra mar gnad la gtugs phyin rtsad gcod pa ni/ nyin mo'i skar ma bas kyang dkon par gda'/ sa mthon po'i spang rtogs/ zhag gnyis nged rang gi nyams su mi lon pa/ de rnams las nged rang la da lta mi dgos ka med rnams rtsad gcod na dga' ba la snyam pa yong bar gda'/ 'di 'dra rnams dper na da lta rang mu ges 'chi la khad pa zhig sbyin gtong phyug po'i khyim du phyin nas/ da lta mi dgos ka med kyang bza' btung mi khyer bar nam phug phan du 59

re ba'i gser dngul 'dra 'khyer yong bar 'dra bar snang / khas brgya smrar zhes pa/ kham pa rnams gtam gtong dus khas brgya smra/rnga ma stong g.yugs kyang don 'di yin zhes/ gtam gye mdo re smra/ de bzhin du thos bsam sgom gsum ci byas kyang / chos ma byung ba tshe 'di'i skyid 'dod 'dis lan gsungs/ skyes bu rnams khong gi gsung 'di kun la go rgyu zhig rang gda'/ da lta rang re snyigs dus kyi chos byed rnams/ bka' rgya che/ lung grangs mang / ji skad gsungs kyang tril gyis dril na nga la da lta sgrub bya dang / spang bya gzhan gang yang med/ tshe blos thongs pa zhig 'dod snyam pa byas kyin 'bungs dgos gsungs pa der gda'/ de 'dra zhig dgos/ gzhan gang gis kyang phan pa med do skyes bu kun/ gong mo them rtsa wa dang spre/ gong mo zhes pa rong gi chu'i tshur khar sre mong gis gong mo'i ske nas bzung / der gong mos pha khar 'phur bas/ sre mo shed/ gong mo 'bri skam 'dra ba zhig bsad lags te/ pha yul mes btsan zhig dang gtan bral byas zer lo/ de bzhin tshe 'di'i mig nyes 'dis/ 'dod yon re dang myong ste/ mtho ris thar pa dang gtan bral byas gsungs/ them rtsa zhes pa 'di nas rgya gar du 'gro ba la dpag tshad brgya'i pha rol gyi g.yang sa rtsad gcod pa min pa/60

them rtsa'i g.yang la zon ma byas pas der lhung nas shi ba bzhin du/ sa lam mthon po'i spangs rtogs rtsad gcod pa min pa/ tshe 'di'i zhen pa'i g.yang la zon ma byung bas der lhung nas ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal phyong / des na skyu srab pa dga' ste skyu rtsa la gzab gsungs/ wa dang spre zhes pa/ wa gzha' mkhas te rde'u tsam re'i rgyab tu'ang gzha' thub/ spre 'khri mkhas te 'jag ma tsam la'ang 'khri shes/ g.yi gab mkhas pas gas pa rta rnga tsam re'i nang du'ang gab shes/ de bzhin du tshe 'di'i mig nyes 'di gzha' mkhas/ 'khri mkhas/ gab mkhas te mkhas btsun bzang gsum 'dzoms pa'am/ thos bsam sgom gsum mam/ bya btang kun spangs yin zer ba la'ang tshe 'di'i mig nyes re 'ong gsungs/ zla ba phyugs lhag lhan cig min/ zla ba zhes pa/ zhog lung bar mi zhig gi bu shi bas gza' zla ba gnod byas pas/der kho zla ba la mi sha len zer/ khos tshes bcu bzhi'i nub mo/zla ba 'char ba'i ri mgo yid la bzhag nas/ bco lnga'i nub mo mda' gzhu 'khyer phyin pas/ ri mgor sleb pa dang / zla ba pha tshad du song 'dug pas/ was kyang ra ba 'dis bya btang nas zer lo/ de bzhin du 'o cag cis kyang chos shig bya snyam/ thos bsam sgom gsum sogs ci byas kyang chos dang 'phrad rgyu med 61

par je ring du song gsungs/ des na tshe 'di la rtag par 'dzin pa 'di/ yon tan brgya yod kyang skyon gcig gi 'og tu tshud pa yin pas/ phyi mar phan pa gang yang med/ des na tshe 'dir zhen nas phyi ma phan chad kyis rtog pa med par/ sangs rgyas kyi sa tshun chad gtan la phab kyang phan pa med dud 'gro dang khyad par med ces sha ra bas gsungs/ po to ba'i zhal nas ltog gi dogs pa las shi yi dogs pa ni ye mi 'dug na gsungs/phyugs lhag ces pa ni/ tshe 'di shes pa la khyo ga grung por rtsi na phyugs dang dud 'gro ded rang las lhag pa yod/ dmigs bus tshang la gnam phug byas/ sbrul gyis ded pa dang / kho rang gis gnam phug bzos pa de la byin/ sbrul gyis rked par so btab nas gsad lo/ gzhan yang spras kyis bral rgyab tu bya rog 'ug pas bya rog gi phrug gu bsad nas zos/ bya rog gis kyang 'ug pa'i phrug gu khos gang du bsad sa dang zos sa der 'khyer nas bsad zos kyi lan byas/ 'ug pa sha glan pa dang / rgyal du g.yag yu mo dang rwa can 'thab pa dgagayag rwa can gyis yu bor brdung / khos 'khon bzung 'thab lugs sbyangs te slar 'thab pas rwa can bsad pa byung ngo / /ke gas bya rog la dmag drangs pa ni/ ke ka la bya rog gis gnod pa byas/ ke gas stod lung gi ke ka tshun bsdus/'phan yul gyi bya rog la sha glan pa byung gsungs/ gnyen dang bu skyong ba 62

sogs ni/ de bas kyang dud 'gro mkhas te/ zla ba re la'ang pha mnyam bu mnyam tshar/ gsog rum dang bzo mkhas pa ni/byi ba dang / khug rta dang / bung ba sogs la ltos/ des na tshe 'di'i don tsam las sgrub mi nus na/ skyes bu'am mi zhes pa'i ming don rang yang ma tshang gsungs/ lhan cig min zhes pa ni/tshe 'di ma nyams pa gcig dang / phyi ma'i chos gnyis lhan cig tu mi yong / pags pa gcig la spu brang lag pas theg tshad gcig dang / rlid bu chu thub gnyis 'ong sa med gsungs/ de'i rgyu mtshan/ dper na ri dgas sgra yis phung / glang chen reg byas phung / phye ma leb gzugs kyis phung / nya mo ro yis phung / sbrang ma dri yis phung ba bzhin/ lus reg bya 'jam pa'i gos/ rna bar snyan pa'i sgra/ mig tu mdzes pa'i gzugs/ lcer ro mngar zas/ sna ru zhim pa'i dri 'dod nas de'i don la 'bad rgyu zhig gi dbang du song na/ de la chos shig 'ong ba phar zhog sdig sdug gtam ngan gyi mtsho rdol nas nam yang bde ba'i go skabs med de/ legs gdams las/ khri snyan sa le sogs ri dwags kha cig glu skad la sogs pa'i sgra la chags pas sems g.yeng ba dang rngon pas gsod pa yin lo/ glang bo che 'dul sbyong ma byas pa gang dgar rgyu ba de/ glang mo'i reg bya la chags pas der 63

kor kor byas pa dang / glang dzis lcags kyu btab ste rnag khrag chal chil byas btul te khur lci ba rnams 'khur dgos pa byung /phye ma leb me'i kha dog de dag la chags te phyin pas mes tshiganya ro la chags pas/ nya pas lcags kyu'i rtse la sha lta bu'i ro zhim pa zhig sbyar te btang bas/ zas de zos pas sgog ma la lcags kyus phug ste 'chi ba yin par gda'/ yang lho bal tsho na/shing rnga bo che 'dra ba zhig la rdzas dri zhim po zhig byugs te bzhag pas/ sbrang ma rnams dri la chags pas der mang po tshang bcas te sbrang rtsi gsog der mi des mdung zhig rgyab pas sbrang rtsi sngo nar ba lha'i bdud rtsi 'dra ba zhig 'ong / der kho rang lho pas longs spyad nas/ lhag ma sbrang dang srin bu dang spra tshil rnams skyo mar ldur btang ba de 'khyer yong ba yin skad de/der ma shi ba'i sbrang ma rnams mya ngan gyes chu la lcebs nas 'chi ste/ de rnams 'dod yon re res phung ba yin/ 'o skol rnams lnga gas brlag pa yin gsungs/ slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis/ri dwags glang po phye ma leb dang nya/ /sbrang ma lnga po lnga yis bcom gyur te/ /gcig gis 'joms na gang zhig lnga rnams ni/ /rtag tu bsten pa ci phyir 'joms mi 'gyur/ /zhes dang /spyod 'jug las/ bsags dang bsrung dang brlag pa'i gdung 64

ba yi/ /nor ni phung khrol mtha' yas shes bya ste/ /nor la chags pas g.yeng bar gyur pa rnams/ /srid pa'i sdug bsngal las grol skabs med do/ /zhes dang / 'jig rten 'di dang pha rol tu'ang / /'dod pa rnams ni phung khrol bskyed/ /'dir ni bsad dang bcings dang gcod/ /pha rol tu ni dmyal sogs sgrub/ /ces dang / 'dod pa rnams la mtshon dang ni/ /dug dang me dang g.yang sa dang / /dgra rnams kyis kyang dper mi phod/ /de ltar 'dod la skyo byas nas/ /dben pa la ni dga' ba bskyed/ /ces dang / dpal gsang ba grub pa las/ til 'bru tsam gye dngos po yang / /yongs su bzung bar mi bya'o/ /yongs su 'dzin las sdug bsngal 'byung / /sdug bsngal las ni sems 'khor 'gyur gsung / bram ze mda' bsnun gyis/ til gyi shun pa tsam gyi zug rngus kyang / /nam zhig sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig bskyed par byed/ /ces gsungs/ zla ba'i snying po'i mdo las/ji ltar chu shing 'od ma dang / /'dam bu 'bras bus 'joms byed cing / /dre'u mo mngal gyis 'joms pa ltar/ /rnyed dang bkur bstes mi ngan 'joms/ /ji ltar ser ba 'bab pa yis/ /lo tog thams cad 'joms pa ltar/ /de ltar rnyed dang bkur bste yis/ /byang chub lam ni 'joms par byed/ /ji 65

ltar ske tog rgyas pa yi/ /shing dang me tog mes bsreg ltar/ /de bzhin rnyed dang bkur bste yis/ /byang chub lam dag 'joms byed do/ /dge slong gang gis rnyed pa dang / /bkur bsti chen po rnyed gyur pa/ /bdud kyis nyams par shes byas te/ /mkhas pas de nas 'gro bar bya/ /ji ltar rnyed dang bkur bste ni/ /thob nas lam ni 'joms byed pa/ /thar pa'i lam rnams 'joms pa yi/ /sdig pa de 'dra yod ma yin/ /zhes dang /brgyad stong pa las/ 'dod pa yid la byed pa dang nor dang 'bru phun sum tshogs pa dag yid la byed pa dag 'byung bar 'gyur te/ rab 'byor 'di yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ /zhes dang /slob dpon klu sgrub kyis/ des pa bdog mang ji ltar sdug bsngal ba/ /'dod pa chung rnams de ltar ma yin te/ /klu mchog rnams la mgo bo ji snyed pa/ /de las byung ba'i sdug bsngal de snyed do/ /zhes dang / 'dod pa rnams ni phung khrol bskyed pa de/ /rgyal ba'i dbang pos kim pa'i 'bras 'drar gsungs/ /de dag spang bgyid de yi lcags sgog gis/ /'khor ba'i btson rar 'jig rten 'di dag bcings/ /zhes dang / lang gar gshegs pa'i mdo bslab btus su drangs pa las/ sha za ba'i nyes 66

dmigs la/ gdol ba gzhung lugs la mi brten pa/ /rigs ngan rme sha can gyi rigs/ /btso lag mkhan du yang yang skye/ /zhes gsungs/ thang yig shel brag ma las/ rang la mi phan gzhan gnod kha zas 'di/ /mis 'phya rang phung chang nag bdud las yin/ /'gyod pa phyi la ma byed sngon bsam thongs rang gis rang nyid ma bslu rjes 'bangs rnams/ /zhes dang / o rgyan rin po che'i zhal nas/ chang la 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dang / /nga rgyal phrag dog nyon mongs ma lus pa/ /slong ba'i rgyun kun 'di la tshang bas na/ /de phyir chang nag ma 'thung zhal gdams yin gsungs/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyis/ chang ni 'jig rten brnyas 'gyur zhing / /don yal nor yang zad par 'gyur/ /rmongs pas bya ba ma yin byed/ /de bas chang ni rtag tu spongs/ /zhes dang / mdo dran pa nyer bzhag las/ mthong dang reg dang bsnams pa las/ /chang gis mi ni rmongs par byed/ /de bas kun tu zhags pa yin/ /de ni ring bar yongs su spongs/ /mthong ba la ni chags pa skye/ /reg pa la ni dri 'byung la/ /dri las ro la chags pa 'byung / /ro rnams kyis ni tha mar 'gro/ /ji ltar chang la nges bsten na/ /da ltar ming dang gzugs 'jig ste/ /zhags pa'i nang na tha ma yin/ /chang zhes 67

mkhas pa rnams kyis gsungs/ /ngag dang mig dang 'gro ba nyid/ /tshab po che ni 'khrul byed pa/ /blo bral rmongs pas 'khrul ba ni/ /ci yang sgrub par mi byed do/ /sa la lhung ba'i mi de la/ /bud med rnams kyang 'phya' bar byed/ /ha la ha la'i dug pas lhag /sgye bo kim pa'i me tog ltar/ /mang ba kho nar byed pa yin/ /zhes dang / bshes springs las/ ji ltar mje can srin bus nyen pa na/ /bde ba'i don du me la kun bsten kyang / /zhi bar mi 'gyur de nyid 'dra ba ni/ /'dod pa rnams la'ang chags pa'ang mkhyen par mdzod/ /ces dang / phar phyin bsdus pa las/ /'dod pa de dag thob pa dang / /nyin gcig bzhin du bsten pa dang / /mang du bsags pas mi ngoms na/ /de las nad che gang zhig yod/ /ces dang / slob springs las/'dod pa rnams dang 'byor dang srid gsum rgyal ba yi/ /sgyu ma smig rgyu chu zla rba rlabs 'dra bar gsungs/ /rmi lam lta bur ngan spyod 'khrul bas bslus pa yi/ /byes pa gang dag de la chags pa dmyal bar ltung / /zhes dang / gzi brjid can gyi mdo las/rnyed pa dang bkur bste la brten pa'i dge slong gis kun nas nyon mongs pa bye ba phrag dgu bcu rtsa dgur 'gyur te/ de dag gis mtshams med pa'i sa thob par 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang /68
