'dod pa la gdams pa'i mdo las/ dge slong 'dod pa rnams las sems ldog cig lam 'di ni 'jigs pa dang bcas pa'o/ /rab tu 'jigs pa dang bcas pa'o/ /tsher ma dang bcas pa'o/ /'thi ba bo dang bcas pa'o/ /lam gol pa'o/ /lam ngan pa'o/ /lam kha phrag go /skyes bu dam pa ma yin pas bsten pa'o/ /zhes dang / dwags po lha rje yis/ nor rdzas sgyu ma'i bslu brid sdug bsngal rgyu/ /pha yul bdud kyi btson ra 'ching byed mkhan/ /su dag 'di la zhen pa 'khor bar 'khor/ /'khor ba'i khong snying bdag 'dzin rtsa ba chod/ /ces dang / gsang ba'i bdag pos/ khyad par skyes pa la bud med bdud du che/bud med la skyes pa bdud du che/ thun mong du lto gos gnyis bdud du che gsungs/ jo bo rjes/ 'dod pa'i gzhi la chags pa'i rgyus/ /sgrub pa'i spyod las nyams pa'i mi/ /'jig rten 'das dang 'jig rten gye/ /phun sum tshogs pa thams cad las/ /shin tu ring ba kho nar 'gyur/ /'khor ba'i btson ra nyam nga ru/ /nyon mongs 'ching ba sna tshogs kyis/ /rab tu bsdams pas nyam thag cing / /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal dpag med kyis/ /de yi rgyud gdungs mi bder 'gyur/ /de yi phyir na blo ldan dag /'dod pa'i gzhi la chags spangs te/ /chos sgrub 69

gtso bor bya bar rigs/ /'dod la chags bral bya ba'i phyi ra/ /'dod pa'i nyes pa dpag med pa/ /gzhung las 'byung ba rtogs byas la/ /rtag tu tshul bzhin yid la bya/ /zhes dang / rgya cher rol pa las/ rtag tu gzugs sdug mchog dang sgra snyan dang / /dri zhim ro mchog reg pa bde byed pa/ /dus ngan snyi la 'gro ba 'di dag thogs/ /dper na rngon pas snyi la spre'u thogs bzhin/ /'dod pas yon tan mya ngan gnod pa mang / /'jigs bcas rtag tu dgra byed nyon mongs bcas/ /ral gri'i so 'dra dug sdong lo mar mtshungs/ /ngan skyug snod ltar 'phags pa'i skye bos spangs/ /'dod pa'i yon tan 'jigs bcas nyon mongs bcas/ /rtag tu brjed pa byed pa mun pa 'dra/ /rtag tu 'jigs pa'i rgyu byed sdug bsngal rtsa/ /srid pa'i sred pas 'khri shing 'phel bar byed/ /ji ltar me 'bar 'ob ni 'jigs bcas pa/ /de ltar 'dod 'di 'phags pa'i skye bo'i rigs/ /'dam rdzab che 'dra ral gris bshag gnas 'dra/ /ral gri'i so la sbrang rtsi sgus dang mtshungs/ /ji ltar sbrul gyi mgo dang ngan skyug snod/ /de ltar 'dod 'di mkhas pa rnams kyi rigs/ /bya sha kham bu 'dra zhing gsal shing 'dra/ /ro la khyi ltar dgra dang bcas pa yin/ /zhes gsungs/ rje mi las/ yul dang po nyams 70

dga' skyid skyid po/ /lus ngag yid gsum 'drad pa'i se brdar mkhan/ /bar du rmo rko 'o re brgyal/ /sa bon phar btab tshur mi 'ong / /yul ngan mu ge'i grong khyer de/ /mgon med dri za'i gnas dang 'dra/ /tha mar bskyur nas 'gro rgyu yin/ /sdig bsog gi gnas khang sems la gzan/ /gnas skabs kyi btson dong nga mi 'dod/ /ces dang / grogs dang po lha mo bzhad kha ma/ /blta ba'i gdong la chog rgyu med/ /bar du srin mo ro mig ma/ /phar gcig lab na tshur gnyis rgol/ /skra la 'ching na spyid la 'ju/ /dbyug pa rgyab na gzar bu 'phyar/ /tha ma ba rgan so med ma/ /srin mo'i sdang mig sems la gzan/ /bdud mo'i 'thab ya spangs pa yin/ /zhes dang / bu dang po lha bu yid 'ong po/ /snying brtse'i sems la bzod glags med/ /bar du bu lon 'ded drag po/ /thams cad byen yang mgu dus med/ /mi yi bu mo nang du bcug /drin can pha ma phyi ru phud/ /pha yis bos kyang lan mi ster/ /ma yis bos kyang ang mi khug /tha ma khyim mtshes snying ring po/ /khram pa'i kha tshis byas pas phung / /rang skyes kyi dgra bo sems la gzan/ /'khor ba'i bshal thag de spangs pa yin/ /'jig rten bu tsha nga mi 'dod/ /ces dang / bu mo dang po lha phrug 'dzum kha mo/ /nor gang dmar khyer ba'i 71

dbang mo che/ /bar du lan chags 'khor med ma/ /pha la dngos su blangs nas 'khyer/ /ma la lkog tu brkus nas 'khyer/ /byen pa ngo sor mi byed pa/ /drin can pha ma'i snying rlung slong / /tha mar srin mo gdong dmar ma/ /legs na gzhan gyi dpal bskyed ma/ /nyes na rang gi byur sdud ma/ /phung byed kyi dri mo sems la gzan/ /sangs med kyi mya ngan spangs pa yin/ /phung gzhi'i bu mo nga mi 'dod/ /ces dang / gnyen dang po 'phrad dga' mthong 'dzum po/ /'dir byon dang 'dir bzhugs kyis lung ba 'gengs/ /bar du sha chang gi zas lan can/ /phar gcig lan du tshur gcig ster/ /tha mar chags sdang gi 'gyod gzhi can/ /sdug 'bros kyi gyong rtsa sems la gzan/ /skyid tshe'i za grogs de spangs pa yin/ /'jig rten gye nye du nga mi 'dod/ /ces dang /nor dang po bdag skyid gzhan smon po/ /ci tsam yod kyang chog shes med/ /bar du ser sna'i mdud pas bcings/ /dge ba'i phyogs su gtong mi phod/ /dgra 'dre gnyis kyi g.yab mo yin/ /rang gis bsags pa mi yis spyod/ /tha mar srog gi bdud du 'ong / /dgra bo'i nor gnyer sems la gzan/ /'khor ba'i bslu rdo spangs pa yin/ /bdud kyi mgo skor deng mi 'dod/ /ces dang / bu mo sa le 'od kyis/ rang ma las skyes nas da bar 72

la/ /rgan gzhon mang po shi ba mthong / /tshe mi rtag rtswa kha'i zil ba 'dra/ /de zhag dang za mas ma tshor 'dzad/ /gang du gnas kyang mi 'chi ba'i/ /sa phyogs gang na'ang med par go /bdag la nges par 'chi dgos shing / /shi nas gar skyes rang dbang med/ /ngan song sdug bsngal bsam tsa na/ /sdug bsngal myong snyam shin tu 'jigs/ /'khor ba gzhan gyi tshul la bsam/ las ngan khyem thab byed do zhes/ /'khor ba'i g.yos sbyor byas tsa na/ /pha ma drin can rgyab tu bor/ /rang gnya' drin med mi la bskyal/ /ngan song gsum gyi 'gram gzhi gtang / /mtho ris thar pa'i sdong bo sgyel/ /pha ma'i zas nor 'khur nas su/ /don med mi yi g.yog la brtson/ /'khor bar 'ching ba'i gnya' grogs te/ /dang po lha bu 'dzum bag can/ /bar du bdud po ngo nag po/ /tha ma glang bu brdung snying can/ /bsam zhing skyo ba nang nas skyes/ /des na bu mo lha chos byed/ /grogs su rdo rje'i spun dang 'grogs/ /de nas lus las skyes pa'i bu/ /bsod nams ldan pa re re la/ /las can re re tsam 'byung ba'ang srid/ /phal cher lan chags 'ded mkhan te/ /dang po lus kyi mdangs 'phrog po/ /bar du kha yi zas 'phrog po/ /tha mar lag gi nor 'phrog po/ /bsam zhing skyo ba nang nas skyes/ /des na bu mo lha chos 73

byed/ /sras su rig pa'i khye'u chung gso/ /gtsug lag khang dang mgron khang sogs/ /rtsigs pa don yod re re tsam/ /'khor ba'i btson dong sa mkhar de/ /dang po sems la sdug bsngal bskur/ /bar du lus la ngal dub bskur/ /tha mar zhig ral phung la btang / /bsam zhing skyo ba nang nas skye/ /des na bu mo lha chos byed/ /'jig med bsam gtan mkhar bu brtsig /bde gshegs gsung rab sku gzugs dang / /dad ldan dge bskul ma gtogs pa'i/ /bshos shing las rnams don med yin/ /dang por thang stong sa la 'dzings/ /bar du 'byung ba chu la 'dzings/ /tha mar mgo nag mi la 'dzings/ /bsam zhing skyo ba nang nas skye/ /des na bu mo lha chos byed/ /zhing du rang rgyud tha rgod 'dul/ /gal te sems bskyed bsam pa yis/ /zin na bsod nams yod pa'ang srid/ /ma zin nor gyi 'du shes kyis/ /phyugs lug skyong ba sdig pa'i las/ /dang po brnab sems 'dod pas brel/ /bar du nga rgyal phrag dog 'phel/ /tha ma dgra bo'i g.yab mo byas/ /bsam zhing skyo ba nang nas skyes/ /des na bu mo lha chos byed/ /phyugs lug rigs drug snying rje skyong / /zhes dang / zla ba sgron ma'i mdo las/ 'jigs pa chen po'i zhags pa ni/ /bud med zhags pa mi bzad pas/ /sangs rgyas rnams 74

kyis 'dod pa dang / /bud med bsten pa yongs mi bsngags/ /lam 'dis byang chub mi 'gyur bas/ /bud med rnams la mi bsten par/ /sbrul gdug shin tu khro ba ltar/ /mkhas pas de ni rnam par spangs/ /zhes dang / dpung bzang gi rgyud las/'dzum zhing 'gro la smra zhing mig zur can/ /yan lag thams cad yid 'phrog byed pa'i gzugs/ /bud med gzugs kyi mtshon cha 'jebs 'dra bas/ /skyes pa'i sems dag mngon du 'phrogs par byed/ /lcags kyi thong lcags rab tu 'bar ba yis/ /mig ni rnam par bkab pa btsags sla yi/ /des na dran pa nyams pa'i bud med kyi/ /dkyus ring mig can bzhin ni ma mthong sla/ /zhes dang / skyes rabs su/ e ma'o 'di ming 'di ltar btags pa ni/ /don dang rjes su mthun cing tshig kyang nyan/ /'dzum pa'i mdangs dkar myos byed ma zhes pa/ /bdag gi sems kyang myos pa bzhin du byed/ /de ni brjed par bdag 'dod na/ /sems kyis mthong ba bzhin du 'gyur/ /bdag gi sems ni de la gnas/ /sems de de yi dbang du 'gyur/ /zhes dang / rgya cher rol pa las/ 'dod pa sdug bsngal mang po bsags shing sdug bsngal rtsa ba ste/ /mi mkhas rnams la bsam gtan rdzu 'phrul dka' thub nyams par byed/ /bud med 'dod 75

pa'i yon tan chog pa med ces mkhas pa smra/ /mi gang 'dod pa'i sems kyis bud med rnams kyi khol por gyur pa dang / /gang zhig chos kyi dga' ba bor te 'dod pas dga' byed cing / /'dod la brkams pa de ni tshul khrims lam las gol 'gyur zhing / /bsam gtan lam gol blo nyams ye shes las ni rab ring gnas/ /zhes dang / kha rag sgom chung gis/ zhen chags bral ba'i dam pa la/ /las kyi phyag rgyas dgos pa med/ /zhen chags sems dang 'dres pa yi/ /phyag rgyas ngan 'gror 'khrid do ang / /zhes dang / dpal gsang ba'i bdag pos/bud med ngan pa mos gus bye pho la byed/ dag snang snying sdug la byed/ tshogs gsog bye pho la 'bul/ zhen log lha chos la byed/nyen na khye la'ang spyod/ dad pa kha nas skye/ ldog na snying nas ldog ser sna dang mig ser che/ yar 'gro'i las mi gsog par mar 'then pa'i lcags kyu byed/ chos 'phel ba'i bogs 'don mi yong bar/ chags sdang gi sna sun byed/ chags pas bogs 'don du re nas bsten par gda' ste/ nyon mongs 'phel ba'i rgyur song / khams rgyas pa'i rten yong du re tsa na/ nyams grib kyis thums par khyer song / dam tshig mi bsrung / bud med 'chol ma bdud mo yin/ gsungs/ mnyam med po to pas/76

bud med ni bdag gi chos dang mi mthun pa'i yid pham par byed pa'i dgra'o/ /thar pa'i srog rtsa gcod pa'i gshed ma'o/ /dkar po'i lo tog 'joms pa'i ser ba'o/ /phun sum tshogs pa thams cad 'phrog par byed pa'i chom rkun ma'o/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad kyi bar du gcod par byed pa'i bdud mo'o/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las thar du mi ster ba'i btson bsrung ma'o/ /gsungs/ gzhan yang mdo las/ dper na bco lnga'i zla ba la/ /sprin gyes g.yogs par gyur pa na/ /'od stong 'jig rten mi mthong ltar/ /skyes bu dge ba'i zla ba la/ /bud med lho sprin de bzhin no/ /zhes dang / dper na til 'bras sa lu yi/ /lo tog phun sum tshogs pa la/ /rdo yi ser ba babs gyur na/ /'bras bu blang du med pa ltar/ /skyes bu dge ba'i lo tog la/ /bud med ser ba de bzhin no/ /zhes dang / bltas shing gtam yang phongs gyur na/ /de nyid bsten pa smos ci dgos/ /yud tsam bde la chags pa ni/ /'bar ba'i khri la chags pa'o/ /zhes dang / slob dpon bai ro tsa nas/ bud med bya ba btsan dug ha la yin/ /sems can gang gis zos kyang 'chi bar 'gyur/ /bud med bya ba las kyi srin mo yin/ /sems can gang gis 'khor yang la 'ur 'chi/ /bud med bya ba dmyal ba'i 'dam rdzab yin/ /sems 77

can gang gi 'khor ba'i 'dam la 'dzin/ /bud med bya ba 'khor ba'i btson ra yin/ /gang gis 'bags kyang thar pa thob mi srid/ /bud med bya ba bdud kyi mya ngan yin/ /gang gis 'brel kyang sdug bsngal tshad med myong / /gsungs/ slob dpon don yod 'char gyis/ mi srun dgra 'dra gang zhe na/ /mi bzad pa yi yul rnams la/ /dmyal ba dang 'dra gang zhe na/ /gzhan gyi dbang du gyur pa'o/ /zhes dang / a ba dhu ti pas/ khyem gyi rtsom pa sdug bsngal te/ /nam nga/nga bde bar gyur ma yin/ /zhes dang /rtogs brjod las/ rnga rtsid shing la thogs pa'i g.yag bzhin du/ /blo yi lam ni rnyog pas nyer 'gags shing / /log par chags pa'i yal gar sems thogs pa'i/ /skyes bu ngan pa khyim bsten phung bar 'gyur/ /zhes dang / mi dbang gzhan yang rang gi mthar 'jigs pa'i/ /'tsho ba'i 'jig rten dag na sdug pa su/ /sdug dang 'phrad par dga' bar sems pa dag /nges par sdug dang bral ba'i sdug bsngal thob/ /de yi don la rnam dpyod mkhas pa yang / /sdug ces pa 'das sems ni rnam par g.yeng / /zhes dang / nyi khri snang ba las/ skyo ba'i sems la bsten pa/ gang / /'ga' zhig mya ngan 'das 'gyur zhing / /'jig rten legs snyam la brten na/ /la la 'khor bar 'khor 78

bar 'dod/ /ces dang / rin chen sgang pa khu dbon gyi zhal nas/ ja 'di'i phyir du dka' las sdug bsngal yod tshul bsam na/ ja 'thung phod pa snying khams re che gsungs/ spyan snga pa rin po che'i zhal nas/ khyed ja khog ma gang bskol pa'i ring la ngas bzlas pa 'di rnams song ba yin/ jas dge sbyor bcag pa tsam sus bcag gsung skad/ legs gdams las/ nga 'di las bod pa rang med de/ sdug dka' las byas/ nor bsags pa rnams kyis nor thams cad brlag par byed par snang / thams cad don byar 'dis 'dzud par snang / zhes dang / mi rung ba dang mthun tshabs ja las che ba med/ chang dang 'di gnyis la spyo mi spyo 'di min pa phung tshabs la khyad mi snang / gsungs/ sha po sgang pa'i zhal nas/ tshe 'di'i 'dod pa la skam sha btsal na rang rma rang gis phab/ rang sdug rang gis byas/ mis 'phya la rang sdug pa/ phyi ma la ngan song du 'gro ba rnams yong ba yin gsungs/ kha rag pas/ snyan grags bdud kyi phye gtor yin/ /rnyed bkur 'ching ba'i zhags pa yin/ /bsod nams dge sbyor bar chad yin/ /dug la sman dum lta ang gsungs/ /sa paṇa gyis/ ha cang blo rgya che bas 'du 'dzis g.yeng / /gcig la gcig 'phros zin med bya bas g.yeng / /'di dang 'di dgos 79

'dod pas rim gyis 'brid/ /de 'dras mi tshe zad pa ma tshor ro/ /gsungs/ po to ba'i gsungs las/ mnga' thang mtha' rgyas sdug bsngal mtsho rdol/ /mngags las kyang 'byung de ltar shes bya/ /zhes dang / yang / rgyag dang ja dang chu rdor mang po tshags byed pa la chos mi 'ong / /gsungs/ 'od srung gi le'ur yang / ji ltar 'jig rten mi gtsang lhung ba smad/ /de ltar sngon bzhin phyis ni de ma yin/ /de bzhin dge slong mang du thos pa yang / /bkur bsnyi mi gtsang lhung ba de ltar bshad/ /ces dang /rje skal ldan rgya mtshos/ yul sde dgon bdud kyi btson ra yin/ /dpon gra slob dge ba'i bar chad yin/ /nor rnyed bkur 'ching byed thag pa ste/ /gsungs/ gang pos zhus par yang / grong khyer dag la chags mi bya/ /bsten na rnyed sems skye bar 'gyur/ /rnyed pa thob na rab tu dga'/ /ltogs par gyur na mya ngan skye/ /de yis sangs rgyas mchod byas pa/ /mchod pa bya zhes brjod mi bya/ /de 'dra'i nyes dmigs spong 'dod na/ /rnyed pa rnams ni spang bar bya/ /spangs nas gnas dben rab gnas na/ /stong dben chos ni sgom par bya/ /zhes gsungs/ dbu ma bzhi brgya par/ gang gi 'jig rten 'di mthong dga'/ /de ni gzhan las blun pa nyid/ /gang dag de rjes 'gro de dag /shin tu yun ring 80

bslu bar 'gyur/ /zhes dang / 'ba' ra bas/ nor dang kha drag yod tsa na/ /mgo nag gi mi 'dis gang bcol nyan/ /phan gnod nus pa med tsa na/ /drin gyis bskyangs pas zhor la brnyas/ /dus ngan 'khor gyis phan par dka'/ /zhes dang /gnyen nye 'brel nye ring mnyam lags kyang / /'byor ldan kha so ngo lag blta/ /dbul zhing phongs pa byur du mthong / /'khos med mi mthong mtho kha 'grim/ /dus ngan gnyen zla srang bar dka'/ /gsungs/ rgyal sras rin po ches/ 'byor pa'i tshe na bros kyang rjes su snyegs/ /rgud pa'i tshe na drung du snyegs kyang 'bros/ /bu yis rang gi pha yang gsod byed na/ /nye du rnams la su zhig yid brtan byed/ /mngon du gyur na dga' ba'i tshul ston cing / /lkog tu gyur na mi snyan sna tshogs sgrog /phan btags lan du gnod pa skyel byed pa'i/ /byes pa'i grogs po mdza' yang nges par bslu/ /'byor tshe bzhin 'dzum kha bsags sna tshogs kyis/ /bdag gi 'byor pa thabs kyis 'byal byid cing / /rgud na bzhin bsdud 'thab cing cung zad kyang / /phan med gnyen bshes skyong ba 'khrul bar zad / /gnyen mang dar ba sdongs nas pha rol 'joms/ /so sor gyes na nang du chags sdang byed/ /gal la bab na pha bu phan tshun gsod/ /gnyen gyis 81

phan bde sgrub pa shin tu dkon/ /zhes dang / rang gi nye du'i bkur bsti rab spangs nas/ /gzhan gyi bkur bste 'dod na blos btang snyam/ /yul dang gnyen bshes longs spyod kun spangs nas/ /snyan grags 'dod pa'i blo yis bcings gyur na/ /lcags sgrog chod nas srad bus 'khyigs pa yin/ /gsungs/rig 'dzin gang shar rang grol gyis/ nye 'brel mdza' bshes snying po med/ /'byor tshe brgya la phan srid kyang / /rgud tshe brnyas pa'i thog mar 'ong / /lhag par 'khor ba'i 'then thag byed/ /gnyen gyi rang bzhin bsam pa'i tshe/ /gdung sems 'brel thag gcod snying 'dod/ /grogs med gcig pur sdod snying 'dod/ /mi la'i rnam thar skyong snying 'dod/ /nor gyi bsog 'jog snying po med/ /phyug po phal cher nor gyi g.yog /bsog bsrung sdug bsngal bsam mi khyab/ /nor gyi rang bzhin bsam pa'i tshe/ /ser sna'i 'ching ba gcod snying 'dod/ /nor med sprang bo byed snying 'dod/ /mi la'i rnam thar skyong snying 'dod/ /ces dang /rje rgod tshang pas/ yang la la dag blos btang byas nas/ snyan grags dang bsod nams la sogs sgrub par 'dug ste/ de blos ma btang bas tshabs che/ sangs rgyas pa'i bar chad la de bas che ba mi yong gsungs/ tshe blos btang bya ba de chos brgyad don 82

gnyer blos thongs pa cig la zer ba yin/ bzang 'dod byed pa'i blos btang des ci yang mi btub gsungs/ lhag bsam bskul ba las byams pa 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos/ rnyed pa dang bkur bste ni 'dod chags bskyed pa yin par brtag par bya'o/ /rnyed pa bkur bsti ni dran pa 'joms par byed pa yin par brtag par bya'o/ /rnyed pa dang bkur bsti ni/ rnyed pa dang ma rnyed pas khengs pa dang 'dud par brtag par bya'o/ /de bzhin du sbyar te/ gti mug bskyed pa dang / bdag gi don sgrub pa'i khyim la ser sna byed pa dang / chags pa byed pa dang / g.yo sgyur byed pa dang / 'phags pa'i rigs bzhi yongs su spong ba dang / ngo tsha mi shes pa dang /khrel med pa bskyed pa dang / sangs rgyas thams cad kyis ma gnang ba dang / nga rgyal dang / rgyags pa dang / dregs pa bskyed pa dang / bla ma rnams khyad du gsod pa dang / bdud kyi phyogs yin pa dang / gcig tu bag med pa'i rtsa ba yin pa dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba 'phrog pa dang / glog dang 'khor lo dang / lce 'bab ba lta bu dang / sbag pa mang pos sbags pa dang / mdza' bshes kyi khyim dang / slong mo ster ba'i khyim la blta ba dang / yid mi bde ba bskyed pa dang / blo rnams 'khrul bar byed pa dang /83

sdig pa'i dngos po rnam par 'gyur bar byed pa'i phyir mya ngan bskyed pa dang / dran pa nye bar bzhag pa bzhi brjed par byed pa dang / dkar po'i chos rnams nyam chung bar byed pa dang /yang dag par spong ba bzhi yongs su nyams par byed pa dang /rdzu 'phrul dang mngon par shes pa yongs su nyams par byed pa dang / sngar bkur bsnyi byed pa la phyis mi byed par byed pa dang / mi mdza' ba dang gnas par byed pa dang / mdza' bo spong ba dang / pha rol brid pas smad tshong ma dang 'dra ba dang /bsam gtan dang tshad med pa spong ba dang / sems can dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro'i skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten du lhung bar byed pa dang / rnyed pa dang bkur bste ni/ lhas sbyin dang lhag spyod kyi cho ga dang mthun par brtag par bya'o/ /byams pa/ byang chub sems dpas rnyed pa dang bkur bste la nyes dmigs gang brtag par bya ba ni 'di lta bu'i de dag go /brtag nas 'dod pa chung bar bya'i/ yongs su gdung bar mi bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ byams pa/ 'dod pa chung ba la skyon 'di lta bu dag med pa'i phyir ro zhes gsungs/ rdo rje rgyal mtshan gye mdo las/ bdag ni 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga po'i dga' ba myong bar bya ba ma yin/ 'dod pa'i yul bsten par bya ba'i 84

phyir ma yin/ 'dod pa'i khams su gtogs pa'i dga' ba bkod pa'i gzhan dang gzhan sgrub pa'i phyir ma yin par/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa spyad par bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/'jig rten thams cad kyi dga' ba 'di ni dga' ba ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /'di lta ste/ 'dod pa rnams la bsten pa 'di ni bdud kyi yul lo/ /'di lta ste/ 'dod pa la bsten pa'i lam 'di ni blo ngan pas bsten pa'o/ /nye bar bsten pa 'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyis ma bsngags pa'o/ /de'i nye bar bsten pa 'di ni sdug bsngal gyi phung bo thams cad 'byung ba nyid yin zhes dang / sems can dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro'i skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten rnams 'byung ngo / /sems can rnams 'thab pa dang / rtsod pa dang / mtshang 'bru ba dang / 'gyed pa dang / 'khrug pa dang / kun tu 'khrug po rnams 'byung ngo / /sems can de dag gi 'dod pa bsten na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams las ring bar 'gyur ro/ /'dod pa 'di dag ni mtho ris skyes pa'i bar chad du yang 'gyur na/bla na med pa ye shes kyi rgyal srid sems can thams cad kyis 'grub pa dang / bde ba la lta smos kyang ci dgos zhes gsungs/rang tu byung ba bar du gcod pa tshar gcod pa'i mdo las/85

dper na mi la la zhig mi gtsang ba'i dong du lhung nas/ mi gzhan yang 'di skad du/ a la la 'di ltar chu 'di shin tu dwangs pa ngo mtshar ro zhes zer ba de ni/ chu min pa la chur 'du shes bskyed de/ dwangs pa'i chur 'du shes pa de bzhin du/sems can gang la la bdag nyid 'dod pa'i 'dam du bying ba dag gzhan yang 'dod pa'i 'dam du 'jug par byed do/ /bdag nyid 'dod chags kyi g.yang sar lhung bar byas/ zhe sdang gi g.yang sa dang / gti mug gi g.yang sar lhung bar byas/gzhan yang de dag dulhung bar byed do zhes dang / des pas zhus pa las/ gang gis 'dod pa rab mang rnam par 'phel zhing longs spyod bdag gi chog mi 'tshal/ /gnod pa bgyid pa'i slad du rgyal srid 'khrug cing bdag nyid kyang ni 'dor bgyid pa/ /de ni 'di na 'jig rten mi bsrung yon tan chung ngu dag la mchog tu 'dzin/ /de phyir 'di na de la rtag tu chos 'dod rnams ni dbul bor lags par sems/ /zhes dang / slob dpon don yod 'char gyis/ shin tu dbul ba gang zhe na/ gang na chog shes med nyid do/ /zhes dang / spyan snga bas 'dod pa zhig skyes phyin phyi nang bar gsum kun nas rang dbang shor/gzhan dbang du mi 'gro ba'i thabs med/ ma mtha' khab sngon po 86

skud pa skya bo tsam re dgos na'ang / gzhan la rag las tshul dang / rang dbang ma thob lugs ji ltar 'dug soms dang gsungs/ tshoms las/ gzhan gyi dbang gyur kun sdug ste/ /rang dbang yod pa thams cad bde/ /ces dang / ting 'dzin rgyal po las/ srog kyang g.yo zhing dbang med de/ /rmi lam sgyu ma 'dra ba la/ /sems can gang dag chags pa ni/ /shin tu ma rung las byas nas/ /mnar med dmyal ba mi bzad par/ /mi mkhas bdud kyi bzhon pas song / /zhes dang / skyes rabs su/ rgyu rkyen med par myur du chud za ba'i/ /nor ni shin tu mi bzad nor min rigs/ /glog ni 'gyu ba bzhin du mi brtan no/ /kun tu blun rmongs phongs pa du ma'i rgyu/ /zhes dang / tshoms las/bsten pa'i tshe la mngar la dga'/ /rnam par smin pa me dang mtshungs/ /'dod las byung ba'i dga' ba ni/ /rtag tu sems can dmyal bar 'gro/ /zhes dang / dran pa nyer bzhag las/'dod pa rnams la blo mi btang / /'dod pas mchog tu bslu ba yin/ /'khor ba'i 'ching ba drag po ste/ /sems can dmyal ba kun gyi rgyu/ /gang zhig 'dod pa rnams la dga'/ /de yi sdug bsngal mtha' med de/ /'dod pa'i sbrul gyis zin pa la/ /bde ba nam yang ga la yod/ /'dod pas yongs su bslus pa yin/ /87

'jig rten 'khor lo bzhin du 'khyams/ /thog ma med pa'i 'jig rten la/ /'dod pa yongs su bslus pa dag /rgya mtsho'i chu nang 'jug par byed/ /mtshon cha 'thib por 'bab pa yis/ /g.yul du yang dag rab tu 'jug 'dod pa'i rgyu yi sa bdag rnams/ /phan tshun dmag tu 'jug par byed/ /nor la sred pa ma bu yang / /'thab mo'i g.yul ni 'gyed par byed/ /sred pa'i dug las rnam grol ba/ /'dod pa'i me 'dag rnam par spangs/ /bong ba gser ltar mnyam pa la/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i mthar 'gro'o/ /mnar med pa ni skye ba dag /nor la 'dod pas bsreg pa yin/ /mkhas pas ye shes chu yis su/ /bsgrims te 'dod pa'i me 'dag gsod/ /'dod pa med par ma byas na/ /mya ngan 'das pa thag ring ngo / /myang 'das 'dod ldan rnams la med/ /grol med bde ba ci la yod/ /de phyir 'dod pa bsten mi bya/ /'dod dang sdug bsngal mnyam du 'byung / /ji ltar dug ni ljon shing gi /me tog bung ba rnams 'jib pa/ /de ltar de ni dug 'dra ste/ /rmongs pa rnams ni bde la spyod/ /bung bas dug ni 'thung ba dag /gal te kha cig 'tsho 'gyur gyi/ /'dod pa'i dug ni 'thung ba yis/ /'tsho ba rnyed par dka' bar 'gyur/ /gsungs/ sngon byang chub sems dpa' 88

mched drug byung / nags su sgom gyin bzhugs pa pad+ma'i rtsa ba gsol ba las/ gcig gis pad+ma'i rtsa ba rkus snang bas/ khong rnam pas dmod pa 'di ltar dor/ gcig na re/ bram ze khyed kyi rtsa ba sus 'khyer ba/ /'byor ba'i mtshan mas brgyan pa'i khyim pa ba/ /chung ma yid du 'ong ba rnyed par shog /bu dang tsha bo rnams dang ldan par shog /gcig na re/ bram ze khyed kyi rtsa ba sus 'khyer ba/ /phreng ba do shal tsan dan gos bzang dang / /bu yis reg pa'i brgyan rnams theg byas te/ /'dod pa mi bzad pa la spyod par shog /gcig na re/ gang gi rtsa ba mthong la chos ma mthong / /de ni gcig pu dge ba rnams dang bral/ /bsnyen bkur byas pas myos par gyur nas ni/ /kha zas zhim po dag la dga' bar shog /gcig na re/ bram ze khyed kyi rtsa ba sus 'khyer ba/ /rig byed legs par lob nas ston par byed/ /dka' thub can du re ba chen po yis/ /de ni yul mi kun gyis mchod par shog /ces brjod gsungs/ 'dod yon longs spyod rgyas nas sdug bsngal gyi mtsho rdol nas/ sdug thag chod pa re yong dgongs nas dmod mo de 'dra byas pa yin te/ des na spyan snga ba rin po ches/ pad+ma'i rtsa ba brku ba de bstan bcos legs par bslab nas/ 'khor mang po la ston pa dang / de ni mkhas 89

btsun bzang gsum 'dzoms pa/ kun gyis shes nas/ rnyed bkur gyis mchod par shog ces dmod pa bor/ da lta yin na/dge bshes dka' bcu 'dzin pa'ang / de lta bu la smon gnas mthar thug tu byed pa mang gsungs/ sngon bya btang ri khrod pa zhig la/ rgyal pos gnod pa btang tshul ni/ kho rang gis maṇ+ḍal phul ba'i nas sa la 'thor ba/ yar legs por skyes pas mgo la 'bras phun sum tshogs pa smin du bcug pas ri khrod pa'i bsam pa la/ sa 'dir lo tog legs po 'ong rgyu red snyam zhing btab pas phun sum tshogs pa byung / de nas zhing 'di la bdag byed pa'i bud med cig dgos snyam bud med gcig blangs pas sdom pa shor/ bu tsha bu mo mang po byung / chos min gyi las mang po byas nas dmyal bar lhung skad/ de la dgongs nas rig 'dzin gang shar rang grol gyis/ bzang la bcud che bza' btung longs spyod 'dra 'dzom byung / chos kyi mthun rkyen 'dra yin na ni dga' ba/ rgyal 'gong cho 'phrul 'dra yin na ni skyo ba/skyo ba bzod thabs rang mi 'dug rigs kun gyi khyab bdag gsungs/ yang spyan snga bas/ 'jig rten gyi phun sum tshogs pa dang rgud pa gnyis nyin mtshan bzhin du nam yang 'bral ba med do/ /de yang phun tshogs rgya che ba dang grangs mang ba ltar/90

rgud pa dang / mya ngan rgya che grangs mang zhes grags pa 'jig rten gye phun tshogs sgrub na nam yang pho ma skyes pa las mi 'da' ste/ phun tshogs ji ltar che yin de la sred pa cher 'gro/ de byung ba ltar gyi phun tshogs thams cad mi rtag cing mi brtan pas nges par 'jig cing 'bral la/ de'i tshe gzhan la 'byung bar mi rigs pa'i mya ngan dang smre ngag dang / sdug bsngal dang yid mi bde ba 'ong ste/ na ning byang pha gir 'bri gung pa'i dpon skya chen po zhig bu gces pa shi bas kho rang yang mya ngan gyis shi song zer/ yon btsun tshul rin kun phyug pa la thams cad smon pa bzhin snang ste/ bu ni min/ tsha zhang yin/ tsha bo de na nas 'dang zhag shi phan la zla ba lnga drug gcig song / de'i bar du ngu 'phro gcod rgyu ye med par dwang kha chag sha zhu pags skam la song snang zer/ 'phan yul du sngags pa zhig gi bu shi bas kho dus thams cad du bu yid la byed cing ngu bas/ mdo dran pa nyer bzhag las/ 'dod 'jigs mya ngan gyis rlams dang / /rkun po rmi sogs kyis slad pa/ /mdun na gnas pa bzhin du ni/ /yang dag min pa'ang mthong bar 'gyur/ /zhes pa de kho na byung nas/ lan cig bu de mdun du car gyis byung ba'i snang ba byung skad/ brag rtsar yon btsun lha bzang gi tsha bo na ba dang /91

kho snyam pa/ bu yi ro mthong bas sdug drag snyam nas dug 'gam nas shi/ dge ba gnyis sgrub dgos pa byung / na ning shaka tshul de kun gzhon nu nas rab tu byung / mkhan chen gzhon 'od de lta bu'i bla ma bzang po lus dang grib ma'i tshul gyis bsten/ lo bdun cu don grangs lon lon du dge sbyor byas/ zhag re sman bla tshar lnga lngar ma chag pa gtong ba byas kyang / khong tshe 'di'i phun tshogs la zhen pas thams cad byas pa don med du song /kho'i zhing chung la zor brdeg pa cung zad byung ba tsam la/ de'i mya ngan dang khong khros skems te shi song ba/ yugs ma 'di kun ji 'dra'i mya ngan zhig song gi snang / phag mo gru ba'i dus/ ma bde ba 'di kun yang byung nas da lo yang mang du song ste/ gong ma kong dkar bskor la ji 'dra ba'i mya ngan dang sems khral dang sdug lugs shig yod de/ bde dang sdug bsngal gsar ba yis rnying pa nye bar brjed par byed/ ma byas par 'di 'dra rnams la bsam blo btang na/ tshe 'di'i phun tshogs 'dra ba su rang sgrub pa 'di rnams la phun sum tshogs pa'i ming btags kyang don la dgra rang yin snyam nas spong ba zhig byung na pho skyes pa bya ba de yong gsungs/ mdor na 'dod yon la chags pa ni ri dwags rngon pa'i snyi la chags pa dang / spu gri rnon po'i so la 92

chags pa'i sbrang rtsi lces 'dag pa dang / dug sbrul nag po'i gdengs ga'i grib bsil bsten pa dang 'dra bar gnod pa dang sdug bsngal du ma'i rgyu 'ba' zhig yin/ dper na rgya a 'ban tshos nag can gyi mi 'ga' res gsod dus da khyod gtong rgyu yin zer/ gar shing thog sogs sder kha bzhag 'ga' res sngon nas gar khrab gi bcug mi des mig sems g.yengs pa'i bar der/ phyi ltag nas mgo gcod mkhan gyis gri rnon pos mgo bcad nas sa la 'phangs tshe bzod glags med pa'i sdug bsngal myong ba ltar/ tshe 'di yi 'dod yon gyi bslu brid la zhen cing chags na nyon mongs mgo gcod kyi sdig ltung spu gri rnon pos mtho ris thar pa'i bde skyid kyi mgo bcad nas ngan song gsum gyi sa la 'phangs tshe bzod glags med pa'i sdug bsngal yun ring myong dgos/ de rnams la dgongs nas/ rje bdag nyid chen po'i zhal nas/ dge 'dis mtshon nas dus gsum dang 'brel ba'i/ /bdag gzhan dge ba'i rtsa ba ji snyed pa/ /de dag thams cad skye zhing skye ba ru/ /byang chub mchog gi rjes su mi mthun pa'i/ /shes kyi khe 'dod pa dang grags pa dang / /'khor dang rnyed bkur grags sogs bde ba'i rgyur/ /skad cig tsam yang smin par mi 'gyur zhing / /bla med byang chub kho na'i 93

rgyur gyur cig /bde med sdug bsngal brgya yi gtses pa yis /'khor ba'i phun tshogs yid la dran tsam gyis/ /lcags khang 'bar ba'i nang du tshud pa ltar/ /yin la 'dod pa til tsam med par shog /ces gsungs/ khyad par 'dod yon lnga'i nang nas/ ro mngar zas dang zas kyi rgyu'i nor rdzas btsal dus tsha grangs bkres skom ngal dub kyis gdungs/ rnyed na gzhan gyi rku 'phrog chud zos su 'gro yis dogs nas/ nyin mtshan gnyis ka rtsol ba drag pos bsrung dgos/ de'i phyir pha spun sogs phan tshun rtsod cing 'thab/ sred pa cher gyur nas rgyal bo sogs phan tshun g.yul sprod/ pha rol po dang 'thab na sdug bsngal du ma myong / zas dang zas kyi rgyu'i phyir sgo gsum gyi sdig pa bsags nas 'chi tshe de dag dran nas 'gyod bzhin du 'chi zhing / shi nas kyang ngan song du lhung nas bzod glags med pa'i sdug bsngal myong zhes/ lam rim sogs nas gsungs/ bza' btung la longs spyod rag bar du chu blangs g.yo skol sogs byas phung po ngal/ zas de la longs spyad nas zhun cung zad cig gis sha khrag sogs skye yang phal che ba bshang gcir gyur/ lus kyi smad na gnas pa yang yang bsal dgos/ zas la brten nas nad kyi rigs du ma bskyed/ tsho bsog nas khur po chen po zhig 'khur 94

ba ltar lus lci ba dang / dbugs 'byung rngub len dka' ste/phyin ci log bzhi 'gog pa'i gtam las/ skyes bu zas nyung dag gis red 'gyur zas mang dag la mngon dga' ba'i/ /dbugs mi 'thon cing sdug bsngal 'gyur la mi mthun zas kyis 'chi bar byed/ /zas mi 'ju ba'i nad skyes 'gyur zhing zhu bas bkres pa nyid du 'gyur/ /kye ma zas zos gyur na sdug bsngal mi bskyed skabs de yod ma yin/ /zhes dang / zla ba sgon ma'i mdo las/ de dag kha zas ro zhim bsod pa dag /rnyed nas rnal 'byor mi brtson za zhing 'thung / /de dag rnams la zas de gdug par 'gyur/ /ba glang phru gus rtsa ba ma bkrum bzhin/ /zhes dang / 'phags pa bden pa po'i le'u las/ skyes bu gang zhig mang za ba/ /de ni lus lce le lo can/ /'di dang pha rol tshe 'di'i don/ /nges par rab tu 'grib par 'gyur/ /de ni sad na'ang sdug bsngal te/ /nyal na'ang sdug bsngal gzhan gnod bgyid/ /de bas phan dang ran par bza'/ /zas kyi dus ni nges par bgyi/ /zhes dang / dran pa nyer bzhag las/ le lo brtson 'grus dman pa gang / /zas la rtag tu dga' bas phyugs/ /de ni gson yang shi ba yin/ /de nas kyang ni dmyal bar 'gro/ /zhes dang / sdud pa las/ sems can yongs su rtog 95

pas zas la 'dod byed cing / /'khor bar chags pa'i yid dang ldan rnams rtag tu 'khor/ /zhes dang / po to bas/ lto gdung nan tar che ba la chos ma byung bar byed/ lto phyir gnam rdib pa chos lar mi yong zhes gsungs/ zas kyi nang nas dkor zas kho na zos na dkor sgrib che lus lci/ dkor shig mang / ro stod na/dbugs tshang / mig tsha/ na zug mang po ldang / rig pa mi gsal/ gnyid che/ je blun du song nas/ phan bde'i lam la rang gis spyod mi shes/ gzhan gyis bshad kyang mi nyan/ bong bu dang khyad par med par 'gyur te/ spyan snga bas/ dkor gyis tshos bas 'phral du je blun song / /phan bde'i lam la rang gis spyod mi shes/ /gzhan gyis 'thad pa sgron yang der mi nyan/ /bong bu mngon sum yong ngo shākya'i sras/ /gsungs/ bla ma 'ga' res/ dkor snying la bab na mi dran dgu dran/ khar bab na mi bshad dgu bshad/ lag tu bab na mi 'khyug dgu 'khyug gsungs pa ltar/ sems kyi brnab sems gnod sems log lta dran pa nas rdzun phra ma tshig rtsub ngag 'khyal/ lus kyis srog gcod ma byen len mi tshangs spyod sogs byas nas ngan song gsum gyi 'gram gzhi 'ding / nyin bar gyi lto bcag mtshan mo'i gnyid spangs nas phyogs phyogs su rgyug rgyug nas dad zas 96

gshin zas bsdus bsdus ser sna byas bsags nas/ chos phyogs su ma song bar rang dang khyim tshang bza' mi gra rogs grogs mched phyogs su shor na/ tshe phyi mar dkor sdud mkhan/dge slong ban+de gcod pa sngags pa/ bla ma dge bshes/ bya btang sgom chen su yin yang / rkang ba tsha zhing / bu dad che ba'i rnga mong du skye/ dkor za mkhan khyim tshang bza' mi gra rogs grogs mched rnams rnga phrug tu skye/ dkor bdag rnga mong gi bdag por gyur nas/ bkol spyod kyi lan chags 'ded du 'ong /de ma yin pa'i lan chags nyi khri tsam 'ded du 'ong zhes/ rgyal po srong btsan sgam pos gsungs/ sngon li ta zhes bya ba'i dge 'dun gyi las byed pa'i dge slong zhig gis/ dge 'dun gyi dkor zos pas/ tshe dus byas ma thag tu dmyal bar skyes/ kha nang du gshin rje rnams kyis khro chu khol ma blug nas/ khog gi nang 'khrol tshig nas smad nas byung sdug bsngal myang / dge 'dun rnams kyi spyi rdzas nang nas me tog dang 'bras bu bza' ba dang btung ba mang po khyim pa mang po la byin pa rnams/ tshe 'phos nas shing sdong chen po zhig gi steng gi srin bur skyes gsungs/ sngon moṅgal gyi bu/ rigs drug gi gnas su rgyu zhing gshegs pa'i tshe/ rgya mtsho'i 'gram na yi dwags lus la me 'bar 97

ba/ thang la 'gro na gcan gzan mche ba can sna tshogs pas/lus kyi sha phyogs phyogs nas bcad nas zos tshe/ sdug bsngal ma bzod par ngu 'bod byas yar mar phar tshur du rgyug kyang / khye gcan gzan rnams kyis ded nas za ba zhig mthong / de sngon sangs rgyas 'od srung gi dus/ dge slong zhal lta ba zhig gis dge 'dun gyi dkor dang / mchod rten gyi dkor sogs rang gis longs spyad pa dang gzhan la byen pa'i las so gsungs/yang rgya mtsho'i 'gram na/ sems can lus kyi sha rnag chu 'dra ba zhig sa la sdad na/ srog chags mchu khab 'dra ba mang pos 'ong nas zos/ za che bas sdug bsngal ma bzod nas nam mkha' la yar ldang 'phags tshe/ lus nas me 'bar nas sdug bsngal myong ba zhig mthong / de yang sangs rgyas 'od srung gi dus dkor zos pa'i las so gsungs/ sngon dṛ ka ma la shi la'i gnas brtan gyis/ dge 'dun gyi dkor bag tsam 'bru gzhi ba ma gang zhig 'bag pas yi dwags su skyes/ gad phug gcig na sdod pa la/gnas der byes pa rnams kyis rdo rub brgyab pas/ yi dwags des byis pa gcig bzung kha nas chos shwa shwa byung / dge 'dun rnams kyis de la sngags btab kyang ma phan pa la/ byams pa bsgom pa zhig gis khyod su yin dris pa la gzhan rnams phar phye 98

ngas bshad do zer/ de'i shul du nga gnas brtan yin pa la/dkor la 'bag pa 'dir skyes zer byes pa btang skad/ dge 'dun pa'i rdzas 'dab ma'i me tog gam/ 'bras bu tsam yang tshul 'chal gyis spyad na/ sems can dmyal ba chen por skyes pa dang / brgya la yun ring bo nas thar yang / 'brog dgon par ro bskam du dud 'gro rkang lag med pa dang / yi dwags long ba rkang lag med par skyes te/ lo mang por sdug bsngal myong ba la sogs pa nyes dmigs che bar nyi ma'i snying po las gsungs/gzhan yang dge slong dang dge 'dun la bsngos pa/ lo tog la sogs pa tsam yang rang gis spyod pa dang / gzhan khyem pa la ster ba dang / khyim pas longs spyod du mi rung bar gsungs/tshul khrims 'chal ba tshar gcod pa'i mdo las/ mi dge bcu dang ldan pa'i mi zhig rgyun du bar mtshams med par lo brgya'i bar du sdig pa bsags pa las/ dge slong tshul khrims ngal ba'i drang srong gi rgyal mtshan gyis g.yogs nas/ dad pas byin pa la zhag gcig longs spyad pa ni mi dge ba ches mang bar gsungs/lung rnam 'byed las/ lcags gong me lce 'bar ba dag /zos par gyur pa mchog yin gyi/ /tshul 'chal yang dag mi sdom pa/ /yul 'khor bsod snyoms za ba min/ /zhes tshul khrims 'chal ba 99

dang / yang dag par mi sdom pa gnyis ka la gsungs/ rin po che'i phung po'i mdo las/ dge slong rnal 'byor spyod pa lnga brgya tshul khrims ma dag bzhin du dad pas byin pa la longs spyad mi rung gsungs/ yang de nyid las/ bcom ldan 'das kyis/ dad pa byen pa yongs su spyad pa yongs su bstan pa dang / de nas 'khor de nyid nas/ rnal 'byor spyod pa'i dge slong nyis brgya chos kyi rnam grangs 'di thos nas rab tu ngus te/ mchi ma zag cing tshig 'di skad ces/ bcom ldan 'das/ bdag cag ni bkum yang rung ste/ 'bras bu ma thob kyi bar du dad pas btsal ba'i bsod snyoms gcig tsam yang yongs su spyad par mi bgye'o/ /zhes smras so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/skyes bu dam pa dag legs so legs so zhes gsungs/ skye bo zhig gis mi lo brgya yi bar du sdig pa byas pa las/ tshul khrims 'chal bas dad zas gshin zas kham bu gang zos pa ngan zhes dam pa gong ma 'ga' res gsungs/ ding sang dad zas gshin zas min gzhan rnyed dka'/ tshul khrims nyis brgya lnga bcu rtsa gsum bsrung ba phar zhog mi dge bcu spong gi tshul khrims yod ni dka'/ des na gzhan khrims ldan tsho'i lad mo byas mang po mi za bar tshod re 'dzin dgos par snang / 'on kyang nged tsho'i 100

kha nang du ma 'ongs pas sdug de min med/ sngon bka' gdams bla ma zhig gis/ bye'u chung zhig nam mkha' nas 'phur bar grib mar sku byol tshe/ slob ma 'ga' res/ de ci red lags dris tshe/ dge 'dun pa mang po'i spyi rdzas nas kyi thang ma bkram yod pa'i nang nas 'bru kham gang bye'u ya kis 'khyer snang / nga de'i grib ma phog na dkor grib 'phog gis dogs pa yin gsungs/ e tsho'i khog tu zos rang dkor gyis sgrib gi bcug pas mi tshad/ ser mo 'ga' re tsho'i khos mtshar re zhig rnyed bzhag ni 'dra gi blta byas/ sha lhu rtsam ril zhig yan chad bo mi za 'khyer 'ong nas/ khyem tshang bza' ba che chung 'ga' re 'di zo tsho zer ster ba de/ don gyis phan btags pa min pha ma glen pa yin te/ mdo nyi ma'i snying po las/ spu gri rdon po dag gis su/ /rang gi yan lag btub pa sla'i/ /dge 'dun dag la bsngos zin pa/ /khyem pa rnams la byin mi bya/ /me lce 'bar ba lta bu yi/ /lcags kyi thu lum zos pa sla'i/ /dge 'dun dag las gang de ni/ /dge 'dun gyi las longs mi spyad/ /lhun po dang ni 'dra ba'i me/ /blang bar byas te zos pa sla'i/ /khyim par gyur pas dge 'dun gyi/ /longs spyad par ni mi bya'o/ /thams cad dbyung bar byas pa dang / /gsal shing steng du bteg pa 101

sla'i/ /khyem par gyur pas dge 'dun gyi/ /longs spyad par ni mi bya'o/ /zhes gsungs/ de na dge 'dun pa la yon bdag dad can gyis phul ba'i bza' btung khyim par byen pa de/ me dang lcags gong me 'bar ba kha nang du bzhag pa las nyes pa che bar gsungs/ dkor me ngan na/ tshogs ja thang la phob/ khye ba lang gis 'thung na steng gi spu yan chad bud 'gro ba la ltos dang /chu tshan me ma mur gyi 'og tu bzhag nas spu 'then kyang de ltar mi 'ong / dkor dug chu me las thu ba de gcig pu la ltos dang ha go yong / gzhan mi dgos/ deng sang bla rgan 'ga' re'i mig 'grib/ rnam shes mi gsal/ dgos med kyi lab lob mang pos khyem tshang bza' ba bshad pa de yang dkor grib yin/ tshul khrims dang kha ton bzlas brjod kyi sman med par/ dkor nag dug gi chus rang gzhan gnyis ka tshe 'di phyi gnyis gar pham glan zhes mdo dang bstan bcos rnams su yang dang yang du gsungs/ dper na mi zhig bkyig yod pa zhig grol na bde phyam me song nas gang 'dod du song chog pa ltar/ tshe blos thongs na lus sems bde zhing chos la thos bsam sgom gsum gang byed kyang 'ong ste/ rje rgod tshang pas/ tshe 'di blo yis gtong ba 'di/ /bcings pa 'khrol ba'i gdams pa yin/ /yangs shing lhod pa'i 102

gdams pa yin/ /zhes dang / zla ba'i snying po'i mdo las/ gal te bde ba kun 'dod na/ /'dod pa thams cad yongs su sgong / /'dod pa thams cad yongs spangs na/ /mchog tu bde ba thob par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / slob dpon klu sgrub kyis/g.yan pa phrug na bde 'gyur gyis/ /bde bas g.yan pa med na bde/ /de bzhin 'jig rten 'dod ldan bde/ /de bas 'dod pa spangs na bde/ /zhes dang / nor rnams kun gyi nang nas chog shes pa/ /rab mchog lags pa lha mi'i ston pas gsungs/ /kun tu chog shes mdzod cig chog mkhyen na/ /nor ma bdog kyang yang dag 'byor pa lags/ /ting 'dzin rgyal po las/ gang dag bdag gir 'dzin pa ci yang med/ /gang dag yongs 'dzin dam pa kun tu med/ /bse ru lta bur 'jig rten 'dir gnas pa/ /de dag nam mkha' la ni rlung ltar 'gro/ /gang dag 'jig rten la ni yid mi chags/ /de dag mi yi 'jig rten rab tu bde/ /zhes dang / rje mi las/ las ngan 'dzin pa'i rtsa ba can/ /bu tsha'i 'khri ba bcad nas ni/ /rang nyid gcig pur sdod zug na/ /zhing khams rnam dag shugs las 'byung / /zhes dang / slob dpon don yod 'char gyis/ shin tu bde ba gang zhe na/ /'du 'dzi kun la ma chags pa'o/ /zhes dang / a ba rnyu ti pas/ zang 103

zing phyir ni rtsod 'gyur te/ /zang zing med la rtsod pa med/ /zang zing yongs su spangs pa las/ /chu skyar bde ba 'phel bar 'gyur/ /zhes dang / spyan snga bas/ bzung ba ci yang med pas su'i yang ngo bsrung mi dgos bsrung ba'i don med/ su la'ang rag ma lus/ rang dbang rang gis thob/ steng na lding ba bya mi na pa med/ dgra ma thul ba'am/ gnyen ma 'khyong ba med/ ces dang / tshe blos btang ba 'di nyams rtogs ma skyes pa skye ba skyes pa mi nyams par gong 'phel tu gtong ba'i thabs nyag gcig yin zhes dang / 'dod pa spangs na yon tan gzhan gang yang med kyang / de ka 'jig rten na dkon pa'i yon tan mchog rab yin gsungs/ tshoms las/ 'dod pa rnams las rab 'das shing / /'jig rten 'dod chags bral ba bde/ /skye bo cang med yon tan rtogs pa dang / /skye bo ci yang med par gyur pa bde/ /skye bo sgye bo'i lus la rab chags shing / /cung zad yod pa brlag par 'gyur la ltos/ /nga la ci yang med mod kyi/ /dga' bar za bar byed pas na/ /'od gsal gyi ni lha bzhin du/ /kye ma ho shin tu bde bar 'tsho/ /zhes dang / sha bo pas/'dod pa'i blo sna mang po 'di zlog na/ skyid mgo tshugs pa yin gsungs/ zhes dang / jo bos/ rab byung 'ching ba dam po 104

gang / /rnyed pa dang ni bkur bste ste/ /'ching ba de las grol ba gang / /me yi nang gi pad+ma bzhin/ /mkhas pas ngo mtshar gnas su gyur/ /zhes dang / skyes rabs su/ mang du thos pas snyoms pa med/ /'byor pa rnams la ser sna med/ /nags tshal gnas rnams chog shes pa/ /yon tan rgyan gyi mchog yin no/ /zhes dang / rtogs ldan bsam gtan 'bar gye zhal nas/ tshe 'di'i skyid 'dod sdug bsngal yin/ /rlung la bskur na gtan skyid 'byung / /zhes dang / gtsang pa rgya ras kyi zhal nas/ nyams myong can gye sgo khang na/ /skyid po sgo nyal byed kyin yod de/ /zhim lto can gyis ma tshor bar yod pa yin/ /gnyen po can gyi sgo khang na/ /'jig rten blos btang sgo nyal byed kyin yod de/ /chags sdang can gyis ma tshor ba yod pa yin/ /rtsa ba gcod pa'i sgo khang na/ /blo bde sgo nyal byed kyin yod de/ /re dogs can gyes ma tshor bar yod pa yin/ /chog shes can gyi sgo khang na/ /phyug po sgo nyal byed kyin yod de/ /'dod pa can gyis ma tshor ba yod pa yin/ /zhes dang / tshe blos btang bas tshe 'di la ma chags pas sbyin pa'i rab/ ci byas sems can gyi don du 'gyur bas 'gro don gyi rab/ yul gang la chog shes pas phyug po'i rab/ rgyal khams gar phyin yang chog pas pha yul gyi rab/105

gnas gar nyal yang skyid pa khang bzang gi rab/ nyams myong grogs su bzang bas grogs po'i rab brtsams pa mthar 'don pa pho rgod po'i rab/ rang dbang rang gis thob pas kha rag gi rab/ sems chags sdang gi dbang du ma shor bas snying rje'i rab/ tshul min yid la mi 'gyu bas tshul khrims kyi rab/blo sems nyams dang ldan pa mkha' 'gro bsdud pa'i rab yin/zhes dang / tshe 'di blo yis thongs na sbyin pa brgya yi do zla min/ /zhes dang / skyid 'dod na gcig pur sdod/ bza' che na che ste su dang yang bgod mi dgos/ med na med de su yang skyong dgos kyi sems khral med pas skyid rung 'khyag rung ltogs rung gcig bu yin pas skyid gsungs/ rgyal sras rin po ches/ blo chos su 'gro na tshogs bsags mthar thug yin/ /nam 'chi nges med dran na spyang bo'i mthar thug yin/ /sdig spong dge ba bsgrubs na grung bo'i mthar thug yin/ /'gro kun spyi bor 'khur na mthon po'i mthar thug yin/ /chog shes blo dang ldan na phyug po'i mthar thug yin/ /gang la'ang chags zhen med na skyid pa'i mthar thug yin/ /zhes dang / na ning dus su rmi lam gyi dge sbyor zin po yong gin yod pa yin te/ bar skabs su 'du long rnams kyis 'grib song / do zhag na ba des legs par sor 106

chud byung / bsod nams skye ba skad zer ba 'di kun kyang ma byung na rang yong bar 'dug gsungs/ kun spangs grags rgyal gyi slob ma dge bshes kha rag pa bya ba yon tan dang sku bsod chen po yod pa cig la mdze byung / thabs ci byas kyang ma phan/nub cig nad 'dis gang ltar yang mi khyu nas 'bud pa la 'bud ngo shes pa zhig bya/ longs spyod gang yod dge phyogs la btang / khye mo rdza 'phreng gi rdza 'og der bsdad la lto la zan slong / ma ṇi 'dren snyam pa byung / de'i nub rmi lam na khong chus 'khyer bas/ mi dkar po zhig gis chu nas bton/ khye mo rdza 'phreng gi brag steng du bzhag pas lus las chu mang po zag pa rmis/ sad tsa na mal chus khengs/ mje sang phan zer gsungs/bla ma zhang rin po ches/ tshe blos btang 'di la ma 'bad na gar sdeb cha med pas/ ngas ni dge sbyor gyi gtso bo tshe blos btang 'di la sgril bas/ zla ba re tsam la yon tan rong rong ba skyes byung gsungs/ yang phar bsre tshur bsre'i sgrub pa yun ring las/ tshe blos btang ba'i sgrub pa zhag gcig dga' gsungs/ pha dam pa rgya gar slob ma'i khyu rgyan/ dam pa kun dga' bya ba des/pha dam pa la dngos grub rnam pa lnga blangs so/ /bdag yul med thab med du byin gyis rlob tu gsol/ bza' med bca' med du 107

byin gyis rlob tu gsol/ 'dris med bshes med du byen gyis rlob tu gsol/ mis cir yang mi mthong bar byin gyis rlob tu gsol/ bsod nams til gyi 'bru tsam yang mi skye bar byen gyis rlob tu gsol/ zhes zhus nas dka' thub byas nas bsgoms pas ting 'dzin bzang po brnyes pa zhig byung ba der gda'/ sha bo sgang pa'i zhal nas/ nga la blo gtod nus pa yod na skyid du gzhug tu yod pa yin te snyam/ 'o na nga yang blo gtad snyam na/thabs gzhan med/ man ngag gzhan med/ tshe 'di blos gtong 'jug pa yin gsungs/ zhes dang / 'o skol gyi tshe 'di phyi'i sdug bsngal gye rgyu thams cad/ tshe 'di'i 'dod pa yin pas/ tshe 'di'i 'dod pa bsgrub bya skyung dgos/ tshe 'di'i bsgrub bya che tsa na thugs mi bde/ gar rgyug cha med de tsa na sdig sdug gtam ngan gsum dus gcig la 'ong / des na 'dod pa'i blo mang po 'di bzlog dgos/ 'dod pa'i blo sna zlog tu btub tsa na skyid 'go tshugs pa yin/ des na tshe 'di phyi thams cad du bde ba sgrub pa la/ yas rtag tu snying la ci yang mi 'dod pa/ ci yang mi gsog pa zhig dgos/ rnyed pa mi 'dod tsa na rnyed pa'i mchog yin/ snyan pa mi 'dod tsa na snyan pa'i mchog yin/ grags pa mi 'dod tsa na grags pa'i mchog yin/ 'khor mi 'dod tsa na 108

'khor gyi mchog yin/ snying nas chos byed na blo sprang la gtad dgos/ sprang gi tha ma 'chir 'jug nus dgos/ blo sna de lta bu zhig skyes pa na/ lha 'dre mi gsum gyi 'o brgyal du mi 'jug nges pa yin gsungs/ skyes mchog pa'i zhal nas/ tshe 'di rlung la bskur nus na/ /zhen log po zhes 'dogs pa lags/ /ci yang dgos pa med tsa na/ /grags pas sa steng khyab pa lags/ /lus srog chos phyir thong tsa na/ /snyan pa'i bser bus bskyod pa lags/ /zhes dang / slob dpon zhi ba lhas/ g.yeng ba med pa'i tshul can chos mchog gang thob pa/ /sngon chad ma thob pa yi skyid pa'ang rab thob cing / /bde ba las ni nam yang nyams par 'gyur ba med/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i bde mchog mi zad dang / /sangs rgyas go 'phang mnyam med phun sum tshogs pa'ang thob gsungs/ 'phags pa thogs med kyis/ shes rab kyi 'tsho ba chos kyi longs spyod spyad pa'i bde ba ni/ bza' ba dang btung ba dang / bud med dang glu gar sogs 'dod pa la longs spyod pa'i bde bas ye mi bde ba zhig yin gsungs/skyes mchog pas/ sems la khur med par sdod pa las skyid pa med/ bya byed med par sdod pa las las sla ba med/ sems gnyer med du sdod pa las don che ba med gsungs/ sa skya paṇa 109

chen gyes/ rang dbang thams cad bde ba ste/ /gzhan dbang thams cad sdug bsngal yin/ /bde ba'i mchog ni sems skyid pa/ /nor gye mchog ni sbyin pa ste/ /gsungs/ spyan snga bas/ 'o cag lto rgyab kyi 'tsho bas phongs kyang / blo phugs sprang la gtad pas/ dad ldan kun gyis mchod gnas byed/ des na longs spyod kyi gtso bo zhen chags med pa yin pas/ ka ca'i gsog rum bya ba'i don med/ 'o cag la mis 'phyar kha btang yang / rang sems la zol zog med pa zhig byas pas mjug kun gyis yid du 'ong ba zhig yong ba yin/ des na snyan grags kyi gzhi ma spyod lam la skyon med pa 'di yin pas tshul 'chos bya ba'i don med gsungs/ 'ba' ra bas/ rang gcig pu'i g.yo skol sus kyang shes/ /'bral med kyi nye gnas lag pa bzang / /tshul 'chos kyi bzang tshul mi dgos par/ /rang gcig pu'i spyod pa bag re yangs/ /dka' thub kyi zas la zad pa med/ /rang gcig pu'i 'tsho ba gar yang rnyed/ /rang gcig pu'i gos 'di cis kyang dro/ /gtum mo'i me 'di gting dro che/ /rang gcig pu'i sdod sa 'di cis kyang chog/ bdag med kyi spyil chung snang ba bde/ /gsungs/ kha rag pas/ snying ring bka' blo mi bde rang 'dod can/ /zag pa 'phel ba'i 'khor g.yog med kyang legs/ /kho 110

bo'i nye gnas shes rab brtson 'grus yin/ /dgos pa'i don kun sgrub la skyo ngal med/ /gsungs/ pha dam pa'i zhal nas/ tshe 'di blo yis thongs na/ gdams pa de la bya rgyu med/ dge sbyor gyi gtso bo bya ba btang ba la bya/ spyod pa'i gtso bo dman sa 'dzin pa la bya/ sgom gyi gtso bo gcig pur sdod pa la bya/ bya ba thongs na chos brgyad logs su spang mi dgos tshe 'di blos thongs na sdug bsngal logs su spangs mi dgos/ bzung ba la ma chags na 'khrul ba rang zhig la 'gro gsungs/ rig 'dzin gang shar rang grol gyis skyid pa'i rgyang glu las/ pha yul rgyal khams kyi phyogs med/ /dgon gzhis nges med kyi ri khrod/ /nye 'brel rigs drug gi sems can/ /yan pa blo bde tsho'i skyid pa/ /phar bltas dpon po ni mi 'dug /tshur bltas g.yog po ni mi snang / /khyem mtshes chags sdang dang bral ba'i/ /bya btang rnal 'byor tsho'i skyid pa/ /bdag 'dzin dgon pa ni mi 'dug /dngos po'i srog bsrung ni mi snang / /mi ngan ngo srung dang bral ba'i/ /kun spang blo bde tsho'i skyid pa/ /bsdad na zhen chags ni mi 'dug /'gro na lus rgyu ni mi snang / /gang bde stabs bde rang byed pa'i/ /tshogs bsags rnal 'byor tsho'i skyid pa/ /ras gos rkyang gcig gi ngang nas/ /bza' btung slong mo la brten te/ /rgyal khams 111

phyogs med la 'grim pa'i/ /rnal 'byor ras pa tsho'i skyid pa/ /sdig spong dge ba ni sgrub yod/ /'khor bar zhen pa ni log snang / /gzhan phan byang chub sems 'byong ba'i/ /gu yangs blo bde tsho'i skyid pa/ /bla ma'i byin rlabs ni zhugs byung / /gang shar rig stong du 'char snang / 'brel tshad don ldan la 'god pa'i/ /rig 'dzin bu brgyud tsho'i skyid pa/ /'di 'dra'i skyid pa tsho mi byed/ /tshe 'di bya ba la zhen pa'i/ /snyigs dus skya ser gyi tshogs rnams/ /snying med yang na ni spyon pa/ /ding sang 'jig rten gye khams na/ /rang re dpon slob las skyid pa/ /mi 'dug nyams len gye ngang nas/ /rgyal khams gang bzang la chas 'gro /bya btang mgrin pa yi mdzod nas/ /skyid glu de 'dra zhig thal song / /tshig don snying dbus su zungs dang / /skyid pa'i nyi ma zhig 'char nges/ /gsungs/ thog ma'i blo sbyong las/ tshe blos btang 'di blos gting dpag dka' ba/ thams cad kyis rtogs par dka' zhing / gsang ba'i gnas dam pa yin pas na/ gsang ba bla na med pa'i chos bya ba 'di lags/ gzhan yang phan bde thob pa'i thabs gzhan na med par 'di la yod pas na/ yang chos 'di zab mo gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pa lags te/ tshe 'di'i bde ba dang / byang chub rnam pa gsum 112

gyi bar thams cad 'dis tshegs med par 'grub pas so/ /'o na tshe blos gtong ba/ tshe 'di'i bde ba spong ba ma yin nam/ tshe 'di blos btang bas tshe 'di'i bde ba ji ltar 'grub snyam na/de khyed bden te/ e re 'dod kyis myong ba min/ chen po 'dod pas skal ba chad/ mthon po 'dod pas g.yang du lhung skad na/ bde bde mo skyid skyid mo zhig 'dod pa la skyid po yong ba med/ ma byung yang kho rang shes/ dgos pa med snyam pa zhig la skyid po yong ba yin no/ /rnal 'byor pa rtags mi 'dod kyang rtags kyis rnal 'byor pa mi gtong mi zer ram/ sangs rgyas zer ba'i sgra bo che/ /'dod pa spangs pa'i rtsa na gda'/ /mi zer ram gsungs/ bu mo zla ba mchog gis zhus pa las/ gang dag yul rnams la ni chags med cing / /me 'dag lta bu'i 'dod pa 'bar spong dang / /dbang po drug po sdom pas bsdams pa dang / /gang dag tshangs spyod rnam par dag spyod dang / /gang dag gzhan gyi chung ma mthong gyur na/ /ma dang sring mo'i 'du shes bskyed byed pa/ /de dag mdzes shing lta na sdug pa dang / /sdug pa mchog tu yid du 'ong bar 'gyur/ /zhes dang / bshes springs las/ gang dag dbang po drug yul rnams la ni/ /rtag tu mi brtan g.yo dang gang dag cig /g.yul ngor dgra tshogs las 113

rgyal de dag las/ /mkhas rnams dang po dpa' rab lags par 'tshal/ /zhes dang / lhag bsam bskul ba las/ de'i sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams la bar chad med pa yin/ khyem pa dang /rab tu byung ba dag yid 'byung bar mi 'gyur ba yin/ lha dang mi rnams yongs su dag par bya ba'i phyir/ gnas pas rjes su bsrung bar 'os pa yin/ ngan 'gror log par ltung ba thams cad kyis skrag pa med pa yin/ sdig pa dang bral bar zil gyis mi non par yin/ bdud kyi las yongs su grol ba'i mi 'phrog pa yin/ sdug bsngal thams kyis mi tshugs pa yin/ lha dang mi rnams kyi mngon par 'dod par bya ba yin/ bsam gtan la goms par byed par gnas pas gsal ba yin/ g.yo sgyu spangs pa dang / 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga la skyon du blta bas bag yod pa yin/ 'phags pa'i rigs bzhi la gnas pas ji skad smras pa bzhin du byed pa yin/ mkhas pa rnams dang / tshangs par mtshungs par spyod pa rnams kyi 'dod pa yin te/ byams pa phan yon 'di lta bu 'di dag shes nas/ byang chub sems dpa' mkhas pas rnyed pa dang bkur bste thams cad spangs pa'i phyir lhag pa'i bsam pas 'dod pa chung ba la gnas par bya zhing /'dod pa chung ba la brten par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs/ kun 114

spangs grags rgyal gyis/ stong gsum 'jig rten nor la dbang bsgyur yang / /zhe 'dod rtsa ba ma spangs dbul phongs yin/ /bdag 'dzin rtsa ba gting nas chod tsa na/ /dbul zhing phongs pa bya ba'i ming yang med/ /'byor ldan rgyal po bya ba de la zer/ /zang zing sgyu ma'i nor gyes dgos pa med gsungs/ /yang dgon pa'i zhal nas/ ngas ni tshe blos gtong ba 'di ga la 'bad pas/ blo bskol je 'dod la song / dge sbyor gyi bskyed dang bogs thams cad kyang de nas byung gsungs/ ting nge 'dzin rgyal po las/ dbu ba rdol 'dra'i lus dang ni/ /chu yi chu bur 'dra srog la/ /mi gang chags par mi byed pa/ /de dag 'gro ba mchog tu 'gro/ /zhes dang / des pas zhus par/ gang zhig byams pa rab tu bsgoms te sems can rnams la tha ba ma mchis shing / /rtag par rgyun du ngan ngon tsam gyis chog par 'dzin cing 'dod pa ma mchis la/ /nyam thag mthong na rtag tu snying rje bgyid cing sha gnyer bgyid pa ma mchis pa/ /de ni phyug cing nor bzang bzhin du nor che dad pa la sogs longs spyod gnas/ /zhes dang / tshoms las/ nad med rnyed pa'i dam pa ste/ /chog shes pa ni nor gyi dbyig /yid gcugs bshes pa'i mchog yin te/ /mya ngan 'das pa bde ba'i phul/ /zhes dang /115

dbul bo des pas rgyal po gsal rgyal la/ gsal rgyal zan gcig med bzhin du/ /gang dag la ni gtong phod pa/ /de dag 'jig rten nor chen zhes/ /yang dag gzigs pa rnams kyis bshad/ /ces dang / tshoms las/ gang zhig 'dod pas rnam grol ba/ /de ni dga' ba mchog yin no/ /de la brten nas rnal 'byor pa/ /'gro ba mchog tu 'gro bar 'gyur//zhes dang /bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa'i mdor/ nga rgyal med dang khengs med dang / /chog shes mthun par 'tsho ba dang / /rtag tu byas pa gzo byed pa/ /de ni bkra shis dam pa yin/ /zhes dang / skyes rabs las/ chog shes ldan cing snying rje'i yon tan gyis/ /'jig rten dag na sgye bo ma 'dris pa'ang / /gzhan la ma byams bzhin du de la byams/ /'dod pa chung la ngan g.yo mi shes shing / /rnyed dang grags dang de la ma chags shing / /des na lha rnams yid kyang mgu gyur nas/ /dwangs shing rab tu gus la gzhol bar byed/ /ces dang / tshoms su/ dge slong bsod snyoms spyod pa bdag rang tsam/ /bgrang bar byed kyi gzhan dag mi gso ba/ /skyob pa de la lha rnams dga' byed cing / /bkur bsti nor dang grags 'dod rnapos la min gsungs/ dran pa nyer bzhag las/ bde ba yis yang rtsa ba mchog /zhi ba gcig 116

pu rab tu grags/ /gang gi snying la de med pa/ /de ni sdug bsngal can zhes grags/ /gang zhig 'dod chags zhe sdang can/ /sred bcas de la bde ba med/ /gang zhig 'dod chags me las grol/ /de ni dri med bde bar 'dod/ /ces dang / 'dod pa yongs su spangs byas shing / /rtag tu thar la dga' ba ni/ /nyi ma shar ba'i mun sel ltar/ /mi dge'i chos rnams 'jig par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / gang la don dang don min mnyam/ /de bzhin rnyed dang mi rnyed dang / /bde dang sdug bsngal med mnyam pa/ /de ni dge slong zhes pa'o/ /ri mor bris pa'i bud med la'ang / /mig gis blta bar mi byed de/ /'jig rten 'dod pa dam bcom pa/ /de lta bu ni grol zhes bya/ /zhes dang /yab sras mjal ba'i mdo las/ /skom dang me 'dra'i 'dod pa la/ /sdug bsngal 'byung bar sus shes pa/ /de dag sred pa zhi 'gyur te/ /me la chu ni blugs pa bzhin/ /zhes gsungs/ sngon bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa'i tshe/ drang srong a ga ta zhes bya bar gyur pa na nga la mchog slong zhig zer bas/ chung ma yid du 'ong dang bu dang dbang byed dang / /mngon par 'dod par nor rnams rgya chen thob gyur kyang / /gang gi yid gdung nam yang chog mi shes pa yi/ /bskams pa'i rlung de bdag gi 117

snying la med par byos/ /byes pa rnams ni nam yang mi thos shing / /mthong bar mi 'gyur nam yang mi spra zhing / /de dang 'grogs pas skyo ba'i sdug bsngal yang / /mi myong mchog de bdag gis khyed la slong / /lha rnams kun gyi mchog tu gyur pa khyod/ /bdag la phan 'dogs rgyur 'gyur mchog sbyin na/ /gsal ba bdag drung slan chad mi 'byon pa'i/ /mchog 'di lha min 'joms pa khyod la slong / /zhes dngos grub kyi mchog de 'dra bslangs/ spyan snga bas/ da lta 'du long bun ne/ grags pa di ri ba zhig ma byung na/ kho dge bshes chen po yin pa la/gdul bya re yang mi 'du ang zer nas/ 'du long ma byung na chos kyi dgos pa ma byung bar byed par 'dug ste/ ye ma go ba yin te/ jo bo'i zhal nas/ dngos grub kyi mchog nyon mongs je chung la song ba yin/ grub rtags kyi mchog 'dod pa je chung la song ba yin/ bya ba min pa dngos grub kyi mchog rnyed bkur 'byung ba yin/ mi gsung bar gda' gsungs/ des na chos kyi gzhi gtan nas nyes ma nyes/ chos pa yin nam min sngar chos byas sam ma byas/ da chos yong ngam mi yong / tshe blos btang ma btang 'di la blta dgos te/ mkhas grub rin po che'i zhal nas/dam pa rnams kyis tshe 'di blos btang nas/ zab mo'i man 118

ngag rtse gcig nyams blangs pas/ /don gnyis phul phyin mtha' yas rnam thar la/ /yid gsos 'dun pa cha tsam mi skye bar/ /da lta'i ston pa 'ga' yi rnyed grags dang / /'khor slob rgya chen 'du 'god mang po'i gtam/ /thos pa tsam gyis 'gram chu ldang ba de/ /gzhi rtsa gting nas nyes pa'i rtags ngan yin/ /zhes dang /rig pa'i dbang phyug gi zhal nas/ chos kyi nyams len sna gcig ma grub par/ /khyod nyid chos par rlom pa kye ma blun/ /chos kyi dang po tshe 'di blos thongs pa/ /rang gi rgyud la 'dug gam mi 'dug ltos/ /gsungs/ spyan snga bas/ sngar chos byas sam ma byas/ da yong ngam mi yong / rang gi pha yul nye 'brel/zas nor sogs tshe 'di'i phun tshogs rnams blos btang ma btang la brtag par bya zhes gsungs/ des na rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad kyis/ tshe blos btang nas chos bzhin mdzad pas don gnyis lhun gyis grub tshe/ rjes 'jug 'o skol rnams la thugs brtse bas tshe blos thongs zhes yang yang nan tan gsungs te/ sangs rgyas kyi zhal gye bum bzang las/ nga yongs su mya ngan las 'das shing dam pa'i chos kyang nub par 'gyur la/ khyed kyang 'dod pa rnams la brten nas rnam par ltung bar song na nam zhig rga ba dang / 'chi bdag las thar par 'gyur dge 119

slong mchog gis 'dod pa rnams las ldog cig 'di ni 'dod pa btsal ba'i dus ma yin gyis/ chos btsal ba'i dus yin no/ /gsungs/ mdo sde dkon mchog sprin las/ yi dam gyis bar chad dam/ sems g.yeng bar gyur mi rung ngo / /bud med dang skyes pa dang / khye'u dang bu mo rnams dang / 'du 'dzi mi byed cing / 'du 'dzi dag thag ring po bas kyang ring por yongs su spong ngo zhes dang / rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi mdo las/'dod pa skyon tshad med pa ldan pa rab tu 'bar zhing / kun tu 'bar bar mthong gis de lta bas na/ bdag gis gzhi de la mi spyad par nan tan bya'o/ /zhes gsungs/ mdor na bdag tu 'dzin pa khab skud tsam yang bya mi rung tha na bud med la mig zur tsam yang blta mi rung / gser dngul la lag gis reg kyang mi rung ba'i bcas pa mdzad/ gnas shing drung pa zas bsod snyoms pa byed dgos zhes mdo sde rnams su rgya cher gsungs/ de bzhin du o rgyan rin po ches kyang / myang ban ting 'dzin bzang po sogs la/ chos ma gtogs bud med sogs bya ba gzhan thams cad bskyur/ zang zing spangs nas sgrub pa rtse gcig tu bya dgos gsungs/ bal yul nas bod du 'byon khar/ bal bza' dkar lcam gyis/ 'khor bar mi 120

'khyams pa'i chos gcig zhu byas pas/ gang la'ang ma zhen cig /gang la yang ma chags shig /gang la yang ma 'dzin cig /khams gsum du mi 'khor gyis/ /gsungs/ brtse brtse dung dung chos bshol sgrub bcog pa'i/ /nye du 'brel pa thams cad 'gal rkyen yin/ /pha yul ma bsdad gar song cha med song / /'gal rkyen med pa'i gnas su sgrub pa gyis/ /zhes dang / su 'grogs yon tan mi 'byung gcig bur sdod/ /yun ring 'gro don dngos grub ngang gis 'byung / /lto gos g.yog byed phongs pa zher ma bzhag /gyi na srog 'tsho lhag skyob tsam la bsten/ /sems dkrug dgra sems 'dzin pa'i bud med btang / /'phral phug gnyis ka mi blta zhen pa log /mi yi gral nas ci bud ci 'thon gyis/ /yongs su 'dzin pa khab skud cig mi bya gsungs/ jo bo rjes/ bsod nams zer ba'i 'du 'dzi de yang chos kyi bar chad yin pas spongs/ /rnyed dang bkur sti bdud kyi zhags pa yin pas srang kha'i rdo bzhin sol/ /bstod dang grags pa'i tshig rnams bslu khrid yin pas mchil snabs bzhin du dor/ /da lta bde skyid snyan gsum 'dzom yang yud tsam yin pas rgyab tu skyur/ /gsungs/ 'dres pas 'dres shing chags par byed/ /de yis 'khor ba'i 'khor lo bskor/ /de ltar 'dris pa spangs pa 121

la/ /rtag tu bag dang ldan par bya/ /gsungs/ yang sku 'da' khar bu chen rnams la/ khyed thams cad kyis 'brom ston pa la brten la tshe blos thongs gsungs/ rnal 'byor pa chag pa khri mchog gis/ jo bo gshegs pa na/ bdag gis bsgom par zhu zhus pas/ bya ba ngan pa yin bor la thongs gsungs/ 'o na 'chad par zhu zhus pas de skad gsungs/ 'o na res bshad res bsgom mam zhus pas de skad gsungs/ 'o na ci bgyi zhus pas tshe blos thongs gsungs/ btsun pa gcig gis bskor ba byas pas/ston pa rin po che'i zhal nas/ jo bo bskor ba byed pa'ang glo ba dga' ste/ de bas chos shig rang byas na dga' gsungs/kho'i bsam pa la phyag gcig byas na dga' ba yin nam snyam nas byas pas kyang de skad gsungs/ de bzhin du kha ton dang sgom byas pas kyang de skad gsungs/ 'o na ci ga bgyid zhus pas tshe 'di blos thongs shig lan gsum gsungs/ bram ze sa ra ha'i zhal nas/ gang la zhen pa yod na de yang thongs/ /rtogs par gyur na thams cad de yin te/ de las gzhan pa sus kyang shes mi 'gyur/ /zhes dang / gser phreng las/ bya ba btang ba man ngag yin/ /zhe 'dod med na rtogs pa yin/ /zhes dang /te lo pas/ snang bas mi 'ching zhen pas 'ching / /zhen pa 122

chod cig nā ro pa/ /gsungs/ grub chen thang stong rgyal pos gsol zas spangs nas zla ba gsum tsam gyi bar du sku mtshams bsdams pas/ skabs shig slob ma yon bdag rnams kyis bug sgo nas/ bla ma rin po che sku mi ston na gsung byon gsung mi 'byon na saṃ ṭa la phyag bris gnang dgos zhus pa'i lan du/kun gyes tshe blos thongs/ bsam pa dkar po gyis gsungs/ rje mi la'i zhal nas/ bu snying nas lha chos bya bsam na/ /dad pa gting nas skyes pa na/ /tshe 'di la phyi mig mi blta bar/ /bden pas nga phyir 'brang ba na/ /gnyen 'dun bdud kyi bshol 'debs yin/ /bden no ma snyam 'khri ba chod/ /zas nor bdud kyi so pa yin/ /'dris shing ngan no 'dzin chags thongs/ /'dod yon bdud kyi zhags pa yin/ /'ching bar nges so zhen pa thongs/ /gzhon grogs bdud kyi bu mo yin/ /bslu bar nges so khong zon gyis/ /pha yul bdud kyi btson ra yin/ /thar par dka' yi myur du bros/ /gsungs/ rje rin po ches/gang du 'brel na dug gsum la sogs pa'i/ /nyon mongs tshogs rnams yar ngo'i zla bzhin 'phel/ /dkar phyogs tho rangs rgyu skar ltar 'grib pa'i/ /gnas ngan myur du spong dang rgyal khams pa/ /zhes gsungs/ klong chen rab 'byams pas/ mdor na tshe 123

'di'i bya ba thams cad kun/ /kha zas bzang la btsan dug 'dres pa yin/ /snying nas spong ba dam pa'i rnam thar lags/ /gsungs/ bka' gdams glegs bam las/ 'di yi bya bar rgyab kyis phyogs/ /mi bral nas bud ri dwags bzhin/ /'phral la zas tshol bya dang 'dra/ /kog ste langs pa'i gzhis rdzogs pa/ /zhes dang / ) pha dam pas/ gang la zhen pa byung na de yang thongs/ /cis kyang dgos pa med do ding ri pa/ /'jig rten 'dir ni gtan du mi sdod na/ /'gro rtsis da lta gyis shig ding ri pa/ /gsungs/ rgyal sras thogs med kyis/ gnyen gyi phyogs la 'dod chags chu ltar g.yo/ /dgra yi phyogs la zhe sdang me ltar 'bar/ /blang dor 'byed pa'i gti mug mun nag can/ pha yul spong ba rgyal sras lag len yin/ /zhes dang / spyan snga bas/ja thud sha mar la sogs pa'i/ /bkra mi shis pa de dag gis/ /khyod la ltas ngan gtong 'gyur gyis/ /sbrul dug de dag myur spong la/ /dpag tshad brgya yi pha rol songs/ /zhes dang / kha rag sgom chung pas/ bza' med khyem thab byas pa na/ /dgos med bu tsha byung nas ni/ /khrel med sprang po bya dgos kyi/ /gros nyes chung ma ma len ang / /zhes dang / dad gus 'khor las dkon pa med/ /mi ngan dpon las sdug pa med/ /bzang po'i 124

dpon cha ma 'dzin par/ /ngan pa'i dman cha zungs shig ang / /gsungs/ grub chen yu mo'i zhal nas/ nyams la yar bskyed med pa de/ /zla ba nyi mas non pa 'dra/ /de gnyis snang gi yul la zhen pas lan/ /sems kyi 'khri ba chod cig skal ldan kun/ /gsungs/ 'ba' ra ba rgyal mtshan gyis/ phyogs med ri khrod ma 'grim na/ /pha yul skyid kyang shul du 'jog /nges med ri khrod 'grims kyang 'tshal/ /bdag bzung med par bsdad na legs/ /chog shes 'dod pa ma bsten na/ /ser sna'i nor la 'dang dus med/ /nor med sprang po bgyid kyang 'tshal/ /ci med cang med byas na legs/ /zhes dang / mkhas btsun gzhon nu grub kyi zhal nas/ gnas gcig yun ring chags sdang skye ba'i rgyu/ /'dris bshes mang na phyogs ris zhen pa 'phel/ /bsog rum mang pos lus ngag dge sbyor chag /'dris med yul du 'khyams na mi 'thad dam/ /sha tsha'i gtam yin rang gi snying la bris/ /gsungs/ sgo mtha' yas sgrub pa'i gzungs las/sems can gang dag kha cig rtsod gyur pa/ /de yi gzhi ni yongs su 'jin pa ste/ /de ltas gang la sred par 'gyur ba spongs/ /sred pa spangs par byas na gzungs su 'gyur/ /zhes dang /rig pa'i dbang phyug gi zhal nas/ 'dod yon dgra bo'i dang ma 125

yin/ /nye 'brel 'ching ba'i zhags pa 'dra/ /che 'dod 'gong po phugs zhugs 'dra/ /snang shas ma che rgya mi pa/ /gsungs/gtsang pa rgya ras kyis/ chags sdang rtsa ba pha yul spangs/ /sdug bsngal rtsa ba khyim thab spangs/ /'dzin chags rtsa ba nor rdzas spangs/ /g.yeng ba'i rtsa ba ngo srung spangs/ /gsungs/ bla ma zhang rin po che'i zhal nas/ yo byad la sogs pha yul spongs shig /'jig rten gye bya ba ma btang na/ dge sbyor gyi so bsod mi 'byung bas bya ba thongs shig nor rdzas rlung la ma bskur na nye 'brel gyi kho thag mi chod pas nor rdzas rlung la skur cigagasungs/ yang tshe 'di blos gtong ba la dam bca' 'di rnams dgos gsungs/ mi dang blo sna mi bstun par gcig pur sdod pa dang / pha yul spong ba dang / 'dod yon la yi mug 'ba' zhig bsgom pa dang / dman sa 'dzin cing su'i yang ngo mi srung ba dang / gnyen po zog bsgom gyi bya ra 'jog pa dang / mi zer la ched du mi 'dzin par/ zer mod 'dug mod du 'jog pa dang /ci dgu rlung gis 'khyer yang sdug bsngal mi byed pa dang / sprang po shi ba bzhin/ mi tshe sdug zad la gtong ba dang / dgos med kyi drag sngags rgyun du bgrang ba dang / rang gi sna thag rang gis 'dzin pa dang / nyams len bzang po sprin bzhin 'khor bar bya 126

ba dang / bcu gcig po 'di yin gsungs/ gzhan yang tshe blos gtong ba la/ mi rgyud la snying rus dang gcod kham che ba rdo bcag pa 'dra ba zhig dgos/ 'phral bde la gting gcu dka' ba/ g.yag rgan gye 'jing ba 'dra ba zhig dgos/ 'du 'dzi la 'jigs pa sha ba dzis phog pa 'dra ba zhig dgos/ rtsis gdab med pa nyes can g.yang la mchong ba 'dra ba cig dgos/ sdug thub pa yugs mo da phrug bsrel ba 'dra ba cig dgos gsungs/'phags pa thogs med kyi zhal nas/ dngos po'i 'dod pa dang / nyon mongs pa'i 'dod pa gnyis yod de/ 'di gnyis char rab tu byung bas spangs gsungs/ po to ba'i gsung las/skyes pa'i yul spangs nye du thag bsrings/ /'du 'dzi kun spangs tshul bzhin yid byed/ /de la thar pa ring ba ma yin/ /zhes dang / gzhan gyis bdag la snying rje'i gnas byed/ /bdag ni rtag tu dga' bas gnas na/ /de la chos yong gzhan du na min/ /zhes dang / /zhes dang / spyod pa bsod snyoms skye ba bskyal bya/ /'dod chung bsten bya sems kyis mi gdung / /nyi zla bzhin du kun tu rgyu bya/ /yul gcig mi bsdad gnas gcig mi bzung / /zhes dang / sdad na 'phong rjes 'gro na rkang rjes la sa med pa/ lham sna bsgyur na pan gzhis rdzogs pa re dgos/ da 127

'gro na dngos po 'di dang 'di 'chol ba sogs byed/ 'di dang 'di khal 'gel dgos zer ba des mi yong / nga chud zos rung ma zos rung / pha ma la ma chags/ spun dang sring mo dang / bu smad dang mdza' bshes dang / mkhan slob dang / sde pa dang yul mi la sogs pa dang / tha na rang gi lus srog la yang ma chags par snabs lud rgyab tu 'bor ba bzhin du mi blta bar bya'o gsungs/ yang / lus srog thed la btang / bya brel rgyab tu skyur/ 'khri ba btsan chod byas/ zhe 'dod thams cad spangs/gsungs/ slob dpon a wa dhu ti pas/ mang po rtag tu 'thab 'gyur te/ /gnyis po dag ni 'gran zlar 'gyur/ /gzhon nu ma yi gdu bu bzhin/ /gcig bu rnam par rgyu bar bya/ /zhes dang /tshoms las/ khyem nas khyem med spangs nas su/ /spyod yul dben pa gang yin pa/ /de la mngon par dga' bslab cing / /'dod pa ci yang med par spong / /zhes dang / bla ma ye dgon pa'i zhal nas/ nga pha yul la zhen pa'i phyi thag bstung / /gnyen la gdong chung gi ltag pa ston/ /nor la chog shes kyi gnyen po bsten/ /'di bya btang gi mdun gros dang po yin/ /gsungs/rgyal ba yang dgon pas/ yang tshe blos gtong ba la dam bca' 'di rnams dgos gsungs/ tshe 'di'i ltos thag bcad/ lto 128

rgyab la gyong 'khur/ lus srog thed la bor/ dka' brgyud kyi rnam thar bsam/ go cha dang sdug sran bskyed/ ri khrod bsten cing sgrub pa snyug bsrings nas bsgoms pas nang nas skye tshul zhig 'ong ba yin gsungs/ gtsang pa rgya ras gyi zhal nas/nyon mongs yul las skye ba la/ pha yul mi spong ba'i snying med pa/ /nyams len gnyen pos byed pa la/ /gnyen po mi bsten pa'i snying med po/ /chos shan rkyen gyis 'byed pa la/ /rkyen rdong mi sprod pa'i snying med po/ /skyes pa'i pha yul rgyab tu spongs dang / /rlung 'khyer zer yang 'gyod pa med/ /spong thag bla ma'i phyogs su thongs dang / /ltogs nas shi yang 'gyod pa med/ /skam thag chu nang du chod dang / /bla ma bsten yun thung zer yang 'gyod pa med/ /skyes pa'i pha yul rgyab spongs dang / /gnyen po'i rten 'brel des 'grig /'jig rten gyi bde 'bras byur du mthong na/ /dad pa'i rten 'brel des 'grig /'jig rten blos thongs dang sbyin pa'i rten 'brel des 'grig /skyes pa'i pha yul ma spangs na/ /chags srang rgyun mi chad pas chos dang 'gal 'gal dus gcig tu bsdad pas mi yong/ sdig pa sog na 'gro dgos pa yin/ zhes dang / skyes pa'i yul spongs/nye du 'brel pa gcod/ ma brtags pa'i dngos po thams cad 129

spong ba dang gsum po 'di rwa bsgreng ba'i bka' srol yin pa la/phyis kyi mi kun gyis 'di dka' ba byung gsungs/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi mdo las/ khyem dang bsten pa kun spangs te/ /don nyung ba dang bgyid nyung ba/ /bas mtha' dgon pa'i spyod yul ba/ /ri dwags bzhin du 'gyur bar gyis/ /zhes gsungs/mkhas btsun pas/ phugs kyi 'dod blo zhig dang ma bral na/ /tshe 'di'i bya dgos chu bo'i gnyer ma 'dra/ /gcig zin de bas mang ba slar yang skye/ /lus ngag bya byed nyung na mi 'thad dam/ /zhes dang / ja chang thab ga'i sems 'dzin la sogs pa/ /dkar po dge ba'i chos spyod g.yeng ba'i rgyu/ /tshe 'di'i mtho 'grogs mi rjes ma snyogs par/ /mthun 'jug rtsig pa sgyel zhig gzhon nu grub/ /gsungs/ skyes mchog pas/ tshe 'di'i bde skyid rlung la bskur/ /nyams len phyogs su sdug bsngal khur/ /dka' thub phyogs su lus srog btang //gsungs/glang ri pa'i zhal nas/ lto rgyab dben par sdad pas chog gi/tshogs bsog byed pa'i gdung ba chod/ /nyin mtshan dge sbyor byas pas 'da' yi/ /grogs po 'tshol pa'i gdung ba chod/ /mi sems mal du bsdad pas zin gyis/ /mthun 'jug byed pa'i gdung ba chod/ /bla ma sgrub pas mnyes gyis/ /rnyed bkur byed 130

pa'i gdung ba chod/ /srung ba 'dre la bcol bas chog gi /drag sngags bzlos pa'i gdung ba chod gsung/ /khro los/ tshe 'di'i che thabs byas gyur kyang / /'grub rgyu med pa rang sems sdug /gzab nas sgrig kyang 'khrom nas 'jol/ /da ni zhe 'dod thams cad spangs/ /gsungs/ dge bshes yon lud pas mtshams mdzad pa la/ gcig gis thu ba nas bzung gdams ngag tshig gcig zhu zhus pas/ khyod gzhon nu nas rab tu byung ba yin pas/'chi khar mi 'gyod pa zhig gyis shig de la rtsam pa srog thub/dug po rgyab dros la bsten/ khyim mtshes kyis kyang ngo mi shes pa byas/ dma' ba'i sa bzung / hrul po'i gos gyon/ pha yul spangs/ gnyen bshes kyi rgya gad chu bzhin 'thung / tshe 'di la 'phya ba tho re ba zhig dgos/ phur shing chag mdar chu shor yang /'di la sgrim nus na mi 'gyod pa zhig 'ong gsungs/ rig pa'i dbang phyug gis/ sku bsod rgad po g.yo can 'dra/ /rang sems byis pa mgo stong 'dra/ /bya bzhag rtsed mo'i dgag sgrub 'dra/ /mngon zhen ma che rgya mi pa/ /gsungs/ bla ma 'ol sna bas/ bgros mi gtam la nyan nas zin med/ /blo sna mang gi mdun ma sun par sla/ /chos bya snyam gyi phyi bshol mthar mi phyin/ /tshe stong zad byung na ci tsug byed/ /gnas gang du 'dug kyang gsog 'jog 131

bshol/ /yul gang du 'gro yang ngo shes skyungs/ /mthun 'grogs bshes mang yang dbang ma gtong / /'di bya btang gi rang tshugs 'dzin lugs yin/ /su ji skad zer yang dgos med gyes/ /gang 'thad par spron yang na med skyongs/ /phugs ji ltar yong yang sdug sran bskyed/ /'di bya btang gi blo gcod byed pa yin/ /gsungs/ khro phu ba bsod nams seng ges/ grong dang dgon pa ri khrod la sogs pa/ /gang du sdod kyang dgos mdza' mi 'tshol zhing / /su dang 'grogs kyang mi mdza' mi 'khon par/ /rang tshugs 'dzin pa kho bo'i snying gtam yin/ /nang du sdod tshe khang pa'i gad la sogs/ /dben pa'i khong nas phun tshogs sgrub pa yang / /don chung ngang la mi tshe zad pa'i rgyu/ /bya ba gtong ba kho bo'i snying gtam yin/ zhes dang / dad ldan mos pas 'tsho ba sbyar byas te/ /bzang por bkur ba'i tshul 'chos spyod pa yang / /gzhan sems bzung phyir bdag nyid 'ching ba'i rgyu/ /ro snyoms spyod pa kho bo'i snying gtam yin/ /gsungs/ dge bshes phu chung pa'i zhal nas/ chos nan tar nyams su len na/dper na khrab kyi byang bu sna rtse 'ol ba de khrab kyi gseb tu sdeb tu mi btub pa ltar/ /tshe 'di pa'i mi dang sdeb tu mi btub pa zhig dgos/ mthun 'jug dang mi dga' ches na bdud kyis 132

'khyer/ mi ma mgu ba 'dod thog yin/ kho ma mgu bas kho rang mi 'ong / khos 'phyar kha btang bas gzhan mi yong / de tsa na rgyags phye zho ri las med kyang / de'i bar la blo sems bde 'bol le dge sbyor byar yod/ dge sbyor 'phel na gzhan don yang lhun grub tu 'byung ba yin gsungs/ gang pos zhus pa'i mdo las/ bdag ni dbang phyug mi 'tshol gyis/ /gal te rnyed kyang spong bar byed/ /deng 'dir sangs rgyas chos zab dang / /tshul khrims rnam dag 'ba' zhig 'tshol/ /zhes dang / mkhas btsun gzhon nu grub kyis/ lus ngag tshul 'chos log 'tsho 'byung ba'i rgyu/ /dad zas mang na dge sbyor 'grib pa'i rkyen/ /ro zhim zas kyi 'khri ba rtsad nas chod/ /lto gos gyong la bskur na mi 'thad dam/ /gsungs/ rje re 'da' ba/ chos gos gsum dang lhung bzed la sogs pa/ /rang nyid 'tsho ba'i yo byad ma gtogs pa/ /gser dang dbyig sogs lhag pa'i dngos po ni/ /rang gi don du til tsam mi 'chang ngo / /zhes dang / gang du gnas na snang shas 'phel 'gyur zhing / /rang rgyud rnyed bkur zhags pas 'ching byed pa/ /gzhan sems phrag dog 'gran sems kyis gdungs pa/ /gnas der skad cig tsam yang mi gnas so/ /gsungs/ spyan snga bas/ dang po pha yul spong ba 'di 133

shin tu gal che ste/ der zhen chags bskyed pa'i lus nye 'brel dang zhing khang la sogs pa'i nor dang sdang sems bskyed pa'i yul dgra la sogs pa yod pas/ blo chags sdang gi dbang du song nas chos mi 'grub/ gal te rang la chags sdang ma byung yang /de rnams kyis tshur la chags sdang byed du 'ong ste/ nye 'brel gyes khong tsho'i tshe 'di'i so tshis kyi grogs 'tshol/ gal te ma byas na sdig gsog dgras sngar gyi 'khor tsam yid la byas nas sgo gsum gyis ci gnod byed/ rang gzhan la sdig sdug bskyed pa yin/ pha yul spangs na de 'dra'i skyon med pa lags/ /zhes dang /ngas phug nor gyi bsog 'jog mi byed par blo sprang la gtad pa dang / sha mar ja 'thud sogs yid la mi byed par bza' btung ngan ngon kho nas chog shes par byed dgos snyam du bsam pa la ar+ghaṃ chen po bya zhes dang / mi nor zas gsum 'di spangs la/ tshe thung 'di skyes pa lhas ma tshor/ shi ba 'dres ma tshor ba zhig gi ngang la tshe skyel dgos gsungs/ lhag bsam bskul ba'i mdo las/ gang na spros pa'am rtsod pa yod pa las/ dpag tshad brgya yi pha rol 'gro ba mchog /gang na nyon mongs yod pa de dag tu/ /yud tsam zhig kyang gnas shing 'dug mi bya/ /rab byung don 'dod yon tan 'dod pa rnams/ /sdang ba'i sems kyis 134

rtsod pa ma byed cig /khyod la zhing med zhing las tshong bya med/ /gang dag nor phyir 'di dag 'byung ba smos/ /khyod la chung ma bu dang bu mo med/ /khyem dang gnyen gyi tshogs kyang yod ma yin/ /bran po bran mo med cing dbang phyug med/ /gsungs/ rgyal sras rin po che'i zhal nas/ nye du la sogs brtse bas tshe 'di yi/ /phun tshogs sgrub la nan gyes bskul byed na/ /phan par 'dod nas gnod la sbyor byed pas/ /blun po tshe 'di don gnyer de dag nyid/ /thar par bya phyir tshe 'di blos btang nas/ /zab mo'i lam la 'bad par bya dgos pas/ /de dag don du de dag rab spangs nas/ /dben par sgrub la brtson pa shin tu gces/ /gsungs/ skyes mchog pa'i zhal nas/ yul pha yul gyi steng nas chags sdang 'byung / /pho skyo shas can yod na hur thon mdzod/ /gnyen nye 'brel gyi steng nas gdung sems 'byung / /pho chos mdzad po yod na gdong chung mdzod/ /nor dngos po'i steng nas gsog 'jog 'byung / /pho zhen log can yod na nang yan mdzod/ /zas zhim mngar gyi steng nas 'dod sred 'byung / /pho zhe bcad can yod na dka' thub mdzod/ /mgu ba med pa'i nye 'brel 'di/ /bskyang gyen skyong dgos je mang 'gro/ /gdung sems 'brel thag bcad na legs/ /snying gtam yin gyi sems 135

la zhog /gsungs/ rgyal ba yang dgon pa'i gsung las/ tshe 'di rlung la bskur ba'i snying khams dang gcig /blo sna mi dang mi bstun pa'i long med dang gnyis/ /dgos med phyi tshis phor ba'i phral phyid dang gsum/ /'dod yon 'khri ba chod pa'i zhen log dang bzhi/ /tshe 'di blo yis gtong na dgos pa legs/ /zhes dang / spyir chos mthon po kho na la dga'/ dma' mo tshos blo mi khengs/ stong stong po med med po/ mtho mtho bo zhig kho na la dga' ste/ chos kyi pho sgo gang zag gis rtogs tshad du ma 'dod/chos rdzogs pa chen po yin pas mi phan/ gang zag rdzogs pa chen por 'gro dgos/ chos skad la rta ri ba mang po byas nas/gang zag la khye mi ri ba mang po mthong / chos tshig brkyang du song nas/ lag len la mi 'debs pa de pag shi'i glu skad/ ne tso'i 'don pa dang khyad par med/ chos gcig go gnyis go lag len la 'debs/ gcig shes gnyis shes rang rgyud la sbyor ba zhig dgos/ chos rang gi rgyud thog tu ma byon/ sems dang chos kyi phye chu ma 'dres par chos dang gang zag gi bar na har ba mi shong ba tsam byas/ chos gle pa'i tshos ma bzhin kha la ca le byas pa des chos kyi don byed ma nus pa lags mod/ cha 'bal le/ ke ka re byas nas mi nyan pa mang po gda' ste/ de tsa na chos kyi dgos 136

pa ma 'grub pa lags mod/ ngas ni tshe blos gtong ba la sgrub pa'i mthil du byas pa yin no/ /kye bu kun gsungs/ rig 'dzin gang shar rang grol gyi zhal nas/ lar da lta'i gnyen grogs kun gyis bslu/ /tshe 'di ni yud tsam zad nas 'gro/ /nor zas gos sogs la ma chags par/ /da kun spangs gyes shig snying gi bu/ /sngon 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal srid kyang / /dus lan cig min par thob mod kyang / /chos zab mo nyams su ma blangs na/ /da snying po 'dug gam snying gi bu/ /nga rgyal dbang mtsho skyes rdo rje'i bu/ /chos rdzogs chen nyams su len mkhan yin/ /da mi nor zas gsum ci yod kun/ /phaṭa drag po rgyab nas bskyur snying 'dod/ /don de skad smras pa'i snying gtam 'di/ /khyed 'dir tshogs rnams kyi thugs la zhog /ces dang / lha mthong dang 'dre mthong mngon shes dang / /rmi lam gyi lung bstan la sogs pa/ /rdzun tshig gis mi mgo mi bskor bar/ /g.yo sgyu dang bral ba chos pa rab/ /don med kyi lang shor gnas skor dang / /grong gseb kyi 'dre 'dul lha mchod dang / /mi thub pa'i nad pa'i sngas bsrung rnams/ /sgom chen gyi bdud yin dug bzhin spongs/ /gsungs/ rje skal ldan rgya mtsho'i zhal nas/ pha yul bdud kyi btson rar/ /ha cang 'dug yun ma ring / /chags 137
