sdang ngang gis 'byung bas/ /da lta 'byon grab mdzod cig /bsgom pa yul du lus na/ /seng ge lcags kyis bcings 'dra / /skyo shas rtsal stobs bskyed la/ /da lta yul nas bros shig gsungs/ rgyal sras rin po che'i zhal nas/ dam chos thar pa'i lam du 'gro ba la/ /tshe 'di phun tshogs sgrub la rtse gcig pa'i/ /blo ngan 'di las bar chad che ba med/ /de phyir rnam pa kun tu 'di spangs bya/ /thos bsam sgom gsum dge ba gang byed kyang / /blo ngan 'di dang 'dres na ro brgya'i zas/ /ngan skyugs dag dang 'dres pa ji bzhin du/ /bzang po ngan par byed pa gdon mi za/ /dpon slob mched grogs gnyen rnams rtsod byed cing / /sdig sdug gtam ngan kun la mi 'dzem par ngal ba chen pos longs spyod sgrub byed pa/ /blo ngan 'di yis dbang med bskul bar zad/ /gzhan gyi dpal 'byor gzhom phyir lus sems kyis/ /'bad pa drag pos 'thab dang rtsod byas nas/ /rang gzhan 'di phyi gnyis gar phung byed pa/ /de yi snying du blo ngan gdon 'di zhugs/ /gsung rab sgron me lag tu thogs nas kyang / /rnyed bkur 'khor sde'i don du 'thab rtsod sogs/ /sdig pa'i g.yang sar gom pa 'dor ba'i mig /blo ngan rab rib 'di yis sgrib par zad/ /nor mang phyin yang grags dang 'khor 138

la sogs/ /don du gnyer phyir sbyin pa chen po las/ /'bras su chung zhing ngan par bsgyur byed pa/ /blo ngan ba mo 'di yis bcom par nges/ /'bad pas tshul khrims bsrungs kyang rnyed sogs kyi/ /'ching bas bcings nas thar lam mi bgrod cing / /'khor ba'i btson rar 'ching byed lcags sgogs te/ /blo ngan 'di yi lag na nges par gnas/ /yun ring bsam gtan bsgoms kyang chags sdang gis/ /bdag bstod gzhan smod byed cing 'thab rtsod byed/ /zhi gnas bsgom pas ma zhi'i blo skyes pa/ /blo ngan yur ma'i rtsa ba yod pas lan/ /nad gdon chom rkun dgra sogs dam chos kyi/ /bar chad yin zhes grags kyang rang gi blo/ /las su rung na de kun grogs su 'gyur/ /blo ngan 'di ni dam chos bgegs su nges/ /tshe 'di'i phun tshogs sgrub pas 'grub pa dka'/ /grub kyang rang dbang spyod pa'i nges pa med/ /bdag ma nges par 'ong ba 'chi ba yin/ /de tshe nor dang 'khor sogs kyis mi phan/ /de dang bral bas lhag par sdug bsngal 'gyur/ /de lta bsam nas tshe 'di'i che thabs spangs/ /zhes dang / chos pa'i gol sa yin pas tshe 'di'i che thabs spangs/ /rnyed bkur 'ching byed yin pas 'dod yon 'khri ba chod/ /snyan grags snying po med pas de la zhen pa spongs/ /gang 139

byung tsam gyis chog shes blo med na/ /longs spyod bsags pa sdug bsngal 'phel ba'i rgyu/ /bde dang dge ba ngang gis 'phel byed na/ /chog shes blo sna bsten pa man ngag yin/ /des na rnyed bkur grags sogs tshe 'di yi/ /phun tshogs sgrub pa'i bsam sbyor yong spangs nas/ /'chi tshe nges par phan pa'i dam chos la/ /g.yel ba med par rtag tu 'bad pa bya/ /gsungs/ 'gro ba'i mgon po'i zhal nas/ tshe 'di'i mkhas btsun sgom che yang / /tshe 'di'i mkhas lo btsun lo 'dod/ /mtshams bcad ya them yi ge bris/ /mi dang ma 'phrad sgom chen yang / /tshe 'di'i sgom chen bzang po 'dod/ /sbyin gtong byas kyang tshe 'di yi/ /byas lo btang lo kho na 'dod/ /dper na chu la phye btab 'dra/ /tha na dkon mchog mchod pa re/ /byas kyang mi yis mthong du re/ /rnam rtog mi dran dgu dran 'dis/ /ci byed rnams la 'dis slebs pas/ /dge sbyor ci byed lo lor shor/ /thams cad lo pa'i rta pas 'khyer/ /des na tshe 'di'i rnam rtog la/ /mdung re 'debs dgos skyes bu kun/ /'di la mdung re ma jeb na/ /mkhas btsun bzang bsgom thams cad kyis/ /ngan song gsum gyi sgo mi kheg /ngan song sdug bsngal ma zlog pa'i/ /mkhas pa btsun pa sgom chen gyi/ /dgos pa ci yod mdo don 140

shor/ /mi tshe tril gyis grwa sar sdad/ /rgas khar tshe 'di ma spong bas/ /gnas gzhi dgon pa'i zhen pa byas/ /sde 'khrugs la sogs sdig pa rnams/ /byas nas sde dgon shul du bzhag /rang nyid mnar med me nang du/ /'gro ba thams cad mi rtag pa/ /ma bsam pa yis lan pa yin/ /mdor na 'chi ba mi rtag pa/ /bdag gi rgyud la ma skyes na/ /gsang ba 'dus pa mi zab ste/ /'chi ba rgyud la skyes pa'i tshe/ /skyabs 'gro tshig gsum zab pa yin/ /mthon po'i chos la snyegs snyegs nas/ /g.yang du lhung ngo skal ldan kun/ /de tshe zab mo'i gdams ngag kyang / /phyi nang log pa nyid du 'gyur/ /zhes dang / mkhas grub rā ga a gye'i zhal nas/ tshe 'di'i bya ba blos btang nas/ /pha yul spang bas gnas ri ru/ /mi rtag 'chi ba'i sems dngangs te/ /lto gos gtam la gyong bskur nas/ /chu thung rdo mur ro gos gyon/ /zhes dang / dad 'dun yon bdag byung srid na/ /ri dwags rmas ma mi mthong bzhin/ /lung stong mi skad med par bros/ /bka' brgyud gong ma'i ri chos yin gsungs/ thog ma'i blo sbyong las/snying nas chos shig don du gnyer ba yod na/ dang po tshe 'di'i bya ba dkar nag khra gsum 'di blo gtong ba rang gal che/ de yang / mi thabs sdug shos rang yin na ma gtogs bya ba nag po 141

dro/ga gcod pa dang / brku ba la sogs pa rnams bya ba mi rigs pa yin pa go yang sla/ spong thub pa yang re mang tsam yong bar snang ste/ bya ba dkar po'am khra ba'i rigs dbang bskur chos bshad/ lha bzhengs dang / sbyin gtong / grong chog dang / tshwa tshwa/bsrung ba 'dri ba'am/ 'dre 'dul sngags 'debs sam/ nyin klog la sogs pa tshe 'di'i zhen pa rang ma spong ba'i cib tsub 'di rnams spong nus pa rang nyung bar snang / sems tshe 'di'i zhen pa dang ma bral ba'i bya ba ci lags kyang dgos pa rang med gsungs/ deng sang 'ga' res 'dre 'dul grong chog sogs byas/ lo 'ga' mthun rkyen sgrub nas de nas chos byed rgyu yin zer te/ 'dod yon nyes dmigs shes pa'i chos pa dga' mo zhig gis bsam na/ khos sngon du dug bsags nas phyis bdud rtsi dang bsres nas 'thung rgyu yin zhes smra ba dang mtshungs pas bzhad gad kyi gnas yin pas gzhan ma sems/ chos rnam dag cig byed na rang la ci yod blos gtong dgos na/ gzhan tshur len mi rung ba smos ci dgos/ bla ma zhang rin po ches/ la la na re nga yang sgom 'dod de/ nga sgom pa la rgyag dang mthun rkyen dgos/ lo 'ga' mthun rkyen gsog zer ba yod de/ de ni mig ce re bdud kyis 'khyer ba'i rmongs pa bya ba yin/ sgyags gtad 142

de la med/ yo byad yod pa kun gyis kyang spong dang bya bar gsung ba la kho'i snying la ci dran gsungs/ des na skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis tshe 'di dang / phyi ma gnyis me chu tsha grang ltar 'gal bas mnyam du mi 'ong gsungs pa ma go'am/ de yin yang chos kyi mthun rkyen yin pas 'gal ba med snyam na/ de mthun rkyen du 'gro'am 'gal rkyen du 'gro sus shes gcig gis drel bca' lag bzang gi bshad na/ rkun ma ham can tsho nub nam gung 'ong nas kha zum mgo cho rdo bcom byas 'khyer song nas za ma zos nas chos byed mi dgos/ kha ru chu yang ma 'gro bar sdug bsngal myang nas 'chi mi thub pa tsho 'byung / de 'dra sngar byung ba mang / des na 'dod yon shig tsam re rtsa na sdug bsngal ri tsam pa re yod pa mthong nas/ sangs rgyas thugs rje can gyis/ phyi rabs rjes 'jug yongs la rgyu nom gye gsog 'jog phar zhog tha na gser dngul la reg mi rung zhes bcas pa mdzad pa ma gtogs/ chos byed na gsog 'jog byas na skyon med rems gsungs pa zhig da snga phan chad la su'i kha nas go ma myong / rang legs par 'dod na sangs rgyas kyi gsung bzhin byas na bzang / 'o na de yin na deng sang sangs rgyas kyi rjes 'jug bla ma rnams kyis rgyu nom pa mang po gsog gi 'dug143

'di sangs rgyas kyis bcas pa dang 'gal ba ma yin nam zer na/ sangs rgyas kyis 'u tsho chags zhen che ba bstan 'gro'i don mi 'ong ba rnams la bcas pa mdzad pa ma gtogs/ sa thob kyi byang chub sems dpa' chags zhen gtan nas med pa bstan 'gro'i don rgya chen mdzad pa rnams la bcas pa mdzad pa min/dper na lha'i mdun du mchod rdzas bzhag pa ltar/ 'dod sred chags zhen spu tsam med na skyon gyis gtan nas mi gos/sngon sangs rgyas kyis 'gro la chos 'khor bskor dus thog mar bza' btung sogs zang zing gis tshims par mdzad/ de nas chos gsungs pa ltar/ bla ma rnams kyis kyang thabs mkhas bsdu bzhi'i sgo nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bzung ba yin/ 'gal ba med pa ma zad phan yon che/ de ltar ma yin par zhen chags yod/ bstan 'gro'i don ma byas na/ bla ma yin yang chu mgo nas rnyog pa yin pas bcas pa dang 'gal nges/ yang 'ga' res sngon nas chos shig byas na bsam ste/ pha ma yod pa bsgyur nas 'gro ma phod/ da bsam thog tu 'gro dka' gi/ tha na e 'chi snyam na 'chi rgyu yang med gi zer/ pha ma blos ma thongs par de la thogs nas 'dug pa de nam 'chi cha med ma dran/ 'gro kun pha mar ma shes/ chos byas na pha ma la tshe 'di phyir phan rgya 144

chen thogs pa ma shes pas lan pa yin te/ snyigs dus tshe la nges pa med pas/ rdza ma chag gam lung bu 'bud mi shes pa ltar/sngon du gang 'chi mi shes/ pha ma gnyis kyi sngon du rang shi song na rang la chos med/ pha mar bu med/ phyir 'ong nas skyong tshul med med gsum gis 'gro/ kho med na bza' tshang gi kha mi sos rgyab mi kheb sdug myong snyam pa rang 'khrul ba yin/ shi song na mya ngan chen po byas dge ba bzang po bcos/ da dung kha sos pas mi tshad/ lhag par je bzang du 'gro/ shi pos med mug tshang ma 'khur song ba zhig dang rig ka/ de 'dra ngas kyang mthong /khyed tshos kyang soms dang yod/ de bas ma shi gong du chos byed du song na/ pha mas shi ba lta bu'i mya ngan byed mi dgos/ dge rtsa gtong mi dgos/ chos rnam dag byas na/ rang la chos yod/ pha ma la bu yod/ phyir 'ong na 'phrad rgyu'i skal ba yod/ yod gsum yin/ sde gzhan gyis pha ma de gnyis kyi skyid la zer smon gnas su 'gyur/ pha ma la chags nas thag nyer bsdad/ chos mi byed par pha ma e 'chi blta ba de bas gnod sems shig kyang med/ sngon byon rgyal ba rnams dang / rgya bod kyi mkhas grub rnams kyi rnam thar dang yang 'gal te/ sngon sangs rgyas thugs rje can gyis kyang gzhon dus yab yum blon 'bangs bskyur nas 145

dben par phebs pa ma gtogs/ yab sogs gshegs rag bar du bzhugs nas/ de'i 'phro phebs pa med/ jo bo rje/ rje tsong kha pa/ lho brag mar ba/ rje btsun mi la rnams kyis kyang /pha ma gshegs rag bar du bsdad gshegs 'phro chos byas zhes rnam thar na mi snang / lho brag mar pa dang rje mi la gnyis kyis pha ma bskyur nas/ chos byed du song / phyis lan cig kyang ma thug par pha ma 'das song / des na pha ma gnyis yod/ rang na so gzhon thog la chos re byed ma nus na/ pha ma shi rang sgyu lus rgas nas lus kyi stobs zad sems kyi dpa' zhum dus chos byas na 'dod kyang chos mi 'ong bas a ho sngon gzhon dus chos shig byas na 'ong zer 'gyod/ gzhan gzhon nu tsho la ltos nas yid smon byed pa/ skal ba chad ni yin/ 'o na sangs rgyas dang sa thob byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis pha ma bskyur kyang tshe phyi mar phan thogs pa red/ nga de dang mi 'dra/ tshe 'dir drin gzo zhig byed dgos zer na/ chos byas nas tshe 'di phyir drin gzo zhig ma 'ongs na/ pha mas thag nye nas bsdad dkor nag dug gi chu 'khyer 'ong nas pha mas khar blud na phan las gnod che/ dper na khye rgan sngas kyi rus khog ltar pha ma bsrung na/ khye'i rus pa de gzhan gyis khyer gyis dogs 146

nas/ chags sdang drag po skyes/ skad drag po bton nas zug pa bzhin/ pha ma la gzhan gyis gnod kyis dogs/ khong khro langs tshig ngan smras brdeg brdung byas nas pha rol bor gnod/ rang gi sdom pa 'chor/ dkor nag dug gi chu 'dra ba phyogs phyogs nas 'khyer 'ong nas pha mar blud nas/ tshe 'dir pha ma gnyis dkor gyis sgrib nas/ chos byed pa phar zhog nyon mongs je rags su song / dkor khar bab na mi bshad dgu bshad zer ba ltar/ kha nas ngag 'khyal rkyang smra/ tha na ma ṇi brgya skor gcig kyang mi 'don/ tshe phyi mar chos med dkor gyi rnam smin 'khur nas dmyal bar 'gro bas phan btags pa e red/ pha ma'i thag nye bsdad nas phan mi thogs te/ pha ma na dus nad la bgo bsha' bya tshul med/ shi dus bskyal nas yar bde sa zhig tu skyel mi thub/ de thub na 'dug dgos zer yang drag tha na pha ma nad yun ring na/ nad g.yog kyang sun legs po zhig byed mi thub/ yun ring 'grogs na chags sdang las ngan pa bsags nas spyir 'khor ba dang / khyad par ngan song gsum du skyes nas sdug bsngal myong ba yin pas/ pha ma'i drin gzo de la zer ni e yin soms dang / des na khyed chos ngo shes pa rnams kyis skye bo mi nag pa tsho'i lan mo byas thabs sdug de ma bca'/ ma'i glo 147

nas da e 'chi shi na ro 'khur zer ba ltar bsdad nas tshe 'dir phan nam/ phyi ma phan gyi brang khar lag pa zhog sems rnal du phob la zhib tu cig soms dang / pha mar drin gzo bzang po gcig byed na/ sngon gyi rgyal ba sras bcas kyi rnam thar ltar/ tshe 'di'i pha mas gtso byas pha ma sems can thams cad sems kyi phugs su bzung / de kun gyi sdug bsngal bsal nas gtan bde'i go 'phang la 'god pa'i phyir/ rang nyid myur du thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob phyir thos bsam sgom gsum byas na bzang / pha ma 'chi rag bar la blta mi dgos/ ma shi gong du re zhig gi bar du rgyang bsrings na skyon dogs med/ pha ma yin yang rang gi chos kyi gegs byas na bdud yin pas/ gnang ba mi ster gi zhes dbang du gtong mi rung ste/bla ma zhang rin po ches/ pha ma dang mkhan slob la sogs pa'i/byams pa skad sha tsha skad zer zhing / sgom pa dang bya ba gtong du mi ster na/ de kun bdud yin pas ma nyan cig gsungs/ bye tshang ba rin chen dpal 'byor gyis/ sgrub pa'i bar chad du 'gro na sa khang sa gzhis/ gnyen nye ring bu bu mo/ grogs dgos mdza'/ nor longs spyod/ grwa rogs grogs mched/ de rnams thams cad bdud yin pas/ bdud bdud du ngo shes par byas 148

nas/ ngo bsrung gi thag pa bcad/ rang gi sna thag mi la ma shor gsungs/ 'ba' ra bas/ drin can pha ma yin kyang / /dge sbyor bar chad byed na/ /bdud kyi pho nya yin pas/ /zhen chags 'khri ba chod cig gsungs/ dper na tshe 'di'i ma gdon zhig gis spyos rnam shes ngos ma zin par/ bu yi lag mgo'i bzung nas nged ma bu gnyis g.yang sa chen po la 'phyong dgos/ gzhan du 'gro sa med ces 'jus na/ bu yis rang nyid 'phyong ba phar zhog ma 'di yang 'phyong rgyu red snyam lhag pa snying rjes ma gdon de dang bral thabs dang g.yang la mi lhung thabs byed pa ltar/ tshe 'di'i pha ma gnyis nyon mongs pa 'dod chags gdon lta bus smyos nas/ nged pha ma bu gsum mi dge ba byed la dmyal bar 'gro/ gzhan du 'gro sa med smra ba yin pas/ rang nyid kyis mi dge ba byas dmyal bar 'gro ba phar zhog pha ma gnyis kyang dmyal bar 'gro rgyu red snyam na/ lhag par pha mar snying rje bskyed/pha ma gnyis kyi rgyud kyi dug gsum sel ba dang / dmyal bar mi lhung ba'i thabs su dam pa'i lha chos rnam par dag pa byed dgos/ lha chos rnam dag byed na pha ma rgyu nom mkhar khang sogs blos btang nas phyogs gzhan gyi mtshan ldan bla ma bsten/ mdo sngags lha chos nyan/ ri khrod dben pa bsten rtse gcig nyams su 149

len dgos pas/ pha mar snying nas drin gzo byed na de 'dra byed dgos/ sngon gyi rgyal ba sras bcas rnams kyis kyang pha ma yal bar dor nas song ba ma yin/ lhag par snying je nas song ba yin/ bka' gdams bu chos na/ sngon rgya gar gyi rgyal bo zhig gi sras kyis yum la khyod tshe rabs gtan gyi ma bu 'dod dam/ tshe 'dir yud tsam gye ma bu 'dod dris pas/ yum gyis tshe rabs gtan gyi ma bu byas na 'dod smras pas/ sras kyis de yin na tshe 'dir 'bral dgos zhes/ yab yum rgyal srid spangs nas rgyang ring gi bla ma zhig gi drung du song nas chos byas gsungs/ des na spyir 'dus pa'i tha ma 'bral ba yin la/ snga phyi khyad chen po med/ nam yang mi 'bral bar sdod rgyu zhig yin na/ a ho rang gis 'bral gi bcug nas ma bzang zer mod/ de min 'bral dgos phyin chad/ shi bral byas pha ma bu gsum po chos med/ tshe 'di med/ phyi med/ med gsum byed pa las/ da lta chos phyir gson bral byas na/ pha ma bu gsum la 'di phyir bde skyid snyan gsum 'byung bas/ tshe 'dir mnyam du 'grogs pa las chos phyir myur du bral na dga'/ mi 'bral la bsdad nas ci bya/'bral dgos pas mi tshad phyis phyis 'dra/ nga da bar don med du bsdad pa ma bzang snyam/ pha ma 'bral ba la sa'i rtswa tsam yang mi 150

chags par/ gnang ba ma byen kyang smyon pa spyo langs pa bzhin sus kyang ma tshor bar 'bros dgos te/ bla ma zhang rin po che'i zhal nas kyang / yo byad dang pha ma la sogs par chags nas/ nga sgom mi khom/ lo gnyis gsum tsam la/ ma rgan skyong dgos/ bu smad skyong dgos/ yo byad 'di tsho chud ma zos par chos phyogs su song nges shig byed dgos zer zhing / bya ba gtong ma nus pas chos pa gsha' ma ma byung ba yin/ bu smad la sogs par khra dang spyang ki la sogs pas kyang skyong gin 'dug ste/ des mi 'ong /rang gis bya ba gsha' mar btang nas spyo ba 'dra ba zhig byas na chos gsha' ma zhig 'ong ba 'dra gsungs/ deng sang 'o skol tshos chos shig byas na gang gi sa nas lam sna zhig zin gi snyam pa'i chos pa dga' mo tsho yang pha ma la chags nas/ pha yul bdud kyi btson ra lta bur bsdad/ mthar khyi rgan 'chi 'chi byas song ba mang / pha ma drin can yin yang bu la grib ma ngan pa gnag pa yin/ des na sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob phyir lha chos rnam dag byed pa'i bgegs pha ma yin pas blos gtong ba 'di shin tu gal che/ zhes chos pa dga' mo tsho snying gtam smras pa yin pas thugs la shong ni gyis/ 'o na pha mas gnang ba ma byen par la yog nas bud song na/ chos mgo mthar e 'thon/ bla ma 'ga' 151

res de mi rung gsung ba de ci yin nam zer na/ spyir 'chi ba mi rtag de'i nang nas nam 'chi cha med shes/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal de'i nang nas ngan song sdug bsngal shes/ thar pa'i phan yon de'i nang nas kyang rnam mkhyen sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob na yon tan che tshul shes/ rang gi tshe sngon sems can thams cad kyi pha ma spun grogs byas tshul de'i nang nas ma byas drin che tshul bsam/ da sems can thams cad la drin gzo zhig byed na/sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob na phan thogs tshul shes/ sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang de da lta chos rnam dag bsgrubs na thob par go/chos rnam dag sgrub pa la/ tshe blos ma btang na mi 'ong bar shes nas/ rang nyid gcig pu phyi mar bde ba'i don du/ tshe blos btang nas chos byed 'dod pa ma yin par/ tshe 'di'i drin can pha mas thog drangs pa'i ma gyur nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad gtan bde sangs rgyas kyi ngo/ 'phang la 'god pa'i slad du/ thog mar rang nyid skyon kun zad/ yon tan kun ldan sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che ci nas kyang myur ba myur du thob par bya/ de yis phyir chos sgrub tu 'gro snyam nas pha mar gnang ba ma blangs pa'am/ blangs kyang ma gnang na gdong mchi ma khral le btang nas la yog nas bros bud song 152

yang / sangs rgyas yab la gnang ba zhus kyang ma gnang dmag mang pos nyin mtshan med par bsrungs kyang mi khegs par yab dang blon 'bangs kyi gdong mchi mas gang bzhin bskyur nas mtshan mo zhig la gzhan gyis ma tshor ba byas phebs song nas mthar sangs rgyas pa yin pas/ rten 'brel gye che ba yin pas lhag par gang zag des chos mgo mthar thon zhes bla ma dam pa gong ma mang pos gsungs/ bla ma 'ga' res pha mas gnang ba ma byen na chos mgo mthar mi phyin pas mi rung gsung ba de/gang zag dbang po brtul po chos legs po mi 'ong ba dang pha ma rgyu nom cung zad tsam yang med par bud song na/ pha ma mu ger 'chi nges pa dang / pha ma la nad drag pos zin pas bud song na bdag po med par 'chi ba dang kun slong bzang po med par/rang nyid gcig pu phyi mar bde thabs byed snyam nas/ pha mas gtso byas sems can thams cad snying nas yas bar dor nas 'gro ba rnams la dgongs nas de skad gsungs pa yin pas/ pha mas gnang ba ma byin pa thams cad kyis chos mgo mthar mi thon gsungs pa min/ de yin na sangs rgyas nas bzung / sngon byon rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa' phal cher gyis pha mar gnang ba blangs kyang ma byin tshe la yog nas sus ma shes pa byas/153

chos byed du phebs nas mchog thun gyi dngos grub thob pa shin tu mang bas/ de rnams kyis da dung chos mgo mthar ma thon na yod/ ces kha nas ma smras pa ma gtogs/ don gyis chos mgo mthar ma phyin zhes bskur ba btab par 'gyur bas de mi 'grigabasam pa rnam par dag pa'i sgos tshe blos btang nas chos rnam par dag pa byas na/ chos mgo mthar thon nas/ tshe 'dir yang pha mas gtso byas mthong thos dran reg la phan thogs par 'gyur/ phar ded na tshe blos btang ba 'di rang gzhan gnyis 'tshengs pa'i thabs kyi mchog gcig yin pas ngan par ma sems cig yang deng sang bla ma skyes chen dam pa 'ga' res/dka' las myang yang skyo ngal med par slob mar mdo sngags kyi dbang lung khrid gsum lo zla ba byas gnang nas/ da tshe blos thongs la ri khrod dben pa zhig tu song la gcig bur rtse gcig tu sgoms zhes gsungs na 'thad mi 'thad byas lags zer/'gro dus sems can thams cad kyi don du thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang thob 'dod blo phug tu bzung / de thob pa'i thabs bla mas gdams ngag gnang ba da dung mi shes par the tshom za ba'i dogs pa 'dra e yod mi blta/ song nas dben par bsgom na bgegs dang gol sa byung e 'jog snyam/ gegs sel bogs 154

'don gyi gdams pa/ chos mgo mthar 'thon pa'i skyabs 'jug mi zhu/ dang po nas ltogs grang e 'jog snyam/ za rgyu 'thung rgyu de yid la bcangs/ mi ltogs pa'i thabs mthun rkyen yo byad ci yod gi de bltas/ ri khrod la song na 'di dgos snyam/bla mas gdams pa gnang bas mi chog/ kho bo de mkho gi/ 'di 'dra e yod zhes bla ma'i phyag nas mkho tshad blangs/ da dung de'i steng du yon bdag de tshang la kho bo khyed kyi bcol dam/ yi ge zhal gsung re gnong zer nan zhus byas/ khal zang nga zing nga re bkal/ khur po che che re 'khur nas 'gro dgos pa de/ 'jig rten chos brgyad blos ma thongs/ chos rnam dag cig mi 'ong ba'i ltas ngan a wa po lhang nger bud pa yin pas/ sngon bla ma zhig gis yon bdag gcig la/ khyed bu rnams kyi ming la ci zer gsungs pas/ yon bdag gis bu che ba'i ming la mgo rul zer lags zhus pas/ bla ma cig 'dzum nas ya ya/ da des chog gzhan bshad mi dgos gsungs pa ltar/ slob ma de'i chos 'go nas rul ba yin pas/ de'i ming la slob ma mgo rul zer dgos/rje skal ldan rgya mtshos/ kha zhim pa'i zas la dga' ba dang /rgyab 'jam pa'i gos la dga' ba yis/ /chos bzang po zhar dang zhor la khrus/ /gsungs pa ltar/ nyin gcig la ja thug bzhi lnga 155

zhig bskol na nyi ma nam tsha shor 'gro bar der dge sbyor mang po 'chag de ring ci byung dge sbyor chag song zer dus mang po 'ong / rig 'dzin gang shar rang grol gyis/ dal 'byor mi lus ni thob kyang 'chi ba ni ma dran/ /dam chos zab mo 'dra zhus kyang snying rus ni ma byas/ /bza' dga' 'thung skyid la dga' ba'i nga 'dra yi tshogs rnams/ /'chi bdag bdud po kho byung dus ga 'dra rang mdzad dam/ /gsungs pa ltar mi tshe yun thung / nam 'chi nges pa med pas 'chi bdag bdud po kho 'ong dus mi 'gyod pa zhig byed dgos/ des na za dga' 'thung skyid la mi dga' bar bza' btung ngan ngon cung zad tsam re bsten nas 'chi brod dam pa'i chos sgrub pa shin tu gal che/ nyin gcig dka' ba spyad kyang sdig sgrib ri rab tsam 'dag log 'tsho dang dkor sgrib mi gsog lus la na zug mi 'byung / rig pa mkha' ltar dwangs/ nyams rtogs zla ltar rgyas/ bde skyid kyi nyi ma 'char/ snyan grags kyi ba dan g.yo nges/ rje mi las/ chos phyir dka' ba spyod pa la/ /bsod nams dpag tu med pa yod/ /de la 'jug cing bskul ba la/ /bka' drin dpag tu med pa yod/ /gsungs/ tshe blos btang gi chos 'di skal ldan las 'phro can re re ma gtogs/ kun gyi blor shong dka' ste/ spyan snga ba'i zhal 156

nas/ tshe blos btang gi chos 'di ni zab pa bas kyang ches zab pa zhig yin te/ zab mo zhes bya ba ni/ blos gting dpag dka' zhing / rtogs dka' ba dang / sdug bsngal sel ba dang / bde ba sgrub pa'i thabs gnad can gzhan na med pa yod pa la zab pa zhes zer la/ tshe blos btang gi chos 'di ni gting dpag dka' zhing rtogs dka' ste/ rgya gar du yin na dngos smra ba sems tsam pa man chad su'i mdun du yin yang / chos thams cad bden par med stong nyid yin byas na/ a pa 'di 'dra'i kha 'chal zer ba smyo ba yin nam snyam pa yong ba yin par snang / de bzhin du tshe 'di la zhen pa'i dge bshes dka' bcu 'dzin pa'am/ bla ma sgye bo brgya stong gis phyag byed pa'am/ rgyud sde bzhi la kha ton byed/dkyil 'khor brgya'i zhal phye ba'am/ mtshams dang 'dag sbyar gyes dus 'da' zhing lha dang rlung sgom pa'am/ phyag chen dang zhi byed rdzogs chen nyams su len pa kha pho 'brug ltar sgrogs pas kyang / chos 'di mi go mi rtogs par tshe 'di'i phun tshogs dang bde skyid thams cad po blos btang dgos byas na/ a pa 'di 'dra ba'i kha 'chal zer ba snyam nas blor mi shong / chos 'di la dngangs pa dang skrag pa dang spa skong ba skye/ gzhan tshe 'di'i phun tshogs blos btang ba mthong na'ang / de lkugs pa dang / pha ma 157

gnyen bshes la sogs pa su'i kha la yang ma nyan par sprang 'khyams la 'gro ba zer nas/ glen pa go ma chod du brtsi/ bya ba thos bsam sgom gsum sogs ci byed kyang tshe 'dir sdug po sogs mi yong ba dang / mi gral du tshud nas skyid po byed pa rnams su tshud pa dang / mi mthong cha 'jog yod pa/ dngos po phyug pa mi la rem dgos pa/ lag pa gdengs mi dgos sprang mi dgos/ ja dkar nag sha mar thud gsum chil le longs spyad rgyu yod pa/ khyed chos pa'am mkhas pa la sogs pa yin zer nas/mis bstod pa/ skyid pa zhig bya dgos snyam nas/ rang yang de ltar 'bad/ gzhan la yang de ltar slob/ de ltar shes na pho rgod pa dang shes che bar byed par snang na/ gzhan khyem pa la sogs pa'i blor chos zab mo 'di mi shong ba lta yang ci smos/ da lta stong pa nyid la sogs pa'i chos la thams cad dga' tshor byed/grogs gnyis gsum du tshogs na'ang de'i gleng mo kho na gleng /de'i nyams len la 'bad 'bungs 'don pa ni shin tu snang yang / tshe blos btang gi chos la dga' tshor byed mkhan rang dkon/ tshe 'di'i gnyen dang nye 'brel zhing khang dang nor rdzas sogs tshe 'di'i phun tshogs 'di blos thongs shing chos bshad na/bong bu'i mgo la dbyug pa rgyab pa ltar nag thom gyis 'gro/158

sna'i ru'i pa na ting nge nyan ye mi 'dod/ nyams su len ye mi 'dod pa yong gsungs/ 'o na gang dang gang dgos zer na/sngar dam pa rnams kyis gsungs pa ltar/ pha yul dang / nye du dang / 'khor g.yog dang / lung khrid sogs gzhan don ltar snang / yo byad gsog rum dang / bza' btung gi zhen pa dang /longs spyod 'bad med du 'byung ba dang / mthun 'jug ngo srung dang / tshe 'di'i bsod nams 'du long dang / 'jig rten chos brgyad rnams spong dgos/ gzhan rnams go sla la spong nus pa re gnyis snang / 'jig rten chos brgyad cung go yang dka' la spong nus pa su gcig kyang mi gda' bas/ chos brgyad gang la zer na/rnyed ma rnyed/ bde mi bde/ snyan mi snyan/ bstod dang smad pa 'di brgyad yin/ rang gi 'dod phyogs rnyed pa dang bde ba dang /snyan pa dang / bstod pa bzhi po sgrub pa'i phyir dang / rang gi mi 'dod pa'i phyogs/ ma rnyed pa dang / mi bde ba dang / mi snyan pa dang / smad pa bzhi po spong ba'i phyir/ chos 'chad dbang bskur/lha sgom sngags bzla/ mchod sbyin gtong ba sogs byas na chos brgyad dkar po zer/ yang chos brgyad kyis rang gi 'dod phyogs bzhi sgrub pa dang / mi 'dod pa'i phyogs bzhi po spong ba'i phyir/ srog gcod rku 'phrog rdzun sogs mi dge ba byas na chos 159

brgyad nag po zer/ chos brgyad spang blang gi phyir/ chos 'dri/ lha bzhengs/ mo sman rtsis gsum/ gtor mdos glud gsum/ khe tshong zhing las 'tsho skyong sogs dge sdig 'dres ma byas na/ chos brgyad khra bo zer/ rgyal dbang lnga ba rin po ches/ chos brgyad dkar nag khra gsum gdon chen po/ /snying la zhugs pa'i sdug bsngal bde ba ru/ /bzung nas gtan gyi mdun ma rlung la bsgur/ /gsungs/ 'brom ston pa rin po ches/ 'jig rten gyi bya ba thams cad thugs kyis spangs nas yod pa la/ rong du gser 'dun la spyan drangs pas/ dpal gyi dbang phyug bya ba la bod pa mdzad nas/ da lan 'di la khyod song dang / ngas 'jig rten blos gtong lo byas pas mi yong ba 'dug gsungs nas/ na bza' re ral rnying ba zhig gsol/ ras bem zhig gsol phrag pa gnyis phud/ phu thung gnyis phrag pa g.yas g.yon la bkal nas/res 'ga' shugs gseb nas bar gshegs/ res 'ga' sba mkhar gcig yod pa la oṃ tshugs mdzad nas/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyi bshes springs las/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa rnyed dang ma rnyed dang / /bde dang mi bde snyan dang mi snyan dang / /bstod smad zhes bgyi 'jig rten chos brgyad po/ /bdag gi yid yul min par mgo snyoms mdzod/ /ces dang / res 'ga'/ bdag ni 160

grol ba don gnyer la/ /rnyed dang bkur bstes 'ching mi dgos/ /zhes pa de tshang ba re/ res 'go 'bud tsam re/ res phyed tsam re gsung gin ldog ldog bzhugs/ khong la de dgos ched mi gda' ste/ rjes 'jug la slob pa yin gsungs/ sbyan snga bas kyang tshigs bcad de gsung gin chos brgyad mgo snyoms/dgyer sgom chen pos kyang / sngar dge bshes ston pas mdzad pa bzhin 'o cag kyang tshigs bcad de 'don gyin ma mtha' tshig tsam gyi sgo nas kyang gnyen po bsten la chos brgyad spangs gsungs/ rje rgod tshang pas/ 'jig rten blos btang bya ba de/chos brgyad gar blos btang ba cig la zer ba yin/ bzang 'dod byed pa'i blos btang des ci yang mi btub gsungs/ rig pa'i dbang phyug gis/ 'jig rten chos brgyad don du gnyer/ /bstod dang smad dang grags mi grags/ /rnyed dang ma rnyed bde dang sdug /de rnams la ni dga' mi dga'i/ /rnam par rtog pa yod ring la/ /chos pa yin snyam ma sems shig /sngar byas phyir byed da lta'i lam/ /chos brgyad kun slong yod dam med/ /rang gis rang la dri bar gyis gsungs/ 'bri gung chos rje'i zhal nas/ ka cis kyang mi phan 'chi ba la/ /'jig rten bya bzhag kyang mi bden rdzun por gda'/ /chos brgyad 'ja' tshon gyi ri mo la/ /ka blo gtad 'dug 161

gam mi 'dug ltos/ /gsungs/ dpung bzang gi rgyud las/ grags dang ma grags rnyed dang ma rnyed dang / /bde dang sdug bsngal de bzhin bstod smad dang / /sems kyis 'jig rten chos rnams rab bcom ste/ /sdig pa'i gnas su gyur pa spang bar bya/ /gsungs des na spong ba gal che/ sngon byon dam pa rnams kyis 'jig rten chos brgyad dkar nag khra gsum gyi phyir lus ngag gi brtson pa phar zhog yid la shar yang de ma thag mgo la rdog pa brgyab pa yin te/bla ma zhang gis/ 'jig rten chos brgyad mgo la rdog pa brgyab/ /gsungs/ gtsang pa rgya ras kyis/ chos brgyad 'gram pa thang la bsnyal/ /gsungs/de ltar tshe 'di'i bya ba thams cad blos btang nas/ mtshan ldan gyi bla ma dam pa bsten dgos te/ snying po nges par bsdus pa las/ rigs la gnas pa'i gang zag des/ /bshes gnyen dam pa bsten byas la/ /zhes dang / sdud pa las/ nad pa'i tshogs kyis gso phyir sman pa bsten par ltar/ /g.yel ba med par dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten pa bya/ /zhes dang / jo bo rjes/ grogs dag byang chub ma thob bar du bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen dam pa bsten/ /zhes dang / po to pa'i gsung sgos dol ba pas sgrigs pa las/ man ngag thams cad bsdus pa'i mgo ni/162

bshes gnyen dam pa mi btang yin gsung / bla ma ma bsten par 'khor ba las grol mi srid de/ po to pa'i zhal nas/ rnam grol sgrub pa la bla ma las gal che ba med de/ tshe 'di'i bya ba bltas nas byas chog pa la'ang slob dpon med par mi 'ong na/ ngan song nas 'ong ma thag pa 'gro ma myong ba'i sar 'gro ba la bla ma med par ga la 'ong gsungs/ lung gzhan las kyang / bla ma med na srid mthar yin/ /skya ba 'dzin nga med pa yi/ /gru yis pha rol phyin mi srid/ /gsungs/ 'o na bla ma ji ltar bsten dgos zer na/rab tu dad cing gus pas/ zang zing gi 'bul ba dang / lus ngag gi bsnyen bkur/ bka' bzhin sgrub pa gsum gyi sgo nas bsten dgos te/ chos bcu pa las/ gang gis 'dren pa nges 'byung la/ /dad pa theg pa'i mchog yin te/ /de phyir dad dang ldan pa'i mi/ /dad pas rjes su 'brang bas bsten zhes dang /dkon mchog sprin las/ ston pa la dga' ba dang dad pa ltar/mkhan bo la'ang dad pa dang dga' bar bya'o gsungs/ drag shul can gyis zhus pa las/ slob dpon de la des chos kyis gus par bya'o/ /gsungs/ rig 'dzin gang shar rang grol gyis/ ci mdzad legs par mthong ba'i mos gus kyis/ /bla ma gus pas bsten cig bya btang ba/ /zhes dang / /mdo sde rgyan las/ bkur 163

snyi rnyed pa dag dang rim gro dang / /sgrub pa'i sgo nas bshes gnyen bsten par bya/ /zhes dang / lnga bcu ba las/ rang gi dam tshig slob dpon ni/ /sbyin min bu dang chung ma dang / /rang srog gis rtag bsten bya na/ /longs spyod g.yo ba smos ci dgos/ /zhes dang / mi bzad de nyid 'dod pa yis//cung zad yid 'ong gang dang gang / /shin tu khyad par 'gyur ba nyid/ /de dang de ni bla mar 'bul/ /gsungs/ ye shes rgya mtsho'i rgyud las/bla ma sangs rgyas bla ma chos/ /bla ma dkon mchog bsam pa'i yul/ /bla ma mi spangs bla ma bkur/ /zhes dang / sdom pa rgya mtsho'i rgyud las/dpal ldan bla ma rdo rje 'chang / /'dir ni bla med byed pa'o/ /bla med 'bras bu 'dod pa yi/ /de bzhin bla ma bsnyen bkur bya/ /gsungs/ skyes rabs las/ phan pa'i lan du mchod par bya ba ni/ /bsgo ba'i tshig bzhin nyams su len pa yin/ /gsungs/mdor bsdu na bla ma thugs gang dgyes bya zhing / mi mnyes pa thams cad spangs dgos te/ bla ma lnga bcu pa las/ 'dir mang smos pa ci zhig dgos/ /bla ma dgyes byed gang yin bya//mi mnyes byed kun spang ba ni//de dang de la 'bad de brtag /dngos grub slob dpon rjes 'brang zhes/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid gsung bar/ /shes nas dngos po thams cad kyis/ /bla ma yongs su mnyes par 164

bya/ /zhes gsungs/ de ltar bsten na bsod nams dpag med thob ste thal 'gyur las/ ston pa de la yon tan ni/ /dpag bsam shing dang yid bzhin nor/ /'dod 'jo ba dang 'dra ba yin/ /yon tan dpag tu med pa thob/ /ces dang / ye shes rgya mtsho'i rgyud las/ gang gis bla ma'i bya ba la//mkhas pa skal ldan gang yin des/ /dus gsum bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas la/ /bskal pa bye ba 'bum phrag tu/ /phyag bya bas ni 'di don che//bla mas bsgo ba'i las rnams la/ /gang gi mthar phyin tshad bskyal na/ /'dis kyang gong ma'i bsod nams thob/ /bla ma'i rdza sa dang yo byad la/ /rang srog bzhin du sus byas pa/ /'dis ni rang gi longs spyod 'phel/ /lus dang ngag yid stobs kyis ni/ /ci nus pa yi bla ma yi/ /bya ba ma log sus byas pa/ /'dis ni mthu dang nus pa nyid/ /gang la'ang thogs pa med par 'byung / /rang gi rdzas dang yo byad kyis/ /bla ma mnyes par sus byas pa/ /'dis ni khams gsum 'khor ba las/ /sprul sku'i zhing du dbug dbyung ste/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i sar gshegs so/ /zhes dang / slob dpon klu sgrub kyis/ mchod pa thams cad yongs spangs nas/ /bla ma mchod pa yang dag brtsams/ /de mnyes pas ni kun mkhyen gyi/ /ye shes mchog ste thob par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / spyan snga 165

pas/ sangs rgyas thams cad mngon sum mchod pa bas/ /bla ma'i ba spu gcig mchod bsod nams che/ /des na mchod pa thams cad yongs spangs nas/ /bla ma'i bsnyen bkur gyis shig shākya'i sras/ /zhes pa la sogs pa mdo rgyud bstan bcos nas phan yon mtha' yas gsungs so/ /bla ma tshul bzhin bsten nas thos bsam bya dgos te/ mdo las/ bsten 'os bla mar rim gro bsnyen bkur te/ /shes rab sgrub phyir thos pa btsal bar bya/ /zhes dang / 'od srung gi le'u las/ thos las shes rab 'byung ba de rig nas/ /mgo la 'bar bzhin rtag tu thos pa tshol/ /zhes dang / sred med kyi bus zhus pa las/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po bsod nams chen po brtson 'grus brtsams pa rnams kyis thos pa'i tshogs la brtson par bya'o/ /zhes dang / dpal ldan dpa' bos/ thos nyung dmus long sgom pa'i tshul mi shes/ /de med de ko ci zhig bsam par bya/ /de bas thos la brtson bya de rgyu las/ /bsam zhing bsgom pas shes rab yangs pa 'byung / /zhes dang /rje btsun byams pas/ 'khor gsum rnam par rtog pa dag /de ni shes bya'i sgrib par 'dod/ /ser sna la sogs rnam rtog gang / /de ni nyon mongs sgrib par 'dod/ /shes rab las gzhan de dag ni/ /spong rgyu gzhan med de yi phyir/ /shes rab 166

mchog yin de dag ni/ /thos pa de phyir thos pa mchog /ces dang / bslab btus 'grel pa las/ thos pa dang mi ldan pas ni/bsam gtan gyi thabs dang / nyon mongs pa rnam par sbyong ba'i thabs kyang mi shes te/ de bas na skyo ba med par thos pa btsal bar bya/ zhes dang / jo bo rjes/ gnas lugs ma rtogs bar du thos pa dgos pas bla ma'i gdams ngag nyon/ /ces dang / rje rin po ches/ chos tshul bzhin bsgrub par 'dod pa rnams la lam gyi srog dam pa chos rab tu rnam 'byed kyi shes rab bskyed pa'i rgyu bla na med pa/ dri ma med pa'i gsung rab dang / bstan bcos la mang du thos pa dgos so gsungs/ mdo sde rgyan las/'di ni dang por thos la brten nas tshul bzhin yid la byed pa 'byung / /tshul bzhin yid la byed pa goms las yang dag don yul ye shes 'byung / /zhes dang / rim lnga'i 'grel pa don gsal las/ thog mar thos pa'i don la 'bad pa yis/ /rtag tu brtson par byed pa gang yin pa/ /de yi lag tu dngos grub nges par thob/ /ces dang / sred med kyi bus zhus pa las/ 'di ltar rigs kyi bu/ thos pa dang ldan na shes rab 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /shes rab dang ldan na nyon mongs rab tu zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /nyon mongs pa med pa la bdud kyis glags mi rnyed do/ /167

zhes dang / thos pa'i tshoms las/ thos pas chos rnams shes par 'gyur/ /thos pas sdig las ldog par byed/ /thos pas don ma yin pa spong / /thos pas mya ngan 'das pa thob/ /ces dang /ji ltar khyim ni legs g.yogs pa/ /mun pas khebs pa'i nang zhugs na/ /gzugs rnams yod par gyur kyang ni/ /mig ldan bzhin du mi mthong ba/ /de bzhin 'di na rig skyes pa'i/ /mi ni blo gros ldan gyur kyang / /sdig pa dang ni dge ba'i chos ma thos bar du shes mi 'gyur/ /mig ldan mar me yod pa yis/ /gzugs rnams mthong ba ji lta bar/ /de bzhin dge dang sdig pa'i chos//thos pas rnam par shes par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / skyes rabs las/ gang zhig thos pas yid ni dad gyur nas/ /legs par dga' ba brtan pa nyid du 'gyur/ /shes rab skye zhing gti mug med par gyur/ /rang gis shes kyang de ni nyo bar rigs/ /thos pa gti mug mun sel sgron me yin/ /rkun po la sogs mi 'khyer nor gyi mchog /kun tu rmongs pa'i dgra 'joms mtshon cha yin/ /thabs tshul man ngag ston pa'i grogs kyi mchog /phongs par gyur kyang mi 'gyur mdza' bo yin/ /gnod pa med pa mya ngan nad kyi sman/ /nyes pa chen po'i dpung 'joms dpung gi mchog /grags dang dpal gyi gter gyi mchog kyang yin/ /ya 168

rabs rnams dang 'phrad na skyes kyi mchog /tshogs kyi nang na mkhas pa mgu bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs/ kye rdor gyi bka' 'grel mu tig phreng ba las/ blo gros med la thos med ma thos pa la'ang bsam pa med/ /gnyis bral rnal 'byor med cing rnal 'byor med la dngos grub med/ /ces dang / so sor thar pa las/shā ri'i bu byang chub tu sems bskyed nas/ thos pa mang po la mi brtson pa gang yin pa de ni/ bdud sdig can gye byen gyis brlabs pa nyid yin no/ /zhes gsungs pas/ des na thos bsam gal che/ 'o na thos bsam ji ltar byed zer na/ bla mas mdo sngags kyi gdams pa gang ston yang / gdul bya'i tshad la bltas mang nyung ran par bstan/ slob mas nad pas sman pa'i tshig la nyan pa ltar yid gtad cing rna bas legs par nyan/nyan pa tsam du ma zad/ rab tshig ma nor bar blor bzung / de ma byung yang des dpe la ngo 'dris btang nas tshig ma nor bar 'dzin pa la thos pa zer/ de don brtag dpyad nas yid gnyis the tshom yod pa rnams bla ma la slar 'dri/ ma rtogs pa dang log par rtog pa'i dri ma gang yang med par shin tu nges par byed pa la bsam pa zer te/ spyan snga bas/ thos dang bsam pa sgom pa gsum/ /rim pa bzhin du bya ba'i phyir/ /dmigs skor dang po'i 169

'khrid dpe 'di/ /khyod kyis legs par bzung bar bya/ /'di ni legs par nam zin tshe/ /de nas chos re la byon zhes/ /de la legs par bsgo bya gsungs/ /sngon chad blo yul ma byung ba'i/ /chos gang thos nas blor bzung ba/ /de la thos pa zhes byar bshad/ /ces dang / thos shing bzung ba'i tshig don la/ /mkhas pa rnams ni gsung ngo zhes/ /mos blo tsam la mi 'jog par/ /'di la sgrub byed ci yod cing / /'di la gnod byed ci yod ces/ /ji srid nges shes ma skyes par/ /de ni rtog cing dpyod pa la/ /mkhas pas bsam pa zhes par bshad/ /gsungs/ de ltar thos bsam gyis phu thag bcad nas/ de don tshul bzhin bsgom dgos te/ mdzod las/ tshul gnas thos dang bsam ldan pa'i/ /sgom pa la ni rab tu sbyor/ /zhes dang / rje rin po ches/ nad pas sman pas sbyar ba'i sman ma 'thung na/ nad zhi bar mi nus par mthong nas 'thung ba ltar/ chos smra ba'i bstan pa'i gdams pa nyams su ma blangs na chags sogs gzhom mi nus par mthong nas nan tan gyis nyams su len par byed gsungs/sgyes rabs las/ thos pa'i rjes 'jug sgrub pa snying por byed/ /sgye ba'i rdzong las tshegs chung thar par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / jo bo rjes/ man ngag yod pas sgom pa min nam ci byed bla ma'i 170

gsungs bzhin sgrubs/ /gus pa chen pos bsgrubs ni ring bor mi thogs 'bras bu 'phral du 'byung / /zhes gsungs/ klong chen rab 'byams pas/ e ma dad ldan thar pa 'dod pa dag /gsang chen bla med don la rab zhugs nas/ /gcig bur dben par sgrub pa snying por mdzod/ /tshe 'di'i chos sku'i gtan srid zin pa lags/ /zhes gsungs/ nad pas sman blangs nas ma 'thung na/ nad las mi thar pa 'dra bas na don chen po mi 'byung ste/ ting 'dzin rgyal bo las/ sman mang bzang zhing phangs pa de blangs nas/ /na ba 'tsho bar 'gyur ba'i sman mi 'thung / /sman pas ma lan sman gyis ma nyes te/ /nad pa de nyid kyis ni nyes pa yin/ /de bzhin bstan pa 'di la rab byung nas/ /stobs dang bsam gtan dbang po kun rig nas/ /bsgom pa la ni mngon par brtson mi byed/ /rig par mi brtson ga la mya ngan 'da'/ /zhes dang / ngas ni rab tu zab pa'i chos bshad kyang / /khyod kyis thos nas yang dag ma spyad na/ /nad pa sman gyi rkyal ba thogs pa dag /bdag gi nad 'di gso bar mi nus bzhin/ /zhes dang / spyod 'jug las/ lus kyis 'di dag spyad par bya/ /tshig tsam brjod pas ci zhig 'grub/ /sman dpyad bklag pa tsam gyis ni/ /nad pa dag la phan 'gyur ram/ /zhes 171

dang / thos pa'i tshoms las/ legs gsung thos pa snying por shes pa dang / /ting nge 'dzin dag snying por shes gyur kyang / /gang zhig bag med brlang bor byed pa des/ /thos dang shes pa don chen mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang / phal chen las/ la la stobs med chu klung gis/ /nan gyis 'khyer bar gyur pa dag /skom zhing shi bar gyur pa bzhin/ /chos la ma bsgom de bzhin no/ /zhes dang / sdong po bkod pa'i mdo las/ ji ltar dmus long ri mo mkhan/ /tshong 'dus dbus su 'drir bcug kyang / /rang gis de nyid mthong ba med/ /ma bsgom chos kyang de bzhin no/ /ji ltar 'on pas rol mo'i sgra/ /sil snyan glu la mkhas pa zhig /gzhan dag de yis dga' byed ltar/ /ma sgom chos kyang de bzhin no/ /ji ltar 'gro ba mang po la/ /zas dang skom dag byin nas kyang / /rang nyid bkres te 'chi ba ltar/ /ma sgom chos kyang de bzhin no/ /zhes dang / lhag bsam bskul ba las/ bu ram shing shun snying po ci yang med/ /dga' bar bya ba'i ro ni nang na 'dug /shun pa zos pa'i mis ni bu ram ro/ /zhim po rnyed par 'gyur ba ma yin no/ /ji ltar shun pa de bzhin smra ba ste/ /ro lta bu ni de la don sems yin/ /de lta bas na smra la dga' spangs te/ /rtag tu bag yod byos la don soms shig /ces dang / rje skal ldan rgya 172

mtshos/ bsgom na nyams rtogs 'char gyi/ /ma sgom kha bshad rkyang gis/ /phyi mar phan pa dka' bas/ /mdzub mo nang du khug cig /gsungs/de ltar thos bsam byas rjes tshul bzhin bsgom par 'dod pa'i skal ldan dbang po yang rab rnams kyis 'du 'dzi spangs nas ri khrod dben pa bsten dgos zhes/ rgyal ba sras bcas rnams kyis yang yang gsungs te/ bslab btus las/ bzod bya thos pa btsal bar bya/ /de nas nags su gnas par bya/ /mnyam pa ra bzhag la brtson bya zhing / /zhes dang / so sor thar pa'i mdo las/ mang du thos pa nags kyi nang dag tu/ /lang tsho yol ba rnams kyi gnas pa bde/ /zhes dang / ting 'dzin rgyal bo las/grong dang grong khyer dag la dga' spong la/ /rtag tu dben zhing nags khrod bsten par gyis/ /bse ru lta bur rtag tu gnyis med byos/ /ring bor mi thogs ting 'dzin mchog thob 'gyur/ /zhes dang / phar phyin brgya ba las/ rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo dben pa'i lam la gnas par bya/ 'du 'dzi med pa la dga' bar bya/ zhes dang / lhag bsam bskul ba'i mdo las/ dam pa'i chos rnam par 'jig pa'i tshe/ ma snad cing ma rmas par bde bar yongs su thar 'dod pa dang / las kyi sgrib pa thams cad 173

byang bar 'dod pas/ 'du 'dzi med pa la dga' ba dang /dgon pa dang / nags mtha' dang bas mtha' gnas pa la brtson par bya/ zhes dang / rje rin po ches/ tsha kho dbon po ngag dbang grags pa la gdams pa/ de ltar lam gyi gtso bo rnam gsum gyi/ /gnad rnams ji bzhin rang gis rtogs pa'i tshe/ /dben pa bsten nas brtson 'grus stobs bskyed de/ /gtan gyi mdun ma myur du sgrubs shig bu/ /zhes dang / 'khor ba la skyo ba'i gtam las/ sna tshogs 'dam skyes dpag med gcal du bkram/ /rkang drug ldan rnams dga' ba'i glu len cing / /snyan pa'i dir dir sgrog par byed pa yi/ /dben gnas dam pa bsten dang rgyal khams pa/ /ces dang / snyan ngag lam las drangs pa'i blo sbyong las/ dge sems ngang nas gsung rab tshig don de/ /thog mar thos dang bsam pas sgo 'dogs chod/ /phyi nas thos bsam sgo 'dogs chod bzhin du/ /dben par song ste bsgom na don yod de/ /zhes dang / dran pa nyer bzhag las/ gos hrul phyag dar khrod kyi mal/ /lhung bzed gong khog cig dang ni/ /'bras bu rtsa bas chog shes pa/ /de ni bde bar sangs rgyas bzhed/ /bag med pa yi bzung dka' ba'i/ /dur khrod dang ni gnas rnams bsten/ /rtag tu sa yi mal stan can/ /shin tu mya 174

ngan 'das ring min/ /gsungs/ slob dpon dpa' bos/ rgyal po'i chos spangs nor rnams mchog tu don gnyer bu rnams pha mar sdang / /sa la 'bras bu mi skye rgyal bo 'khrug byed rgyal byed mtshon gyis rnam par gnon/ /'jig rten bud med la dad bud med rnams kyang g.yem zhing bram ze rnams ni 'dod chen bcas/ /kye hud sdug bsngal rtsod pa'i dus ni nyer gnas bsod nams gnyer ba nags su song / /gsungs/ sa mtsho sbyin gyis/rab zhi'i bde ro shes pas 'khor los bsgyur ba'i dpal 'byor yang / /yongs su spyad pa'i rnying ba'i me tog phreng bzhin rnam spangs nas/ /lang tsho rang bzhin gyis g.yo ngang tshul can dag yol byas te/ /dgon par ri dwags 'drar mchi zhi ba'i sems ni bsten par bya/ /zhes dang / ci ste gang zhig nang gi dgra las des rgyal bya ba byas pa yi/ /bde gshegs 'jig rten mtha' gzigs de yang nags dag bsten mdzad na/ /yang dag rtogs med skye bo mi gtsang 'dam du bying gyur pa'i/ /sdom can zhi 'dod bde gshegs rjes su ci phyir 'jug mi byed/ /gsungs/blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsung las/ byed rgyu ma mang byed na lha chos gyis/ /smra ba ma mang smra na chos gtam smos/ /bsam rgyu ma mang bsam na las 'bras soms/ /'gro 'dug ma mang 'gro na 175

dben par song / /gsungs/ spyan snga bas/ dben pa ma bsten sangs rgyas lta ci smos/ /'jig rten 'di la bde bar yongs ma mthong / /de bas dben pa bsten cig shākya'i sras/ /gsungs/kha rag sgom chung ba'i tho yig las/ tshe la long med tha snyad thug pa med/ /de bas dam pa'i dgongs pa long mdzod la/ /'du 'dzi spangs pa'i dben gnas zhi ba bsten/ /bse ru lta bur gcig pur gnas par bya/ /zhes dang / bdag gis rtsig pa'i khang ba ru/ /gtan du sdod dbang mi 'dug gi /dgos med mkhar las mi byed par/ /ri khrod dgon pa 'grims shig ang / /gsungs/gsang ba'i bdag po'i zhal nas/ las kyi rdo rje lus 'di nam yang 'jig pas na/ tshe tshad kyang sngon nas bskos tshad re yod/rgan gzhon la nges pa rmad/ thams cad 'chi ba las ma 'das pa/ gzugs legs kyang de la chags pas ma shi bar 'dug pa ngas ma mthong / lus kyi gces 'dzin thams cad blos thongs la ri khrod 'grims gsungs/ te lo pas/ gcig pur nags kyi gseb dang ri sul du/ /bsgom du med pa'i ngang la gnas par gyis/ /zhes dang / a ti zab don las/ 'di ltar nyams su len pa'i gang zag ni/ /'jig rten 'du 'dzi'i gnas su mi 'dug ste/ /ri dwags bzhin du dben pa'i gnas su 'dug /ces dang /176

slob springs las/ skad cig la 'jig zad cing rtag tu 'khrug pa'i yul rnams spongs/ /zhi ba'i bde 'bras 'chi ba'i 'tsher med gcig tu dben pa bsten/ /zhes dang / slob dpon zhi ba lhas/ bde zhing nyon mongs yong med kyi/ /gcig pu dben par gnas par bya/ /byes las thag ring byol bar bya/ /zhes gsungs/o rgyan rin po ches/ myang ban ting 'dzin bzang po la/ ri khrod bsten la dam bca' yun bsrings gsungs/ yang lho nub srin yul du bzhud dus rjes 'bangs yongs la/ dben gnas ri thang mtshams su mi byed par/ /nga yis sgrub pa'i sgrub gnas kun tu gyis/ /zhes dang / sus kyang mi bstongs gcig pur 'chi ba soms/ /bshom ra blo sna ma mang ri la brten/ /zhes gsungs/ jo bo rjes/ sems la gnod pa'i yul dang thag bsrings rtag tu dge ba 'phel sar sdod/ /brtan pa ma thob bar du 'du 'dzi'i gnod pas dben pa'i nags khrod bsten/ /zhes dang / yang las dang po yi gang zag gis/ /lus dben pa la ma bsten par/ /sems dben rnyed par dka' ba'i phyir/ /'dre spangs nags su gnas par bya/ /gsungs/ rgyal dbang lnga pas/ de tshul blo dang brtson pas sgrub pa la/ /yar gyi dpon dang dma' ba'i 'khor g.yog 'bangs/ /dgra 'dul gnyen skyong re dogs kun 177

spangs nas/ /lto gos gyong bskur dben pa rtse gcig bsten/ /gsungs/ rig 'dzin gang shar rang grol gyis/ don med bya bas mi tshe stong bar zad/ /dben pa'i ri khrod 'grims shig rang grol ba/ /gsungs/ bla ma zhang gis/ snying nas bka' bzhin sgrub 'dod na/ /che zhog chung zhog dgon par rgyug /bzang zhog ngan zhog ri khrod 'grims/ /skyid zhog sdug zhog brag phug snyogs/ /gsungs/ /rje skal ldan rgya mtshos/ ri khrod dgon pa bsten na/ /dge sbyor ngang gis 'phel bas/ /bsam blo drag tu thongs la/ /da lta sgom la song zhig /ces dang / kun mkhyen klong chen pas/rnal 'byor nged kyis ri khrod 'grims/ /skal ldan kun kyang ri la gshegs/ /rtag tu ri khrod dben pa bsten/ /gtan gyi don chen sgrub par 'tshal gsungs/ rgyal sras thogs med kyis/ yul ngan spangs pas nyon mongs rim gyis 'grib/ /rnam g.yeng med pa'i dge sbyor ngang gis 'phel/ /rig pa dwangs pas chos la nges shes skye/ /dben pa bsten pa rgyal sras lag len yin/ /'ba' ra bas/mnga' thang rgyas kyin sdug bsngal che/ /gong ma'i sems 'dzin 'og ma skyong / /mnyam pa'i gnya' sdongs nor gyi gter/ /sdug bsngal skyel bsu sangs dus med/ /phun sum tshogs kyang bde skyid dka'/ /sems skyo ba bskyed la ri khrod 'grims/ /zhes dang /178

dus ngan sems can tshor ngan che/ /khyim 'tshes mtho gnon ci gnod bskyel/ /'dzur med hor khral che la yang / /sne mkhan go mtshams stang dus med/ /dus ngan pha yul bzung bar dka'/ /sems skyo ba bskyed la ri khrod 'grims/ /gsungs/ des na bla ma'i bka' bzhin tshe 'dir ma sems can thams cad kyi don du thob bya bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang 'thob par bya/de'i phyir ri khrod dben pa bsten la rtse gcig tu sgom par bya'o snyam nas ri khrod cig tu gom pa bdun tsam spos kyang bsod nams dpag med thob ste/ ting 'dzin rgyal bo las/ rab tu byung nas chos spyod ci 'dra ba/ /zas dang skom dang de bzhin gos rnams dang / /me tog spos dang 'phreng ba rnams kyis ni/ /thub mchog rgyal la bsnyen bkur byas mi 'gyur/ /gang zhig byang chub rab tu 'dod byed cing / /'dus byas ngan la yid 'byung sems can gyi/ /don du dgon par phyogs te gom bdun bor/ /'di ni de bas bsod nams khyad par 'phags/ zhes dang / 'jam dpal zhing bkod kyi mdo las/byang sems khyim pa'i gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi sangs rgyas dge slong dge 'dun gang bcas pa/ bskal ba gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed du dge ba'i yo byad thams cad kyis mchod pa bas/ byang 179

sems rab byung gis dben pa 'dod de dgon par gom pa bdun bor na bsod nams ches che bar gsungs/ zhes dang /zla ba sgron ma'i mdo las/ bskal pa gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed du tshul khrims bsrung ba bas/ bla na med pa'i byang chub sgrub pa'i don du dgon pa'i phyogs su gom pa bdun bor ba bsod nams che gsungs/ mdo gzhan las kyang / dgon pa bsam nas gom pa bdun bor ba/ /de ni sa bdun bar du 'phags par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs/ dben par bsdad nas nyams len byas na mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad 'thob par 'gyur te/ dkon mchog brtsegs pa las/ sngon gyi sangs rgyas 'jig rten mgon/ /gang du mya ngan 'da' gyur ba/ /kun gyi dgon pa rab dben du/ /bla med byang chub thob par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / zla ba sgron ma'i mdo las/ rgyal srid mchil ma'i thal ba bzhin spangs nas/ /dben pa 'dod de dgon par gnas byed pa/ /nyon mongs spangs nas bdud ni bcom nas su/ /byang chub rdul med 'dus ma byas 'tshang rgya/ /grub chen rga los/ ma 'dug dgon par song / /thar pa dgon na 'dug /zla ba sgron ma bton/ /'di gzhan ngas ma shes/ /zhes dang / kun mkhyen klong chen rab 'byams pas/ sngon gyi rgyal ba'i yon tan dang / /grub 180

thob gong ma'i yon tan yang / /dben pa bsten nas byung bar gsungs/ /zhes dang / rje mi las/ bu gcig gson dang ras chung pa/ /khyod yul la chags sems spangs nas ni/ /ri khrod dgon pa 'grims nus na/ /rtsol med dngos grub shugs las 'byung / /gsungs/ skyabs mgon rgyal dbang lnga pa rin po che'i zhal nas/ chos brgyad 'khrul ba'i snang ba bkrag po che/ /sgyu ma'i nyer sprul rta glang ltar rigs nas/ /bas mthar gcig tu byang chub sgrub gzhol na/ /dus gsum rgyal ba dgyes bskyed mchod pa'i gtso gsung / slob dpon sa mtsho sbyin gyis/ nags tshig pa yi bya dang 'dra bar sdug bsngal brgya yi gzhir gyur pa'i/ /khyem gang yin pa yongs su spangs nas gnas su 'gro byed pa/ /de ni srid pa'i gting rab gsal ba kun gyi mgon/ /sangs rgyas rab tu mnyes par byed pa yin zhes de skad grags/ /zhes dang / bye tshang pa rin chen dpal 'byor gyis/ grub thob gong ma rnams kyang tshe 'di'i re bltos bcad/ ri'i bu byas/ na bun gos su gyon/brag phug zhwa ltar gyon/skyid sdug gi rtsis gdab thams cad lings kyis bskyur nas phyogs med ri khrod du thugs dam mdzad pas grub pa brnyes pa yin gsungs/ rje rgod tshang pas/ bla ma la mos gus thob/ gdams pa la nges shes skyes/ phyag rgya chen po la 181

rdo rus thug nas/ tshe 'di blos thongs pa zhig gis ri khrod 'grims na khrid thams cad kyi dgongs pa rgyud la 'char gsungs/ des na g.yu dang gser gyi mdangs 'dzin spang ri mthon po'i steng phyogs bai ḍūr+ya yi mdangs 'dzin/ 'chi med lha lam yangs pa na dri med dung mdog sprin dkar yar gyen du 'phyur nas gdugs ltar mdzes shing / ngo mtshar lha yi spyan gzigs ltar gzi brjid 'od zer 'phro ba'i nyi zla skar gsum shar ba/ ri rtse phrag gong na lha'i dbu rgyan snyan rgyan ltar rab dkar gangs yar spungs pa dang / mar bshams pa/ dngul gye mdog 'dra smug pas rked bcings do shal ltar gnas pa/ lo ma me tog 'bras bus yongs mdzes ljon shing sna tshogs mu men mu tig gi dra ba dra phyed ltar bres pa/ lha'i yan lag brgyad ldan gyi chu dang mtshungs pa'i rdza chu bsil ba'i gtsang gtsang 'thung 'thung zer ba bzhin si li li/ lhung lhung lhung sgra snyan mo sgogs bzhin 'bab pa/ 'chi med lha yi mdun sa dang mtshungs pa'i spang gshong bde 'jam yangs pa na mgo rgyan 'dzin pa'i lha'i bu mo las mdog mjes me tog sna tshogs kyi rtse dga' rgod cing /dar gos gyon pa'i lha'i bu las gzugs mjes skad snyan pa'i bu mang pos rgyang glu ring po 'then pa g.yas g.yon du 'khor 182

nas dga' ba'i gar byed pa/ lha'i dpag bsam lngon shing dang mtshungs pa'i sngo ljang ljon shing rtse na bya khu byug 'jol mong la sogs bya bye'i sna tshogs kyis skad snyan pa sgrogs bzhin dga' zhing 'phyo la lding ba/ lha'i 'dod 'jo'i ba mo nyal ldang 'gro ba bzhin/ mdun gyi g.yas g.yon na ri dwags du ma bag phebs rgyu zhing phan tshun brtse ba la sogs pa/ mig mdzes rnar snyan yid 'bab kyi ngo mtshar mtha' yas pa/ bde ldan lha'i yul las lhag pa'i ri khrod dben pa'i bsil grib tu gcig pur drang srong spyod tshul gyis gnas pa'i mi de las skyid pa zhig 'jig rten gyi khams 'di na yod pa ma yin te/ rje skal ldan rgya mtsho'i zhal nas/ khyed dben pa'i ri la yid spro na/ /ri na bun can gyi skyibs shed na/ /g.ya' rdza brag gi phug pa rang byung yod/ /gnas de 'dra bsten na 'phral phugs skyid/ /khyed dben pa'i nags la yid spro na/ /nags sngo ljang rgyas pa'i khrod cig na/ /shing ljon pa'i lo ma'i bsil khang yod/ /gnas de 'dra bsten na dga' spro 'phel/ /khyod dben pa'i gangs la yid spro na/ /gangs dkar po ri yi mgul zhig na/ /rang gcig pur sdod sa'i sgrub phug yod/ /gnas de 'dra bsten na dge sbyor 'phel/ /khyed dben pa'i spang la yid spro na/ /spang me tog bkra ba'i ljongs 183

shig na/ /rtsa ljang sngon spyil chung nyams dga' yod/ /gnas de 'dra bsten na ngang gis bde/ /khyed dben pa'i brag la yid spro na/ /brag rgod tshang can gyi ngos shig na/ /skyibs rab mdzes phug pa rang grub yod/ /gnas de 'dra bsten na rig pa dwangs/ /khyed dben pa'i rdza la yid spro na/ /rdza phra mo spungs pa'i khrod cig na/ /'phral rnam g.yeng med pa'i phug pa yod/ /gnas de 'dra bsten na ci bsam 'grub/ /khyod dben pa'i g.ya' la yid spro na/ /g.ya' sgo leb brtsegs 'dra'i 'og shed na/ /sprang sgom chung sdod sa'i rdo khang yod/ /gnas de 'dra bsten na ngang gis dal/ /khyed dben pa'i grogs la yid spro na/ /grogs bya dang ri dwags bltas pa'i tshe/ /'phral rnar snyan yid dga' ltad mo yod/ /grogs de 'dra bsten na nyams re dga'/ /khyed dben pa'i mtsho la yid spro na/ /mtsho rba rlabs can gyi ngogs shed na/ /chu lhung ci nga skad snyan 'byen pa yod/ /gnas de 'dra bsten na rgyun mar spro/ /khyed dben pa'i zas la yid spro na/ /zas rang grub shing tog zwa tshod la/ /bcud myang na zhim pa'i bro ba yod/ /zas de 'dra bsten na ngo mtshar che/ /khyed dben pa'i glu la yid spro na/ /glu rang gi rgyud la phan pa la/ /dus gtan du dgos pa'i bag chags yod/ /glu de 'dra blangs na ngo 184

mtshar che/ /gsungs/ klong chen rab 'byams pas/ dben zhing nyams dga' rig pa 'dzin/ /sman ljongs nags dang gangs ris mdzes/ /ri ngogs dben par sgom du gshegs/ /bde skyid ri khrod gnas na yod/ /phug dang brag ri'i khang bzang na/ /sman shing me tog 'bras bus brgyan/ /ri ngogs dben par sgom du gshegs/ /bde skyid ri khrod gnas na yod/ /rtswa dang lo ma'i khang bzang dang / /chu gtsang yan lag brgyad ldan 'bab/ /ri ngogs dben par sgom du gshegs/ /bde skyid ri khrod gnas na yod/ /yid 'ong bung bas snyan sgog cing / /bya dang ri dwags mang pos gang / /ri ngogs dben par sgom du gshegs/ /bde skyid ri khrod gnas na yod/ /ngang gis chos 'phel rig pa dwangs/ /dus bzhi 'gyur bas blo sna thung / /ri ngogs dben par sgom du gshegs/ /bde skyid ri khrod gnas na yod/ /dgra gnyen gang dang ma 'brel ba'i/ /chags sdang zag pa ngang gis med/ /ri ngogs dben par sgom du gshegs/ /bde skyid ri khrod gnas na yod/ /che chung gang dang ma 'brel bas/ /ngo srung sems 'dzin sdug bsngal med/ /ri ngogs dben par sgom du gshegs/ /bde skyid ri khrod gnas na yod/ /skye bo gzhan dang ma 'brel bas/ /zog dang tshul chos ngang gis med/ /ri ngogs 185

dben par sgom du gshegs/ /bde skyid ri khrod gnas na yod/ /gcig pur rang dbang chos la thob/ /sus kyang tshe 'dir 'ching mkhan med/ /ri ngogs dben par sgom du gshegs/ /bde skyid ri khrod gnas na yod/ /'jig rten rnam g.yeng 'du 'dzi med/ /chags sdang nyon mongs ngang gis 'grib/ /ri ngogs dben par sgom du gshegs/ /bde skyid ri khrod gnas na yod/ /spyod lam dus drug thams cad du/ /nyin mtshan rtag tu chos kyis 'da'/ /ri ngogs dben par sgom du gshegs/ /bde skyid ri khrod gnas na yod/ /mi rtag 'chi ba jes su dran/ /dad dang nges 'byung skyo shas skye/ /ri ngogs dben par sgom du gshegs/ /bde skyid ri khrod gnas na yod/ /tshe 'di'i chos dang rgyang bsrings pas/ /rtag tu bya rgyu chos las med/ /ri ngogs dben par sgom du gshegs/ /bde skyid ri khrod gnas na yod/ /rtag tu chos la dmigs pa'i phyir/ /spyod lam thams cad dge bar 'gyur/ /ri ngogs dben par sgom du gshegs/ /bde skyid ri khrod gnas na yod/ /mkhas grub bla ma mchog la bsten/ /rtag par chos mdzad grogs dang 'grogs/ /ri ngogs dben par sgom du gshegs/ /bde skyid ri khrod gnas na yod/ /snying nas mos gus gdung sems skye/ /bla ma 186

mkha' 'gros byin gyis rlobs/ /ri ngogs dben par sgom du gshegs/ /bde skyid ri khrod gnas na yod/ /rtag tu sgrub pa snying por byed/ /nyams dang rtogs pa ngang gis 'char/ /ri ngogs dben par sgom du gshegs/ /bde skyid ri khrod gnas na yod/ /byas pa gcig pu don che ba/ /mi las rin chen don dang bcas/ /ri ngogs dben par sgom du gshegs/ /bde skyid ri khrod gnas na yod/ /tshe 'dir bde ste phyi ma'ang bde/ /gtan du bde la spyod pa yin/ /ri ngogs dben par sgom du gshegs/ /bde skyid ri khrod gnas na yod gsungs/ rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa'i zhal nas/ 'du 'dzis dben pa'i sa 'dzin mthon po'i ngos/ /spang ljongs nags tshal me tog khor yug can/ /rdo ba'i spyil chung rang byung khang bu ru/ /grib ma gnyis pa'i grogs dang lhan cig par/ /lhung lhung dal gyes 'bab pa'i nyal 'gro dang / /bag phebs ri dwags rgyu ba'i skad gnyis las/ /gzhan du dug gsum bskyed pa'i long gtam gyis/ /bsam gtan tsher ma'i byed po dmigs su med/ /phyag bdar khrod pa'i gos dang bsod snyoms kyis/ /nyer 'tsho dkor nag dug chus ma sbags par/ /rnam dkar dge la bskul nas lus ngag yid/ /gtan gyi bde sgrub mdun ma'i yang rtser son/ /187

zhes dang / rig 'dzin gang shar rang grol gyi zhal nas/ nyams dga' dang ba 'dren pa'i gnas/ /'du 'dzis dben pa'i ri sul na/ /dge ba spos chus brlan pa las/ /spos dang dri bzang chil li li/ /mtha' dbus med pa'i mkha' dbyengs su/ /bya rgod gshog rtsal sgor ro ro/ /dri zhim tshang tshing stug po'i khrod/ /lha bya skad snyan kyu ru ru/ /mdangs ldan me tog ge sar rtser /bung ba glu len di ri ri/ /ne'u gsing sngon po'i sman ljongs su/ /ri dwags bang rtsal sha ra ra/ /'od gsal nyi zla'i sgon ma las/ /dri med 'od ldan gsal la la/ /chu 'dzin dkar po'i gdugs mdzes las/ /'ja' tshon ri mo ya la la/ /na bun dar dkar bkram pa las/ /zim pa'i sbrang char si li li/ /rab dkar rdo yi 'bab stegs las/ /ngang bas chu rgyun khrol lo lo/ /dri bzhon dal bur ldang ba yi/ /ljon shing lo 'dab khril li li/ /de ltar ngo mtshar mtha' yas shing / /mtshan nyid thams cad tshang ba'i gnas/ /yid 'ong dben pa'i ri khrod na/ /snang stong sgyu ma'i zlos gar mkhan/ /gang shar rang grol rnal 'byor pa/ /snyoms las mal du nyal nyal nas/ /'khor ba'i gnas tshul bsam pa'i tshe/ /gang la'ang snying po mi 'dug pas/ /rnal 'byor mi la'i rnam thar de/ /kha tsam min par skyong snying 'dod/ /gsungs/ rje mi 188

la'i zhal nas/ me tog sna tshogs skyes pa'i gnas/ /ljon shing gar stabs byed pa'i sa/ /'jol mo gsung snyan sgog pa'i ri/ /spra spre'u g.yang rtsal sbyong ba'i sa/ /de lta bu yi dben gnas su/ /gcig pur 'dug na bde ba ste/ /'du 'dzi spangs na yongs kyang bde/ /zhes dang / yang me tog sna tshogs skyes pa'i yul/ /shing rnams gar stabs byed pa'i khrod/ /bya skad sna tshogs sgogs pa'i gling / /spra spre'u g.yang rtsal spyod pa'i sa/ /de lta bu yi dben gnas su/ /gcig pur ri khrod 'grims pas bde/ /bla ma spyi bor bsgom pas bde/ /gtum mo'i bde drod rang 'bar bde/ /sgyu lus chos brgyad rang grol bde/ /rmi lam 'khrul pa rang sang bde/ /'od gsal ma rig mun bral bde/ /'pho ba ma bsgom sangs rgyas bde/ /bar do cig chod 'ong na bde/ /zag med bde chen dbyings na bde/ /nga de ltar bde ba'i pha rgan la/ /shing tog zhim mngar cha rgyus yod/ /rdza chu grang dro'i cha rgyus yod/ /don de la soms la go ba long / /zhes dang / e ma ri khrod dben pa'i gnas/ /rgyal ba byang chub brnyes pa'i sa/ /grub thob rnams kyis bzhugs pa'i shul/ /ming rang gcig pur 'dug pa'i yul/ /brag dmar mchong lung khyung gi rdzong / /steng na lho sprin khor me khor/ /'og na gtsang chab gya ma gyu/ /bar na rgod po 189

lang ma ling / /rtsi shing sna tshogs ban ma bun/ /ljon shing gar stangs shigs se shig /bung ba glu len khor ro ro/ /me tog dri ngad chil li li/ /bya rnams skad snyan kyu ru ru/ /de 'dra'i brag dmar khyung lung na/ /bya dang bye'u gshog rtsal sbyong / /spra dang spre'u g.yang rtsal sbyong / /ri dwags sna tshogs bang rtsal sbyong/ /nga mi la ras pa nyams rtsal sbyong / /nyams rtsal byang chub sems gnyis sbyong / /zhes dang / dben gnas rkyang phan nam mkha' rdzong / /nam mkha' rdzong gi pho brang na/ /steng na lho sprin smug po 'thib/ /'og na gtsang chab sngon mo 'bab/ /rgyab na brag dmar nam mkha'i dbyengs/ /mdun na spang ri me tog bkra/ /zur na gcan gzan ngar skad 'don/ /log la bya rgyal rgod po lding / /mkha' la sbrang char zim bu 'bab/ /rgyun du bung ba glu dbyangs len/ /sha rkyang ma bu rtse bro brdung / /spra dang spre'u g.yang rtsal sbyong / /lco ka ma bu 'gyur skad mang / /lha bya gong mos glu dbyangs len/ /rdza chab bsil mas snyan pa brjod/ /dus kyi skad rigs nyams kyi grogs/ /gnas 'di'i yon tan bsam mi khyab/ /ces dang / mon ri shing ri bde ba'i mkhar/ /spang ri me tog bkra ba'i yul/ /ljon shing gar stabs byed pa'i gseb/ /spra spre'u rtsed mo rtse ba'i sa/ /bya skad sna tshogs sgrog pa'i gnas/ /bung ba lang 190

ling 'phur ba'i sa/ /nyin mtshan med par 'ja' ris 'khrug /dbyar dgun med par sbrang char 'bab/ /ston dpyid med par na bun 'khrigs/ /de lta bu yi dben gnas na/ /rnal 'byor mi la ras pa nga / /sems stong nyid bsgom pa'i 'od gsal bde/ /'char sgo mang na shin tu bde/ /zhes dang / yol mo stag phug seng ge'i rdzong / /stag mo yi ngar skad skyi sha tsha/ /des dbang med sku mtshams dam du bcug /stag phrug gi rtsed 'phyo snying rje skye/ /des dbang med du byang sems sgom du bcug /spre'u'i rtse sgra zhe la bcag /des dbang med du skyo shas skye ru bcug /spre phrug gi ku sgra rgod snying 'dod/ /des dbang med sems bskyed bsgom du bcug /khu byug gi skad snyan yid rtsa skyo/ /des dbang med du mchi ma 'chor du bcug /lco ga'i 'gyur skad rna bar snyan/ /des dbang med du rna ba nyan du bcug /bya rog gi sgra skad sna tshogs pa/ /rnal 'byor 'dug grogs sems la phan/ /gnas 'di 'drar bsdad na ngang gis skyid/ /grogs gcig kyang med na de bas skyid/ /ces dang / byang chub rdzong gi dben gnas 'di/ /phu na lha btsan gangs dkar mtho/ /mda' na yon bdag dad ldan mang / /rgyab ri dar dkar yol bas bcad/ /mdun na dgos 'dod gnas tshal spungs/ /spang gshong ne'u 191

gsing che la yangs/ /dri ldan yid 'ong pad+ma la/ /rkang drug ldan pa'i dar dar can/ /rdzing bu lteng ka chu ngogs la/ /chu bya mgrin pa skyog nas blta/ /ljon shing rgyas pa'i yal ga la/ /mdzes pa'i bya tshogs skad snyan bsgyur/ /dri bzhon yor bus btab pa la/ /rkang 'thung yal gas gar stabs byed/ /mtho zhing gsal ba'i ljon shing rtser/ /spra spre'u g.yang rtsal sna tshogs byed/ /sngo ljang yangs pa'i gsing ma la/ /rkang bzhi'i dud 'gro zas la bkram/ /de dag skyong byed rdzi bo rnams/ /glu dang gling bu'i skad snyan bsgyur/ /'jig rten sred pa'i khol po rnams/ /zang zing las byed sa gzhi khyab/ /de la blta ba'i rnal 'byor nga / /kun gsal rin chen brag steng na/ /snang ba ma rtag dpe ru 'dren/ /'dod yon mig yor chu ru bsgom/ /tshe 'di rmi lam sgyu mar blta/ /ma rtogs pa la snying rje bsgom/ /nam mkha' stong pa zas su za/ /yangs pa med pa'i bsam gtan bsgom/ /sna tshogs nyams la ci yang 'char/ /e ma khams gsum 'khor ba'i chos/ /med cing snang ba ngo mtshar che/ /zhes dang / /sangs rgyas phal chen las/yul ljongs thang chen mi snang yang / /yid la gdung ba mi bskyed kyi/ /bas mtha' dgon pa ri khrod dag /rtog pa med pa'i bag re yangs/ /mkhar dang grong khyer mi snang yang / /yid la gdung 192

ba mi bskyed kyi/ /bla gab med pa'i khang bzang dag /gza' skar rgyan can nyams re dga'/ /sbra gur yol thabs mi snang yang / /yid la gdung ba mi bskyed kyi/ /gangs ri sman ri gnas ljongs na/ /na bun khyud bskor bre re legs/ /snang zhugs mar me mi snang yang / /yid la gdung ba mi bskyed kyi/ /nyi zla 'od chen 'bar ba dag /snang dro brjid pa 'od re gsal/ /bro gar glu thabs mi snang yang / /yid la gdung ba mi bskyed kyi/ /ljon shing rlung gis bskyod pa yis/ /gar stabs sna tshogs sdeb re legs/ /rol mo'i sil snyan mi grags zhes/ /yid la gdung ba mi bskyed kyi/ /bya bran sna tshogs skad 'byen pa/ /rol mo sna tshogs dbyangs re snyan/ /gos dang lhab lhub rgyan med kyi/ /yid la gdung ba mi bskyed kyi/ /mu stegs mtshan ma spangs pa yi/ /snam sbyar bkra ba rgyan re mdzes/ /las kyi gnyen dang mi 'grogs zhes/ /yid la gdung ba mi bskyed kyi/ /dge bshes chos kyis bsdus pa yi/ /drang srong tshogs rnams grogs re bzang rtse gcig 'khor g.yog mi mnga' zhes/ /yid la gdung ba mi bskyed kyi/ /lha klu gnod sbyin sman la sogs/ /dge bsnyen tshogs kyi 'khor re rag /'jig rten gtsug lag ma sbyangs zhes/ /yid la gdung ba mi bskyed kyi/ /rig pa'i gnas lngar blo sbyangs pas/ /193

mkhas pa'i phul byung rlabs re che/ /gser dang nor dbyig mi bdog pas/ /dbul zhes gdung ba mi bskyed kyi/ /zad mi shes pa gter gyi mchog /'phags pa'i nor bdun tshogs re mang / /blon 'dra rgyal sa ma bzung zhes/ /yid la gdung ba mi bskyed kyi/ /rgyal thabs bcu pa shākya'i sras/ /rigs su gyur pa dbang re mtho/ /g.yos legs kha zas mi gda' zhes/ /yid la gdung ba mi bskyed kyi/ /rtsa ba 'bras bu rang byung zas/ /yid bzhin bda' ba khong du zhim/ /sna tshogs chang dag med do zhes/ /yid la gdung ba mi bskyed kyi/ /yan lag brgyad ldan gtsang ma'i chu/ /klu yis sbyar ba mgur du bda'/ /'dod pa'i yon tan kun spangs pa'i/ /log pa'i longs spyod mi snang yang / /ting nge 'dzin gye rol pa yi/ /dge ba'i longs spyod dpe zla med/ /rin po che yi gter rnyed nas/ /phyir zhing longs spyod 'phel ba ltar/ /de bzhin bde ba'i 'byung gnas kyi/ /dgon par yun bsrings dge ba 'phel/ /gzhan yang ri dgon dben pa yi/ /nags tshal dag la phar bltas na/ /dus bzhi dbang gis sprul pa yi/ /ljon shing dag la dge ba mnga'/ /dpyid ga'i myu gu 'thon pa dag /rje dpon skyob pas drangs pa bzhin/ /sos ga'i lo 'dab g.yo ba dag /ma sring byams pas bsdus pa bzhin/ /194

dbyar gyi me tog rgyas pa dag /mdza' bo mdun na rgod pa 'dra/ /ston gyi 'bras bu smin pa dag /phyag tshang 'dri mkhan stabs pa 'dra/ /dgun gyi lcug ma gug pa dag /slob ma dul ba phyag 'tshal bzhin/ /dgun smad shun pa bcom pa dag /srub ma go cha gon pa 'dra/ /phye leb spu sdug 'khor lding ba/ /gnyen bshes 'khor ba 'tshogs pa'i nyams/ /gzhan yang dgon pa'i g.yas g.yon na/ /'jol mo ne tso sgra 'byin cing / /bung ba na chung glu yang len/ /rma bya pho mo gar yang rtse/ /g.ya' rdo 'bab chu lhung lhung sgog /chab sgra lhung lhung sgra sgog pa/ /rgyal 'khor ba yi lha mo bzhin/ /gzugs dang sgra yis dga' bar byed/ /rtsi thog dri yis bsgos pa yi/ /bser bus bsil g.yab kun nas g.yob/ /chu skyes thang skyes me tog kyang / /mdog sdug dbyebs legs kun nas bkra/ /nags tshal 'bras bu rgyas pa dang / /sman ljongs 'bab chu bcas pa yi/ /dgon pa dag na glu gar dang / /yid bzhin longs spyod brjod mi langs/ /yul gyi rnam pa kun bzang yang / /dmigs pas g.yeng bar mi 'gyur ba'i/ /zhi ba'i dpal bzhed grogs po dag /ri dgon dben par 'dong ngo gshegs/ /gsungs/ rje btsun ye shes rgyal mtshan gyis/ dgra med gnyen med re med dogs med du/ /195

nags tshal dben zhing tshegs chung bde skyid par/ /chog shes bdud rtsi'i dpal la longs spyod cing / /mthong chos bde ba'i dga' ston myang bar bya/ /'du 'dzi g.yeng ba'i chom rkun sgrib pa'i phyir/ /lha yi bzo bos ched du bcos pa bzhin/ /ljon pa bzang po'i phreng ba mtshar du dngar/ /'dab stong ge sar dri bzang kun tu 'phro/ /bser bu rgyu ba'i shugs kyis bskyod pa na/ /ljon shing yal ga gar stabs byed pa ni/ /rtse gcig bsam gtan bsgom rnams 'dir byon zhes/ /dga' bas bskyod nas g.yab mo byed pa 'dra/ /'bab chu'i na chung mu tig do shal can/ /lhung lhung sil sil glu dbyangs brgyud mar sgogs/ /dbang po'i gzhu ltar bkra ba'i 'dab ma can/ /gnyis skyes mgrin pa'i dril chung 'dril ba ni/ /dri za'i glu dbyangs dag la 'gran pa bzhin/ /sbrang rtsi dog pas lag pa brgyan pa yi/ /bung ba'i na chung 'phur lding gar stabs dang / /bcus te rgyud mang glu yi thos 'dzin sim/ /gsog srung spangs te 'phral la zas tshol zhing / /gzhan la mi gnod ran dang chab kyis 'tsho/ /bsam gtan pa la chog shes ston 'dra yi/ /bag phebs ri dwags mgrin pa skyog nas blta/ /srid dang zhi ba'i mtha' la mi ltung phyir/ /thabs shes g.yang rtsal sbyong zhes bskul 'dra yi/ /spra sprel ljon 196

shing gcig nas gcig gi rtser/ /mchong ba'i g.yang rtsal sbyong ba ltad mo che/ /yan lag brgyad ldan bdud rtsi'i btung ba dang / /tshod ma'i khyad par rnam pa mang po dang / /ma rmos 'khrungs pa'i 'bras bu sna tshogs dang / /bste gnas nye 'khor kun tu mtshar du dngar/ /shugs 'brus 'tsho ba'i byi'u'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /shin tu rnyed sla'i kha zas 'di 'dra ba/ /yod bzhin grong khrod myul bas ci bya zhes/ /zur gyis 'doms pa'i ca co rnam mang grogs/ /gnyis skyes 'ga' zhig ljon pa'i rtser 'khod nas/ /kye kye ma yengs ma yengs rtse gcig sgrubs/ /dal ba'i gnas skabs 'di 'dra rnyed dka' zhes/ /yang dang yang du bos te bskul bar byed/ /'bab chu skad cig mi sdod rgyug pa dang / /chu 'dzin lang ling g.yo ba'i zlos gar dang / /lo ma me tog 'bras bu 'gyur ldog gis/ /'dus byas mi rtag bstan te bskul bar byed/ /gdod nas grub pa'i bya skyibs phug pa'am/ /zla ba nor bu'i rdo leb brtsegs 'dra ba'i/ /rang shong spyil bur chog shes bder gnas pa/ /'di 'dra lha dbang gis kyang rnyed par dka'/ /rta bdun dbang po nub kyi sa 'dzin rtser/ /gos dmar gyon te mi snang lam zhugs tshe/ /dkar phyogs lha yis ched du byas pa bzhin/ /dgung sngon baiḍūr sngon po'i bla bre la/ /mkha' 'gro 197

dkar po'i do shal mdzes par bkram/ /bsil zer 'od 'bar sgron me lhag par gsal/ /nags na gnas pa'i gcan gzan khro bo rnams/ /bsam gtan pa la 'tshe ba byung dogs nas/ /phyogs dang phyogs su 'phyo zhing mel tshe byed/ /de ltar bgrang yas yon tan ldan gyur pa/ /lha yi dga' tshal 'dra ba'i dben gnas su/ /spra ba'i 'bol chung bsam gtan stegs bu la/ /rgyal ba rnam snang mdzad kyi bzhugs stangs ltar/ /gnas te rtse gcig bsam gtan bsgom par bya/ /zhes gsungs/ slob dpon zhi ba lhas mdzad pa'i spyod 'jug las/ skal ldan zla 'od tsan dan gyis bsil ba'i/ /yangs pa'i rdo leb khang bzang nyams dga' bar/ /sgra med zhi ba'i nags klung g.yob pa yis/ /gzhan la phan don sems zhing 'chag par byed/ /khang stong shing drung phug dag tu/ /gang du ji srid 'dod gnas shing / /yongs 'dzin srung ba'i sdug bsngal spangs/ /ltos pa med par bag yangs spyod/ /rang dbang spyod cing chags med la/ /gang dang yang ni 'brel med pa'i/ /chog shes bde spyod gang yin pa/ /dbang pos kyang ni rnyed par dka'/ /zhes dang / slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mis/slob ma la springs yig las/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor rgyas pas nye bar brgyan byas shing / /rked chings char chen sprin gyis 'khrig 198

pas 'khyud gyur pa/ /ri rtse nags kyi mthong der chags pa med par ni/ /rlung ltar g.yo ba'i rang bzhin che gtugs skal ba che/ /nags mthong ri dwags dkyu ba'i tshogs kyis brten byas la/ /kun nas nyams dga' bzang po de na skyid pa gang / /de ci dga' ba'i nags tshal lha mi'i nyams bag tu/ /thel gyis 'bebs pa'i rdo leb can la yod 'gyur ram/ /nags klung chu gtsang ngogs bde dben par skyid pa gang / /de ci lha yi bu mo dri zhim byug pa yi/ /lan bu'i rgyan du thogs pa'i rgyan ldan me tog thogs/ /mdzes pa'i zil gnon lha yi chu la yod 'gyur ram/ /rtsa ba 'bras bu shun pa bo ma phun sum tshogs pa'i ljon shing ldan/ /nags tshal ltos med ri bo'i chu rgyun bsil 'bab chags pa med par gnas/ /chu klung yangs pa'i mtha' rgyu 'bras bu me tog lhung bas brgyan pa yi/ /nyams dga' bas mthar ci zhig bde de dmyal dong khyim gyis bslus te sdod/ /ri sul yangs par skye bo bun long med pas rab bde ba/ /nyer spyod rgya chen khor yug nags tshal sngo 'khrungs phreng bas sbrengs/ /chu ngogs bsnyen pa phu chu'i rgyun sgra rnga ltar snyan pa yi/ /bdag cag nyon mongs yul ma yin zhes mgron la sgogs pa bzhin/ /zhes dang / slob dpon sa mtsho sbyin gyis dben pa'i gtam las/ mtshan mo zla 199

ba'i snang ba rab gsal ba'i/ /skar ma'i me tog bkram pa nyer mchod pa/ /dgon pa bsten pa'i yid ni des zhi ba'i/ /lhag par dga' ba dag na skye bar 'gyur/ /gang du dge slong dben pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis/ /kha na ma tho med pa zhi 'gyur bde/ /gang du yo byad yang dag brten chags pas/ /sems ni sna tshogs 'phongs pas gdungs par 'gyur/ /sa yi rdul gyis gos pas ri dwags dag /rtsa dang 'dab ma tsam gyis sgrub byed ltar/ /sems ni dben par gzhol ba 'dod gyur gyi/ /gling bzhi'i phun tshogs rgya chen dag la'ang min/ /shing drung 'bab chu brten pa'i dka' thub dag /yongs su 'dzin pa dag ni rnam spangs nas/ /rang sems tsam dang rab tu 'brel ba yi/ /bde 'byung gang de rgyal po rnams la med/ /ces dang / zhang g.yu brag 'gro mgon rin po ches/ 'jag spyil lha yi gzhal yas khang / /mal chung a mo li ga'i gdan/ /ras gos yang 'jam lha yi gos/ /bsil bu lha yi sil g.yab ste/ /ne'u sing ljang khu sa gzhi'i rgyan/ /nyi zla 'od 'bar bar snang rgyan/ /de lta bu yi ri khrod 'dir/ /mi chen gyi tshul 'chos bya mi dgos/ /kha bsags g.yo sgyu bgyid mi 'tshal/ /ngo srung sems khral bya mi dgos/ /gzhan gyi sdig rten bya mi dgos/ /'gro 'dug gi sdug bsngal bya mi dgos/ /zhes dang /200

dran pa nyer gzhag las/ gang zhig rtag tu yid zhi zhing / /tshal du rnal 'byor bsam gtan pa/ /de dag rtag par tshal du dga'/ /'dod pa tshol ba ma yin no/ /tshal rnams su ni bsgom pa'i sems/ /srog dag tu yang g.yo mi 'gyur/ /de bas rtag tu tshal bsten bya/ /grong khyer gyis ni gnod mi 'gyur/ /mi yi 'dod chags la sogs yid/ /grong khyer dag tu rnam par g.yeng / /rmongs pa mi brtan g.yeng ba de/ /tshal du phyir zhing dwangs par byed/ /gang phyir sdig dang bral ba yi/ /bral las yid kyis rten bya ste/ /de bas mchog tu zhi ba'i tshal/ /rnal 'byor rnams kyi gnas chen yin/ /sems dang dbang po rab zhi ba/ /rnal 'byor snying la dga' ba gang / /de ni brgya byen stong nyid kyi/ /shin tu dga' ba mi 'gyur ro/ /thams cad du ni rnam byang ba/ /rnal 'byor pa yi dga' mthong gang / /rtag tu 'dod chags rjes 'gro ba/ /'thab bral ba'ang de ma mthong / /zhes dang / rje skal ldan rgya mtshos/ ma mkha' 'gro mi med sa char 'byon/ /chos gang byed de la mgon skyabs byed/ /dpal chos skyong srung tshogs sprin bzhin 'du/ /chos byed mkhan de yi bar chad srung / /dgong nyi ma zer zer byung tsa na/ /skyo phyod de blo sna thung thung 'byung / /nang sna bar yar la lang tsa na/ /lha bla ma yi dam wal ler 'char /201

dge sgrub 'dod kyi 'dod pa lhang lhang skye/ /chos gang byed kyi 'dun pa btang bzhin 'grub/ /sdig ltung pa'i phyogs la 'gyod cing sdom/ /nyin phal cher dge sbyor bya bas 'da'/ /mtshan gnyid chung dge sbyor rim pa sbyong / /las de 'dra'i dal 'byor don ldan byed/ /mi de la skyid pa'i nyi ma 'char/ /zhes gsungs/'phags pa yul 'khor skyong gis zhus pa'i mdo las/ skyon gyis gzings pa mtha' yas ldan pa'i khyim spangs rtag tu nor mi blta/ /yon tan ldan pa nges pa de dag dgon par dga' zhing dbang po thul/ /de dag gang du bud med rnams dang skyes pa rnams dang 'dris mi byed/ /bse ltar gcig bur gnas shing bsam pa dri med dag la dri ma bral/ /de dag thob pa rnams kyis dga' bar mi 'gyur ma thob yid zhums med/ /'dod pa chung ste ngan ngon tsam la dga' zhing sgyu dang tshul 'chos spangs/ /sems can don phyir brtson 'grus yid ldan sbyin dang dul ba la yang gnas/ /sangs rgyas ye shes don gnyer bsam gtan brtson 'grus pha rol phyin/ /lus dang de bzhin srog la mi blta sdug pa'i rtsa lag rnams spangs te/ /bsam pa rdo rje lta bur rab brtan rtag tu byang chub lam la sbyor/ /lus ni dum bu dum bur bcad kyang de yi sems la g.yo ba med/ /thams cad mkhyen nyid 202

re ba phyir zhing brtson 'grus shin tu brtan cing rtsom/ /zhes dang / lho brag mar pa'i zhal nas/ 'khor ba ngu bro sgyid lugs bskyur/ /mi med kyi rdza brag pha yi mkhar/ /grogs med gcig pu lha yi yul/ /sems la sems zhon tshad med rta/ /rang lus dgon pa lha yi khang / /yengs med kyi dge sbyor sman gyi mchog /ces dang / mi med lung pa'i brag phug na/ /'khor 'das brje ba'i tshong 'dus yod/ /snying rus lus kyi dgon pa la/ /lha bde gshegs 'dus pa'i mchod khang yod/ /nad med zwa yi tshogs 'khor la/ /mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i bdud rtsi yod/ /ces dang /mtshams dam po mi med khye med na/ /rtags myur du mthong ba'i sgon me yod/ /zas dkor zas med pa'i rang zas la/ /bde ba lha yi pham phab yod/ /gsungs/ skyes rabs las/ khyem ni 'byor na phal cher rgyags par 'gyur/ /rigs btsun nga rgyal che zhing stobs kyis snyems/ /sdug bsngal khro zhing rgud na zhum par 'gyur/ /des na nam zhig rab tu zhi bar 'gyur/ /skye bo chog shes rnams kyi khyim/ /rab tu bde ba dben pa'i tshal/ /ji ltar sems ni dga' 'gyur ba/ /de 'dra lha yi yul na'ang med/ /de bas tshal na ngan pa'i gos gyon te/ /gzhan gyi dring la 'jog cing 'tsho yang rung / /bdag la phan 'dod dug chen mi za 203

bzhin/ /chos min 'dres pa'i bde ba mi 'dod de/ /des na rab tu dben pa'i ro mya ngan/ /zhes dang / nags na bya ba ngan pa mang po btang / /yongs su bzung ba'i sdug bsngal spang la gtsang / /zhi ba 'ba' zhig byed cing yid kyang mgu/ /bde dang bsod nams grags pa thob par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / sngon gyi spyod pa'i de blo yongs su dag /'dod pa rnams la skyon mang mthong nas ni/ /khyim na gnas pa nad bzhin yongs spangs nas/ /nags tshal gnas shing rab tu brgyan par 'gyur/ /gsungs/ zla ba sgron ma'i mdo las/ gang dag nags dang ri sul la dga' ba/ /dge sbyong nyid kyis rab bde myong bar 'gyur/ /zhes dang / dgon par gnas pa de yi yon tan 'di/ /de ni rtag tu gus byas yid 'byung 'gyur/ /de ni 'jig rten ci la 'dod pa med/ /zag pa dag ni rnam par 'phel mi 'gyur/ /nags la gnas pa de yi yon tan 'di/ /de ni nam yang rtsod par mi 'gyur te/ /rtag tu zhi zhing dge ba dben pa ru/ /lus dang ngag dang yid kyang rab bsdams 'gyur/ /dgon par gnas pa 'di la yon tan mang / /de ni thar pa'i rjes su mthun pa yin/ /de ni rnam grol zhi ba myur rtogs byed/ /nags la gnas shing rnam grol bsten byed na/ /dgon gnas de la 204

yon tan 'di kun 'byung / /zhes gsungs/ a wa dhu ti pas/sngon la nags su song gyur te/ /ri dwags tshol bar brtsams pa dang / /dben gnas skyid pa de mthong bas 'tshe ba thams cad spangs nas ni/ /de nyid du ni gnas bcas 'gyur/ /zhes dang / rgyal ba khyung tshang bas/ 'dug na zhen pa ma mchis shing / /'gro na chags pa mi skye ba'i/ /ri khrod dben pa'i spyil bu la/ /bsrung ran ma dgos blo re bde/ /zhes dang / /ngang pa'i skyes rabs su/ nags tshal dgon pa na chos bde bar sgrub nus kyis/ khyim na de ltar mi nus so/ /zhes dang / tshoms las/legs par nyer zhi'i ro dang ni/ /rab tu dben pa'i ro rnyed nas/ /rims nad med cing sdig med la/ /chos la dga' ba'i ro dag 'thung / /zhes dang / gang pos zhus pa'i mdo las/rab tu byung la rtag mos pas/ /rtag tu rab tu byung bar gyur/ /ri dang nags tshal gnas mos pas/ /yon tan 'byung gnas 'phel bar byed/ /dben par gnas la bsten byed dang / /'dod lnga'i chags pa yongs su spong / /de na 'du 'dzi med pas na/ /dge chos rkyen gyes nyams mi 'gyur/ /phan tshun dul zhing gtam 'dri dang / /tshig gis smra bar byed pas na/ /stong dben nyer zhi dben pa las/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis rab tu 205

bsngags/ /de phyir byang chub sems dpa' rnams/ /rtag par yongs su bsten bya zhing / /grong khyer la ni chags mi bya/ /zhes dang / ting 'dzin rgyal po las/ dben par gnas pa'i yon tan bcu gsungs pa ni 'di lta ste/ rtag tu bya ba nyung bar 'gyur/ /'du 'dzi dag kyang ring du spong / /rtsod pa dag kyang de la med/ /gnod pa med par gnas pa dang / /zag pa rnam par 'phel mi byed/ /rtsod pa'i gzhi mi byed pa dang / /rtag tu nye bar zhi bar spyod/ /sgo gsum bsdams par gnas pa dang / /thar pa dang ni mthun 'gyur zhing / /rnam par grol ba myur du reg /gsungs/ gzhan yang de nyid las/ mkhas pas rtag tu dgon gnas shing / /sangs rgyas gter dang chos kyi gter/ /ye shes gter dang sngon mtha'i gter/ /mngon shes lnga yang myur du thob/ /gsungs/ gzhan yang / rtag tu dben pa bsten na dzu 'phrul dag kyang thob pa dang / /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas grangs med dpag tu med pa mthong ba dang / /de dag dang mi 'bral zhing sangs rgyas de dag gis phyogs bcu na dam chos ston pa yang lha'i rna bas thos pas rtag tu chos nyan pa dang mi 'bral/chos kun blor bzung mi brjed sems can rnams la ston nus don gang yin yang rtag tu shes/ 'das ma 'ongs da ltar gyi 206
