'gro ba kun gyi sems shes spyod pa shes pa sogs phan yon mtha' yas pa gsungs/ mdor na ri khrod dben par gnas nas nyams len byas na/ sangs rgyas kyi yon tan thams can thob par gsungs/ khrid yig gzhan phan snying po las/ dben pa snyegs nas mis mi mthong sar sdod pa'i rab byung la/ ma mtha' lkog smra tsam yang 'ongs med na/ btsan po kha drag girab bya ba 'di la zer/ mtshar ba med/ ma grub pa med/ ltogs pa'am 'khyags dogs pa med/ re re po med/ dogs dogs po med/ za ra zi re med/ lab be lob be med/ phyi'i dgra med/nang gi gnyen med/ phar bltas dpon med/ tshur bltas g.yog med/ thams cad 'tshub ril ril thal ba long long /rgyug 'dur yi yi/ snying rtsa long long snang tsar/ pho skye bo ni/stan chung gru bzhi'i steng na/ oṃ cog ge lus dal khyug ge /sems dal khyug ge/ rmongs pa 'dod pas mgo 'khor ba rnams la/ chig rgod shig ge/ sha mar ja 'thud kyi btson dong du tshud pa rnams la snying rje dung nge/ rgyags tshad za dgos snyam tsar/tshug tshad bsran dgos pa rnams la yid mug long nge / bde skyid thang la 'khyams pa sgug ma shes pa rnams la rgod bro se/skyid pa'i tshad du ma gda' 'am skyes bu kun/ rgyal sras zhi ba lha 207

la sogs pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams kyang de 'dra ba'i bde skyid la longs spyod pa'i skyes pa zhig nam yong na zhes smon lam mdzad par gda'/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ tshe blos btang nas ri khrod dben par gcig pur drang srong bsam gtan bsgom bzhin sdod rgyu'i skal ba zhig byung na/ dbul phongs dang /gzhan dbang du 'gyur ba dang / khas nyen dang pho ma skyes pa dang / bkra mi shis pa dang / klung rta rgud pa dang / bde skyid med pa dang / mi mkhas pa dang / mi btsun pa dang / mi bzang ba dang / chos mi 'phel ba dang / tshe phyi ma'i so nam mi 'ong ba dang / thar pa mi thob pa dang / nyams rtogs yon tan mi skye ba dang / nyon mongs gnyen pos mi non pa dang / dngos grub mi thob pa dang / tshogs bsog mi nus pa dang / gdams pa mi zab pa dang / rgyal ba mi mnyes pa dang / 'gro don mi 'ong ba dang / grogs nye gnas ngan pa 'phrad pa dang / bu sogs nye du ngan pa 'phrad pa dang / rnyed pa mi thob pa dang / sbyin gtong med pa dang / smon gnas ngan pa dang bcas nyes skyon nyer lnga po 'di ma spangs bzhin rang 'gag la 'gro/ phyug po'i rab dang / rang dbang thob pa'i rab dang / kha drag gi rab dang /pho skyes pa'i rab dang /bkra shis pa'i rab dang / klung rta dar 208

ba'i rab dang / bde skyid kyi rab dang / mkhas pa'i rab dang /btsun po'i rab dang / bzang po'i rab dang / chos 'phel ba'i rab dang / phyi ma'i so nam gyi rab dang / thar lam gyi rab dang / nyams rtogs yon tan gye rab dang / gnyen bo'i rab dang / dngos grub kyi rab dang / tshogs gsog gi rab dang / /gdams ngag gi rab dang / rgyal ba mnyes pa'i rab dang /'gro don gyi rab dang / grogs nye gnas kyi rab dang / bu sogs nye du'i rab dang / rnyed pa'i rab dang / sbyin pa'i rab dang / smon gnas kyi rab dang bcas yon tan nyer lnga po 'di sgrub mi dgos bzhin du shugs kyis thob/ ces spyan snga ba blo gros rgyal mtshan rin po ches gsungs/ gzhan yang tshe blos btang nas gcig pur ri khrod dben par bar bsdad na/ 'dod chags/ zhe sdang / gti mug nga rgyal/ phrag dog ser sna/gyod dang gtam ngan/ brnyas smod/ brdeg brdung / bka' bkyon/ khral 'jal/ bu lon/ 'tsho skyong / gsog srung / rku dang / 'phrog bcom/ dmag las/ dkor zas/ dud chang /tshul 'chos/ g.yo sgyu/ ngal dub lus nad/ sems sdug dang bcas nyes skyon nyer lnga po 'di yang shugs kyis 'gags nas/lus sems bde/ rgyun du dal/ rig pa dwangs/ nyams dga' 209

spro/ bla ma dgyes/ yi dam mnyes/ mkha' 'gro 'du/ lha yis bsrung / snyan grags che/ dad gus dang / dag snang dang / mi rtag pa dang / nges 'byung dang / byams pa dang / snying rje dang /sems bskyed dang / so thar dang / byang sems dang / sngags sdom dang / sbyin pa dang / tshul khrims dang / bzod pa dang /brtson 'grus dang / bsam gtan dang / shes rab 'phel ba dang bcas yon tan nyer lnga po 'di yang shugs kyis 'ong ba yin zhes bla ma gong ma mang pos gsungs/ gzhan yang ri khrod dben par bsdad na/ srog gcod pa dang / ma byen len/ mi tshangs spyod/ rdzun phra ma/ tshig rtsub/ ngag 'khyal/ brnab sems/gnod sems/ log lta dang bcu po 'di yang shugs kyis 'gags 'gro/ mi dge bcu spangs na dge bcu min pas/ bya btang ri khrod pas skyabs 'gro tsam las ma byas nyal bsdad kyang / shi na ngan song gsum du gtan nas skye mi srid mngon mtho lha mi'i go 'phang zhig thob na mi 'dod kyang shugs kyis thob pas de la dgongs nas/ spyan snga bas/ 'du 'dzir dge ba dpag med sgrub pa bas/ /dben par nyal nas bsdad pa ches dga' ste/ /sdug bsngal rgya mtsho bde ba'i rgya mtsho gnyis/ /'dam kha ma nor dgos so shākya'i sras/ /gsungs/ 'di ltar nyes skyon 210

drug cu tham pa 'gags nas/ yon tan drug cu tham pa ngam ngam shugs kyis 'ong bar shes nas/ sngar ri khrod na sdad yod pa rnams la gzhan yon tan til 'bru tsam ma skyes kyang 'di ka yon tan gyi mchog tu mthong nas skal ba bzang bsod nams che snyam dga' zhing spro bzhin ji srid 'tsho'i bar du bsten 'dod kyi blo ngam ngam shugs kyis skye/ grong yul du song na gtan nas mi 'dod/ grong yul du lus pa rnams kyis kyang ri khrod du 'dug rgyu'i skal ba zhig byung na ci ma rung snyam yid smon byed nges/ grong dang ri khrod dben pa gnyis la/ me dong dang bsil khang / dmyal khams dang / lha yul gyi khyad yod pas/ grong gseb na rnga dril dkrol nas kha lag gnyis gas rem nas grong chog byas bde bar sems pa de/ me zhig gi nang du bsdad nas rkang lag gis ral kha byas/ kha nas a tsa a na smras pa'i mi zhig gis kho bde snyam pa dang 'dra ste/ 'ba' ra bas/ rgyal bas bsngags pa'i ri khrod dam pa ru/ /bse ru lta bur gcig pur mi 'dug na/ /rnam g.yeng nags la mched pa'i me chen 'dra/ /mang po'i gseb tu nyon mongs rnam par 'phel/ /gsungs/ des na ri khrod dben par bsdad na 'di 'dra'i yon tan dpag med yod pa ngo ma shes par/ sngar ri khrod du bsdad yod pa rnams 211

kyis/ ting 'dzin phra mo re tsam la dmigs pa gtad nas lo zla zhag kha shas bsdad nas skyes tshe/ nga ri khrod du bsdad nas yon tan skyes ni can po ma red nyis shor red tsho zer nas mar grong gi me 'ob tu mchong ba mang bas/ skyid ngo shes pa 'di shin tu gal che/ zhes spyan snga ba sogs skyes bu dam pa mang pos gsungs pas/ ri khrod du bsdad yod pa rnams kyis thugs nyams zhogari khrod du bsdad nas skyabs 'gro lan cig byas kyang / nang ba sangs rgyas pa'i gral du tshud/ sdom pa thams cad kyi rten du 'gyur/ sngar bsags kyi sdig sgrib 'dag bsod nams rgya chen po gsog ngan song du mi lhung / mi dang mi ma yin gyi gnod pas mi tshugs/ yid la ci bsam thams cad 'grub/ myur du 'tshang rgya ba sogs phan yon mtha' yas te/ gang zhig skyabs song 'di la gzugs yod na/ /'jig rten stong khams 'di yang snod du chung / /gsungs/ de bzhin du byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems phar phyin drug bskyed rdzogs sogs nyams su blangs pas phan yon ni bskal pa brgyar brjod kyang rdzogs pa'i yul las 'das/rje skal ldan rgya mtshos/ yul gyi dge sbyor brgya bas/ dben pa'i dge sbyor gcig dga'/ des na ri la song la/ gang nus dge la 'bod cig gsungs/ bla ma zhang rin po ches/ ri stong re phyin 212

tsam na bogs rgyang rgyang 'ong bar 'dug de yang mi'i rgyu 'grul med pa dang / gnas mtho ba rang bogs che ba 'dug ces dang /grong dang dgon par lor bsgom pa bas/ ri stong du zla gcig bogs che gsungs/ da mdor bsdu na/ dben pa'i gtam las/'du 'dzi'i gnas la sred pa ring spong la/ /srog bzhin du ni dben pa bsten par bya/ /don rnams nyung zhing bya ba shin tu nyung / /rig pa dwangs shing rnam rtog 'phro 'du nyung / /dben pa'i gnas su thos bsam sgom pa dang / /mdo 'don bzlas brjod 'grub pa'i brgya cha yang / /rnam rtog gis g.yeng don mang bya ba mang / /gnyid rmug gis non 'du 'dzi'i gnas dag tu/ /'grub mi srid cing 'du 'dzi'i gnas dag tu/ /rten gsum bzhengs dang sbyin gtong rgya chen sogs/ /bsod nams rgya chen dpag med 'grub gyur kyang / /thos bsam sgom pa mdo 'don bzlas brjod sogs/ /cung zad tsam gyi'ang bsod nams dper mi phod/ /rten gsum bzhengs dang sbyin gtong rgya chen la/ /gser dngul la sogs nor mang du ma dgos/ /so so'i skye bo'i 'bad rtsol ma bsten par/ /yin tsam gyis ni nor mang 'byung mi srid/ /nor phyir du ni 'bad rtsol bsten gyur na/ /dge rnams 'gag cing nyes skyon ngang gis 'go /rna ba bcad pas 213

'phongs kyi lhan pa ltar/ /nor mang sgrub nas sbyin pa gtong ba la/ /mkhas pa su zhig dga' ba bskyed par byed/ /rmig rjes chu dang rgya mtsho'i chu 'dra bar/ /sbyin dang tshul khrims bsod nams khyad par che/ /tshul khrims nyams len dben pa'i gnas dag tu/ /'grub 'gyur lta bur gzhan du 'grub mi srid/ /sbyin dang tshul khrims lam gyi mthun rkyen te/ /bsam gtan shes rab lam gyi dngos gzhi yin/ /'du 'dzi can la bsam gtan skal ba chad/ /khyad par 'di dag legs par rtogs gyur na/ /mkhas pa su zhig 'du 'dzi spang mi byed/ /gsungs/ des na rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis kyang ri khrod dben par 'dod chung chog shes kyi sgo nas chos sgrub pa la yid smon byed bzhin 'gro ba yang yin te/ slob dpon zhi ba lha'i zhal nas/ nags na ri dwags bya rnams dang / /shing dag mi snyan brjod mi byed/ /'grogs na bde ba de dag dang / /nam zhig lhan cig bdag gnas 'gyur/ /phug gam lha khang stong ba'am/ /ljon shing drung du gnas bcas te/ /nam zhig rgyab tu mi blta zhing / /chags pa med par 'gyur bzhin du/ /sa phyogs bdag gir bzung med pa/ /rang bzhin gyis ni yangs rnams su/ /rang dbang spyod cing chags med pa/ /nam zhig bdag ni gnas par 'gyur/ /lhung 214

bzed la sogs nyi tshe dang / /kun la mi mkho'i gos 'chang zhing / /lus 'di sba bar ma byas kyang / /'jigs med gnas pa nam zhig 'gyur/ /dur khrod song nas gzhan dag gis/ /rus kong dag dang bdag gi lus/ /'jig pa'i chos can dag tu ni/ /nam zhig mgo snyoms byed par 'gyur/ /gsungs/ gzhon nu ma bdun gyi rtogs brjod las/ skra rnams breg par gyur nas ni/ /phyag dar khrod kyi gos 'chang zhing / /dgon pa yul du 'dong bar ni/ /nam zhig de ltar 'gyur zhig gu /gnya' shing gang tsam rnam blta zhing / /sa yi lhung bzed lag thogs nas/ /dpyas med khyem nas khyim du ni/ /nam zhig slong mo spyod par 'gyur/ /rnyed dang bkur bste chags med cing / /nyon mongs tsher ma'i 'dam rdzab dag /spyod par byed cing grong khyer gyi/ /sbyin pa'i gnas su nam zhig 'gyur/ /rtsa yi tshogs las langs byas nas/ /ba mo'i lci ba'i gos dag dang / /zas skom ngan ngon tsam gyis ni/ /nam zhig lus la chags med 'gyur/ /shing drung ne tso ltar ljang ba'i/ /dur ba 'jam pa'i gos can du/ /mthong thos bde ba'i dga' ston du/ /nam zhig bdag ni nyal bar 'gyur/ /'dor bar 'gyur ba'i lus srog la/ /chu dang rtswa yi bsil ba ltar/ /ltos med yun ring goms pa yis/ /bde ba chen po nam 215

zhig thob/ /nam zhig chu ngogs sman ljongs su/ /gnas nas chu rlabs 'byung 'jug dang / /'tsho ba'i 'jig rten gnas 'dra bar/ /yang dang yang du blta bar 'gyur/ /lta ba kun gyi mar gyur pa'i/ /'jig tshogs lta ba 'byin pa dang / /srid pa'i longs spyod mi 'dod par/ /bdag ni nam zhig 'gyur zhig gu /rmi lam smig rgyu sgyu ma sprin/ /dri za'i grong khyer mtshungs par ni/ /rgyu dang mi rgyu'i 'jig rten dag /nam zhig rtogs par byed par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / ting 'dzin rgyal bo las/ gcig pur gnyis su med par nags gnas shing / /rtag tu bse ru lta bur 'tsho ba gtsang / /khor mor bya ba nyung zhing su dag ni/ /khe phyir tshul 'chos med la yi rang ngo / /zhes dang / rgyal bu gzhon nu snying stobs chen pos/ thub pas bsngags pa'i nags khrod dben pa 'dir/ /bdag ni mi 'jigs mya ngan ma mchis kyi/ /shin tu rgyal mchog don chen rnyed dam snyam/ /bdag gi snying 'di rab tu dga' bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs/ rje rin po che'i zhal nas/dmu rgod gdul dka'i sems can 'di rnams la/ /bshad pas phan thogs chen po ka la 'gyur/ /de bas sgrub pa lhur len dben pa bsten/ /rang gzhan gnyis ka 'tshengs pa'i lam rnyed snyam/ /gsungs/ rgyal ba bskal bzang rgya mtsho'i zhal nas/ yul 216

'dod yon 'ching bas ma bcings par/ /gnas nyams su dga' ba dben pa'i tshal/ /don bsam bsgom rnal 'byor lhur len pa/ /mi kho bo snying nas yid smon 'cha'/ /zhes dang / g.yag sde paṇa chen gyis/ nges med dben pa'i gnas su chags med rgyu/ /gsog 'jog spangs pa'i 'tsho ba gtsang la spyod/ /ri dwags spyod tshul 'di yis bdag yid 'phrog /ces dang / rje skal ldan rgya mtshos/ ri yid 'ong nyams dga' mthong ba'i tshe/ /bdag skal ldan dben pa'i nags tshal dran/ /bya sna tshogs skad snyan sgog thos tshe/ /bdag dben pa'i gnas la yid rab g.yos/ /shing sna tshogs sngo ljang 'dab rgyas tshe/ /bdag dben pa'i nags tshal dran zhing spro/ /rdza khra khra sdem pa mthong ba'i tshe/ /bdag de ru 'gro snyam 'dun pa shar/ /grogs bzang po 'ga' re ri na bzhugs/ /ri shin tu dben pa'i dga' tshal na/ /rang gcig pur drang srong spyod la gnas/ /'di bsam zhing bsam zhing smon pa skyes/ /bdag khrid 'bog bla ma yin na yang / /dus da dung sems dang khrid ma 'dres/ /da dben pa'i dga' tshal nyams dga' bar/ /sems khrid dang mja'/ bar byin gyis rlobs/ /gsungs/ gzhon nu blo gros kyis/ dad pa gzhon nus 'dab brgya'i tshal mthong ltar/ /dben pa'i gnas la kho bo yid rab 217

chags/ /thos pa'i chos rnams don yod bya ba'i phyir/ /gzhon nu blo gros dben pa'i nags su 'gro/ /gsungs/ 'ba' ra bas/tshogs gseb sdad na dred po'i rgyu/ /gcig pur bsdad na nyams rtogs 'phel/ /sprang po dben pa'i gnas su 'dong / /zhes dang /phal chen nas/ skyes bu chog shes rnams kyi gnas/ /rab tu bde ba dben pa'i yul/ /ji ltar sems ni dwangs gyur pa/ /de 'dra lha yi yul na'ang dkon/ /dbang po'i spyod yul phun tshogs la/ /sems kyi dga' ba kun tshogs pa'i/ /longs spyod su 'dod grogs po dag /ri khrod dben par 'deng ngo gshegs/ /gsungs/ sngon rgya gar gyi rgyal po zhig gi mnga' 'og na rgyal phran khri khrag yod pa zhig la/ /sras khye'u gang ga ma zhes bya ba zhig yod pa de/ 'du 'dzi'i skyon la yid sun dben pa'i yon tan gyis yid 'phrog nas rgyal srid spangs nas/ nags khrod nyams dga' zhig tu phebs nas/ yul phyogs de na rgyal bu kun tu dge zhes bya ba gcig yod pa de 'bod du song / khyim bzang dpal dang 'dra ba bor nas ni/ /nags khrod shin tu dben pa'i gnas bsten pa/ /bdud kyis bslus sam yang na spyos par nges/ /shin tu 'khrul bas bdag la tshur gson dang / /rgyal po'i srid bzung chos kyang khyim na spyod/ /spras pas/ lan du 218

khye'u'i zhal nas/ khyed kyis gsungs pa'i tshig rnams ni/ /byams nas gsungs pa yin mod kyang / /bdag gi don dang shin tu 'gal/ /nags khrod dben par gnas mthong na/ /'khor mang rgyal po'i pho brang dag /grog tshang hrul po dag dang mtshungs/ /gsungs/ yang / rgyal srid 'dzin par mi byed kyang / /khyim du sdod la chos gyis shig /smras/ lan du/ khyim gyi so nam bya ba la/ /snga ma byas pas nyon mongs nas/ /phyi ma byed pas sha thang chad/ /khyim ni sbrul gyi tshang dang 'dra/ /gsungs/yang / 'khor 'dab brten la bde bar mnos/ /nor rdzas zungs la sbyin pa thongs/ /smras/ lan du/ gser gyi ri la g.yu yi khron rdol yang / /nor gyi 'os su rang sems chog shes bzang / /dpal gyi ri la sred kyi chu 'brub kyang / /sems kyi rten sa bla ma dkon mchog bzang / /gsungs pas/ rgyal po ngo mtshar skyes/ rgyal srid spangs nas gnyis ka nags khrod der gnas gsungs/ spyir 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs/ khyad par 'dod yon dkor gyi nyes dmigs bsam na/ grong du 'dug pa'i skya ser pho mo'i thad tsho na/ bya btang ri khrod la gnas pa'i mi de skyon zad yon tan kun ldan sangs rgyas dang mtshungs te/spyan snga bas/ dben par rtse gcig brten pa'i mi dag la/ /219

byis dang 'grogs pa'i nyes skyon nam yang med/ /'du 'dzir gnas pa'i nyes dmigs la bltas na/ /sangs rgyas mngon sum yin no shākya'i sras/ /gsungs pas/ des na rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa'i smon gnas yid 'ong ri khrod dben pa'i dga' tshal du 'dug rgyu'i skal ba byung ba a re dga' snyam du/ ji srid 'tsho yi bar du srog gi phyir yang mi gtong dgos te/ 'phags pa chos bzhi pa'i mdo las/ dge slong dag byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos ji srid 'tsho'i bar du dgon pa la gnas pa srog gi phyir yang mi gtong ngo / /zhes gsungs/dben par bsdad dus grong du 'gro 'dod skyes tshe chos kyi bar chad byung bar bsam dgos te/ bla ma zhang rin po che'i zhal nas/ g.ya' spang mtshams 'dir phyin phyin nas/ /da rung grong du 'bab snyam zhing / /da rung 'du 'dzi bsten snyam na/ /dam sri snying du zhugs pa yin/ /bdud kyi mthu yis rlabs pa yin/ /grong gi 'dre mos 'khyer ba yin/ /the'u rang dmag gis tshugs pa yin/ /rgyal 'gong bar chad byung ba yin/ /mkha' 'gro'i bka' chad byung ba yin/ /gdon gyi dbang du song ba yin/ /zhes gsungs/ rgyal sras rnams kyi smon gnas yon tan du ma'i 'byung gnas/ dben pa'i ri khrod blos btang nas/220

rgyal sras rnams kyis smad pa'i gnas nyes skyon du ma'i 'byung gnas/ grong yul du rgyug pa/ khri snyan sa le sogs ri dwags glen pa kha cig rngon pa'i glu la nyan du rgyug pa dang mtshungs te/ sa mtsho sbyin gyis/ ma rgad sngon po dang 'dra ne'u sing tshogs dag gi /shing rtsa nye bar bkod dang yal ga me tog gis bskor ba'i/ /zhi ba'i nags mtha' kye ma'o dge sbyong mchog gis spong byed pa/ /bsad phyir rngon pa'i glu yis drangs par 'gyur ba'i ri dwags mtshungs gsungs/ gal te dgos pa chen po yod nas 'gro dgos byung na yang myur du ldog dgos te/ khyim bdag drag shul can gyis zhus pa'i mdo las/ khyim bdag gal te byang chub sems dpa' dgon ba pa/ chos nyan par 'dod dam/ mkhan po dang / slob dpon la blta bar 'dod nas nad dri ba'i phyir grong gi gnas su song na/ de'i dgongs su slar ldog par bya/zhes dang / rig 'dzin gang shar rang grol gyis/ khyem pa'i nang du yun ring na/ /rang gi rnam thar rang gis ston/ /de bas yun ring ma 'dug par/ /dben pa'i gnas su 'jug cig ang / /zhes dang / bla ma zhang rin po ches/ bya ba btang yang ri khrod la sogs par dgon par sdod mi nus par grong thams cad na yu ru ru byas nas nga bsod snyoms byed/ sgom rgyags tshol ba yin 221

zer sdod ma zug pa'i snyad kha re mang na/ de bas ri khrod la sogs par song zhig gsungs/ des na grong yul gyi nyes dmigs dang / dben pa'i yon tan bsam nas/ dus rtag tu ri khrod dben par ri dwags bzhin gcig pur bsdad/ rgas kyin ri khrod je mthor gtong dgos te/ rgyal ba rgod tshang bas/kho bo rgyal khams sprang po 'di/ /gong ma'i gdan sa bzung ba dang / /sgrub brgyud bstan pa dar ba'i phyir/ /rgas kyin ri khrod je mthor 'gro/ /tshe 'di'i rtod phur gtong ba dang / /'dod yon tshwa chu 'bo ba dang / /chos brgyad rlung la bskur ba'i phyir/ /rgas kyin ri khrod je mthor 'gro/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho bsgral gyur nas/ /thar pa'i skam sar sleb pa dang / /bde chen khang bzang bzung ba'i phyir/ /rgas kyin ri khrod je mthor 'gro/ /zhes dang /klong chen rab 'byams pas/ rgas kyin ri khrod je mthor thongs/ /skal ldan kun kyang de bzhin mdzod/ /ri khrod dben par bsgom du gshegs/ /bde skyid ri khrod gnas na yod/ /gsungs/ rgas kyin ri khrod je mthor btang nas sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan bzung na seng ge dkar mo lta bu'i sgom chen rab yin te/ sa skya paṇa chen rin po ches/ lta ba spros bral rnam dag shugs 'chang lus/ /yengs med bsgom pa rnam dag 222

yan lag ldan/ /spyod pa rnam dag g.yu yi ral pa can/ /seng ge gangs la gnas pa'i sgom chen yin/ /'gro don dpag med go cha rab bgos te/ /tshogs gnyis rta zhon brtson pa'i lcag gis bskul/ /shes rab mtshon gyis nyon mongs dgra tshogs 'joms/ /dpa' bo g.yul du zhugs pa'i sgom chen yin/ /dri med bslab gsum rin chen bang mdzod ldan/ /'gro la zang zing mi 'jigs sbyin gtong mdzad/ /dam chos sbyin pas thar lam 'jug byed pa/ /bsdu bzhi gzhan don mdzad pa'i sgom chen yin/ /de ltar sgom chen rab gsum bstan pa yin/ /zhes gsungs/ dben par sdod mi tshugs par grong yul du song nas/tshe 'di'i bya ba spro bzhin byed pa 'di sngon las ngan pa'i 'bras bu yin te/ rje btsun ye shes rgyal mtshan gyi zhal nas/ skye bo phal cher las ngan pa'i dbang gis/ dben pa'i gnas su gcig pur sgrub pa la sbyar na/ btson du bzung ba lta bur mthong nas/ sdug bsngal ba dang yid mi bde ba kho na byed cing /so nam dang dgra 'dul ba dang / gnyen skyong ba dang / tshong dang / bun skyed dang / mkhar las sogs byed pa la/ nyin mtshan kun tu dka' ba ci yod kyang de la sdug bsngal ba dang yid mi bde ba med par/ dga' zhing spro bar byed gzhan rnams 223

lta ci smos/ tshe stod la thos pa yun ring du byas shing / chos sgor zhugs nas lang tsho phal cher yol ba'i rgan po dag kyang / tshe 'di'i bya ba re la ngal ba ci byed dgos kyang bzod pa dang / skyo ngal med cing / dben par zla re tsam sgrub pa la bskul yang /mi bzod sdug bsngal ches cher byed pa kun gyi mig la snang ba 'di ltar yin pas/ las ngan pa'i 'bras bus bcom par gdon mi za'o/ /zhes gsungs/ des na sngon las kyi dbang du mi gtong ba gal che/ yang ri khrod dben par bsdad nas bsgom byed dus rang rgyud ma smin gzhan la smin byed kyi dbang bskur ba dang / rang ma grol bar gzhan la grol byed kyi 'khrid 'debs pa dang / don med dpe cha blta ba/ 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum/ nyams dbyangs len pa sogs spong ba shin tu gal che ste/spyan snga bas/ dge bshes sam sgom chen pa su yin yang / yon tan cung drag tu song ba na/ chos bshad byed 'dod 'dis brlag bcug pa phal cher la 'ong bar snang gsungs/ 'gro mgon gyi zhal nas/ 'o skol sgom chen pa rnams kyi dbang du byas na/ dug po btsem ber re gyon/ a ru ra'i phreng ba thogs/sgom khang bye'u'i rjes bkra lam me sgom du yod pa'i dus su/ mi phan nges pa'i btsun chung rnams la chos bshad byed pa 'di 224

yang / dge bshes pa dgyer sgom chen po gsungs te/ nga ni de yang smyo ba yin nam snyam gsungs/ gtsang pa rgya ras kyi zhal nas/ sa bon ma btab par ston thog re ba ltogs 'gong yin/dus la ma bab bar 'gro don re ba 'o brgyal ba yin gsungs/po to ba'i gsungs las/ de ltar rang rgyud yongs su smin pa/las dang po yis gtso bo de bya/ gzhan don gtso bor bya bar ma gnang / sems kyis sems can don las gzhan med/ lus dang ngag gi dngos su mi 'jug ces dang / 'dod pa'i rta kha khyer ba'i mi shes dran dran bzlo/ /long bas long ba 'khrid pas mnyam por g.yang la lhung / /gsungs/ khro los/ gtan gyi rang 'gros ma shes na/ /ji tsam gzhan gyi dpon bcol yang / /don la gla med kyi 'khol po yin/ /ming stong skam po 'di a tsa ma /gsungs/ kun mkhyen chen po'i zhal nas/ deng sang dus ngan skye bo mi bsrun pas/ /dben par rang don sgrub pa shin tu gces/ /'dab gshog ma rdzogs 'phur bar mi nus ltar/ /mngon shes mi ldan gzhan don mi nus pas/ /rang don lhur blangs yid kyis gzhan phan bsam/ /rnam g.yeng 'du 'dzi bdud kyi bslu brid 'dis/ /rang sems ma bslus sgrub la 'bad pa gces/ /zhes dang / snying gtam bdun cu pa las/ slob ma 225

gcig yod sdug bsngal du ma yod/ /slob ma brgya yod sdug bsngal brgya phrag yod/ /sdug bsngal mi 'dod bde ba 'dod bzhin du/ /blang dor log par ma sgrub shākya'i sras/ /ja sogs lhag tshos sdug bsngal kho na yin/ /med du mi rung tsam pa kho na ste/ /tsam pa breng tsam ci ltar byas kyang phyid/ /gdul bya sdud la ma dga' shākya'i sras/ /gsungs/ jo bo rjes/ rang rgyud ma thul bar du gzhan rgyud mi thul bas na thog mar rang rgyud thul/ /mngon shes med par gzhan dag smin par mi nus pas na sgrub la brtson par mdzod gsungs/ gang shar rang grol gyis/ 'gro don gyi mchog ste nyin re bzhin/ /sems can la dmigs pa'i dge sbyor yin/ /rang sems la brtan pa ma thob par/ /don med kyi tsab tsub ma byed ang / /gsungs/ rje skal ldan rgya mtshos/ dbang zab mo rjes gnang la sogs pa/ /dus deng sang nor gyi rin du 'jal/ /tshul 'dis kyang dben pa'i gnas mchog tu/ /rje gong ma'i rnam thar skyong du 'gro/ /chos kun gye snying bo zab 'khrid rnams/ /dus deng sang kha bshad tsam du byed/ /tshul 'dis kyang dben pa'i gnas mchog tu/ /rje gong ma'i rnam thar skyong du 'gro/ /gsungs/ rig 'dzin dpal ldan bkra shis kyis/ mi gzhan la dam chos 'chad 'chad nas/ /tshur 226

rang la nyams len med pa de/ /dpe mdze bos khyung sgrub bshad pa dang / /khyad e 'dug soms dang sdom brtson pa/ /gsungs/rje re mda' ba'i zhal nas/ thos pa'i gting dpog nas tshe blos btang gi sgrub pa snying por byed pa las lhag pa'i rgyal ba sras bcas mnyes par byed pa'i mchod pa gzhan na med/ de'i thad na deng sang gi 'chad nyan 'dra ba gzhan don ltar snang yin/rnyed bkur sbud byed kyi thabs dbang bskur lung khrid sogs 'khor sdud pa'i thabs/ gzhan don ltar snang rnams la snying po med gsungs/ yang / chos brgyad rkyen gyis nam yang mi g.yo ba'i/ /sems la brtan pa ji srid ma thob par/ /gcig tu rang rgyud 'dul ba ma gtogs par/ /gzhan don thabs kyis rang don nyams mi bgyid/ /gsungs/ chos rje bus/ 'das pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis ma thul zhing / /mthu chen rgyal sras rnams kyis ma thul ba/ /smad na khong khro bstod na dregs pa skye/ /mtho la phrag dog mnyam la 'gran sems can/ /dma' la nga rgyal rtsub pa'i sems 'chang ba/ /chos mthun tshig gis smras kyang chags sdang byed/ /byes pa'i skye bo 'di 'dra bdag gis ni/ /da lta 'dul bar mi nus rang sems thul/ /gzhan don chos kyi gtso bor gsungs pa yang / /gdul bya'i dbang po khams dang 227

bag la nyal/ /tshogs dang sngon dang phyi ma'i mtha' shes kyang / /rang don ma chags gdul bya 'dul la dgongs/ /rang nyid rnyed grags bde 'dod don gnyer bar/ /mngon shes med par gzhan don byed pa ni/ /gshog pa med pas mkha' la 'phur ba bzhin/ /gzhan don mi 'grub rang don nyams pa'i rgyu/ /bshad nyan bstan pa 'dzin par gsungs pa yang / /nges 'byung rnam dag khrims la brten byas nas/ /nyan po sa/zur gnas don gnyer blo ldan la/ /mkhas pas sde snod 'chad la dgongs pa yin/ /tshe 'di'i rnyed grags 'dod pa'i 'khor sdud de/ /ma dad mi 'dod bzhin du chos 'chad cing / /nyams len mi byed chags sdang bskyed pa'i rgyu/ /'chad nyan 'di yang 'khor ba'i zhags pa yin/ /zhes gsungs/ stong gsum lha chos kyis gang ba'i gtsug lag khang du byas pa bas/ tshig bzhi pa tsam 'dzin pa bsod nams che ba dang / 'dzam gling thos bsam byed pas gang ba bas/ nang du yang dag 'jog pa la brtson pa gcig phul du byung zhes lhag bsam bskul ba'i mdo las gsungs/stong gsum sems can dge ba bcu sogs bkod pa'i bshad nyan bskal par byas pa bas/ byang chub sems gnyis la sogs la bsam gtan skad cig tsam byed pa bsod nams che bar 228

mdo sde du mar gsungs/ bskal pa bcur bshad pa bas/ se gol gtogs pa tsam sgom na bsod nams che bar yab sras mjal bar gsungs/ slob dpon dpa' bo'i zhal nas/ 'ga' zhig rang nyid ma dul bar ni rig par ldan pa'i tshig smra yang / /rang gi tshig dang 'gal bar spyod pas gzhan dag 'dul bar mi nus zhes/ /khyed kyis dgongs te de slad 'gro ba mtha' dag thugs la bzhag mdzad nas/ /re zhig rang nyid ma dul ba nyid dul bar mdzad phyir brtson pa lags/ /zhes gsungs/ dkon mchog brtsegs pa las/ ma brgal pas ni bsgral mi nus/ /ma grol bas ni sgol mi nus/ /long pas lam yang ston mi nus/ /grol bas sgol bar byed par nus/ /mig ldan long la lam ston nus/ /zhes dang / lhag bsam bskul ba las/ bdag ni sgrub nyams da ni ci bya zhes/ /'chi ba'i dus tshe byis pa mya ngan byed/ /gting rnyed ma gyur shin tu sdug bsngal 'gyur/ /smra la dga' ba'i nyes pa 'di dag go /zhes dang / yun ring dus nas smra la dga' bas na/ /des ni bdag nyid dag pa mi thob bo/ /tshig gang dga' ba mtha' yas thob 'gyur ba/ /tshig gcig tsam zhig bsam kyang mchog yin no/ /gsungs/ rje btsun bsod nams seng ges/ dbul phongs rnams la khral 229

chen bsdus nas ni/ /rten chen bzhengs dang yo langs 'gyed la sogs/ /de la brten nas gzhan sdig gsog pa'i rgyu/ /rang sems dge ba kho bo'i snying gtam yin/ /gsungs/ rtse gcig bsgom tshe sems la go sdur dang / /bstan bcos rtsom dang nyams dbyangs len pa sogs/ /rtsal snang yin yang rnam rtog 'phel ba'i rgyu/ /blo bral skyong ba kho bo'i snying gtam yin/ /gsungs/ dang po'i blo sbyong yid bzhin nor bu las/ blo ma sbyang ring la/ dka' bcu 'dzin pa'ang spyo ba rang song pas phug bshad nyan byed 'dod na'ang re zhig la dben pa bsten nas blo sbyangs na de rting phan 'dogs gzhan dang mi 'dra ba/ sngar gye sgrub brgyud kyi bla ma rnams dang / mtshan nyid pa'i slob dpon rnams la khyad ci 'dug bltas pas kyang shes te/ mtshan nyid pa'i slob dpon bzang bor the ba zhig yin na'ang / kho rang 'das nas ming tshun chad nub nas rjes med pa zhig 'ong /sgrub brgyud kyi bla ma bzang bar the na'ang / de'i mtshan bskal par yang mi nub cing / thams cad kyis kyang phyag mchod kyi yul du byed pa re 'ong gin snang / khong gnyis phan thogs kyang 'dzol te/ mtshan nyid pa des dge bshes brgya tham pa thon pa bas/ gzhan des tshe blos btang gi sgrub pa po gcig thon pa 230

phun sum tshogs gsungs/ rje rgod tshang pas/ tshe thung ba zas nor med pa 'khor ngan pa sogs phun sum ma 'tshogs pa'i 'gro don las/ 'gro don gyi sa bon ma rlag pa la brten nas sgrub pa byas na khebs che/ lam du ma slong na rang gzhan gnyis ka phung bas/ de las bar chad che ba med/ de tsam ring mi dgos sgrub nga/ nan tan bskyed gsungs/ slob dpon chung ngu ma byed snyigs ma'i dus su 'gro don chos pa thams cad spyi bor 'khur nas rang gis 'gro don ma byas par sgrub pa tshul bzhin byas na 'gro don che gsungs/ yang / 'gro don che chung gi go ba ni/ 'khor gcig las ma byung yang gcig de smin cing grol na phan 'dogs che ba yin/ gcig pu des nam zhig sems can smin grol la 'god pa cig 'ong / zang zing las 'brel gyi 'khor mang yang phan thogs che rgyu med gsungs/ dper na sman gyi sdong po rgyas rag bar du gzhan la mi ster bar rtag tu bsrung nas yar rgyas pa'i thabs la 'bad dgos pa ltar/ rang rgyud la lung rtogs kyi yon tan thams cad rgyas rag gi bar du lus ngag gis dngos su gzhan don byed pa'i bsam sbyor thams cad bor nas/ de'i bar la bdag pas gzhan gces kyi blos dman pa'i sa bzung hrul bo'i gos gyon gyong lto gos gtam gsum la 231

btang nas mi med pa'i gangs dang ri sul rnams su/ zab mo'i sgrub la gzhol na 'gro don de ka rang yin te/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'brom ston rin po che la/ sku mched gsum gyis/ dben par nyams su len pa dang / sems can la chos kyis phan 'dogs pa gnyis khebs gang che lags zhus pas/ ston pa'i zhal nas/ rang rgyud la nyams rtogs ci yang med pa'i las dang po pa'i gang zag gis sems can la chos kyi phan btags kyang mi thogs te/ byen rlabs snod stong pa byo ba dang 'dra ste/ byen rlabs la 'ong rgyu med/ gdams ngag sbang ma ma mnan par bsings pa'i chang dang 'dra ste/ gdams ngag la ro bcud med/drod thob la brtan pa ma thob pa'i mos pas spyod pa'i gang zag gis sems can gyi don byar mi btub ste/ byin rlabs bum pa gang byo dang 'dra ste gzhan gang tsam na rang nyid stong bar 'gyur/ gdams ngag sgon me lag brgyud dang 'dra ste/ gzhan gsal tsam na rang nyid 'grib par 'gyur/ sa thob nas ma sems can gyi don 'grub tshad bya ba yin te/ byen rlabs bum pa bzang po'i dngos grub dang 'dra/ 4 gzhan thams cad smin par byas kyang rang la gang stong med/ gdams ngag mar me'i gzhi ma dang 'dra ste/ gzhan gsal bar byas kyang rang la 'grib 232

pa med pa yin/ des na da lta snyigs ma'i dus 'dir so so'i skye bos dben par byams pa dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems la blo goms par bya ba ma yin par sems can la dngos su phan gdags pa'i dus ma yin/ rang rgyud kyi nyon mongs pa bsrung ba'i dus yin/ dper na sman chen po'i ljon shing gi myu gu de bcad pa'i dus ma yin bsrung ba'i dus yin gsungs/ rje btsun mi la rin po che la/ bu slob ras pa rnams kyis/ gzhan don du 'gyur na spros bcud zad bgyid na chog lags sam zhus pas/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ rang 'dod kyi 'khri ba ye med na chog ste/ de ka dka' mo yin rang gis tshe 'di'i 'dod pa dang ldan pas/ 'gro don byed pa des gzhan don dag lta ci smos te/ rang don yang mi 'grub/ stobs med chus 'khyer bar chus 'khyer gzhan sgol zer ba dang 'dra bas/ gnas lugs ma rtogs kyi bar du gzhan don la ma rings long bas long ba 'khrid pa dang 'dra zhing / rang don du shor nyen yod do/ /nam mkha' ma zad bar du sems can la zad pa med pas nyams len nus na 'gro don byas chog pas dus gcig 'ong gis/ de bar khyed rang rnams bsam pa bdag pas gzhan gces sems can thams cad kyi don sangs rgyas thob 'dod kyis/ sbyor ba 233

dman pa'i sa bzung / hrul bo'i gos gyon/ gyong lto gos gtam gsum la thongs/ lus la bab bskur/ sems la 'khur bskur la nyams su long zhig sems can gyi don de ka yin no gsungs/khyad par snyan grags dang sku bsod rgyas tshe dben pa'i ri khrod dor/ grong gi thag nye zhig nas dgon gzhi zhig 'dzin pa byang chub sgrub pa'i lam gyi bar chad bdud yin pas ngo shes pa gal che/ rje rgod tshang pas/ tshe blos btang nas grub thob cig byed pa yin/ 'khor ba ma stongs bar du gzhi dgon gyi bdag 'dzin mi byed/ so nam mi byed gsungs/ yang bsod nams kyis ci byed chos zhe nas byed na 'tsho ba bsod snyoms byas kyang chog yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis dgos 'dod thams cad sgo rtsar 'ong bar mkhyen nas ma mdzad par bsod snyoms mdzad pa lags mod/ dgon chung 'dzin pa kun bdud kyis 'khyer ba yin gsungs/ bka' gdams bla ma 'ga' res/ snyigs ma'i dus su dgon pa zhig btab pa las/ gang zag gcig gi rgyud la phan btags pa bsod nams che gsungs/ rje mi las/ grong ltag gi dgon chung khra bo de/ /ming dgon par btags kyang grong ba yin/ /gsungs pa cha gcig na thugs mad de/ deng sang dgon pa btab pa phal cher gyi chags sdang sogs la ltos 234

dang ha go yong / yang gter ston 'ga' res lung bstan na/snyigs ma'i dus su bla ma res bdag tu bzung ba'i dgon pa re btab/ dgon pa re bdag tu bzung ba'i sbyin bdag re btsal/dgon pa gnyis res sbyin bdag re res brtsad nas bsam ngan sbyor rtsub mthu gtad 'khon 'dzing sogs byas bstan pa bshig skad/ de yang thugs mad par gda'/ deng sang dgon gnyis re rgyab 'gre rgyab nas mi bsad rta ded zer ba mthong thos yod la/ de la dogs nas rje mi las bdag tu bzung ba'i dgon pa ma 'debs gsungs/ spyan snga bas/ chos dang 'jig rten gnyis ka med/ /'og nas 'og tu lhung srid pas/ /dgon gog chags zhen dgra ltar bltas gsungs/ gang shar rang grol gyis/ dgon gnas grwa tshang la chags pa'i bla ma yi tshogs rnams/ /tshe mjug don med du zad tshe gang 'dra rang mdzad dam/gsungs/ rje skal ldan rgya mtshos/ sngon rgyal pos bskyong tshe grwa tshang btsugs/ /da pe har dgyes thabs mi byed par/ /khong sangs rgyas byang sems mnyes phyir du/ /bdag 'di ru mi sdod ri la 'gro/ /gsungs/ bka' gdams gsung bgros thor bu las/ ri khrod dgon pa mi 'grims par/ /'khor ba'i mun khang brtsigs pa 'di yang 'khrul/ /gsungs/ des na thugs bsam 235

zhib tu gtong dgos te/ gang shar rang grol gyis/ phyogs med rgyal khams yangs pa'i sa phyogs su/ /ltos med slong zhing rang rgyud mi 'dul bar/ /skyid med dgon chung re la zhen nas sdod/ /snying med po tsho da ni mno bsam thongs/ /gsungs/ ngas bsam na/ deng sang bla ma 'ga' res dang po dgon pa 'debs rgyu yin zer/ mi phyugs mang pos sa rdo shing mang po blangs/ bran g.yogs mang po ngal du bcug khal rta mang po rgal rma bton/ srin 'bu mang po bcur/ bar du dgon pa skyong rgyu yin zer/ mi rta mang po bcas/ yon bdag mang po'i sgor song / dkor mang po bsdus 'ong / mthar 'gyed phogs mang po brgyab kyang / bla ma la bsten nas grwa ba mang pos ngan smras mang po byas/ dmyal bar 'gro ba mang po snang / deng sang snyigs ma'i dus 'dir bde skyid snyan gsum 'dod nas dgon pa rtsig pa sdig sdug gtam ngan gsum gyi gzhi ma chung ma bdud mo zhig blangs pa las kyang thu/ dgon ngan gyi phar re tshur rer ma sbyin len mi chos bla ma'i dzun sogs smras/ rtsa ba bzhi'i sdom pa yan chad shor nas/ mthar thug gi thob bya sdig sdug gtam ngan gsum ma gtogs 'di phyir skyid ma mchis par gda'/des na dgon khog ma bzung bar spangs na skyid che ste/ skyid 236

pa'i rgyangs glu las/ bdag 'dzin dgon pa ni mi 'dug /dngos po'i gsog bsrung ni mi snang / /mi ngan ngo srung dang bral ba'i/ /kun spangs blo bde tsho skyid pa/ /gsungs/ gsung 'di shes na 'o skol rnams la dam pa gong mas snying gtam smras pa yin te/ rje bsod nams seng ges/ sna tshogs thabs kyis 'khor mang bsdus nas ni/ /mthun rkyen 'dzoms pa'i dgon gzhis 'dzin pa yang / /rtsod pa'i gzhi dang bdag sems zhen pa'i rgyu/ /gcig pur sdod pa kho bo'i snying gtam yin/ /gsungs/ sngon yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nas bzung dam pa gong ma thams cad kyi rnam thar dang zhal gsung 'khrul med yin pas gdams pa'i mchog yin te/ sngon sangs rgyas kyi dgon pa tsha khang tsam zhig kyang ma rtsig par sku tshe gang po gnas shing drung sogs byas/ 'tsho ba bsod snyoms byas pa yin la/ de khong gis ma 'dzoms pa dang ma mkhyen pa ma yin te/rjes 'jug 'o skol rnams kyis khong gi lad mo byas/ gzhis dgon bdag tu bzung chags sdang byas/ nyes skyon gyis gos par mkhyen nas/ de la phan par dgongs nas mdzad pa de 'dra gnang ba yin pas bka' drin che la/ sngon gyi skyes chen dam pa rnams kyi mdzad pa yang 'o skol rjes 'jug rnams la phan par 237

dgongs nas de slad du byas pa yin pas bka' drin che ste/ rje rgod tshang pas/ ngas lus longs spyod gzhi dgon yon bdag la sogs pa bdag 'dzin mi byed pa 'di/ khyed slob bu rnams la drin che ba yin/ nga la gang shar chos skur 'char ba 'dug ste/tshe gang sgrub pa byed pa khyed tsho'i don yin gsungs/ 'o skol rnams la yang sangs rgyas thugs rje can khong gi rnam thar 'di ltar gnas shing drung pa/ zas bsod snyoms pa gyis gsungs pa ma gtogs/ rjes 'jug rnams kyis khong gis 'di ltar byas na mi yong / gzhi dgon rgyob rgyu nom mang po bsdus dang / rang gzhan bstan 'gro'i don yong zhes nam yang ma gsungs/ des na dgon pa'i bsil grib tu zas bsod snyoms la brten nas lha chos rnam dag byed dgos te/ klong chen rab 'byams pas/mang po'i nang du 'du 'dzis g.yeng / /sde dgon yin yang phan pa med/ /phyogs ris chags sdang zag pa 'phel/ /ri khrod dben pa 'grim du gshegs/ /gsungs/ bla ma zhang gis/ lar sgom chen gsha' ma cig byed na grong ltag gi dgon pa dkar khra shig ge ba zhig la blo rtse gtad pas mi yong / ri khrod du ri dwags bzhin du sdod dgos pa yin gsungs/ de ltar byas na bstan pa bzung 'gro don byas pa yin pas de lugs gyis dang 238

bzang / yang bya btang ri khrod pa la gtad pa bzhi dgos/ blo phugs chos la gtad/ chos phugs sprang la gtad/ sprang phugs shi la gtad/ shi phugs brag la gtad/ 'di la gtad pa bzhi zer/ yang bya btang ri khrod pas bud snyegs thob gsum byed dgos/ mi gral nas bud/ khye gral snyegs/ lha gral thob/ 'di la bud snyegs thob gsum zer/ khyi gral zer ba de dman sa 'dzin pa la zer/ bya btang ri khrod pa la rdo rje gsum dgos/thebs med rdo rje sngon la btang / khrel med rdo rje rjes la 'jogaye shes rdo rje rang dang 'grogs/ 'di la rdo rje gsum zer/thebs med rdo rje ni/ tshe blos btang nas dben par sgrub pa byed dus pha ma gnyen bshes gang gis bshol ci btab kyang bshol mi thebs shing / phyi thebs ye med pa ltar byed pa thebs med rdo rje de sngon du gtong dgos/ khrel med rdo rje ni tshe 'di'i pha ma gnyen bshes rnams ma bskyangs na rjes kye mi rnams kyis nga la khrel gzhung ngo tsha med gi e zer snyam 'dzem pa cung zad mi byed par ci bshad dang bshad gi chug ces 'jig rten 'di'i ngos nas khrel med byed pa khrel med rdo rje de rjes la 'jog dgos/ ye shes rdo rje ni/ chos ma gtogs bya ba gzhan spangs nas byar med bya snyam pa/ gzung 'dzin thams cad 239

spangs nas 'dzin med bya snyam pa/ bya ba gzhan bya long med de lta yin yang 'chi snyam pa gsum yid la bcangs pa ye shes rdo rje de rang dang 'bral med du 'grogs dgos zer ba red/ gtad pa bzhi bud snyegs thob gsum dang bcu po 'di la dam pa gong ma 'ga' res phugs nor bcu yang zer/ nor 'di bcu po yod pa'i bya btang ri khrod pas 'jig rten gyi 'khrul ba 'joms/ chags zhen gyi rgya mtsho skam/ chos brgyad kyi ri bo bsnyil/ nyon mongs kyi rdzong 'gyel/ las ngan gyi gru 'jogaganyen po'i thang bde ba la slebs zhes spyan snga bas gsungs/ bla ma dbu ma pa'i zhal nas/ thebs med rdo rje sngon la btang / /khrel med rdo rje rjes la 'jog /ye shes rdo rje rang dang 'grogs/ /thar 'dod blo phugs chos la gtad/ /chos phugs rgyal khams sprang la gtad/ /sprang phugs ltogs grir 'chi la gtad/ /'chi phugs grog phug cig la gtad/ /rdo rje gsum dang gtad pa bzhi//'di bdun nga yi phugs nor yin/ /'jig rten bya btang mdun ma'i yang rtse yin/ /gnas gzhi grwa sar chags pa'i sgom chen gol/ /snying nas blo phugs chos la gtod pa rnams/ /nges med dben pa'i ri khrod 'grims pa gces/ /gsungs/ yang bya btang ri khrod pa 'phags pa'i rigs bzhir 240

gnas dgos te/ /gos ngan ngon tsam gyes chog pa dang /bsod snyoms ngan ngon tsam gyis chog pa dang / mal cha ngan ngon tsam gyis chog pa dang / na ba'i gso sman sogs mkho ba'i yo byad ngan ngon gyis chog shes pa la/ 'phags pa'i rigs bzhi zer te/ snying rje pad dkar du/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa'i rigs bzhi la nges par gnas pa yin te/ bzhi gang zhe na/ 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gos ngan ngon tsam gyis dga' zhing chog shes pa/gos ngan ngon tsam gyis chog shes pa'i bsngags pa brjod par byed cing / des gos kyi phyir tshul dang mi mthun pas 'tshol bar mi byed la/ gos ma rnyed na yongs su gdung ba med cing /gos rnyed na yang chags pa med pa dang / zhen pa med pa dang /mkhren pa med pa dang / mdud pa bor ba med pa dang / brgyal ba med pa dang / chags pa med pa dang / lhag par chags par 'gyur ba med par longs spyod cing / nyes dmigs su blta la/nges par 'byung bar rab tu shes shing yongs su spyod par byed pa ste/ de ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa'i rigs bzhi la gnas pa'i dang po yin te/ gos la ji lta ba bzhin du bsod snyoms dang / mal cha na ba'i gso sman 241

la yang sngar ltar sbyar nas gsungs/ des pas zhus pa'i mdo las/ rgyal po chen po byang chub sems dpa' bdag nyid kyang 'dod pa spong bar 'gyur zhing / gzhan yang 'dod pa'i sems bskyed par mi 'gyur ba de lta bu'i gos bcing bar bgyi'o/ /zhes gsungs shin tu dbul ba'i cha byad kho nas sems can 'dul bar gsungs/ rje spyan snga bas/ de ltar zas sogs la chags pa/ /nyes skyon ma lus kun gyi gzhi/ /ngan ngon tsam gyis chog shes pa/ /phan bde kun gyi gzhir gzigs nas/ /khams gsum chos kyi rgyal pos kyang / /lo drug bar du dka' thub spyad/ /bran mo'i ro gos gsol tshul bstan/ /rjes 'jug slob ma'i tshogs la yang / /gnas mal shing drung tsam dag dang / /gos ni phyag dar khrod pa ste/ /zas ni bsod snyoms las byung dang / /bkus te bor ba'i sman tsam dang / /chog shes dam bca' gyis zhes gsungs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bcom ldan 'das kyis rnam pa thams cad du zas gos nyung ngu dang ngan pas lus 'tsho bar byed pas dgang sla ba dang / rang gcig pu ma gtogs gzhan 'khor g.yog kyang sbyin bdag sogs kyis gso dgos pas gso dka' ba med pas/ gso sla ba dang ldan par bya dgos par gsungs pa go dgos/ lag len la yang 242

'debs dgos kyang / deng sang 'ga' res/ ngas ri khrod dben pa zhig nas khong rnams bzhin dge sbyor byas na 'dod de/ mthun rkyen mi 'grig gi zer sdug gtam mang po bshad pa mang / khyod la ci ma 'grig dris na/ rgyal ba sras bcas kyis smad pa'i gnas/ ja mar/ snam ras sogs/ zas gos bzang po mang po zhig ma 'grig zer/ tsam pa sngo tshod shing 'bras gos hrul ngan ngon gang byung tsam gyis chog 'grig 'ong smras na/ ang de sngon gyi dam pa dang khyed rnams kyi spyod yul zhig red lags/nga 'dra'i de gas yong dogs med zer/ rgyal ba'i rnam thar zhal gsungs la rgyab bstan/ khyim pa pho mo'i spyod ngan tshig de dang du blangs/ ja mar sha 'thud/ gro phye rtsam pa/ phyur tshwa 'bras sogs chos kyi 'gal rkyen mi 'dod sna dgu bo tshang dgos/ de 'dra'i mi la mthun rkyen 'grig nas chos shig 'ong ba'i dus mi 'byung / gal te cung zad byung yang mthar mi 'khyol te/ rje 'ba' ra bas/ ser mo'i gzugs brnyan/ breg pa khyur rgyab/ nyi ma gang dro/ lto gang phyid/ dad rdzas kyi rkyal pa/ bza' btung gang rnyed du 'dong pa'i chos pas mi yong gsungs/ rje bye tshang pas/ khab rnyed na lha gsol/ snyung bu 'chag na brang brdung / lto 'brang gos dro/ rkyen med par nyi ma 243

dro po la sgod tsa na/ 'phreng ba sgril/ mchu lteb lteb pa byed/mig ru zang zing byed/ chos yod yod 'dra bo zhig 'dug ste/rang la lto gos med pa'am/ nye rigs la rkyen ngan/ lus thog tu na tsha/ rna ba'i yul du gtam ngan cig byung tsa na/ dge sbyor gnam gye mtha' la yer nas/ rkyen dbang du 'chor bar 'dug pas/ de 'dra'i chos pa la chos rnam dag yong ba'i re ba chad/chos byed pa la skyid rung sdug rung / shi rung gson rung /rkyen bzang rung ngan rung / gtam snyan rung mi snyan rung /mthun rkyen 'dzom rung ma 'dzom rung / zhen log gi ngang nas gnyen po dper na gzhu brdung ba 'dra ba'i thang sgring nge ba des rkyen snang thams cad rang grol du khrol khrol 'gro ba cig dgos pa yin mod/ ri la sdod rung klung du 'gro rung rang gi dge sbyor gyi ngar ma shor bar/ shi skyid rgal ral byas nas rkyen dbang du mi gtong ba zhig dgos pa yin te/ chos de skyid skyid 'dra na byed/ sdug sdug 'dra na 'jog sla sla 'dra na byed/ dka' dka' 'dra na 'jog de 'dra la dge sbyor 'go 'thon pa yong ba dka'/ chos byas pa'i rjes la lto 'brang ba/ gos dro ba/mthun rkyen 'dzom pa/ za snying 'dod na bzas pas chog pa/'thung snying 'dod na btung bas chog pa/ nyal snying 'dod na 244

nyal bas chog pa/ dga' ba'i mi dang 'grogs pas chog sdom pa dang dam tshig bsrung mi dgos pa/ mtshams dang 'dag 'byar sgom sgrub byed mi dgos pa/ tshe 'di gang skyid dang mi bde gang chos la byed cing / gang dga' stabs bde rang dbang 'dus 'dus mo zhig gi ngang nas/ 'chi tsa na sangs rgyas thob pa cig 'dod par 'dug ste/ de rang cung dka' las che/ chos dang 'jig rten mi mthun cing rgyab log yin pas/ skyid po cig 'dod pa la sdug pa'i las shig byed dgos/ sangs rgyas sgrub pa la dka' ba dang du ma blangs par sangs rgyas mi 'grub pas/tshe 'di thed la bor zhing rkyen bzang ngan gang gi dbang du mi gtong zhing / ri khrod dben pa'i gnas su sgom sgrub 'ba' zhig gis dus 'da' bar byed pa cig dgos so gsungs/ dper na bya dang bye'u chung la yul dang nye 'brel bdag tu bzung ba med cing zas nor longs spyod kyi gsog 'jog sogs gang yang med par tshe gang po nyin re bzhin gang rnyed za zhing / gang 'dod gnas su song / gang bder sdod pa bzhin du chos rnam dag cig snying thag pa nas byed na de 'dra zhig byed dgos/ de ltar byas na 'tsho ba gar yang rnyed sla ste/ skyes rabs las chog shes nges pas bdag nyid kyi/ /'tsho ba gang na btsal mi 245

dka'/ /rtswa dang lo ma chu yi gnas/ /gang na med pa ma yin no/ /zhes dang / spyan snga bas/ 'tsho ba ma rnyed dogs pa med/ /rtsam pa phor res de dag tshim/ /rtsam pa phor re mi rnyed pa'i/ /gnas dang grong khyer gang na'ang med/ /gsungs/ dpal gsang ba'i bdag pos/ thams cad blos thongs ri khrod 'grims/ /gos ni dug po gyon kyang chog /sto ni rdo dang chus kyang yong / /mi rnams kyis chos byed ma nus pa yin/ /gsungs/ bye tshang pas/tshe 'di'i lto gos srog 'tsho tsam zhig ni/ rgyal ba gong ma rnams kyis bcud len gyi gdams pa dpag tu med pa byung 'dug pas bcud len byas kyang chog mod/ bsod snyoms nyung ba re byas dka' thub la bsten kyang chog gos kyang bam bem dang ro gos khye lbags la sogs pa lhag pa thub tsam gyon kyang chog skyid sdug gi rtsol sgrub bskyung gsungs/ de 'dra'i chos pa zhig byed e thub blta dgos/ gzhan gang ltar byas kyang bde ba med/'khor ba khab kyi rtse mo na/ /bde ba nam yang yod ma yin/ /zag bcas nyer len phung bo 'di/ /bde ba sgrub kyang sdug bsngal rgyu/ /zhes skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis ma gsungs sam/chos pa rnams thugs bsam legs par thongs/ cis kyang dgos med rgyud la skyes pa'i chos pa la zas sna re tsam 'dzoms 246

kyang thams cad kyi go chod/ mthun rkyen gyis 'phongs dus shig mi 'byung / des na rtsam pa spar mo gang ngam/ 'bras phor pa gang lag tu 'ong na mthun rkyen kun 'grig pa zhig dgos/ de ltar 'phags pa'i rigs bzhir gnas pa'i gang zag de/'phags pa'i rigs yin pas phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba rnams kyi sras gcig pu ltar thugs brtse bas dus rtag tu skyong zhing dkar phyogs skyong pa'i lha'i dbang po brgya byen sogs bye ba stong phrag lha dag 'ongs nas 'phags pa'i rigs la gnas pa'i gang zag la phyag byas srung skyob byed pa smos mi dgos/ des chos gos ngan ngon zhig bzhag yod tshad yan chad la phyag byed pa yin pas 'dun ma rabs rnams kyi rtse mor phyin cing / dam pa gong ma rnams kyi rnam thar kyang zin pa yin/ mdo sde las 'dod pa zad na 'phags pa dngos yin te/ 'dod pa chung na 'phags pa'i rigs yin no gsungs/ dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su 'dzin pa'i mdo las/ 'od srung la/ bcom ldan 'das kyis na bza' sha na'i ras kyi snam sbyar ngan pa gnang / 'khor lnga brgya dang bcas pa lus 'phags ri la gnas te/ thams cad bsod snyoms pa/ sbyangs pa'i yon tan bcu gnyis pa sha stag go /'khor dang bcas pa bcom ldan 'das kyi chos nyan du byon 247

pas/ 'od srung khyod tshur shog nga'i gdan phyed la 'dug cig ces gdan phyed gnang gsungs/ bcom ldan 'das kyis 'od srung la/ khyod kyi gos hrul po'i rnam sbyar te phyogs gcig tu bzhag nas 'chag pa na/ lha stong phrag 'ong nas gos de la phyagar 'tshal/ nga yang du ku la'i ras dang / ko tam pa'i ras dang /ngang ris can gyi chos gos spangs nas/ sha na'i ras kyi gos gyon te/ mi gti mug can ni khyod dang nga'i rjes su mi slob par/gos bzang po tshol zhes rin po che phung po'i mdor gsungs/legs gdams las/ dpon po zhal ngo nag pa'i ja chang las/ /g.yog po thang kha yangs pa'i chu ra skyid/ /zer ba bzhin dben pa bsten nas sdod mkhan yod pa yin na sha mar za rgyu med kyang / sdig sdug gtam ngan gyis ma gzir bar 'dug pas/'dun ma rabs kyi rtse mor song snang gsungs/ bye tshang pas/ de ltar byas pas gong ma'i rnam thar 'khyongs/ zhen pa nang nas log 'jig rten gyi bya ba thongs shing / sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan tshugs/ rang gzhan gyi don gnyis 'grub pa'i bya btang gi rnal 'byor pa yong ba lags so/ /de tsam zhig thugs la 'jog par zhu gsungs/ yang bya btang ri khrod pa/ dge sbyong gi chos bzhir gnas dgos/ gzhan tshur rang la khro yang/ phar la mi khro/248

gzhan gyis tshur la gshe yang phar mi gshe ba/ gzhan gyis tshur la mtshang 'bru yang phar la mtshang mi 'bru ba/ gzhan gyis tshur brdungs kyang phar mi brdung ba/ bzhi po 'di la dge sbyong gi chos bzhi zer te/ rje btsun ye shes rgyal mtshan gyis/ gshe yang slar mi gshe/ khro yang slar mi khro/ brdeg kyang slar mi brdegamatshang 'brus kyang slar mtshang mi 'bru ba/ 'di ni dge sbyong gi chos bzhi yin gsungs/ de ltar dge sbyong gi chos bzhir gnas pa'i bya btang ri khrod pa chos dang mthun pas/ kun gyis phyag bya ba'i gnas yin te/ mdo las/ bzod pa dka' thub bzod pa dam pa ste/ /mya ngan 'das pa mchog ces sangs rgyas gsungs/ /zhes dang / klong chen rab 'byams pas/ bdag gzhan gnyis med 'phags pa'i gang zag 'dra/ /nyon mongs rang grol chu yi rba rlabs 'dra/ /ci smras 'dzin med brag ca'i sgra dbyangs 'dra/ /gang la chags med 'dab chags mkha' lding 'dra/ /spang gnyen rang grol sbrul gyi mdud pa 'dra/ /thams cad ye grol mkha' la sprin dwangs 'dra/ /de 'dra'i skal bzang bde gshegs rig 'dzin dngos/ /dad brgya'i spyi bos btud nas phyag byar 'os/ /yid bzhin nor bu bas kyang ches lhag pa'i/ /bde ba'i 'byung gnas de la skyabs su mchi/ /gsungs/249

deng sang 'ga' res/ tshur la tshig ngan khab tsam zhig byung ba mi bzod par/ phar lan du tshig rtsub rdo log 'dra ba 'phen pa'i snying stobs che ba'i shed can po rnams chos dang bstun na rab byung ngam dge sbyong ma yin pas spyod ngan de rgyang ring du 'dor ba gal che ste/ mdo las/ rab tu byung ba gzhan la gnod pa dang / gzhan la 'tshe ba dge sbyong ma yin no gsung / blo sbyong don bdun las/ bdag la gzhan gyis mi mang sar rma phab pa la sogs par lan mi bya zhing / ko long mi bya'o/ /de lta 'o skol chos pa rnams kyi chos bdag 'dzin gyi gnyen por ma song bas/bzod sran sha'u bas chung ko long gtsang btsan pas dam par gda' ste/ des chos kyi go mi chod pas/ chos bdag 'dzin gyi gnyen por 'gro ba zhig dgos gsungs/ yang bya btang ri khrod pas chos phyir ltogs grir/ 'khyag grir 'chi yang 'chi ru 'jug pa'i go cha 'dzin dgos/ de ji ltar 'dzin yong zer na/ ma gyur nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal bsal nas bde la 'god pa'i don du/ thob bya bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i phyir/ mtshan ldan bla ma'i mdun du mdo sngags kyi dbang lung khrid gsum legs par nyan/ bla ma'i bka' bzhin 250

ri khrod dben pa'i gnas su tshul bzhin nyams len byed dus/ltogs 'khyag gcan gzan nad gdon zhig gis shi song yang /sngon sangs rgyas thugs rje can gyis sems can don du sangs rgyas pa'i phyir/ slob pa lam gyi gnas skabs su bsam bzhin khong gi dbu bcad nas stong phrag tsam gzhan la sbyin par btang nas sangs rgyas/ bdag gi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa'i sngon chad sa'i rdul snyed kyi lus blangs pa dor ba'i sha rus bsags rgyu yin na ri rab las mtho yang / don go spu tsam ma byung bar da bar 'khor bar 'khyams dgos pa byung / da res bsam bzhin chos phyir shi na sangs rgyas kyi rnam thar bzung nas zin pa yin pas tshe phyi ma'am/ yang na skye ba bzang po brgyud nas sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob nges pa yin shin tu legs skal ba bzang / des na bsdad pa las chos kyi phyir myur du shi na rnyed pa chen po 'ong bar 'dug mi 'chi bsdad nas ci bya spyir skye ba'i tha ma 'chi ba yin pas nam 'chi yang snga phyi khyad ci yod nam yang mi 'chi ba'i 'chi med rdo rje'i sku zhig yin na dka' ba spyad nas 'chi ru bcug pas ma bzang zer mod/ de min 'chi rgyu yin phyin chad don med du shi nas khyi bya rgod gnyis kyi kha 'gul du bcug pa las/ chos phyir mi med lung stong zhig 251

tu shi ba mi yis ma tshor/ ro rul bya yis ma mthong ba zhig byas na/ rang nyid 'tshengs par gda' snyam du lus srog chos phyir 'dor ba la thang gi rtswa tsam yang mi 'phangs par/ sngon yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis lo drug la chu thigs re dang / til nyag ma re min par gsol rgyu med par dka' ba spyad tshul dang / sngon rje btsun mi la ras pas bla ma'i bka' bzhin mi med pa'i ri nas lo dgu la zwa tshod re la brten nas sgrub pa mdzad/ na bza' chad nas khab skud kyang ma 'byor bar mdud pa brgyab nas sku la gyon/ dka' spyad drag po'i sgo nas sgrub pa mdzad tshul dang / rje rmog cog pas lo bcu gnyis kyi bar du zwa tshod re tsam bsten nas dka' spyad byas sgrub pa mdzad tshul dang / spyan snga bas tshe stod zwa tshod tsam la bsten sogs ltogs sgur la mi tshe bskyal/ na bza' lhan pa med par gom po rgyab pas spyan snga ba ko sham can tu grags/ de bzhin sngon gyi dam pa gong ma thams cad kyis dka' ba de 'dra spyad nas sgrub pa snying por byas pas/ mchog thun gyi dngos grub brnyes tshul gyi rnam thar bsam nas de bzhin sgrub pa snying por mdzad dgos te/ spyan snga ba chen po'i zhal nas/ snying nas dam chos bya 'dod na/ /skyid 'dod tshe 'di blos thongs la mi yi khyu 252

nas ro ltar phud/ /za 'dod 'thung 'dod dug ltar spongs/ /mi la ri dwags bzhin du bros/ /shi la khad pa'i sdug sgur tshugs/ /chos phyir lus srog 'bor ba dang / /'chi ru 'jug pa'i go cha bskyed/ /skyid dang sdug pa gang byung yang / /bsam mno ma mang chos la dril/ /zhum khengs med par ri ltar gyis/ /grub thob gong ma'i rnam thar soms/ /zas su gyi na ngan ngon zo/ /skom du tsha med rdor med 'thung / /lus la bem po mda' brtug gyon/ /yid la bsam rgyu chos las med/ /mi yis nam yang mi mthong zhing / /gal te brgya lam mthong na yang / /sha skam mdog nag mig rtsa zhan/ /gsang bar lhan pa gon pa yi/ /skyes bu 'di 'dra snying rje zhes/ /snying rje'i yul du byed pa zhig /da ni lag len mi 'gel ri/ /sngon yang skyid chos byas pas phung / /da ni skyid chos byed ri shi/ /snyam du zhe mna' lan gsum bskyol/ /lag len la yang de bzhin thob/ /gsungs/ bye tshang pa rin chen dpal 'byor gyis/ ltogs nas skam krong nge shi na yang shi 'khyag nas sngon rang shi yang shi mi'i rjes ma snyog na yang ma snyog mi tsho rang la 'phya na yang 'phyo/ smon na yang smon/ dga' ba tsho dga' ba gyis/ mi dga' ba tsho mi dga' ba gyis/ nga ri khrod 'di nas bab ste lto gos kyi rtsol sgrub byed ri 253

snyam pas zhen log dang zhe spyad drag po zhig dgos gsungs/ bla ma zhang rin po che'i zhal nas/ ngas ni sang nang par nas/ltogs grir shi yang bya ba btang nas chos byed 'khyag grir shi yang chos byed/ pha ma dang bu smad rnams rlung gis 'khyer ya/nga nga ni bya ba btang nas chos byed zer ba cig dgos pa yin gsungs/rje mi las/ go ba rnams mngon du byed pa la/ lus la babs bskur/ lto la gyong bskur/ sems la las bskur nas/ snang ba gdong 'ded 'chi nus thog 'gel/ ci byung ro snyoms gsungs/zhang btsun yer pa'i zhal nas/ 'khyag rir shi na yang shistogs rir shi na yang shi snyam nas chos shig byas na/ 'khyag rir 'chi nges kyang med/ ltogs rir 'chi nges kyang med gsungs/po to ba'i zhal nas/ 'brom lo sdengs pa la/ snga phyogs pa dang /ga yu phyogs pa dang / stong ra ba gsum yod pa'i/ snga phyogs mang btsan zer ba la chung ma shed/ khyed lo gsum tsha ba 'thung nas gtan du zan za'am/ lo gsum zan zos nas gtan du tsha ba 'thung zer/ der kho shed/ ngas lo gsum tsha ba 'thung bas/ga yu rang yang snang ba mtha' yas/ skar chen dang / seng ge 'gying ba sogs sgrig pa mdung gang yod zer/ de bzhin du chos byed pa la sdug cig dang dka' las cig dang du len dgos/254

sdug thog nas chos shig ma byas par/ sems rtsa mi non blo mi khengs/ snam bu bkru bcag byed pa rnams so thub pa cig bya snyam nas 'then pas so mi thub/ phar ngos ma yang 'grongs pa zhig bya snyam nas 'then na so thub/ de bzhin du chos byed pa la yang tsham tshom med pa zhig byas na 'ong ste/ mdung kha ral kha yos yong ba des dpa' bo mi 'ong / yos mi yong ba zhig byung na dpa' bo 'ong ba yin/ de bzhin du yos chos ma byung ba de ngas byas zer ba zhig dgos/ zhe phugs sprang la gtad/ sprang gi tha ma shir bcug sang gnangs nas rkang mgo khyis 'drad/ byis pa rnams kyis mgor 'chang bstun rgyag pa zhig bya dgos snyam pa zhig bya/ spyir 'khor ba khyad par ngan song / yang dgos mnar med du skye ma dgos na/ ltor 'khrud ma 'thung na yang 'thung / gos su stan gon yang gon sems pa zhig dgos gsungs/ rje rgod tshang pas/ ngas chos phyogs su dka' ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa cig spyad/ bar chad 'chi nges pa mang po byung ste/ sems la sdug bsngal mi phod pa skad cig kyang yong ma myong / 'jig rten blos btang ste chos phyogs su 'chi nus pa cig dgos pa yin pas/ lus sems la phreng ba'am phangs sems skad cig kyang yong ma myong / spyir yang chos phyogs su 255

lan gsum bzhi tsam 'chi nus na/ gzod chos shig 'ong ba 'dra gsungs pa ltar/ 'chad ka pa'i zhal nas/ dka' thub kyi ri sul du drang srong gi spyod tshul gyis gnas pa zhig byung na/ da gzod phas bu gsos bya ba yin gsungs/ zang zing gi zas nor longs spyod yid la skad cig tsam yang mi bsam par rtse gcig tu sgrub pa la 'bad na/ dper na snying stobs che bas de ring rang shi na shi snyam g.yul du zhugs na mi 'chi ba ma zad pha rol gyi dgra thams cad cham la phab/ dgra cham la phab tshe gnyen thams cad dga' nas dpa' bo zer ming bzang po btags 'dang rtsi sgo sngar las je cher 'gro ba ltar/ bya btang ri khrid pas chos phyir shi yang rung snyam/ rtse gcig tu nyams len byas na mi 'chi bar ma zad/ bdag 'dzin nyon mongs kyi dgra thams cad cham la phab tshe/ lha 'dre mi gsum dga' nas chos pa bzang po zer ming snyan pa btags kun gyes sngar bas lhag pa'i mchod bstod bkur te/ tshul khrims 'chal ba tshar gcod pa'i mdo las/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i phyir rab tu byung nas/ chos de la yang brtson 'grus kyis gnas na/ 'dod pa chung ba'i lha rnams dang / 'dod pa chung ba'i mi rnams dang /'dod pa chung ba'i sems can thams cad las/ dge slong rnal 256

'byor spyod pa des lhung bzed dang chos gos 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs/ snying rje pad+ma dkar po las/ sngon bcom ldan 'das kyis thugs bskyed dus/ bdag gi bstan pa la/chos gos ngur smrig sor bzhi 'chang ba la yang bza' btung bsam pa bzhin du ma thob na/ bdag gis sangs rgyas bslus pas sangs rgyas mi thob par gyur cig ces dam bca' mdzad cing / khyim pa'i skye bo thams cad kun/ /sen mo'i steng du zhing rmed kyang / /nga yi rab tu byung ba rnams/ /'tsho bas 'phongs par mi 'gyur ro/ /yang dkar phyogs skyong ba'i lha rnams kyis kyang dben par rtse gcig tu sgrub pa byed pa rnams la gus pa dang bsnyen bkur byed pa sher phyin gyi ra/do las gsungs/gsang ba spyi rgyud las/ 'jig rten pha rol don gnyer skyes/ /'jig rten 'di yi 'bras bu rgyas/ /gsungs/ de bzhin du/mnyam med jo bo chen pos/ snying nas chos bzhin byas na lto rgyab gnyis ka zhor la 'byung tshul 'dug ces dang / zhang sna rnam rdo rje dbang phyug gi zhal nas/ zhag kha shas cig ri gseb tu ltogs par bsdad pas/ sngon la phyugs rdzis 'dzar ba ster/de nas grong gseb pa sbran nas ster gsungs/ spyan snga rin po che'i zhal nas/ 'o cag 'tsho bas 'phongs kyang / blo phugs sprang 257

la gtad pas/ dad ldan kun gyis mchod pa'i gnas byed/des na longs spyod kyi gtso bo chags med yin pas/ ka cha'i sog rum bya ba don med gsungs/ spyan snga ba blo gros rgyal mtshan gyis/ shākya'i rjes su rab byung nas/ /chos la brtson 'grus kyis gnas na/ /bye ba stong phrag lha dag gis/ /mi las 'das pa'i bsnyen bkur byed/ /de bzhin mis kyang bsnyen bkur nas/ /'tsho bas 'phongs par mi 'gyur gyis/ /gsungs/ rje mi la'i zhal nas/ 'tsho ba lha yis sbyor ba la/ /sdug gsog byas pa'i kha na med// ser snas bsags na mi 'phel ba/ /mkha' 'gro spyi yi dam tshig yin/ /de phyir phyis kyi bsam sbyor bor/ /de phyir tshe 'di blo yis thongs/ /gsungs/ bla ma zhang rin po ches kyang /tshe 'di la ma 'khris na/ lto gos la sogs pa'i mthun rkyen zhar la je 'dzom je 'dzom 'ong gsungs/ bla ma 'ga' res/ chos bzhin byas na char bzhin 'bab/ /gsungs/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen po to ba'i zhal nas/ chos shig byas na tshe 'di rang la yang gzhan dang mi 'dra ba zhig 'ong ste/ nga mi skya'i dus gser khar lan gsum phyin pa la gser zho gcig kyang ma rnyed/ da lta ni nyin re la'ang gser srang mang po 'ong gsungs/ yung ba lung ba na kham lung pa las bde skyid snyan gsum che ba med/208

klung shod na spyan snga pa las skyid pa med de/ de chos bzhin byas pa las byung ba yin gsungs/ spyan snga pa dang po'i dus rtsam pa chad kyin zwa tshod re tsam la bsten/ sham thabs la lhan pa ma rnyed par kom po brgyab pas/ spyan snga ko sham can du grags/ da lta ni 'dzam bu gling kun ngas gsos kyang sos snyam gsungs/ dge bshes 'ban gyi zhal nas/ nga mi skya'i dus na mda' gzhu tsher ma 'dra ba btags/ gri gnyis gsum re btsugs kyang dgra mang spun nyung / nga pho reng ba mi gcig la ston thog bzhi bcu thon pas grong ba rnams kyis nga'i ming la bzhi bcu sdigs su btags/ nyin mo la kha'i jag pa/ mtshan mo grong gi rkun ma byas kyang lto mi phyid/ da mtshon cha spangs pas dgra gcig med/ las ka mchil ma rdo la mi 'bo de lto phyid/ mu ge ci byung yang phyug po dang mjing sbrel nas zar yod/ sngar nga'i khas zas mi rnyed/ da zas kyis nga'i kha mi rnyed/ zos pas ni mi 'dzad/ 'thung bas ni mi yog chos bden bsam pa 'di gnyis btud gsum btud 'chor gsungs/ dper na lo tog gi phyir 'bad na sog ma zhor la 'ong ba ltar/ phyi mar thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang thob pa'i phyir 'bad na/ tshe 'di'i bde skyid shugs la 'byung / des na 'tsho ba rnyed rgyu ma red snyam/259

de phyir sems khral gtan nas byed mi dgos/ sngon gyi dam pa rnams kyis tshe blos btang nas dben par sgrub la gzhol dus/chos phyir tshe stod dka' ba spyad zhes zer ba go myong / 'tsho bas phongs nas ltogs grir 'di ba sang mgo thur bstan nas shi zer ba'i gtam da snga yan chad la su'i kha nas thos ma myong /sngon bla ma gcig gis slob ma la chos gnang / tshe blos btang nas dben gnas gzhan du bsgom du 'gro khar/ cha rgyus med pa'i yul gzhan tsho song na 'tsho ba mi rnyed par/ mu ges shi mi 'gro'am zhus pas/ bla mas 'o de bden/ mu ges mi 'chi ba'i srung 'khor zhig yod pas ngas 'dri/ de'i rdzas la ri khrod pa mu ges shi song ba'i rus pa zhig dgos pas/ khyod song la tshol shog gsungs pas/ song nas ri khrod pa re mu ges e shi zhes gzhan la dris pas/ ri khrod pa mu ges shi ba'i rus pa phar zhogade shi song zer ba zhig rna bas kyang ma go tshe/ phyir 'ong nas ma rnyed zhus tshe/ bla mas 'o de rnyed mi dgos srung 'khor de yin/zas nor yid la ma bsam par dben par song la rtse gcig tu bsgom gyis dang / chos pa mu ges shi song ba sngar yang ma byung ba de red/ phyin chad kyang mi 'byung / da lta khyod kyang mi 'chi ba'i khag ngas 'khur zhes gsungs pas/ slob ma de dben par sdod 260

dus/ zang zing gi zas nor longs spyod yid la ma bsam par rtse gcig tu sgom brgyab pas/ ring bor ma lon par lo 'ga'i 'phro nas grub thob cig byung skad/ dge bshes kha rag pa'i zhal nas/ so nam ma byas yo byad ma bsags kyang / /sgom chen 'khyags sam bkres nas grong pa dag /sngon chad mthong zhing thos pa cang yod dam/ /phyin chad nam yang mthong zhing thos mi 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs/ yang bla ma dam pa 'ga' res/ seng ge gangs nas 'khyag pa med/ /bya rgod mkha' nas ltung ba med/ /chos pa mu ges shi ba med/ /ces gsungs/ des na dben par chos rnam dag cig byed 'dod phyin/ snying stobs chung mi rung /kho ltogs nas shi e 'gro/ grang nas shi e 'gro/ gcan gzan gyis gsad e yong / lha 'dres gnod pa re btang nas glo bur du shi e 'gro snyam sems dpa' zhum nas/ bsam blo mang po gtong rgyu zhig gi dbang du song na/ chos mi dgos 'jig rten kyang mi 'ong / sngon nga'i yul phyogs kyi mi gnyis kyis bong bu gnyis ded nas nang par snga bar shing 'thu ru nags su song /nags su slebs tshe gcig gis grang gi zer me bus/ gcig gis cung zad grang yang yul du phyir snga bar ldog dgos snyam nags su phyin nas shugs langs nas shing btus pas skabs 261

shig grang ba phar zhog jul chu tsho byung dpung ba phyir 'phud dgos pa'i tshod byung shing bong bur bkal nas snga bar rang yul du song tshe/ khyod mgyogs zer kun dga' ja blud/ khong tshang gi shing 'thun dris pas/ phyin yong zer/ me 'bud mkhan de grang tshe/ me'i thag nyer bsdad pas lham gyi yu ba mes tshiganags su song shul nas bong bu grogs med par rang yul du log song tshe/ shing 'khyer nas 'ong bong bu med tshe yar mar du rgyug rgyug nas ngal ba du ma blangs/ rang yul du ldog dus shing chen po mi theg snyam/ shing mchu gcig bzung nas 'ong tshe/khyim tshang gis khyod la ci byung / gzhan mi de 'ongs dus bong bur shing bkal nas mi 'ongs kyang / phyi nas rgyab tu 'ga' 'khur nas na mi chog gam/ shing med pa mi shes sam zer/mtshan mo nas bzung kha ba chen po babs nas nyi ma mang po'i bar du shing med pas ja dron po zhig kyang 'thung ma thub par sngar gyi de bas grang ba byung zer/ dper na snying stobs med pa zhig gis dmag la song nas 'thab tshe kho gsod snyam yib pa'am bros na lhag pa pha rol pos ded nas mtshon gyis rgyab nas rmas pas/ mtshon 'phrog phyir yul du log nas kun gyis skrag shor bu ngan/ gsang na gang yang med gi zer/ mi gral 262

nas 'bud pa ltar/ chos byed dus ltogs grir shi snyam/ zas gos rgyu nom btsal bsags na/ nyon mongs dmag lta bu je rgyas song nas/ mi dge nyes ltung gi mtshon cha steng du babs tshe chos 'chor/ kun gyis de ba chos pa bzang po min zer dad pa med/ chos pa'i khyu nas bud nas/ tshe byas phyi mar sangs rgya mi dgos/ 'jig rten 'di la yang bde skyid snyan gsum gang yang mi 'ong / des na chos byed dus snying stobs chung mi rung ba'i rgyu mtshan de yin/ yang dben par bsdad nas sgom sgrub byed dus gzhan gyis mthun rkyen 'tsho ba re khyer e 'ong / 'ong na ci ma rung snyam na de mi dge bcu'i nang gi brnab sems yin brnab sems de 'dod chags kyis bskul ba yin/ 'dod chags bdag 'dzin phung rgan gyis bskul ba yin/ bdag 'dzin nyon mongs kyis kun nas bslangs pas dge ba ci byas kyang zas bzang dug gis slad pa 'dra bas ci tsam bsgoms kyang sdig pa yin te/ jo bo rje'i zhal nas/ kho bos bsgom pa rin chen bla ma bsgom skad/ bsgom tsa na bsgom pas dar yug dang ja sig mang po 'ong sems na/ ci tsam bsgoms kyang sdig pa yin te/bsgom tsa na skye ba'i rgya mtsho mthar dbyung / byang chub mchog gi sa bon btab sems na sems pa tsam zhig byas pa'i bsod 263

nams nam mkhar mi shong gsungs/ yang rtsa ba dug yin na yal ga dang lo ma dug rtsa ba sman yin na yal ga dang lo ma sman du 'ong ba bzhin/ rtsa ba 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum gyis kun nas bslangs pa'i las ci byas pa thams cad mi dge ba yin gsungs/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyis/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum/ /de skyes las ni mi dge ba/ /ma chags mi sdang gti mug med/ /de skyes las ni dge ba'o/ /zhes dang /lung las/ yid ni rab tu 'khrugs pa yis/ /byas pa dang ni bsags pa dag /thams cad mi dge'i las su 'gyur/ /yid ni rab tu dwangs pa yis/ /byas pa dang ni bsags pa dag /thams cad dge ba'i las su 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs/ rje rin po ches/ dkar nag las rnams bsam pa bzang ngan lags/ /bsam pa bzang na sa dang lam yang bzang / /bsam pa ngan na sa dang lam yang dman/ /thams cad bsams pa dag la rag las pas/ /gsungs/ 'brom rin po ches/ jo bo rje la/ tshe 'di'i bde skyid dang rnyed bkur 'dod nas byas pa'i las rnams la 'bras bu ci mchi zhus/ lan du 'bras bu de kho na mchi gsungs/ phyi ma ci mchi zhus pas/ dmyal ba mchi/ yi dwags mchi/ dud 'gro mchi gsungs/ dge bshes dgon pa pa'i zhal 264

nas/ chos brgyad kyi bsam pas byas pa rnams la 'bras bu 'dod pa bzhi byung na tshe 'di la 'bras bu de rang yin/ phyi mar phan pa med/ mi 'dod pa bzhi byung na tshe 'di rang la yang phan pa med gsungs/ de la dgongs nas/ bla ma zhang rin po ches/dben pa'i yon tan dpag tu med pa bka' dang lung rnams nas gsungs pas na/ dad pa brtan po dang blo rgya chen pos/kun slong ngan pa dang ma 'dres par 'jig rten bya ba mtha' dag spangs te shin tu dben pa zhig tu 'du long la sogs pa tshar gcad de/ mthun rkyen 'dzoms kyang 'phral 'tsho tsam tshags byas te gnas par bya'o/ /gsungs/ des na kun slong ngan pa 'di 'dra skyes pa dug ltar spangs nas mi la re ba ma che lha la gsol ba thob gsungs pa ltar/ dkon mchog gsum la blo gtad nas sgrub pa la rtse gcig tu 'bad na 'tsho bas 'phongs nas 'chi bar mi 'gyur/ dam pa gong ma thams cad kyis yang dang yang du gsungs so/ /yang dben par 'dug dus/mtshan mo thams cad la shi nyal ro nyal byas gnyid/ nyin par bza' btung long gtam sogs rnam g.yeng le lo byas na/sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa smos ci dgos te bde ba gang yang mi thob pas/ nyin mtshan dal khom med par sgrub pa la 265

brtson 'grus byas na/ sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang nas bzung mi 'grub pa gang yang med pas/ le lo spangs nas brtson 'grus bskyed pa gal che ste/ rje spyan snga bas/ mtshan mo thog thag ro nyal byed/ /nyin mo'i bzhi cha bza' btung byed/ /bzhi cha long gtam rnam g.yeng byed/ /dge sbyor glog 'gyu tsam byas pas/ /grub rtags yong bar re ba yi/ /khyod kyi brtson 'grus 'di la ltos/ /rang gis rang la ngo yang tsha/ /rgyal ba rnams kyi thugs kyang khrel/ /spyod khyer 'di ni ma dor na/ /sangs rgyas thob pa lta ci smos/ /bde ba gang yang thob mi srid/ /gsungs/ dran pa nyer bzhag las/ gang la le lo gcig yod pa/ /de la chos kun med pa yin/ /zhes dang / blo gros rgya mtshos zhus pa'i mdo las/le lo can byang chub shin tu ring zhing rnam par ring ngo le lo can rnams la sbyin pa med pa nas/ shes rab kyi bar du med do/ /le lo can la ni gzhan gyi don med do zhes dang / klong chen rab 'byams pas/ snyom las ma te'i gnyid dang 'dra/ /byas pa'i las la 'grub dus med/ /da res brtson 'grus lcag brab la/ /rig pa'i rta mchog bskul na legs/ /zhes dang /mdo sde rgyan las/ brtson 'grus kyis ni byang chub mchog sangs rgyas/ /zhes dang / byang sa las/ brtson 'grus kyis ni bla na 266

med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob pa byed/ /ces dang / phar phyin bsdus pa las kyang / yongs su skyo med brtson 'grus che ldan na/ /mi thob mi 'grub rnam pa gang yang med/ /ces dang / spyan snga pas/ bsrubs na shing las me yang 'byung / /bsags na rgya mtsho thigs pas khengs/ /rkos na skam sar chu yang 'thon/ /'bad na mi 'grub gang yang med/ /ces gsungs pa sogs mdo rgyud bstan bcos na le lo'i nyes dmigs brtson 'grus kyi phan yon mtha' yas pa gsungs so/ /yang dben par sgrub pa byed dus 'dod thag mi nye bar sgrub pa yun bsrings/ rkyen ngan bar chad gang byung yang snying rus sdug sran bskyed pas nam yang blos chos mi gtong bar 'bad pa 'di shin tu gal te/ bla ma zhang gis/ de ma thag tu grol rtags 'dod/ /bshol la khad kyi snga ltas yin/ /gsung ba dang / snyug bsrings 'dod thag ma nye mdzod/ /la 'ur phye gtor ma 'gam mdzod/ /gsungs/ rgyal ba yang dgon pas/ blo ngan goms kyi bag chags shog dril 'dra/ /nyams gsar bu skyes kyang rkyen gyis 'jig /dus yun thung gi 'khrul ba mi chod kyis/ /bsgom yun du bsrings shig sgom chen kun/ /gsungs/ po to ba'i zhal nas/ so med kyang snyil gyis 'drad zer ba bzhin/ blo chos la 267

'gror mi nyan yang / da ci tsug song yang chos byed zer ba zhig byung na/ blo bskyed byung ba dang chos byung ba de ka yin gsungs/ rje skal ldan rgya mtshos/ chos slob long med par mkhas ming 'dod/ /bsgom byed long med par grol rtags 'dod/ /'di 'jog la khad kyi snga ltas yin/ /yun thod pa ma bzhag bar du bsrings/ /zhes dang / sa mdo smad mi 'di dran rgyu mang / /chos gcig pu mthar 'don byed pa dkon/ /mi rang yang de dang mthun par 'jug /'di bsam tshe yi mug gting nas skyes/ /gsungs/ gang shar rang grol gyis/ chos zab pa kho nas mi chog gi /rang brtson 'grus lhag par gal che bas/ /khyod gang shes chos de lag tu long / /gang mdzad pa de nyid mthar thon mdzod/ /ces dang / o rgyan rin po ches/ sangs rgyas bka' yis bslu ba cang srid dam/ /drod rtags ma thon bar du sgrub la 'bungs/ /zhes dang / 'phong rul gdan rdol shi yang rdzogs chen bsgom/ /gsungs/ rje mi las/ myur du grub rtags ma 'dod par/ /bsgom yun shi dang mnyam par gyis/ /zhes dang / rje rgod tshang pas/ lar grub thob cig byed na sgrub pa yun gcig ring dgos/ lo gcig lo gnyis re bar mi phan/tshe dang sgrub pa snyoms pa'i go cha gyon nas nam mkha' ma zad 268

bar la dril/ nyams dang rtogs pa thams cad gsang nas bsgom na grub thob rang 'ong ste gsungs/ spyan snga pas/ kha mo ma myong bar mngar po mi myong / skyid 'dod pa la sdug sgur dgos/ ngu bro ba'i las ma byas par rgod bro ba'i zas mi myong /kha za 'dod pa la lag pa lcags 'dra ba zhig dgos mi zer ram/mer bcug na gsur thon pa/ chur bcug na cob thon pa zhig gis gang byas kyang yong ba yin/ kha za 'dod pa la byen pa 'dar bas gang yang mi 'ong gsungs/ chos sam 'jig rten ma byung tshad thams cad sdug bsngal cung zad re sran ma tshugs pa 'dis ma lan na gang gis lan/ des na sdug bsngal la sran mi tshugs pa la gtan 'khyams mi tshugs pa la gtan 'khyams mi yong ba'i don med pas/ ngas da phyin chad 'jig rten pa rnams sdug bsngal du 'dzin pa la ngas bde bar 'dzin/ khong rnams bde bar 'dzin pa la ngas sdug bsngal du bzung la btang snyam pa bya/ de 'dra zhig byung na/ snying stobs ldan pa'i skyes bu yis/ /sgrub na mi 'grub gang yang med/ /dka' las gnag pa ma dor na/ /ri bo rnams kyang thal bar rlog /zer ba zhig 'ong ba yin gsungs/ des na rje mi las/ mi med pa'i gangs dang ri sul nas sgrub pa mdzad tshul dang / 'phags pa 269

thogs med kyis rje btsun byams pa bsgrub pa'i rnam thar ltar/dka' spyad sdug sgur byas nas bsgom yun bsrings na dngos grub thob/ gal te tshe 'dir ma thob kyang phyi mar thob par the tshom med par mdo rgyud bstan bcos du ma nas gsungs so/ /yang dben par 'dug dus/ mi gzhan gyis mi shes snyam nas/dge slong dgong srung mkhan gyis phyi dro'i kha zas za ba dang /nyin mo gcer bur bsdad nas shig 'thu ba dang / glu blangs gar byed pa dang / 'dug ma thub par khang las byed pa dang /bza' btung gi lag las byed pa sogs chos min gyi bya ba dang /brnab sems gnod sems log lta sogs gang dran kyang mkhyen pa thogs med sangs rgyas byang sems/ mngon shes ldan pa'i nam mkha'i lha dang sa'i lha mo bstan ma sogs kyis nyin mtshan med par sa le mkhyen nges/ mkhyen tshe sangs rgyas byang sems thugs khrel/ lha sogs kyis 'phya bar 'gyur/ rtag tu sangs rgyas byang sems lha sogs kyi drung na 'dug pa ltar ngo tsha khrel yod kyi sgo nas chos mthun gyi bya ba byed pa gal che ste/ kha rag sgom chung pa'i zhal nas/ khyod kyi sems la ci bsam pa /rgyal ba'i thugs la ma sgrib gsal/ /rang gi yi dam lhas khrel bas/ /bsam ngan yid la ma 'gyu ang / /long pa'i drung na 270

mig ldan ltar/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams/ /rtag tu sgrib med spyan gyis gzigs/ /spyod ngan phag tu ma byed ang / /gsungs/ rin po che phung po'i mdo las/ de dgon pa'i gnas de na gnas pa na/ 'di ltar sems bskyed par bya ste/'di ltar bdag ni lam ring po nas 'dir 'ong la/ gcig pur gnyis su med pa ste/ legs par byas pas mnyes par byas pa bskul ba'i grogs ni gang yang med kyi/ lha dang klu dang /gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang dag bdag gi sems kyi bsam pa shes pa dag yod de/bdag dgon pa'i gnas na gnas la/ mi dge ba'i sems kyi dbang du song na/ de dag dbang du 'gyur ro/ /bdag lam ring po nas 'dir 'ong zhing / gcig pur gnyis su med de/bdag gi med/ rten pa med/ yongs su 'dzin pa med la/gal te 'dod pa las rnam par rtog pa'i rnam par rtog pa/gnod sems kyi rnam par rtog pa/ 'tshe ba'i rnam par rtog pas rnam par rtog gis mi dge ba gzhan la rnam par rtog par gyur na/ bdag 'du 'dzi dang 'du ba la mngon par dga' ba'i sems can rnams dang bye brag med par 'gyur ro/ /bdag gis lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za rnams la bslus 271

par 'gyur zhing / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyang mi mnyes par byas par 'gyur gye ci nas kyang / 4dedag la lha rnams kyis 'phya bar mi 'gyur ba dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyang dgyes par 'gyur ba de ltar bya'o snyam du sems bskyed par bya'o/ /zhes dang / lhag bsam bskul ba las/ rnyed pa dang / bkur bsti dang / tshigs su bcad pa spang ba/ des ni 'dod pa chung ba bsgom par bya'o/ /gcig pur dga' ba der don la rtog pa dang / nam gyi cha stod cha smad la mi nyal ba dang / bya ba nyung ba dang / snye bar zhi ba gnas shing rtsod pa ma mchis pa lhur blang bar bya zhing / sems can la byams pa bsgom par bya'o/ /zhes dang / slob dpon zhi ba lha'i zhal nas/ 'di ni gnya' drag 'gyur tshul du/ /shed bskyed par ni mi bya ste/ /bag ma gsar ba'i tshul bzhin du/ /ngo tsha 'jigs bcas bsdams te bzhag gsungs/ de bzhin du spyan snga pas/ bag gsar de 'gro na sgra chung ba/ sdod na mngon mtshan chung ba/ shin tu ngo tsha dang bcas pa/ spyod pa mi legs pa byung na mis smad du 'ong snyam nas khrel che ba/ ri dwags bzhin mi la 'bros pa/ dbang po mi rgod pa/ mig gnya' shing gang phan du mi blta ba/ sgra skyung pa/ spra bcad byas pa 'dra ba 272

zhig yong ba yin/ de bzhin du rang re yang dbang po'i sgo bsdams par bya ba/ de 'dra zhig dgos pa yin/ de med par dge sbyor re byed lo byas kyang 'bras bu ye mi 'ong gsungs/yang dben par nyams len byas nas tshe mjug mchog thun gyi dngos grub brnyes pa'i rtags spyan dang mngon shes dzu 'phrul phul du byung ba bstan nas sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i che ba 'byin mi nus rung / bsdad kyin bsdad kyin 'dzin chags je che/nyon mongs je rags su song nas/ tshe blos ma thongs/ rgyud ma thul na/ tshe gang po ri la bsdad kyang rang sdig yin sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i bla btsong rkang 'dren ri la gnas pa'i byi ba gcan gzan wa khyi dang khyad par med de/ sa paṇa gyi zhal nas/ dam pa'i gdams pas spros pa ma chod par/ /zhi gnas bying po gcig la sems bzung nas/ /gti mug mun pa yang yang spel byed pa/ /phyi ba tshang du nyal ba'i sgom chen yin/ /dad dang 'dun pas sems rgyud ma thul bar/ /'gran 'dod dben pa'i ri la brten byas te/ /'dod yon dogs dgu yid la sems byed pa/ /gcan gzan ri la nyal ba'i sgom chen yin/ /thar pa'i lam dor nyes pa kun spel zhing / /bzang 'dod ri brag gnas pas dus 'das te/ /de rjes yon bdag pho mo'i grong 273

chog mkhan/ /wa 'dra lung stong 'grim pa'i sgom chen yin/ /chos brgyad 'dod pa rtswa phung me bzhin 'bar/ /kha phyir kun tu rgyu ba'i brtson 'grus can/ /log pa'i 'tsho bas rtag tu 'tsho byed pa/ /khye rgan grong mtha' myul ba'i sgom chen yin/ /rgyal po ngan pa'i tshul 'chang ngur smrig 'dzin/ /chags sdang mtshon thogs du ma'i 'khor gyis bskor/ /mi dge'i 'phrin las phyogs bcur rgyas byed pa/ /ngan 'gro gnas gsum spel ba'i sgom chen yin/ /gsungs/ rgad po 'ga' res/ shing gcig gis me mi len/ mi gcig la mi 'cham zer ba ltar/ deng sang ri khrod pa 'ga' res ri la lo mang po bsdad nas grong dgon tsho 'ong na thams cad kyis da sangs rgyas los yod snyam re bzhag che tshe khos/ tshig ngan re mi theg ngo tsho dmar por song / kha log tshig log brgyab nas mi gang dang mi 'cham par/ kun re log ge gtong ba mang / sngar ngo shes ni 'ga' res/ khong dang po 'di 'dra zhig min thugs 'jam/ da rlung khams pa zhig gi bud song ka zhig red/ skyabs su mchi dang rgyang nas phyag 'tshal na bzang gi zer/ sngon mi skya zhig gis lam na khong rnam pa gcig 'ong ba la/ khyed ci zhig yin dris pa la/ kho sgom chen pa zhig yin zer tshe/ tshod brtags phyir/ khyod sgom chen pa yin na/274

khyod kyi pha'i sha zo smras pas/ sgom chen pa tshur rgyugs nas thong rtsa'i bzung tshe/ mi skya'i mchil mas sgom chen pa'i ngo la thu byas he ran sgom chen pa smras tshe/ sgom chen pas khyod kyis kho bo bsgom gi mi 'jug ka smra ba ltar/ tshig ngan re tsam gong du mi gtong bar lan byas na/ dge sbyong ma yin te/ khyem bdag drag shul can gyis zhus pa'i mdo las/ dgon pa na gnas pa 'ba' zhig ni dge sbyong ma yin te/ 'di na ni ma sbyangs pa/ ma sbas pa/ ma zhi ba/ ma dul ba mi 'grus pa rab tu mi brtson pa 'di lta ste/ ri dwags dang spre'u dang / bya mang po dang / chom rkun dang gdol ba dag mang du gnas te/ de dag kyang dge sbyong gi yon tan dang ldan pa ma yin pas/ gang gi phyir bdag dgon pa la gnas pa 'di lta ste/ dge sbyong gi don yongs su rdzogs par bya'o gsungs/ mkha' 'gro ni gu mas/ tshe 'di blo yis ma thongs na/ /ri la bsdad kyang ri dwags 'dra/ /ci bsgom ngal ba don med yin gsungs/ sngon bla ma gcig gis dang po tshe blos btang / skabs shig nas gzhi gcig bzung / mdzo mo brgyad bzhos/ dgong bsrung nas dgong mo tsho mar khu phor pa gang tsam 'thung / gzhan la nga bzhin tshe blos thongs bshad tshe/ rgan mo gcig gis/ tshe blos btang mdzo mo brgyad bzho sang / /blos ma 275

btang ba tshos ci bzho soms/ /dgong bsrung mar khu phor 'thung sang / /dgong ma bsrung ba tshos ci 'thung soms/ /zhes smad ra btang ba de 'dra zhig tu ma song ba gal che/ bla ma zhig gis/ tshe blos thongs ma thongs nom pa ston dang shes/ shes rgyud thul ma thul khong khro slong dang shes gsungs pa ltar/ rgyu nom gang byen yang skyugs nad can la zas bstan pa ltar 'dod pa spu tsam med na tshe blos thongs pa'i tshad yin/ bya btang ri khrod pa yin na de 'dra zhig dgos te/ rje rgod tshang pas/ 'jig rten blos btang gsha' ma cig byed na/ dman sa bzung nas/ rang bas dma' ba chu mig las med pa cig dgos/ tshur la bsnyen bkur byed pa byung na skyugs nad can gyis zas spangs pa 'dra ba cig dgos/ rang gis phar la gtong na 'dzin pa med pa bu chung lta bu gcig dgos/ 'du 'dzis gting nas 'jigs pa ri dwags rmas ma lta bu cig dgos gsungs/ dpal gsang ba'i bdag pos/ 'dod pa'i longs spyod thams cad sgyu mar shar nas/zhen chags gang yang mi skye/ byung yang dgag mi dgos gnod pa med/ ma byung yang sgrub blo ma skye re ba med de zhen pa log pa'i tshad yin gsungs/ gzhan gyis tshig ngan brgya phrag smras brdeg brdung brgya phrag byas kyang / ras bal dkar 'jam thang 276
