du brdal ba bzhin/ rgyud je rtsub tu 'gro rgyu med par lhod kyi le 'dzum yal le gnas na grub thob dang grub rtags kyi rab yin te/ rig 'dzin gang shar rang grol gyis/ rang gi sems rgyud thul na grub thob yin/ /rang skyon rang gis thon cig rang grol ba/ /sgo gsum zhi zhing dul na grub rtags yin/ /nye ring chags sdang spongs shig rang grol ba/ /gsungs/ jo bo rjes/ dngos grub kyi mchog nyon mongs je chung la song ba yin/ grub rtags kyi mchog 'dod pa je chung la song ba yin/ gsungs/ dgon pa bas sne'u zur pa la/ zhang sgom khyod la ma 'ongs pa na/khyed kyi dge bshes de dngos grub dang grub rtags ci 'dra ba bzhed zer na/ rdzu 'phrul dang mngon shes sogs la bzhed byas par 'ong gi /de skad ma zer bar nyon mongs je chung 'dod pa je chung la song ba zhig la bzhed kyis gsungs skad/ rang rgyud thul na gzhan rgyud la yang phan thogs pas thog mar rang rgyud thul nges su byas nas/ phyis dben par 'dug pa'i zhor la gzhan don yang byas chog ste/ phal chen las/ mang du thos nas dben pa la gnas pa la bskul bar bya'o/ /rab tu dben par gyur nas dge ba'i bshes gnyen du 'gyur bar yongs su bskul bar bya'o/ /zhes dang / khyem bdag drag shul can gyis 277

zhus pa'i mdo las/ khyim bdag gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' rab tu byung bas/ sangs rgyas kyi dgon pa la gnas pa bka' stsal pa shes nas dgon pa la gnas par shes par bya ste/der dge ba'i chos thams cad yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba nye bar brtan nas/ phyis grong dang grong khyer dang grong brdal dang ljongs dang yul 'khor dang / pho brang dag tu zhugs te chos bstan par bya'o zhes gsungs/ da mdor hril gyis dril na/ sngon bdag cag gi ston pa thugs rje can gyes rgyal srid spangs mchod rten rnam dag drung du dbu skra bsil/ chu bo ne ra dza na'i 'gram du lo drug dka' ba sbyad nas bsgoms pas mthar mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba yin la/ slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis rgyal srid spangs nas/ rgya gar dur khrod brgyad sogs gnas chen rnams su rig 'dzin brgyad bsten bka' brgyad sgrub pa mdzad/ dngos grub brgyad thob gu ru mtshan brgyad du grags/ bod du byon nas bod yul mun pa'i gling lta bur sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nyi ma shar ba ltar mdzad/jo bo rjes/ pho brang rgyal mtshan mthon po sogs stobs 'byor rgya nag rgyal po dang mnyam pa'i rgyal srid spangs te/ bla ma du ma 278

bsten nas/ zab rgyas kyi gdams pa dpag med gsan/ khyad par rgya mtshor gru btang nas zla ba bcu gsum gyi bar du rgya mtsho'i nang nas dka' ba spyad/ bla ma gser gling pa'i drung du byon lo bcu gnyis kyi bar du 'bral med bsten/ byang chub sems kyi gdams pa zhus/ dben pa bsten nas tshul bzhin du bsgoms pas rang don mngon du gyur/ gzhan don du rje btsun sgrol mas lung bstan bod du phebs sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i sgon me gsar du sbar nas/ 'phags yul las kyang ches cher gsal ba byung / 7rje btsun mi las kyang / tshe blos btang lho brag mar pa bsten/ zab mo'i gdams pa gsan/ ri khrod dben pa bsten/ dka' spyad drag po byas/ ma yengs rtse gcig tu bsgoms pas/ tshe gcig lus gcig la sangs rgyas nas/nam mkhar bya ltar 'phur/ chu la nya ltar 'phyo/ pha bong 'dam ltar brdzis/ ri brag thal byung phug lus lha'i dkyil 'khor du sprul nas gzhan la ston pa sogs ngo mtshar phul du byung ba'i rdzu 'phrul dpag med bstan nas/ sgrub brgyud kyi bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan srid rtser bsgrengs/ rje rin po ches kyang / pha yul spangs nas dbus su byon/ dang po mtshan ldan bla ma du ma bsten nas rgya chen thos pa btsal/ bar du gzhung lugs thams 279

cad gdams par shar/ tha mar dben pa bsten nas nyin mtshan kun tu nyams su blangs/ rang don mthar phyin nas gzhan don du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa gser lta bu/ 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyis bzhu btul byas pas/ deng sang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsre bslad med pa gser sbyangs btso ma lta bu 'di byung / grub pa'i dbang phyug pha dam pa sangs rgyas/ ma cig lab kyi sgron ma/ 'brom ston rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas/ rgya gar grub chen brgyad cu/ bod kyi rje 'bangs nyer lnga sogs rgya bod kyi mkhas grub sngar byon tshad thams cad kyis de ltar mdzad pas mchog thun gyi dngos grub brnyes/ 'o skol rnams kyis kyang dam pa gong ma de rnams kyi rnam thar dang zhal gsung ltar sgrub na tshogs gnyis rdzogs/ sgrib gnyis byang / sku gnyis thob/ don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub par gdon mi za'o/ /smras pa/ sngon byon dam pa gong ma thams cad kyis/ /mngon shes dzu 'phrul dpag med ston bzhin du/ /zhabs kyis bcags shing byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas/ /rin chen gser dang g.yu yi mdangs 'dzin pa'i/ /spang ri lhun chags mthon po'i steng phyogs kyi/ /baiḍūr+ya ya yi mdangs 'dzin lha lam na/ /dri med lha yi dar dkar dang mtshungs pa'i/ /sprin dkar gyen 280

du 'phyur nas gdugs ltar mdzes/ /ngo mtshar lha yi spyan gzigs dang mtshungs pa'i/ /gzi brjid rang 'bar nyi zla gza' skar shar/ /ri rtse phrag gong rnams na lha rnams kyi/ /dbu rgyan snyan rgyan dpyang bzhin gangs ri chags/ /lha yi mgul rgyan rin chen do shal ltar/ /skabs re na bun dngul mdog sked la 'khril/ /lo ma me tog 'bras bus yongs mdzes pa'i/ /ljon shing sna tshogs mu men mu tig gi /dra ba dra phyed bres 'dra rlung gis bskyod/ /lha yi yan lag brgyad ldan chu bo bzhin/ /ri yi g.yas g.yon ngos na chu gtsang gis/ /shin tu gtsang gtsang 'thung 'thung zer ba bzhin/ /sil sil lhung lhung sgra snyan sgogs bzhin 'bab/ /tshangs dbang brgya byin mdun sa dang mtshungs pa'i/ /dri zhim 'byung ba'i spang gshong bde 'jam na/ /mgo rgyan 'dzin pa'i lha yi bu mo las/ /mdog mjes me tog mang po'i rtse dga' rgod/ /dar gos gyon pa'i lha bu gzhon nu las/ /gzugs mjes sbrang ma'i glu blangs gar stabs bsgyur/ /lha bya khu byug 'jol mong la sogs pa'i/ /snyan pa'i skad 'byin dga' zhing 'phyo la lding / /lha yi 'dod 'jo ba mo nyal 'gro bzhin/ /sha ba rna ba rgo ba la sogs pa'i/ /ri dwags bag phebs nyal zhing dal bur rgyu/ /lha yi ma rmos lo tog 'khrungs pa bzhin/ /'bad 281

med sngo tshod mang pos khor yug gang / /mdor na sngon chad mthong dang ma mthong ba'i/ /mig tu mdzes shing rnar snyan yid 'bab kyi/ /ngo mtshar ltad mo bshad na brjod mi lang / /'dod yon lnga ldan 'dod khams lha yul las/ /lhag pa'i ri khrod dben pa'i bsil grib tu/ /drang srong bsam gtan sgom bzhin gcig pur bsdad/ /yengs med sgrub la brtson pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /de las skyid cig 'jig rten khams na med/ /de yi lus sems dga' bdes khyab pa de/ /gzigs rgyu yin na rgyal ba paṇa chen dang / /rgya gar bal yul rgya nag rgyal pos kyang / /dmu rgod gdul dka'i 'khor 'bangs skyong khur gyi/ /thugs ngal 'o brgyal byung ba'i dus skabs tsho/ /thugs smon 'chor na gzhan rnams smos ci dgos/ /rgyal sras byang chub sems dpas smon pa'i gnas/ /yid 'ong ri khrod dben pa'i gnas mchog tu/ /bsdad nas dge sbyor byed rgyu'i skal ba zhig /byung ba'i bsod nams nam mkhar shong mi 'gyur/ /sngon gyi las bzang smon lam bzang po'i mthus/ /bsil ldan ljongs 'dir skyes pa'i dad ldan rnams/ /mi tshe yun thung nam 'chi nges pa med/ /tshe phyed yad yud shor ba ma tshor ram/ /blo sems mthun pa'i grwa rogs grogs mched rnams/ /gshegs tshul bsam na skyo ba mi skye 282

'am/ /'khor ba spyi dang khyad par 'dod yon gyi/ /nyes dmigs bsam na nges 'byung mi 'phel lam/ /tshe 'di'i mi nor zas gsum blo yis thongs/ /mtshan ldan bla ma bsten la thos bsam gyis/ /dam pas byin rlabs dben gnas nyams dga' ru/ /ma yengs tshul bzhin bsgom dang e ma ho/ /rgyal ba'i gsung rab rgya che gting dpag dka'/ /bdag ni shes rab dman zhing thos pa nyung / /'di la 'gal 'khrul nongs pa ci mchis pa/ /bla ma rgyal ba sras bcas spyan sngar bshags/ /sngon med chos bshad gzhan phan zla ba 'dis/ /chos kyi 'gal rkyen chags zhen mur bsal nas/ /dam pa'i gshegs shul mdo sngags lam bzang brgyud/ /'gro kun rnam mkhyen sa ru bgrod par shog /ces chos bshad gzhan phan zla ba zhes bya ba 'di ni/ bya btang ri khrod la dga' ba'i skal ldan snying gi slob bu kun bzang rang grol dang lhun grub rig 'dzin gnyis kyis mtshon dad can du mas yang yang bskul ngor/ bya btang7tshogs drug rang grol gyis gnas chen tsā ri nas sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni snye mo'i drung yig bstan 'dzin phun tshogs so/ /'dis kyang bstan pa dang sems can la phan dpag tu med pa thogs par gyur cig /283

༄༅ / /mi shes mun pa mthug po sel ba'i lam rim gsal ba'i sgron me bzhugs so/ /'dzam bu gling gi rgyan gcig snyan pa'i ba dan 'gro na lhang nge ba/ /rgyal ba gnyis pa blo bzang grags pa dga' ldan zhing nas 'dir spyon la/ /bdag gi byang khog stod kyi lha khang snying gi pad dkar bzhad pa'i rtser/ /gzi brjid 'od zer 'bar bzhin bzhugs la sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol/ /rab tu gsal ba'i byang chub lam rim che chung nyi zla yod bzhin bzhag /lam rim shin tu bsdus pa'i sgon me tsam la re ba don go chung / /'on kyang las dang skal dman khang pa blo gros dkar khung med pa yi/ /mi shes mun pa mthug po sel phyir lam rim nyung 'dus sgon me sbar/ /rang nyid gnas khang bye dor bya zhing sku gsung thugs rten legs par dgram/ /ji ltar 'byor ba'i mchod pa rnams ni g.yo med bkod pa mdzes par bshams/ /bde ba'i stan la lus gnad 'dug lugs brgyad dam spyod lam 285

gang bder gnas/ /skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med bzhi po bsgom pa sngon du legs par btang / /bdag gi tshe rabs mang mang thog ma ma mchis pas na sems can skye/ /bdag sngon byes ts+tsha yang yarngo rme ma ma byas pa ni gcig kyang med/0/bdag ni da lta dzhar hūṃr a rme rme lus don du 'tshang rgya'i phyir/ /rdodag gis dam chos zab drob0 rnal ma ma lus lam rim bsgom pardo bya/ /dkon mchoXg gaXsum gyi r+shardon pa sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i byin rlabs dang / /tshogs gnyis yongs rdzogs chos dbyings rnam dag stobs dang bdag gi dad mos kyi/ /mthu las rang gnas sa phyogs tha mal gnas 'di lta bu ma yin par/ /sa gzhi baiḍūr+ya las grub cing rin chen du ma'i phra yis spras/ /rgya che bde 'jam dri ngad ldang zhing sna tshogs me tog gcal du bkram/ /bteg na 'phar zhing rmenan na nem pa sna tshogs mchod sprin 'khrigs pa'i dbus/ /seng ge chen pos bsnyeg pa'i rin chen sna tshogs khri mang bsgrigs legs shing / /yid 'ong gdugs dang rgyarlo mtshan ba dan sna tshogs brgyan pa zhig tu gyur/ /gar bzhugs zhing nas rtsa ba'i zle ma thub dbang skur sprul 'byon la chas/ /chas dang lhan cig lam rim brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams rdong yi dam rnye/ /lha mir bcas pa'i 'gro mgon sangs rgyas 286 ༷ ༷

byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ma/ /ma yis bu bzhin skyong mdzad chos skyong rnams kyang rjes rdes dus ༷gcig tu/ /steng gi phyogs nas thur du 'byon rnams kha ba bu yug 'tshubs bzhin spyorno/ /'og gi phyogasaX nas byen du 'byon rnams sa yi kha ༷rlangs 'thul bzhin spyonaX/ /brdo gyi hūṃgs rdos 'phred du 'byon rnams darge 'dun 'du khang 'du bzhirdo spyon/ /rang rge phyorges 'di dag tu 'byon rnams kun gyisaX rdzu 'phral ston bzhin spyode/ /khrus kyi kharngo baX shin rte dri zhim shel gyi sa rgozhi gsal skong 'tsher/ /rin chen 'bar ba'i ka ba yid 'ong mu tig 'od chags bla re bres/ /de'i nang yangs par dar zab stan la bla ma thub dbang 'khor bcas dang / /phyogs bcu'i zhing nas byon pa'i zhi khro rab 'byams thams cad bzhengs nas bzhugs/ /lha tshogs bzang po de dag rnams la nyon mongs dri ma mi mnga' yang / ༷/bdag lus bzang po grangs med sprul nas sems can sgrib pa sbyong slad du/ ༷/bum pa bzang po gos kyis dkris shing dpag bsam shing gi kha rgyan can/ /༷chu gtsang bzang pos bkang nas glu dbyangs rol mo sgrogs bzhin sku khrus gartsel/ /stong gsum kun tu dri ngad ldang ba'i dri mchog rnams kyis sku la byurkes/ /sgo gsum rab tu gus pa'i sgo nas gtsang ma'i gos kyis ༷ 287

sku phyi zhing / /srid gsum kun na mtshungs med gos bzang sna tshogs rgyan gyis sku la spraXs/ /sku gsum mchog brnyes rgyal rnams da ni mdun gyi khro la sku bzhugs garmel/ /bdag lus grangs med sprul nas lus rngog yid gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /dngos su 'byor dang yid kyis sprul pa'i mchod sprin bsam gyis mi khyab 'bul/ /sngar byas sdig sgrib nyes ltung thams cad snying nas 'gyod pas mthol lo bshags/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mdzad spyod rnams la rab tu dga' bas rjes yi rang / /zab dang rgya che'i chos kyi 'khor lo rgyun 'chad med par bskor bar bskul/ /bdag dang 'gro ba'i don du mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs/ /'dis mtshon dge ba ci bsags thams cad 'gro kun sangs rgyas 'thob phyir bsngo/ /gang yang 'gro ba'i 'bad ma dgos par bdag gi dge bas yongs grol shog /sa gzhi lcags ris bskor ba'i dbus su ri rab gling bzhi gling phran dang / /rin po che yi ri bo dpag bsam ljon shing 'dod 'jo'i ba mo dang / /ma rmos lo tog rgyal srid sna bdun gter chen bum bzang lha mo brgyad/ /nyi zla gdugs dang rgyal mtshan lha mi'i dpal 'byor blo yis blangs nas 'bul/ /'gro ba'i skyabs mgon bla ma rgyal ba zhi khro'i tshogs rnams dgongs su gsol/ /288

gagol ba 'debs pa'i bdag dang bdag 'dra'i da lta'i skal ba dman pa kun/ /kun mkhyen sangs rgyas mang po sngon dus byon yang 'dren par ma nus bzhag /bzhag rnams da ni myur du thar pa'i lam sna zin par byin gyis rlobs/ /de ltar gsol ba btab pas tshogs zhing rnams las bdud rtsi 'od zer 'phros/ /bdag gzhan la phog sdig ltung sbyangs nas mchog thun dngos grub thob par gyur/ /tshogs zhing thams cad mtha' nas rim bzhin bla ma thub pa'i dbang por thim/ /thub dbang byon nas rang gi spyi gtsug pad zla'i gdan la bzhugs par gyur/ /skyabs gnas kun 'dus bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod tshogs kun 'bul sdig ltung mthol bshags mdzad spyod rnams la rjes yi rang / /chos 'khor bskor dang bzhugs par gsol 'debs dge tshogs byang chub chen por bsngo/ /sa gzhi ri gling nyi zla bdag gzhan lus dang longs spyod dge tshogs 'bul/ /mjes sku sku gzhan las mchog sus mashong mardong tshe sngon ldas ldas sgrib 'dag /gsung gang gang gi rna bas thos na nad gdon gnod 'arngos nyatshe las grol/ /rab gsal gsal stong thugs kyis gsung dab dab 'byams zhing khasas khasas gsum mkhyen/ /bla sa sa lus 'gro ba'i skyabs mgon 289

mgon med gdungs dbyāngs dbyāngs la gson/ /khyed ni bla ma khyod ni sangs rgyas chos kyang yin/ /khyod ni dge 'dun khyod ni dpa' bo khyod ni mkha' 'gro ma rnams dang / /khyod ni chos skyong khyod ni skyabs 'dus khyod ni rgyal ba kun las lhag /khyed ni 'gro mgon khyod la re bas khyod kyis mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ /rgyul kun 'dus gzugs rtsa ba'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang po khyad par du/ /rgyul bas lung bstan brnyes pa'i klu sgrub thogs med gnyis las rim bzhin brgyud/ /rgyu pa ba gnyis pa blo bzang grags pas rtogs dka'i gnas rnams gsal bar phyes/ /rgyul sras rnams kyis bsngags pa'i lam rim rgyud la skye bar byen gyis rlobs/ /spyi bo'i bla ma thub dbang sku las bdud rtsi sna lnga 'od zer rgyun/ /rgyun 'chad med par byung nas bdag gzhan 'gro ba kun gyi lus la zhugs/ /zhugs ma thag tu nyi ma'i 'od kyis grib ma ded bzhin sdig ltung kun/ /kun kyang lhag med dag nas tshe bsod lung rtogs yon tan rgyas par gyur/ /bla ma thub pa'i dbang bo'i thugs ga'i chos 'brel yod tshad bla ma rnams/ /tshur byung rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar 'ja' 'od klong du bzhugs par gyur/ /rnga bo che yi mdo las ston pa shākya thub pas snyigs dus su/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen sku ru sprul nas 290

sems can don mdzad gsungs pa bzhin/ /bdag gi bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'di rnams sangs rgyas ngos rang yin/ /skyon ltar snang ba rnams ni rang snang ma dag pa yi dbang gis yin/ /sngon dus legs pa'i skar mas sangs rgyas ci mdzad skyon du mthong ba dang / /rje btsun thogs med kyis kyang rje btsun byams pa khyi mor mthong ba dang / /nā ros grub chen te lo nya ni gson bsreg byed par mthong ba dang / /dge tshul tshem bu pa yis rdo rje phag mo mdze mor mthong ba sogs/ /dam pa phal cher la yang 'khrul ba'i snang ba de 'dra byung gyur na/ /las dang nyon mongs gting du lhung ba bdag la snang tshul phyin ci log /de 'dra ci'i phyir mi 'byung dper na dung ni rab tu dkar ba la/ /ser po med kyang mkhris nad can gyi mig la ser por snang ba de/ /dung gi byon min kho rang skyon bzhin bla ma rnams la skyon med kyang / /rang la skyon ltar snang ba de nyid bla ma'i skyon min rang skyon yin/ /de ltar skyon ni med par ma zad drin can bla ma thams cad la/ /mkhas btsun bzang gsum la sogs yon tan khyad par can ni mang po mnga'/ /gzhan yang sgra bsgyur mar bas mi la'i las sgrib 'dag phyir sku rgyab la/ /rgal ba byung rag bar du sras mkhar dgu thog brtsig tu bcug pa ltar//drin can 291

rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams kyis bdag la mdzad pa sna tshogs shig /ston pa rnams la thugs dgongs ci 'dra ba zhig yod pa mi shes pas/ /sna tshogs mdzad spyod ston la log lta skad cig tsam yang mi byed cing / /ci mdzad thams cad legs pa'i yon tan rnams su mthong nas dad par bya/ /de ltar nus par spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang bo'i byin gyis rlobs/ /snyigs ma'i dus 'dir dmu rgod gdul dka'i rang rang 'gro rnams 'dren slad du/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad mi yi gzugs su sprul nas byon pa lags/ /skyon zad yon tan ldan pa'i cha nas sangs rgyas rnams dang khyad ma mchis/ /khyad par rang gi ngos nas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas las kyang lhag yin te/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis 'gro ba mang po smin grol lam la sngar bkod mod/ /sangs rgyas nye ring yod nas rang nyid yal bar dor ba ma yin kyang / /brag phug kha byang bstan la nyi ma mi 'char ba bzhin rang nyid ni/ /las dang skal ba dman pas sangs rgyas de rnams dngos su mjal ba dang / /gsung gi bdud rtsi myong ba ma byung sngon nas da bar 'khor bar 'khyams/ /da re la yang drin can bla ma dam pa rnams dang ma mjal na/ /slar yang dkon mchog sgra tsam mi thos 'khor bar gtan 'khyams dgos 292

pa la/ /da res bla ma rnams kyis zab cing rgya che'i chos ni mang po bstan/ /nyams len nus na thar pa dang ni thams cad mkhyen pa thob par nges/ /sangs rgyas dngos dang mjal yang de las lhag pa'i gzhan zhig byed rgyu med/ /gzhan yang thugs kyis brtse bas zas gos gnas mal yan chad gnang ba dang / /nad gdon bar chad 'jigs las bskyabs shing sha tsha'i bslab bya bstan pa sogs/ /bka' drin stong gsum gser gyis bkang nas phul kyang gzhal bar ga la nus/ /rang la sangs rgyas las kyang bla ma rnams ni bka' drin lhag par che/ /rtag tu gus pas mnyes pa sgrub cing mi mnyes bya ba spang bar bya/ /de ltar nus par spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang bo'i byen gyis rlobs/ /drin can glu ma dam pa mnyes na mig dang snying yang cis mi 'bul/ /sangs rgyas slob pa lam gyi gnas skabs chos tshig re re gsan pa'i phyir/ /sku lus mar me stong tsho btsugs shing lcags gzer stong tsho btab pa dang / /bu dang bu mo mnga' thang longs spyod thams cad 'phangs med phul pa dang / /rtag tu ngu yis chos 'phags bsten phyir gzhan la sku sha rus pa btsongs/ /lus kyi rtsa chen phug nas sa la khrag gis chag chag btab pa dang / /mnyam med jo bo chen pos bla ma gser gling pa la byang chub 293

sems/ /zhu ba'i phyir du rgya mtsho chen por zhugs nas dka' ba spyad pa dang / /'brom gyis jo bo nā ros te lo mi las mar ba bsten pa sogs/ /dam pa gong ma rnams kyis chos phyir lus dang longs spyod thams cad la/ /'phangs pa med par dka' ba bsam gyis mi khyab mang po spyad pa bzhin/ /bdag kyang bla ma mnyes phyir zas nor rab tu gces dgu ma lus 'bul/ /bya bar dka' zhing byed du mi rung ba zhig gsungs kyang 'di nyid la/ /phan pa'i dgos pa ci yod mi shes snyam du tsham tshom med par 'jug /yang na gtan nas mi 'grub mi rung 'dug na tshig gis bshad sbyangs bya/ /sku mnye dril phyis gdan 'bul bsnyung g.yog bza' btung phud kyis rtag tu mchod/ /bstod pa'i dbyangs kyis gsol ba 'debs shing yon tan phyogs mtshams kun tu sgogs/ /lus srog longs spyod rnams la 'phangs sems med par bla ma'i phyogs su gtong / /khyad par bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i mchod pas bla ma shin tu dgyes pas na/ /bla ma rnams kyis bstan pa'i chos la thos bsam bsgom gsum nan tan bya/ /de ltar nus par spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i byin gyis rlobs/ /bla ma tshu' bzhin bsten na sangs rgyas go 'phang mchog nye rgyal rnams dgyes/ /dge ba'i bshes kyis mi phongs pa dang 294

ngan 'gro'i gnas su mi ltung dang / /las nyon gnyis kyis thub par dka' dang byang sems spyod par mi 'gal zhing / /de la dran pa dang ldan yon tan tshogs kyis je mtho je mthor 'gyur/ /mdor na gnas skabs mthar thug bsam don thams cad myur du 'grub par gsungs/ /tshul bzhin ma bsten bla ma rnams kyi bka' bcag thugs dkrugs sogs byas na/ /mi 'dod sna tshogs 'ong zhing ngan 'gror skye bas shin tu 'dzem par bya/ /de ltar nus par spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i byen gyis rlobs/ /bla ma thams cad dgyes bzhin slar yang thub dbang thugs gar thim par gyur/ /tshe sngon tshul khrims bsrungs shing tshogs bsags smon lam rnam dag btab pa'i mthus/ /da re dge slong dge bsnyen pha ma rnam bzhi med pa'i mtha' 'khob dang / /glen lkugs yan lag nying lag rna ba la sogs dbang po ma tshang dang / /tshe la snga phyi las 'bras dkon mchog med par 'dzin pa'i log lta dang / /yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'byung ba med pa'i rgyal ba'i bka' med dang / /dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro gsum dang 'du shes med pa'i tshe ring lha/ /mi khom de dag rnams su ma skyes dam chos sgrub la khom pa yi/ /dal ba phun sum tshogs pa thob pa'i dus 'dir chos la brtson par 295

bya/ /de ltar nus par spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i byin gyis rlobs/ dam pa'i lha chos sgrub pa'i rten bzang mi yi lus rten thob pa dang / /gangs can bod 'dir dge slong dge bsnyen pha ma rnam bzhi ma tshang yang / /dge slong pha ni yod na don gye yul dbus yin pas yul dbus skyes/ /glen lkugs sogs su ma skyes yan lag nying lag mig sogs dbang po tshang / /mtshams med las di ma byas byed du ma bcug las mtha' ma log dang / /dkar chos thams cad skye gnas 'dul ba mdo sde mngon par dad pa dang / /'byon dka'i sangs rgyas 'jig rten khams su byon dang des chos bstan pa dang //bstan pa ma nub tsam du gnas dang de yi rjes su 'jug pa dang / /gzhan gyi snying nas brtse bas rang la zas gos mthun rkyen ster ba ste/ /'byor ba phun sum tshogs pa'i dus 'dir dam pa'i lha chos bsgrub par bya/ /de ltar nus par spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i byen gyis rlobs/ /da re blang dor ma nor ba zhig byas na mngon mtho lha mi dang / /nges legs thar pa dang ni thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang mchog de yang / /snyigs dus tshe thung gcig la 'thob par nus pa'i dal 'byor rten bzang 'di/ /da re rang gis rnyed pa yid bzhin nor bu las kyang lhag 296

par 'dug /rnyed dka' don che'i lus rten bzang po ci'i phyir 'bras bu med par byed/ /ngan song la sogs mi khom gnas su bskal pa brgyad khrir btsal gyur kyang / /rnyed dka'i rten 'di don med byas nas slar yang gnas der log gyur na/ /bdag ni spyos sam gdon gyis zin nam yang na sems ni med par nges/ /de phyir da re bdag gis dam pa'i chos kyi snying po ci lon bya/ /de ltar nus par spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i byen gyis rlobs/ /rgya mtshor gnya' shing bu gar rus sbal mgrin chud bas kyang ngan 'gro las/ /dal 'byor tshang ba'i mi lus thob pa shin tu dka' ba sangs rgyas gsungs/ /gyang logs ngos la sran ma gtor ba re re tsam min chags pa dkon/ /de bzhin ngan 'gror skye ba sran ma sa la lhung ba'i tshod dang mnyam/ /mi lus thob pa re re chags pa 'dra zhes dam pa gong mas gsungs/ /bde 'gro tsam zhig thob la tshul khrims sna gcig bsrung ba yan chad dgos/ /khyad par dal 'byor mi lus thob la tshul khrims rnam dag gzhi bzung zhing / /sbyin pa sogs kyis grogs byas smon lam dri med rnam dag mtshams sbyor dgos/ /rgyu de da lta bsgrub pa'ang nyung bas dal 'byor rten bzang thob pa dkon/ /dmyal ba rnams las yi dwags nyung zhing yi dwags rnams las 297

dud 'gro nyung / /dud 'gro gzhan tsho phar zhog ri klung zhig la gnas pa'i srin bu la/ /bod yul mi yi grangs tsam 'dug pas mi lus nyin skar bzhin du dkon/ /da re tshe mjug 'di la gtan gyi btsan sa zin par ma byas na/ /phyin chad mi lus rnyed par dka' 'dug da ni snying po len par bya/ /de ltar nus par spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i byen gyis rlobs/ /shin tu rnyed dka'i dal 'byor rten bzang thob kyang dam chos sgrub pa la/ /ga le sos dal byed pa'i long med myur du mi rtag 'jig par nges/ /lus ni ci 'dra blangs kyang 'chi bas mi tshugs pa ni gcig tsam med/ /sngon byon yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas skye 'chir rang dbang thob rnams kyang / /gdul bya rtag 'dzin can rnams chos la bskul phyir mya ngan 'das tshul bstan/ /drang srong chen po mngon shes lnga dang ldan rnams dpag tshad mang po yi/ /nam mkhar bya bzhin 'gro ba la sogs rdzu 'phrul can rnams thams cad kyang / /sdod pa'i thabs ni ma rnyed grongs na rang nyid lta bu smos ci dgos/ /tshangs pa brgya byen dga' bo 'jog po 'khor los bsgyur rgyal rnams kyang shi /rgya gar bod yul mkhas grub rgyal blon byang chub sems dpa' thams cad gshegs/ /rang gi pha ma mkhan slob grogs mched dgra gnyen 298

bar ma mang po shi /sngon chad skyes pa'i mi rnams tshe thar lus pa mthong thos gcig kyang med/ /yod dam med dam snyam pa'i the tshom 'jug pa tsam yang mi srid na//rang nyid gcig pu dmigs bsal byas nas 'chi mi dgos pa ga la 'ong / /yul phyogs gang du bsdad kyang 'chi ba mi 'ong sa phyogs gang yang med/ /'chi bar bros pas mi thar rdzas sngags sman sogs rkyen gyis bzlog tu med/ /tshe la snon pa cung zad tsam med 'brid byed bar ma chad du yod/ /da lta lo brgya thub pa dkon pas drug cu thub pa'i dbang byas kyang / /tshe lo drug cu lon pa'i mi tsho sang 'chi gnangs 'chi lta bu yin//tshe lo lnga bcu lon pa'i mi tsho tshe lhag lo bcu tsam min med/ /de bzhin mi rnams la las sum gnyis la las tshe phyed song ba mang / /tshe yi lhag ma cung zad yod pa lo zla zhag gis myur du 'dzad/ /gson pa'i tshe yang dam chos byed pa'i skabs ni cung zad tsam min med/ /gzhon nu'i dus su dam chos mi dran rgas dus dran kyang chos mi nus/ /bar gyi tshe la phyed ka gnyid kyis khyer zhing phyed ka rnam g.yeng dang / /bza' btung na ba sogs kyis khyer ba'i shul na dam chos byed pa la/ /mi lo lnga drug tsam min med pas dam chos sgrub khom med par 'chi/ /des na tshe 'di'i phun tshogs ji ltar 'dzom rung rmi lam — 299

thun gcig na/ /bde ba spyad pa sad nas dran ltar 'chi dus dran pa'i yul du 'gyur/ /'chi ba'i dgra ni dgag tu med par rang gi thog tu nges par 'ong / /khrid nas 'jig rten pha rol rgyus med cha med gnas su 'gro dgos na/ /sems yod skyes bu su zhig tshe 'di'i bslu brid dag la dga' zhing chags/ /da ni tshe 'di'i phun tshogs spangs nas phyi mar skyid pa'i chos shig bya//de ltar nus par spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i byin gyis rlobs/ /'chi bar ma zad nam 'chi cha med do nub yin yang 'chi nyen yod/ /'dzam gling tshe la nges pa cang med la la btsas ma thag tu 'chi/ /la la gzhon nu dar bab dus su glo bur nad mtshon dug gis 'chi/ /kha sang yod pa'i mi rnams de ring thi ba thos pas shul gyi mis/ /la la na re kha sang nged gnyis za ma zos nas lhan cig bsdad/ /zla ba phyi ma'i grabs shom mang byas glo bur shi ba u shi zer/ /la la na re de yis mi tshad da nang nged gnyis kha ta byas/ /a kha snying rje lo cang ma lon na gzhon 'chi ni ma ran zer/ /de 'dra ba zhig rang la de ring tsam la mi 'ong nges pa med/ /'chi rkyen mang zhing gson rkyen nyung bas dug btang mtshon gyis brgyab pa dang / /gnod sbyin rgyal po btsan dang ma mo sogs kyis srog ni 'phrog pa dang / /glo bur chus khyer 300

mes tshig g.yang la lhung dang gad pa dib pa dang / /gza' rgod gdong thug la sogs rkyen mang char rlung gseb kyi mar me 'dra/ /gson rkyen zas gos sman sogs yin kyang zas dug sman ni ma 'phrod dang / /byes pa gos kyis bsrung dang gnas khang rdib dang mdza' bos bslus pa dang / /gson pa'i rkyen yang 'chi ba'i rkyen du 'gyur bas gson rkyen mi snang ngo / /lus 'di shin tu nyam chung bas na nam 'chi nges pa med pa yin/ /chu yi lbu ba lta bu'i lus la nad gdon chen po mi dgos par/ /tsher ma zug pa tsam gyi rkyen la snyad btags 'jig par 'gyur bas na/ /'chi rkyen cung zad tsam gyis sgyu lus gzhom par shin tu sla ba yin/ /de bas nam 'chi cha med myur du chos shig mi byed sdod ri shi /mi phan tshe 'di'i bya ba mgar ba shi ba'i lag cha bzhin du bsgyur/ /da lta da ltar 'chi nyen 'dug pas chos kyis nyin mtshan 'da' bar bya/ /de ltar nus par spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i byin gyis rlobs/ /'chi ba zer ba'i 'brug bzhin grags pa'i 'chi bdag thog dang 'dra ba de/ /nges par thog tu bab tshe dam chos ma gtogs gang gis phan pa med/ /brtse gdung che ba'i gnyen gyis mi phan 'grogs nas phyi mar 'khrid dbang med/ /yid du 'ong ba'i nor gyis mi phan ji snyed yod 301

kyang 'khyer sa med/ /lhan cig 'grogs pa'i lus kyis mi phan shul du bzhag nas pha rol 'gro/ /mo sman rim gros mi bzlog mkhas pa'i ngag gis zhu ba byed du med/ /dpa' mdzangs dmag gis bsrung bar mi nus rgyu nor dngos pos blu mi nus/ /dpa' bos mtshon gyis mi bzlog sdar mas lkog tu bros nas 'gro sa med/ /mi 'di lo cang ma lon da dung 'chi ni ma ran bshad sa med/ /bu gcig 'di las med pas bu 'di mkho bas zhog ces bshad sa med/ /mi 'di yul sde bza' tshang kun la dgos pas zhog ces bshad sa med/ /mi 'di yar la ma rgas mar la mi gzhon zhog ces bshad sa med/ /rgan rgon sha zad rus zad 'di 'dra dgos med zhog ces bshad sa med/ /de tshe lus la nad kyis gdungs shing sha dang khrag skam bkrag mdangs nyams/ /mo sman rim gros bor nas rkang lag g.yab cing dbugs sgra ngar ngar 'don/ /ci zhig zos kyang dang kha mi bde mngar mo zos kyang kha mor tshor/ /mal gyi tha mar nyal zhing zas kyi tha ma chu thigs tsam re 'thung / /nye du 'brel bas mtha' nas bskor zhing gdong la hrig trig blta ba'i tshe/ /srog gcod nad ni bgo bsha' mi thub sdug bsngal rang nyid gcig pus myong / /dbugs kyi 'gyu ba chad das kha gdangs so gtsigs ro la ling 302

gis song / /de tshe nye 'brel rnams kyis shi zer thag gus bsdams nas yol bas bsgribs/ /ngu 'bod byed cing gza' skar brtsi dang shi dge dur 'debs shoms ra 'dings/ /tshe 'dir ser snas bsags pa'i zas nor rang gis spyad par ma phod pa/ /gnyen grogs 'khor gyis ci bder spyod cing rang nyid lag pa stong pa ru/ /cha med bar do'i 'phrang ring lam la rgyus med gcig pur 'gro dus 'gyod/ /ngan song 'jigs pa chen po mthong tshe rab tu skrag nas glo snying 'dar/ /de tshe mgon skyabs dkon mchog gsum dang phan pa dge ba ma gtogs med/ /de 'dra'i dus shig ring por mi 'gor 'ong zhing nam 'ong cha med pas/ /mi phan tshe 'di'i gnyen bshes nor rdzas rnams la zhen pas ci zhig bya/ /thams cad shul du bzhag nas 'gro bas gang la chags med zhen med bya/ /thag ring phyi ma'i lam la 'gro dus phan pa'i brgyags phye chos kho na/ /da ni sdod grabs byas pas ci bya 'jig rten phyi mar 'gro grabs byed/ /da lta da ltar 'chi brod tshags su tshud pa'i dam chos rnam dag bya/ /de ltar nus par spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i byin gyis rlobs/ /rnyed dka' don che'i dal 'byor tshang ba'i rten 'di mi rtag myur du 'jig /zhig pa'i 'og tu rtswa phung bsreg ltar med nas mi 'gro skye dgos 303

la/ /skyes na bde 'gro ngan 'gro gnyis min ma gtogs gzhan du skye sa med/ /bde 'gro ngan 'gro gang skye rang la dbang med las ni rang dbang che/ /dge dang mi dge'i las kyis ji ltar 'phangs pa bzhin du skye bar 'gyur/ /mi dge'i las kyis ngan song gsum du skyes pa sdug bsngal bzod par dka'/ /'di nas dpag tshad sum khri nyis stong 'og na dmyal ba yang sos yod/ /de nas dpag tshad bzhi stong bzhi stong chod pa'i 'og na gzhan bdun yod/ /dmyal ba yang sos gnas su skyes pa'i sems cam 'tshogs nas las dbang gis/ /byung ba'i mtshon cha sna tshogs rim gyis byung ba rnams kyis gcig la gcig /brdeg par byed cing de nas brgyal de thams cad sa la 'gyel ba dang / /mkha' las khyed rnams da yang sos par gyur cig ces pa'i sgra 'byung ngo / /de nas sos te langs nas sngar ltar brdeg cing sdug bsngal dpag med myong / /dmyal ba thig nag gnas su skyes pa'i sems can dmyal srung rnams kyis bzung / /thig nag btab ste sog les 'gra zhing mtshon chas gshags nas sdug bsngal myong / /dmyal ba bsdus 'joms gnas su skyes pa'i sems can gcig tu 'dus pa'i tshe/ /dmyal srung rnams kyis lcags kyi ri bo ra lug rta dang glang po che/ /seng ge stag gi 304

gdong ba 'dra ba gnyis re'i bar du 'tshir bar byed/ /de 'dra'i bar du bcir nas sgo rnams kun nas khrag gi rgyun 'bab cing / /de nas ri gnyis gyes pas thams cad sos te sngar bzhin 'dus pa na/ /lcags kyi 'phrul 'khor chen po'i nang du bcug nas bur shing btsir bzhin 'tshir/ /de nas phyi ru phyung nas sos te 'dus pa'i tshe na yar steng nas/ /lcags kyi pha bong chen po lhung nas lcags kyi gzhi la gcod pa dang / /'byed dang brdungs dang dmyal bar byed pa'i dus su khrag gi rgyun 'bab bo/ /dmyal ba ngu 'bod gnas su skyes pa'i sems can de dag gnas 'tshol tshe/ /lcags kyi khang ba'i nang du phyin nas de ma thag tu sgo 'grigs te/ /lcags khang nang nas me 'bar bsreg nas 'gro sa mi 'dug snyam du ngu / /dmyal ba ngu 'bod chen po'i gnas skyes sems can lcags khang nyis rim gyi/ /nang du zhugs tshe de ma thag tu sgo 'grigs nang nas me 'bar bas/ /lus kun bsregs pas 'gro sa mi rnyed snyam du ngu 'bod chen po byed/ /tsha ba'i dmyal ba'i gnas su skyes pa'i sems can dmyal srung rnams kyis bzung / /lcags zangs dpag tshad du ma yod pa tsha zhing 'bar ba'i nang du bsregs/ /lcags kyi gsal shing rab tu 'bar bas 'phongs nas phug ste spyi bor 'byin/ /kha 305

dang mig dang sna dang rna ba'i bu ga ba spu'i khong bu nas/ /me lce 'bar dang lcags kyi sa gzhi rab tu 'bar la gan rkyal lam/ /kha sbub bzhag ste lcags kyi tho ba tsha zhing rab tu 'bar bas brdungs/ /rab tu tsha ba'i dmyal bar skyes pa'i sems can dmyal srung rnams kyis bzung / /lcags kyi gsal shing rtse gsum 'bar ba 'phongs su btsugs nas rtse mo gsum/ /phrag gnyis spyi bor 'byin cing kha sogs sgo rnams kun nas me lce 'bar/ /lcags leb tsha zhing 'bar bas lus po yongs su snam bu dkris bzhin dkri/ /lcags zangs chen por khro chu khol ba'i nang du 'tshod cing sha khrag rnams/ /zhig nas keng rus lta bur gyur tshe phyir phyung lcags kyi sa gzhir 'grems/ /sha khrag skyes tshe nang du 'jug cing lhag ma gzhan ni tsha ba 'dra/ /mnar med dmyal ba'i shar phyogs sa gzhi dpag tshad brgya phrag du ma zhig /yod pa kun tu 'bar zhing mched de me dpung 'bar ba'i shugs 'ong nas/ /de ru skyes pa'i sems can rnams kyi pags pa sha khrag rim gyis 'tshig /mar me'i sdong bu bzhin du lus po thams cad me yis khyab cing 'bar/ /phyogs gzhan gsum nas de bzhin me 'bar 'ong bas phyogs bzhi'i me rnams 'dres/ /nyam thag ngu ba'i skad kyis sems can yin pa shes tsam ma gtogs 306

pa/ /me dang lus gnyis lhan cig 'ur 'ur chem chem 'bar bas lus mi mthong / /lcags kyi gzhib ma'i nang du lcags kyi 'dag ma 'bar ba 'khrab tu 'jug /lcags kyi sa gzhir lcags kyi ri la 'bab 'jeg byed du 'jug pa dang / /kha nas lce phyung lcags kyi phur bas glang gi ko ba bzhin du rgyongs/ /lcags kyi sa gzhir gan rkyal bzhag nas lcags kyi 'byed byed dag gis kha/ /phye nas lcags kyi thu lum 'bar ba kha ru 'jug par byed pa dang / /khro chu khol ba kha ru blugs nas khog rnams tshig nas smad nas 'byung / /lhag ma gzhan ni yod pa rab tu tsha ba'i dmyal ba ji bzhin no/ /de dag gnod pa rags pa tsam yin gzhan yang gnod pa sna tshogs yod/ /mi yi me las bskal pa 'jig pa'i me ni bdun 'gyur tsha ba dang / /de las tsha ba'i dmyal ba brgyad kyi me ni bdun 'gyur tsha ba yin/ /dmyal ba'i me la bltas na mi yi me ni kha ba tsam du bsil/ /mi yi me yis bsreg pa'i lus la chu yis reg na bsil ba ltar/ /dmyal mes bsreg pa'i lus la mi'i mes reg na bsil sangs 'gro zhes gsungs/ /sdug bsngal de dag rnams ni yun thung tsam zhig myong bas mi chog ste/ /dmyal ba brgyad po'i nang gi tshe thung dmyal ba yang sos tshe tshad ni/ /mi lo khrag khrig gcig dang ther 'bum 307

chen po drug dang ther 'bum gnyis/ /yine cing dmyal ba 'og ma 'og ma nyis 'gyur nyis 'gyur tshe ring zhing / /ji srid mi dge'i sdig pa ma zad bar du srog dang 'bral mi 'gyur/ /da lta'i dus 'dir rang gis spyod tshul ngan pa 'di la phar bltas na/ /da dung de las yun ring ba zhig mi 'ong nges pa ci zhig yod/ /da lta lus la me stag lhung ba skad cig tsam yang mi bzod na/ /sdug bsngal de dag thog tu babs na yun ring phyong dgos su yis bzod/ /'di dang phyi ma de gnyis bar na dbugs kyi 'gyu ba 'di min med/ /do nub tsam la shi nas glo bur de ru lhung na ci zhig bya/ /kye ma kye hud tshe 'di'i kha rgyab phyir du mi dge las ngan bsags/ /a tsa ma nga sngon chad spyos sam gdon gyis zin nam ci yin nam/ /de la 'jigs par spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i byin gyis rlobs/ /dmyal ba brgyad po de dag re re la yang rtsig ngos bzhi bzhi dang / /sgo yang bzhi bzhi yod pas de dag phyi rol lcags kyi ra bas bskor/ /ra ba la yang sgo ni bzhi bzhi yod cing sgo de re re na/ /nye 'khor dmyal ba lhag pa 'di rnams yod de me ma mur gyi 'obs/ /rab tu tsha ngar che ba pus mo man chad nub pa tsam yod la/ /mi dge'i las kyis de ru skyes pa'i sems can de dag gnas 'tshol tshe/ /'gro 308

ba'i dus na de ru rkang ba bzhag tshe pags pa sha khrag 'jig /rkang pa yar la bteg pa'i tshe na slar yang myur du sha pags skye/ /de yi 'dabs na phyi sa'i 'dam ni yod la de ru skyes pa yi/ /sems can gnas 'tshol rnams kyis brgal —tshe 'dam der mgo bo man chad tshud/ /de nas mchu rnon 'bu yis lus kun 'bigs shing rkang la gtugs nas 'bru/ /de yi 'dabs na spu gri'i lam yod de ru skyes pa'i sems can gyis/ /rkang ba bzhag tshe pags pa sha khrag gcod cing bteg tshe sha pags skye/ /de yi 'dabs na nags tshal ral gri'i lo ma can zhes bya ba yod/ /de ru skyes pa'i sems can gnas 'tshol de dag thams cad nags tshal der/ /song nas nags tshal de yi bsil grib rnams la brten cing 'khod pa na/ /shing las ral gri babs te yan lag nying lag gcod cing lus kun gshags/ /sa la 'gyel tshe khye ni sre bo mang po 'ong ste rgyab nas za/ /de yi 'dabs na shal ma li yi sdong po yod de sems can der/ /song ba de la 'dzeg tu 'jug cing 'dzeg tshe tshar ma rnams kyi kha/ /thur du blta la 'bab tshe gyen du bltas nas lus kun gshags par byed/ /khwa lcags mchu can bya bas mgo dang phrag gong babs nas mig 'bras 'bru/ /de yi 'dabs na tsha ngar che ba'i chu klung rab med 309

ces bya yod/ /der skyes sems can nang der 'tshod cing steng 'og 'gro zhing bsreg par byed/ /dper na me cher sbar bas zangs chu khol ba'i nang du nas blugs 'dra/ /gshin rje'i pho nya mang po bsdad nas phyi ru 'ong du mi ster la/ /'ong ba rnams ni lcags kyi sa gzhi rab tu 'bar la gan rkyal bzhag /ci 'dod 'dri la de dag rnams kyis skrag nas ci yang mi 'dod zer/ /'on kyang bkres so skom mo zer na kha ru zangs zhun khol ma dang / /lcags kyi thu lum 'bar ba bcug nas skom zhing bkres na 'di zo zer/ /de dag rnams kyi tshe tshad nges pa med par sa yi dngos gzhir bshad/ /'on kyang mi dge sdig pa'i las kyi nus pa ma zad de srid du/ /srog dang 'bral bar mi 'gyur sdug bsngal de dag yun ring nyams su myong / /de la 'jigs par spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i byin gyis rlobs/ /grang dmyal brgyad ni tsha ba'i dmyal ba chen po brgyad kyi thad so yi/ /byang gi phyogs na dpag tshad khri phrag re re'i pha rol de na yod/ /kun gyi 'og gzhi thams cad kha ba'i thang dang 'khyag pa'i chab rom dang / /mtha' rnams gangs ris bskor zhing steng nas rgyun tu kha ba bu yug 'tshubs/ /kha ba bu yug rlung gis bskyod nas phyogs bzhir lus la 'debs par byed/ /'di nas dpag tshad 310

sum khri nyis stong 'og na chu bur can yod de/ /de nas dpag tshad nyis stong nyis stong chod pa'i 'og na gzhan bdun yod/ /grang ba'i dmyal ba chu bur can gyi gnas su skyes pa'i sems can rnams/ /lus la gon pa med pas gcer bur grang nas chu bur byung zhing 'khums/ /de yi 'og na grang ba'i dmyal ba chu bur rdol ba'i gnas yod de/ /de ru skyes pa'i sems can rab tu grang bas chu bur rdol bzhin 'khums/ /de 'og grang ba'i dmyal ba so tham gnas yod de ru skyes pa yi/ /sems can grang bas skad 'don mi thub so ni 'tham 'tham byed pa dang / /de yi 'og na grang ba'i dmyal ba kyi hud zer ba'i gnas yod de/ /der skyes sems can grang bas skad 'don mi nus shub bus kye hud zer/ /de yi 'og na grang ba'i dmyal ba a chu zer ba'i gnas yod de/ /de ru skyes pa'i sems can grang bas des kyang shub bus a chu zer/ /de 'og grang ba'i dmyal ba ut+pal ltar du gas pa'i gnas yod de/ /de ru sgyes pa'i sems can lus la kha rlung chen pos btab pa yis/ /lus ni kha dog sngo zhing ser kha lnga'am drug tu gas pa'o/ /de yi 'og na grang ba'i dmyal ba pad+ma ltar gas gnas yod de/ /der skyes sems can grang bas mdog dmar kha bcu de las mang bar gas/ /de 'og grang ba'i dmyal 311

ba pad+ma chen po ltar gas gnas yod de/ /der skyes sems can mdog ni shin tu dmar zhing kha brgya tsam du gas/ /gong ma gong ma rnams las 'og ma 'og ma bdun 'gyur grang ba yin/ /sdug bsngal yun thung tsam min dper na ma ga rnya yi bre bo che'i/ /til khal brgyad cu shong ba'i bang ba til gyis phyur bur gang ba zhig /mi lo brgya brgya 'das nas til de re re phyi ru bor ba na/ /til 'bru zad nas bang ba stongs pa'i yun de lta bu chu bur can/ /tshe yi tshad yin de 'dra nyi shu chu bur rdol pa'i tshe tshad dang / /de bzhin snga ma snga ma las kyang phyi ma phyi ma nyi shur 'phar/ /de la cung zad tsam yang mi skrag da dung tshe 'di'i lto rgyab phyir/ /sdig la hab thob byed mkhan rang snying rul lam lcags las byas sam ci/ /de la 'jigs par spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i byin gyis rlobs/ /nyi tshe ba ni tsha dmyal grang dmyal rnams kyi nye 'khor dag na yod/ /la la mi yul na yang yod pas gnas la nges pa med pa yin/ /mang nyung ma nges la la mang zhing la la gnyis sam gcig las med/ /sdug bsngal mtha' gcig ma nges gtun dang ka pa thab dang thag pa dang / /khro zangs phyags ma rkam pa la sogs dbyibs dang ldan pa'i lus blangs nas/ /sdug bsngal mi zad yun ring myong zhing tshe la nges 312

pa med pa yin/ /'on kyang sdig pa'i rgyu de ma zad bar du 'bras bu sdug bsngal myong / /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal nang nas ngan song sdug bsngal bzod par dka' ba yin/ /de yi nang nas dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal skad cig tsam yang bzod glags med/ /tshe 'dir nyin gcig mdung rnon sum brgyas bar ma chad du btab pa yi/ /sdug bsngal de la dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal chung ngu tsam gyi char yang med/ /dmyal ba rnams kyi nang nas mnar med dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal ches che ste/ /de dag rnams su skye ba'i rgyu ni tshe 'dir srog gcod byas pa dang / /ma byen pa blangs mi tshangs spyad dang rdzun dang phra ma tshig rtsub bshad/ /ngag 'khyal smra dang brnab sems gnod sems log lta chen po byas pa rnams/ /skye zhes gsung rab rnams su lan cig ma yin yang dang yang du gsungs/ /khyad par mtshams med lnga byas log lta skyes dang pham pa bzhi spyad dang / /so thar nyes byas khyad du bsad na tsha ba'i dmyal ba yang sos skye/ /sor bshags khyad du bsad na dmyal ba thig nag gnas su skye bar gsungs/ /byang sems rtsa ba'i ltung ba byung dang byang chub sems dpa' la dmigs pa'i/ /khong khro skyes na khong khro skad cig ma ni ci tsam skyes pa yi/ /grangs dang mnyam pa'i bskal par dmyal bar 313

gnas dgos spyod 'jug las gsungs pas/ /'di la shin tu shin tu 'dzem dgos byang sems gang na yod mi shes/ /gsang sngags rtsa lhung byung na sor ma chud kyi bar la skad cig ma/ /ci tsam yod pa'i grangs mnyam mnar med gnas dgos rgyud sde rnams las gsungs/ /bla mar dmigs pa'i khong khro skyes na bskal par bsags pa'i dge rtsa 'joms/ /khong khro skad cig ma ni ci tsam skyes pa'i grangs dang mnyam pa yi/ /bskal par dmyal ba'i gnas su sdod dgos dus 'khor rtsa rgyud las gsungs phyir/ /rang gis sngon chad 'di 'dra'i mi dge'i las ngan mang po bsags yod pas/ /shi na dmyal bar skye nges skyes na de dus rang gis ci zhig bya/ /de la 'jigs par spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i byen gyis rlobs/ /yi dwags byings gnas 'dzam gling 'di 'og dpag tshad lnga brgya 'das pa na/ /grong khyer ser skya zhes bya rtswa chu shing sogs 'dod pa'i dngos po med/ /de ru skyes pa de dag sha khrag bskams shing mdog nag gdong skras khebs/ /shin tu kha bskams lce yis bldeg cing phyi sgrib can gyi yi dwags kyis/ /chu mig mtsho dang mtshe'u mthong nas phyin na mtshon cha thogs pas bsrung / /btung du mi ster la las rnag khrag sogs su mthong nas 'thung mi 'dod/ /nang gi 314

sgrib pa can gyi yi dwags kha ni khab kyi mig tsam dang / /mgrin pa rta lnga tsam dang yan lag 'jag skya tsam dang lto ba'i tshad/ /ri gtos tsam yod zas skom mi rnyed rnyed kyang kha ru mi shong zhing / /cung zad shong yang mgrin par mi thar thar kyang lto ba mi khengs shing / /khengs kyang rkang lag rnams kyis mi theg sdug bsngal sngar bas che ba myong / /zas skom sgrib pa can gyis zas skom spyad na me 'bar lus po 'tshig /ljan ljin za ba zhes byas bshang gci spyod dang kha cig rang sha za/ /de dag rnams la dgun dus nyi ma grang la dpyid dus zla ba'ang tsha/ /kha 'thor mi yi yul na yod gsungs tshe tshad mi yi zla ba gcig /zhag tu byas pas rang lo lnga brgya lnga stong khri sogs thub par bshad/ /de ru skye ba'i rgyu ni mi dge bcu po 'bring tsam byas pa dang / /khyad par ser sna shas cher brten dang brnab sems mang po byas pa dang / /gzhan gyi nor rdzas ma byen pa rnams blangs pa la sogs yin zhes gsungs/ /shi nas sngar byas las kyis de 'dra zhig tu skyes na ci zhig bya/ /de la 'jigs par spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i byin gyis rlobs/ /dud 'gro byings na gnas pa ri rab chu mtshams man chad khong gseng gi /mun par rab tu gnag par yod pas lus kyi che chung mdog dbyibs sogs/ /ma nges sna 315

tshogs chang gi sbang ma lta bur yod pas che ba yis/ /chung ba khyur mid byed cing chung ba mang po 'dus nas che ba za/ /lus po phar thal tshur thal 'bigs shing mun pa shin tu gnag pa yis/ /lag pa'i brkyang bskums tsam yang mi mthong che bas chung ba rab tu mnan/ /dbugs kyis 'byung rngubs tsam yang mi nus sdug bsngal yun ring nyams su myong / /dud 'gro kha 'thor lha dang mi yi yul na yod pa thams cad ni/ /ri dwags rnams ni rngon pa khyi yis bdas nas bros kyang mi thar gsod/ /phan tshun gcig gis gcig gsod srog chags phra mo nyi mas 'tshig pa dang / /dud 'gro klu yi rigs su gyur pa bye tshan mkha' lding 'jigs pa dang / /lha dang mi yi dbang du gyur pa rnams ni bkol dang sna 'bigs shing / /mi theg bzhin du khal 'gel 'phongs pa brdung tshe ro smad 'khyogs nas 'gro/ /ma bzod 'u thug 'gyel la khad byas lus po na tshas gang bzhin 'khur/ /'phongs zad rgyab rnams sgal pas khengs kyang sos dal nyin gcig sdod dbang med/ /la la sha khrag ched du sa la bsgyel nas gsod grabs byas pa'i tshe/ /skrag nas gsod mkhan ngo la mig gis hrig hrig bltas kyang dbang med du/ /kha bsum yang na gri yis mgo gcod yang na lto ba phral nas gsod/ /gzhan yang 316

dbang po gcod dang spu bregs rmo dang bcings dang bzho ba dang / /bkres shing skom dang tsha grang la sogs sdug bsngal dpag tu med pa yod/ /mtha' dag blun zhing lkugs pa blang dor mi shes lam gyi snod mi rung / /tshe tshad ring mtha' bskal par gnas dang thung ba snga dro phyi dro tsam/ /dud 'gror skye ba'i rgyu ni mi dge bcu po chung ngu spyad pa dang / /khyad par chos spangs pa dang chos dang chos smra ba la ma gus dang / /bstan la zhugs pa rnams kyis phan tshun skyon brjod byas pa sogs yin gsungs/ /shi nas las kyi dbang gis de 'dra zhig tu skyes na ci zhig bya/ /de la 'jigs par spyi bo'i bla ma thurba pa'i dbang po'i byin gyis rlobs/ /mdor na da lta lag pa me dong bcug nas zhag gcig sdod pa dang / /dgun gyi kha rlung 'tshub dus gos med gcer bur zhag gcig sdod pa dang / /nyi ma gsum bzhi tsam la bza' btung gang yang med par sdod pa dang / /sa rdo mang po'i khrod du bsgul bskyod mi nus sdod dgos lta bu zhig /byung na bzod bsran su yis mi thub mngon sum grub pa de ltar na/ /ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal stobs che shugs drag bzod par ga la nus/ /shi nas sngar byas las kyi dbang gis de ru skyes na ci zhig bya/ /de la 'jigs par spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang 317

po'i byin gyis rlobs/ /chos kyi sgra tsam mi thos mun bskal mtshan mo sprin nag 'khrigs pa yi/ /smag rum lta bu chos dang mjal rgyu yod pa'i sgron bskal smag rum na/ /glog rgyu bzhin du dkon pa'i sngon chad sdig pa rgya mtsho tsam bsags nas/ /dge ba ku sha'i rtser blangs chu thigs bzhin du bsags pa shin tu nyung / /de yi steng du mi tshe 'dir yang mi dge'i las ni mang po bsags/ /dge ba legs po nyin gcig byas pa rang la dran rgyu mi 'dug pas/ /shi ma thag tu ngan song gnas su lhung nas sdug bsngal myong bar nges/ /dper na rang la gnod pa'i dgra zhig lo gcig tshun la 'ong nges shing / /de yi bar la nam 'ong cha med shes na dal bar mi sdod par/ /pha rol dgra yi 'jigs las skyob mkhan dpon zhig myur du 'tshol dgos ltar/ /ngan song sdug bsngal rang gi thog tu lo brgya tshun la 'ong nges shing / /zla ba phyi ma mnar med dmyal ba gnyis kyi gang snga cha med par/ /shes nas ngan song 'jigs las skyobs pa'i skyabs shig myar du 'tshol re ran/ /dper na pha rol dgra las stobs dang kha drag chung ba'i dpon zhig gis/ /rang nyid pha rol dgra yi 'jigs las skyob par mi nus ji bzhin du/ /tshangs pa khyab 'jug dbang phyug la sogs lha mi mthu bo che bsten kyang / /ngan song 'jigs 318

las skyob par mi nus dper na pha rol dgra bo las/ /stobs dang mnga' thang che ba'i dpon gyis rang nyid dgra yi 'jigs pa las/ /skyob par nus bzhin ngan 'gro'i 'jigs las dkon mchog gsum gyis skyob par nges/ /sangs rgyas sku yi yon tan sku mdog gser mdog dbu la gtsug tor ldan/ /mtshan bzang sum cu rtsa gnyis dang ldan dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus spras/ /na bza' chos gos rnam gsum gsol zhing rab mdzes blta bas chog mi shes/ /mthong na mi mthun med cing mthong ba tsam gyes don dang ldan par byed/ /gsung gi yon tan pi wang gling bu'i sgra las gsung gi sgra snyan zhing / /'jig rten khams kyi sems can kun gyis dus gcig dri ba mi 'dra ba/ /re re zhus kyang gsung snyan yan lag drug cu rtsa bzhi'i gdangs dbyangs kyis/ /legs sbyar skad ni lta bu gcig gi sgo nas dri bar lan mdzad kyang / /'gro ba so so'i skad du go ste je tshom mtha' dag gcig char sel/ /thugs kyi mkhyen pa'i yon tan shes bya mtha' dag lag mthil skyu ru ra/ /rlon pa bzhag bzhin sa ler mkhyen pas gdul bya 'dul ba'i thabs la mkhas/ /brtse ba'i yon tan dper na mi gnyis gcig gis g.yas nas tsan dan gyi/ /lde gus sku la byug dang gcig gis g.yon nas sta gris gsheg na 319

yang / /mi de gnyis la nye ring mi mnga' 'gro ba rigs drug sems can la/ /dper na ma yis bu la brtse ltar thugs rje rgyun chad med par skye/ /'phrin las yon tan 'gro ba thams cad sgol ba'i nus mthu yongs rdzogs pas/ /gzhan la phan par 'gyur na tsha ba'i dmyal ba'i me nang yin na yang / /rab tu spro ba dang bcas thogs pa med par zhugs nas don mdzad 'gyur/ /mdor na sangs rgyas rang nyid 'jigs pa kun las grol zhing 'gro ba gzhan/ /'jigs pa kun las sgol ba'i thabs la mkhas shing thugs rje chen po yis/ /kun la nye ring med par 'jug cing phan btags ma btags thams cad kyi/ /don mdzad pa ni sangs rgyas yon tan yin gyis dbang phyug sogs la med/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi yon tan de dag dam chos bsgrub las byung / /chos ni skyon rnams sel zhing yon tan mtha' dag sgrub pa'i bdag po yin/ /byams pa 'jam dbyangs spyan ras gzigs sogs byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun dang / /'od srung chen po mchog zung gnyis la sogs pa'i nyan thos dge 'dun gyis/ /dam chos de nyid rtag tu g.yel ba med par tshul bzhin sgrub par byed/ /de dag la yang sku gsung thugs yon bsam gyis mi khyab mnga' ba yin/ /de 320

ltar sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun gsum gyi yon tan dran byas nas/ /spyi bo'i bla ma thub dbang thugs ga'i skyabs yul nam mkha' gang bar spros/ /de dag bla ma thub dbang mtha' bskor 'ja' 'od klong du bzhugs par gyur/ /rang nyid ngan 'gro'i 'jigs pas skrag dang dkon mchog skyob pa'i nus ldan du/ /shes shing sems can rnams la snying rje chen po'i kun slong dang bcas pas/ /bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyis/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun gsum la byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi/ /skyid sdug ci zhig byung yang skyabs mgon re sa gzhan na ma mchis pas/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal spyi dang khyad par ngan 'gro'i 'jigs las bskyab tu gsol/ /tshogs zhing rnams kyi sku las bdud rtsi sna lnga 'od zer bcas pa'i rgyun/ /rgyun chad med par byung nas bdag gzhan 'gro ba kun gyi lus la zhugs/ /zhugs ma thag tu nyi ma'i 'od kyis grib ma ded bzhin sdirge sgrib kude/ /kun kyang lhag med dag nas tshe bsod lung rtogs yon tan rgyas par gyur/ /tshogs zhing thams cad slar yang bla ma thub dbang thugs gar thim par gyur/ /sangs rgyas skyabs su song bas 'jig rten lha mi gtan gyi skyabs mi 'tshol chos la 321

skyabs su song bas sems can rnams la gnod 'tshe mi byed cing / /dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su song bas bslu med dkon mchog rnam gsum la/ /yid mi ches pas mi dang mu stegs pa dang lhan cig 'grogs mi bya/ /sangs rgyas sku gzugs bzo dang rgyu ngan la yang sangs rgyas dngos su mos/ /gsung rab tshig bzhi yan chad la yang dam chos dkon mchog yin par mos/ /rab tu byung ba'i rtags tsam 'dzin pa la yang dge 'dun dkon mchog tu/ /mos pa'i sgo nas sgo gsum mi gus spangs nas mchod bstod bkur bar bya/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song ba'i gnas skabs mthar thug phan yon ni/ /nang pa sangs rgyas par chud sdom pa kun gyi rten du 'gyur ba dang / /sngar bsags las sgrib srab cing 'dzad dang bsod nams rgya chen thob pa dang / /ngan 'gror mi ltung mi dang mi min gnod pas mi tshugs ci bsam 'grub/ /myur du sangs rgyas 'thob pa la sogs skyabs song bsod nams gzhal mi nus/ /de phyir dkon mchog gtan gye skyabs su bzung nas rgyun tu skyabs 'gro bya/ /de ltar nus par spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i byin gyis rlobs/ /mi dge ba las 'bras bu sdug bsngal 'byung bas bde ba 'byung mi 'gyur/ /dge las 'bras bu bde ba kho na 322

'byung bas sdug bsngal 'byung ba min/ /da lta tsha bas gdungs pa'i dus su rlung ni bsil po rang lus la/ /phog pa yan chad bde ba sngon gyi dge ba'i las kyi 'bras bu yin/ /tsher ma zug pa yan chad sdug bsngal sngon gyi mi dge'i 'bras bu yin/ /dge sdig chung ngu byas kyang 'phel nas 'bras bu chen po 'byin pa ste/ /sngon dus dge tshul kyun des dge slong dbyangs ni mi snyan pa zhig la/ /khyod kyi dbyangs de khye zhig zug pa'i skad dang 'dra zhes smras pa yis/ /sgye ba lnga brgyar khyi lus blangs bzhin mi dge'i las ni 'phel stobs che/ /sngon dus byes pa gcig gis sangs rgyas sa ni snyim pa gang phul bas/ /chos rgyal mya ngan med du skyes bzhin dge ba'i las kyang 'phel stobs che/ /dper na gro nas ma btab 'bras bu lo tog smin dang mi 'phrad bzhin/ /rgyu yi dge sdig ma byas 'bras bu bde sdug gang yang 'phrad mi srid/ /dper na sa bon gang btab ser ba la sogs rkyen gyis ma bcom na/ /nam yang chud zos cung zad mi 'gro lo tog legs par smin pa bzhin/ /dge ba'i las ni gang byas zhe sdang la sogs rkyen gyis ma bcom na/ /nam yang cung zad chud mi za bar 'bras bu bde ba smin par 'gyur/ /dper na khog tu song ba'i dug de sman sngags sogs kyis ma bcom na/ /cung zad 323

tsam yang chud zos mi 'gro bzod med sdug bsngal skyed pa bzhin/ /mi dge sdig pa'i las ni gang byas bshags pa sogs kyis ma sbyangs na/ /nam yang chud zos mi 'gro 'bras bu sdug bsngal smin par 'gyur ro zhes/ /thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas gsungs la yid ches nges pa rab bskyed nas/ /sdug bsngal rgyu yi mi dge bcu spangs bde rgyu dge bcu bsgrub par bya/ /de ltar nus par spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i byin gyis rlobs/ /mi dang mir chags rta nor ra lug ri dwags nya sogs srog chags rnams/ /mtshon cha rdo dang dbyug pa dug dang mthu gtad la sogs gang yin gyi/ /sgo nas rang gis gsod dam gzhan la gsod du bcug nas srog gcod las/ /chen po byas na dmyal bar skye zhing 'bring byas yi dwags gnas su skye/ /chung ngu byas na dud 'gro'i gnas su skyes nas sdug bsngal yun ring myong / /thar nas mi ru skyes kyang srog gcod la dga' tshe thung nad mang zhing / /yul phyogs bza' btung sman dang lo 'bras la sogs mthu chung yul du skye/ /de phyir srog gcod las ni ngo lkog gang du dug bzhin spang bar bya/ /de ltar nus par spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i byin gyis rlobs/ /gzhan gyi gser dngul rta nor lug gsum ja ras gos 324

dar la sogs pa'i/ /dngos po che chung gang zhig yin yang 'phrog gam 'phrog tu bcug pa dang / /'jab pus brku dang brku ru bcug dang g.yar po bcol po g.yo thabs kyis/ /len dang gzhan gyi nor rdzas blangs nas de yi skyin pa mi 'jal dang / /bre dang rgya mar g.yo sgyu byed pa la sogs sgo nas ma byin pa/ /chen po blangs na dmyal bar skye zhing 'bring gis yi dwags gnas su skye/ /chung ngu blangs na dud 'gro'i gnas su skyes nas sdug bsngal yun ring myong / /thar nas mi ru skyes kyang ma byin len la dga' zhing longs spyod chung / /longs spyod gang yod gzhan dang thun mong 'gyur zhing yul phyogs lo 'bras nyung / /sad ser than pa la sogs che zhing 'bras bu smin dka'i yul du skye/ /de phyir ma byen len ni ngo lkog gang du dug bzhin spang bar bya/ /de ltar nus par spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i byin gyis rlobs/ /gzhan gyi chung ma rnams dang rab byung ma dang bag mar ma song ba/ /pha la sogs pas bsrung ba rnams dang rgyal pos chad pa'i khrims bcas dang / /gzhan gyis gla gzhal smad 'tshong ma dang rang gi nye dur spyod pa dang / /mngal sgo min pa'i kha dang bshang lam khye'u bu mo'i brla'i bar ram rang gi lag pa'i sor mo sogs kyi rtsol bas khu ba 'byin pa dang / /bla 325

ma pha ma lta bu'i nye 'khor sku gzugs dam chos mchod rten dang / /skye bo mang pos mthong ba'i gnas dang spyod yul de la gnod pa yi/ /sa phyogs mi bde 'bar 'bur can dang sra ba sogs nas spyod pa dang / /zla mtshan 'dzag pa'i dus skabs rnams dang zla ba tshang ba'i sbrum ma dang / /nu zho 'dzag pa'i bu chung bcas dang bsnyen gnas bsrung dang nyin mo dang / /nad dang ldan pa mya ngan byed dang mi mos pa dang lnga las lhag /rang gis sbyad dam yang na gzhan la spyod du bcug nas mi tshangs pa/ /chen po sbyad na dmyal bar skye dang 'bring gis yi dwags gnas su skye/ /chung ngu spyad na dud 'gro'i gnas su skyes nas sdug bsngal yun ring myong / /thar nas mi ru skyes kyang mi tshangs spyod la dga' dang g.yog 'khor la/ /yid brtan mi rung ba dang chung ma 'gran zla bcas dang yul phyogs ni/ /bshang gci 'dam rdzab ljan ljin mi gtsang dri nga mang po'i yul du skye/ /de phyir mi tshangs spyod ni ngo lkog gang du dug bzhin spang bar bya/ /de ltar nus par spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i byen gyis rlobs/ /mig gis gzugs ni mthong la ma mthong ma mthong mthong zhes smra ba dang / /de bzhin rna ba sna dang lce dang lus dang yid kyi dbang po la/ /brten nas rdzun gtam smra dang dang 326

du len nam lus kyis brda' ston dang / /gzhan la de ltar byed du 'jug pa la sogs sgo nas dzun gyi tshig /chen po smras na dmyal bar sgye dang 'bring gis yi dwags gnas su skye/ /chung ngu smras na dud 'gro'i gnas su sgyes nas sdug bsngal yun ring myong / /thar nas mi ru skyes kyang dzun la dga' dang skur ba 'debs mkhan mang / /gzhan gyis bslu bar 'gyur dang yul phyogs rdzun gyis phal cher bslu ba dang / /'jigs dang 'jigs su rung ba'i rgyu yang mang po ldan pa'i yul du skye/ /de phyir rdzun gyi tshig rnams ngo lkog gang du dug bzhin spang bar bya/ /de ltar nus par spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i byin gyis rlobs/ /bden pa'i tshig gam dzun tshig gnyis kyi gang rung sgo nas sems can gzhan/ /mthun pa rnams ni phan tshun dbye dang mi mthun pa rnams mi 'dums par/ /rang gis byed dam gzhan gyi mi la byed du bcug nas phra ma ni/ /chen po byas na dmyal bar skye dang 'bring byas yi dwags gnas su skye/ /chung ngu byas na dud 'gro'i gnas su skyes nas sdug bsngal yun ring myong / /thar nas mi ru skyes kyang phra ma smra la dga' dang 'khor g.yog ngan/ /mi 'dums pa dang sa phyogs 'bar 'bur ljang ljong mtho dman che ba dang / /ngam grog g.yang sa gcong rong la sogs bgrod 327

par dka' ba'i yul du skye/ /de phyir phra ma 'di ni ngo lkog gang du dug bzhin spang bar bya/ /de ltar nus par spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i byen gyis rlobs/ /rab tu byung dang skye bo pho mo rnams la sdom shor khyi rgan dang / /bdud mo la sogs mi snyan smra dang sod chod gtubs dang rgyob la sogs/ /pha rol gzhan gye sems la gnod pa'i tshig ngan rnam pa sna tshogs pa/ /rang gis smra'am yang na gzhan la smra ru bcug nas tshig rtsub ni/ /chen po smras na dmyal bar skye dang 'bring gis yi dwags gnas su skye/ /chung ngu smras na dud 'gro'i gnas su skyes nas sdug bsngal yun ring myong / /thar nas mi ru skyes kyang tshig rtsub smra la dgar dang mi snyan thos/ /'thab mo'i tshig tu 'gyur dang yul phyogs sdong dum tsher ma mang ba dang / /rdo dang gseg ma gyo mo mang sogs rab tu rtsub pa'i yul du skye/ /de phyir tshig rtsub rnams ni ngo lkog gang du dug bzhin spang bar bya/ /de ltar nus par spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i byin gyis rlobs/ /'thab mo mtshang 'dru rtsod 'gyed tshig smra phyi rol bstan bcos bklag pa dang / /rgyal blon chom rkun dmag la sogs pa'i 'du 'dzi'i gtam rnams smra ba dang / /glu dang gar gyi tshig rnams brjod dang dga' mgur spyod pa spra ba dang / /shin tu nyam thag smre sngags tshig dang log 328

pa'i 'tsho ba'i smra ba sogs/ /spyon pa bzhin du kha nas don med mtho bshad dma' bshad sna tshogs pa/ /rang gis smra ram yang na gzhan la smra ru bcug nas ngag 'khyal tshig /chen po smras na dmyal bar skye dang 'bring gis yi dwags gnas su skye/ /chung ngu smras na dud 'gro'i gnas su skyes nas sdug bsngal yun ring myong / /thar nas mi ru skyes kyang ngag 'khyal la dga' tshig bzung mi 'os shing / /ma nges spobs par 'gyur dang yul phyogs ljon shing rnams la 'bras mi chags/ /dus min 'bras chags dus su mi chags ma smin smin par snang ba dang / /rtsa ba mi brtan pa dang ring du mi gnas pa sogs yul du skye/ /de phyir ngag 'khyal tshig ni ngo skog gang du dug bzhin spang bar bya/ /de ltar nus par spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i byen gyis rlobs/ /gzhan gyis bdag tu bzung ba'i dngos po rta nor rgyan gos gnas khang dang / /'khor g.yog la sogs gang yang rang la byung na snyam pa'i brnab sems ni/ /chen po byas na dmyal bar skye dang 'bring gis yi dwags gnas su skye/ /chung ngu byas na dud 'gro'i gnas su skyes nas sdug bsngal yun ring myong / /thar nas mi ru skyes kyang brnab sems la dga' 'dod pa shin tu che/ /chog mi shes dang yul phyogs phun sum tshogs pa thams 329

cad lo re dang / /zla ba zha ga re la yang nyams shing bri la mi 'phel yul du skye/ /de phyir brnab sems 'di ni ngo lkog gang du dug bzhin spang bar bya/ /de ltar nus par spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i byen gyis rlobs/ /rang dang mi mthun pa la sogs pa rang gis gsod bcings brdeg snyam dang / /gzhan la na tsha shi god la sogs byung na snyam pa'i gnod sems ni/ /chen po byas na dmyal bar skye dang 'bring gis yi dwags gnas su skye/ /chung ngu byas na dud 'gro'i gnas su skyes nas sdug bsngal yun ring myong / /thar nas mi ru skyes kyang gnod pa'i sems la dga' dang mi phan 'tshol/ /phan pa mi 'tshol ba dang yul phyogs nad yams 'khrug pa mang ba dang / /chom rkun gcan gzan sbrul la sogs pa'i gnod pa mang ba'i yul du skye/ /de phyir gnod pa'i sems ni ngo lkog gang du dug bzhin spang bar bya/ /de ltar nus par spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i byin gyis rlobs/ /legs par spyad dang nyes par spyad pa la sogs med par 'dod pa dang / /phyag dang bskor ba kha ton la sogs rnam dkar dge la brtson byas kyang / /tshe dang bsod nams mnga' thang mi rgyas 'bras bu bde ba 'byung ba med/ /srog gcod la sogs mi dge bcu po byas kyang 'bras bu sdug bsngal 330

med/ /pha dang ma med 'jig rten snga phyi med dang sems can dzus skyes med/ /'jig rten khams na dgra bcom pa sogs med par 'dod pa'e log lta ni/ /chen po byas na dmyal bar skye dang 'bring byas yi dwags gnas su skye/ /chung ngu byas na dud 'gro'i gnas su skyes nas sdug bsngal yun ring myong / /thar nas mi ru sgyes kyang log lta byed la dga' dang lta ba ngan/ /g.yo sgyu can du 'gyur dang yul phyogs rin po che la sogs pa yi/ /'byung khungs bzang po mi ldan pa dang dngos po mi gtsang ngan pa'i rigs/ /mang zhing skyabs dang dpung gnyen rnams ni gang yang med pa'i yul du skye/ /de phyir log par lta ba ngo lkog gang du dug bzhin spang bar bya/ /de ltar nus par spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i byen gyis rlobs/ /yang lci'i tshad ni dug gsum drag pos mi dge bcu yi gang byas lci/ /sngon chad byas sam byed pa phyin chad byed 'gyur ba la dga' ba dang / /rang yang byed la gzhan gyi mi la de ltar byed du 'jug pa dang / /de yi bsngags pa brjod dang de 'dra mthong na yid ni dga' ba dang / /yun ring bsams shing bsags pa'i sems kyis byed dang rtag tu byed pa dang / /lan re la yang mi dge bcu yi gang yang mang po byas na lci/ /bsnyen gnas mchod sbyin phyag bskor la sogs 331

tshogs bsogs sgrib sbyong ma byas lci/ /mchod sbyin phyir du byas na nyes pa med do snyam nas byas na lci/ /srog gcod nang nas lci ba sdug bsngal drag po bskyed nas gsod pa dang / /'jigs pa bskyed nas bya ba min pa byed du bcug nas gsod pa dang / /dud 'gro lus bong che dang mi 'am mir chags pa dang pha ma dang / /phu nu mdza' bshes bla ma gsod pa lci zhing de las gzhan rnams yang / /ma byen len gyi nang nas lci ba dngos po rin thang che ba dang / /mang dang dman pa bkren pa rab byung dge 'dun mchod rten la sogs pa'i/ /nor rdzas brkus dang 'phrog pa rnams ni lci zhing de las gzhan rnams yang mi tshangs spyod kyi nang nas lci ba ma sring grogs kyi chung ma dang / /dge slong ma dang dge slob ma dang dge tshul ma la zhugs pa dang / /khar 'jug pa dang bsnyen gnas gnas dang sbrum ma zla ba tshang ba dang / /nad dang ldan pa'i dus su spyad dang mchod rten nye 'khor dge 'dun gyi/ /kun dga' ra bar nyal po byed pa lci zhing de las gzhan rnams yang / /rdzun gyi nang nas lci ba gzhan dag bslu bar 'dod nas mang po'i rdzun/ /smra dang bla ma mkhan slob pha ma nye du rnams la rdzun smra dang / /srog gcod ma byin len dang mi tshangs spyod gsum lci ba skyed byed pa'i/ /rdzun 332

dang dge 'dun dbye ba'i rdzun rnams lci zhing de las gzhan rnams yang / /phra ma'i nang nas lci ba ring nas bshes su gyur dang bla ma dang / /pha ma dge 'dun pa rnams 'byed dang lus kyi las gsum lce ba rnams/ /bskyed pa'i phra ma smra ba rnams ni lci zhing de las gzhan rnams yang / /tshig rtsub nang nas lci ba drin can bla ma pha ma grogs mched la/ /mi snyan tshig rtsub smra ba rnams ni lci zhing de las gzhan rnams yang / /ngag 'khyal nang nas lci ba phyi rol bstan bcos bklag dang 'thab mo dang / /mtshang 'dru rtsod 'gyed la brten ngag 'khyal lci zhing de las gzhan rnams yang / /brnab sems nang nas lci ba dge 'dun mchod rten dkor la rngams pa dang / /yon tan rlom pas rgyal blon tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa mkhas rnams las/ /shes kyi khe dang bkur ste 'dod pa lci zhing de las gzhan rnams yang / /gnod sems nang nas lci ba pha ma nye du bla ma nyes med dang / /bkren dang sdug bsngal ba dang snying rje ba dang nyes pa byed dag gis/ /bshags pa byed la mnar sems bskyed pa lci zhing de las gzhan rnams yang / /log lta'i nang nas lci ba kun la log lta byed dang 'jig rten na/ /dgra bcom pa sogs med par blta ba lci zhing de las gzhan rnams yang lus ngag 333

bdun ni snga ma snga ma lci zhing phyi ma phyi ma yang / /yid kyi gsum ni phyi ma phyi ma lci zhing snga ma snga ma yang / /gzhan yang bla ma dkon mchog pha ma rnams la phan gnod gang byas dang / /snying nas dad pas dkon mchog mchod dang byams dang snying rje byang chub sems/ /drag pos sbyin gtong byas dang zhe sdang drag pos srog gcod byas pa dang / /chos kyi sbyin pa zang zing khyad par 'phags pa byen dang sdom pa gsum/ /ldan pas dge sdig gang byas stobs che gsungs la yid ches bskyed par bya/ /de ltar nus par spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i byin gyis rlobs/ /mi dge bcu yi nyes dmigs shes nas de dag byed pa'i kun slong tsam/ /yan chad bsdams nas sgo gsum de dag rnams dang ma 'dres dge bcu yin/ /dge bcu chen po byas na khams ni gong ma gnyis kyi lha ru skye/ /'bring byas 'dod khams lha ru skye dang chung ngu byas na mi ru skye/ /dge bcu byed la dga' dang srog gcod spangs pas tshe ring nad med cing / /yul phyogs bza' btung sman dang 'bras bu la sogs mthu che'i yul du skye/ /ma byin len pa spangs pas longs spyod che dang dgra rkun la sogs med/ /yul phyogs lo 'bras mang zhing sad ser than pa med pa'i yul du skye/ /mi tshangs spyod spangs g.yog 'khor yid brtan 334

rung ba chung ma 'gran zla med/ /yul phyogs gtsang zhing spos kyi ngad ldan shin tu nyams dga'i yul du skye/ /rdzun tshig smra ba spangs pas gzhan gyis bskur ba med cing bslu mi 'gyur/ /yul phyogs rdzun gyis bslu dang 'jigs pa gang yang med pa'i yul du skye/ /phra ma smra ba spangs pas g.yog 'khor bzang zhing phan tshun mthun par 'gyur/ /sa phyogs 'bar 'bur la sogs med cing bgrod par sla ba'i yul du skye/ /tshig rtsub smra ba spangs pas snyan pa thos shing mthun pa'i tshig tu 'gyur/ /yul phyogs sdong dum tsher ma rdo gseg med cing 'jam pa'i yul du skye/ /ngag 'khyal smra ba spangs pas tshig bzung 'os shing nges pa'i spobs par 'gyur/ /yul phyogs ljon shing 'bras bu chags shing dus su smin pa'i yul du skye/ /brnab sems spangs pas 'dod pa shin tu chung zhing chog shes che bar 'gyur/ /yul phyogs phun sum tshogs pa med cing 'phel ba'i yul du skye/ /gnod sems spangs pas mi phan pa rnams mi 'tshol phan pa 'tshol bar 'gyur/ /yul phyogs nad 'khrug chom rkun la sogs gnod pa med pa'i yul du skye/ /log par lta ba spangs pas lta ba bzang zhing g.yo sgyu med par 'gyur/ /yul phyogs rin chen 'byung khungs ldan zhing skyabs dang dpung gnyen yod sar skye/ /de phyir mtho ris 335

bgrod pa'i shing rta dge bcu dang du blang bar bya/ /de ltar nus par spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i byen gyis rlobs/ /bsam pa nag pos srog gcod byed pa lta bu 'bras bu sdug bsngal 'byung / /bsam pa dkar pos sbyin gtong byed pa lta bu 'bras bu bde ba 'byung / /gzhan la phan phyir brdeg brdung byed pa lta bu bsam pa dkar na yang / /sbyor ba nag pas 'bras bu bde sdug gnyis ka spel mar 'byung ba yin/ /gzhan la gnod phyir sbyin gtong byed pa lta bu sbyor ba dkar na yang / /bsam pa nag pas 'bras bu bde sdug gnyis ka spel mar 'byung ba'o/ /bde 'gror 'phen pa'i las ni dge ba yin cing ngan 'gror 'phen pa yi/ /las ni mi dge ba yin rdzogs byed la ni nges pa med pa yin/ /dper na mir skyes dbang po tshang zhing tshe ring longs spyod che ba rnams/ /'phen byed dge ba'i las kyis 'phangs la rdzogs byed dge bas rdzogs pa yin/ /mi ru skyes kyang dbang po mi tshang tshe thung nad mang dbul po rnams/ /'phen byed dge ba'i las kyis 'phangs kyang rdzogs byed mi dges rdzogs pa yin/ /dper na dud 'gro yi dwags la'ang dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa rnams/ /'phen byed mi dge'i las kyis 'phangs kyang rdzogs byed dge bas rdzogs pa yin/ /336

dper na dud 'gro la las mi 'dod sdug bsngal sna tshogs myong ba rnams/ /'phen byed mi dge'i las kyis 'phangs la rdzogs byed mi dges rdzogs pa yin/ /phyug po gcig gis mchod gnas gcig gam mang por zhabs tog byed pa bzhin/ /las ni gcig gis lus gcig 'phen dang du mar 'phen pa'i las kyang yod/ /dbul bo mang pos mchod gnas gcig gam mang po'i zhabs tog byed pa bzhin/ /las ni du mas lus gcig 'phen dang du mar 'phen pa'i las kyang yod/ /myong bar 'gyur ba nges pa'i las ni bsam bzhin dge sdig byas rnams yin/ /myong bar 'gyur ba ma nges las ni rmi lam nang du byas pa dang / /bsam bzhin min dang drag po min la rgyun chags min par byas pa dang / /nor dang brjed pas byas dang mi 'dod bzhin du byas dang rang bzhin gyis/ /lung du ma bstan pa dang 'gyod pas bsal dang gnyen pos bsal ba'o/ /myong nges las kyi 'bras bu tshe 'dir smin dang tshe ni gnyis pa la/ /'bras bu myong dang tshe ni gsum pa phan chad du yang smin par 'gyur/ /dge sdig gang lci thog mar smin dang lci yang mnyam na 'chi dus gang / /mngon du gyur pa de nyid thog mar smin dang de yang 'dra na gang / /goms pa shas che thog mar smin dang de yang 'dra na 337

sngon du gang / /byas pa de nyid thog mar smin nas bde sdug gang rung myong bar 'gyur/ /des na mi dge'i las spangs dkar po dge ba'i las la 'bad par bya/ /de ltar nus par spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i byin gyes rlobs/ /mi dge bcu spang gis kyang bde 'gro'i rten bzang bo zhig rnyed mod kyang / /rnam mkhyen sgrub pa'i rten la mtshan nyid tshang ba zhig ni grub na lam/ /bsgom pa'i sa chod gzhan dang mi 'dra bas na rten de sgrub tshul ni/ /sems can rnams la mi 'tshe ba dang mi 'tshe'i bsam pa bsten pa dang / /gzhan gyis mi dang ra lug ri dwags nya la sogs pa gsod pa rnams/ /thabs mkhas du mas de dag rnams ni gsod pa dgag cing tshe thar bya/ /srog chags phra mo chur lhung nyi mas bsreg pa yan chad srog skyabs bya/ /nad pa rnams kyi nad g.yog bya dang sman ni gzhan la ster ba dang / /bran g.yog sgo phyugs khye sogs rnams la rdo dang dbyug pas mi brdung zhing / /gzhan gyis gzhan la rdo dang mtshon cha dbyug pas brdungs pa bshol byas na/ /phyi mar rab tu tshe ring nad kun med pa'i mi ru skye bar 'gyur/ /mi tshe ring na yun ring dge ba mang po gsog nus dgos pa yod/ /khro med bzod pa bsgom dang rten la mar me me tog 'bul ba dang / /338

gzhan la gos rgyan gsar ba byen na phyi mar gzugs byad shin tu mjes/ /mjes na gdul bya 'du zhing tshig la nyan dang bya bar sems pa yin/ /nga rgyal bcom nas bla ma rnams dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal zhing / /khri dang gdan sogs 'bul dang pha ma sogs la bkur sti byas gyur na/ /phyi mar kun gyis bkur zhing grags pa'i rigs ni mthon po rnams su skye/ /rigs ni mtho na bsgo ba rnams las mi 'da' sgrub pa'i dgos pa yod/ /zas gos nor gyes dge 'dun mchod dang dbul bor sbyin pa gtong ba dang / /'byung bor gtor ma btang na phyi mar 'khor dang longs spyod rab tu che/ /'khor dang longs spyod che na sems can bsdus te smin par byed nus so/ /rdzun spangs drang bor smra dang phra ma spangs nas 'khon pa bsdum pa dang / /tshig rtsub spangs nas 'jam po smra dang ngag 'khyal spangs nas bla ma sogs/ /gzhan gyi yon tan brjod na phyi mar gang smra tshig rnams tshad mar 'dzin/ /tshad mar bzung na sems can sdud cing smin par byed nus dgos pa yod/ /phyi mar rang la yon tan sna tshogs 'byung ba'i smon lam 'debs pa dang / /dkon mchog gsum dang bla ma mkhan slob pha ma la sogs mchod byas na/ /phyi mar sbyin pa gtong la brtson pa la sogs yon tan dang 339

ldan pas/ /snyan grags che zhing de las skye bo mang po'i mchod pa'i gnas su 'gyur/ /de ltar gyur na byas pa gzo zhing myur du bsgo ba nyan pa yin/ /pho yi lus rten thob la dga' zhing mo yi lus la dga' ba spangs/ /pho yi dbang po mi gcod gcod pa thar par byas na pho ru skye/ /pho lus thob na spobs pa che zhing gegs byed nyung ba'i dgos pa yod/ /gzhan gyis gtan nas mi nus pa rnams rang gis byed cing rang nyid dang / /bsdoms nas nus pa thams cad la yang grogs byas bza' btung byin pa na/ /phyi mar rang bzhin gnod pa chung zhing nad med pa dang spro shugs che/ /spro shugs che na rang dang gzhan gyi don gang la yang mi skyo zhing / /so sor rtog pa'i stobs thob mngon par shes pa myur ba'i dgos pa yod/ /de phyir de dag thams cad da lta rang gis sgrub la 'bad par bya/ /de ltar nus par spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i byin gyis rlobs/ /dge sdig gnyis kyi blang dor 'byed la 'bad kyang gnyen po stobs chung zhing / /nyon mongs stobs che'i dbang gis 'phral du nyes pa gang byung thams cad dang / /tshe rabs thog ma med nas bsags pa'i sdig ltung thams cad sbyangs dgos pas/ /ltung ba phyir bcos sdom gsum so so'i skabs nas gsungs ltar bya ba dang / /sdig 340

pa phyir bcos bya ba'i tshul ni 'phral du sdig pa gang byas dang / /de yi cha tsam du yang 'gran par mi nus tshe sngon rang nyid dang / /dpon grogs bu spun bud med 'khor g.yog sde dgon don du sdig pa'i las/ /grangs med bsags pa yod pas de yi dbang gis ngan 'gror sgye ba dang / /thar nas mi ru skyes kyang sdug bsngal sna tshogs myong ba'i tshul bsams nas/ /thog ma med nas mi dge sdig pa'i las byas pa la dug khong du/ /song ba lta bu'i 'gyod pa drag po bskyed pa rnam par sun 'byin stobs/ /sher phyin la sogs mdo sde zab mo 'dzin dang klog pa la sogs dang / /stong ba nyid la mnyam par 'jog dngayi ge brgya pa la sogs pa'i/ /gzungs sngags zab mo rnams ni bzla dang sangs rgyas sku gzugs bzhengs pa dang / /rgyal dang de yi mchod rten la yang mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul ba dang / /de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan la sogs pa brjod pa gnyen po kun spyod stobs/ /phyin chad srog la bab kyang mi byed sdom sems byed pa nyes pa las/ /slar log stobs dang skyabs su 'gro dang byang chub sems bsgom rten gyi stobs/ /stobs bzhi'i sgo nas bshags na sdig pa ri rab tsam yang 'dag pa ste/ /sngon dus sor mo'i 'phreng bas mi ni dgu brgya dgu bcu go dgu bsad/ /bshags sdom 341

byas pas dgra bcom thob pa la sogs bsams nas dga' bar bya/ /'on kyang 'jig rten dag na rkang lag la sogs bsnad pa phyir bcos su/ /yod kyang ma bsnad gal che ba ltar sdig pas ma gos pa la 'bad/ /bsnad kyang de ma thag tu bcos bzhin nyes pa byung ma thag tu bshags/ /ma bcos sdug bsngal myong bzhin ma bshags 'di phyir sdug bsngal 'byung ba'o/ / de yang skabs 'dir shin tu mdor bsdus bshags pa byed na 'di ltar bya/ /spyi bo'i bla ma thub dbang thugs ga'i skyabs yul nam mkha' gang bar spros/ /de dag thub dbang mtha' bskor 'ja' zer 'od phung klong du bzhugs par gyur/ /bla ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa sdig can bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bdag gis tshe rabs thog ma med nas tha ma da ltar thug gi bar/ /pha ma sems can srog bcad ma byen pa blangs mi tshangs spyad pa dang / /rdzun dang phra ma tshig rtsub ngag 'khyal brnab sems gnod sems log lta sogs/ /rnam mang sdig pa'i las rnams ci bgyis gnong ngo 'gyod do spyan sngar bshags/ /khyad par so thar sdom par 'gal dang byang sems bslab byar 'gal ba dang / /gsang sngags dam tshig rnams dang 'gal ba snying nas 'gyod pas mthol lo bshags/ /da nas bzung ste phyin chad 342

srog la bab kyang mi byed sdom par brgya/ /sngar byas thams cad da lta nyid du byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ /skyabs yul rnams kyi sku las 'od zer 'phros pas sdig sgrib nyes ltung rnams/ /mun pa'i gling du nyi ma phog bzhin thams cad phyi ru sangs kyis dag /tshogs zhing thams cad slar yang bla ma thub dbang thugs gar thim par gyur//skyon rnams kun zad yon tan kun ldan 'dren pa mnyam med sangs rgyas dang / /shes bya kun mkhyen rje btsun 'jam dbyangs thugs rje'i gter chen spyan ras gzigs/ /bdud dpung 'joms mdzad gsang bdag rnams dang dbyer med kun mkhyen blo bzang grags/ /da dung snying ga'i pad sdong rtse mor gzi brjid 'od zer 'bar bzhin bzhugs/ /khyod gsung skyes bu chung ngu'i chos skor rnam thos sras kyi mdzod khang nas/ /skyes bu chung dang thun mong lam rim nyung 'dus kha zas blangs zin nas/ /da ni skyes bu 'bring gi chos skor rin chen gser gyi gling bsnyegs nas/ /skyes bu 'bring dang thun mong lam rim nyung 'dus rin chen gser phye len/ /de ltar 'chi ba mi rtag pa dang shi nas ngan 'gror ltung ba'i tshul/ /bsam ste 'jig rten 'di yi blo log phyi ma'i bde 'gror don gnyer skyes/ /skyabs su 'gro 343

dang dkar nag las 'bras nges pa'i sgo nas sdig pa spongs/ /dge ba sgrub la 'bad pas phyi mar bde 'gro'i go 'phang thob mod kyang / /'on kyang de tsam zhig gis mi chog dper na nag can mi zhig bzung / /nyin re bzhin du dbyug pas bsnun sogs chad las rnam pa sna tshogs pa/ /bcad pas sdug bsngal myong ba zla ba kha shas 'phro nas gsod pa zhig /gzhan gyis ngo chen sogs byas dbyug pas bsnun pa'i sdug bsngal med mod kyang / /'on kyang de las ma thar phyin chad nyin re bzhin du gsod pa la/ /je nye je nyer song nas nam zhig gsod bzhin sdug bsngal rtsa ba nas/ /spangs pa'i thar pa ma thob phyin chad bde 'gro'i go 'phang ci 'dra zhig /thob kyang sngar byas las bzang 'phen pa zad tshe ngan song gsum du rtsang / /yun ring shugs drag bzod glags med pa'i sdug bsngal sna tshogs myong dgos 'dug /gzhan yang 'khor ba'i gnas 'dir las nyon dbang gis skye ba blangs phyin chad/ /dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gror skyes na sdug bsngal yod pa smos ci dgos/ /lha dang mi ru skyes kyang sdug bsngal ma gtogs bde ba cung zad med/ /mi la skyes pa'i sdug bsngal ma yi mngal du gnas skabs mi gtsang ba'i/ /dong du nyal 'dra ma yis bza' btung tsha ba bsten na me 344

dong du/ /lhung ba lta bu ma yis grang ba bsten na 'khyag pa'i spubs gnas 'dra/ /mchongs dang rgyug tshe g.yang la lhung ba lta bu'i sdug bsngal drag po myong / /btsas dus pags pa bshus nas mchu rnon 'bu yis zos 'dra'i sdug bsngal dang / /stan la bzhag tshe tsher ma'i gseb tu bsgyur ba lta bu'i sdug bsngal dang / /ma yi pang du blangs dus bye'u phrug khra yis khyer 'dra'i sdug bsngal dang / /lte ba bcad dus snying la tsher ma zug pa lta bu'i sdug bsngal dang / /gos su dro 'jam pags pa bskon kyang rma 'bras reg 'dra'i na tsha 'ong / /mal du bsnyal tshe bkyigs nas btson dong 'phangs pa 'dra ba'i sdug bsngal dang / /'og na dri chus nyal stabs mi bde kha skom grod ltogs lus 'khyags dang / /yan lag thams cad sprid pas 'di byung 'chad par ma shes ngu ba la/ /ma yis nu ma khar brdzang a bo zer yang kho la phan pa dka'/ /rgas pa'i sdug bsngal drang bo'i lus po gzhu ltar gug cing nag po'i skra/ /lu gu bzhin du dkar por 'gro dang 'khur tshos khrag gi tshom bu yang / /me tog bzhin du yal zhing kha yi so lhung brag khung stong pa 'dra/ /dras stan bzhin du lus la gnyer ma mang zhing bkrag mdangs gzi brjid kyang / /ston dus ba mos yang yang mnar ba'i me to ga bzhin du smug 345

por 'gro/ /mig kyang mi gsal gyur pas rab rib zang zing mang po mthong ba dang / /rna ba mi gsal gyur pas gzhan gyis gang bshad mi go lan mang 'dri/ /shin tu brjed nges che dang tsha grang bkres skom cung zad tsam mi bzod/ /lus stobs zad pas yar la langs pa'i dus su rtod phur 'don bzhin ldang / /'gro na chang gis bzi ba'i mi bzhin gom 'gros 'khyor zhing sdod pa'i dus/ /sa sgye lung thag chad bzhin gyur pas a pha a ma kha nas 'chor/ /byis pas lad mo byas nas dgod cing yul mi khyem mtshes brnyas chos byed/ /khyim tshang bza' mi sun nas nang nub kun tu mi 'dod 'chi ran dang / /phung rgan 'di 'am 'chi med ma 'di 'chi ba'i srog gcod mi 'ong zer/ /kha ngan tshig ngan nyin re bzhin du go bas sems sdug sna tshogs byed/ /mtshan mo gnyid yer nam la langs pa'i dus med lhu tshigs khol bur na/ /dri chu 'dor sar mi slebs gdan khar shor bas kun gyi yid mi 'ong / /gos phud gon par mi nus shin tu 'khyags dang ngo tsha'i gnas rnams kyang / /sbed par mi shes bstan pas gzhon nu kun gyis ltad mo che zer dgod/ /zas rnams ci yod thams cad mna' ma tsha mo sogs kyi lag tu shor/ /lo lon rgan rgon a khus ltogs skom 'o dod bos kyang 346
