bcos ma zer/ /nor rdzas ci yod thams cad bu dang tsha bo sogs kyi lag tu shor/ /lo lon rgan rgon a khus dro 'jam yang gos 'dod kyang bskon mkhan dkon/ /dro 'jam gon pa bu dang mna' ma tsha bo tsha mo sogs kyis gon/ /lci la hrul ba'i dug po lo lon rgan rgon a khu'i gon skal gyur/ /lus stobs shor bas mi theg mod kyang grang bas mi gon rang dbang med/ /bza' btung zhim mngar bu dang mna' ma tsha bo tsha mo sogs kyis za/ /ngan ngon grang la nyog pa'i bza' btung thams cad lo lon rgan rgon dang / /a khu'i za skal gyur pa lhag par snyigs ma'i dus 'dir shin tu mang / /pho bar mi bde mod kyang ltogs shing skom pas mi 'thung kha med 'byung / /de yang mkho ba'i dus su mi 'ong re thag chad pa'i dus su 'ong / /na ba'i sdug bsngal nad gdon drag pos zin nas nyin re'i gnad gcod kyi/ /sdug bsngal bzod par mi nus lus kyi sha lpags skams shing 'gul bskyod dka'/ /yid du 'ong ba'i zas dang skom rnams 'dod kyang spyod pa'i rang dbang med/ /nad la gnod kyis dogs nas zas dang skom gyi tshod rnams sman pas 'dzin/ /yid du mi 'ong ba yi zas skom sman dang gtar bsreg mi 'dod bzhin/ /bsten dgos mo sman rim gro byas rnams gnod pa bskyal ba 347

bzhin du 'gro/ /'chi ba'i sdug bsngal nad 'tshab cher song mo sman rim gro byed rnams kyis/ /shab shub gtam lab ngo 'dzum gnag cing rim pa bzhin du rang yul bsnyegs/ /gnyen bshes rnams kyis mtha' bskor smre sngags 'don zhing shi dge dur 'debs sogs/ /gshom ra 'dings tshe nad pa'i lus kyi bkrag mdangs kun nyams yi dwags 'dra/ /kha skams mchu badzes mig gnyis dong lhung dbugs brtsegs sngar byas las la 'gyod/ /mgo mi theg cing rkang ba gnyis kyis lus kyang mi theg lag pa yis/ /zas snod mi theg mar lhung nam ring nyi ma shar ba ngang thung skye/ /nga yar khyog dang 'chi bar 'dug pas bslab bya tshig gsum bya'o zer/ /gnyen bshes ngus tshe lag pa bcings nas ma ngu snying rus gyis shig zer/ /gnyen bshes nor rdzas chags nas hrig hrig blta zhing mchi ma re gnyis 'dor/ /gnyen bshes 'khor g.yog nor rdzas dang bral gces pa'i lus kyang mal nas bzhag /mar gyi nang nas sru nyag bton bzhin gcig pur lag pa stong pa ru/ /cha med bar do'i 'phreng ring lam la grogs med gcig pur 'gro dus 'gyod/ /bar do'i 'jigs pa chen po mthong tshe rab tu skrag nas snying rtsa 'dar/ /gzhan yang mi mthun dgra la 'phrad dang 'phrad kyis dogs pas sdug bsngal 348

dang / /yid du 'ong ba'i gnyen bshes bral dang 'bral gyis dogs pas sdug bsngal dang / /phyugs la jag rkun god sogs byung dang 'byung gis dogs pas sdug bsngal dang / /lo tog sad ser sogs kyis bcom dang bcom gyis dogs pas sdug bsngal dang / /rab byung gnyen po zhan pas tshul khrims 'go ma thon pas sdug bsngal dang / /shes rab dman pas thos bsam sgom gsum bya ba ma grub sdug bsngal dang / /phyug po rnams kyis 'tsho skyong ma thub nam yang mi khom sdug bsngal dang / /dbul bos khyi bzhin nyul nas nor rdzas btsal kyang mi rnyed sdug bsngal dang / /zha bo 'on pa long ba lkugs pa bran g.yog gyur pas sdug bsngal dang / /phyug po sprang por song dang mang po gcig tu gyur pas sdug bsngal dang / /nad tsha tsha grang bkres skom 'thab rtsod gtugs bsher la sogs sdug bsngal mang / /des na mi yi sdug bsngal spangs nas thar pa'i go 'phang 'thob par bya/ /de ltar nus par spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i byin gyis rlobs/ /lha ma yin rnams lha yi bsod nams longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa la/ /phrag dog skyes pa'i dbang gis lha dang 'thab tshe mtshon cha'i 'khor lo yis/ /gnod pa 'ba' zhig bskyed la lus ni rmas nas 'dral dang 'chi ba dang / /ngag 349

gis rgyob sod mi snyan sgra mang sgrogs shing gson bsreg byed pa dang / /chu la skyur dang mgo bo gcod dang snying 'don nang khrol 'byen pa sogs/ /sdug bsngal myong dgos nyin 'khrug mtshan 'khrug las ka thams cad dmag la byed/ /sdug bsngal bzod med lan gcig ma yin nyi ma re re bzhin du pyong / /'dod lha rnams la 'chi bar nye tshe lus kyi bkrag mdangs nyams pa dang / /stan la 'dug snying mi 'dod me tog phreng rnying gos la dri ma chags/ /lus la sngon med rngul 'byung 'chi ltas lnga dang lus 'od chung ngur song / /khrus chu lus la chags pa gos dang rgyan las sgra mi snyan pa 'byung / /mig gi rdzi ma 'khrab pa yul gcig la chags nye ba'i 'chi ltas lnga/ /de bcu 'chi ba'i ltas su rigs nas sdug bsngal ba dang khyad par du/ /gang du skye gnas brtags na shes pa yin pas dmyal ba lta bu la/ /skye na dmyal bar skyes dang khyad med lta bu'i sdug bsngal mi bzod pa/ /lha yi zhag po lnga sogs pyong zhing lha yi zhag po nyung shos la/ /mi lo nyis brgya lnga bcu yod pas sdug bsngal yun ring myong ba yin/ /gzhan yang bsod nams che ba'i lha rnams chung bas mthong bas spa bkong dang / /stobs che lha yis stobs chung lha rnams gnas nas gzhan du sgrod pa dang / /lha ma yin la 'thab pa'i dus su 350

gcod dral sdug bsngal sna tshogs myong / /gzugs khams gzugs med khams na mngon gyur sdug bsngal med kyang sngon las kyi/ /'phen pa zad nas shi na sla/ra yang 'og tu ltung ba'i sdug bsngal yod/ /de phyir mdo rgyud bstan bcos rnams las 'khor ba sdug bsngal rgya mtsho zhes/ /gsungs pa yin pas da ni bdag gis 'khor ba 'di la rgyab bstan nas/ /bde chen thar pa'i grong khyer nyams dgar snyogs pa/re thabs la 'bad par bya/ /de ltar nus par spyi bo'i bla ma rdo/ba pa'i dbang po'i byen gyis rlobs/ /nyer len phung po grub pa tsam nas las dang nyon mongs dbang gyur pa'i/ /'du byed thams cad 'du byed sdug bsngal dper na tsha ba'i rma 'bras 'dra/ /'di yis sna tshogs thabs kyis mi 'dod sdug bsngal du ma bskyed pas na/ /'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal sdug bsngal sdug bsngal gnyis ka bskyed pa'i rtsa ba yin/ /'gro 'dug nyal ba bza' btung nyi ma grib ma ha cang bsten drags na/ /sdug bsngal bskyed sogs 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal tsha ba'i rma 'bras chu bsil bas/ /btab na bar der bde bar snang yang 'gyur nas sdug bsngal bskyed pa 'dra/ /mdze thog phol mig grang thog tsha nad mug ge'i thog tu nad yams dang / /rgas thog nad byung la sogs sdug bsngal sdug bsngal tsha 351

ba'i rma 'bras la/ /tshwa chus reg pas sdug bsngal sngar bas cher 'phel bzod glags med pa 'dra/ /'gro drug sdug bsngal gsum gyis mnar ba brtags na sdug bsngal phung por 'dug /des na sdug bsngal de gsum spangs nas thar pa'i go 'phang thob par bya/ /de ltar nus par spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i byin gyis rlobs/ /nyer len phung po 'di yis tshe 'di'i rga na 'chi ba la sogs pa/ /sdug bsngal kun gyi snod byed pa dang phyi ma'i sdug bsngal sna 'dren byed/ /'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal sdug bsngal sdug bsngal 'di phyi gnyis gar 'dren par byed/ /phung po grub pa tsam nas 'du byed sdug bsngal rtag tu 'grogs pas na/ /dper na khur chen khur ba ma phog bar du bde ba med pa bzhin/ /phung po 'di las ma grol bar du sdug bsngal ma gtogs bde ba med/ /des na sdug bsngal phung po spangs nas thar pa'i go 'phang thob par bya/ /de ltar nus par spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i byin gyis rlobs/ /gzhan yang khams gsum 'khor ba 'di na dgra rnams gnyen du 'gyur ba dang / /gnyen rnams dgra ru 'gyur nas 'gro bas phan gnod byed la yid brtan med/ /skye ba 'phos nas dgra gnyen gnyis ka go ldog ma zad tshe 'dir yang / /phan tshun 'gyur nas 'gro ste re 352

zhig cig na dgra yang mdza' bor 'gyur/ /mdza' bo yang ni de bzhin dgrar 'gyur de bzhin kha cig bar mar 'gyur/ /bar ma de nyid kyang ni dgrar 'gyur de bzhin mdza' bshes 'gyur 'gro bas/ /des na yid brtan mi rung gnyen bshes rnams la chags pa don mi 'dug /sngon chad sems can gcig gis ma byas nu zho 'thung ba gang yin pa/ /rgya mtsho chen po bzhi la de yi tshad tsam med gsungs de bzhin du/ /sems can kun gyis ma byas nu zho 'thung ba gzhal bar ga la nus/ /da yang rang gi tshe mjug 'di la thar pa'i btsan sa ma zin phyin/ /'khor ba'i gnas 'dir 'khyams nas de bas da dung ches mang 'thung bar 'gyur/ /de bzhin lha yi bdud rtsi la so gas 'khor ba'i bde ba ci tsam zhig /sngon chad spyad kyang tshim nga/ ma byung lhag par sred pa cher 'phel nas/ /bde ba de dag cha tsam du yang mi phod sdug bsngal mi zad myangs/ /sngon chad yang dang yang du dmyal ba'i zangs zhun bskol ba gang 'thung ba/ /phyi yi rgya mtsho chen po la yang de yi tshad tsam yod ma yin/ /sngon chad khyi dang phag tu gyur nas mi gtsang zos pa gang yin pa/ /da bus kyi ri yi rgyal po ri rab tshad las shin tu lhag par 'gyur/ /sngon chad mdza' bshes rnams dang bral nas 'khor ba'i gnas su gang ngus pa/ /mig 353

gi mchi ma'i thigs pa bsags na snod du rgya mtsho rung ma yin/ /sngon chad phan tshun rtsod pa'i phyir du mgo bo bcad pa gang yin pa/ /spungs na mtho ba'i tshad kyang tshangs pa'i 'jig rten las kyang thal bar 'gyur/ /des na da yang thar pa'i btsan sa ma zin phyin chad 'khor ba ru/ /yun ring 'khyams nas sdug bsngal shugs drag bzod glags med pa myong bar nges/ /sngon chad sems can re re'i lus blangs dor ba'i rus pa ma god na/ /lhun por mnyam pa yod gsungs des na lus thob pa la yid brtan med/ /rang gi ma dang ma yi ma byas bgrang ba'i ched du sa chen bo/ /'di nyid ril bu chung ngu dper na rgya shug tshi gu tsam pa byas/ /bgrangs kyang sa yis mi langs de bzhin sems can rnams kyis rang gi ma/ /rkyang ba byas pa bgrangs na grangs kyis mi langs ma de rnams kyi mngal/ /mi gtsang nang du nyal nas sngon chad sdug bsngal yun ring myong ba yin/ /sngon chad tshangs pa brgya byen 'khor bsgyur la sogs 'jig rten mchod 'os su/ /gyur kyang las kyi 'phen pa zad nas 'khor ba'i yang bran gyur pas na/ /mthon por gyur la yid brtan cang med 'chi dus gcige pur grogs med par/ /'jig rten pha rol 'gro dgos pas na 'grogs pa'i grogs la yid brtan med/ /des na sngon 354

chad rab lha'i bdud rtsi 'bring ma'i nu zho 'thung ba dang / /tha ma mi gtsang ba dang khro chu khol ma la sogab/ rgya mtsho las mang ba 'thungs kyang bzang pos tshim de chog 4gas ma byung ngan pa rnams/ /'thungs pas sun te zhen log ma byung da bar myang ba des chog gi /da ni dal 'byor mi (thus thob pa'i dus 'dir 'khor bar rgyab bstan nas/ /thar pa'i go 'phang rin po che de cis kyang myur du 'thob par bya/ /de ltar nus par spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i byin gyes rlobs/ /sdug bsngal de dag rgyu ni las dang nyon mongs gnyis yin khyang ) par du/ /nyon mongs gtso bo yin la nyon mongs rtsa ba bdag 'dzin phung rgan yin/ /bdag tu bzung la brten nas bdag ba/zhan so sor ris su gcod par byed/ /de ltar bcad ca/ sa rang phyogs la chags gzhan gyi phyogs la zhe sdang dang / /ga'an las mchog tu 'dzin pa'i nga rgyal la sogs lta log rnams skye pa/ /de la brten nas bdag med ston pa'i ston pa des bstan las 'bras dang / /bden bzhi dkon mchog gsum sogs med par 'dzin pa'i log lta the tshom skye/ /de la brten nas nyon mongs gzhan rnams rgyas nas nyon mongs de'i dbang gis/ /bsags pa'i las kyis sngon chad rigs drug so so'i lus blangs mi 'dod pa'i/ /sdug 355

bsngal rnam pa sna tshogs rang gis da lta'i bar du myong ba yin/ /da yang nyon mongs dgra ru bltas nas ma spangs phyin chad las bsags nas/ /slar yang 'gro ba rigs drug so so'i lus blangs sdug bsngal myong bar nges/ /des na bdag gis nyon mongs gang byung dgra ru bltas nas 'bur 'joms bya/ /de ltar nus par spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i byen gyis rlobs/ /rang nyid las dang nyon mongs gnyis kyi snying nag phung rgan dgra bo yis/ /'khor ba'i btson khang nang du nyer len phung po'i thag pa nag pos bcings/ /'du byed 'gyur dang sdug bsngal sdug bsngal gsum gyi chad pa nyin re bzhin/ /gcod cing sdug bsngal sna dgu 'dzom pa'i 'khor ba'i btson khang 'di nyid du/ /blo bder sdod pa shin tu 'khrul 'dug da ni bslab gsum cang shes kyi/ /rtar zhon 'bad rtsol drag pos lcag brab thar pa'i lam la gyen du rgyug /nam yang phyi mig mi blta bde chen thar pa'i grong khyer snyogs par bya/ /de ltar nus par spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i byen gyis rlobs/ /khyad par tshul khrims tshul bzhin bsrung na phan yon che zhing ma bsrung na/ /nyes dmigs shin tu che bar 'dug pas rang gis ji ltar khas blangs pa'i/ /tshul khrims srog gi phyir yang mi gtang mig 'bras bzhin du bsrung bar bya de 356

yang mi shes ltung ba 'byung ba'i sgo yin de yi gnyen po la/ /bslab bya rnams nyan shes par bya zhing ma gus ltung ba 'byung ba'i sgo/ /yin pas de yi gnyen por ston pa de yis bcas pa'i bslab pa dang / /bslab pa de la tshul bzhin slob grogs dge 'dun rnams la gus par bya/ /bag med ltung ba 'byung ba'i sgo yin de yi gnyen po blang dor gnas/ /gang yin dran pas gsal 'debs pa dang legs nyes dpyod pa'i shes bzhin gyis/ /bya ra byed cing ngo tsha khrel yod bskyed nas bag dang ldan par bya/ /nyon mongs mang ba ltung ba 'byung ba'i sgo yin de yi gnyen po la/ /nyon mongs gang byung 'bur 'joms byas nas nyes pas ma gos pa la 'bad/ /brgya pa gos kyang de ma thag tu phyir bcos stobs bzhi'i bshags sdom bya/ /de ltar nus par spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i byen gyis rlobs/ /rmad byung blo gros ri rab bsrubs shing sra bas mdo sngags rgya mtsho bsrubar+sha/ /lung rigs bzang dze/'i shel las legs grub lam rim che chung nyi zla blangs/ /rgengs can mkha' la 'phags tshe kun gyi mi shes mun pa bsal zhes grags/ /rgyal ba stobs mchog gnyis pa da dung snying gi pad dka/ra rtse la bzhugs/ /khyod gsungs smyos bu 'bring gi chos skor rin chen gser gyi 35 (

gling mchog nas/ /skyes bu 'bring dang thun mong lam rim nyung 'dus gser phye blangs zin nas/ /da ni skyes bu chen po'i chos skor yid bzhin nor bu'i gling bsnyegs nas/ /skyes bu chen po'i lam rim nyung 'dus 'dod don kun skong nor bu len/ /de ltar 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsams nas srid pa mtha' dag me 'obs ltar/ /mthong nas nyon mongs pa dang sdug bsngal nye bar zhi ba'i thar pa la/ /thob 'dod shugs drag blo skyes de nas bslab pa rin po che gsum la/ /bslab na 'khor ba las grol thar pa thob cing de yang mtho ris kyi/ /dpal ltar zad nas slar yang 'khor ba'i gnas su ltung ba ma yin mod/ /'on kyang skyon zad pa dang yon tan rdzogs pa phyogs re ba yin pa'i/ /rang don ma rdzogs pas na gzhan gyi don yang nyi tshe bar zad cing / /mthar yang sangs rgyas kyis bskul theg pa chen por nges par 'jug dgos pas/ /des na gzhan don gtso bor byas pas rang gi gnas skabs mthar thug don/ /ma tshang med par zhar la 'grub pa'i theg pa chen por 'jug par bya/ /de ltar nus par spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i byen gyis rlobs/ /rang gi mdun du pha ma grogs mched la sogs yid 'ong gnyen rnams dang / /dgra la sogs pa'i yid du mi 'ong ba dang bar 358

ma'i sems can dang / /de dag mja/'a bskor rnams su sems can gcig kyang ma lus yod par dmi/gas/ /sems can rnams kyi ngos nas bde 'dod sdug bsngal mi 'dod mtshungs pas na/ /sems can 'ga' zhig nye bar bzung nas phan 'dogs gnod pa sel ba dang / /'ga' zhig ring bar bzung nas gnod dang phan pa mi 'dogs ye mi rigs/ /rang gi ngos nas thog ma med nas da bar sems can 'di dag rnam sa/ /lan grangs mang por bdag gi gnyen du ma gyur pa ni ba/nga yang med/ /des na sems can gang la chags par bya la gang la sdang bar bya/ /da lta'i pha ma spun zla la sogs yid du 'ong ba'i gnyen rnams kyis/ /tshe rabs thog ma med nas dgra yi gtso bo byas pa grangs mi chod/ /dgra nam byas pa'i dus su nga nga la mi 'dod gnod pa tshad med bskyal/ /gnas khang gcig ji/ nang du gnas kyang yid mi bde bar nag yo re/ /de gzhan song na nam langs song ba lta bu grangs med byas pa yod/ /da lta'i dgra sogs yid mi 'ong ba 'dis kyang 'khor ba thog med nas/ /bdag gi pha ma phu nu spun zla sring mo bu dang chung ma dang / /grogs mched la sogs byas pa grangs kyis mi chod byas pa'i dus skabs/ su/ /phan bde tshad med bsgrub cing gnod pa tshad med pa pas bskyabs pa dang / /359

khyad par bdag gis 'di nyid med na cung zad sdod mi tshugs pa dang / /'dis kyang bdag med cung zad sdod mi tshugs pa grangs med byas pa yod/ /des na dgra gnyen gang la nye ring chags sdang gnyis dang bral bar bya/ /de ltar nus par spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i byen gyis rlobs/ /'khor ba thog ma med pas bdag gi skye ba la yang thog ma med/ /skye ba gcig nas gcig tu brgyud de yul phyogs sa phyogs 'dir ma skyes/ /bya ba gcig kyang med la skyes pa grangs kyis mi chod sems can gyi/ /lus 'di ma blangs bya ba gcig med blangs pa la yang grangs mi chod/ /sems can 'di yis bdag gi pha ma phu nu sring mo la sogs pa/ /ma byas gcig med byas pa la yang grangs kyis mi chod khyad par du/ /sems can re res mi yi rten la bdag ma ma byas gcig kyang med/ /byas pa grangs kyis mi chod de yi rgyu mtshan sangs rgyas sku tshe de'i/ /yum gyis sku tshe mang por ma byas gsungs shing gang zag gzhan la yang / /de ltar byas zhes gsungs pa'i phyir na sangs rgyas bka' la bslu ba med/ /sngar ma byas par ma zad ma 'ongs pa na da dung byed par 'gyur/ /'o na sems can grangs med pas na sems can thams cad bdag gi ma/ /ma yin snyam na sems can grangs med bzhin du bdag 360

gi skye ba yang / /grangs med blangs pa'i phyir na sems can thams cad rang gi ma yin nges/ / /dag gzhan kun gyi ma bu yin par ngo mi shes pas bdag gi ma/ /ma yin snyam na mi tshe 'dir yang ma bu gnyis ka chung dus su/ /dbye bas ngo mi shes na skye shis bar du bcad na ga la shes/ /gzhan yang sems can thams cad bdag gi tshe rabs snga ma'i dus su ma/ /yin kyang sngar 'das zin pas da ni bdag ma yi na par mi 'thad do/ /snyam na tshe 'di'i ma de zla ba sngon ma'i dus su ma yin la/ /zla ba phyi ma'i dus su bdag gi ma ma yin par ga la 'gyur/ /zla ba snga phyi'i dus su ma yin pa la khyad par med pa bzhin/ /tshe rabs sngar ma tshe 'di'i ma gnyis ma yin pa la khyad par med/ /des na sems can thams cad drin gyis bskyangs pa'i bdag gi ma (mar shes pa/)yin nges/ /dang po tshe 'di'i ma yi mngal du zhugs nas zla bcu'i bar du mas/ /gzhan gyis kha zas byen yang gnod kyis dogs nas gang yin za mi phod/ /‘ragro 'dug 'gul bskyod shugs drag byas na gnod kyis dogs nas dal bar byas tha na ske rags yan chad bsdams na gnod kyis dogs nas lhod por bcings/ /mngal nas chud zos ma byas dal 'byor lus 'di byin pas drin re che/ /bar du btsas dus sha rus 'gas 361

'dra'i sdug bsngal drag po myong bzhin btsas/ /btsas ma thag tu nor bu rnyed ltar sems dga' 'jam pa'i stan la bzhag /lag tu blangs nas byams pas mig gis blta zhing dga' ba'i 'dzum gyis bsus/ /snyan pa'i ming nas 'bod cing mngar ba'i nu zho kha ru yang yang blud/ /rum gyi phug gi dro sar bcug nas sha yi drod la rgyun tu glan/ /zas g.yos byin na chog kyang gnod kyis dogs nas lce yis bsnyad nas byin/ /snabs ni lag pas phyis na chog kyang gnod kyis dogs nas kha yis phyis/ /mi gtsang sa rdos phyis na chog kyang gnod kyis dogs nas lag pas phyis/ /mtshan mo'i dus su 'og tu gcur gyis dogs nas gnyid kyi bde ba bkag /zla ba kha shas song ba'i 'phro nas 'dzum re byas pa la yang ma/ /dga' ba bsam gyes mi khyab pa byas de nas gom pa re gnyis tsam/ /'degs shes tsa na bdag gi bu la ltos zer dga' bzhin gzhan la ngoms/ /chang 'thung bzhin du 'gro 'dug byed dus yul nas 'dug dus mig bzhin 'tsho/ /gzhan du song na bu de ci byas yod snyam sems la bde dus med/ /me chu g.yang sogs 'jigs pa las bskyabs za lugs 'gro lugs yan chad bslab/ /bu la mgo na tsam zhig byung yang gang yod 'phangs med glud du btang / /bu 'di na las rang nyid na dang 362

shi las rang nyid shi na snyams/ /de nas che ru song nas za ma gang bzang pho bas 'ju tshad byin/ /gang yod dro 'jam yang ba'i gos kyis g.yogs nas mjes pa'i rgyan gyis spras/ /bu rang gzhan du song ba'i shul nas za ma bza nga po zhig rnyed kyang / /kha ru za mi phod par bu la ster snyam rul rag bar du 'jog /bu la bzang zhig yod na sgog cing skyon 'ig yod kyang 'geb cing gsang / /skom dus mngar ba'i ja blud ltogs dus za ma gang yod mdun du bzhag /'khyags dus gos bskon mdor na gang mkho dga' bzhin byen pas drin re che/ /tha ma sdig sdug gtam ngan rang srog la yang ma bltas btsal ba yi/ /sa zhing khang ba nor rdzas ci yod thams cad rang la legs par byin/ /thams cad bu la 'phrod pa yin zhes dga' nga/ ga' byed pas drin re che/ /tshe 'di kho nar ma zad tshe rabs thog ma med nas da lta'i bar/ /ma 'dis bdag gi ma byas pa tshe mas bgrangs na grangs kyis chod mi 'gyur/ /ma byas dus su tshe 'dir rang nyid bskyangs bzhin drin gyis bskyangs pa yin/ /khyad par tshe rabs snga ma ma byas dus su rang gi don du mas/ /lus srog dor ba'i dus kyang yod nges ma 'di shin tu drin re che/ /tshe 'di'i pha dang dgra sogs 'gro drug sems can kun gyis bdag gi ma/ /byas 363

dus tshe 'di'i ma yis bskyangs bzhin drin gyis bskyangs pa sha stag yin/ /lhag par tshe rabs sngon mar sems can rnams kyis bdag gi ma byas dus/ /bdag gi don du lus srog dor ba'i ma ni mang po yod pa yin/ /phan gcig ma yin yang yang sems can re res bdag gi ma byas pa/ /grangs kyis mi chod ma nam byas pa'i dus su phan bde tshad med bsgrubs/ /gnod pa tshad med pa las bskyabs pas sems can thams cad drin re che/ /dper na kha sang ltogs dus zas byen de ring ltogs dus zas byin la/ /khyad par med bzhin tshe 'di'i ma dang tshe rabs sngon ma'i ma rnams kyi/ /drin gyis bskyangs la khyad par med pas sems can thams cad drin can(drin dran pa/)yin/ /ma rnams drin gyis bskyangs pa'i lan du rang gis drin gzo byed dgos te/ /da lta 'jig rten 'di na tshur la zas nor tsam gyis phan btags pa/ /phar la gdab lan ster na tshe rabs thog ma med nas sems can gyis/ /lan gcig ma yin yang yang phan btags drin lan 'jal ni cis mi dgos/ /rang gi ma smyos mig long long 'khrid med par lam log g.yang kha zhig /'grims pa rang gis mthong bzhin ma de yal bar dor na khrel med bzhin/ /ma gyur sems can thams cad nyon mongs gdon 364

gyis yid dkrugs dbang med spyos/ /ja1ra pa'i lam la blta ba'i mig long long 'khrid dge ba'i bshes gnyen med/ /'khor ba'i g.yang kha 'jigs su rung ba 'grims pa rang gis mthong bzhin du/ /skyabs med 'gro rnams yal bar dor na de las khrel med gzhan na gang / /da ni drin gyis bskyangs pa'i lan du sems can gcig kyang ma lus pa/ /'khor ba'i g.yang las myur du bsgral nas thar pa'i lam la 'god(drinagazo ba/)par bya/ /de ltar nus par spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i byen gyis rlobs/ /rang gi tshe 'di'i ma yis gtso byas ma gyu ra sems can tham/sa cad la/ /zag med bde ba yod pa phar zhog zag bcas bde ba tsam mi 'dug /bde ba 'dod nas 'bad 'bad dung dung byas kyang sdug bsngal tsam ma gtogs/ /bde ba gtan nas mi 'dug sems can bde dang ldan na ci ma rung / /sems can thams cad bde dang ldan par gyur cig(byams pa/)bde dang ldan par bya/ /de ltar nus par spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i byin gyis rlobs/ /byams pa legs par bsgom pa'i phan yon lho phyogs 'dzam bu'i gling tsam la/ /byams pa bsgom na de la dbang ba'i 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal por 'gyur/ /gling gnyis bsgom na de la dbang ba'i zangs kyi 'khor los bsgyur 365

rgyal 'gyur/ /gsum la bsgom na de la dbang ba'i dngul gyi 'khor los bsgyur rgyal 'gyur/ /gling ba zhir bsgom na de la dbang ba'i gser gyi 'khor los bsgyur rgyal 'gyur/ /stong dang po dang stong gnyis pa la bsgom na der dbang bdag por 'gyur/ /stong gsum po la bsgom na de la dbang ba'i tshangs par skye bar 'gyur/ /mar gyur nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad la bsgom na/ /de yi 'bras bu rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas min pa gzhan du mi 'gyur gsungs/ /spyir las bdag gir bya ba yin kyang byams pa rnal ma zhig skyes na/ /gzhan la phan te dper na rgyal po byams pa'i stobs lta bu yin gsungs/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis bdud sde byams pa'i stobs kyis pham par mdzad/ /des na 'bad pas bsgom na rang gi bsrung ba'i mchog tu 'gyur ba yin/ /byang shar mtshams kyi sangs rgyas dbang phyug chen po'i rgyal po'i 'jig rten khams/ /stong gis brgyan pa zhes bya de na dge slong 'gog pa la zhugs pas/ /bde bzhin sems can rnams kyang bde la der lo bye ba brgya stong du/ /tshangs spyod spyad las zhing 'dir tha na se gol gtogs pa'i yun tsam du/ /sems can rnams la byams sems bskyed na snga ma de las bsod nams 366

ches/ /mang du bskyed na nyin dang mtsha da du gnas pa lta ci smos zhes gsungs/ /bye ba khrag khrig zhing gi mchod pa rnam mang dpag med ji snyed pa/ /skyes mchog rnams la de yis rtag tu mchod las bsod nams ches che gsung sa/ /rdzi'u tshos sum brgya'i kha zas nyin re bzhin du dus gtsu/ma byin pa las/ /byams pa yud tsam thang cig bsgoms pa'i ba sod nams dag la char mi phod/ /lha dang mi yis byams par 'gyur dang de dag rnams kyis bsrung ba dang / /yid bde ba dang bde ba mang dang dug dang mtshon gyis gnod med dang / /'bad pa med par don 'thob pa dang tshangs pa'i 'jig rten skye bar 'gyur/ /gal te grol bar ma gyur na yang phan yon 'di na mas 'thob par gsungs/ /des na byams pa thugs dam mthil du bzung nas rtag tu bsgom par bya/ /de ltar nus par spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i byin gyis rlobs/ /rang gi tshe 'di'i ma yis gtso byas ma gyur sems can thams cad kyis/ /dmyal ba tsha grang yi dwags bkres skom dud 'gro bkol spyod sdug bsngal dang / /mi yi skye rga na 'chi lha min 'thab rtsod lha yi rapho ltung gi /sdug bsngal khor mo yug tu rgyun du myong ba shin tu snying re rje/ /sems can thams cad 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal kun dang bral na ci ma 367

rung / /sdug bsngal kun dang bral bar gyur cig sdug bsngal kun dang bral bar bya(snyingarje/)/ /de ltar nus par spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i byen gyis rlobs/ /snying rje bsgom pa'i dgos pa ma gyur sems can thams cad 'khor ba las/ /sgrol phyir nges par dam bca' byed nus de ltar dam bcas pa de yang / /tshogs gnyis rgya chen po la ma bslab mi 'grub mthong nas bya dka' ba'i/ /tshogs rgya chen po rnams la zhum pa med par nges par 'jug par nus/ /de ltar shin tu bya dka' ba la zhugs na ring por mi thogs par/ /myur du tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs nas thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas kyi/ /go 'phang thob nus sangs rgyas go 'phang thob nas theg pa dman pa bzhin/ /zhi bar mi gnas 'khor ba ma stongs bar du 'gro don mdzad pa yang / /snying rje chen po'i mthu yin dper na 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po yi/ /'khor lo rin po che de gang du mchis pa de ru dpung gi tshogs/ /thams cad mchis pa bzhin du snying rje chen po gang du mchis pa der/ /sangs rgyas chos kun mchi'o dper na srog gi dbang po mchis gyur na/ /dbang po gzhan rnams kun kyang mchis bzhin snying rje chen po mchis gyur na/ /byang chub sems dpa'i chos gzhan rnams kyang 'byung bar 368

'gyur zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ /des na snying rje thugs dam mthil du bzung nas rtag tu bsgom pa bya/ /de ltar nus par spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i byen gyis rlobs/ /sdug bsngal myong zhing bde bas phongs pa'i sems can myur du sdug bsngal dang / /bral ba bdag gis bya zhing bde dang ldan pa zhig kyang bdag(lhagabasam/)gis bya/ /de ltar nus par spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i byin gyis rlobs/ /sems can thams cad don byed pa la sangs rgyas nges par thob dgos shing / /rang gi don yang mthar phyin pa zhig byed na sangs rgyas thob dgos 'dug /sangs rgyas sku ni mtshan dpe gsal rdzogs mdzes shing blta bas chog mi shes/ /gsung dbyangs/ shin tu snyan cing 'gro ba so so'i skad du chos ston nus/ thugs kyis shes bya kun mkhyen 'gro ba kun la thugs rje nye ring che/da/ /'phrin las 'bad med lhun grub sku gsung thugs kyi 'od zer re re tsam/ /spros kyang sems can dpag med thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang la 'god nus/ /des na bdag gis tshe 'di'i ma yis gtso byas sems can thams cad kyi/ /do na du myur bar myur du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas go 'phang(byangachub kye sems/)thob par bya/ /de ltar nus par spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i nga/ bang po'i byin gyis 369

rlobs/ /spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i sku las rang 'dra gnyis pa zhig /mar me gcig las gnyis chad tshul du byung nas rang nyid la thim pas/ /rang nyid 'dren pa mnyam med rgyal ba shākya thub pa'i sku ru gyur/ /rang gi sku las 'od zer bsil ba chu rgyun lta bu dpag med 'phros/ /tsha dmyal sems can rnams dang gnas la phog pas tsha ba'i sdug bsngal zhi/ /snod kyi skyon sbyangs bde ba can zhing lta bu'i dag pa'i zhing du gyur/ /tsha dmyal yul gyi mar gyur sems can thams cad thub dbang sku ru gyur/ /'od zer me dang nyi ma'i 'od zer lta bu dpag tu med pa 'phros/ /grang dmyal sems can rnams dang gnas la phog pas grang ba'i sdug bsngal zhi/ /snod kyi skyon sbyangs bde ba can zhing lta bu'i dag pa'i zhing du gyur/ /grang dmyal yul gyi mar gyur sems can thams cad thub dbang sku ru gyur/ /'od zer dpag med 'phros pas yi dwags rnams dang de yi gnas la phog /bkres skom grang dro ngal dub la sogs yi dwags sdug bsngal thams cad zhi/ /snod kyi skyon sbyangs bde ba can zhing lta bu'i dag pa'i zhing du gyur/ /yi dwags yul gyi mar gyur sems can thams cad thub dbang sku ru gyur/ /'od zer dpag med 'phros pas dud 'gro rnams dang de yi gnas la 370

phog /bkol spyod sdug bsngal la sogs dud 'gro'i sdug bsngal yod tshad thams cad zhi/ /snod kyi skyon sbyangs bde ba can zhing lta bu'i dag pa'i zhing du gyur/ /dud ragro'i yul gyi mar gyur sems can thams cad thub dbang sku ru gyur/ /'od zer dpag med 'phros te mi yi 'gro ba rnams dang gnas la phog /skye rga na 'chi la sogs mi yi sdug bsngal yod tshad thams cad zhi/ /snod kyi skyon sbyangs bde ba can zhing lta bu'i dag pa'i zhing du gyur/ /mi yi yul gyi mar myur sems can thams cad thub dbang sku ru gyur/ /'od zer dpag med 'phros nas lha ma yin dang de yi gnas la phog /'thab rtsod zhe sdang phrag dog la sogs lha ma yin gyi sdug bsngal zhi/ /snong kyi skyon sbyangs bde ba can zhing lta bu'i dag pa'i zhing du gyur/ /lha min yul gyi mar gyur sems can thams cad thub dbang snyu/ ru gyur/ /'od zer dpag med 'phros nas lha dang lha yi gan ga ni kun la phog /'pho ltung sdug bsngal la sogs lha yi sdug bsngal yod tshad thams cad zhi/ /snod kyi skyon sbyangs bde ba can zhing lta bu'i dag pa'i zhing du gyur/ /lha yi yul gye mar gyur sems can thams cad thub dbang sku ru gyur/ /rang gi tshe rabs thog ma med nas mar gyur 'gro kun yal bar dor/ /rang nyid gces 371

par bzung nas rang don kho na rgyun du 'bad 'bad kyang / /rang don ma grub ma zad mi 'dod sdug bsngal sna tshogs da bar myong / /des na rang nyid gces 'dzin 'khor ba ngan song sdug bsngal la sogs pa'i/ /rgud pa kun gyi gnas su 'dug pas rang nyid gces 'dzin ma skyes pa/ /mi bskyed pa dang skyes pa rnams kyang dgra ru bltas nas spangs par bya/ /de ltar nus par spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i byin gyis rlobs/ /thub pa'i dbang pos rang nyid yal bar dor nas gzhan rnams gces par bzung / /gzhan don 'ba' zhig mdzad pas sngon nas mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas 'dug /bdag gis de ltar byas na snga bar 'tshang rgya ba la ma byas lan/ /des na gzhan rnams gces par 'dzin pa yon tan kun gyi 'byung gnas su/ /'dug pas gzhan rnams gces 'dzin ma skyes gsar du bskyed dang skyes zin pa/ /gnyen du bltas nas zla ba yar ngo bzhin du gong nas gong 'phel bya/ /de ltar nus par spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i byin gyis rlobs/ /rang gis tshe 'di'i drin can ma sogs sems can thams cad mdun du dmigs/ /sems can 'di dag rnams kyi ngos nas bde 'dod sdug bsngal mi 'dod mtshungs/ /rang gi ngos nas sems can thams cad tshe 372

sngon gnyen du ma gyur med/ /des na ser/sa can gang la nye ring chags sdang gnyis dang bral bar bya/ /de ltar nus par spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i byen gyis rlong/sa/ /'gro bas bdag ma ma byas gcig med byas pa la yang grangs mi chod/ /byas dus tshe 'di'i ma yis bskyangs bzhin bskyangs pa yin pas drin re che/ /da lta drin can ma rnams sdug bsnga' / sna tshogs myong ba snying re rje/ /rang la drin lan 'jal rgyu yod na da lta mi 'jal nam tshod 'jal/ /da ni myur du mar gyur ḍardogro ba'i sdig sgrib sdug bsngal bdag gis blangs/ /bdag ge bde dge thams cad gzhan la btang nas ma gyur 'gro ba kun/ /sdug bsngal kun dang bral zhing bde ba phun sum tshogs dang ldan par bya/ /de ltar nus par spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i byin gyis rlobs/ /rang gi sna sgo'i rlung phar 'gro dus rang gi bde dge ci yod rnams/ /'od zer dkar po'i rnam nga/ra song nas tshe 'di'i ma yis gtso byas pa'i/ /sems can kun gyi lus sems la zhugs zag pa med pa'i bde bas gang / /'gro kun 'phral du bde zhing phugs su 'tshang rgya nus pa tsam du gyur/ /rang gi sna sgo'i rlung tshur 'ong dus tshe 'di'i ma sogs 'gro kun gyi/ /sdig sgrib sdug bsngal thams cad dud pa nag dze/'i rnam par tshur 373

'ong nas/ /rgyun du snying gi dkyil na nga nga zer ba'i bdag 'dzin phung rgan gyi/ /thog tu sib sib thim pas bdag 'dzin rjes med rdul phran bzhin du brlag /'gro rnams sdig ltung kun dang bral bar bsams la gtong len yang yang bya de ltar nus par spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i byen gyis rlobs/ /mar gyur 'gro ba'i sdig sgrib sdug bsngal ma lus bdag la smin par shog /bdag gi bde dge btang ba'i mthu yis 'gro kun bde zhing skyid par shog /ces pa'i tshig 'dis smon lam rnam par dag pa mjug tu gdab par bya/ /smon 'jug gnyis kyi sdom pa 'jug pa bde phyir dus gcig len pa'i tshul/ /spyi bo'i bla ma thub dbang sku las skyabs yul nam mkha' gang bar spros/ /de dag bla ma thub dbang mtha' bskor 'ja' 'od klong na bzhugs par gyur/ /sems can thams cad don du myur du sangs rgyas go 'phang thob par bya/ /de phyir dus 'di nas bzung bla med byang chub go 'phang ma thob bar/ /rgyal sras sdom pa bzung nas spyod pa rlabs po che la bslab par bya/ /snyam du spyi bo'i bla ma thub dbang rjes zlos byed par mos pa'i sgos/ /bla ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol/ /ji ltar sngon gyi bde gshegs rnams kyis byang chub 374

thugs ni bskyed pa dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i bslab byar rim bzhin gnas ltar bdag kyang 'gro ba4na phyir/ /byang chub sems bskyed bgyi zhing byang sems bslab byar rim bzhin gnas par bya/ /lan gsum brjod pas byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa thob pa'i mos pa bya/ /da re bdab/ gi dal 'byor mi lus thob pas bzang bzang don chen 'grub/ /de ring sangs rgyas rigs su sgyes pas sangs rgyas sras su da gyur to/ /'jig rten lha mir bcas pa'i phyag byar 'os su gyur pa e ma ho/ /da ni rigs mthun ya rabs las bya ma rabs spyod ngan spangs par bya/ /snyam du tshig bzhi ngag tu brjod ci nga rang la spro ba bskyed par bya/ /tshogs zhing thams cad slar yang bla ma thub dbang thugs gar thim par gyur/ /phan yon sem sa bskyed byas ma thag nas bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /sras su gyur pa'i dgra bcom pa rnams rigs kyi sgo nas zi‘ba gyis gnon/ /'jig rten lha mir bcas pa'i phyag dang mchod pa'i gnas su 'gyur ba dang / /'khor los bsgyur rgyal bsdi/nga ba'i srung mas nyis 'gyur gyis ni rtag tu bsrungs/ /gnyid log pa dang myos dang bag med gyur kyang gnod sbyin mi ma yin/ /gnyug mar gnas pa rnams kyis gnod par mi nus gsang sngags rig sngags 375

tshig /yams dang gnod pa 'go nad zhi bar byed pa gang zag gzhan lag na/ /yod pa ma grub pa rnams byang chub sems dang ldan pa'i gang zag gi /lag tu 'ong na 'grub par 'gyur na grub pa gzhan rnams lta ci smos/ /des na zhi ba la sogs las kyang sems bskyed brtan na 'grub sla bar/ /brtan pas thun mong dngos grub sgrub pa la yang 'di nyid yod na myur/ /gang zag de nyid gang na gnas sar 'jigs dang 'jigs par 'gyur ba dang / /mu ge mi ma yin gyi gnod pa ma byung ba rnams mi 'byung zhing / /byung ba rnams kyang myur du zhi bar 'gyur dang nam zhig tshe 'phos pa'i/ /'og tu nad med pa dang gnod pa nyung zhing gnod pa byung na yang / /yun ring po dang drag pos mi 'debs chos ston pa sogs sems can gyi/ /don la 'jug na lus mi ngal zhing brjed nges pa dang sems nyams par/ /mi 'gyur ba dang byang chub sems dpa'i rigs la gnas par rang bzhin gyis/ /gnas ngan len ni nyung ba yin la sems bskyed na ni lus sems kyis/ /gnas ngan len ni shin tu chung bar 'gyur dang bzod pa dang ldan pas/ /tshur la gnod pa byas pa bzod cing phar la gnod pa mi byed la/ /gzhan gyis gzhan la gnod pa byed pa mthong na shin tu mi dga' dang / /khong khro 376

phrag dog g.yo sgyu la sogs re 'ga' tsam las mi skye zhing / /skyes kyang shugs mi drag la ring du mi ga nas myur du 'bral bar 'gyur/ /ngan song gsum du skye dka' gal te skyes kyang myur du tha ra pa dang / /der yang sdug bsngal chung dang de yi rkyen byas 'khor ba 'di nyid la/ /shin tu skyo da ri sems can de dag la yang snying rje skye ba'o/ /sangs rgyas zhing khams thams cad gang gis rin chen dag gis kun bkang ste/ /'jig rten mgon la phul las gang gi lag gnyis thal mo sbyar bgyis te/ /byang chub sems bskyed byas na mchod pa 'di ni khyad par 'phags zhes gsungs/ /jo bo chen po rdo rje gdan la bskor ba mdzad nas ci byas na/ /myur du yang dag rdzogs pa re sangs rgyas go 'phang thob snyam dgongs pa na/ /sku gzugs chung ba rnams bzhengs che ba rnams la myur du 'tshang rgya bar/ /'dod pas gang la bslab par bya zhes yar la dri ba mdzad pa'i tshe/ /sku gzugs che bas byang chub sems la bslab par bya dgos gsungs pa dang / /gan dzha la yi steng gi nam mkhar bud med rgan pa zhig la yar/ /gzhon pa zhig gis dris pa la yang lan ni sngar ltar mdzad par skad/ /des na myur du 'tshang rgya ba sogs byang chub sems kyi bsod nams ni/ /gzugs su grub rgyu yin na nam mkha' la 377

yang da dung shong mi 'gyur/ /rgyal sras rnams kyis bskal pa du mar rmad du byung ba'i mkhyen rab kyis/ /lam rnams kun la dpyad tshe 'di nyid myur du 'tshang rgya'i thabs dam par/ /gzigs pa'i phyir na theg pa chen po'i man ngag rnams kyi gnad bsdus pa/ /dngos grub kun gyi gter chen theg pa dman las 'byed pa'i theg chen gyi/ /khyad chos rgyal sras thams cad spyod pa rlabs po che la bskul ba'i rten/ /byang chub sems su shes par byas nas bsgom la spro shugs je 'phel btang / /nyin dus lan gsum mtshan dus lan gsum byang chub sems ni bskyed par bya/ /de ltar nus par spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i byen gyis rlobs/ /sems can rnams kyi ngos nas byed spyod ci 'dra na yang rang ngos nas/ /sems can gcig kyang blo yis mi spongs sems bskyed gong du 'phel phyir du/ /dkon mchog gsum la mchod pa la sogs tshogs gnyis bsog la 'bad par bya/ /gzhan yang bla ma mkhan slob sogs la tha na ku re bzhad gad phyir/ /rdzun gyis dbu bskor ba dang dge ba byed la 'gyod pa bskyed pa dang / /theg pa che la zhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams la zhe sdang gis/ /mi snyan smra dang bsam pa drang bo min pa'i g.yo sgyu byed pa ste/ /nag po'i chos bzhi la sogs 378

sems bskyed nyams pa'i rgyu rnams spangs/ par bya/ /de ltar nus par spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i byin gyis rlobs/ /sems can mchog dman bar ba gang la tha na bzhad gad phyir du yang / /shes bzhin rdzun tshig smra ba spong dang rang gis gdul bya'i sems can rnams/ /nyi tshe'i jeg pa da mi 'jug rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dzin du 'jug pa dang / /byang chub sems dpa' rnams la ston pa'i 'du shes bskyed cing de dag gis/ /bsngags pa phyogs bzhir brjod cing sem/sa can rab 'bring tha gsum su la yang / /g.yo sgyu byed pa rtag ra/1 spangs nas bsam pa drang bos gnas pa ste/ /dkar po'i chos bzhi la sogs sems bskyed 'phel ba'i rgyu la bslab par bya/ /de ltar nus par spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i byen gyis rlobs/ /sems can thams cad don du myur du sangs rgyas go 'phang thob par bya/ /de'i phyir rnyed bkur grags pa sogs la mi blta bsam pa bzang po'i sgos/ /chos kyis phongs paḍirdo sems can rnams la dam chos ci shes ston pa dang / /de yang rang nyid chos 'chad pa la bskos pa min yang gzhan rnams kyis/ /tshig don 'dri tshe tshig slob don ston pa dang pha rol snod rung du/ /shes tshe gleng mo'i tshul gyis pha rol po la thos bsam sgom gsum gyi/ /shes 379

rab bskyed na gzhan la shes rab ji tsam bskyed pa de tsam gyi/ /skye ba phyi mar rang la shes rab de snyed skye bar 'gyur ba dang / /chos kyi sbyin pa zang zing sbyin pa las kyang phan yon che bar gsungs/ /des na bsam pa bzang pos gzhan la dam chos ci shes ston par bya/ /de ltar nus par spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i byen gyis rlobs/ /rgyal po chom rkun la sogs mi yi 'jigs pa rnams dang stag seng dang / /dug sbrul bya dang gcan gzan la sogs mi ma yin pa'i 'jigs pa dang / /sa chu me sogs 'byung ba'i 'jigs pas nyen pa'i sems can skyobs par bya/ /de yang tha na grog ma la sogs chu yis khyer ba 'don pa dang / /me dang nyi ma gnyis kyis 'tshig par rtsom pa thams cad thabs mkhas kyis/ /'jigs pa de las bskyabs na phyi mar 'jigs bral bde ba 'thob par 'gyur/ /des na sems can 'jigs pas nyen pa mthong tshe skyobs la 'bad par bya/ /de ltar nus par spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i byen gyis rlobs/ /rang la phan 'dogs mdza' bshes rnams dang gnod pa byed pa'i dgra bo dang / /phan gnod gang yang mi byed tha mal ba dang tshul khrims la sogs pa'i/ /yon tan can dang tshul 'chal la sogs skyon can rnams dang rang nyid las/ /dma' ba rnams 380

dang rang dang mnyam pa rnams dang rang las lhag pa dang / /'byor zhing skyid pa rnams dang sdug cing phongs pa'i sems can gang la yang / /zang zing sbyin dus 'de la brten nas bdag gis bla na med pa 'i tshogs/ /sbyin pare phar phyin rdzogs par bya'o snyam dang byang chub sems dpa' yis/ /yo byad ci yod thams cad sngon nas sems can rnams la btang zin pas/ /bcol ba len ltar rang gi rdzas la gzhan gyi yin no snyam pa dang / /slong dang mi slong sbyin yul rnams la 'di dag bdag gis sbyin pa yi/ /phar phyin rdzogs pa ra byed pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen yin no snyam pa dang / /gnod pa byed la byams pa'i sems dang sdug bsngal ba la snying rje yi/ /bsam pa yon tan can la dga' ba'i bsam pa phan 'dogs byed rnams la/ /btang snyoms bsam pa bzhag nas gang 'a/ gang 'os nor rdzas sbyin par bya/ /de ltar nus par spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i byin gyes rlobs/ /sbyin yul rnams la sems snyoms bya dgos sbyin pa btang ba'i 'bras bu yang / /slong ba po sogs nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems/ can thams cad la/ /gtong dang khyad par sdug bsngal can gyi snyen yul rnams la brtse bar bya/ /sbyin pa 'bras bu med do snyam dang gnod 'tshe'i 381

sbyin pa chos su 'gyur/ /snyam dang dge mtshan bkra shis sbyar te sbyin dang sbyin pa rdzogs tsam gyis/ /'jig rten 'jig rten las 'das chags bral 'gyur ro snyam nas sbyin mi bya/ /slong ba po la brnyas dang nor rdzas sbyin par btang nas bdag nyid ni/ /gtong phod can no gzhan ni de ltar ma yin snyam pa'i rlom sems spangs/ /snyan grags 'ong du re nas sbyin par mi bya ster ba'i sngon nas rang / /yid dga' sbyin tshe dang bar byed la byin nas 'gyod pa med pa dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i sbyin pa shin tu rgya che ba rnams thos na yang / /zhum pa mi byed bdag la khyad du gsod par mi byed spro ba spel/ /dgra gnyen gang la phyogs ris med par snyoms pa'i snying rjes sbyin par bya/ /de ltar nus par spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i byin gyis rlobs/ /rang gi ma gyur sems can thams cad bde bas phongs dang sred pa yi/ /mes tshig pa dang sdug bsngal sel ba'i mthu med pa dang rang bzhin gyis/ /sdug par mthong nas de nyid sel ba'i bsam pas ster bar ma gtogs pa'i/ /pha rol po yis phan 'dogs re ba'i bsam pas sbyin pa gtong mi bya/ /nor rdzas snying bo med par shes nas sems can don du sangs rgyas kyi/ /go 'phang thob phyir sbyin par ma gtogs phyi mar lus 382

dang longs spyod rnams/ /phun sum tshogs pa thob tu re nas de'i phyir sbyin pa gtong mi bya/ /gnas skabs 'bras bu de dag rnams la re ba 'gog pa ma yin gyis/ /srid pa'i phun tshogs tsam la mthar thug thob byar 'dzin pa ḍa gog par bya/ /de ltar nus par spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i byen gyis rlobs/ /gzhan yang sbyin pa btang na rgyal po sogs kyis gtong phod can du bdag /shes nas bkur sti byung na snyam pas log pa'i 'tsho ba'i bsam pa dang / /dbul bor (ragyur du dogs nas mi sbyin pa dang slong ba po gang la/ /brje / bsam pa dang yid mi dga' dang khro dang sems g.yeng med pa dang / /slong ba po yis log sgrub sna tshogs kyis kyang skyo ba med pa dang / /rang nyid bslu ba la sogs slong ba po yi skyon ni mthong zu/ yang / /gzhan la sgogs pa'i bsam pa med dang gzhan gyeb/ kha drangs mi thub par/ /sbyin pa so so'i 'bras bu so sor rdobyung bar yid ches sgo nas sbyin/ /myur bor mi ster 'gyangs rtarte ster dang nyon mongs byas nas ster ba dang / /chos sam ḍardojig rten tshul dang mi mthun las byed bcug nas ster ba dang / /sngar dus 'di tsam ster zhes dam bcas pa las phri nas ngan pa 'am/ /nyung ngu ster dang drin ni bgrang gin ster dang dus gcig byin chog pa/ /383

nyung ngu byas nas ster dang rgyal por gyur nas gzhan gyi bu chung ma/ /'phrog ste ster dang pha ma bran la sogs pa'i yo byad nan gyis blangs/ /gzhan la ster dang gzhan la gnod par 'gyur ba'i thabs kyis sbyin gtong dang / /rang gis sbyin pa mi gtong bsdad nas gzhan la byed du 'jug pa dang / /slong ba po la 'phya dang zur gyis smod dang tshig rtsub smra ba dang / /sangs rgyas bcas par 'gal nas ster dang longs spyod 'phral du gang byung ba/ /bzhin du mi gtong yun ring bsags nas ster tshul thams cad 'dor bar bya/ /de ltar nus par spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i byin gyis rlobs/ /bzhin mdangs rab tu gsal zhing 'dzum pa snyan tshig smra ba dang ldan pas/ /sbyin yul ci 'dra ba zhig yin rung gus pa che rim gro bskyed pa dang / /rang gi lag gis ster dang slong ba'i dus las mi 'da' ster ba dang / /gzhan la mi gnod pa dang dka' spyad sdug bsngal bsran nas sbyin par bya/ /de ltar nus par spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i byen gyis rlobs/ /rim gro bgyis nas byen pas gnyen la sogs pas rim gro byed par 'gyur/ /rang gi lag gis byin pas rim gro thob dang longs spyod rgya chen rnyed/ /slong ba'i dus su byin pas rang gi don rnams dus su 'grub par 'gyur/ /384

gzhan la gnod med byen pas longs spyod med par mi 'gyur brtan par 'gyur/ /rang la yo byad yorngod na sbyin pa gtong bar mi nus ser sna can/ /rnams kyi khyim du song nas mgu zhing bag phebs byas te 'di skad du/ /nga la yo byad rgya chen yod de da ni bdag gis sbyin pa yi/ /phar phyin rdzogs / pa'i phyir du slong ba po 'dod khyed ni slong ba dang / /phra da na bzlog ste ma gtong nga yi nor rnams long la de la byin/ /nga/nga na nga yi thad du khrid de shog dang gang 'os sbyin zhes bshad/ /des kyang rang gi nor rnams gol ba med pa'i dga' bas de bzhin byed/ /de ltar byas na goms pa'i shugs kyis rang nor chung ngu ster bar nus/ /de la brten nas 'bring dang nge la brten nas chen po gtong bar 'gyur/ /de bzhin rang gi ma/ban slob grogs sogs gtong mi nus pa thams cad dang / /po/ byad med par yo byad byin te dkon mchog gsum la mchod pa dang / /dbul bo rnams la sbyin pa gtong du bcug nas ra ra gis mi byed do/ /'dis ni rang gi bsod nams mang po bskye da la gzhan ni kha cig gi /nyon mongs thul dang kha cig cho sa kyi 'dod pa rdzogs pas shin tu legs/ /rang la longs spyod med na bzo dang las kyis nor bsgrubs ster ba dang / /ya rdo na sgo ru slong ba gang 385

byung dad can 'byor ldan khyim du gtong / /rang yang de ru song nas ci nus sbyin par gtong ba'i grogs byed do/ /gzhan yang sbyin bya'i nor rdzas rnams las 'dam ste bzang rim ster ba dang / /sbyin par bya ba'i rdzas rnams bshams pa yongs su rdzogs par sbyin par bya/ /de ltar nus par spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i byin gyis rlobs/ /dngos po gang btang ba des 'phral du ngan 'gro'i rgyu dang bral ba yi/ /tshor ba bde ba bskyed la phugs su phan pa sdig pa sgong ba'am/ /dge la 'god dang phral du mi bde 'gyur yang phugs su phan 'gyur na/ /byang chub sems dpas gzhan la btang bar bya la gang btang ba des phral/ /sdug bsngal bskyed la phugs su gnod par 'gyur dang phral du bde na yang / /phugs su gnod na byang chub sems dpas gzhan la btang bar mi bya'o/ /byang chub sems dpas sngon nas lus la sogs pa sems can thams cad la/ /bsam pa thag pas btang yod mod kyang lus kyi sha sogs slong ba la/ /byen pa'i nad tshas yid 'byung mi 'gyur snying rje chen po'i bsam pa ni/ /ma rgyas bar du gzhan gyis slong yang rang lus gtong bar mi bya'o/ /rang gi ngos nas ser sna la sogs sbyin pa'i gegs byed dang bral zhing / /gzhan gye ngos nas lus ma 386

btang na sems can mang po'i don 'a/yib pa'i/ /dgos pa che tshe yan lag la sogs gzhan gyes slong 0 4nga sbyin mi bya/ /srog gcod la sogs gzhan dang rang la gnod pa'i nyes spyod byed phyir du/ /slong ba byung na rang nyid de la nam yang sbyin par mi bya'o/ /bdud ris lha dang de yis /rlams pa'i sems can rnams kyis mtho 'tshams pas/ /bsam pas yan lag la sogs slong na mi sbyin smyos dang sems 'khrugab/ pa/ /rnams kyis slong na mi ster 'di dag bsam pa thag pas slong ba min/ /de'i phyir ma byen ltung ba med par ma zad byin na stung bar 'gyur/ /de dag ma gtogs skabs su lus slong ba la sbyin par bya ba ste/ /de yang yan lag la sogs gsil nas g.yo/na la gtan nas sbyin pa dang / /gzhan gyi chos ldan dgos pa sgru ba phyir bran du 'gro ba la sogs bya/ /de ltar nus par spyi boḍirdo bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i byen gyes rlobs/ /rab byung bsnyen rdzogs bsnyen gnas can la phyi dro'i kha zas ster mi bya/ /sdom /brtson can la zas skom lhag mar gyur pa ster dang bshang gci dang / /mchil ma snabs dang skyug pa rnag khrag gis sbags bza' /btung ster mi bya/ /sgog pa btsong dang sha mi za zhing chang mi 'thung ba'i sdom ldan la/ /sgog btsong sha chang mi ster de /pes sbags pa'i bza' 387

btung ster mi bya/ /gzhan la song zhes bshad tshe bu dang bran sogs 'gro bar 'thad na yang / /gnod sbyin srin po mi mdza' ba dang drag shul can gyis gnod pa'am/ /byas pa mi gzo rnams kyis slong la bu dang bran sogs ster mi bya/ /bza' btung mi 'phrod pa dang 'phrod kyang tshod mi zin pa'i slong ba po/ /nad can rnams la mi ster ha cang sred pa che zhing 'grangs pa yi/ /kha zas slong la mi 'phrod pa dang ha cang mang po ster mi bya/ /mu stegs glan ka 'tshol dang glegs bam don shes 'dod pa ma yin par/ /nor gyi 'du shes can gyis slong la glegs bam ster bar mi bya'o/ /rang gi glegs bam dgos pa sgrub zin pa yang min la glegs bam la/ /ser sna'i dri ma med tshe shes 'dod slong yang glegs bam ster mi bya/ /glegs bam khyod la mi ster mi smra thabs mkhas byas nas gtong bar bya/ /thabs mkhas byang chub sems dpa'i yo byad ci yod thams cad dang po nas/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems rnams la bsam pa thag pas bsngos zin pas/ /yo byad thams cad sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyis bcol ba 'dra bar 'chang / /slong ba po ni 'ong tshe yo byad sbyin par 'os pa zhig yin na/ /sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyis sems can rnams la ma btang yo byad ni/ /388

gang yang med do snyam du ster la 'os nga ma yin zhig yin na/ /sangs rgyas byang sems rnams la bsngos zin pa la brten nas 'di skad smra/ /bzhin bzang 'di ni ga(nan gye yin te khyed la nga yis sbyin du med/ /zhes pas 'jam pare tshig gis go bar byed la yang na glegs bam de'i/ /rin sdo nyis 'gyur sum 'gyur rdzas sbyin pa na slong ba de nyid kyis/ /byang sems 'di ni sred pa che nas mi sbyin pa ni ma yin gyi/ /glegs bam 'di ni sbyin pa'i dbang med pa zhig yin nges snyam du 'gro // /de ltar thabs mkhas byed pa de ni shes rab can gye sbyin pa'o/ /rang gi pha dang ma dang srog chags bcas pa'i bza' ba btung ba dang / /gzhan la gtong ba yin zhes ma bshad / 4 dang bshad kyang 'gro ba la/ /mi 'thad bu dang chung ma bran sogs mi 'thad bzhin du sbyin mi bya/ /bu dang chung ma skyid lob pa rnams gzhan gyi bran du ster mi bya/ /chos gos gsum dang de pas gzhan pa'i yo byad lhag pa sangs rgyas kyis/ /rjes su gnang ba rnams la ser sna'i bsam pa med cing nyer mkho ba/ /yin na gzhan gyis slong la ma byen na yang nyes pa med par gsungs/ /rang ngam gzhan la gnod pa'i phyir du dug mtshon me char ste ra ba dang / /phyi mar ngan 'gro'i gnas su 'gro ba'i rgyu gsog ཿdgag bya dang ldan 389

pa'i/ /dga' zhing rtsed mo rtse ba'i dngos po slong la de dag sbyin pa dang / /rgya dang sa mda' la sogs sems can rnams la gnod pa slob pa dang / /slong la'ang de dag slob dang sbyin dang skam mam gsher la gnas pa yi/ /srog chags rnams la gnod pa bskyel ba'i phyir du sa phyogs chu slong la/ /de dag sbyin dang yul mi de'am gzhan la gnod pa bskyel phyir du/ /rgyal srid slong la de dag sbyin dang mi mdza' rnams kyis slong ba la/ /de yi dgra ster lta bu'i rang dang gzhan la gnod pa sbyin mi bya/ /ston pas ma bkag dus dang slong la mi 'os sbyin pa ma yin zhing / /de dang 'tsham pa yin na dngos po gang yang dga' bas sbyin par bya/ /de ltar nus par spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i byin gyis rlobs/ /glegs bam nyid la ser sna ldan na mu stegs glan ka 'tshol ba dang / /nor rdzas phyir du glegs bam btsong ba lta bu ma yin glegs bam don/ /shes par 'dod pa'i slong ba po la sbyin dgos de yang dpe gnyis pa/ /yod na de nyid ster dgos med na dpe de 'dri ba'i rin ster dgos/ /de yang med na bdag gis glegs bam 'di nyid byen pa'i tshe 'di la/ /lkugs par gyur kyang sla yi ser sna dang du blangs par mi bya'o/ /snyam du bsams nas ser sna can gyi glegs bam nges par sbyin 390

par bya/ /de ltar nus par spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i byen gyes rlobs/ /dngos po sngar bshad pa las ma gtogs pa dang rgyal po byed pa'i tshe/ /gzhan gyi bu dang chung ma la sogs kha phral sbyin du mi rung yang / /grong la sogs dang bcas te slong ba po la sbyin par btang bar bya/ /de bzhin ngan 'gro'i rgyu ru mi 'gyur ba yi dga' rtsed dngos po dang / /gzhan 'a mi gnod rgya la sogs dang srog chags dag la mi gatsho da na/ /srog chags gnas pa'i skam dang gsher gyi sa dang dro stog chags med pa yi/ /bza' btung slong la sbyin dgos pa dang rang ngam gzhan la phan phyir du/ /slong na dug dang mtshon cha me dang chang la sogs pa'ang sbyin par bya/ /de ltar nus paza ri spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i byin gyis rlobs/ /zang zing sbyin pa gtong ba'i dus su slong ba bkren dang 'byor ldan gnyis/ /byung na ci ltar bya dgos snyam na gnyis ga'i 'dod pa rdzog sa nus na/ /gnyis ga'i 'dod pa bskang bar bya la mi nus 'dug na bkren pa pos/ /'dod pa rdzogs par bya'o snyam pa sngon du btang nas 'di skad zer/ /bzhin bzang nga yi yo byad 'de nyid bkren pa 'di la dang po nas/ /bsngos zin tshar ba yin nga/sa khyod la ma byen snyam du ma sems shig /ces pas 'jam po'i tshig gis go bar byas 391

nas bkren po'i 'dod pa bskang / /slong ba po yis bslangs pa'i dus su ser snas non na rang nyid kyi/ /lus srog longs spyod thams cad chu yi lbu ba lta bu mi rtag pas/ /dngos po 'di dang bdag gnyis gdon mi za bar nges par so sor 'bral/ /'dis kyang bdag 'dor bdag gis 'di 'dor nam yang 'dor ba mnyam po la/ /da lta'i dus 'dir sbyin par btang na rang la skye ba phyi ma ru/ /ji ltar btang ba chung yang brgya 'gyur thob pas phongs shing dbul mi 'gyur/ /'chi dus nor la chags par mi 'gyur 'gyod pa med la rab tu dga'/ /snyam du bsam la longs spyod gang la'ang chags pa med par gtong bar bya /de ltar nus par spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i byen gyis rlobs/ /gzhan yang sbyin bya'i rdzas yod bzhin du slong la sbyin mi 'dod pa'i dus/ /nyes pa 'di ni bdag sngon sbyin pa goms par ma byas lan par 'dug /da yang sbyin pa ma btang phyin chad skye ba phyi mar sbyin gtong la/ /mi dga' 'gyur ro snyam du myur du rig par byas nas yo byad ci/ /yod pa thams cad sbyin par byed kyis ma goms nyes pas dbang mi btang / /longs spyod ha cang chung bar brten nas gtong ba'i sems mi skye ba'i dus/ /bdag sngon 'khor bar 'khor tshe pha rol gzhan la phan 392

'dogs ma byas par/ /sngon gyi las sam gzhan gyi dbang du gyur pas bkres skom la sogs pa'i/ /du 1ga bsngal bzod dka' mang po myong na da lta gzhan la phan btags par/ /brten nas byung ba'i tshe 'di'i sdug bsngal de yi dbang gis bdag 'chi yang / /phyi mar bsod nams dpag med 'thob pas shi na'ang rnyed pa legs po rnyed/ /longs spyod de dag med kyang sngo sogs ci yang rung ba tsam gyis 'tsho/ /snyam du bsams nas phongs pa'i sdug bsngal dang du blangs te sbyin par bya/ /de ltar nus par spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i byen gyes rlobs/ /sbyin bya'i rdzas rnams shin tu yid du 'ong zhing mchog tu gyur pa la/ /chags nas slong la gtong mi 'dod dus chags pa'i nyes pa de myur bar/ /rig par byas nas bdatha/ gis sdug bsngal ba la bde'o snyam pa yi/ /'du shes phyin ci lob/ tu 'dzin pa 'di yis phyi mar sdug bsngal ba/ /bskyed pa yin no snyam du bsams nas dngos po de nyid sbyin par bya/ /de ltar nus par spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i byin gyis rlobs/ /mjug tu sbyin pa che chung gang btang sbyin par btang ba'i 'a thus bu rnams/ /slong ba po sogs nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam semab / can rnams la gnas skabs dang / /mthar thug phan bde rgya zen 'byung phyir bsam 393

pa thag pas bsngo bar bya/ /de ltar nus par spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i byin gyis rlobs/ /phan yon sems can re re la brten bsod nams de snyed 'thob pa'i tshogs/ /bde blag rdzogs nas mthar thug bla med sangs rgyas go 'phang 'thob par 'gyur/ /gnas skabs bde skyid snyan gsum 'byung sogs sbyin pa btang ba'i bsod nams de/ /gal te gzugs su grub rgyu yin na gaṅgā'i bye ma snyed kyis ni/ /'jig rten khams su shong mi 'gyur zhes sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs/ /des na lus dang longs spyod dge tshogs thams cad 'gro la btang bar bya/ /de ltar nus par spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i ༄byen gyis rlobs/ /sems can thams cad don du myur du sangs rgyas go 'phang thob par bya/ /de'i phyir rang gi lus dang longs spyod dge tshogs 'od zer rnam par 'phros/ /sems can rnams la phog pas sdug bsngal pa rnams sdug bsngal las grol gyur/ /de nas zas gos 'dod la zas gos skom 'dod pa la btung ba dang / /gnas mal bzhon pa gru dang zam pa gser dngul yid bzhin nor bu sogs/ /'dod pa rnams la ji ltar 'dod pa de ltar yid kyis rab sprul nas/ /'phangs med btang bas sems can re res 'dzad med longs spyod thob par gyur/ /de nas 394

dam chos bstan par mos nas chos dbyangs snyan mos brjod pa'i tshe/ /dbyangs de chos kyi sgra dbyangs yan lag drug cur gyur pas nam mkha' yis/ /khyab tshad dresnyegs bcu'i 'jig rten khams la chos kyi sgra de yongs la grag /sems can so so'i skad du go nas kun gyi mi shes mun pa sangs/ /tshig don rtogs shing mi brjed gzungs dang chos ston spobs ba thob pa sogs/ /mar gyur nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam 'gro la pha na pa rgya chen 'byung bar gyur/ /tshegs ni chung ngus bsod nams rgya chen dpag tu med pa 'phel bas na/ /dben pa'i gnas su bsam pa tsam gyis sbyin pa la yang 'bad par bya/ /de shāltar nus par spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i byin gyis rlobs/ /sems can thams cad don du myur du sangs rgyas go 'phang thob par bya de phyir mi dge bcu sogs rang gis ji ltar khas blangs sdom pa rnams/ /mig 'bras bzhin du bsrung zhing nyes pas ma gos pa la 'bad par bya/ /phyin drug la sogs dge ba rnam dag rang gi rgyud la ma skyes pa/ /gsar du bskyed byeng skyes pa rnams kyang nyams pa med par gong 'phel bya/ /rang ges tshul khrims bsrung ba'i sgo nas sems can thams cad tshul khrims sogs/ /dge ba rnam par dag par sbyar nas smin grol lam la 'god par bya/ /395

de ltar nus par spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i byin gyis rlobs/ /phan yon bskal pa bye ba gaṅgā'i bye snyed zas dang skom rnams dang / /gdugs dang ba dan mar me'i 'phreng bas sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig la/ /rim gro byas las gang gis sangs rgyas bstan pa 'jig la nye dus 'dir/ /tshul khrims nyin mtshan gcig tsam srung yang bsod nams de bas che bar gsungs/ /tshul khrims med pas 'bri mar rgya mtsho tsal la sdong bu ri rab tsam/ /btsugs nas mar me phul las tshul khrims ldan pas 'bri mar thigs pa la/ /sdong bu khab rtse tsam zhig btsugs nas mar me phul ba phan yon che/ /byang shar mtshams kyi sangs rgyas dbang phyug rgyal po'i zhing du bskal pa'i bar /tshul khrims srung las mi mjed 'jig rten khams 'dir tshul khrims sna re tsam/ /srung ba phan yon che zhing ston pa'i bstan par skyon ma zhugs dus su/ /tshul khrims yun ring srung las ston pa'i bstan pa 'jig la nye dus 'dir/ /snga dro phyi dro tsam zhig tshul khrims srung ba phan yon che bar gsungs/ /gzhan yang 'bad rtsol ma byas na yang nyer mkho'i yo byad 'du ba dang / /drag po'i las kyis bsdigs pa med kyang skye bo thams cad 'dud pa dang / /phan ma btags dang ngo mi shes pa rnams kyang 396

ngang gis byams pa dang / /rkang pa'i rjes kyi rdul yang lha mi kun gyis spyi bor len pa dang / /mchod pa'i zhing du 'khyer sogs tshul khrims srung ba'i phan yon brjod mi lang / /des na ngo lkog gang du srog gi phyir yang mi dge bcu spong sogs/ /tshul khrims nam yang mi btang mig gi 'bras bu ba(non du bsrung bar bya/ /de ltar nus par spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i byen gyis rlobs/ /sems can thams cad don du myur du sangs rgyas go 'phang thob par bya/ /de phyir sems can thams cad dgra ru langs kyang khro sems skad cig kyang / / me bskyed sgyes pa rnams kyang spangs nas gnod pa'i lan du phan pa sgrubs/ /mkha' mnyam sems can kun gyis bdag gi a / ma ma byas gcig kyang med/ /byas dus tshe 'di'i ma yis bskyangs bzhin drin gyis bskyangs pa sha stag yin/ /drin gyis bskya ngas pa'i ma rnams nyon mongs dbang du song bas da lta'i ma/ /'a/ la gzhan la sems mi dga' ba'i nyon mongs skyes tshe lcebs pa dang / /rang la mtshon gyis 'debs dang g.yang la mchongs da ri zas gcod la sogs pas/ /rang la gnod pa byed na 'gro ba ba/zhan la byed pa smos ci dgos/ /des na rang la gnod pa byas kyang lan du khro bar mi rigs te/ /dper na ma zhig gdon gyis smyos nas bu la brdeg 397

pa sogs byed kyang / /ma de spyos pa shes bzhin bu des lan du khro bar ga la rigs/ /mi khro tsam du ma zad spyo ba'i gdon dang 'bral thabs byed pa bzhin/ /mar gyur sems can nyon mongs gdon gyis spyos nas rang la gnod bskyal kyang / /nyon mongs gdon gyis smyos pa shes bzhin bdag ni lan du khro mi rigs/ /mi khro tsam du ma zad nyon mongs gdon dang 'bral thabs bya dgos te/ /de yi tshul ni rang la mi 'am mi min gnod pa byed pa'i tshe/ /gnod byed 'di yis thog ma med nas bdag gi a ma grangs med byas/ /byas dus rang gi sdig sdug gtam ngan lus srog gang la ma 'jem par/ /bdag la thub tshad phan pa mang po byas pa yin pas drin re che/ /bdag la brten nas 'di yis sngon chad sdug bsngal mang po myang bar nges/ /bdag gis 'di yi drin gyis bskyangs pa'i lan du gnod pa phra mo zhig /ci'i phyir mi bzod bzod dgos snyam du khro med bzod pa'i go cha gyon/ /da lta kho rang nyon mongs gdon gyis yid dkrugs dbang med smyos pa dang / /bdag gi sngon las ngan pas bskul nas 'di yis bdag la gnod bskyal na/ /de yi 'bras bu phyi mar ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal 'di yis myong bar nges/ /bdag la brten nas 'di yis sngon yang sdug bsngal sna tshogs yun ring 398

myang / /da yang bdag la brten nas phyi mar sdug bsngal myong nges snying re rje/ /don la 'di nyid bdag la gnod pa byed mkhan ma yin bdag 'di la/ /gnod byed nyid du song 'dug a kha shin tu snying rje ci zhig bya/ /di/ma du snying rje shugs drag bsgyed nas dngos su phan pa ci thogs bya/ /dngos su phan 'dogs ma nus dus su gtong len gtes ka yang yang bya/ /de ltar nus par spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i byin gyis rlobs/ /gzhan yang rang la dbyug pa sogs kyis rdung tshe dngos su gnod byed la/ /khro na dbyug par khre/ dgos brgyud pa 'ded na dbyug pa pha rol gyi/ /mi des rbad bzhin pha rol mi de nyon mongs gdon gyis rbad pas na/ /khro na pha rol mi de'i rgyud kyi nyon mongs pa la khro dgos bsam/ /yang na rang gi sngon las ngan pas pha rol mi de dbang med du/ /bskul pa yin pas khro na rang la khro dgos snyam du bsam par bya/ /da lta sdug bsngal phra mo tsam zhig mi bzod lan du khros pa na/ /khong khro'i 'bras bu dmyal bar skyes na bzod dam snyam du bsam par bya/ /de ltar nus par spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i byin gyis rlobs/ /gzhan yang bstod smad byas la dga' sdug skyes dus bstod dang snyan grags kyis/ /phyi mar mi phan ma gud mi tshe 'dir yang tshe 399

ring nad med dang / /bde dang bsod nams mi 'phel steng du don med g.yeng bar 'jug pa dang / /gzhan gyis phrag dog bskyed par byed pa'i phung 'dre de yis ci zhig bya/ /gzhan gyis smad pa la sogs byas na snyan grags nyams pa'i rgyur song nas/ /rnam g.yeng med par gnas skabs mthar thug bde ba mang po sgrub chog pa/ /'di ni bla ma dkon mchog byin rlabs yin snyam dga' ba bsgom par bya/ /rdo mtshon dbyug pa sogs kyis phog na lus la cung zad gnod mod kyang / /ngan smras sogs kyis lus sems gang la cung zad tsam yang mi gnod pa'i/ /tshul la bsams nas bstod smad gang la dga' sdug med par ro snyoms bya/ /de ltar nus par spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang bo'i byen gyis rlobs/ /gzhan yang zas gos gnas mal sogs kyis phongs dang na tsha la sogs pa'i/ /sdug bsngal byung dus 'di sngar las ngan bsags pa'i 'bras bu smin pa yin/ /dper na gsod dgos nag can mi zhig sor mo bcad nas btang ba bzhin/ /da lta mi yi sdug bsngal chung ngu 'di tsam myong ba la brten nas/ /phyi mar dmyal bar skye ba'i las kyang 'phral du dag 'gro snyam du bsam/ /sdug bsngal byung dus bzod pa bsgom na sngar byas sdig sgrib 'dag pa dang / /phyi mar gzugs bzang 400

thob pa la sogs bsod nams mang po 'phel bas na/ /mi 'dod sdug bsngal byung dus rang gi da go sbyor chag par mi sems par/ /lhag par rang gi sdeg pa sbyangs dang tshogs bsags mang po byas par bsam/ /rang la gnod pa byed la drin che snyam du phan pa'i drin gzo bya/ /de ltar nus par spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i byin gyes rlobab 4/ /khyad par sems can don du sangs rgyas go 'phang thob phyir dam pa'i chos/ /bsgrub pa'i dus su sdug bsngal gang byung ba pa bzod sran bskyed pa la/ /brten nas sangs rgyas go 'pha/nga thob la shin tu nye bar 'gyur bas na/ /sdug bsngal gang dang /phrad kyang dbul bo rin chen gter dang phrad pa bzhin/ /rab tsu / dga' ba'i shugs kyis dang du blangs nas bzod sran bskyed par bya/ /de ltar nus par spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i byen byes rlobs/ /sdug bsngal med na snyam dus sdug bsngal mi 'dong ) phyin chad sdug bsngal rgyu/ /spongs zhes bskul ma byas 'dug snyam du mi dge sdig pa spangs par bya/ /bde ba 'dod pa'i dus su bde ba 'dod na phyin chad bde ba'i rgyu/ /tshogs bsags gyis zhes bskul ma byas 'dug snyam du tshogs bsags ci thub bya/ /de ltar nus par spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i byen gyis rlobs/ /gzhan yang 401

dkon mchog gsum gyi yon tan gang zag chos kyi bdag med dang / /yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi mthu chen dang / /legs spyad nyes spyad rgyu dang de dag 'bras bu 'dod dang mi 'dod dang / /thob bya byang chub de nyid thob thabs byang sems bslab pa'i lam rnams dang / /gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis la sogs dam pa'i lha chos de dag kun/ /ji ltar yin la nges pa rnyed nas 'dzin cing yang yang sems par bya/ /de ltar nus par spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i byen gyis rlobs/ /phan yon phyi mar dgra dang 'bye ba mi mang bde dang yid bde mang / /'gyod pa med par 'chi dang shi nas bde 'gro lha ru skye bar 'gyur/ /zhe sdang dug sbrul gsod pa'i mkha' lding gnod sems me chen gsod pa'i chu/ /tshig rtsub mdas mi 'bigs pa'i sra ba'i go cha khyad par 'gro kun gyi/ /mig dang yid dbang 'phrog pa'i gser gyi mdog can mtshan dang dpe byad kyis/ /brgyan pa'i mdzes pa'i gzugs mchog bsgrub pa'i bzo bo mkhas pa la sogs pa'i/ /bzod pa'i phan yon brjod mi lang bas des na bzod pa bsgom par bya/ /de ltar nus par spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i byen gyis rlobs/ /sems can thams cad don du myur du sangs rgyas go 402

'phang thob par bya/ /de phyir bdag ges bskal chen stong phrag gcig la zhag tu byas pa yi/ /zhag po tsu/ma cur zla ba gcig dang zla ba bcu gnyis lor byas pas/ /bska pa chen grangs med 'bum phrag re rer sems can gcig gi phyir du yang / /mnar med dmyal bar gnas nas sangs rgyas go ḍarephang sgrub dgos byung na yang / /brtson pa mi 'dor spro bas gnas par bya'o snyam pa'i go cha gyon/ /'o na bdag gis da lta me / rtog sdug bsngal tsam yang bzod dka' na/ /mnar med dmyashā/ ba'i sdug bsngal shugs drag yun ring bzod par ga la nus/ /snyam na rgyu yi sdig pa spangs pas lus la gnod pa mi 'byung /deng / /chos rnams rang bzhin med par shes pas sems la sdug bsngal mi 'byung bas/ /lus sems bde na yun ring gnas kyang mi dga' ga la yod snyam bsam/ /de 'dra'i go cha gyon nas zab dang rgya che'i dge chos rang rgyud la/ /bsdud par byed cing 'gro ba gzhan yang dge ba'i lam la'ang dgod par bya/ /jeshe ltar nus par spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i byin gyis rlong/sa/ /rang gzhan gnyis kyi don gang bsgrub kyang gnyid dang le 'i /'i dbang mi btang / /skyo ngal med pa khyem bdag rnams kyis so nam byed pa lta bur bya/ /gang la 'jug kyang dpa' mi zhum par dpa' bo g.yul 403

'jug lta bur bya/ /rgyun chad med pa gaṅgā la sogs chu bo chen po'i rgyun ltar bya/ /de ltar nus par spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i byen gyis rlobs/ /phan yon skyo med brtson 'grus che na mi thob mi 'grub gang yang med/ /'jig rten 'jig rten las 'das dgos pa thams cad brtson 'grus byas na 'grub/ /ring bor mi thogs myur du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas go 'phang thob pa yang / /brtson 'grus rag las pas na sngon byon dam pa gong ma'i rnam thar bzhin/ /thos bsam bsgom gsum gang gi dus su brtson 'grus me ltar sbar bar bya/ /de ltar nus par spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i byen gyis rlobs/ /sems can thams cad don du myur du sangs rgyas go 'phang thob par bya/ /de'i phyir mthun rkyen rnyed sla dgra dang gcan gzan sogs kyis 'tshe ba med/ /sa chu 'phrod pas nad mi bskyed dang chos dang mthun pa'i grogs bzang dang / /'du 'dzi ku co'i sgra sogs med pa'i ting 'dzin ngang gis 'phel gnas su/ /zas gos sogs la 'dod pa chung dang ngan ngon tsam gyis chog shes bya/ /nyo tshong la sogs bya ba spongs dang tshul khrims dag pa la gnas dang / /'dod pa rnams la gsod dang bcings pa la sogs tshe 'di'i nyes dmigs dang / /ngan 'gro'i gnas su 'gro ba la 404

sogs phyi ma'i nyes dmigs bsgom pa dong / /'khor ba'i dngos po thams cad 'jig pa'i chos can rgyun du mi rtag ste/ /nges par de dag rnams dang bdag gnyis ri nga bor mi thogs so sor 'bral/ /snyam du bsams nas 'dod pa'i rnam par rtog pa thams cad spang par bya/ /rab tu 'jam pa'i gdan la lus kyi gnad ni rnam snang chos brgyad bya/ /khyad par rlung gi 'gro 'ong gcig tu byas te nyer gcig bgrangari sa nas rlung / /cham la phab nas dngos gzhi'i dmigs rten du ma gsungs kyang gtso bo ni/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi sku la dmigs rten byas nas sems bzung na/ /sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa yin pas bsod nams mtha' yas skye ba dang / /sku de'i rnam pa gsal zhing brtan na phyag dang mchod pa smon 'a ma sogs/ /tshogs bsogs zhing dang bshags bsdams la sogs sgrib sbyong tshogs zhing bsgom pa la/ /khyad par shin tu che zheng 'chi tshe sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa las/ /mi nyams pa sogs yon tan dag dang khyad par gsang sngags lha'i bskyed rim/ /bsgom la shin tu khyad par che sogs dgos pa mang po snang ba ste// /des na ting nge 'dzin yang 'grub la dgos pa khyad par can gzhan yang / /zhar la 'thob pa'i sangs rgyas sku la dmigs rten byed pa shin 405

tu legs/ /de yi tshul ni rang gnas sa phyogs tha mal gnas 'di ma yin par/ /sangs rgyas byen rlabs las byung dag zhing chen por gyur pa'i mdun phyogs su/ /seng ge chen po brgyad kyis bteg pa'i rin po che yi khri steng du/ /spyi bo'i bla ma thub dbang thugs ga'i rang 'dra gnyis pa zhig byung nas/ /rang la zhal bstan dgyes 'dzum gzi brjid 'od zer 'phro bzhin bzhugs par gyur/ /de yang sku mdog gser bzhin ser po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas sa gnon/ /g.yon pa mnyam bzhag steng na bdud rtsi'i bcud kyis gang ba'i lhung bzed bsnams/ /sku la chos gos ngur smrig mdog can gsol zhing mtshan dang dpe byad kyis/ /spras pa'i sku las sgyes pa'i 'od kyi phung po'i dkyil na zhabs gnyis kyis/ /rdo rje skyil krung byas nas bzhugs pa'i rim pa bzhin du gsal gdab la/ /de'i mthar sku spyi yid la byas nas yid ngor yan lag rags pa rnams/ /cha phyed tsam zhig shar na 'od dang bcas pa'i gsal bo ma byung yang / /de tsam zhig gis chog shes byas nas de la rtse gcig sems 'dzin bya/ /de'i tshe ser po bsgom 'dod pa la dmar po la sogs 'char ba dang / /bzhugs pa'i rnam pa bsgom 'dod pa la bzhengs pa'i rnam pa 'char ba dang / /gcig po bsgom 'dod 406

pa la du ma 'char ba la sogs byung na 'a/nga / /de dag rjes su mi 'brang rtsa ba'i dmigs rten kho nar sems 'dzin bya/ /de'i tshe sems ni shin tu gsal ba'i gsal cha'i ngar dang ldan pa dang / /dmigs rten nyid la rtse ga cig gnas pas mi rtog gnas cha gnyis ka dgos/ /de ltar gsal cha'i ngar thon pa la byeng bas bar du gcod pa yin/ /rtse gcig mi rtog gnas la rgod pas bar du gcod pa'i byeng rgod ba/nyis/ /ting 'dzin rnam par dag pa skye bar byed pa'i gegs kyi gtso bo yin/ /'o na byeng ba rgod pa gnyis kyi mtshan nyid ci 'dra yen zer na/ /sems kyi gsal cha nyams nas sems la mun pa babs pa lta bu yis/ /dmigs rten yid ngor gsal bar mi mthong ba dang dmigs rten rtse gcig tu/ /'dzin pa'i 'dzin stangs lhod nas dam par mi 'dzin pa ni bying ba yin/ /gti mug char gtogs lus sems lci zhing las su mi rung rmug pa yin/ /dmigs rten de la mi gnas gzhan du yud yud 'gro ba 'phro ba yin/ /yid du 'ong ba'i yul la 'phro zhing rgyug par byed pa rgod pa yin/ /dper na gdul dka'i glang chen 'dul tshe ka ba rab tu brtan dgos bzhin/ /rang sems 'dul tshe dmigs rten gsal dgos ma mtha' rags rim tsam 'char dgos/ /zhags thag shin tu sra ba 407

du mas ka bar dam du bcings dgos bzhin/ /dmigs rten sku la rang sems btags te brjed med du re dran par bya/ /glang rdzis bslab dgos bslab tshe 'phag nas thag pas bsdams pa lhod pa bzhin/ /byeng rgod phra mo'i dbang song dmigs rten dam par mi 'dzin lhod gyur na/ /glang rdzis de ma thag tu lcags kyus btab nas thag pas bsdom pa bzhin/ /de ma thag tu shes par byas nas dmigs rten du re dran par bya/ /de ltar nus par spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i byen gyis rlobs/ /nyal dang mchongs lding shugs drag byed bzhin bying rgod rags pa'i dbang 'gro na/ /glang dzis zhi drag gnyis ka byas nas thag pas dam par bcings pa bzhin/ /byeng rmug gnyis kyi gnyen por dkon mchog gsum gyi yon tan dran pa dang / /nyi ma zla ba'i 'od sogs snang ba'i mtshan ma yid la byed pa dang / /lte ba'i thad du rang sems thig le dkar dmar lcog sgong tshad tsam gyi/ /rnam par yod par dmigs nas de nyid spyi bo'i gtsug nas rgyangs kyis thon/ /nam mkhar song nas nam mkha' stong par 'dres pas dbyer med gyur pa la/ /rtse gcig mnyam par 'jog pa nam mkha' sgo 'byed dbyings rig bsre dang 'dra/ /'phro rgod gnyis kyi gnyen por dbugs kyi 'gyu ba lan mang 408

bgrangs pa dang / /yang na steng rlung dkar po sna bug gnyis nas drangs te mar la mnan/ /thur se pa ser po gyen du drangs te lte bar kha sbyor bum can gyi/ /tshul du bsgom pas byeng rgod skyon rnams bsal nas sngar ltar bsgom par bya/ /dper na gdul dka'i glang chen btul tshe glang rdzis ji ltar bslab pa bzhin/ /byed cing steng du zhon nas ra nga gis gang 'dod bya ba bsgrub pa ltar/ /rang sems btupa tshe btang na dge ba'i dmigs pa kun la 'jug pa dang / /bzhag na g.yo med ri bzhin brtan cing lus sems shin sbyang zhu thob pa na/ /de la brten nas rang gis mngon mtho nges le /gas gang 'dod bsgrub par bya/ /de ltar nus par spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i byen gyis rlobs/ /phan yon zhi gnas /spyab na sems la dga' ba lus la bde ba rgyas/ /mthong chos ba1de bar gnas dang lus sems shin sbyangs bde ba rnyed pa'i sems/ /dge ba'i dmigs pa gang 'dod dag tu bkol du rung dang dbang med par/ /phyin ci log gi yul la g.yeng ba zhi nas /rtes spyod mi 'byung zhing / /dge ba gang byas stobs che ba da nga zhi gnas brten nas mngon shes dang / /rdzu 'phrul sogs kye yon tan bsgrub nus khyad par zhi gnas la brten nas/ / p+tag mthong rtogs pa skye 409

bas 'khor ba'i rtsa ba myur du gcod nus sogs/ /phan yon mang po yod pa bsams nas rang sems 'dul la 'bad par bya/ /de ltar nus par spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i byen gyis rlobs/ /mi bsgom dus su mdun gyi bla ma thub pa'i dbang po yar byon nas/ /rang gi spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i thugs gar thim par bsam/ /sems can thams cad don du myur du sangs rgyas go 'phang thob par bya/ /de phyir tshe rabs 'khor ba thog ma med nas rang gi snying dkyil du/ /'dug sa bcas te mi 'dod sdug bsngal sna dgu thog tu 'dren mkhan gyi/ /nga dang bdag ces ming gnyis yod pa'i snying nag phung rgan dgra bo yi/ /snying gi dkyil du so sor rtog pa'i shes rab mdung ring rnon po yis/ /brgyab nas stong sangs chos dbyengs thang du zings se bsgyel nas chems la 'bebs/ /de ltar nus par spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i byin gyis rlobs/ /chems la 'bebs tshul tha na rmi lam gnas skabs tshun chad nga nga zhes/ /snying gi dkyil na dam spring 'dzin pa ngar 'dzin 'ug pa'i mgo can yin/ /kho bo bzang ngan rkyen dang 'phrad tshe gsal bor mngon la de min dus/ /mngon med gnas pas da lta gsod dus mngon du bcug nas gsod dgos pas/ /thog 410

mar rang la sngon dus gzhan gyes gnod pa byas sam phan btags pa/ /gang rung drag po byas pa gsar du yang yang gsal gdab gsal thebs dus/ /dper na rang la don med rkus shig btsugs na ngas rkus byed mi dgos/ /rku snyam bsam pa'ang med na nga la don med 'di 'dra'i rkus btsugs snyam/ /zhe sdang dmar lam pa dang bcas pa'i rkus te 'dzugs pa'i yul nga zhig /snying gi dkyil na dam spring mthong rgyu 'dzin rgyu yod pa lta bu 'char/ /rang la tsha grang la sogs nad kyis btab nas 'chi la phyogs pa'i tshe/ /sman pa mkhas bas sman mang byin nas nad las grol na phan btags snyam/ /phan de 'dogs yul nga zhig snying gi dkyil na yod yod 'dra ba ḍa char/ /de ltar lam lam shar na phung rgan gsal bar mngon sum mngon pa yin/ /de 'dra shar na shin tu legs te ma mtha' yang yang gsal btab nas/ /nga la phan gnod 'di 'dra byas so snyam pa'i ngar 'dzin skyer bcug nas/ /nga de gang na yod 'dug brtags tshe sngon chad snying gi dkyil na yod/ /snyam pa ma gtogs gang gi steng du yod pa thag chod ma nges pa/ /legs pangari zhib tu brtags tshe re 'ga' lus kyi steng na yod pa 'dra/ / re 'ga' phung po gzhan rnams steng du yod 'dra 'char tshul sna tsho gas 'char/ /mthar 411

phar ded na phung po re re'i steng na yod pa ma yin par/ /phung po lnga po tshogs tsam steng du phar la rtog pas btags pa tsam/ /ma yin sngar nas nga zhig grub nas yod 'dug snyam pa shar ba'i tshe/ /nga de phung po lnga yi steng du yod na nga dang phung po gnyis/ /gcig yin dgos la yang na phung po nga gnyis tha dad yin dgos la/ /de gnyis ma gtogs yod tshul gzhan zhig gtan nas med snyam blo thag bcad/ /nga dang phung po rnams gcig yin na nga dang nga yi phung po zhes/ /so sor byas nas ming gnyis 'dogs don mi 'dug gcig gis chog dgos la/ /phung po lnga yod bzhin du nga yang tha dad lnga yod dgos par 'gyur/ /yang na nga gcig yin bzhin phung po lnga yang cha med gcig tu gyur/ /phung po lnga po skye 'jig byed bzhin nga yang skye 'jig byed dgos la/ /nga de skye 'jig byed par 'dod na las ni byas pa chud zos dang / /ma byas pa dang 'phrad dang skye ba dran par gsungs pa rnams dang 'gal/ /des na nga dang phung po rnams gcig ma yin snyam du blo thag bcad/ /'o na nga dang phung po tha dad yin na gzugs phung tshor phung dang / /'du shes phung po 'du byed phung po rnam par shes pa'i phung po rnams/ /so sor yod bzhin nga yang yod dgos snyam du yid kyis phung po rnams/ /so sor phye 412

nas bltas pas sngon chad nga nga zer ba snyeng dkyil na/ /lag pas 'dzin rgyu mig gis mthong rgyu yod nga 'dra ba rdul tsam yang / /ma rnyed stong bar cham gyes song dus nga zhes ming btags tsam ma gtogs/ /gtan nas me 'dug snyam du stong ba nyid la rtse gcig mnyam par 'jog /rje ) ltar nus par spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i byen gyis rlobs/ /'jog bsgom mang pas nges shes shugs zhan song na dpyad bsgom mang du bya/ /dpyad bsgom mang pas gnas cha chung du song na 'jog bsgom mang du bya/ /byeng rgod shin tu che na gong star bying rgod sel ba'i thabs rnams bya/ /de'i tshe nga zhes mi /da tsam ma gtogs rang bzhin mi 'dug stong pa nyid/ /snyam du rtse gcig skyong ba mnyam bzhag nam mkha' lta bu'i skyong tshul lo/ /rjes thob dus su nga sogs 'di ltar snang ba'i chos kun sgyu ma dang / /rmi lam bzhin du rang bzhin grub pa cung zad tsam yang med par blta/ /sgyu ma mkhan gyis lha yul dmyal ba sprul dang gnyid log gnas skabs su/ /rmi lam bzang ngan rmis na bde ra sdug pyong ba mngon sum grub pa bzhin/ /dge sdig gnyis las ( bras bu bde dang sdug bsngal 'byung bar yid ches bskyed/ /sgyu ma mkhan gyis sprul bsgyur byed bzhin spyod phyogs gang la'ang 'jug par bya/ /de 413

ltar nus par spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i byin gyis rlobs/ /sems can thams cad don du myur du sangs rgyas go 'phang thob par bya/ /de'i phyir chos kun stong ba nyid du gtan la phab nas bsgom par bya/ /de yang yan lag tshogs tsam steng du rtogs pas btags tsam ma yin par/ /rang ngos grub pa'i lus shig yod na gcig tu grub bam tha dad grub/ /gcig tu grub na yan lag lnga bzhin lus kyang du mar 'gyur dgos la/ /yang na lus gcig bzhin du yan lag lnga yang cha med gcig tu 'gyur/ /de ltar 'dod na mgo bo g.yo ba'i dus su rkang pa g.yo bar 'gyur/ /lus dang yan lag so sor khas len byed pa don med 'gyur dgos la/ /tha dad grub na mgo sogs yan lag re re bsal ba'i shul na'ang lus/ /'di zhes mdzub mo btsugs nas ston rgyu dgos la de 'dra cang mi 'dug /lus zhes ming zhig phar btags ma gtogs rang bzhin grub pa rdul tsam yang / /gtan nas mi 'dug stong pa/ nyid do snyam du rtse gcig mnyam par 'jog /de ltar nus par spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i byen gyis rlobs/ /de ring snga dro phyi dro nyin gung shes pa'i steng du rtog pa yis/ /btags tsam ma yin rang ngos grub pa'i de ring shes pa zhig yod na/ /snga dro nyin gung phyi dro'i shes 414

pa gcig tu grub bam tha dad grub/ /gceg tu grub na snga phyi nyin gung shes pa bzhin du du mar 'gyur/ /yang na de ring shes pa gcig bzhin thams cad gcig tu 'gyu da dgos la/ /de ltar cha med gcig tu 'dod na de ring snga dro'i shes pa yi/ /steng na nyin gung phyi dro'i shes pa de yang yod par 'dusdir dgos la/ /snga dro phyi dro nyin gung shes pa tha dad khas blangs rngo/ na med 'gyur/ /tha dad grub na snga dro phyi dro nyin gung shes pa re re nas/ /bsal tshe de ring shes pa 'di zhes ston rgyu dgos 'a/ cang mi 'dug /de ring shes pa ming zhig btags pa ma gtogs rang bzhin grub pa ni/ /rdul tsam mi 'dug stong ba rta)da do snyam du rtse gcig mnyam par 'jog /de ltar nus par spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i byen gyis rlobs/ /zla ba bcu gnyis steng du phar la rtog pas btags tsam ma yin par/ /lo zhig yod na zla ba rnams dang gcig tu grub bam tha dad grub/ /gcig tu grub na zla ba bzhin du lo yang bcu gnyis yod nga ra 'gyur/ /yang na lo gcig bzhin du thams cad cha med gcib/ tu 'gyur dgos la/ /de ltar 'dod na zla ba snga ma'i steng du phyi ma yod par 'gyur/ /lo dang zla ba so sor khas blangs pa yang nyidon med 'gyur dgos la/ /tha dad grub na zla ba bcu gnyis re re bsal ba'i shul na 415
