lo/ /'di zhes ston rgyu zhig yod dgos la de 'dra ston rgyu cang mi 'dug /lo zhes ming gis btags tsam ma gtogs rang bzhin grub pa rdul tsam yang / /gtan nas mi 'dug stong pa nyid do snyam du rtse gcig mnyam par 'jog /de ltar nus par spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i byen gyes rlobs/ /phyogs bzhi dbus kyi nam mkha'i steng du rtog pas btags tsam ma yin par/ /tshugs thub grub pa'i nam mkha' yod na gcig tu grub bam tha dad grub/ /gcig tu grub na phyogs bzhi'i nam mkha' bzhin du nam mkha' du mar 'gyur/ /yang na nam mkha' gcig yin bzhin du phyogs mtshams cha med gcig tu 'gyur/ /de ltar gcig tu 'dod na shar phyogs nam mkha'i char ba babs pa'i skabs/ /nub phyogs nam mkha'i char ba 'bab pa la sogs nyes pa du ma phog /phyogs mtshams dbus kyi nam mkha' so sor khas blangs pa yang don med 'gyur/ /tha dad grub na phyogs mtshams dbus kyi nam mkha' re re bsal shul na/ /nam mkha' 'di zhes ston rgyu yod dgos de 'dra ston rgyu cang mi 'dug /nam mkha' zhes pa ming tsam ma gtogs rang bzhin grub pa rdul tsam yang / /gtan nas mi 'dug stong pa nyid do snyam du rtse gcig mnyam par 'jog /de ltar nus par spyi bo'i bla ma thub 416

pa'i dbang po'i byen gyes rlobs/ /maro /ra na nga dang phung po ri dang rwa ba khang khyim la sogs pa'i/ /'khor 'das chos kun phar la rtog pas btags pa tsam zhig ra/ gtogs pa/ /rang bzhin grub pa rdul phran tsam yang gtan nas mi 'dug stong pa'o/ /snyam du mnyam par 'jog pa mnyam bzhag nam mkha' lta bu'i skyong tshul lo/ /rjes thob dus cwa/ chos kun sgyu ma lta bur bden med stong par blta/ /sgyu ma'i rta glang sprul pa bzhin du tshogs gsog sogs la 'jug par bya/ /rjerdo ltar nus par spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i byin gyis rlong/sa/ /phan yon stong pa nyid kyi gtam tsam go bas thar pa'i sa bon 'jog /chos rnams thams cad stong ngam mi stong snyam du the tshom tsam zos kyang / /srid pa hrul po byed gsungs khams gsum sems can rnams la ji srid 'tsho'i/ /bar du 'tsho ba'i yo byad du mas tshogs gsog byas las stong pa nyid/ /thun gcig bsgom pa bsod nams che gsungs yun ring bsgom na smos ci dgos/ /stong nyid bsgom la bdud ni bye bas gnong ) pa byas kyang mi tshugs gsungs/ /khang stong mun pa bo stong lon pa mar me bteg pas skad cig la/ /sel ba bzhin du bskal pa grangs med mang por bsags pa'i sdig pa yang / /stong nyid rtogs pa 417

tsam gyis thams cad lhag med 'dag par 'gyur ro gsungs/ /yun ring bsgom na spyan dang mngon shes rdzu 'phrul dpag med 'thob pa dang / /sangs rgyas byang sems bsgrub dang ma bsgrub yi dam lha zhal mthong ba dang / /myur du sangs rgyas go 'phang 'thob pa la sogs phan yon brjod mi lang / /des na stong nyid rgyun tu thugs dam mthil du bzung nas bsgom par bya de ltar nus par spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i byen gyis rlobs/ /sems can thams cad don du myur du sangs rgyas go 'phang thob par bya/ /de phyir thog mar sems can so so'i khams dang 'tsham par zang zing dang / /mi 'jigs sbyin pa la sogs gang mkho sbyin nas gdul bya 'khor du bsdu/ /de nas bzhin mdangs gsal zhing 'dzum pa'i sgo nas khams ni 'dri ba sogs/ /'jig rten tshul dang mthun pa'i snyan pa smras nas de dag dga' bar bya/ /de nas dad dang tshul khrims thos dang gtong ba shes rab bskyed pa sogs/ /phan dang bde ba'i phyir du de rnams blo dang 'tsham pa'i chos ston cing / /rang nyid gsod pa'i dgra la skyon med sems kyis snyan tshig brjod pa dang / /dbang po shin tu rtul la chos gtam bshad cing dge ba byed du 'jug /g.yo sgyu can dang mkhan slob sogs la bslu zhing 418

log zhugs byed pa la/ /zhe sdang med par phan pa'i tshig brjod smra bar dka' ba la yang bslab/ /khyim pa rnams dang rab tu byung ba bag med pa rnams bag yod la/ /'god pa'i phyir du bskul dang the tshom byung ba rnams ni bas/la ba'i phyir/ /dam chos 'chad cing 'bel gtam byed pa de ni snyan par smra ba'o/ /dge ba'i phyogs la spro bar byas nas byis pa shes rab can rnams la/ /thog mar sla ba'i gdams pa rig tshe ring nad med pa la dge ba'i las/ /'di dang 'di 'dra bsgrub dgos zhes pas mtshon pa'i dge ba phra mor 'jug /de ni blo ni 'bring du song tshe 'bring gi gdams ngag ston cing 'jug /shes rab che ru song nas dam chos zab mo'i gdams pa phra mor 'jug /gzhan yang khyem pa sogs la longs spyod bsgrub dang bsrung dang spel ba'i thabs/ /chos dang mthun par byed du 'jug cing bsnyen gnas sgyung gnas bsrung du 'jug /dge bsnyen rab byung dge tshul dge slong byed du 'jug pa la sogs pa'i/ /blo dang 'tsham pa'i chos bstan ltar du byed du 'jug pa don spyod dang / /gzhan la bstan pa tsam ni ma yin rang yang de las lhag pa 'am/ /yang na de dang mtshungs pa tsam zhig nyams su le na pa don mthun no/ /de ltar thabs mkhas bsdu bzhi'i sgo nas gdul bya mngon mtho 419

lha mi dang / /nges legs thar pa tsam dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam la dgod par bya/ /de ltar nus par spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i byen gyis rlobs/ /de ltar rgyu dang 'bras bu theg chen lam mchog gnyis gar dgos pa yi/ /thun mong lam la sbyangs nas mkhas pa'i ded dpon bzang po la brten nas/ /rgyud sde rgya mtsho chen por zhugs nas yongs rdzogs man ngag rin po che/ /blangs nas dal 'byor tshang ba'i mi lus thob pa don dang ldan par bya/ /de ltar nus par spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i byen gyis rlobs/ /thur pa'i grong khyer nyams dgar sngon gshegs dam pa gong ma thams cad kyis/ /thur lam mchog gyur byang chub lam gyi rim pa nyams su de ltar blangs/ /thur par shin tu dka' ba'i khams gsum 'khor ba'i btson ra chen po las/ /thār 'dod bdag gzhan kun kyang da nas de bzhin nyams su len par bya/ /rgyul mtshan rtse mo'i nor bu ji bzhin skye dgu'i 'dod don ma lus skong / /rgyul sras rnams kyis bsngags pa'i byang chub lam gyi rim pa 'di'i sgo nas/ /rgyul ba'i go 'phang bdag gzhan kun gyis myur du bde legs thob nus par/ /rgyul ba kun 'dus spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i byen gyis rlobs/ /dang gi spyi bo'i bla ma thub dbang sku las rang 420

'dra zhig chad nas/ /dang la thim pas rang nyid rgyal ba shākya thub pa'i sku ru gyur/ /dang gi thugs ka/'e 'od zer nyi ma'i zer ltar dpag tu med pa 'phros/ /dang gnas khang ba snod bcud la phog dag zhing thub dbang sku ru gyur/ /dang gi spyi bo'i bla ma thub dbang dgyes bzhin spyi bo nas zhugs te/ /dang gi snying dbus pad zla'i gdan la gzi brjid 'od zer 'bar bzhin du/ /dang nyid sangs rgyas go 'phang ma thob bar du 'bral med rtag bzhugs nas/ /dang don mthar phyin gzhan don rgya chen 'byung bar byen gyis brlabs par gyur/ /dwage ba'i bshes gnyen bsten tshul nas bzung dge la gzhan 'god bsdu bzhi'i bar/ /dge sems sgo nas 'don bsgom byas pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis mtshon pa'i/ /dge ba ci bsags ma rgan 'gro la dge legs phun tshogs 'byung phyir bsngo/ /dge la 'bad ma dgos par bdag gi duge bas 'gro kun 'tshang rgya shog /gde ba'i thabs sa rmongs pas dwade med bdag ga nan 'khor dwa'i btson ra las/ /dwade ba'i lam lda zhugs nas dwade dga' dpag med yod sda'i ngo mtshar zhing / /dwade 'jam 'a/ngas sa gtan du gde ba'i gnas mchog thar sda'i gling son nas// /dwade skyid dpal sa rol bzhin dwade gshegs mdun du dga' dwa'i gar byed shog /421

rgyal bstan rin chen 'jig rten khams na gnas tshad spyi dang rted par du/ /rgyal dang rgyal sras rnams kyis lan cig ma yin yang yang bsngags pa yi/ /rgyal ba'i dgongs pa bde blag rnyed sogs che ba bzhi dang ldan paje chos/ /rgyal khams yongs la nyi ma shar bzhin phyogs bcur rgyas pa'i brke shis shog /sku yi lhun po mtshan dpe'i 'od 'bar 'khor bzang gser ri'i khrod na brjid/ /gsung snyan 'brug sgras skal ldan rma bya dga' bskyed log smra'i byes rnams skrag /thugs kyi mkha' la lung rtogs yon tan du ma'i nyi zla gza' skar rgyas/ /zla med blo bzang grags pa da dung snying gi pad dkar rtse la bzhugs/ /khyod gsungs skyes bu chen po'i chos skor rin chen nor bu'i gling son nas/ /skyes bu chen po'i lam rim nyung 'dus yid bzhin nor bu blangs zin nas/ /da ni mi shes mun pa sel ba'i lam rim gsal ba'i sgon me 'di/ /bton dang thos tshad rgyud la phan thogs rgya chen 'byung bar byin gyis rlobs/ /kun mkhyen blo bzang grags pa'i rmad du byung ba'i mkhyen rab mdzub mo yis/ /gzhung bzang stong gi 'dod 'jo'i ba mo legs bzhos byang chub lam rim gyi/ /rab dkar 'o ma'i rgya mtsho chen po blo gros rtsal stobs ci yod kyi/ /shugs kyis bsrubs nas lam rim go sla nyung 'dus mar 422

'di bdag gis blangs/ /lam rim che chung nyi zla gzhan pa'i lam rim gza' skar 'od la dpe/ /bzhag nas lam rim nyung 'dus sgon ske sbar la lhag chad 'gal 'khrul gyes/ /mi gsal rab rib ci byung thams cad dam pa rnams la bzod par gsol/ /da dung ches cher gsal ba'i tshig gis mgo sgron thongs zhes thal mo sbyor/ /'dis mtshon bdag gis bsags pa'i dge tshogs ci yod dri med rab dam/ra gangs/ /bsngo ba rnam dag rta bdun 'od snang 'gyed nas legs par bzhus pa'i mod/ /dge ba'i dwangs bsil chu rgyu na ngal med ma gyur 'gro kun rgya mtshor zhugs/ /gnas skabs mthar thug bde skyid lbu ba rba rlabs phyogs brgyar g.yo bar shog /gangs can mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan blo bzang grags/ /byang chu na ma thob par du bdag skyongs shig 7 /bya btang byams pa chos dar zhes bya ngas/ /bcu pa'i nyi shu lnga yi mtshan mo la/ /ra / tu gsal ba'i mar me zhig sbar nas/ 7 /rgyal ba gnyis pa blo bzang grags pa la/ /gsol ba btab nas gnyid tshe rmi lam du/ /rin chen du ma las grub ri bo la/ /dri med shel gyi skas ni ring po zhig /btsugs par 'dzeg nas ri steng der son tshe/ /ba gzhi 'jam zhing khod snyoms me tog dang / /dri dang sna tshogs ldang ba'i dbus nyid 423

na/ /kha dog sngo zhing ri mo sna tshogs pa/ /bkra ba'i gos la dar tshon sna lnga yi/ /chon thag gser dngul chon phur byas pa zhig /phubs pa'i nang na mjes pa'i khri zhig la/ /gzi brjid 'od zer 'bar ba'i bla ma zhig /bzhugs nas skal ldan gdul bya mang po la/ /lam rim bsdus don lung zhig gnang bar mnyan/ /dpe de bdag la mgon khyod g.yor dgos zhes/ /zhus tshe dpe de gnang bas rum la bzung / /rab tu dga' bzhin phyi rol la 'ong nas/ /bltas tshe gangs can bod kyi yul phyogs rnams/ /mthong bas phyogs bzhir ltad mo cung zad bltas/ /skas te gzar bas mar la 'ong ma nus/ /skas 'gor bsdad pas g.yon nas mi zhig gis/ /ri rtse 'dir 'ong thams cad phyir 'gro dus/ /'phur nas song na chog ces smras pa'i tshe /bdag gis gzan la gshog pa byas nas mkhar/ /'phur nas 'ong ba'i rmi lam rmis pa dang / /phyis nas dad gtong shes rab dang ldan pa'i/ /slob bu bya btang rig 'dzin zla ba sogs/ /ri pa dad ldan du mas gser dang bcas/ /'di 'dra'i go sla nyung 'dus lam rim zhig /dgos zhes bskul ngor kun mkhyen blo bzang grags/ /snying dbus bsgoms nas gsol ba 'debs bzhin du/ /sa gsum sgon me lam rim chen mo la/ /gzhi byas 424

lam rim du mas zur brgyan nas/ /gnas chen khyad 'phags mtsho snying dben par sbyar/ /lam bzang 'di nyid nyams su len pa la/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams kyis byin gyis rlobs/ /yi dam zhi khro'i tshogs kyis dngos grub stsol/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong bar chad srungs/ /lha 'dre mi gsu ma rnams kyis grogs byed shog /'di nyid 'dri zhing 'don dang thos tshad kyi/ /skye 'gro thams cad rdzogs ldan dus bzhin du/ /nyin bde mtshan bde nyi ma'i gung yang bde/ /nyin mtshan rta ga tu bde zhing skyid par shog /'di nyid gang du gnas pa'i yung/ phyogs der/ /nyin yang bkra shis dpal 'bar ta la la/ /mtshan yang bkra shis dpal 'bar gye li li/ /nyin mtshan khor mo yu ka tu bkra shis shog/smras pa/ bskal bzang sangs rgyas stong gi nang nas kyang / /pad dkar lta bur bsngags nga 'i zas gtsang sras/ /yab sras brgyud par bcas la gsol ba 'debs/ /chos kun sems la 'char bar byin gyis rlobs/ /rgya bod mkhas grub yongs kyi thugs dam mthil/ /gzhung bzang chu bo kun 'dus legs bshad mtsho/ /skye dgu'i 'dod do na skong ba'i yid bzhin nor/ /chos kyi snying khu byang chub lam rim 'di'i/ /par yig 'dri mkhan dbu mdzad bskal bzang skyabs/ /par brko'i 425

mchog gyur ska gsar bsam 'grub lags/ /par shing kha 'go stag yan kun dgas byas/ /par yon slob ma yon bdag mang pos phul/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i pad tshal rab rgyas shing / /'gro la bde skyid lo yag bskrun pa'i phyir/ /chos sbyin 'dzad med par gyi dal 'gro'i rgyun/ /dben gnas nyams dga' bkra shis 'khyil bar bzhugs/ /dge ba 'di yis tshe rabs thams cad du/ /theg mchog dge ba'i bshes kyis rjes bzung nas/ /lam rim 'di nyid goms pa mthar phyin te/ /rnam 'dren rgyal ba'i go 'phang myur thob shog /pha ma drin can 'gro ba ma lus dang / /khyad par chos 'dir 'brel ba thogs tshad kyi/ /gnas skabs mthar thug bsam don ma lus pa/ /thams cad chos bzhin 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog /ces pa 'di yang zhabs dkar pas sbyar ba'o/ /sarba maṅga lo/ / / / 426

༄༅/ /dag snang sprul ba'i glegs bam zhes bya ba bzhugs so//༄༅/ /na mo gu ru/ rgyal ba khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po dang ngo bo dbyer ma mchis pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la rab tu gus pas phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /thugs brtse ba chen ngo/'i sgo nas chos dang gang zag yongs la dad gus dag snang skye bar byen gyis brlab tu gsol/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga la longs spyod cing / /kha sbyor bde stong ro la rtag rol pa'i/ /rgyal ba rdo rje 'cha ri dbang yab yum la /lus ngag yid gsum gus pas phyag 'tshashā 4 lo/ /rdo rje 'chang gis ji snyed gsungs pa yi/ /gsang sngags bsdu mdzad rigs sngags 'chang ba'i rje/ /log 'dren bdud sde'i tshogs rnams 'joms mdzad pa'i/ /mthu stobs bdag por gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas las kyang da kon pa'i gsang sngags chos/ /brten nas dka' tshegs med pa ra tshe gcig la/ /'chi med rdo rje'i sku brnyes pad+ma 'byung / /gtso 'khor gsum la gus 427

pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug dpal ldan sā ra ha/ /te lo nā ro rnams kyis gtso byas pa'i/ /grub thob brgyad cu rig 'dzin brgyad la sogs/ /rgya gar mkhas grub yongs la gus phyag 'tshal/ /rje 'bangs nyer lnga gter ston brgya rtsa dang / /grub dbang mi la rwa lo rdo rje grags/ /gtsang spyon dbus spyon 'brug pa kun legs sogs/ /bod kyi mkhas grub rnams la gus pas 'dud/ /thun mong lam gyes rgyud sbyangs sngon btang ste/ /gsang ba sngags la brten nas sangs rgyas pa'i/ /sngon byon mkhas grub tshad ldan yongs la 'dud/ /kun gyi rnam thar zin par byen gyis rlobs/ /rang la dgyes bzhin gsang sngags zab mo'i chos/ /stsol mkhas chos rgyal ngag gi dbang po sogs/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams la gus pas 'dud/ /dad gus dag snang 'char bar mdzad du gsol/ /gsang 'dus bde mchog kye rdor dus 'khor dang / /dam pa rigs brgya sgrub pa bka' brgyad sogs/ /yi dam lha tshogs rnams la bdag gis bstod/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub char bzhin phob/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i gnas dang dur khrod brgyad/ /sa 'og sa steng sa bla gsum po la/ /gnas pa'i mkha' 'gro chos skyong thams cad mchod/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyas pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /gsang 428

sngags bskyed rdzogs gsang ba sgogs tha la/ /zhing skyes sngags skyes lhan skyes mkha' 'gro mas/ / ma yis bu bzhin gnang ba stsol ba dang / /bgegs kun ‘rte bar zhi ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /phan bde'i 'byung gnas sang sa rgyas bstan srung ma/ /chos mdzad bu ltar skyong ba'i dam ldan ma/ /tshe ring mched lnga lus dang grib ma bzhin/ /'grogs das ci 'dod dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /de ltar lha la mchod bstod gsol btab nas/ /dam pa'i chos dang chos mdzad thams cad la/ /dad gus dag snang bskyed tshul bshad par bya/ /mdo sngags lam la slob 'dod gus pas nyon/ /de yang dre1gas bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas rgya bod kyi mkhas grub mang pos/ spyir mdo sngags kyis bsdus pa'i rgyal ba'i gsung rab mtha' dag gi dgongs pa lon na/ dbu rdzogs phyag gsum gang la yang phyogs med kyi dad gus dag snang skye zhing / 'khor 'das spyi) chos thams cad kyi ngo bo gdod nas stong zhing / rnam pa sgyu ma rme lam ltar snang la rang bzhin gyes ma grub par rtogs na/ 'khor ba yang bde ba'i rang bzhin du 'char la/ sgos su gang zag dbang po yang rab rnams kyis thabs la mkhas pas spyod sheb 4 na/ 'dod yon lnga bde ba'i longs spyod dang / 'dod yon lnga'i nang nas kyang lto 429

gos bud med gsum bde ba'i 'byung gnas/ khyad par du mi lus rin po che la brten nas mdo sngags kyi chos la longs spyod shes na tshe 'di phyi'i bde skyid thams cad 'byung bar 'gyur bas na/ deng sang gi dus 'dir chos mdzad kun gyi nang na phal che ba zhig la phar bltas na 'khor ba 'di la zhen chags dang / 'dod yon lnga la sred pa dang / lus la gces 'dzin che ba ltar snang yang skyon gyis mi gos pa'i gdengs ci yod mi shes snyam du gang la yang log lta spu tsam yang mi byed par/ thams cad la dad gus dag snang sbyong dgos zhes gang gsungs pa rnams 'dir bshad rgyu'i chos so/ /de ji ltar 'chad na kun yid ches pa'i phyir dpe bzhag lung mang po drangs rigs pas kyang bsgrubs nas bshad par bya'o//de yang 'o skol lha dang bcas pa'i 'gro ba ma lus pa'i rnam par 'dren pa mnyam med zas gtsang gi sras po de nyid don dam par 'khor 'das thams cad kyi thog mar rdzogs byang bla na med pa'i go 'phang dam pa mngon du mdzad kyang / zhing 'dir rigs can gsum gyi skye dgu mtha' yas pa dag yongs su smin par bya ba'i phyir/ smon lam dang thugs rje chen po'i stobs dang shin tu thabs la mkhas pa'i spyod pa rmad du byung 430

pas slar yang zhi ba brnyes pa'i tshul byi)sa/ thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i gdul byar gyur pa ra/tha' dag la rang rang gi blo dang 'tsham par chos kyi sgo mo brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungs shing / de dag kyang bsdu na kun rdzob chos can gyi bden pa gtso bor stom pa rgyu mtshan nyid kyi theg pa da nga / don dam chos nyid kyi bden pa gtso bor ston pa 'bras bu sngags kyi theg pa gnyis su 'dus te/ laṅkar gshegs par/ theg pa rnam pa gnyis yin te/ /mtshan nyid rgyu yi theg pa dang / /'bras bu rdo rje theg pa'o/ /zhes gsungs/ de ltar mdo rā/gas zung du 'brel ba'i chos tshul rnams shin tu zab cing rgya che ning / de dag gi tshig re re la'ang don du ma'i bdag nyid du gan sa pa'i phyir na/mtha' gcig tu bzung dka' bas/ so skyes lam zhugs pa rnams kyes phyogs re re zhen pa'i blos tshig phyir 'brang ste dpyad cing gzhigs na 'gal ba ltar sna/nga ba chos nyid yin te/mkhas pa'i dbang po rje btsun mi 'gyur rdo rje'i zhal nas/ 'o skol gyi ston pas dang po byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed/bar du bskal chen grangs med du tshogs bsags/ mthar mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa'i tshuḍatha tsam la yang mi mthun pa mang ste/ de yang nyan thos kyi (thugs la rgyal po gsal 431

grags su gyur pa'i tshe thugs bskyed par bshad/ theg chen gyi lugs la mdo bskal pa bzang por/ nga ni sngon tshe dman par gyur pa'i tshe/ /zhes rdza mkhan gyi khye'u snang byed du gyur pa'i tshe thugs bskyed pa dang / snying rje pad dkar du bram ze rgya mtsho'i rdul du skye ba bzhes pa'i dus su dang / drin lan bsab pa'i mdor/ dmyal ba'i shing rta 'dren pa'i gyad du 'khrungs pa'i dus su dang / phung bo gsum pa'i mdor/ tshong dpon gyi bu mngon dgar 'khrungs pa'i dus su dang / yang rgyal bo 'od ldan du gyur pa'i tshe thugs bskyed tshul sogs mang / de bzhin du tshogs bsags tshul la'ang / sangs rgyas kyi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa'i gzungs las/ kye ma sangs rgyas yon tan che/ /bskal pa grangs med gsum bsags pa/ /zhes grangs med gsum du phal cher 'dod kyang / rgya cher rol par grangs med bdun dang / sde ba tha dad pa'i 'khor lor grangs med bcu dang / brgyad stong 'grel chen du grangs med sum cu rtsa gsum du bshad pa sogs kyang mi mthun/ mngon par byang chub pa'i tshul la'ang / mdo ltar na srod la bdud btul/ gung la mnyam par bzhag de nas bsam gtan bzhi dang rig pa gsum bskyed nas/ skya rengs 'char khar rten 'brel bcu 432

gnyis lugs ldog tu shar zhing / bden pa bzhi khong du chud nas skad cig dang ldan pa'i shes rab kyis mngon par byang chub par bshad/ sngags ltar na rgyud sde bzhi bo rim pa bzhin/dang bo bya rgyud ltar na thog mar bdud btul/ de nas gung thun la bsam gtan bzhi dang / mngon shes lnga la sogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi brtan pa thob nas/ mtsham mo'i mthar skya rengs 'char ba'i dus su rdo rje lta bu re ting nge 'dzin gyis srid pa'i skye ba mthar phyin par byas te/ gnyis su snang ba med pa'i ye shes mthar phyin pa thob nas sangs rgyas par bshad/ spyod rgyud ltar na de nyid sngags kyi sa bcu rdzogs ma thag sku gsung thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i dbyings su mngon par byang chub par bshad/ 'di la bu ston gyis/ thog mar ting nge 'dzin gyis bdud bcom nas/ kha mas gsum las 'das te 'og min stug po bkod par skyes nas mngon byang lnga'i byang chub par bshad pa la/ bo dong paṇa chen gyes/ de ltar ma yin pa'i shes byed du skye ba gcig gis thogs pa 'og min du skyes nas rgyun mtha'i rten la rdzogs par sang sa rgyas pa'i phyir dang /zhes sogs kyi sgrub byed mdzad pa'ang yod do/ /rnal 'byor rgyud du/ slob dpon shākya bshes gnyen gyi nga/zhed pa ltar na/ chu bo 433

trī rañdza na'i 'gram du dka' ba spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam smin gyi lus der dor nas ye shes kyi lus 'og min du phyin te/ mngon byang lnga'i sgo nas sangs rgyas/ slar sngar gyi lus la zhugs te byang chub kyi shing drung du sangs rgyas pa'i tshul bstan par bzhed/slob dpon kun dga' snying po ni thog mar 'og min du sangs rgyas nas slar zhing 'dir skye ba sten par bzhed la/ de yang sems can thams cad la phan bde'i rgyur/ bdag ni sangs rgyas mchog tu 'gyur ro zhes rnal 'byor pas bsams nas/slob pa'i bya ba mthar phyin pa dag gis sems can thams cad kyi don 'bad med lhun 'grub tu 'byung bas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par byas so/ /zhes dgongs nas snying po byang chub kyi shing drung du bzhugs te mi g.yo ba'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas pa'i tshe/ de bzhin gshegs pa til gyi gang bu lta bus mi mjed kyi zhing 'di yongs su gang bar gyur pa de dag byang chub sems dpa'i thad du lhags nas/ sngags dang se gol gyi sgras ting nge 'dzin las bslang ste/ rang sems so sor rtogs pa la sogs mngon byang lngas sangs rgyas par bshad/ bla med ltar na rang gis zhing sbyangs pa las grub pa'i 'og min gyi zhing khams der/smon lam legs par sad pa'i 'khor dang bcas te/ de bzhin 434

gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'od zer chen po'i dbang skur ba legs par thob pa'i byang chub sems nga/ pa' des dpa' bar 'gro ba'am rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin mngon du mdzad nas/rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba sgyu ma lta bu'i tshogs thams cad la de kho na nyid du yod pa dang / med pa dang / gnyis ka dang /gnyis ka ma yin par spros pa'i mtha' nga/ga chags phra mo gang bud shing brlan med pa ltar/ zhen pa'i gsher dang yun ring mo nas bral ba/ gnyen po ye shes kyi me lce grangs med pa 'bar bas shin tu phra bar byas pa/ de dag gnyis su med pa'i ye shes skad cig ma gcig gis legs par bcom ste/ de kho na nyid ma rig pa thams cad rnam par bcad la/ de kho na nyid rig par gdags pa'i gnyis su med pa'i blos mngon par byang chub par bshad la/ de bzhin du spong ba'i theg pa dang / bsgyur ba'i theg pa dang / rang bzhin shes pa'i theg pa sogs su dbye ba'i dbang gis/ chags bral theg pa'i skabs nas spangs par bya ba rnams/ rdo rje theg pa'i gsang ba bla na med pa'i skabs su bsten par bya ba kho na yin pas mtshon/ theg pa gong 'og thams cad kyi 'jug bya gang zag 'jug byed dbang po/ spang bya chags sogs/ spong byed dbang sogs/ thun mong dus 435

tshigs kyi sgo nas dbye ba/ sa lam gyi grangs dang rim pa'i bsgod tshul sna tshogs su gsungs pa re re nas bgrang bar ma langs pas/ de dag gi dgongs pa'i gnad ma longs pas phyogs rer mngon par zhen pa'i blos brtags pa na/ thams cad kyang nang 'gal ba'i rang bzhin yin la/ de dag las gang yang rung ba zhig 'thad ldan du khas blangs pas na/ cig shos de dag log par 'gyur zhing / de bas na theg pa 'di dag blang bya'am 'on te dor bya zhig go snyam du blo gros chung ngu dag som nyir byed pa ni chos spang gi las mi zad pa ste/ ting 'dzin rgyal bor/ gang gis 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir ni/ /mchod rten thams cad bshig byed las/ /gang gis mdo sde spongs byed pa/ /sdig pa de ni chos khyad 'phags/ /zhes dang / rnam snang mngon byang las/ gang gis sems kyi gnas lugs gtan la ma phebs par rnam par 'khrul nas 'di skad du/ 'di ni sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa ma yin gyi/ 'di dag ni rang bzo can gyis rang bzor byas pa yin no zer ba dag 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /gsang ba ba'i bdag po/ mi blun po de dag ni 'gro ba gnyis su 'gro bar rig par bya ste/ gnyis gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ sems can dmyal ba dang dud 'gro'o/ /zhes dang /436

'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ gang zhig chos mchog gtso bo 'di/ /rgyal bas mchod pas chos kyi mdzod/ /sa steng mi yis spong byed pa/ /de ni mnar med dmyal bar 'gro/ /zhes sogs rgya cher gsungs pa 'di dag bslu ba med pa rdo rje'i tshig tu rig par bya ba nyid yin pas/ 'jam dbyangs sa paṇa gyis/ 'di mtha' 'di tsam kho nar gnas so zhes/ /de mtha' de tsam kho nar rjes dpag na/ /'gro ba'i bla ma'i gsung la brgal ba ste/ /des na mtha' min dgongs pa dpyad nga/ra bya/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin no/ /'o na bstan pa thams cad 'gal med du ji ltar sgrub ce na/ 'di la thugs rje che zhing thabs la mkhas pa ni sangs rgyas kyi khyad chos yin pas/ chos sgo sna tshogs tha dad du bstan pa de dag don la so so ma yin gye/ gdul bya'i gang zag khams dbang mos pa sna tshogs pa de dag 'dul bar bya ba'i phyir so so'i blo dang 'tshams par bstan pa ste/ sgon gsal las/ skye bo 'dod chags can don du/ /de yi byed pa rdo rje sems/ /zhes dang / mtshan brjod du/ theg pa sna tshogs thabs tshul gyis/ /'gro ba'i don la ston pa po/ /zhes so/ /rgyu mtshan de'i phyir rgyas par nyon mongs pa brgyad khri bzhi stong gi gnyen por chos kyi sgo mo brgyad khri bzhi stong du gsungs pa dang /437

'bring du nyon mongs pa phra rags bcu gnyis la dgongs nas gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis su gsungs pa dang / bsdus par nyon mongs pa dug gsum du 'dus par dgongs nas sde snod gsum du gsungs pa rnams/ gdul bya gang zag gi dbang po dang ji ltar 'tshams par bstan pa ste/ bde mchog nyung ngu'i rgyud las/ mos pa du ma'i sems can la/ /spyod pa sna tshogs ston mdzad cing / /sna tshogs tshul gyes gdul bya la/ /thabs ni sna tshogs ston pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de bas na blo dang ldan pa dag gis phyogs re ba'i rmongs zhen dor nas/drang ba'i don dang / nges pa'i don dang / dgongs pa can dang / dgongs pa can min pa dang / dgongs pa can la yang dgongs pa bzhi dang / ldem dgongs bzhi dang / sgra ji bzhin pa dang / ji bzhin ma yin pa'i bye brag shes par bya ba ni/gnad kyi dam par che ste/ sgon ma gsal bar/ gleng bslangs pa yi grangs ni lnga/ /rig pa rnam pa bzhi yin la/ /rgyas bshad mtha' ni rnam pa drug /bshad pa yang ni rnam pa bzhi/ /lnga ba'i dbye ba rnam pa gnyis/ /drug pa'i dbye ba lnga dang ldan/ /bdun pa'i dbye ba rnam gnyis te/ /rgyan rnams mdo ru bsdus pa'o/ /zhes dang / de nyid las/ /drang ba dang ni nges don bcas/ /438

dgongs pas bshad dang dgongs min dang / /ji bzhin sgra dang ma yin te/ /mtha' ni drug tu shes pa ra bya/ /skal ldan rnams la rgyal ba yis/ /sbas te bshad pa drang ba'i don/ /yang dag don ni rab ston phyir/ /nges pa'i don yang gsungs pa yin/ /mchog 'dod sems can rnams kyi phyir/ /chos kyi de nyid rab ston pa/ /'gal ba'i tshig gi sbyor ba yis/ /gsungs pa gang de dgongs bshad do/ /dbang po dman pa'i sems can rnams/ /rtogs phyir shin tu gsal ba yi/ /de nyid nges par ston pa ni/ /dgongs pa min pa'i bshad pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor la sogs chog zhib la/ /spyod pa ji lta ji ltar gas/ngas/ /don rgyas bshad pa gang yin pa/ /de ni ji bzhin sgrar ba/sungs pa/ /ko ṭa khya la sogs pa'i sgra/ /'jig rten bstan ba cos la med cing / /de bzhin gshegs pa'i brdar gyur pa/ / de ni ji bzhin min par grags/ /zhes sogs rgyas par gsungs pa 'di'i don khong du chud pa na gong du bshad pa'i 'gal ba thams cad nad grol gdon grol la 'gro bar the tshom med do 6nos gsungs so/ /gzhan yang theg pa'i rnam grangs mang ste/ dam chos pad dkar las/theg pa gcig ste gnyis su yod ma yin/ /zhes dang / kun byed las/ yod ni gcig las med pa la/ /1nes dang / 'byung bzhi 439

zad pa'i rgyud las/ rgyu chos rnams dang 'bras bu'i phyir/ /theg pa de yang rnam pa gnyis/ /zhes dang / ye sgron las/ che chung rim pa'i blo yod phyir/ /theg pa'i grangs kyang de bzhin te/ /bsdu na che chung rnam gnyis so/ /zhes dang / rnam snang mngon byang las/nga yi bstan pa rnam gnyis te/ /dman pa mu stegs theg pa dang / /mchog gyur sangs rgyas theg pa'o/ /zhes dang / laṅkar gshegs pa las/ theg pa rnam pa gnyis yin te/ /mtshan nyid rgyu yi theg pa dang / /'bras bu rdo rje'i theg pa'o/ /zhes dang / mdo sde rgyan las/ sbyor ba dang ni tshogs dag dang / /bsam pa dang ni bshad nyid dang / /sgrub pa'i rab tu dbye ba yis/ /theg pa rnam pa gsum du 'dod/ /ces dang / 'jam dpal sgyu 'phrul drwa ba las/ theg pa gsum gyi nges 'byung la/ /theg pa gcig gi 'bras bur gnas/ /zhes dang / yang laṅkar gshegs pa las/cho 'phrul mngon byung gi theg pa dang / dka' thub rig byed kyi theg pa dang / 'khor lo rgyun gyi theg pa dang / don dam nges pa'i theg pa dang bzhi gsungs/ gsang snying las/ thams cad kyang 'di lta ste/ 'dul ba'i dbang gis lha dang mi'i theg pa dang / nyan thos kyi theg pa dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa dang / bla na med pa sngags 440

kyi theg pa zhes lnga gsungs/ gsang ba kun byed las/ nges pa thob pa'i theg pa drug /ces dang / dkyil 'khor bsdu ba las/lha dang mi yi nyan thos dang / /sangs rgyas rang byung byang chub sems/ /gsang ba phyi dang nang gnyis te/ /de ltar theg pa bdun du bshad/ /ces dang / nam mkha' chen po las/ de ltar brgyad las 'das pa'i zhes brgyad sogs bshad tshul mi 'dra ba mang yang / kun byed las/ byung ni theg pa dgu ru byung / /gsungs/gzhan yang mtshan nyid rgyu'i theg pa gcig pu la'ang theg pa gsum du phye ba yod de/ glang chen rab 'bogs kyi le'u gsum pa las/ mtshan nyid theg pa gsum la sde snod gsum/ /zhes dang /dur khrod rgyan gyi rgyud las/ gzhan yang nga yis gsungs pa'i bka'/ /dus gcig nyid du gsungs gyur kyang / /du ma nyid du so sor snang / /chos tshul du ma'i bye brasgyuka dang / /'du shes du ma'i bye brag gis/ /theg pa'i mtha' la thug pa med/ /ces dang /laṅkar gshegs pa las/ sems can rnams ni yongs drangs phyir/ /zeg pa mtha' dag ngas bshad de/ /'di zhes dmigs su yod ma yin/ /lha yi theg dang tshangs pa 'i theg /de bzhin du ni nyan thos dang / /de bzhin gshegs ཿdang rang rgyal gyi/ /theg pa tha dad pa bshad do/ /ji srid sems ni 'jug pa'i bar/ /441

theg pa'i mtha' la thug pa med/ /ces dang / bla ma zhang gis/sems can gyi rnam par rtog pa dang / mthun par sangs rgyas kyi theg pa'i mtha' la zad pa med/ ces gsungs pa 'di rnams go na rnying ma'i theg pa rim dgu gsungs pa la yang dag snang skye bar 'gyur ste/ rje rin po che'i sras kyi thu bo mkhas grub rje la/sangs rgyas rin chen gyis/ gsang sngags rnying ma ba 'di la snga rabs kyi mkhas pa rnams kyis kyang dgag pa 'dug cing / da lta yang skur pa 'debs pa mang du 'dug pa/ 'di ji 'dra zhig yin zhes dris pa la/ mkhas grub rje'i zhal nas/ gsang sngags bstan pa snga dar gyi dus 'gyur ba la rnying ma dang / phyi dar la 'gyur ba la gsar ma zhes 'byung ba yin/ rnying ma la skur pa 'debs pa mang ba'i rgyu mtshan yang / sngon glang dar mas bstan pa bsnubs nas bar stongs byung dus gsang sngags pa rnams sbyor sgrol la sogs pa spyod pa phyin ci log byed pa byung ba dang /deng sang yang khyem pa lcang lo can gyi spyod pa mang bas gang zag gi spyod pa la dpag nas chos la smod pa 'di byung ba 'dra/ de min sngags rnying ma 'di dang po chos rgyal dam pa rnams kyis bai ro tsā na dang rma gnyag gnyis dge slong mi lnga la sogs pa'i tshad ma'i skyes bur 'gyur ba lo tsā ba rnams la gser bres bshar la 442

yon du bskur nas/ rgya gar du brdzangs te/ rdzogs pa chen po la sogs pa'i gsang sngags bla na med pa'i chos rnams padhi ta dang / grub pa brnyes pa rtsod med du grags pa rnams la zhus shing bsgyur/ gzhan yang pad+ma 'byung gnas dang / bi ma la mi tra dang / sangs rgyas gsang ba la bo/gas pa'ang bod du spyan drangs nas de dag gis kyang gsungs pa'i chos/ theg pa bla na med pa'i chos zab skyon dang bral ba yi na te/ 'di tshul bzhin nyams su blangs nas grol ba dang / grub pa brnyes pa dpag tu med pa byung ba tshad mas grub bo/ /bsam yas na yang da dung snga 'gyur gyi rgya dpe mang du yod par 'dub/ cing / bod pa lo tsā bas kyang rgya gar du byon pas/ yul dbus 'gyur tshal na gsang snying / lung gi mdo lnga la sogs pa rgya dpe 'dug zer/ des na 'di lta bu'i theg chen bla na med pa'i chos zab mo la skur pa 'debs pa rnams ni dmyal ba'i rgyu kho na ra bas so/ /gsungs/yang mkhas grub rjes/ blun po kha cig zla ba grags pa bod kyi mkhas pa snga ma kha cig gis bkag pas/ zla ba grags pa bkag pa la de tsam du mtshar che rgyu med do zhes smra/ kha cig gis phar phyin 'chad pa na rje btsun byams mgon la yang mdo dang ma mthun pa'i skyon brjod kyi tshig zur brib/ par snang / bod blun 443

po dag gi dgag yul ni da lta rang nyid kyi rnyed bkur dang /'khor 'du ba sogs nyams par mi 'gyur zhing / da lta lus la dbyug pa sogs kyi 'gog byed mi 'byung na/ sangs rgyas nyid kyang mtshan nas smos te 'gog par byed pa la ya mi nga bar snang gsungs/ yang / blun po 'jig rten pha rol spangs pa/ mdo rgyud kyi gzhung lugs rgya chen po dag klog pa tsam yang ma byas par/ phrag dog gdon gyis bslad pa'i brtol gtam byung rgyal du smra ba bstan pa'i snying po la mi mthun par 'dzin pa'i nag po'i phyogs kyi bdud kyi rigs kyi lhas yid bsgyur ba'i gzhan dbang du song ba dag gi gtam la/ blo dang ldan pa bdag nyid legs su 'dod pa dag gis rna ba dgab par byos shig gsungs/ sngags kyi spyi don tshangs dbyangs 'brug sgra las/thos chung log lta can gyi rigs kha cig na re/ sngags rnying ma'i rgyud la yang dag pa ma yin/ rgya gar na mi 'dug zer ba sogs ni rang gi blo gros kyi mig long ba yin te/ rgya gar thang bi la ha ra'i gtsug lag khang na rnying ma'i chos bskor rgyud rgya dpe bzhugs pa'i mtshan yi ger bkod na bka' rgyas pa tsam bzhugs par grags/ spyan snga ba blo gros rgyal mtshan gyis/ gtso bo rnying ma'i rdzogs rim ston pa yin pas/ rdzogs chen la 444

sangs rgyas kyi chos med byar mi rung la/ chos spong ni mtshams med pa las kyang lci ba mang du gsungs pas bag yod par gyis shig chos spong gis thams cad 'phung du 'jug pas/ gzhung lugs rnam dag rnams la blta ba dang nyan pa gal che'o/ /gsungs/ mnyam med po to bas/ chos thams cad gcig pa yin/ nga cag gi chos dang khong cag gi chos byas nas gzhan gyi chos la smad na dmyal bar skye/ gsungab // des na mdo sngags chos kyi snying po dbu rdzogs phyag gsum zhes bod khams yongs la 'brug bzhin du grags pa rnams la phyogs med kyi dad gus dag snang sbyongs bzhin du/ rang )da gang mos kyi chos de nyams su len pa gces te/ sangs rgyab/ snang ba mtha' yas kyi rnam 'phrul paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan gyis/ lhan cig skyes sbyor ga'u ma/ /lnga ldan ro snyoms yi ge nga/zhi/ /zhi byed gcod yul rdzogs chen dang / /dbu ma'i lta khrid la sogs pa/ /so sor ming 'dogs mang na yang / /nges do na lung rigs la mkhas shing / /nyams myong can gyi rnal 'byo pas/ /dpyad na dgongs pa gcig tu 'bab/ /ces dang / grub thob 'brug pa kun legs kyis/ phyag chen dang rdzogs chen dbu ma gsum/ /mkhas pas bltas na gcig tu 'dug / drun po chos spong mdzad 445

'dod rnams/ /so sor phyes la nga yis sgoms/ /'brug pa kun legs de skad lo/ /zhes dang / paṇa chen blo bzang ye shes kyis/dbus gtsang mnga' ri'i bar gyi grub pa'i mtha'/ /kun kyang rgyal bstan kho na yin pas na/ /phyogs lhung gdon gyis sdang shugs ma mdzad par/ /dag snang nor bu'i 'od kyis khyab na legs/ /zhes dang / rig 'dzin gang shar rang grol gyis/ /deng sang chos lugs grub mtha' mang / /thams cad sangs rgyas lam du gcig /don med kha sdig ma bsogs par/ /kun la dag snang mdzod cig ang / /zhes dang / rje btsun skal ldan rgya mtsho'i zhal nas/ chos rang rang mos pa'i ngo na zab/ /mchog sangs rgyas thob pa'i thabs dam pa/ /sa dge ldan gsar rnying kun la yod/ /gzhan ma smod kun la dag snang sbyongs/ /zhes dang / kun mkhyen tho bkwan chos kyi nyi ma'i zhal nas/bod du byung ba'i grub mtha' sna tshogs 'di dag la/ skur pa 'debs pa'i 'os su gyur pa gcig kyang mi snang bas/ bdag bde legs su 'dod pa rnams ni kun la dag snang gis khyab par byed pa nyid/ rang la phan pa'i 'dun ma'i rtsa bar sems so/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar chos lugs yongs la dad gus dag snang byed bzhin rang nyid gang mos chos de nyams su len pa ma 446

gtogs/ chos lugs gang la yang khas gtong ba sogs gtan nas mi bya'o/ /de yang phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs chos kyi sku spros pa nga nga bral ba/ nam mkha' ltar stong la mtha' dbus med pa skye 'gags gnas gsum dang bral ba de la/ gdod ma'i mgon po 'od mi 'gyur ba'am/ chos sku kun tu bzang po/ yuca/ chen mo sogs ming gi rnam grangs mtha' yas kyang / don da 4 par chos thams cad kyi gdod ma'i gnas lugs mtha' bral tshos sku'am chos kyi dbyings 'di la gzhol zhing 'bab/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku'i mchog kyang chos sku 'gyur ba med pa 'di yin te/ mdo las/ 'dren pa rnams ni chos kyi sku/ //gsungs/ dper na kha dog lnga ldan gyi 'ja' 'tshon ri mo ji tsam shar yang de thams cad nam mkha'i dbyings las tshur byung / nam mkha'i dbyings la brten/ nam mkha'i dbyings su yal ba ltar/ snang srid 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams/ cad chos kyi dbyings las tshur byung / chos kyi dbyings la brte na/ chos kyi dbyings la thim par 'gyur/ des na 'khor 'ang) sa kyi chos thams cad sangs rgyas su zhig gis sprul pa'am/ rnam 'phrul yin bshad kyang don gyi ngos nas 'gal ba med/ nge( la dgongs nas rnying 447

ma'i rgyud 'ga' re na chos thams cad kun tu bzang po'i rnam 'phrul yin gsungs/ lung gzhan 'ga' re na/ thub pa ma gtogs ji lta'i dngos/ /de bzhin gshegs las gzhan yod min/ /zhes dang / rje 'brug pa kun legs kyis/ rgyud las/sangs rgyas kun tu bzang po nga / /dmyal ba kun tu bzang po nga / /gsungs pa'i lung de chos thams cad kyi rnam pa mi gcig pa ma gtogs ngo bo gcig dper na ngas dmag byas na dmag dpon kun legs/ gzhas byas na gzhas mkhan kun legs/chos bshad na chos rje kun legs/ zer rung / nga'i ngo bo gcig las ma 'das pa bzhin/ gshis stong nyid de rgyu rkyen phun sum tshogs pas bskyed nas/ spangs rtogs mthar phyin pa de la/rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas su mtshan gsol/ gshis stong nyid de las ngan sna tshogs kyis bskyed nas 'khor bar 'khyams pa de la sems can zhes ming btags rung / don stong pa nyid du gcig gsungs/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs ni nam mkha' ltar 'khor 'das yongs la khyab cing brdal nas phyogs dang ris su ma chad par dus dang rnam pa thams cad du ye nas gnas pa yin/ shes na don dam du sems can ji snyed mchis pa kun kyang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs chos sku kun tu 448

bzang po'i ya gcig yin zhing / 'khor ba'i mtho dman gang du skyes kyang sangs rgyas kyi thugs kyi klong zhus nam yang mi 'da'/de la dgongs nas mdo las/ bde gshegs snying pos 'gro ba yongs la khyab/ /'gro ba 'di dag ma 'u/sa sangs rgyas nyid/ /gsungs/ sems can rnams kyis kyang sems la ngo bo ngos bzung dbyebs kha dog skye 'gags gnab/ gsum dang bral ba skye med chos sku ru ye nas gnas pa yin te/ dkon mchog brtsegs pa las/ sems ni sangs rgyas kyis ma gzigs/ /mi gzigs gzigs par mi 'gyur ro/ /gsungs/ ba /ngas rgyas kyi zhal nas/sems ni kha dog med dbyebs nam mkha rdo lta bu'o/ /gsungs/slob dpon dga' rab rdo rjes/ sems/ kyi rang bzhin ye nas bud+dha ste/ /sems la skye 'gags med pas nam mkha' 'dra/ /gsungs/ 'da' ka ye shes las/ sems rtogs na ye shes yin pas sangs rgyas gzhan nas mi 'tshol ba'i 'du shes rab tu bsgom par bya'o/ /gsungs/ shes na don dam par chos kyi sku 'am chos dbyings kyi klong na sangs rgyas na nga sems can thugs yid gnyis chu la chu bzhag pa ltar dbyer med du 'dres nas ye nas gnas pa yin te/ chos rje 'brug pa kun legs kyis/sangs rgyas kyi stong pa dang / sems can gyi stong pa gnyis 449

logs su 'di yin zhes 'byed rgyu ga na yod/ chu rlabs dang /chu 'khyil li ba gnyis chu'i ngo bor gcig gam gsungs/ de ltar shes na 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad nam mkha'i 'ja' tshon chu nang gi zla gzugs/ sgyu ma rmi lam ltar sems can gyi sems nyid stong pa don dam chos kyi sku'i rol ba yin zhes brjod kyang 'gal ba med/ de la dgongs nas phal po che las/sems ni ri mo mkhan dang 'dra/ /sems kyi phung bo byas pa ste/ /'jig rten khams ni ji snyed pa/ /de dag sems kyi ri mo yin/ /gsungs/ dgongs pa 'dus pa las/ chos thams cad ni sems la gnas so/ /sems ni nam mkha' la gnas so/ /nam mkha' ni ci la yang mi gnas so/ /gsungs/ yang chos thams cad kyi gdod ma'i gshis lugs stong pa nyid dang dbyer med pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs chos kyi dbyings rgya chad phyogs lhung med pa'i khyab brdal chen po dus dang rnam pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam 'phrul las/ tshur 'og min gyi zhing dang /gzhan rigs lnga gangs chen mtsho'i zhing khams lnga sogs zhing khams tshad med pa sangs rgyas rnams kyis bkod pa las/ rnam snang gangs chen mtsho'i phyag gi lhung bzed kyi nang na pad+ma nyi shu rtsa lnga brtsegs mar gnas pa la/ zhing khams nyi shu rtsa lnga gnas 450

pa'i thugs ga'i thad kyi pad+ma bcu gsum pa'i nang na stong gsum mi mjed kyi zhing khams 'di nyid yod ces gsungs/shes na 'o skol rnams sangs rgyas thamar / cad kyi thugs kyi klong du chud pa tsam du ma zad/ sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad kyi phyag gi mthil na gnas pa yin par gda'/ dper na yul bzang po mi bdag bzang po'i dkyil na yod pa'i mi zhig gdon gyis smyos nas spyod log byas/ tsha grang bkres skom sogs kyi sdug bsngal myang ba gzhan nus ldan zhig gis gdon dang phral bar byas/ thabs mkhas pas stoX/da pa de dang 'di gyis dang zhes bslabs nas/ bslab pa lta byas na gang du bsdad kyang bde ba ltar/ 'o skol sems can rna mas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs dkyil dang / khyad kur thub pa gangs chen mtsho'i phyag tu bzung yod kyang ma rig to /na mongs pa gdon lta bus spyos nas/ log spyod lta bu'i las ngan pa bsags pas spyir 'khor ba dang / khyad par ngan song gi ji /ga bsngal myong ba yin kyang / nus ldan lta bu'i mtshan ldan bla ma /sa ma rig nyon mongs kyi gdon dang bral nas/ gnas lugs ji bzhin pa dang /dge sdig blang dor ma nor ba bstan/ de ltar byas na 'khor 'das gang du bsdad kyang sdug bsngal med par bde ste/ byang 451

chub sems dpa' gnas lugs kyi lta ba rtogs nas mngon du gyur pa dang / sdig spangs dge ba chen po bsgrub pa'i rigs dmyal ba'i me nang du bcug kyang nyi zer gyi nang du gnas pa lta bu dang / grang ba'i dmyal bar gnas kyang zla zer gyi nang du bsdad pa tsam gyi snang ba 'byung ba ma gtogs/ tsha grang gi sdug bsngal lus sems kyis gtan nas mi myong zhes gsungs/ des na byang chub sems dpa' sems can re re'i phyir yang mnar med dmyal ba'i me nang nas bskal pa rgya mtshor gnas dgos kyang / thugs skyo ba cung zad tsam yang mi 'byung ba yin skad/des na gnas lugs rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pa la 'khor 'das bzang ngan blang dor re dogs bral ba'i rgyu mtshan yang de yin/dper na me long gzugs brnyan dkar nag dang / sgyu ma rmi lam gyi rgyu mtshan shes pas/ de rnams kyi bzang ngan legs nyes 'dor len byas kyang rung ma byas kyang phan gnod med pa ltar/ chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pas 'khor 'das kyi 'dor len byas kyang legs/ ma byas rung 'gal ba med mod/ 'on kyang gnas lugs rang ngo shes pa tsam du ma zad bsgoms nas/ lus sems la bzang ngan gang gis phan gnod gang yang mi 'byung bar sgyu ma rmi lam tsam du mngon 452

sum du 'gyur rag gi bar dang / mngon du gyur nas rang la phan gnod med rung / pha ma sems cam/ la phan phyir dus rtag tu dge sdig gi 'dor len byed kyang dgos/ byas pa la 'gal ba yang med/ gnas lugs mkha' ltar rtogs nas mngon du gyur kyang / rgyu 'bras sngar bas zhib mo snyed pa stong pa nyid rten cing 'brel 'byung du rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pa'i khyad chos yin/ de ltar rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pas chos ma byas kyang blo bde ste/rje mi las/ bla ma rje yi bka' drin gyis/ /'khor 'das dgag sgrub med par go /cir snang phyag rgya chen por shar/ /zhes dang /'khor ba gzhan du spang du med/ /mā ngan 'das pa sgrub tu med/ /rang sems sangs rgyas su blo thab/ chod/ /ces dang /'khor ba zhi ba yin pa cha med dam/ /rang sems sangs rgyas yin pa cha med dam/ /gsungs/ ras chung bas/ sems ma bcos pa 'di sangs rgyas rang du 'dug /ces dang / 'khor bar 'khyams kyang nyam nga med/ /'khor ba byang chub lam du bde/ /gsungs/ klong chen rab 'byaca/sa pas/ chos kun ye nas sangs rgyas pas/ /khams gsu tha 'khor ba'i ming yang med/ /ces dang / 'khor 'das rmi 'a/ma bzang ngan 'dra/ /rang snang gzhi med stong pa'i gzugs/ /da res blang dor gnyis 453

med pa'i/ /rig pa rang sa bzung na legs/ /gsungs/ des na 'khor ba'i rang mtshang rig nas gnas lugs ngang la btsan sa zin na 'khor ba yang bde ba'i rang bzhin yin pas/ de lta bu'i rnal 'byor pas 'khor 'das blang dor mi dgos par gsungs so/ /yang gsang sngags kyi bskyed pa'i rim pa la sgyu ma lta bu'i goms pa mngon du gyur na/ phyi snod dag pa'i gzhal yas khang dang / /nang bcud 'gro ba ma lus pa lha dang lha mo'i rnam par shar nas/ rnal 'byor pa kho rang gi snang ngor sa thams cad bde ba can gyi zhing du 'gyur te/ rje nā ro bas/snod ni gzhal yas khang yin la/ /bcud ni lha dang lha mo ste/ /'gro ba rigs drug bde gshegs drug /dmyal ba'i 'jig rten bde ba can/ /lha yi 'jig rten bde ba can/ /yi dwags 'jig rten bde chen gyi/ /ngang du shes na lha yi sku/ /zhes pa dang /yang / snod ni 'jig rten min te gzhal yas khang / /bcud ni sems can min te rgyal ba nyid/ /gsungs/ des na snod bcud tha mal du mi blta bar dag snang 'ba' zhig byed pa gces/ de yang dper na dngul chu dkar mo sa nang du lhung yang sa rdul gyis gos mi srid pa bzhin du/ chos kun bden med stong pa nyid du rtogs pa'i nges don gyi rtogs ldan 'khrul zhig 454

nam mkha'i rnal 'byor pho mo rnams 'ji ga rten pa'i khyem du gnas/ nas/ sha chang bud med la sigs pa'i 'dod yon la 'jol nyog tu spyod kyang rtogs pa'i stabs kyis sdig pa'i skyon gyes nam yang gos par mi 'gyur te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i mdzod kyi mdo las/ mi dge ba bcu'i che shos rnams smos nas /de dag dang ldan pas bdag med pa'i chos la 'jug cing /chos thams cad gdod ma nas dag pa ra dad pa dang mos pa'i sems can de ngan song du mi 'gro'o/ /zhes pa dang / bdud 'dul ba'i le'u las/ dge slong gang gis chos thams cad dul bar shes shing nyes pa rnams kyi thog ma'i mtha' yang rang bzhin gyes dben par shes te/ nyes pa byung ba'i 'gyod pa sel zhing brtan por mi byed pas mtshams med pa yang gnon na/cho ga dang tshul khrims la log par zhugs/ pa phran tshegs lta ci smos/ zhes dang / ma skyes dgra'i mdo bas/ mtshams med byed pas dam pa'i chos 'di thos nas 'jub/ cing mos na de'i las de las kyi sgrib pa yin zhes nga mi smra'o/ /zhes gsungs/ de lta bu'i nges don ston pa'i yul snod ldan ne/ 'jug pa las/ so so skye bo'i dus na'ang stong pa nyid thos na sa/ /nang du rab tu dga' ba yang dang yang du 'byung / /ra gu tu dga' ba las byung 455

mchi mas mig brlan cing / /lus kyi ba spu ldang bar 'gyur ba gang yin pa/ /de la rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas blo yi sa bon yod/ /de nyid nye bar bstan pa'i snod ni de yin te/ /de la dam pa'i don gyi bden pa bstan par bya/ /gsungs/ de lta bu la bla mas kyang thog ma nas nges don ston par bya ste/ rin chen phung bo'i mdo las/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis chos ci dang ci ston pa thams cad chos kyi dbyings don dam pa'i bden pa 'ba' zhig las brtsams te ston par byed gsal bar byed pa de ni/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen lam drang bo nas 'khrid par byed pa yin no/ /zhes dang / 'phags pa lhas/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba 'di/ /shes na gti mug 'byung mi 'gyur/ /de phyir 'bad pa kun gyis 'dir/ /gtam 'di kho na bsnyad par bya/ /gsungs/ des na sngon sbyangs las 'phro can/gcig char ba'i rigs gang zag dbang po yang rab rnams la thog ma nas nges don zab mo stong pa nyid kyi don bstan nas/rjes su mdo sngags kyi lam bzang la bslab na rgyal sras kyi spyod pa rlabs po che rnams la yang dpa' zhum pa med par slob nus par gsungs so/ /des na de lta bu'i rigs can rnams kyis lam la rim gyis ma bslab ces skur pa mi 'debs par dad 456

gus dag snang sbyong ba gal che'o/ /sgos su gang zag dbang po yang rab rnams kyis thabs la mkhas pas spyod shes na/ 'khor ba'i phun tshogs gzugs mjes pa dang / sgra snyan pa/ dri zhim pa/ ro mngar ba/ reg bya 'jam pa'i 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga bo de dag re re la brten nas 'phral du bange zhing phugs su phan pa'i yon tan mtha' yas pa 'byung ste/ 'dod yon lngas lha dang mi dang lha ma yin dang dri za dang bcas 4'i lus sems tshim pas bde zhing / rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i thugs dgyes pa bskyed nas bsod nams rgya chen 'byung / 'dod yon lnga la longs spyod rgyu med na kun gyes ngan song gsum ltar sdug bsngal myong bas na/ dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro dang khyad med par 'gyur/ 'dod yon gyi bde ba yod med kyis mtho ris dang ngan song gi khyad byung / 'di med na khyad yod dogs med/'dod yon la brten nas bde skyid tshad med pa myong zhing bde ba'i sgo nas 'dod yon chos phyogs su btang / bsgom bsgrub byas na gtan gyi bde ba yang 'dod yon lnga la brten nas thob pas na/sangs rgyas rnams kyis sems ca na rnams gnas skabs su mngon mtho lha mi'i gnas su skye ba'i thabs gsungs/ sems can rnams kyis bsgrub pa yin/ 'dod yon lnga la brten nas 457

gnas skabs su lus sems bde ba'i phan yon yod pa smos ci dgos/ mthong thos myong bas shes sla la/ 'dod yon lnga'i mchod sbyin btang / sku gsung thugs rten bzhengs pa sogs dge ba byas na mngon mtho lha mi'i go 'phang / nges legs thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang yang skye ba 'di'am ma 'ongs pa'i skye ba bzang po brgyud nas thob ste/ gsang 'dus las/ rtag tu 'dod pa'i yon tan lngas/ /sangs rgyas tshul bzhin mchod par bya/ /mchod pa rnam pa lnga rnams kyis/ /sangs rgyas myur du thob par 'gyur/ /gsungs/ 'di med na bde ba gang yang thob mi srid/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ bde ba thams cad tshogs bsags pa las byung ba yin/ tshogs gsog rgyu ma mchis na bde ba la spyod rgyu zhig kyang ma mchis/ dper na sa bon ma btab par ston thog 'byung rgyu med pa dang 'dra'o/ /thabs la mkhas mi mkhas ni dper na bu chung bsam med des me yis 'tshig pa'i thabs mi shes pas me kha nas 'jog mi rung ste/ bzhag na mes 'tshig par 'gyur la/ a mas me yis mi 'tshig pa'i thabs shes pas mes mi 'tshig par ma zad me la brten nas bza' btung thams cad dron po byas na rang gzhan la phan par 'gyur ro/ /dpe de bzhin du gang zag las dang po 458

pas skyon gyis mi gos pa'i mdo sngags tshos kyi thabs mi shes pas 'dod yon bsten na las nyon gyis phung bar 'gyur la/gang zag dbang po yang rab rnams kyis mdo sngags kyi lam khyer shes pas/ 'dod yon la spyad kyang skyon gyis mi gos par ma zad de la brten nas rang gzhan la phan thogs par 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang 'dod yon lnga'i longs spyod yod na deng sang bla ma rnams kyang ma bos kyang lo re bzhin rgyug cing / med na phyogs der mi 'byon/ de yang 'dod po/na gyi yon tan yin/sngon grwa rkyang zhig yod pa dgon pa'i bla ma grwa ba gzhan gyis kho la rgyu noms dang yon tan med tshe brnya 4 smod byung tshe/ kho rang rgya nag tu song nas dngul dang gos da ja sogs noms pa mang po khyer 'ong tshe sngar gye bla ma grwa pa brnyab/ smod byed pa tshos kyang stan mthon por bzhag zas zhim po drangs mchod bstod bkur tshe/ dngul rdo tshad cig yod pa mgo tho ga tu bzhag dngul rin po che 'di yod na 'di 'dra 'byung ba ya mtshan/ thugs rje can thugs dam skyabs 'og nas nam yang ma 'dor zhes ku re kha rgyags smras pa ltar/ bla ma rnams la ji 5nga rgyu noms pa yod na yon tan med kyang kun gyis bkur/ noms pa med na bla ma sangs rgyas dngos yin rung kun gyis ba rnyas bcos byed pa 459

mang / des na 'dod yon longs spyod 'di kun la dgos shing khyad par thabs mkhas bsdu bzhis 'gro don mdzad pa'i bla chen bla chung dang / bskyed rdzogs nyams su len pa'i rnal 'byor pa'i mthun rkyen du 'dod yon longs spyod med thabs med par bsten dgos zhes rgyud sde rnams las gsungs la/ mdo las kyang 'bad rtsol med par byung chags zhen med na dge slong gis kyang gser srang brgya'i rin gyi zas dang / stong gi rin gyi gos kyang gyon chog par gsungs pa'ang yod skad/ 'dod yon longs spyod rgyal ba rnams kyis spyod mi rung zhes ma bkag par ma zad/ longs spyod rgyas pa'i thabs mdo rgyud bstan bcos na mtha' yas pa gsungs snang / 'dod gsol byed na yang /longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing / /zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi/ /las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /zhes pa lta bu grangs mang / 'dod yon lnga ngan na de 'dra zhig shog zer dogs med/'on kyang mdo rgyud dang bla ma dam pa 'ga' res/ 'dod yon la nyes dmigs che spongs dgos zhes gsungs pa'i dgongs gzhi ni/ 'dod sred chags zhen skyes/ 'dod yon gyi phyir sdig pa mi dge ba byas 'jog gi dgongs nas de skad gsungs pa yin/ 'dod yon la ha cang chags zhen med 'dod yon phyir 460

sdig pa ma byas na/ 'dod yon la spyad nga/ tsam gyis ngan song du ltung bar mi 'gyur/ 'dod yon la spyad pas ltung zer na/ de yin na zas kham gang mi za ba gcig meng) / thams cad ltung dgos par gyur pas de mi 'grigs/ 'dod yon lnga'i nang nas lto gos 'di la chos pa 'jig rten pa thams cad brten dgos/'di la brten nas bya ba gang byed kyang spo/nga / bde ba gang yang thob/ lto gos 'di yon tan thams cad bskyed pa'i gzhi ma yin/chos sgrub par mthun rkyen zas gos bzang po yod na chos yong /lto gos bzang po ma mchis kyang lus sems bde bar gnas pa'i lto gos shig ci nas kyang dgos/ gos dro lto mod na dge sbyor gang 'dod yong /sangs rgyas kyi gsu/nga rab na/ zas mchis na srog mchis/ srog ca/chis na chos kyang mchis gsungs pa mang /sngon rje mi las dka' ba spyod dus/ khyi nga ba 'ga' res sha dang phye'i lhag ma phul ba sha tshod mdzad nas sa sol bas/ sku lus 'bol shigs kyis btang bas bsgom sheng) cher song / lus bde sems gsal du song bas dge sbyor bzangari po 'phel ba byung gsungs/ lto gos med par chos phar (nog 'jig rten kyang mi 'ong ba mthong thos myong bas grub/ gob/ med par zhag gcig lto med par zhag gnyis tsam la sdod dgos byung na dge sbyor 461

byed mi nus par ma zad rang ka nyal nas kyang sdod mi nus na/zhag mang por sdod mi nus pa smos ci dgos/ des na chos pa rnams kyis chos bsgrubs pa'i mthun rkyen dang sems can rnams la bde skyid 'byung ba'i ched du dmigs nas/ rgyal blon khyim pa rnams kyis gsog 'jog dang zhing las so nam la rems pa gal che/ bla ma chos pa thams cad kyis char chu dus su 'bebs shing lo phyugs rtag tu legs pa'i thabs rgyal ba rnams kyis gsungs la 'bad dgos/ ri che na skyibs dro zer ba ltar kun gyis longs spyod rgyas pa'i thabs la 'bad na phyug po mang po yong / phyug po mang po yod na bla ma rnams la 'bul ba/ chos pa bya btang ri khrod pa la mthun rkyen zas gos/ dgon pa rnams la 'gyed phog dbul bo rnams la lto gos 'byung snyam nas/ rang la med rung thams cad kyi sems dro/ yod sna phan med sna gnod zer ba yin pas/ phyug po ser sna che rung dbul bor ngang ngam shugs kyis phan/ gal te ma phan rung gnod mi srid/ dbul bo mang na mug sna de yod med gnyis shar gnod/phyug po ser sna che rung shi dus rgyu noms pa gang yod tshe phyi mar khur mi 'gro thams cad bzhag yong / shul na yod pas chos phyogs su btang na yar mar gyi mchog dman yongs la phan 462

yong / gal te phyug pos ser sna can gyi nor dgra 'dre la shor yang de rnams la phan thogs yong / khang ba me shor yang gsur dris bar snang gi dri za bye ba dung phyur gyi lus sems tshim yong /mi ltogs kyi khang ba tshig pa dang mi 'dra dbul bo'i khang ba me la shor na gzhob dris nam mkha'i lha yan chad brgyal 'gro/ rang gi pho lha tshun chad bros 'gro/ phyug po shi na ro yang dur khrod du bskyal na bya khyi ltogs pa'i lus sems tshims pas lus kyi sbyin pa'i mchog tu 'gyur/ dbul bo shi ba/re ro yang bya khyi la 'cha' rgyu med/ rgyu noms pa ser sna byas bsags na phyug po yong /phyug por yong na 'jig rten 'di'i skying longs pa phar zhogamachod sbyin byas na phyi ma'i bde skyid kyang tshe 'dir 'grub yong /de rnams la dgongs nas 'brug pa kun legs kyis/ 'ga' rer sbyin pa ma gtong ser sna gyis rgyu no mas bsags dgos zhes chos gsungs tshe/ tshe dbang 'dzom zer bas/ bla ma gzhan tshos phyug por sbyin pa thongs gsungs pa khyed kyis ma gtong gsungs pa ci yin zhus pa'i lan du/ byu sprir gyi mi thams cad la gyis zhes na mi byed/ ma byed byas na byed pa ka mang / khyad par phyug po'i mdun du sbyin pa thongs smras na sngon bsod nams bsags pas da lta phyug po byung ba ni/ kho la mngon shes 463

med/ kho rang la dbang yod dus btang na phan bsam rung de mi go bar thongs zer mkhan la e ster na snyam pa'i go ba log pa skye srid pas/ phyug por sbyin pa ma gtong byas pa yin/ yang yul na phyug po yod pa rang gis kyang blo dro/ deng sang phyug po'i khang ba la me shor na'ang / gsur gyis yi dwags rnams kyang tshim mi ltogs kyi khang ba tshig pa dang mi 'dra/ mi ltogs kyi khang ba tshig na gzhob kyis pho lha tshun bros pa cig 'ongs/ des na 'gro mgon gtsang ba'i tshogs chos mno 'khor na/ bre re phul re nas gsog nus na/ phyug po'i rten 'brel de yis 'grigs/gsungs pa yod/ gnod sbyin nor lha tsho yang mi ser sna can la nor bcol po byed zer ba'ang 'dug gsungs/ chos thams cad rten cing 'brel 'byung yin pas/ 'jig rten longs spyod la brten nas chos 'byung / chos bsgrub pa la brten nas 'jig rten longs spyod rgyas pa 'byung / chos dang 'jig rten gnyis mi 'gal ba tsam du ma zad gcig grogs su gcig 'gro/ 'o na bla ma mang pos tsha grang ltar 'gal zer ba de ci yin zer na/ de gang zag phal cher gyis dang po longs spyod sdig pa byas nas bsags/ bar du longs spyod gang yod chags shing zhen/mthar bla ma dkon mchog la mchod pa dbul bo la sbyinapa 464

sogs gtong mi nus/ ser sna cher tho /nga / lag pa je dam du song/ zas nor gyi steng nas chag sa sdang sogs nyon mongs langs/ chos dang mi mthun pa'i las ཿrdon pa bsags na 'gal zhes gsungs pa yin gyis/ de ma yin par zas nor gsogs dus sdig dang ma 'dres par bsags/ bar du longs spyod la chags zhen med/ mthar bla ma dkon mchog la mchod pa/dbul bo nyam thag la sbyin pa/ rang gib / chos bsgrub pa'i mthun rkyen byas chos mthun gyi bya ba byas na 'gal zhes gsungs pa'i tshig tu 'khrul bar mi bya'o/ /de lta bu'i gang zag de chos dang ma 'gal bar ma zad 'jig rten gyi skye bo dang yang ma 'gal/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ zas nor chos phyir blos/ btang ba yin pas/tshe blos btang gi ming thob/ chos byas pa yin pas chos dang mthun/ 'phral du zas nor gsog 'jo ga byas/ khyim pa pho mo ltar byas pa yin pas 'jig rten skye bo kun dang mthun/ de ltar byas na chos dang 'jig rten gnyis byas kyang mi 'gal ba'i rtags su/ bla ma skyes bu dam pa du mas lugs gnyis zung 'brel gyi bslab bya mang po gsungs pa da nga / sngon gyi skyes bu dam pa da lta'i bla chen rnams kyis lugs gnyis gcig grogs su gcig khyer nas kun mthun chos mthu na gnyis po byung ngo / /465

zhes gsungs pa yin/ 'gal na de ltar gsungs par mi 'gyur/de yin rung 'gal zer na/ de yin na deng sang chos dang mthun pa zhig btsal kyang rnyed dka' bar 'gyur/ de yin na log rtog gi khur gyis non nas kun la sgro skur 'debs dgos pas de mi rung / ngas bshad pa de ltar legs par go na chos dang mthun pa mang po yod par mthong nas dad gus dag snang rtsol med du byung bas shin tu legs/ 'dod yon gyi bde ba la longs spyod bzhin dka' ba med par bde ba nas bde bar bsgrod pa gsang sngags kyi khyad chos yin te/ 'dus pa'i rtsa rgyud las/ 'dod pa'i longs spyod thams cad la/ /ji ltar 'dod par bsten na ni/ /de lta bu yi sbyor ba yis/ /sangs rgyas myur du 'thob par 'gyur/ /'dod pa'i longs spyod thams cad ni/ /ji ltar 'dod pa bsten bya ste/ /rang gi lha yi sbyor ba yis/ / bdag dang gzhan la mchod par bya/ /slong mo za zhing mi bzla ste/ /slong la'ang dga' bar mi bya'o/ /'dod pa kun la longs spyod cing / /sngags kyi yan lag ma nyams bzlas/ /zhes dang /ma hā ma ya las/ bde bas bsgrub pa zhes bya ba/ /bde bas 'khor ba gcod par byed/ /ces gsungs/ de ltar rgyud dang bstan bcos du ma nas bsngags brjod mdzad pa mang / 'dod 466

yon mi spong bar de la brten nas gsang sngags nyams su len dgos pa'i rtags su gnas skabs su lus sems bde ba'i thun mong gi dngos grub bsgrub pa'i sgo mthar yas/ zhi rgyas dbang drag sogs sems can la gnas skabab/ su phan pa'i thabs mchog gsang sngags na yod yod cig mdo sde na med/ thun mong gi dngos grub la brten nas sngags kyi rnal 'byor pa rang gcig pu bde ba tsam du ma zad/ de'e 'khor du gtogs tshad yul khams de bde yong / bde ba'i ngos nas gsang sngags kyi lam nyams su blangs na rab tshe gcig lus gcig la sangs rgya/'bring bar dor longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku ru sangs rgya/ tha ma rnams kyang ma 'ongs pa'i dus skye ba bzang po sha stag blangs skye ba bdun nam bcu drug tshun la sangs rgya ba rdo rje 'chang dpal kun tu bzang pos gsungs/ des na tshe 'di skyid phyi skyid kyi chos zab mo gsang sngags kho na yin/ 'di 'dra sngar ma byung phyin chad 'byung dka'/ da lta yang skyes bu bsod nams can skal ldan las 'phro can ma gtogs mjal dka' gsungs/'di la bltas na rgyu pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pas rkang lag sogs chos phyir gtong dgos/ rang bde gzhan la byen/gzhan sdug tshur len dgos/ 'dod yo na longs spyod kyang spong 467

ci nus bya dgos/ de ltar byas na yang rab bskal pa grangs med gsum/ 'bring gis drug tha mas dgu la sogs bsgugs nas sangs rgya dgos/sngags lam la bltas na mdo lam mi bde lam yun ring ba yin zhes skyes bu dam pa du mas gsungs/sems can la dmigs pa'i skyes bu snying rje chen po can rnams kyis rgyu pha rol tu phyin pa'i ring lam de kho na la mi zhen par sngags kyi sgor 'jug dgos/ gsungs/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/byang chub sems dpa' de'i ngos nas sems can re re'i phyir dmyal bar bskal mang sdod pa byung na bzod kyang / sems can rnams kyis sdug bsngal bzod med myong ba'i ngos nas sangs rgya ba zhig de ring nangs par gnyis kyi de ring rgyas thabs shig yod na bya dgos/ sangs rgyas na 'od zer re re tsam spros pas kyang sems can mang po smin grol gyi lam la 'god nus pa'i phyir ro/ /sngags kyi rnal 'byor pas zas kyang bcud can gyi rigs gang bzang thams cad bsten dgos/ khyad par sha chang bza' ba tshogs kyi 'khor lo dang / rig ma bsten pa sngags kyi phyag rgya yin pas/ 'di gsum dus rgyun du bsten dgos/bza' btung bzang po ma bsten na lus stobs mi rgyas/ lus stobs ma rgyas na bde ba med/ bde ba med na bde stong du sbyor 468

rgyu med/ de med na bde stong phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub mi 'thob/ bza' btung longs spyod la ci bder longs spyod dgos/ zhes sngags gzhung du ma nas gsungs pas de ltar ma bsten na/ dam tshig rdzas ni ji bzhin nyid/ /mi bsten pa ni bcu gsum pa/ /gsungs pas rtsa ltung bcu gsum pa de 'phogasha zos chang 'thung na 'jig rten pas kyang lus stobs rgyas nas bud med la spyad nas bde ba myong / sngags kyi rnal 'byor pa'i thig le rgyas tshe phyag rgya ma la brten nas bde stong phyag rgya chen po la mnga' brnyes/ 'dod yon lnga/ bo 'dis dang bo chos la 'jug pa'i rgyu byed/ bar du chos sgrub pa'i grogs byed/mthar thug sku gnyis kyi go 'phang thob pa'i rkyen byed/ thabs mkhas bsdu bzhi'i sgo nas gzhan don ya rdo rgya chen 'byung bar byed do/ /des na chos pa 'jig rten nga/ rnams kyi su yin kyang thog mar btsal ba'i dus su yang sdig da nga ma 'dres pa byas btsal/ bar du bsten pa'i dus su chags sdang sogs nyon mongs pa'i dbang du ma shor ba byas bste /na/ tha ma bsten pa'i rjes su yang las ngan 'dra ma bsags pa re lugs gnyis kyi blang dor tshul bzhin byas na legs/ khya ) par gsang sngags kyi rnal 'byor pa'i mkho ba'i yo byad bsten 4'i dam rdzas ni/469

mkhas grub rjes mdzad pa'i rnal 'byor rol pa'i dga' ston dang / 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas rdo rjes mdzad pa'i longs spyod dam tshig bde ba'i dpal sbyin sogs nas bshad pa ltar bsten pa gal che/ 'dod yon lnga'i nang nas lto gos bud med gsum po 'di thabs mkhas kyis spyod shes na/ bde skyid kyi 'byung gnas yin te/ de yi rgyu mtshan gang yin zhe na/ de yang 'di rgya nag dang bod kyi bsod nams kyi dpal las 'khrungs pa yin te/ 'brug pa'i ja mchod las/ phun tshogs bsod nams stobs las grub pa'i bcud/ /rgya ja dri bzang mdog mdzes ro brgya ba/ /gsungs/ des na rgya gar sogs phyogs gzhan na med pa'i khyad chos/ gangs can bod kyi skye bo pho mo yongs kyi btung ba mchog ja 'di yin/ ja 'di mi 'thung ba'i mi gcig med/ mtho ba rgyal blon nas dma' ba sprang slong yan gyis 'thung / ja 'thung na chu 'thung ba dang mi 'dra/ skom pas gdungs pa sel/ lus dang rtsa khams thams cad dros/ bde drod 'bar ba lta bu'i nyams skye/ lus la gzi mdangs rgyas/rig pa gsal/ smra lce bde/ gnyid chung / mgo na bas 'thung na mgo nad sel/ ja 'di gcig pu la 'dod yon lnga tshang /dbang po sgo lnga tshim/ kha dog mjes pas mig tshim/ phyar na sgra 470

snyan pas rna ba tshim/ snum na dri zhim nga/sa sna tshim/ 'thung na ro mngar bas lce tshim/ reg na reg bya rajam pas lus tshim nas dbang bo sgo lnga la bde ba tshad med bskye da/ de'i mthus nang sems la dga' bde'i nyi ma 'char/ ja 'di la brten nas khyem pa rnams kyis so nam 'ongs/ mtshan nyid pa la slob gnyer yong / thugs dam pa rnams la thugs dam 'phel/ bla ma rnams la 'gro don yong / ja 'di la yon tan brgya phrag mang po mnga'/ des na ro brgya'i bcud ldan sbyo1 ja'i btung ba dang / /zhes pa dang / phun tshogs dri ngad ldan pa'i ja dkar phud/ /sogs kyis ja 'di bstod nas bla ma lha 1dang mkha' 'gro chos skyong gzhi bdag la phud mchod pa yin/ ja 'di ngan na lha la mi 'bul/ lha la phul ba de bzang ba'i rta gas yin/ mnyam med jo bo rin po che yang bod la byon dus ja drangs pa bzhes nas/'di 'thung na rig pa dwangs pa smra lce ba / ba phung bo yang ba sogs yon tan mang po snang zhes slar rgya gar du skyes su yang lan mang bskur skad/ ja 'di chu ngan kun kyang bdud rtsir bsgyur ba'i rtsi yin pas/ lha'i bdud rtsi dang mtshungs/ ja 'di bas btung ba zhig rgya bod hor sogs gang na yang med/ ja 'di la yon tan mang po ldan pas rin du gser dngul gos 471

dar rta mdzo sogs nor rdzas rngam can rnams byen nas nyos pa yin/ yon tan med —na nor de lta bu byen nas mi nyo/ de yang ja 'di bzang ba'i rtags yin/ ja 'di shing gi lo ma yin pas sdig pa yang spu tsam med/ 'o na ja btus nas btsongs mkhan gyis srin 'bu mang po gcur/ ja 'tshong mkhan gyi drel rta mdzo g.yag la bkal nas rgal ba bton/ ngal dub kyis lam nas shi/ ja 'di'i phyir tshong dpon dang g.yog po mi yang mang po zhig shi ba'i nyes pa de rnams kyi che shos ja 'thung pa po rnams la 'byung bas 'thung mi rung nyes pa che zer na/ spyir sangs rgyas kyi gsungs las 'bras kyi dbye ba lam rim sogs na bshad yod tsa na/ sems can gsod bsam pa ni yid la ma shar/ dang po gsod pa'i sbyor ba ma brtsams/ bar du rang ngam gzhan gyis ma bsad/ tha ma bsad tshar song snyam pa'i blo ma skyes par ma shes pa'i dbang gis srin 'bu sogs bsad na nyes pa zhig yod rung srog gcod kyi pham pa mi 'byung bar gsungs/ des na 'e tshos ja btu dgos ma bshad/ ja khyer shog ces bshad pa med/ ja yi phyir yang srin 'bu sod khal rta rgal ba thon mi phyugs mang po 'chi ru 'jug pa'i bsam sbyor sogs gang yang med pas na ja 'thung ba tsam gyis nyes pa phran 472

bu chung ngu re 'byung ba ma gtogs nyer / pa chen po zhig mi 'byung / nyes pa cung zad re yod kyang ja la brten nas chos pa rnams kyis dge sbyor byas pa la brten nas 'brel tshad thams cad la phan pa'i phyir/ bsngo ba smon lam gyis mtshams sbyor byas na nyes pa chung ngu de lta bu re 'dag par ma zad/ 'brel thogs thams cad la 'phral phugs su phan thogs kyang brgya stong 'gyur gyi che ba 'byung bas skyon gyis mi gos/ 'o na 'o skol chos pa rnams la skyon gyis mi gos rung / 'e tsho la brten nas ja 'thung ba dang 'tshong ba bo la sdig pa chen po 'byung bas/'thung mi rung zer na/ ja 'thu ba rnams kyis kyang ja 'thu bsam pa ma gtogs 'bu gsod ma bsams/ gsod pa'i sbyor ba ma brtsams/ 'bu rnams kyang ja 'thu baḍirdo sa na med/ yod kyang bros song na ga la gsod/ rang ka ma mthong ma shes par rkang lag gis srin 'bu re gcur btang yang de'i sha ma zos khrag ma 'thung / des na sdig pa chen po med/ ron kyang nyes pa chung ngu zhig yod pas 'dzem los dgos/ 'dzem kyang ma shes pa'i dbang gis bsad song ba la khong rigab / rnams kyis kyang ja la brten nas tshogs bsags sgrib sbyong ga ri nus byas/ 'o skol chos pa rnams kyis kyang de dag rnams la dmigs nas dge 473

sbyor byas na nyes pa las dge ba stobs che bar gyur nas thams cad la skyon gyis mi gos/ des na khyim pa pho mo rnams kyis kyang ja 'thung bzhin phyag bskor bsnyen gnas smyong gnas yig drug bgrangs ja yis dkon mchog mchod sbyin pa btang dge ba bsgrubs/ chos pa rnams kyis ja 'thung bzhin thos bsam sgom gsum gang la 'bad na nyen pas khe che bas de ltar gyis/ yang mar 'di la yon tan du ma mnga'/ sa yi bcud 'dus pa rtsi shing yin/ rtsi bcud mdzo 'bris bsdus pa 'o ma yin/ 'o ma'i bcud thams cad tshur 'dus nas mar 'di byung ba yin pas mar 'di zas skom gzhan dang mi 'dra/ mar 'di zos na lus stobs rgyas/ sha 'jam sha snum dang ldan/ rgas kha sra/ ltogs skom gyi gdung ba mtha' dag sel/ rlung nad sogs nad du ma la phan/ mar 'di la 'dod yon lnga ka tshang bas dbang po sgo lnga la bde ba bskyed/ sems la dga' ba bskyed/ skye bo pho mo rnams la 'jig rten yong / chos pa rnams la chos yong / des na sman rgyud las/ mar 'dis sems can la phan bde'i las stong phrag cig byed par gsungs/ dkon mchog mchod pa'i mchog kyang mar 'di yin/ mar 'di la brten nas bsod nams chen po 'thob ste/ yon tan bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho 'byung 474

ba'i rgyud las/ nam mkha' gang ba'i sangs rgyas la/ /sna tshogs rin chen spras pa yis/ /stong gsum gang bar phul ba bas/ /bla ma'i ba spu nyag gcig la/ /mar gyi thigs pa gcig byugs pa/ /bsod nams brgya phrag cha ra mi phod/ /gsungs/sngon rgan mo gcig gis sangs rgyas la dmigs nas mar me chung ngu gcig phul bas/ sangs rgyas kyis rgan mo de la khyod ma 'ongs pa nas sangs rgyas mar me'i 'ed ces bya ba zhig tu 'gyur zhes lung bstan thob pa sogs mar 'di'i sgo nas chos byas na phan yon mtha' yas pa mdo rgyud bstan bcos mang po nas gsungs/ 'o na mar 'di'i phyir khyem pa sogs kyis mdzo mo'i rtol lu sogs bsad nas sdig pa cha da med byed pas/mar 'di sdig zas yin/ sdig pa de'i che shos za ba po rnams la 'byung bas/ chos pa rnams kyis chos rnam dag cig byed na mar 'di za mi rung spongs dgos zer na/ spyir 'khor ba'i gnas na sdig dang ma 'dres pa'i zas shig dkon pas/ sdig pa dang cung zad tsam yang ma 'dres pa'i zas shig rnyed dka'/sdig pa cung zad yod gi zhes 'brog pa se/gas kyis mar ma blangs/ chos pa rnams kyis ma zos na/ mi yang mang po rlung gis 'chi zhing chos pa rnams la yang thos bsam sgom gsum 475

sogs gang yang mi yong / bla ma dkon mchog gsum sogs mchod nas bsod nams kyang gsog rgyu med par 'gyur bas nyes pa da dung de che/ de bas 'brog pa rnams kyis mdzo mo'i bu sogs ma bsad par ci nus kyis sdig pa la 'dzem bzhin 'o ma bzhos mar blangs mar la brten nas yar bla ma dkon mchog la mchod pa mar dbul bo la sbyin pa/ bar dge 'dun mang po la bsnyen bkur byas na ma shes bzhin du srin 'bu bsad pa sogs kyi sdig pa las dge stobs che bar gyur nas nyen chung la khe che bar 'byung / chos pa rnams kyis mar spangs pa bas mar bsten na sbyin bdag mdzo 'bri srin 'bu sogs mar la brten nas bzang ngan 'brel thogs rnams phan phyir dge sbyor byas na nyes pa bas phan yon che bar 'gyur/ des na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang / khyim pa rnams la sdig pa 'dzem dge ba sgrubs gsungs pa ma gtogs/ mdzo 'bri ma bzho mar ma len zhes ma gsungs/ dge slong sogs chos pa rnams la zas dkar gsum mngar gsum bsten gsungs pa ma gtogs/ 'di yang spongs la mug sdug myong ma gsungs/ des na khyim pa pho mo rnams kyis kyang mdzo 'bri'i bu ma gsod par 'o ma bzhes mar longs/ de la brten nas chos gyis/ rang gis kyang zo phyag 476

bskor kha ton sogs gyis/ chos pa rnams kyis mar bsten la chos bzhin 'dul ba bzhin dge sbyor rnam dag gyis dang mar zos pa'i nyes pa sogs kyi skyon gyis mi gos/ sdig dang cung zad ma 'dres pa'i zas shig 'khor ba na dkon pas/ chos pa 'jig rten pa su yin rung chos mi bya bar rang gar bag med du mar sogs zas gang la spyad kyang nyes pa med par mi 'gyur ba'i ha de go nas longs spyod shes byed pa gal che/ yang rtsam pa 'di kha dog mdzes sgra yang bsgrags na snya na/ dri zhim ro mngar reg bya 'jam pas 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga tshang / mi rnams kyi dbang po sgo lnga mnyes par byed pa'i zas kyi mchog 'di yin te/sman gyi rgyud las/ zas kyi mchog gyur nas rnying rtsam pa ste/ /gsungs/ zas 'di la brten nas phung khams rgyas pas bzang ste/ rje mi las/ rnyed dka' 'jig sla'i lus po 'di/ /zas dang 'phrad pas sku khams bzang / /gsung sa/ zas 'di chos pa 'jig rten pa su la yang med du mi rung ste/ spyan snga bas/ med du mi rung rtsam pa kho na ste/ /gsungs/ de thugs bden rtsam pa med na mi kun 'chi yang 'dis thams cad kyi srog bzung yod pa tsam du ma zad lus srog yar yar bskyed pas/ sman dkar bo gcig thub yin te/ sman pa zhig pa dkar bo gcig thub 477

gang yin dris tshe rtsam pa thun gcig bskur nas 'di yin zer skad/ des na rgad po 'ga' res/ mgo nag mi 'chi gos sman rtsam pa drin can po zer/ rgya rnams kyis za ma rin po che zer yar stegs su bzhag mar sa la lhung na mgo thog tu bzhag nas drin can po 'di dang mi 'bral bar shog ces smon lam 'debs/ rtsam pa 'dis mi rnams kyi bkres pa'i gdung ba bsal lus zungs bskyed/ lus la bde ba sems la dga' ba dpag tu med pa bskyed/ 'di'i steng nas chos 'jig rten gyi bde skyid snyan gsum gang yang thob pas/ 'di bde ba thams cad ster ba'i yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang 'dra/ 'di mi rnams kyi bsod nams kyi mthu dang / sangs rgyas rnams kyi rnam 'phrul las byung ba zhig yin zhing / khyad par 'phags pa thugs rje chen po'i byen rlabs las byung ba'i zas yin pas zas 'di mi 'phrod pa'i mi gcig med / mi za ba yang med/ rtsam pa 'di zos nas ma 'phrod gnod nas shi song zer ba gcig med/ 'di la chos pa 'jig rten pa thams cad brten dgos/ 'o na 'di'i phyir sa yi srin 'bu bgrang gis mi langs pa 'chi bas phan yon bas nyes pa che bas bsten mi rung zer na/ srin 'bu kha shas shi 'gro yang nyes pa med pa ma yin te/ de bas rtsam pa 'dis mi 478

bye ba ther 'bum gyi srog ba zung yod pab 4/ mi gcig gi srog bzung kyang srin 'bu khri tsho gnyis dang sngong tsho gcig gi srog bzung ba tsam gyi phan yon yod pas/ des na khe nyen gang che ba ltos/ khe che ba nyen chung ba de 'dems dgos/ srin 'bu kha shas 'chi ba'i nyes par 'jigs nas khyem pas zhing 'debs pa bzhag chos pa 'jig rten pa rnams kyis rtsam pa spangs nas chos byas na thar pa dang thams cad mkhye/na pa'i go 'phang mi 'thob pa phar zhog thams cad mu ger / shi yong / mu ges 'chi ru bcug na mi bsad pa'i sdig pa yod nga/ra ma zad sngags kyi rnal 'byor pa yin na lha bsad pa'i nyes pa 'byung bas sdig pa de che/ ltogs na mu ges 'chi ru 'jug sus kyang mi thub/ lto 'di'i phyir srin 'bu mi tshad ltogs na me rnams kyis phan tshun gsod re byas sha khrag za zhing 'thung nges // de bas zhing steng gi srin 'bu kha shas shi yang khyim pa rnams kyis zhing btab rtsam pa'i steng nas chos byas/ chos pa rna mas kyis zas phul ba'i sbyin bdag srin 'bu shi ba sogs la dmi gas nas dge sbyor rnam dag byas na srin 'bu shi ba sogs 'a/ phan yong / srin 'bu phal cher mi yis ma bsad rung zhag re'i tshe min med pa mang /phal che ba bya dang bye'u chung gis za/ nyi mas bsregs ston 479

mjug dgun kha thams cad shi 'gro/ de ltar shi ba la dgos pa med de/ de bas mi chos byed mkhan rnams kyi mthun rkyen gyi ched du shi na 'brel tshad don ldan gyi skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis 'dren pas dgos pa che/ yang rtsam pa 'di'i phyir khyim pa pho mo rnams kyis srin 'bu sogs bsad nas sdig pa mang po byas rung / 'o skol rab byung bsnyen rdzogs pa sogs chos pa dgon dang ri khrod nas sdod pa sogs zas za mkhan la zas zos pa tsam gyi nyes pa ma gtogs nyes pa chen pa mi 'byung ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ srin 'bu gsod dgos pa snyam pa yid la ma shar/sod ces kha nas ma bshad/ bsam sbyor gang yang med na nyes pa chen po zhig 'byung ba rgyal ba sras bcas kyis ma gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /cung zad yod pa chos byas pa'i mthu las byang zhing dag par 'gyur bas skyon gyis mi gos/ khyim pa pho mo rnams kyis kyang bsam bzhin du bsad pa min pas nyes pa chung / dge ba byas na sdig pa bas dge ba stobs che bar song nas skyon med/ des na sangs rgyas kyis zhing ma 'debs btab na sdig pa che zhes sngar ma gsungs da yang mi gsungs/ rgyal ba rnams kyis lo legs pa'i thabs sna tshogs gsungs/ sngon sangs rgyas kyis kyang bsod snyoms byas zas kyi bya ba mdzad/480

gzhan rjes 'jug yongs la zas bsod snyoms la brten gsungs pa ma gtogs/ zas nyes dmigs che bas khong gi rjes 'jug rnams kyis rang ltogs grir 'chi ru chug ma gsungs/zas 'di spong dgos gsungs pa yang zas la yon tan du bltas nas bag med du mi spyod pa dang / gsog 'jog cher mi mdzad pa zas kyi phyir sdig pa'i las mi byed par dgongs nas de skad gsungs pa yin gyis/ gtan nas ma za spong zhes pa'i tshig tu 'khrul bar mi bya'o/ /zas spangs nas chos shig 'ongs pa sangs rgyas kyis ma gsungs/ deb/ na khyem pa pho mo rnams kyis kyang yul khams kyi mi thams cad tshe ring nad med par bde zhing / chos mdzad skyes bu rnams la chos kyi mthun rkyen sgrub pa'i ched du dmigs nas zhing las la 'bad/ chos mdzad rnams kyis yul phyogs kun tu lo legs 'byung ba'i phyir sku rim yang bya dgos/ bsam pa bzang na ci byas chos su 'gro zer ba yin pas/ chos pa sku rim grong tsho ga kho na byed mkhan la yang yag po red snyam dag snang sbyongs dgos/ mthun rkyen zas gos 'dzom par bsags nas za bzhin du lo tog phyir srin 'bu shi ༷la rta rgal ba bton pa sogs/ kyis gtso byas sems can thams cad gnas skabs su bde zhing / mthar thug sangs 481

rgyas phyir mi lus thob tshad kyis chos byas na sdig pa bas phan yon che ba 'byung / de ltar ma yin par khyim pa rnams kyis zhing btab nas rang gis zos nas gzhan chos phyogs su ma gtong chos pa rnams kyis sbyin bdag gis gang phul zos nas dge sbyor ma byas na dug zos zos nas sman ma 'thung ba ltar sdig dang 'dres pa'i zas zos nas/ sdig pa 'joms pa'i dge ba ma byas pa yin pas/ nad zug ldang ba ltar tshe 'di phyir sdug bsngal 'byung nges pas go bar gyis/ yang sha 'di rtsam pa bas lhag gi nus pa yod/ mi rnams kyi lus stobs rgyas pas zas kyi mchog 'di yin/ nad pa zungs zad sang 'chi gnang 'chi ba yang sha bzang po zhig gis srog 'chad pa mthud nus/ des na sangs rgyas kyis dge slong rlung shas che ba rnams la tshong 'dus kyi sha zo zhes gnang ba byin yod/ nyan thos rnam gsum dag pa'i sha /za bar rung gis mi za na/ /lhas sbyin gyi ni brtul zhugs 'gyur/ /gsungs/ rnam gsum dag pa'i sha zos na chog pa mdo rgyud bstan bcos kyi dgongs pa yin te/ mkhas grub rjes/ 'dod sred chen pos bsten na ma gtogs/ rnam gsum dag pa'i sha ni dge slong rnams kyis bzhes chog tshul ni sdom gsum rnam bshad nas shin tu rgyas par gsungs pa dang / rje 482

sangs rgyas rdo rjes/ gsang sngags kyi rnal 'byor pas sha zos chog tshul lung rigs kyis bsgrubs nas longs spyod dam tshig las gsungs pa dang / gsang 'dus 'a/sa kyang / glang bo'i sha dang rta yi sha /de bzhin dam pa khye yi/ sha /zas kyi phyir du bza' bar bya/ /zhes dang / sangs rgyas thod pa'i rgyud las/ sha dang chang la ma brten par/ /gsang sngags 'grub par mi 'gyur te/ /sa dang brlan la ma brten par/ /myu gu skye bar mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang / he ru ka rtsa ba'i rgyud pas/ rdo rje lha mo pyos byed sha rnams kyis/ /skye bo gus pas rab tu mchog byed na/ /he ru ka dpal mngon dgar gyur pa yin / /gang phyir de rnams lag na mchog gi gnas/ /mgu ba'i thugs kyis myur du stsol bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs/ sngon rgya gar gyi grub thob phal che bas dur khrod du phebs nas/ baṃ ro bshas nas tshogs 'khor bskor te sha chen bzhes pa dang / bong) kyi grub thob gling chen ras pa dang / gtsang spyon bas bud med kyi ro'i thod pa bkog nas klad pa zho ltar 'thung ba dang / shāgyib thob thang stong rgyal pos rta shi ba'i glo ba rnag gis zin yod nga/ rnag dang bcas te bzhes pa sogs de 'dra'i lo rgyus brgya dgos na stong yod/ des na rwa los/ rig ma brten pa las kyi phyag rgya yin/ /sha chang 483

bza' ba tshogs kyi 'khor lo yin/ /dam nyams sgrol ba drag po'i brtul zhugs yin/ /gsungs pa ltar sngags kyi rnal 'byor ba sha chang bza' ba tshogs kyi 'khor lo yin pas lam gyi grogs su 'gyur te/ rje mi las sgrub pa mdzad dus khye ra ba 'ga' zhig gis sha phul bas dge sbyor shed cher song nyams rtogs khyad par can skyes gsungs/ yang sring mo dang mdzes se gnyis kyis sha chang sogs 'tsho ba khyer 'ong ba bzhes pas/ dbu ma'i rtsa mdud grol ba'i grogs su gyur nam mkha' la 'phur nus pa byung bar gda'/ gzhan yang sha zos na lus stobs rgyas nas thig le 'phel ba'i bde ba che/ bde ba che na stong ba nges/ bde stong gnyis sbyor nus na phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob/ shes na sha 'di sngags kyi dam rdzas kun gyi mchog gcig yin/ 'o na dus 'khor na za ba po dang / gsod pa po gnyis kyi za ba po nyes pa che zhes bshad 'dug zer ba de bden na/gsod mkhan bshan pa dang za mkhan bla ma dge slong rnams kyi za ba po bla ma dge slong la nyes pa chen po 'ong zer na/ de la sems can gsod pa'i bsam pa dang / sbyor ba dngos gzhi mthar thug gsum mam gang rung zhig tshang na nyes pa che ba yin gyi/ de rnams kyi gang yang mi ldan na sha zos pa'i nyes pa tsam 484

zhig 'byung ba ma gtogs sdig pa'i che shos mi 'byung / de ltar ma shes na ja mar rtsam pa sha thud sogs zas gang yin rung 'bul ba po sbyin bdag dang za ba po chos pa gnyis kyi chos pa la nyes pa chen po 'phog zer dgos/ de yin na sbyin bdag gis zas nor phul ba yang chos kyi mthun rkyen phul ba ma yin par sdig pa chen po zhig phul ba yin ze da dgos/ de yin na sbyin bdag la phan yon 'byung mi dgos nyes pa chen po 'byung bar 'gyur/ de yin na chos pa rnams la sangs rgyas kyis zas dkar gsum mngar gsum/ rnam gsum dag pa'i sha sogs bsten rung gsungs pa yang mi rung bar 'gyur/ de yin na chos rnam dag cig byed na mu ges 'chi ru 'a jug dgos/ de yin na chos lugs de nang ba ma yin par phyi ro'/ pa kha cig gi lag len ma nor ba yin pas khams che/ mu ges 'chi ru bcug na mdo ltar na mi bsad pa'i nyes pa 'byung / sngags ltar na de tsam du ma zad yi dam gyi lha bsad pa'i /)sa pa 'byung bar bshad/ de'i rnam smin gyis shi ma thag das ngan song gsum du song nas tsha grang bkres skom sogs kyi sdu ga bsngal myong bar 'gyur/ de ni chos la brten nas rang ngan song du ltung ba'i rgyu bsam bzhin bsgrubs pa yin pas gzhan ma sems/ 'o skol 485
