nang ba'i chos 'di sems can thams cad gnas skabs su lha mi'i bde ba myong bas bde zhing / mthar thug sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob nas gtan du bde ba'i thabs sha stag yin pas/chos byed na 'di sdug phyi mar sdug pa zhig byed dgos par ma gsungs/ khyad par gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i chos 'di lam bde ba nas bde bar bsgrod pa'i chos pas dka' spyad sogs sdug bsngal myong dgos pa zhig gtan nas ma gsungs/ sha sogs 'dod yon la spyad pa'i nyes pa rnams mdo sngags kyi chos nyams su blangs rung de'i mthu las byang zhing dag nges/chos gzhan phar zhog ma ṇi dang ltung bshags tshar gcig bton pa'i phan yon sogs la ltos dang ha go yong / des na bla ma dge slong sngags kyi rnal 'byor pa sogs chos pa rnams la rnam gsum dag pa'i sha ma za zhes pa ma mdzad/ sangs rgyas kyis zo zhes gnang ba byen yod na gzhan gyis dgag don med/ dgag kyang thub dogs med/ sdig dang ma 'dres pa'i sha la kun gyis longs spyod la dam pa'i chos bzhin sdig spong dge sgrub kyi las la 'bad par gyes shig yang chang 'di la yon tan mang / lha yul nas bdud rtsi'i thigs pa zhig lhung ba 'dzam gling skye bo rnams kyi bsod nams las 'bru rnams bcud du chags nas 486

chang gi dwangs mar gyur pa yin/ chang 'di kha dog mjes sgra snyan dri zhim ro mngar reg bya 'jam pas 'dod yon lnga tshang pas phun sum tshogs pa lha'i bdud rtsi da nga 'dra/ mthong na yid dga' bsten nas 'bral mi phod/ ro myang na zhim zhing khong du song na lus sems bde/ 'thung gyen je bder 'gyur/gnyid mi 'ong ba gnyid khug gtam med pa gtam rdol/ glu mi shes par glu 'byung / skyags shor rnams la snying stobs 'dzul/ lus kyi 'byung ba cha snyoms/ nad rnams kun la phan/khyad par bad rlung 'du ba sel/ sman rnams nang nas bdud rtsi sman 'di mchog sems sdug ca na gyis 'thung na mya ngan sangs/ mi khom pa las kyis brel yod pas 'thung na brel ba dal du 'jug chang 'di skyid sdug kun la dgos/ mi che chung kun gyes 'thung / don zhig sgrub kyang gleng ba'i gzhir dgos/mdza' bshes 'dus kyang ngo dga'i skyes su dgos/ gnyen 'dun 'tshogs kyang sna len gzhi ru dgos/ grong dang sde dgon dben pa'i ri ngogs man chad na longs spyod kun gyi gzhi mor bsten/ bla ma dge bshes mtshan nyid pas kyang skog tu 'thung /sgyes pa bud med ban bon sngags pa rnar /sa kyis ci yod chang la 'jal/ grub thob rnams kyis kyang nyi ca/ 'dzin pa sogs chang 487

la brten nas grub rtags ston/ gsang sngags zab mo'i sgrub rdzas/ dbang dang byen rlabs chos sgo 'byed thabs/ bskyed rdzogs lam gyi mthun rkyen/ rtsa gsum lha yi mchod pa/ bstan bsrung bsten pa'i rdzas/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i longs spyod kyi mchog kyang chang 'di yin/ 'di yod na dpa' bo mkha' 'gro 'du/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug dgyes/ tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs/ lha yis dgyes bzhin rol/ 'dre rnams zhim pas 'khyer/ sngags kyi rnal 'byor pa rab kyis 'thung na dwangs ma 'phel bas lus bde/ bde drod skyes pas ting 'dzin 'phel/rig ngar thon pas rtogs pa 'char ba sogs brtags shing dpyad na yon tan dpag tu med pa brjod kyis mi lang lha yi bdud rtsi lta bu'i mi yul btung ba'i mchog gyur 'di rang gzhan gyis rol la nyin mtshan rtag tu dga' bde'i dpal la longs spyod ces kun mkhyen klong chen rab 'byams pas chang gi byung rabs dang yon tan la bsngags pa bdud rtsi'i zil mngar ma las gsungs pa 'og nas 'chad par 'gyur ro/ /mkhas pa g.yu thog pa'i gso ba rig pa'i bstan bcos las kyang chang gi yon tan mang po gsungs skad/ gzhan yang o rgyan chen pos pad+ma g.yang 'bum nas chang gi bsngags brjod mang po gsungs/488

bde mchog gi rgyud las kyang / chang med pa la ye shes ci/ /chang ni ye shes skye ba'i rgyu/ /zhes dang / dam tshig bkod pa'i rgyud las/ dngos grub rtsa ba sha chang ste/ /de med par ni dngos grub med/ /tshe 'dir dngos grub rnyed 'dod pas/ /sha dang chang dang ldan par bya/ /zhes dang / sdo/ma 'byung las/ chang gi ston mos dga' byas la/ /rdo rje grus ci dga' bar bya/ /zhes dang / dus 'khor las/ chang dang spron ma sangs rgyas rnams dang bzang po'i yul rnams mtha' dag 'khor lo la ni bsten par bya/ /zhes dang / rnal 'byor dbang phyug birlu bas rgyal khams kyi chang 'thung mdzad pa'i lo rgyus rnams las shes so/ /sngags pa dam tshig can gyis chang 'thung ri ba'i mang nyung gi tshad ni/ brtag gnyis kyi rgyud las/ skyes pa'i thod pa cha gcig pa/ /btung ba bzang pos yongs bkang ste/ /zhes thod pa mtshan ldan dum bu gcig pa zhib/ gi gang tsam 'thung rung bar gsungs/ de byin gyis brlabs nas rathung tshul ni/ sdom 'byung las/ o āḥ tsū zhes bya sngags kyis/ /rtag tu byen gyis brlabs par bya/ /ha ho trīḥ zhes bya sngags kyis/ /sbyangs pa dang ni rtogs pa ste/ /yi ge has ni kha dog 'phrog /ho yis dri ni gzhom par byed/ /yi ge hrīḥ yis nub/ pa bcom/ /bdud 489

rtsi'i rnam pas bsten par bya/ /gsungs/ 'brug pa kun legs kyis/ bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho sngags kyi dam rdzas yin/ /gsungs/des na mdzo mo'i bu bsad 'bri yi bu'i kha 'phrog mug sdug myong gi bcug nas 'o ma 'thung ba bas 'bras chang 'di 'thung ba dga' ste/ kun legs kyis/ lho bas dge bshes chos pa kun/ /'bras chang khag mo mi 'thung bar/ /bu chung nu zho 'phrog nas ci bya ba gsungs/ des na khyim pa rnams kyis kyang chang gi phyir sdig pa ma byas/ chang 'thung nas kyang mi dge ba ma byas na chang 'thung ba gcig pu la nyes pa re yod kyang / chos ldan gyi bya ba gyis dang byang zhing dag nas skyon mi yong / gsang sngags kyi rnal 'byor pa rnams kyis sngags kyi bskyed rdzogs kyi gzhung bzhin bsten na nyes pa'i skyon gyis mi gos pa tsam du ma zad/lam gyi grogs su song nas rtogs pa khyad par can skye bas de lugs gyis/ 'o na mdo na sha chang gnyis rang gis longs spyod pa smos ci dgos/ sbyin par byin yang dmyal ba ngu 'bod du skye gsung ba ci yin zer na/ de chang ni nyes pa bskyed pa'i gzhi yin pas/ chang 'thung na srog gcod sogs mi dge bcu byed kyi dogs nas chu mi 'ongs chu ska rgyangs nas 'then pa yin pas de la dgongs gzhi che/ chang la brten nas sems can gzhan la 490

phan thogs/ chos ldan gyi bya ba mang dze/ 'ong dgos pa che na/chang gi mi tshad dug dang ngan sngags mtshon cha sogs sbyin par btang na yang nyes pa med par gsungs/ sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams skyon 'gog thabs dang yon tan bskyed pa'i thabs sha stag yin pas/ blo gros dang ldan pas yul dus dang bstun nas bsgrubs shes na sangs rgyas kyis ma gnang ba'i sdig pa yang dge bar 'gyur na bsgrub chog 'a/nga gang zag gi blo kha'i che chung ngam yul dus kyi dbang gis sangs rgyas kyis sgrubs gsungs pa'i dge ba yang mi dge bar 8gyur na re zhig 'jog dgos/ mdor na sangs rgyas kyi gsung star bsgrubs na khe gang che nyen gang chung ltos/ khe che ba da ra nyen chung ba de bsgrub dgos/ nyen chung ngu re bltas nas khe chen po 'byung ba de spong mi rung / dper na sangs rgyas kyis sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhing gsungs pas na/ zhing btab na srin 'bu mang po 'chi gi zhes zhing 'debs pa bzhag na 'jig rten pa pa bde skyid mi yong /chos par chos mi 'ong bar kun gyis mug sdug myang nas ltogs grir 'chi ru 'jug dgos pa lta bu'o/ /yang gos 'di spyir mi rnams lus sems bde bar 'tsho ba'i gzhi yin/ sgos su chos mdzad skyes bu rnams kyi chos kyi grogs khyad par can yin/ lto 491

yod kyang gos ngan na pho bar zas dugs nas na zug langs 'chi ba yin kyang gos kyi thugs rjes lto ci tsam zos kyang lus la bde ba sems la dga' ba 'byung / spyir sems can thams cad kyi spyi gos ni nyi ma yin/ nyi mas dros na thams cad bde/ sgos su g.yang mo lug gi bal 'jam las byas pa'i snam bu dang ras ther gos chen sogs mi kun gyi lus 'tsho ba'i gos yin/ dro 'jam yang pas bde/ khyad par lug gu'i tshar bu sogs pags pa'i rigs dro bas dgun gos kyi mchog yin/ rje mi las/ dro 'jam lug gu'i tshar bur yod/ /gyon ma myong la ci cha yod/ /gsungs/ gos bzang po la 'dod yon lnga tshang / kha dog ri mo'i gzugs mdzes/ sprugs na sgra snyan/ sgrums na dri zhim/myang na ro mngar/ reg na reg bya 'jam pas dbang po sgo lnga la bde ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'byung / lus bde ba'i shugs kyis sems dga'/ lus sems dga' bdes 'tshos na chos pa zhig gis chos gang byed 'dod pa rnams yong / gos la brten nas bde skyid snyan gsum thams cad 'byung / 'o na pags pa la sogs pa'i gos 'di la nyes dmigs mtha' yas par gsungs/ 'di sdig pa'i gos yin pas gyon na mi rung bas spangs dgos gsungs pa ci yin zer na/ de gos kyi phyir sdig 492

pa byed kyi dogs nas de skad gsungs nga/ yin/ gos kyi phyir sdig pa ma bsags/ 'bad med du byu nga na gos bzang po gyon kyang nyes dmigs chen po med/ cung zad re yod kyang chos kyi mthus dag nas skyon gyis mi gos/ des na sangs rgyas kyis chos gos rnam gsum gyon ngo tsha khre' yod bsten na ngo tsha 'gogs pa'i thabs gos yin/ gos gyo na na mi rung thams cad gcer bur 'bud dgos na/ bsil ldan ljongs 'di'i mi thams cad dgun zhag gcig gnyis tsaca/ la shi yong / shi ru bcug na phan yon yod ces sangs rgyas kyi gsungs na yod dam bsam mno thongs/ gcer bu byas gsang mtshan yang mi sbed pa de spyon pa yin mod gzhan de 'dwa mdzad mkhan su yod/chos mdzad skyes bu rnams kyis bstan pa'e che ba 'don phyir gos bzang po gyon dgos/ gyon na khyim pa pho mo rnams kyis bstan pa'i sgor zhugs na ka 'dra'i skyid po yong ba red snyam yid smon byas bstan pa'i sgor 'jug pa mang / dad gus dag snang byas mchod bstod bkur nas bsod nams bsags mtho ris dang thar pa'i bde ba thob pa'i dgos pa yod/ chos pa nang na yon tan kun ldan yang phyi cha lugs legs po ma byas ngan ngon chad chod smyon pa 'dra ba byas na khyim pa pho mo rnams 493

mngon shes med pas chos pa bzang po yin pa'i ha ma go'aga' res snying rje zer 'ga' res kha ming sna ming btags/brnyas smod khyad gsod byas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i bla btsongs rkang 'dren skyugs bro bo mar rgyugs sogs smra/ las ngan pa bsags nas chos pa bzang po la brten nas ngan song du lhung ba mang po 'ongs/ des na spyir mi thams cad kyis sdig dang ma 'dres pa'i gos shig gyon rgyu rnyed dka' rung / gos gyon nas chos ldan gyi bya ba byas na gos la brten nas nyes pa las dge ba stobs chen 'byung bas/ gos gyon na chog pas gyon dang bzang / sgos su chos mdzad skyes bu rnams kyis gos dro 'jam mdzes pa gyon bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa dang / bstan 'dzin bla ma skyes bu dam pa rnams kyi dbu 'phang bstod/ dge 'dun gyi sde bskyangs/ bsdu bzhi'i sgo nas gzhan don byas/chos ldan gyi bya ba gang legs byas/ khyad par sngags kyi rnal 'byor pas gos lha la phul ba'i tshul du gyon nas/ rim gnyis kyi nyams len la nyin mtshan med par 'bad na/ tshe gcig lus gcig la sku bzhi ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid rgyal ba khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang thob nas/ gos sogs kyis 'brel ba thogs tshad kyis gtso byas sems can thams cad smin 494

grol gyi lam la 'god nus pas de lugs gyis/ gos gang bzang gyon nas chos ldan gyi bya ba gang yang ma byas/ sngags kyi rnal 'byor pa rnams kyis rim gnyis ma bsgom par rang dgar rnam g.yeng dang / ro nyal byas na gos gyon pa'i nyes pa tsam yang mi kheg par 'khor ba ngan song gi sdug bsngal myong bar 'gyur/ mdor na 'khor ba'i gnas na sdig dang ma 'dres pa'i zas gos shig med pas zas zos gos gyon bzhin du sdig pa mi dge bar 'dzem/ phan yon che ba'i chos gang zab rnams kun gyis bsgrub pa gces/ de ltar byas na sangs rgyas kyi chos la brten nas rang gzhan sems can thams cad la bde skyid kyi nyi ma 'char bas/ chos zer ba de 'dra zhig la zer dgos/yang bud med 'di ni yon tan thams cad kyi 'byung gnas yid bzhin gyi nor las lhag ste/ sngon 'a/nga dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa yang yum la brten nas 'jig rten 'dir byon/ sangs rgyas kyis 'gro la phan thogs ci 'dra byung bshad ci dgos/ kun gyi yid na yod pa de red/ de bzhin du rgyan drug mchog gnyis/ grub chen brgyad cu/rje 'bangs nyer lnga/ mar mi dwags kasum/ khu rngog 'brom gsum/ rje rin po che yab sras gsum sogs sngon byon skyes bu 495

dam pa ci tsam byung / de thams cad ma'i mngal kho na'i byung /khong rnams kyis sems can thams cad smin grol gyi lam la ci ltar bkod soms dang / pho skyes kyi bshang lam nas skyes bu dam pa de 'dra zhig phar zhog bu rkang zha lag rdum zhig kyang byung ba tshor ma myong / spyir bud med 'di med na sems can rnams kyi tshe rabs thams cad du dal 'byor gyi mi lus rin po che yid bzhin gyi nor las lhag pa 'di gang nas rnyed/ gnam nas mi 'bab/ sa nas mi skye/ bcos nas mi 'grub/ 'o skol rnams kyi lus srog 'di yang ma drin can mas byin/ 'jig rten 'di na ma drin can mas bu la byams byams shig pha yis kyang byams mi 'ong / sems can thams cad la ma las drin che ba med/ a ma bud med yin mod pho skyes ga la yin/ bud med thams cad shes rab kyi rang bzhin can yin/ nang na ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma yang mang po yod/ 'jig rten na mo las bzang ba zhig med de/ chos rje 'brug pa kun dga' legs pas/'jig rten gyi snod bcud la'ang zla ba pho dang nyi ma mo yin te/nyi ma shar dus zla ba 'od tsam mi 'ong / bal yang lug pho'i bal las mo'i bal 'jam/ shing yang mo gsom rang dga'/ nas kyang dkar mo nas zer ba min pa dkar pho nas zer na mi 496

yong / rdo yang mo rdo de brtsig na legs/ 'jig rten phyogs nas des mi tshad mang pos mo dga' ba'i lo rgyus 'dug de 'dra 'jig rten yin mod zer na/ chos la thams cad kyi drags shos de la yum sher phyin zer nga/ min pa pha sher phyin zer ba med/ gsang sngags na yang de bzhi na gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje btsun mo'i bha ga na bzhugs zer ba min pa a pha'i de na bzhugs zer ba med/ gzhan yang dkyil 'khor yang mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho zer ba de rgya che/ gnyis su med pa'i rgyud byas kyang ma la brten dgos/ chos skyong tsho'i yang yum de gnyan par 'dug bla ma chung ma yod pa tsho yang sprang 'gying gang yang byas nas jo mo gso dgos kyi e 'dugalha sa na bu mo la bal bos spos shel mu teg gang tsam ster gyi 'dug khyo gas lto phyid na dregs par brtsi dgos/ chos kyi ma mo ma bslab khong du chud gsungs/ sa skya ba'i bstod pa na'ang ya mtshan par mdzad kyi 'dug skyabs 'gro zhig byed na'ang /ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du zer ba min pa pha nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i zer mkhan med/ dus 'khor nas kyang / yum rnam kun mchog gi stong pa nyid gsungs pa yod/ nyams su len na 'ang gnyug ma'i gnas 497

lugs rtogs par byen gyis rlobs/ zer ba ma gtogs gnyug pho'i gnas lugs zer ba med/ byen rlabs kyi rtsa ba de la yang bla ma zer ba ma gtogs bla pho zer ba med/ de bzhin du bag ma len pa sogs la dka' dgu ci 'dra 'dug des na chos 'jig rten gang la mo chags 'di gal che/ 'o na rdo rje 'chang zer kyang yum sher phyin la ma brten par mi 'thob/ des mi tshad 'das ma 'ongs kyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi lam yang yum chen mo yin/ mo la smod pa ni gsang sngags nas/ shes rab rang bzhin bud med la/ /smod par byed pa bcu bzhi ba/ /zhes ltung ba 'byung ba ma gtogs yon tan 'byung bar ma gsungs/ de bas na bla ma bzang po chags lam pa tsho la yang rig ma la mkho ba'i yo byad kyis bsnyen bkur dgos par gsungs/ zhes gsungs la/ 'o na 'dod chags spyod pa ni sdug bsngal la spyod pa yin zer na/ de rdzun yin te/ 'dod pa spyod dus bde ba tshad med pa myong rgyu yod bzhin du de su zhig gis sdug bsngal yin zer/de sdug bsngal yin zhes bshad na chos pa zhig mi dgos khyim pa pho mo'i rna bar yang mi 'gro/ de sdug bsngal min rung de'i 'phro la sdug bsngal mang po drangs nas 'ong bas na sdug bsngal gyi rgyu yin zer na/ de yin dogs med/498

de'i 'phro la rab la bstan 'gro yongs la phan pa'i sangs rgyas byang sems kyi sprul sku dang zhabs drung gdung rgyud 'dzin pa 'byung / 'bring la sde ba tsho ba rgyal khams la phan pa'i rgyal po dang blon po pher ba'i bu 'byung / tha ma la yang khyim tshang bza' mi pha ma rgan rgon gyi lto rgyab bsgrub nas/ chos 'jig rten byed nus pa'i bu dang bu mo bzang po 'byung sdug bsngal zhig ga la 'byung / yang 'jig rten khams 'di na bde ba'i mchog gcig yod pa 'dod chags kyi bde ba 'di yi/na zhes sman rgyud sogs nas gsungs/ rgan gzhon byes pa rnams kyis kyang bshad yong /bud med la brten na bde ba'i che ba'i rtags su chos pa 'jig rten pa gang gis kyang bud med kyi steng du srog 'jog tha na khyi rgan bya ri dwags yan chad kyis 'di gaḍirdo las la spyod/ 'di sdug bsngal zhig yin na spyod dgos med/ 'o na 'di bde rung 'dis mi bde ba gzhan drangs yong pas mi bzang skyon che zer na/ de thabs ma mkhas pa yin gyes/ thabs mkhas na lcags kyang gser du 'gyur/ dgra yang gnyen du 'gyur/ dug kyang bdud rtsir bsgyur thub pa mig gis mthong / rna bas thos bud med bsten shes na 'dis sdug bsngal mi 'dren par ma zad 'di la brten nas bde skyid dpag med drangs yong / sngags 499

kyi rnal 'byor pas mthar thug zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang yang bud med la brten nas thob yong / grub chen brgyad cu'i phal cher bod kyi mkhas grub mang po yang bud med la brten nas sangs rgyas pa mang / ma 'ongs pa na yang bud med la brten nas sangs rgyas pa 'byung gsungs/ sdug bsngal gang gis 'dren na srog gcod pa ma byen len tshig rtsub sogs gzhan gyi lus sems la dngos brgyud nas gnod pas/ sdig pa mi dge bas sdug bsngal drangs yong ba thag chod/ deng sang phar la brdungs na tshur la brdungs yong ba mthong thos myong bas grub la/ bud med la phar spyad na tshur la sha 'jam po byas glan pa ma gtogs khyod kyis mo la 'di 'dra mi 'os zhes brdungs pa zhig med/ de ma gnod par ma zad phan zhig thogs pa'i rtags yin/ rab byung dge slong khrims ldan pa ma gtogs pas/ gzhan su zhig yin rung bud med la longs spyod dang bzang / bud med la ma spyad na mi rabs chad 'gro/ mi rabs chad na mi bzang / mi mang po spel dgos/ mi mang po spel na nang na khyim pa byed rgyu dang / chos sgor 'jug rgyu mang po 'byung / de byung na khyim pas sbyin bdag byas/ chos sgor zhugs pas bstan pa bzung na/ sems can kun la gnas 500

skabs su bde skyid sngar bas che zhing / chos byas pa'i mthus mthar thug sangs rgyas pa'i dgos pa spo/da/ mi lus 'di ni yid bzhin nor bu las lhag ces sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyis gsungs/ de bden na yid bzhin gyi nor bu gong 'phel du gtong dgos/ nyung du btang nas gang yong / 'ga' res bud med 'di sdug bsngal gyi 'byung gnas yi /na tsho zer ba de bud med gnyom chung ba'i tshod kyi gtam zhig tu mngon no/ /bud med 'di las khyad par 'phags pa zhig gzhan na med de/slob dpon klu sgrub kyi zhal snga nas/ sgyu ma dag ni thams cad las/ /bud med sgyu ma khyad par 'phags/ /ye shes gsum gyis dbye ba yi/ /gsal ba de la mtshon pa'o/ /gsungs/ gzhan yang sngags kyi rgyud sde du ma dang / rgya bod kyi mkhas grub thams cad kyis bud med la bsngags brjod rgya cher mdzad pa mtha' yas/bud med su mthong yang 'di phyi'i bde skyid thams cad ster ba'i 'byung gnas rdo rje phag mo dang / rje btsun sgol ma sogs ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro lta bur bltas nas// dngos su bskor ba lan gsum dang / phyag lan gsum byas/ khyod ma bdag ni bu yin te/ /ji srid byang chub 'byongs ba ra du/ /byang chub yan lag nu ma las/ /byung ba'i rang gi 'o mas skyongs/ /zhes gsol 501

ba lan gsum 'debs dgos par gsungs/ gal te dngos su ma nus na yid kyis de dag bya dgos/ bud med rnams mi bzang skyon gyi 'byung gnas shig yin na sngon gyi skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis phyag 'tshal dogs kyang med la/ gzhan rjes 'jug la phyag 'tshol zhes kyang mi gsungs/ skyes bu dam pas phyag 'tshal 'o skol rnams la yang phyag gyis gsol ba thobs gsungs pa de yon tan kun gyi 'byung gnas shig yin pa'i rtags yin/gal te phyag mi 'tshal rung bsdigs brdungs sogs lus sems la dngos su gnod pa'i bya ba gtan nas byed mi rung ste/ byas na skye ba du mar bud med dang mi 'phrad/ ma 'phrad na dal 'byor gyi mi lus mi 'thob/ ma thob na gzhan gang gi lus blangs kyang thar pa'i go 'phang zhig gtan nas thob pa'i skal ba med/ gal te bud med la brten nas mi lus shig thob kyang bud med kyi grogs bzang po zhig mi rnyed/ rnyed kyang gzhan dbang du song nas rang gis ci bder longs spyod mi chog bud med med na ba dang khyi mo la zhon pas mi 'ong / pho skyes su la yang grogs bud med cig dgos/ bud med med pa'i khyo ka de'i sdug gcig med/ rdo rje 'chang gis kyang yum zhig bang 'dug pa de zung 'jug gi mtshon byed yin mod/ 'on kyang 502

sngags nyams su len pa'i rnal 'byor pa dang 'jig rten pa rnams la yang grogs bud med dgos/ brnyas smod bya mi rung ba'i brda yin/ smad na nyes pa che ste/ dpal tī la ka las/'jig rten ma dang smod gyur na/ /smod pa nyid kyis nyams gyur te/ /bskal pa bye ba stong gis kyang / /dngos grub go 'phang 'thob mi 'gyur/ /gsungs/ sngon tshangs pa phun sum tshogs pa dbang phyug ces bya bas bud med du bsgyur nas rgyal ba tshe dpag med kyi spyan sngar 'khod pa la/ brgya byen gtsug phud 'dzin ces bya bas rnam grangs du mas smad pa la rjes su bshags pa ma byas pas tshe rabs brgyad khri bzhi stong du bud med du skyes par gsungs/ sngon grub chen ku ku rī bas kyang sku tshe snga mar bud med la kha btang mang po byas pas/ phyis sku tshe der sngags kyi lam grogs su lha mi'i bu mo ma 'byor bar khye mo zhig bsten dgos byung ba'i tshul bstan skad/ des na gsang sngags kyi dbang thob 'dod chags lam 'khyer gyi gdams ngag yod pa rnams kyis bud med bsten pa 'a/ khas gtong gtan nas mi rung / 'o na rab byung dge blo /nga gis bud med mjes ma'i gdong la blta ba dang / lhan du sdad cing 'gro ba dang /glu dbyangs snyan pa rgyang nas len pa sogs la nyan yang mi rung 503

ba'i bcas pa mdzad/ mdo las/ bltas shing gtam yang 'phung gyur na/ /de nyid bsten pa smos ci dgos/ /gsungs pa sogs ni gang yin zer na/ de ni gsang sngags kyi 'dod chags lam 'khyer gyi gdams pa med pa'i dge slong sha stag gi sdom pa shor gyis dogs nas/ nam yang mi 'chor ba'i don du chu mi 'ong chu rka rgyang nas 'then pa yin/ bud med la chags pa'i dbang gis blta ba dang / skad grag pa la nyan mi rung ba yin gyi/dge slong yin rung chags pa ma skyes na bu mo mdzes ma'i gdong la lan gcig gis mi tshad brgya bltas na yang skyon med/ 'on kyang khrims ldan rnams kyis de ltar byas na 'jig rten mig sngar mi mdzes spangs na legs/ mdor na khyed chos pa 'jig rten pa gang gis spyir bud med 'di skyon gyi gong bur lta ba 'di rgyal ba'i gsung rab kyi dgongs pa ma lon pa'i mtshang du go nas/ da nas bud med 'di chos 'jig rten gang byed rung sa gzhi lta bu/ yon tan ma lus pa'i 'byung gnas yid bzhin gyi nor bu lta bur bltas nas/ dus nam yang brnyas smod khyad gsod sun 'byen sogs lus sems la gnod pa'i bya ba cung zad tsam yang ma byed par zas gos sogs kyis mchod bstod bkur/ khyad par lus srog bskyed pa'i drin can gyi ma la drin 504

gzo bzang po gyis/ de ltar byas na bud med la brten nas legs tshogs rgyas shing ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyang dgyes nas/ mchog thun mong gi dngos grub kyang dngos sam brgyud nas ster bar 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang mkhas pa'i dbang po dge bshes sog bzlog pa'i zhal nas // 'dod yon lnga spyod cing bud smad dang bcas pas theg chen gyi gral du mi chud pa 'di ni pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg par yang mi bzhed de/'phags pa sdud pa las/ gal te byang chub sems dpa' 'dod yon lnga spyod kyang / /sangs rgyas chos/ dang 'phags pa'i dge 'dun skyabs song ste/ /sangs rgyas bsgrub bya snyam du kun mkhyen yid byed na/ /mkhas pa tshul khri mas pha rol phyin gnas rig par bya/ /zhes dang / mngon rtogs rgyan las/ 'dod la spyod pa thabs mkhas dang / /zhes 'byung la/ gsang sngags pa ni 'dod yon lnga la nges par bsten par gsungs te/ rgyud dag las/ dka' thub sdom pa mi zad pa/ /bsten na 'grub par mi 'gyur te/ /'dod pa'i longs spyod thams cad la/ /brten na myur du 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs te/ sngon gyi rnal 'byor rgyud pa rgyal po rab gsal zla ba dang / gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyal po bi su galpa dang / rnal 'byong ma rgyud kyi rgyal po in+d+ra 505

bhu ti la sogs pa de rnams khyim pa bud med dang bcas pa kho na yin la/ in+d+ra zu ti'i khab tu bcom ldan 'das kyis theg pa thun mong gi chos bstan pas/ rgyal pos/ luspu'i tshal ni nyams dga' bar/ /wa nyid seng ger 'gyur srid kyang / /'dod yon spangs pa'i thar pa ni/ /bdag gis nam yang mi 'tshal lo/ /zhes gsol bas/ dbang po rab gsang sngags kyi snod du gziṭa nas dbang bskur rgyud gsungs pas rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pas grol ba thob pa yang gsar ma'i gzhung la grags/gsungs/ paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston gyis/gtsang mi gtsang la sogs pa'i rtog pas 'ching ba yin/ rtog pa de spangs nas de dag bdud rtsir byen gyis brlabs nas spyad na chos thams cad la tha dad rtog pa 'byung ba dzun par nges shes 'byung la/ mi ma yin kha cig de nyid la dga' bas chos bzhin du skyobs pa dang / de'i gdams ngag 'dzin par 'gyur ba yod do/ /sha lnga bcud rtsi lnga ni mtshon pa tsam ste/ yul gang na sha la sogs pa mi gtsang bar 'dzin pa de la ma chags par spyod de/ 'di ni spyod pa myur ba'o/ /zhes gsang sngags kyi thabs myur ba'i yan lag tu bshad do/ /sasbu ṭar yang / gong du bshad pa'i bshang gci khrag dang ni/ /sha dang nya yi sbyin bsreg 506

ni/ /lha ni khyod kyis gsungs pa nyid/ /ji ltar ye shes sems dpa' la/ /mi gtsang bas ni kha bskang na/ /sdig pa ci ltar skye mi 'gyur/ /gal te sdig las ji ltar 'bras/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /mi shes/ rmongs pa'i sems can gang / /ye shes thabs ni rnam par spangs/ /phyi rol dngos por mngon zhen pas/ /rtog pa'i dra bas dra bar byas/ /de yi sdig dang bsod nams kyi/ /cha gnyis rnam par rtog pa ste/ /'di rnams chos ni rang bzhin dag /ma skyes pa dang gnas med cing / /sems can ye shes 'phel ba'i phyir/ /don dam la ni bsod nams nyid/ /thabs ni sangs rgyas rnams kyis bstan/ /skye ba dang ni spangs med na/ /bsod nams med la su zhig zhen/ /gsungs/ gsang sngags kyi thabs kyis zin pa'i spyod pa dang / skye bo rang ka bas spyod pa gnyis kyi bsam sbyor gtan nas mi gcig kyang / tha mal bas phar bltas na 'jig rten spyod pa dang khyad par med pa 'dra nga/ zhig tu mthong ste/sngon slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes ga hon 'ban mo chung ma can du mthong ba dang / dpal sha ba ri dbang phyug ri dwags gsod pa'i rngon par mthong ba bzhin no / /nyon mongs dug lnga bo de yang pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa nas spang byar mdzad 507

kyang / gsang sngags pas dug lnga ye shes lngar grol ba yin te/sasbu ṭi las/ chags pas chags pa dag 'gyur te/ /zhe sdang nyid kyis zhe sdang sbyongs/ /gti mug nyid kyis gti mug sbyongs/ /nga rgyal nyid kyis nga rgyal sbyongs/ /phrag dog gis ni phrag dog sbyongs/ /rdo rje 'dzin sogs thams cad sbyongs/ /zhes dang / brtag gnyis las/ ji ltar me yis tshig pa yang me nyid la ni bdug par bya/ /de bzhin 'dod chags mes tshig gis/ /'dod chags me yis bdug par bya/ /skye bo mi bzang pa yi las/ /gang dang gang gis 'ching gyur pa/ /thabs dang bcas na de nyid kyis/ /srid pa'i 'ching ba las grol 'gyur/ /chags pas 'jig rten 'ching gyur pa/ /'dod chags kyis ni rnam grol 'gyur/ /bzlog pa'i bsgom pa 'di nyid ni/ /sangs rgyas mu stegs kyis mi shes/ /zhes gsungs so/ /des na gsang sngags kyi lam la slob pa'i rnal 'byor pas 'dod yon gang la spyad kyang / gzung ba dang 'dzin pa'i chos thams cad ye gdod ma'i gnas lugs stong pa chen por grol ba'i gnad shes na thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang thob pa la dka' las chen po zhig myang mi dgos par mdo rgyud bstan bcos mang po nas yang yang gsungs so/ /508

des na 'dod yon la spyod pa'i chos pa thams cad la dad gus dag snang sbyongs par bya'o//smras pa/ chos sku kun la khyab pa'i kun tu bzang / /longs sku mtshan dpes spras pa rdo rje 'chang / /sprul sku 'gro don mdzad pa'i shākya thub/ /skyabs mchog gsum dang brgyud pa'i bla mas skyongs/ /bdag sems gsal stong gzims khang nyams dga' ru/ /'jam dbyangs dbyangs can lha mo rtag bzhugs nas/ /bde stong bdud rtsi'i ro yis myos bzhin du/ /gsang gtam zhu yang mi dgos gsung du gsol/ /sha chang bud med rnams dang lhan cig tu/ /glu gar rtsed 'jo byed bzhin lam bzang la /slob mkhan rnal 'byor pho mo dga' ba'i phyir/ /rdo rje glu dbyangs snyan la ring ba len/ /ngo mtshar rgyal ba'i gsung rab mtha' yas kyang / /mkhas pa nyams myong can gyi rnal 'byor pas/ /dpyad nas chos kun dgongs pa lon tsa na/ /gsar rnying yongs la dad gus dag snang 'char/ /nges don lta ba rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /'khor bar 'khyams kyang sdug bsngal bde bar 'char/ /dngul chu dkar mo sa la mi 'dres bzhin/ /sdig pas nam yang gos pa med pa mtshar nges 'byung byang sems yang dag lta ba yi/ /gzhi bzung gsang sngags 509

dbang lung khrid thob nas/ /'dod yon ma spangs rgyan du rol bzhin du/ /bskyed rdzogs lam la slob rnams skal ba bzang /ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyas byen brlabs nas/ /lha la mchod pa'i tshul du 'dod yon lnga/ /khyad par sha chang bud med gsum bsten kyang / /nyams rtogs gong 'phel sangs rgyas myur thob 'gyur/ /gang zag dbang po yang rab rnal 'byor pas/ /rgyal po in+d+ra bhu ti'i rnam thar bzhin/ /'dod yon ma spangs lam du 'khyer ba'i dus/ /dad gus dag snang mchod bstod bkur bar rigs/ /gal te mchod bkur bstod bsngags mi byed kyang / /theg chen spyod pa blo dman mang po yi/ /blo la ma shong don med kha btang na/ /tshe 'dir sdug cing phyi mar dmyal bar 'gro/ /de phyir theg pa chen po'i rnal 'byor pa'i/ /phyi yi spyod lam mig sngar mi mdzes kyang / /nang gi thugs dgongs ci yin mi shes pas/ /kun la dad gus dag snang sbyang na legs/ /bdag kyang deng nas tshe rabs thams cad du/ /'jam mgon bla ma yab sras rnam thar bzhin/ /mdo sngags gnyis ka zung 'brel nyams blangs na/ /zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang dbang thob par smon/ /phyi rabs rjes 'jug gang zag las can rnams/ /so thar byang sems gsang sngags sdom pa 510

la/ /dgos pa med par 'da' bar me byed cing / /gnang bkag so mtshams shes nas spyod par gyis/ /glu 'di thos tshad rnal 'byor pho mo yis/ /gsang sngags khrom du nam yang mi sgrogs par/ /dur khrod la sogs dpen pa'i gnas rnams su/ /gsang nas nyams su blangs nas 'tshang rgya shog /ces pa'ang bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o //de yang khyad par dal 'byor gyi chos bco brgyad tshang ba'i mi lus rin po che 'di ni bde skyid thams cad 'byung ba'i gzhi ma yid bzhin nor las lhag ste/ rje rin po ches/ dal ba'i rten 'di yid bzhin nor las lhag /'di 'dra rnyed pa da res tsam zhig yin/ /gsungs/ yid bzhin nor las lhag pa'i rgyu mtshan gang yin zhe na/ nor bu la zas gos gser dngul sogs thun mong gi dngos grub 'byung ba ma gtogs/ mchog gi dngos grub mi 'byung / mi lus la brten nas mkha' spyod ral gri ril bu mig sman sogs grub pa brgyad zhi rgyas dbang drag sogs thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad thob cing / mchog gi dngos grub sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang bde blag tu thob pa'i phyir ro/ /mi yi lus kyi nang nas kyang gling gzhan gsum las lho 'dzam bu'i gling gi skyes pa'i mi khyad par du 'phags/ 'dzam 511

gling mi rnams kyis las bzang ngan gang byas kyi 'bras bu smin pa la myur bas las kyi sa ba yin/ gling gzhan de ltar ma yin/des na gling gzhan dang 'jig rten khams gzhan na gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems can la dmigs pa'i snying rje chen po can myur du sangs rgyas nas/ 'gro don mtha' yas pa mdzad 'dod pa rnams kyis bde ba can du skye ba'i ngo mtshar gyi ltas dang cho 'phrul byung na mi dga' bar/ bde ba can bas gsang sngags myur lam gyi sgo nas tshe gcig lus gcig la sangs rgyas nas/ tshe mjug nas 'gro don 'byung ba'i sa lho 'dzam gling zhes bya ba de ru skye bar shog ces thugs smon gtong ba yin/ zhes skyes bu dam pa mang pos gsungs/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ bde ba can du skyes na 'jig rten 'di'i bskal pa gcig bde ba can gyi zhag gcig yin pas/ bskal pa mang por rang nyid bde ba tsam ma gtogs sangs mi rgya/ sangs ma rgyas na 'gro don chen po mi 'byung / byang chub sems dpas 'khor ba'i sems can rnams kyi sdug bsngal bsam na bskal pa mang por sdod pa phar zhog de ring nangs par gnyis kyis kyang de ring sangs rgyas nas sems can rnams smin grol gyi lam la 'god pa la snga phyi tshad pa'i phyir ro/ /lha rnams kyang 'chi ba'i tshe lha gzhan gyis 512

khyod kyis slar skye ba'i smon lam thob smras na/ 'ga' res lha yul du skyes nas ci bya/ 'pho ltung gis sdug bsngal bar gda' smon pa mi gtong / de bas lho 'dzam bu'i gling gi mi zhig tu skyes na chos kyi mthu la brten nas/ 'che 'pho ltung byed kyi sdug bsngal sogs sdug bsngal gyi ming yang med pa'i thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang thob par 'dug skye ba phyi mar mdo sngags kyi chos dar ba'i gling lho 'dzam bu'i gling gi mi ru skyes nas/ rten de la sangs rgya bar shog ces smon lam 'debs par mdo las gsungs/ sngags/ ltar na lus 'di yid bzhin gye nor dang lha bas lhag pa'i rten bzang po yin par ma zad/ gzugs kyi phung po 'di rnam par snang mdzad kyi sku'i rang bzhin yin gsungs/ des na mi lus rin po che nor bu las lhag cing rnam par snang mdzad dang mtshung sa pa 'di mi 'jig par yun ring du gnas pa'i slad du/ rgyal ba rnams kyis tshe bsgrub dang rim gro mang po gsungs pa yin/ 'o skol rnams kyis kyang dkon mchog gsum la gsol ba 'debs kyang / tshe dang bsod nams lung rtogs kyi yon tan 'phel zhing rgyas par byin gyis rlobs zer/ chos skyong zhig la 'dod gsol byed kyang /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang / /zhes/ 'phrin bcol mdzad 513

pa yin/ 'di mi gtsang ba'i rkyal ba lta bu zhig yin na de ltar mi bya/ mi lus rin po che 'di la skyon zhig ma zhugs na/ chos dang 'jig rten gyi bya ba gang byas kyang yong / lus 'di la ci byung yang 'byung du chug chos byed zer/ u tshugs byas 'byung ba cha mi snyoms pa'i spyod ngan rkyang byas na skabs shig lus la nad sna du ma'i tshang bcos/ chos phar zhog tha na langs 'dug kyang dka' ba 'byung / chos sgrub pa rnams kyis kyang chos kyi snying bo len 'dod na thog mar lus rten 'di nad med bde bar yun ring du gnas pa'i thabs su tshe bsgrub dang lto gos bzang po bsgrub dgos/ sngon gyi skyes bu dam pa rnams kyi lad mo byas kyang mi yong / seng ge mchongs sar wa lding na ltag tshigs 'phud pa ltar/ dka' ba spyad nas nyams rtogs 'byung mi dgos nad du ma 'byung nyen yod/ rje mi la la ngan rdzong ston pas/ khyed kyi bla ma dang sgrub pa mdzad pa'i dus dka' ba spyad pa lta bu zhig phar zhog de'i cha 'dra tsam zhig lag len la thebs dka' bar gda'/ brgya la lag len la btab kyang phung bos kyang gcog dka' bar 'dug gsungs/ deng sang bya btang bsgom chen pa phal che ba zhig gis thabs mi mkhas par dam pa gong ma'i lad mo byas/ chu rul 'thung sa brlan gyi nyal 514

ba sogs spyod log byas/ tsha grang bkres skom myong gi bcug nas 'byung ba 'khrug lo nad tshe nad byas/ 'chi ru 'jug pa rnams kyis rang gis bsam bzhin du rang lag nyes la btang ba yin pas/ de bas snying med smyon pa zhig gzhan na med/ blo ldan rnams kyis dal ba'i rten yid bzhin gyi nor las lhag pa de brlag mi phod de/ bshes springs las/ gang zhig thob nas skye ba'i rgya mtsho mthar phyin cing / /byang chub mchog gi dge ba'i sa bon 'debs gyur pa/ /yid bzhin nor bu bas kyang yon tan ches lhag pa'i/ /mi nyid de ni su zhig 'bras bu med par byed/ /gsungs/ bla ma 'ga' res bla ma'i sku don dang chos bsgrub dus/ sems can gyi don byed dus lus srog 'dor dgos rung dor gsungs pa rnams chos la snying rus 'byung ba'i thabs su gsungs pa yin gyi/ nges par chos phyir phye leb mar mer lding ba ltar/ lus srog ma 'tsho rang gis rang la lag nyes su myur du thongs gsungs pa'i tshig tu 'khrul bar mi bya/ 'brug pa kun legs kyis/ 'ga' zhig na re/ dpal ldan nā ro ba des bla ma'i bka' sgrub pa la g.yangs dang chu dang me sogs gang la yang ma brtsis par mchongs pa de ya mtshan/ da lta bla mas mchongs byas na ni thog so gcig la'ang mchongs mi nus zer/515

ngas 'di skad byas/ de dus kyi bla ma te lo bya bas mkhar med pa la dzu 'phrul gyis mkhar gcig sprul nas/ nā ro ba'i sems kyi snyems thag bcad pa yin mod/ gzhan thang bde mo nas sor bzhi tsam yang mar la bogs med byas pas/ 'o na rkang ba chag pa'i sdug bsngal mi yong ngam zer/ rmi lam la g.yangs la mchongs pas rkang lag chag nas sdug bsngal byung ba'i nyams kyang yod/ mal sa nas bla log kyang 'dres pa med/ de bzhin yong bsam pa mdzad nas/ da lta bla ma rnam pas shes rab chung chung la dad pa dga' mo yod pa'i mi lkugs pa 'dra ba g.yangs la mchongs su bcug na phyag gis byel ba mdzad pas e sos mi shes pas/ lha rje bos nas rkang lag la chag chings mdzad dgos byung tsa na/ dpon slob gnyis ka 'gyod la ngo tsha ba'i gtam gyi dpe 'khyer ba/ phug pa bsod rgyal bas rgod kyi rkang dmar zhabs la byugs nas 'phur bas/ sog rags su rke dzing nge bas brgyab nas bgad cha mang po shor ba de 'dra yong gsungs pa de thugs bden par gda'/ dper na mi thabs mkhas pa dgra dang 'thab dus pha rol gyi mda' mtshon gang la yang byol ci thub byas/ rang gis lus la rma med pa gzhan pha rol gyi dgra thabs g.yo sgyu sna tshogs pa'i sgo nas pham ci thub byas na dpa' 516

bo zer gyis/ rang myur du ro rgang nge gtong gi 'jug pa la glen pa go ma chod zer gyi dpa' bo mi zer ba ltar/ chos byed dus zas gos kyis lus bskyangs nas na zug mi bde ba med par byas/ dam pa'i chos bzhin byas rang rgyud nyon mongs pa'i dgra thams cad cham la phab na chos pa bzang po zer gyi/ lto gos ye med pa byas yang na gang byung ngan ngon nad slong ba bsten nas chos kyi sngon du rang gis rang ro rgang nge btang na glen pa u tshugs can thabs mi mkhas pa zer gyi/ chos med par shi ba legs sus zer/ dper na da 4'a bo dgra dang 'thab dus rang la ji tsam 'dzems kyang ma khog pha rol dgra pham rang yang mtshon babs nas shi tsa na/ gzhan gyis kyang de'i nyin mi des cig 'khyug yod bu rgod po dpa' bo de 'dra la zer/ de ma bsad na ang zhes yid smon byed cing rang yang mi 'gyod pa ltar/ chos byed dus lus srog 'tshos kyang ma phan rung dam pa'i chos kyang yong na nad kyis btab nas shi song yang / gzhan gyis des chos legs po byas chos pa de 'dra la zer/ da dung ma shi na ang zer yid smon byed cing rang yang mi 'gyod pa zhig 'ong/ chos phyir 'chi dgos zer ba la yang rnam pa mang / ku na mtha' gcig tu bzung nas gzhan dka' spyad mi byed pa rnams 517

la khas ma gtong / rang gis dka' ba spyad pa yon tan tu zloms nas gzhan thams cad khas gtong ba 'di chos chen po mi shes pa'i rang mtshang bstan pa yin pas gzhan ma sems/gsang sngags kyi rnal 'byor pa bskyed rdzogs kyi rtogs pa dang ldan pa yin na dka' spyad kyis lus gdung gis bcug na yi dam lha la brnyas pa lta bu'i nyes pa 'byung ste/ ras chung rdo rje grags pas/ 'tsho ba dka' thub cig la byang chub re/ /phyi dros dgung lto bcad pa'i yus bo che/ /lha la brnyas pa byas pa ma tshor gda'/ /gsungs/ 'brug pa kun legs kyis/ gdod nas sems can sangs rgyas yin pa la/ /de ltar ma shes 'khrul ba'i lus rnams blangs/ /de nyid ma shes dka' thub sangs rgyas zer/ /sku gsum brnyas pa bgyis pa mthol lo bshags/ /gsungs/ de 'dra'i rnal 'byor pa'i phung bo tsha grang bkres skom gyis gdung gis bcug na/ phung bo sangs rgyas mnga' bdag nyid/ /de la brnyas byed brgyad pa yin/ /zhes rtsa ltung brgyad pa 'phog sngags kyi bskyed rdzogs bsgom pa'i rnal 'byor pas lha la phul ba'i tshul du gos rgyan sogs legs po gyon khrus dang gtsang sbra sogs kyis lus la byi dor byas/ sha chang sogs 'dod yon bcud can bsten na rang gi tshogs rdzogs shing / zas gos 518

ster ba'i sbyin bdag rnams la yang bsod nams mtha' yas 'byung ste/ rje mi la ras pas sbyin bdag 'ga' la/ rnal 'byor pa rtsa rlung bsgom pa'i ba spu re re'i rtsa ba na yang mkha' 'gro ma bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod par mdo rgyud kun nas gsungs pas/ bro bzang po drongs shig gsungs/ sngon dbus gtsang gi bskyed rdzogs kyi rnal 'byor pa bzang po zhig gis/ sbyin bdag 'byor ldan gyis ser 'bras dge gsum la mang ja bskol nas phul ba bas kho bos ja phor ba gang re bskol nas 'thung ba 'di bsod nams che/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kho bos rang lus lha ru gsal ba'i nang du phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba rab 'byams ma lus pa spyan drangs nas/ ja phor de 'dod yon lnga'i mchod sprin bsam gyis mi khyab par dmigs nas phul ba yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gsungs/ des na 'dod yon lobs spyod kyis lus 'di gces par skyongs la dam pa'i chos kyi snying po len par gyis/'o na tshogs bsags pa la dngos 'byor las yid sprul khyad che ba yin nam zer na/ sprul nus na dngos 'byor gyi mchod pa las yid sprul lhag de ci'i phyir zhe na/ sdig dang cung zad ma 'dres/ zag med kyi mchod pa shin tu rgya che ba'i phyir ro/ /yid kyis sprul ma nus na dngos 'byor phul ba bsod nams che/ mig 519

zim zim byas pas bsod nams gang yang mi yong / 'o skol rnams kyis yod na ser sna mi byed par dngos 'byor gyi mchod pa ci nus 'bul zhing / de la dmigs nas yid kyis kyang ci sbogs sprulda nas 'bul ba gnyis ldan byas na/ tshogs rdzogs pa la khyad chen po 'byung bas gnyis ka zung 'brel byed pa gces/de yang gang zag dbang po yang rab gsang sngags bskyed rdzogs kyi gdengs dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pas ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs nas/ 'dod yon lnga dang /khyad par sha chang bud med gsum la longs spyod bzhin gsang sngags kyi lam la slob dus/ rtsa gsum lha la yang 'dod yon spyi dang / khyad par gsang mchod phul na thugs mnyes nas rang rgyud la bde stong gi rtogs pa khyad par can bskyed par dgongs nas/ rje rin po ches gsang 'dus kyi dkyil 'khor 'khor lo mchod pa'i skabs su/ gsang ba'i 'khor lo in+d+ra nī la ltar/ /shin tu sngo ba'i rdo rje bung ba yis/ /bskyod pa'i pad+mo las 'ong me tog dmar/ /mi bskyod rdo rje'i lha tshogs mnyes phyir 'bul/ /sprul ba'i 'khor lor gtum mo'i mes bsregs nas/ /yid 'ong dri yi ngad ldan ga bur spos/ /nyams su myong ba'i yid rab sim byed pa/ /mi bskyod rdo rje'i lha tshogs mnyes 520

phyir 'bul/ /chos kyi 'khor lo'i dbus gnas bde ba'i dngos/ /hūṃ yig nyi ma gsal ba'i 'od zer can/ /mi shes mun 'joms sngags kyi mar me 'di/ /mi bskyod rdo rje'i lha tshogs mnyes phyir 'bul/ /bde chen 'khor lo'i dbus na legs gnas pa/ /kun da ltar dkar dri yi byugs pa yis/ /lus kun khyab par bde ba'i mchog ster ba/ /mi bskyod rdo rje'i lha tshogs mnyes phyir 'bul/ /rmi lam yul la rol ba ci bzhin du/ /gang gang dbang po'i lam nas byung nas ni/ /de dang de yi yul la longs spyod zas/ /mi bskyod rdo rje'i lha tshogs mnyes phyir 'bul/ /snyoms 'jug dga' ba'i ro'/ ba las byung ba/ /mi shig yi ge mchog gi rol mo'i sgra/ /ā/ li kā li'i gdangs su shar ba rnams/ /mi bskyod rdo rje'e lha tshogs mnyes phyir 'bul/ /zhes pas nang gi nyer spyod dbupa/ de nas/ rin chen dbang gi rgyal po bai ḍūr+ya'i/ /sngon po la sogs kha dog dbyebs kyi gzugs/ /rnam gsum gzugs kyi rdo rje mar byas nas/ /dkyil 'khor lha yi spyan la dbul bar bya/ /ma zin 'byung ba'i tshogs pa las byung ba'i/ /brjod bral da byangs la sogs pa sgra yi tshogs/ /rnam gsum sgra yi rdo rje mar byas nas/ /dkyil 'khor lha yi snyan la dbul bar bya/ /ga bur a shar dz+wa ti la 521

sogs pa/ /legs par sbyar las byung ba dri yi tshogs/ /rnam gsum dri yi rdo rje mar byas nas/ /dkyil 'khor lha yi shangs la dbul bar bya/ /lus mchog brtas byed bdud rtsi'i zas sogs kyi/ /mngar skyur kha dang bska la sogs pa'i ro/ /rnam gsum ro yi rdo rje mar byas nas/ /dkyil 'khor lha yi lngags la dbul bar bya/ /lus la reg pa tsam gyis bde ster ba'i/ /dpag bsam gos la sogs pa'i reg bya'i tshogs/ /rnam gsum reg bya'i rdo rje mar byas nas/ /dkyil 'khor lha yi lus la dbul bar bya/ /zhes pa phyi'i 'dod yon/ 'dod pa'i sgyu rtsal drug cu bzhi la mkhas/ /yid 'phrog gzugs mjes lang tsho'i dpal yon can/ /pad+ma can sogs phyag rgya'i gzugs mchog rnams/ /mi bskyod rdo rje'i lha tshogs mnyes phyir 'bul/ /zur gyis blta zhing 'dzum pa'i bzhin ras can/ /drug ldan la sogs yang dag glu la mkhas/ /pad+ma can sogs phyag rgya'i glu dbyangs mchog /mi bskyod rdo rje'i lha tshogs mnyes phyir 'bul/ /lhan cig skyes dang sbyar ba'i bzang po'i dri/ /gang gi lus las rtag tu rnam 'byung ba/ /pad+ma can sogs phyag rgya'i dri mchog rnams/ /mi bskyod rdo rje'i lha tshogs mnyes phyir 'bul/ /gang zhig myangs pas byang chub sems 'ju ba/ /bim pa ltar dmar ma 522

mchu'i sbrang rtsi sogs/ /pad+ma can sogs phyag rgya'i ro mchog rnams/ /mi bskyod rdo rje'i lha tshogs mnyes phyir 'bul/ /gsang ba'i sna rtse phan tshun phrad pa yi/ /reg bya myong ba'i gtum mo bskul byed ma/ /pad+ma can sogs phyag rgya'i reg bya mchog /mi bskyod rdo rje lha tshogs mnyes phyir dbul/ /zhes pas nang gi 'dod yon dbul bar gsungs/ yang bde mchog mchod phreng gi skabs su/ ting 'dzin pir gyis bris pa'i smin legs gzugs/ /'khri shing gzhon nu bzhin du lus phra zhing / /bzhin ras rgyas pa'i zla ba'i mjes pa 'phrog /ut+pal sngon po'i mig can mchu sgos dmar/ /ting 'dzin pir legs ma 'di ni dga' ldan 'debs dus/ gnas gsum mkha' 'gro rnams kyis dbyangs su bsgrags pa ste/ rje rin po ches bde mchog gi mchod phreng du bkod par mdzad pa yin skad/ spel legs me tog phreng ba 'dzin mdzad ma/ /'dod pa'i bde la chags pa mang sprul te/ /dkyil 'khor ba rnams dgyes pa bskyed pa'i phyir/ /nyer spyod lha mo'i bde bas mchod par bya/ /de bzhin du/ spel legs me tog phreng ba 'dzin mdzad ma/ /zhes pa'i gnas su rim pa bzhin/ dri zhim bdug pa'i spos phor 'dzin mdzad ma/ /rin chen 'od 'bar snang gsal ba dzin mdzad ma/ /stong 523

gsum ngad ldang dri mchog 'dzin mdzad ma/ /ro brgya ldan pa'i zhal zas 'dzin mdzad ma/ /zhes pa bsgyur nas gzhan rnams sngar bzhin du 'don/ yid 'ong rol mo'i cha byad mtha' yas las/ /byung ba'i gdangs snyan mi 'dra du ma can/ /thos pas lus sems gdung ba zhi byed pa/ /sna tshogs rol mo'i sgra yis mchod par bya/ /zhes rol mo rnams dbul/ phul byung gzugs mdzes yid 'phrog rgyan gyis spud/ /lang tsho rab rgyas glu dang gar la mkhas/ /dbang po drug la rmad byung bde ba ster/ /kun gyis dga' bskyed mchod pa'i lha mo ni/ /pi wang gling bu rnga zlum rdza rnga mas/ /gdangs snyan sgra yis rna ba'i dga' ston 'gyed/ /rab 'byams mchod pa'i sprin gyis bdag mchod na/ /dgyes bzhin bzhes te mchog rnams bstsal du gsol/ /de bzhin du/pi wang zhes pa nas dga' ston 'gyed/ ces pa'i tshig rkang gnyis kyi gnas su/ bzhin mdzes 'dzum dang ldan pa'i 'gying bag can/ /snyan pa'i glu len mjes pa'i gar bsgyur ma/ /de bzhin du/ me tog kon bu dri zhim bdug spos dang / /mar me'i sdong bu dri yi dung phor 'dzin/ /dri med me long sbrang char snod dang ni/ /sna tshogs gos dang chos kyi 'byung gnas 'dzin/ /ces pa bsgyur nas gzhan rnams sngar bzhin bton nas/ rig 524

ma bcu drug gis mchod/ rab 'byams zhing na ji snyed gzugs mchis pa/ /yongs su gyur pa las byung lha mo ni/ /bzhin ras rgyas shing sku yi mdzes pa ston/ /gzugs kyi rdo rje ma yi mchod pa yis/ /gang shar gzugs kyi snang ba thams cad ni/ /gzugs kyi rdo rje mar ni shar ba'i mthus/ /mi 'gyur bde ba chen po rab stsal te/ /bde stong mchog gi ting 'dzin rdzogs par shog /de bzhin du tshigs bcad rnams snga ma bzhin du brjod la/ khyad par ni gzugs zhes pa 'og ma bzhin la rim pa bzhin/ sgra dang dri dang ro dang reg bya zhes pa brjeb/ nas/ bzhin ras rgyas shing sku yi mdzes pa ston/ /zhes pa'e gnas su/ snyan pa'i pi wang brdungs shing glu len ma/ /de bzhin du 'og ma gsum la yang / bzang po'i dri yis phyogs kun rab 'gengs ma/ /bdud rtsis gang ba'i rin chen snod 'dzin ma/ /'jam mnyen reg bya mchog gis yid 'phrog ma/ /zhes 'dod yon lngas mchod par gsungs so/ /de bzhin du nga/ṇa chen blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis/ yid 'ong lang tsho'e dpal 'dzin drug cu bzhi'i/ /'dod pa'i sgyu rtsal la mkhas lus phra ma/ /zhing skyes sngags skyes lhan skyes pho nya'i tshogs/ /ca/dzes sdug sgyu ma'i phyag rgya rnams kyang 'bul/ /zhes dang / rgyal dbang lnga bas/ /pad+ma 525

can sogs yid 'phrog lha mo'i gzugs/ /rked phra nu 'bur bha ga mngon par rgyas/ /dbang po drug la dga' ba'i bde ster ba/ /nam mkha'i khams kun yongs su bkang ste 'bul/ /mkha' la mkha' yis sbyor ba ji bzhin du/ /dga' bzhi lugs 'byung lugs ldog tu drangs pa'i/ /bde stong ye shes mchog gis dgyes bskyed nas/ /thabs lam zab mos tshe 'dir grol byen zlobs/ /zhes gsungs/ gzhan yang grub dbang mkhar rdo rin po ches gzigs snang tsalco li sde lnga'i cho ga las/ hūṃ thugs las spros pa'i rdo rje pho nya mo/ /mdzes shing sgeg la chags pa'i rnam 'gyur can/ /mchod pa'i las la rnam par goms pa yis/ /zhal gyi chab skyems mi zad a r+ghaṃ spro/ /g.ya' chu sil ma'i zhabs bsil rgyun du bsgrengs/ /mjes pa'i lang tsho me tog kun nas 'dzum/ /kha dang lus ni dri zhim bdug spos 'thul/ /ye shes snang gsal bde drod 'od du 'bar/ /chags pa'i rngul rgyun dri chab yongs su 'gyed/ /ljags bcud mngar ba'i ro brgya'i zhal zas 'bul/ /sid dang 'khun cing bsrub pa'i sgra snyan sgogs/ /rang rang mchod rdzas dgyes pa bskyed byed pa'i/ /mdzes sdug gar mkhan mchod pa'i lha mo yis/ /rnam par mchod pa yongs su spros pas mchod/ /bde chen rol ba'i rtsal snang ma 526

'gags pas/ /ye shes sgyu ma'i ngang du bzhes su gsol/ /zhes pa la sogs rgya cher gsungs so/ /gzhan yang mdo nas bskal chen grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags nas sangs rgyas pa/sngags nas lha sngags ting nge 'dzin gye sgo nas tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i yo byad rnams byin gyis brlabs nas mchod sbyin byas na/bskal pa mang po'i tshogs dus gcig la rdzogs nas/ tshe gcig la sangs rgyas par 'gyur bas yar mar gye tshes bcu sogs skabs skabs su tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bskor ba gal che ste/ de la sngon gyi dus su rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul na 'byor ldan gyis gser srang bco brgyad tsam gye rin gyi tshogs rdzas brgya phrag mang po 'tshogs par byas/ rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor pho mo brgya phrag du ma 'tshogs nas tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor ba yin skad/ bod 'di 'byor ba chung bas de tsam ma 'dzoms kyang / thabs shes kyis rdzas sha chang la sogs rang rang gis gang 'dzom gyis tshogs 'khor bskor na chog par gsungs/tshogs mchod kyi skabs su rdo rje'i glu dang gar gyi mchod pa yang bya ste/ tshes bcu'i bskul byang las/ 'byor ldan ga na'i tsakra bya/ /nyams kyi bro brdungs gar stabs byos/ /lus la bde ba'i nyams myong 'bar/ /ngag gis chos bshad nyams dbyangs 527

blangs/ /gsang ba ngag la nus pa 'char/ /yid kyis mi rtog ting 'dzin sgoms/ /spra med rtogs pa'i nyams kyang 'char/ /zhes dang / gsang rgyud rin po che las/ glu ni chos nyid stong pa'i glu/ /gar ni don dam rtogs pa'i gar/ /bro ni gdug pa 'dul ba'i bro/ /glu bro gar gyis mchod pa 'bul/ /zhes dang /rdo rje gur gyi dka' 'grel du/ sangs rgyas gar mkhan rdo rje yis/ /'dod chags can gyis byang chub sgrub/ /ces dang / bla ma dgongs 'dus las/ gar stabs 'cham dang rnam 'gyur du ma yis/ /rnal 'byor nyams dang bstun te gzhung bzhin bya/ /des na byin 'bebs ma mo mkha' 'gro 'du/ /mnga' thang longs spyod dpal 'byor gong du bskyed/ /ces dang / rdo rje gur las/gar dang glu la rab zhen pa'i/ /sems can rnams ni bsdu ba'i phyir/ /sangs rgyas gar mkhan rol ba mdzad/ /sangs rgyas gar mkhan rdo rje yis/ /'dod chags chen pos byang chub sgrub/ /ces dang / dang po'i sangs rgyas las/ dga' bde de bzhin spro ba yis/ /glu gar rol mo'i rnam par rol/ /dri dang phreng ba byugs pa yis/ /rig sngags rgyal po rab bsgrub bya/ /ji ltar bde ba'i bde ba bzung / /ji ltar 'dod pa de ltar spyad/ /ji ltar bza' btung spyod pas kyang / /mchog tu mi 'gyur bsgrub 528

par bya/ /zhes dang / kye rdo rje las/ gang du gus bcas glu len dang / /gang du gus bcas gar byed pa/ /zhes dang / mngon brjod bla ma'i le'u nyer lnga bar gsungs pa'i dpyid kyi glu dbyangs len tshul ni/ rang bde mchog yab yum la sogs pa'i lhar gsal/ snod bcud kyang gzhal yas khang dang lhar bltas/snyoms 'jug gi bde ba bskyed nas 'di ltar len par bya ste/ khro bo bde ba dgyes pa yis/ /bde ba'i longs spyod las byung ba'i/ /bde ba dbab pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /rab tu rmongs pas bsten par byed/ /bde chen bde ba'i gar gyis rol/ /rnal 'byor ma mchog pad+ma'i bde/ /a la la ho/ dgyes pa rnams kyi bde ba mchog /rnal 'byor ma mchog mchod par mdzod/ /a ldi ā ā ra li ho/ /rab dgyes mgon po khyod bzhugs mdzod/ /mkha' 'gro drwa ba'i bde ba stsol/ /dgyes pa'i bde ba stsol bar mdzod/ /zhi ba'i gar gyis gar mdzad pa/ /bdag la bde chen bde ba stsol/ /thar pa'i mtshan nyid ldan pa khyod/ /a la la la la ho/ /bde ba spangs pas grol mi ragyur/ /bde med sdug bsngal gyis mi grol/ /bde de chu skyes dbus na gnas/ /chags pa'i dngos po khyod ma gyur/ /bde ba che yis grol bar mdzod/ /pad+ma rgyas pa'i ro nyid kyis/ /bung ba lta bur tshim par mdzod/ /529

ces gsungs pas/ dang po'i tshig bzhi la/ lo chung gi 'gyur las/ khro bo bde ba'i dgyes pa yi/ /longs spyod las ni byung ba yis/ /rab rmongs ma yis bsnyen byas nas/ /bde ba'i sbyor ba la zhugs te/ /zhes 'byung ngo / /ci'i phyir dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu zhes bya snyam na/ bde ba'i dga' ston 'bar bas/ me tog sogs rgyas pa'i dpyid kyi dus dang 'dra bas na dpyid do/ /rgyal mo ni mchog gi don no/ /byed las de lta bu sgrub pa'i glu la dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu zhes bya'o/ /theg pa bla na med pa'i lam ni bde ba'i khyad du byas la/ glu 'dis bskul na bde ba 'phel ba'i gnad yod pas/ 'di ni mkha' 'gro ma'i byen rlabs chags pa'i glu khyad par can yin no/ /de bzhin rdo rje bdag nyid chen pos dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs mdzad pa ni 'di lta ste/ t+t+waṃ bde ba che la dgyes pa'i te ru gas/ /bde bas rab myos ma la bsnyen byas nas/ /cho ga bzhin du longs spyad pa yis ni/ /lhan skyes bde ba'i sbyor ba la zhugs so/ /bde ba chen pos yid ni rab bskyod pas/ /lus ni kun tu g.yo ba'i gar gyis ni/ /phyag rgya'i pad+mar rol ba'i bde ba che/ /rnal 'byor ma mchog rnams la mchod par mdzod/ /yid 'ong zhi ba'i nyams kyis gar mdzad pa/ /rab dgyes mgon po khyed dang mkha' 530

'gro'i tshogs/ /bdag gi mdun du bzhugs te byin rlobs la/ /lhan skyes bde chen bdag la stsal tu gsol/ /bde chen thar pa'i mtshan nyid ldan pa khyod/ /bde chen spangs pa'i dka' thub du ma yis/ /tshe gcig grol bar mi bzhed bde chen yang / /chu sgyes mchog gi dbus na gnas pa yin/ /'dam gyi dbus su skyes pa'i pad+ma bzhin/ /chags las skyes kyang chags pa'i skyon ma gos/ /rnal 'byor ma mchog pad+ma'i bde ba yis/ /srid pa'i 'ching ba myur du grol bar mdzod/ /sbrang rtsi'i 'byung gnas rnams kyis sbrang rtsi'i bcud/ /bung ba'i tshogs kyis kun nas 'thung ba ltar/ /mtshan nyid drug ldan mtsho skyes rgyas pa yis/ /bcud bcings pa yi ro yis tshim par mdzod/ /gsungs/ sā ra has/ glu gar gling bu rtse 'jo'i ro'/ mo'i tshogs su 'jug /he ru ka yi gar dang drug las skyes sogs glus/ /sems la gzengs bstod cung zad skye bar mi bya'e/ /gsungs/ 'o na rab tu byung ba la glu gar bkag par ma zad/ sngags las kyang khrom sogs su byed par ma gnod de/ rje mi las/ gsang sngags gsang nas spyod rgyu la/ /brtu'/ zhugs khrom du bshad pa 'phang / /zhes dang / mkhan po dkon mchog rgyal po dang /dpa' bo gtsug lag pa sogs kyis bkag pa'i phyir ro zhe na/531

dgag bya ba la dgos pa gtso bas/ spyir bstan 'gro la ma phan pa'i khar gnod na dgag la/ phan par 'gyur na dmigs gsal gyi gnang ba yod cing / skyon med par ma zad yon tan bskyod par gsungs te/ bla ma dgongs 'dus las/ rtsa brgyud bla ma dbyings na dgyes/ /yi dam lha tshogs brtse bas dgongs/ /mkha' 'gro chos skyong stongs grogs sgrub/ /byin rlabs dngos grub char ltar 'bebs/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi shugs kyis 'byung / /chos mthun bsam pa yid bzhin 'grub/ /gzhan phan 'gro don mtha' rgyas 'gyur/ /ces gsungs/dpal ldan bzhad pa rdo rje'i thabs lam snying bcud las/ rgyal ba thams cad kyi gshegs shul bsgod pa gcig pa'i lam du gyur pa rdo rje theg pa yin la/ de'i gtso bo yang rnal 'byor bla med yin zhing / de'i bsgrub bya'i snying po mthar thug pa ni bde stong phyag rgya chen po'i ye shes yin la/ de bsgrub par byed pa la phyag rgya'i lam la brten pa nges par dgongs pa yin te/ klong gsal le'u brgyad pa las/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyang / /bha ga'i dbyengs las rang byung ste/ /chos rnams kun gyi 'byung gnas nyid/ /bha ga gsang sngags kun gyi gnas/ /bde chen ye shes 'byung gnas yin/ /'di nyid ma brten thabs 532

gzhan med/ /thabs kyi rgyud kyis gro'/ ba yin/ /bde chen 'di bsten bde ba 'thob/ /yang dag sangs rgyas 'di las byung / /zhes pa dang / thabs lam bde chen snying po las/ gsang sngags bde ba lam byed ni/ /dri mas dri ma ba krus pa bzhin/ /rnam rtog nyid kyis rnam rtog dang / /srid pa nyid kyis srid pa sbyongs/ /ji ltar me yis tshig pa la/ /me yis nga /nga ni gdung bar bya/ /de bzhin 'dod chags mes tshig pa/ /'dod chags me yis gdung bar bya/ /zhes chags pa can rnams chags lam gyi sgo nas bsgod dgos par ma zad/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i ye shes kyang / /lhan skyes bde ba che las brnyes/ /zhes gsungs shing bde mchog nyung ngu'i rgyud las kyang / slob dpon lus la sogs gnas te/ /sgrub pa po las mchod pa ‘pen/ /dpa' bo rnams kyi stan dag dang / /phyag rgya nyid du the tshom med/ /sgrub po shin tu mnyam bzhag pas/ /glu dang gar la sogs pa bya/ /zhes gsungs shing / de'i 'grel par/ rje btsun bla ma tsong kha pa chen pos de ltar na/ rdo rje slob dngo/na gyi lus la gnas nas slob ma'i mchod pa len pas tshogs rdzogs sla ba bzhin du/ phyag rgya'i lus la yang gnas nas byen gyis/ brlabs nas lam myur ba yin no/ /zhes pa nas glu dang gar la sogs pa'i mchod pas 533

rang dang phyag rgya la mchod par bya'o/ /zhes bya ba'i bar gyi phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas rnams rdo rje slob dpon gyi lus la zhugs nas slob ma la dngos grub stsol zhing mchod pa len pa bzhin du/ phyag rgya ma'i lus la zhugs nas dngos grub stsol zhing mchod pa len pa dngos su gsung ba'i shugs kyis/lam gyi rtsa ba dge ba'i bshes gnyen rdo rje slob mas ji ltar bsten pa bzhin du/ phyag rgya'i bsten tshul yang de lta bur dgos par gsungs pas/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad kyi 'jug sgo gcig pur gyur pa yin te/ bde mchog rtsa rgyud las/ ji ltar mchod pa byas nas ni/ /sgrub po sa 'og langs pa dang / /zhi ba nyid dang rgyas pa dang / /zhes pa nas/ci rung ba yi lus kun la/ /nyon mi mongs par 'grub pa ste/ /the tshom med par sgrub pa pos/ /dngos grub thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /ces pa'i bar gsungs/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/yid 'ong bde ba'i 'bras bu ni/ /bla med gsal ba'i blo yi mthu/ /'bras bu don gnyer rgyu sgrub na/ /der ni lha mo su zhig 'gog /ces dang / sā ra has/ ma lus rang bzhin gang gis mi shes par/ /kun tu rgyu yi skabs su bde chen sgrub pa ni/ /ji ltar skom pas smig rgyu snyogs pa bzhin/ /skom pas phyin kyang nam 534

mkha'i chu rnyed dam/ /rdo rje pad+ma gnyipo/ kyi bar gnas pa/ /bde ba gang gi rnam par rol ba ni//ci ste de bsten nus pa med pas na/ /sa gsum re ba gang gis rdzogs par 'gyur/ /zhes bde stong ma sbyar bar sangs rgyas mi 'grub par gsungs shing / bde stong sbyor ba la de'i ya gyal bde ba chen po tshang dgos/ de'i bde ba yang dbang po gnyis sbyor gye bde ba la ltos dgos pas/rje thams cad mkhyen pas/ phyag rgya mchog dang kun tu 'dus gyur te/ /rdo rje pad+ma sbyor ba'i snyoms 'jug gis/ /bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin ma btsal na/ /lam bzang myur ba'i mthar thug gang las yin/ /de phyir stong ba bzhi yi ting nge 'dzin/ /phyag rgya zab mo'i rjes su 'gro ldog par/ /rnam dag rigs pas bsgrub par ma nus na/ /pho nya'i lam la dga' ba dga' ba tsam /'dod yon lam byed lam 'di'i khyad chos te/ /de yi gtso bo reg bya de yi yang / /phul du byung ba chos 'byung reg bya ste/ /des bskyed bde ba lam byed lam gyi du/la/ /zhes gsungs shing /de yang gtso bo ni phyag rgya'i srog rtsol ces phyag rgya'i sbyor ba la brten nas/ rlung dbu mar zhugs gnas thim gsum bgyis pas rdzogs rim gyi ye shes khyad par can de rgyud la ma skyes par sangs rgya ba'i thabs med pas/ bdag cag gi ston pa 'og min 535

du 'tshang rgya ba'i mdzad pa ston par bzhed pa'i tshe/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pas lha'i bu mo thig le mchog ma bkug ste dbang gsum pa dngos dbang du bskur/ de la brten nas sangs rgyas par gsungs pa bzhin du/ phyag rgya bsten nas dga' bzhi'i ye shes rgyud la bskyed de/ de gnas lugs kyi don la mnyam par bzhag pas/ ma dag pa'i snang zhen gyi dri ma rnams sbyangs te/ rdzogs rim gyi rtogs pa khyad par can bskyed/de las mchog gi dngos grub bsgrub dgos pa yin la/ de las gzhan pa thun mong dang thun mong min pa'i dngos grub mang po yang phyag rgya la brten nas bsgrub dgos pa 'og tu 'chad par bya zhes lung dang rigs pas bsgrubs nas rgya cher gsungs so/ /yang o rgyan chen po'i gsung nyi ma grags pa'i gter ma phag mo dmar mo'i zab tig las kyang / gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i snod gyur pa'i/ /skal ldan skyes bu myur lam bsgrod 'dod rnams/ /mtshan dang ldan pa'i mu tra bsten par bya/ /ya kha 'jig rten chos brgyad kyis bcings nas/ /skal ldan skyes bu'i nyams len ma 'byongs na/ /dal 'byor snod du gsang sngags rul ba yin/ /tshe 'di'i bde skyid rmi lam snang ba 'dra/ /thabs kyi gdams pa'i mthun rkyen btsal bar bya/ /nyin mtshan med 536

par chu bo'i gzhung bzhin sbyor/ /de tshe longs spyod rdzogs sku'i lha tshogs rnams/ /rdo rje btsun mo'i bha ga'i gzhal yas na/ /dga' bzhi'i brda skad bsgom bzlas mchod bstod kyis/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba rig 'dzin pho mo dang / /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad snyoms par 'jug /nyon mongs las rlung dzñā na dhu tir rgyas/ /thams cad bde ba'i go 'phang rdo rje 'chang / /'bring gis nyin mtshan dus drug bcad la sbyar/ /tha ma'ang ni nyin mtshan dus bzhir sbyor/ /'di ne mthar phyin rdo rje gsang ba'i sku/ /mu tra mi 'bral grib bzhin bsten cing rol blta dang 'khyud dang 'o sen chags gtam spra/ /de ltar nyams su blangs pa'i phan yon ni/ /nyams grib kun byang yid 'ong bud med 'du/ /mtshan ldan mkha' 'gro rnams kyis srog ltar gces/ /ngag snyan ting 'dzin gsal zheng shes rab 'bar mi rtog nyams myong 'char zhing ye shes rgyas/ /bde ba rgyas pas lha klu mi gsum gyi/ /rigs ldan bu mo thams cad dbang du 'gyur/ /'byung ba snyoms pas nad med rgas sra zhing / /ngag la nus pa sems la rtogs pa 'char/ /kun rdzob thig le 'byongs pa'i rten 'brel gyis/ /nyin mo mi/ 'du mtshan mo bud med 'du/ /nang nub zas 'du bde ba me ltar 'bar/ /tshogs drug 537

yul snang bde ba chen por 'char/ /'dod chags ma spangs lam du khyer ba yis/ /gnas lugs mngon gyur chos skur sangs rgyas shing / /'gags med longs skus sa bcu'i zhing kun khyab/ /ma 'gags sprul skus 'gro drug kha lo bsgyur/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan rgyun du 'byung / /'jig rten ma mos zhabs tog mnyes pa bsgrub/ /lha 'dre mi gsum 'du zhing kha lo bsgyur/ /ces pa la sogs pa'i bsngags brjod rgya cher gsungs so/ /tā re phyi rgyud las/ bskal pa bye ba grangs med par/ /bzang po spyod pa kho nas kyang / /byang chub rin chen ma thob pa/ /phyag rgya'i sbyor ba 'di yis ni/ /tshe 'di nyid kyis 'thob par 'gyur/ /bud med sbyor las phyag rgya che/ /mngon du mtshon par byed pa de/ /khrus dang gtsang sbra mi dgos shing / /dka' spyad sdom pa med par yang / /bde ba nyid dang dga' bas 'grub/ /gzugs brnyan blugs ma la sogs pas/ /rnal 'byor skye bar mi 'gyur gye/ /byang chub sems la rab brtson na/ /de las rnal 'byor lhar gyur to/ /g.yo dang smra ba spyod pa kun/ /phyag rgya sngags dang cho gar 'gyur/ /mar me legs par blangs nas ni/ /mun pa'i khrod na nor bu len/ /sgrib pa'i mun par chos kyi dbyings/ /bud med bde bas 'tsho bar bya/ /zhes dang / ār+ya 538

de bas/ bde ba chen po'i 'bras bu thob par byed pa la/ bde ba chen po'i thabs las gzhan med de// de'i don du zas dang gnas la sogs pa'i bde bas/ dbang phyug chen po brgyad dang ldan pa'i bde ba bsgrub par bya'o/ /zhes dang / slob dpon chen pos/ byad mtshar skad snyan glu dbyangs mkhan/ /sha 'jam so legs smra ba snyan/ /khyad pa ra khrom gseb bcug na mtshar/ /skyes pa kun gyi yid 'phrog ma/ /gsang gnas spu med rus sbal rgyab/ /de 'phrad dngos grub ring mi 'gyur/ /ces dang / rdo rje gur las/ bud med mchog mthong lus bde zhing / /glu thos pas kyang yang dag bde/ /dri zhim mnam las bde ba che/ /skye gnas reg las kyang bde che/ /ro mchog btung ba dang sbyar ba'i/ /bde ba sus kyang ldog mi nus/ /gsungs/de lta bu'i yon tan can gyi phyag rgya ma de nyid 'bad pas btsal dgos pa yang slob dpon chen pos/ ma dzes shing yid 'ong 'od ldan ma/ /g.yem chung khyad par chos 'a/ mos/ /de lta bu yi bud med nyid/ /srin mo'i gling na yod kyang rung / /nor bu srog dang bsdos nas len/ /rnal 'byor brtson 'grus can gyis sgrub/ /smra rtsod 'char ga'i phyir mi gtong / /zhes gsungs/ deng sang gi dus 'dir chags lam gyis 'gro phan 'byung ba'i lung bstan 539

yod de/ slob dpon chen po'i thabs lam bde chen snying po las/snyigs dus skye bo brtson 'grus chung / /le lo snyoms las che ba dang / /bar chad rkyen mang dang bcas phyir/ /rgya che'i chos kyi don mi 'byung / /zab lam gnad kyi gdams pa 'dis/ /dus der 'gro phan byed par 'gyur/ /gsungs/ bde stong sbyor tshul ni/ lus med mkha' 'gro'i chos bskor las/ phyag rgya mtshan nyid dang ldan pa dbang dang byen rlabs kyis smin par byas nas bde ba'i stan la 'dug ste/ yab yum lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas mkha' gsang byen gyis brlabs nas/ brtse ba dang dung ba'i sgo nas rtsa'i nus pa rgyas par byas la/ de nas dal bus snyoms par 'jug cing thig le rim pas phab la bde stong gi ngang la gnas par bya/ mthar bde ba rgyas nas thig le nyams su nye ba na/ 'og rlung drag tu 'then/ rgyu ma'i zhabs sgal ba sbyar nas/ t+t+waṃ zhes dbu ma'i nang nas yar drag tu drangs nas/ bde chen gnas su lhan gyis bskyal lo/ /shin tu thig le rgyas nas mi thub par 'chor na rtsa dgag pa'i sbyor ba la 'bad par bya'o/ /de ltar rtsa nus ldan gyi steng du thig le phab cing / bde ba la stong pa'i rgyas btab cing bde stong gi nyams yang nas yang du byas shing / mjug rdo rje skyil krung gis steng 540

'og gi rlung lan gsum bcud la bor la thig le gnas su khyab par dgrams/ rjes lus sems rtsol me/da phyag rgya chen po'i ngang la bzhag go /gsungs/ de ltar thabs du ma'i sgo nas bde ba cher bskyed nas/ bde ba'i ngang nas stong pa nyid la mnyam par bzhag pas/ bde stong phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub tshe 'dir thob par 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang mkhas pa'i dbang po klong chen rab 'byams pa de nyid lhun grub gling na bzhugs pa'i dus su skal ldan 'gas zhus pa/ chang 'di ngos lkog tsam la thams cad kyis 'thung yang /sgos su sgom chen pa kho na la 'thung zhes bka' gdams 'dul 'dzin la sogs kyi grwa pa rnams kha zer bar gda' bas/ thams cad kyis 'thung ba'i rgyu mtshan dang / chang gi yon tan legs pa zhig chos gzhas su mdzad par zhu zhes nga/'i lan du/ chang gi byung rabs dang yon tan brjod pa bdud rtsi zil mngar ma zhes bya ba'i rdo rje glu 'di gsungs so//na mo gu ru/ chang gi yon tan la nga/sngags pa/ dpal ldan rdo rje phag mo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chang gi mes po rdo rje 'chang chen dang / /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams mchod/ /skal bzang rnams kyi btung ba'i mchog gyur pa'i/ /bdud rtsi 541

chang gi yon tan bshad kyis nyon/ /yid 'ong mtho ris lha yi grong khyer nas/ /bdud rtsi'i thigs pa mchog gcig lhung ba ni/ /'dzam gling skye bo yongs kyi bsod nams las/ /'bru rnams bcud chags chang gi dwangs mar gyur/ /kha dog ro ldan sbrang rtsi lta bu la/ /dri bsung phun tshogs lha yi bdud rtsi bzhin/ /mthong na yid dga' bsten pas 'bral mi phod/ /zhim mngar chang gi yon tan phun sum tshogs/ /'thung bar bde la myong na zhim pa ste/ /khong du song na lus sems mchog tu bde/ /snang ba khrol bas chos nyid rtogs pa 'dra/ /zhim mngar chang gi yon tan phun sum tshogs/ /'thung ba'i rjes la blo bde rang mal du/ /rtog med ngang la rgya yan gnyid phebs pas/ /ting 'dzin 'od gsal bsam gtan 'byongs pa 'dra/ /zhim mngar chang gi yon tan phun sum tshogs/ /'thung ba'i mod la dga' bde'i gtam rnams dang / /yid 'ong snyan pa'i glu dbyangs du ma 'byung / /gzhan la mi 'jigs spobs pa dpag tu med/ /zhim mngar chang gi yon tan phun sum tshogs/ /ro mchog brgya ldan bdud rtsi chang nyid la/ /gtso bo ro mchog mngar skyur kha ba gsum/ /phyogs su ma chad gcig la kun tshang ba'i/ /zhim mngar chang gi yon tan phun sum tshogs/ /dang po mngar ba 542

cung zad sgyur ba'i ro/ /'bol zhing 'khril la kha bas 'bral mi phod/ /brtags shing ngo mtshar ro mchog dpag tu med/ /zhim mngar chang gi yon tan phun sum tshogs// /'thung bas lus bde gzi brjid 'phral la skye/ /mgrin pa'i mtsho rol gre 'gyur phun sum tshogs/ /snang ba yul bde sems la dga' ba rnyed/ /zhim mngar chang gi yon tan phun sum tshogs/ /'du ba snyems shing nad rnams kun la phan/ /khyad par bad rlung 'du ba sel ba'i sman/ /sman rnams nang nas bdud rtsi sman gyi mchog /zhim mngar chang gi yon tan phun sum tshogs/ /gang du 'phrad na brel ba'ang dal 'gyur cing / /'thung ba'i mod la sems kyi sdug bsngal 'gags/ /nyin mtshan yun thung song ba mi tshor bas/ /zhim mngar chang gi yon tan phun sum tshogs/ /skyid sdug kun la rang gzhan dgos pa dang / /che chung kun gyes yongs su spyod pa dang / /gzhi byes kun tu med thabs med pa'i phyir/ /zhim mngar chang gi yon tan phu na sum tshogs/ /don rnams bsgrubs kyang gleng ba'i gzhir dgos la/ /mdza' bshes 'dus kyang ngo dga'i skyes su dgos/ /gnyen 'dun tshogs kyang sna len gzhir dgos pas/ /zhim mang ra chang gi yon tan phun sum tshogs/ /mthon por gyur pa'i mi dbang rgyal po nas/ /bla 543

ma mchog dang dge bshes mchog rnams dang //khrims la dbang ba'i mi chen che dgus bsten/ /zhim mngar chang gi yon tan phun sum tshogs/ /yul khams so so'i grong gi mi rnams dang / /sde dgon phal dang dben pa'i ri ngogs na'ang / /longs spyod kun gyi gzhi mor bsten pas na/ /zhim mngar chang gi yon tan phun sum tshogs/ /sgrin por rloms pa'i bka' gdams 'dul 'dzin dang / /mtshan nyid pa dang jo gdan la sogs kyang / /lkog tu 'thung zhing sred pa su bas che/ /zhim mngar chang gi yon tan phun sum tshogs/ /skyes pa rnams kyang ji yod chang la 'jal/ /bud med rnams kyang bal skud gte mar 'jog /yon tan mkhan rnams bzo yon 'tshab tu 'jog /sngags bon rnams kyang rnga gshang rin du 'jal/ /btsun pa rnams kyang btsun chas 'tshab tu 'jog /grub thob rnams kyang nyi ma gte bar 'jog /zhim mngar chang gi yon tan phun sum tshogs/ /gsang sngags zab mo'i sgrub rdzas yin pa dang / /dbang dang byin rlabs chos sgo 'byed pa dang / /bskyed rdzogs lam gyi mthun rkyen yin pa'i phyir/ /zhim mngar chang gi yon tan phun sum tshogs/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro mchod pa dang / /srung ma dam can rgya mtsho bsten pa dang / /tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i longs spyod 544

yin pa'i phyir/ /zhim mngar chang gi yon tan phun sum tshogs/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams 'du ba dang / /rnal 'byor dbang phyug tshogs rnams dgyes pa dang / /tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i dam rdzas yin pa'i rjirnyir/ /zhim mngar chang gi yon tan phun sum tshogs/ /mi rnam4sa kun kyang dga' bas bsten pa dang / /'dre rnams kun kyang zhim pas 'khyer ba dang / /lha rnams kun kyang dgyes pang ri rol ba'i phyir/ /zhim mngar chang gi yon tan phun sum tshogapo// /dwangs ma 'phel ba'i lus sems bde ba dang / /bde dro /da skyes pa'i ting 'dzin 'phel ba dang / /rig ngar thon nga/'i rtogs pa 'char ba'i phyir/ /zhim mngar chang gi yon tan phun sum tshogs/ /brjod kyis mi langs lha yi bdud rtsi bzhin/ /mi yul btung ba'i ro mchog dam pa 'di/ /rang gzhan kun gyis dgyes shing rol bar mdzod/ /tshul 'di snang ba rgya yan rnal 'byor pa/ /rig pa ku yangs yan pa blo bdes blangs/ /dge ba 'di yis bdag dang 'gro ba kun/ /nyin mtshan rtag tu dga' bde phyam gdal shog /chang gi yon tan la bsngags pa bdud rtse'i zil mngar zhes bya ba theg pa rgyal ba'i rnal 'byor pa klong chen rab 'byams kyis mdzad pa'o/ /snang ba kun ban ba'i bun ma/ /rig pa kun phyad 545

ma'i phyod ma/ /rang rgyud kun shag ma'i shig ma/ /rang sems kun khral ma'i khrol ma/ /dga' yal le/ skyid chil le/ ban ma bun mar ya/ phyad ma phyod mar ya/ shag ma shig mar ya/ khral ma khrol mar ya/ rgyob rgyob rgyob/ bdud rtsi chang gi rba klong de la cong nge ba zhig rgyob/ zhong nge ba zhig gsol/ khrol le ba zhig mchod/ ces dang / o rgyan chen po'i gsung pad+ma g.yang 'bum las/ ro mchog brgya ldan bdud rtsi'i mchog /ro ldan mdangs dang 'jam pa'i mchog /lto la mi gnod mgrin par 'jam /mthong ba tsam gyis 'dzum dang ldan/ /'thung ba tsam gyis skom pa'i gdung ba sel/ /lag tu blangs pas yid kyi nyams re dga'/ /ljags la phog pas tshor ba'i 'du shes skyes/ /mgrin par phog pas lus kyi na tsha zhi/ /sems la phog pas sems 'phang mtho/ /bdud rtsi gser skyems dam pa dang / /chang bas ngo che ting 'dzin gang yang med/ /gzhan la nyos na mchan gyi bu yang ster/ /mi la btsongs na 'dod yon sna lnga khug /ces dang /'gro mgon 'phags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal nas/ /o swasti sirnyi/ khro bo'i rgyal po bdud rtsi 'khyil ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sa yi snying bo 'gro ba'i nyer 'tsho dang / /de bzhin me tog 'bras bu'i tshogs rnams dang / /rtsi sman sna tshogs 546

sbyar ba'i phab dang ni/ /'gro ba'i dag byed gyur pa'i chu gtsang rnams/ /snod dang rkyen dang sna tshogs sbyor ba dang / /dus kyi 'gyur ba bzang pos yongs smin par/ /byas shing dwangs ma'i dwangs ma legs byung bas/ /'di yi rgyu rkyen phun sum tshogs pa yin/ /cher dwangs shel ltar snang ba'i /zu ba yi/ /phreng ba mu tig phreng bas spras 'dra ba/ /mthong bas mig gi dpal ster chil chil sgra/ /thos pas rna ba'i dpal la bsud ngad kyis/ /dri 'dzin dbang po tshim par byed pa yin/ /kun nas myang ba lce li dpal yang bde/ /grang dang tsha ba'i tshe na dro dang ni/ /bsil byed lus kyi dbang po bde ba'i rgyu/ /myang na 'thibs pa sel ba'i nyi ma ste/ /dga' bde bsil ba bskyod pa'i zla ba yin/ /shes rab me lce 'bar byed rlung yin la/ /smra 'dod rnams kyi spobs pa'i dpal yang yin/ /g.yul ngor zhugs pa'i brtul zhugs skyed byed cing / /'dod ldan rnams kyi bde ba rgyas byed yin/ /zhir 'dod rnams kyi rgyud la 'de yis ni/ /dam 'dzin dam pa lhug par bskyed pa yin/ /de phyir 'di ni btung ba'i phul yang yin/ /longs spyod rnams kyi snyeng por gyur pa yin/ /de slad 'di ni mchod 'os mchod pa dang / /sbyin 'os rnams la sbyin par bya ba yin/ /chang la bsngags pas rab tu phye ba bdud 547

rtsi bu ram zhes bya ba i thi/ zhes dang / gter ston stobs ldan rdo rje'i zhal nas/ phun tshogs lo 'bras smin pa 'bru yi bcud/ /legs bcos bdud rtsi'i phab kyis nus pa bskyed/ /ro brgya ldan pa'i 'chi med lha'i btung ba/ /nyon mongs bdud 'joms ye shes lnga bskyed rtsi/ /zag med bde stong ye shes rgyas pa'i rdzas/ /rlung nad 'khrug pa ldan 'dus nad kyi sman/ /rnal 'byor nyams dang gsal snang 'phel byed cing / /sgom chen ting 'dzin 'od gsal brtan pa'i grogs/ /chang zhes bya ba'i bdud rtsi dam pa 'di/ /rin chen gser gyi skyogs su legs bstsal te/ /rtsa gsum lha la phul bas dngos grub stsol/ /dam can srung mar phul bas thugs dam skong / /lha srin sde brgyad bsngos pas ru nga zhi/ /'byung bo yi dwags byin pas lan chags 'khyer/ /bdud rtsi chang gi btung bas ngoms byas na/ /phyin pas snying med snying stobs che ba dang / /klad med dgra la rgol ba'i spobs pa bskyed/ /bsam med bsam pas blo gros sgo yang 'byed/ /bsgrod med bsgrod pa'i rkang 'gros rta ltar mgyogs/ /ser sna 'jur bgegs can rnams gtong phod che/ /ngo nag bzhin bsdud rnams kyi ngo yang dkar/ /smra nyung lkugs pa rnams kyi ngag sgo 'byed/ /'khrug rtsod 'khon 'gras can rnams 'dum 548

zhing mthun/ /sngon gyi skyid sdug mtshang brjod dran pa gsal/ /de ltar ser mo chang gi btung ba 'dis// /'jig rten skye bo rnal 'byor pho mo dang / /sngags 'chang bon po rtsis mkhan la sogs la/ /so so'i gzhung dang go bar mthum/ pa yi/ /dgos ched mang yod yon tan mchog gi gzhi/ /de ltar shes bzhin dran shes bag yod pas/ /ser mo chang gi rgya mtsho chen po la/ /spro dgar bcas pa'i blo ldan ngang mo'i tshogs/ /bdud rtsi bcud len thabs tshul mkhas par mdzod/ /ces dang / rje btsun po dong ba chen po phyogs las rnam rgyal gyis/ cha nga zhes bya ba'i bdud rtsi dam pa 'di/ /da lta mi yi yul du ma rdothung na/ /phyi mar lha yi yul du ji ltar 'thung / /ngang ba'i rgya'/ po phyogs las rnam rgyal nga / /mtsho mo bdud rtsi ru songs kyang yi/ la la ho/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ khong rnams tsho lta bu'i grub thob dang / ya rabs rnams kyis dran shes bag yod bsten nas 'thung na yon tan ma bskyed kyang / skyon gyis mi gos pa pa dgongs nas gsungs pa yin pas/ de 'dra'i chang 'thung mkhan la yang khas gtong mi rung / 'o na sngon gyi rgyal ba sras bcas / kyis tshe blos btang nas mdo sngags kyi chos zab mo nyams su blangs/ gzhan rjes 'jug rnams la tshe blos ma btang na chos rnam dag cig mi 'ong / tshe 549

blos btang na chos yong / des na tshe blos thongs zhes yang yang gsungs pa la/ deng sang gi bla chen dang sngags kyi rnal 'byor pa spyod pa chal chol byed pa dang / dge slong sogs kyis gsog 'jog byed pa 'di/ sngon gyi sangs rgyas shākya thub pa 'khor nyan thos dgra bcom rnams dang / jo bo rje khu rngog 'brom gsum sogs bka' gdams bla ma rnams dang / mi la yab sras sogs bka' brgyud pa'i bla ma gong ma rnams kyi rnam thar gsungs dang rgyab 'gal byas pa yin pas de mi rung zer na/ 'o tshe blos thongs zer ba de pha yul nas bros/ gzhan yul zhig gam ri khrod cig tu sdod pa gcig pu la mi zer gyi/ de yin na sprang bo dang gla ba sogs ri dwags thams cad kyis tshe blos btang nas rgyal ba sras bcas kyi gsung brtsis 'dug ste/ des gang yang mi 'ong / tshe blos btang zer ba de 'khor ba'i chos rnams sgyu ma rmi lam ltar snying po med la/ mi rtag par 'jig cing bslu ba'i rang bzhin can du mthong nas gang la yang chags zhen gyi 'khri ba gtan nas med par 'di'i sgo nas rgyal ba mchod cing dbul bor sbyin pa gtong ba sogs byas snying po len snyam/ zas nor longs spyod gang yod chos phyogs su blos lings kyis btang ba'i mi de mchog dman su yin rung gnas gang du bsdad kyang 550

tshe blos btang zer gyis/ rgyu noms med rung 'dod sred zhen chags can la mi ltogs sprang bo zer ba ma gtogs tshe blos btang gi ming yang thogs dogs med/ nor rdzas ri tsam yod kyang de la chags zhen med na/ dper na ri skyibs shig nas bsdad pa tsam gyi snang ba ma gtogs/ zas nor gyi snang ba med pas skyon gyis mi gos/ tshe blos thongs na rgyu noms gang byung yang dga' ba med/ ser sna mi skye/ ma byung yang 'gyod pa med/sgrub blo mi skye/ dus de tsa na tshe blos/ btang gi gral du chud pa yin zhes mkhas grub du mas gsungs/ tshe blos ma thongs na dngos su btang ba ltar mdzad pa la yed brtan med/ tshe stod tshe blos btang byas/ tshe smad rgyu noms lag tu byung tshe blos ma thongs pa mthong thos mang / tshe blos btang zer ba de phyi'i rnam 'gyur la bltas nas shes dka'/ nang gi sems la blta dgos/tshe blos sus thongs yod mngon shes can zhig ma gtogs gzhan gyis mi shes/ rgyal ba rnams kyis tshe blos thongs gsungs pa la yang rnam pa mang / 'o skol rang don mngon du ma gyur pa chags zhen che ba rnams la tshe blos btang nas chos sgrub dgos gsungs pa yin gye/ gzhan sku tshe snga ba'am sku tshe 'dir rang don mngon du gyur/ gzhan la mkho ba byen/ snyan pa smra/ don 551

mthun/ donatsūd bsdu bzhi'i sgo nas 'gro don byed mkhan dang / sngags kyi rnal 'byor pa 'dod yon la brten nas mchog thun gyi dngos grub thob pa'i dgos pa chen po yod pa la nor rdzas ma len sprang bo lta bu byed dgos gsungs pa'i tshig tu 'khrul bar mi bya/ khong skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis nor rdzas ma blangs na 'gro bas bsod nams gsog tshul ga la yod/sangs rgyas kyis khong rnams la bsdu bzhis gzhan don mdzod gsungs pa sogs dang 'gal bar 'gyur/ 'brel tshad don ldan gyi bla ma skyes bu dam pas yon bdag dad pa can gyis gang phul ma bzhes na/dad pa can gyi tshogs bcag pa zhes log pa brgyad kyi nang nas gcig yin pas ma blangs na nyes pa de bas che bar gsungs/yang cha gcig na deng sang snyigs dus 'dir yul dus kyi dbang gis len dgos te/ de yi rgyu mtshan sngon dus dang da lta gang nas 'dra/ deng sang bya btang re gnyis kyis lto mi phyid pa la ltos/ bla ma che chung dge slong sogs chos pa kun gyis 'khar gsil dang lhung bzed bzung bsod snyoms byas na chos mi dgos lto yang mi phyid/ rgya gar lta bu bod yul 'di min/ mtha' 'khob 'dir longs spyod dman/ dge sems chung bas dgag bya ba la dgos pa gtso/ sangs rgyas kyi 552

gsung rnams dge sbyor 'phel thabs dang / bstan 'gro la phan thabs sha stag yin pas/ gsog 'jog byas nas rang gi dge sbyor 'phel/ gzhan bstan 'grong phan thogs che na don gye sangs rgyas kyi rnam thar bzung gsung bsgrubs pa yin pas 'gal ba med/ yul ngan pa nas sangs rgyas kyi rnam thar ltar bsod snyoms byas kyang / nang tshul khrims nyams/ dge sbyor nyams nas/ khyem pa pho mor las dang nyon mongs gsog gi bcug na rnam thar ltar snang yin/ don gyis sangs rgyas kyi bka' bcag pa yin/ des na mkhas pas yul dus dang dgos pa'i che chung la bltas nas sangs rgyas/ kyi bka' bsgrub dgos/ma shes na bka' ltar byas rung sdig pa gsog dus 'byung /shes na bkar 'gal ba ltar snang yang dge ba mang po gsog dus yong / sangs rgyas zhal bzhugs rgyu 'dra zhig yin na/ bod 'di yi dwags kyi yul lta bur longs spyod chung bar 'dugabasod snyoms byas na lto mi yong bar ma zad dge sbyor gyi bar chad du 'gro bar gda'/ thos bsam sgom gsum mi 'phel bar ma zad rang gzhan gnyis ka chags sdang sogs nyon mongs 'phel 'dug pas/ bod yul gyi khyed kye/ rjes 'jug rnams kyis gsog 'jog byas na e chog ces zhu rgyu yin na/ yul ngan pa 553

nas chags zhen chen po ma byed par gsog 'jog gyis zhes gnang ba dgyes bzhin ster nges/ sngar sangs rgyas bzhugs dus de 'dra zhus pas sngar ma gnang ba phyis gnang ba byin pa'i lo rgyus gtam rgyud mang po yod/ des na deng sang bla ma skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis 'dod yon longs spyod lhur blangs pa yin/'di dge sbyor 'phel ba'i mthun rkyen min/ bstan 'gro la phan thogs pa med/ chos kyi bar chad bstan 'gror gnod pa'i rgyu 'ba' zhig yin na gsog 'jog mdzad dogs med/ khong rnams kyis tshe 'di'i 'dod yon sogs legs nyes phran tshegs zhig mi dgos/ sangs rgyas kyi sa tshun gyi shes bya kun thugs su chud yod/ mdzad pa 'di 'dra gnang ba dgos pa che/ khong rnams kyis ma mkhyen pa zhig 'u tshos shes dogs med/ deng sang gi bla ma skyes bu dam pa rgyal ba paṇa chen sogs sa thob kyi byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang / sngags kyi rnal 'byor 'dod yon rgyun du rol nas bstan 'gro'i don rgya chen bsgrub pa rnams kyi rnam thar la ltos/ de ltar byas na rang gzhan kun gnas skabs su bde zhing mthar thug gtan bde sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang yang thob yong / sangs rgyas kyi rnam thar dang gsung re re tsam la nges pa ltar snang re rnyed tshe ri sul du sdod pa'i bya 554

btang ba kha cig gis/ 'dod yon lnga 'a/ longs spyod pa'i mkhas grub bye ba ther 'bum la yang kha btang byed pa chos rgya chen po la ma sbyangs pa'i rang mtshang phyir bstan pa yin/ mkhas pa'i bzhad gad kyi gnas las gzhan ma seca/sa/ sangs rgyas kyi rnam thar ji bzhin byed dgos na sangs rgyab/ bcom ldan 'das kyis dgongs lo sum cu'i bar du btsun mo bzhes 'dug pas/ de'i lad mo yang khyod gyis/ de ci'i phyir zhe da/ sangs rgyas kyi rnam thar ltar byed dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /gcwa/nga thams cad ltar byed dgos zer na mgo rkang lag sogs lus kyi sbyin pa yang thongs gsungs 'dug pas/ khyod kyi lus kyang sbyin par gtong dgos/des na gsungs rnams kyi dgongs pa lon dgos/ ma lon na chos la brten nas chos min byed srid/ rgyal ba rnams kyis chos gsungs pa rnams mi gcig gis bsgrub dgos zhes gsungs pa ma yin pas/ gang zag gcig gis thams cad bsgrub dgos pa'i nges pa med/ bsgrubs kyang snyigs dus tshe thung gcig la 'grub mi srid cing / lus sems kyis mi lcogs pa yang mang /ston pa thugs rje can thabs mkhas la thugs rje che ba des/'dod yon lnga nyes dmigs che dug ltang spongs dgos gsungs pa de/ de la brten nas gzhan gyi lus sems la gnod pa'i 555
