sdig pa mi dge ba byed kyis dogs nas de skad gsungs pa yin gyi/ gzhan la mi gnod bzhin 'dod yon gang la longs spyod kyang nyes pa med/ 'dod yon spyad tshad ngan song du 'gro gsungs pa'i tshig tu 'khrul nas gzhan la kha btang byed par mi rigs/ 'dod yon la spyad na nyes pa chen po yod zer na de 'gal ba che/ de yin na ston pas mngon mtho'i 'dod yon gyi bde skyid sgrub pa'i thabs du ma gsungs pa yang nyes pa che ru gtong ba'i thabs su gsungs zer dgos/ bsod nams dam pa'i mdo las/ gang zhig bsod nams chen po 'di/ /til 'bru tsam zhig bsags gyur na/ /myur du sangs rgyas 'thob par 'gyur/ /gsungs pa sogs 'dod yon gzhan phar zhog rtsam pa cung zad re sbyin par btang ba dang / mar me cung zad re lha la phul bas mchog thun gyi dngos grub thob pa'i lo rgyus gtam rgyud dang phan yon gsungs pa rnams kyang don med par 'gyur/ des na sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rgya bod kyi mkhas grub rnams kyi gsung rnams gang la dgongs nas gsungs pa yin nam snyam dgongs pa 'tshol dgos/ dgongs pa lon na 'gal ba med/ ma lon na sangs rgyas kyis gang zag gi bdag med pa la yod gsungs pa dang / pha mar byams 556

dgos pa la/ pha ma bsad bya yin gsungs pa lta bus mtshon tshig gi dngos nas 'gal ba can gye gsung du ma yod/ gzhan mdo rgyud bstan bcos na de 'dra'i tshig gi 'gal ba ltar snang ba bye ba dung phyur yod/ de rnams blun po la 'gal ba mkhas pa la mi 'gal bar ma zad/ gcig grogs su gcig khyer chog pa mang ste/ rje rin po ches/ blun po la da/gal yang mkhas pa la mi 'gal ba mtha' yas gsungs/ des na sangs rgyas kyi gsung re re tsam la nges pa ltar snang re rnyed tshe/ gzhan kun ci min par sems pa de chos mi dgos 'jig rten kyang mi shes pa'i rang mtshang yin te/ deng sang 'jig rten pa mkhas pas/ gzhan yul phyogs spyi dang bye brag re gnyis tsam la phan phyir gtam mi mthun pa lta bu ngo lkog gang du mang po rji/sa tshe/ blun po zhig gis nyan na gtam mi mthun pa lta bu mang yang / phyi nas thams cad bde thabs 'jam thabs su gcig tshe ang de red snyam ya mtshan par 'dzin dgos/ de ‘pa 'gal ba ci yang med/blun pos gtam re drang bor smra ba dang / gzhan gyi gtam re re tsam bden par bzung ha ma go bar de bzhin byas 'khon re brdungs re sogs byung rang gzhan phung tshul la ltos/ des na sangs rgyas kyi gsung bzhin sus bsgrubs gi yod/ su 'gal gi 557

yod mkhas pa'i dbang po zhig ma gtogs gzhan po ti kha shas re sbyangs pas shes dka'/ blangs na 'dod kyang 'dod yon lag tu ma byung ba'i chos pa dang bya btang ba'i gzugs brnyan dang / byung yang mi len par mi nor zas gsum spangs nas/brag phug rer 'tshangs nas sdod pa'i chos pa dga' mo rnams kyis kyang rang gis de ltar byas pa'i sdug yus kyis gzhan skyes bu dam pa bla chen rnams dang / sngags kyi rnal 'byor pas 'dod yon longs spyod la brten nas rang gzhan bstan 'gro'i don chen sgrub pa rnams la khas ma gtong / khas btang na rang gi sdom pa 'chor ba'i rgyu tshe blos btang ba la brten nas rnyed pa yin/ des na rang gis rang sdom shor byed par mi 'dod na de rnams la dag snang sbyongs dang bzang / gsang sngags kyi chos 'di gsang dgos tshul la bltas na 'di la skyon zhig yod rtags red zer na/ de gsang sngags la skyon yod nas gsang dgos pa ma yin kyang / gang zag dbang po rtul bo rnams kyis thos na kha gtong zhing / 'ga' res lad mo byas seng ge mchongs sar wa lding ba ltar nyen chen po 'byung gis dogs nas gsang ba yin te/ gsang sngags gsang nas bsgrub pa de/ /sngags la skyon yod ma yin te/ /dbang po rtul bo rnams 558

la gsang / /gsungs/ yang spyir gsang ba'i chos de 'gal rkyen bar chad med par 'grub sla ba'i phyir gsang dgos te/ gang shar rang grol gyis/ bsgom gang byed yi dam gang bsgrub kyang / /mi gzhan la gsang ba shin tu gces/ /lar gsang ba'i chos de 'grub sla zhing / /rkyen bar chad med par mthun rkyen myur/ /gsungs/ rje mi las dwags po lha rje la/ spyir yang yon tan gsang ba gal che/ gsang sngags gsang na 'grub pa yin pas gsong la sgrub pa gyis shig gsungs/ ma gsang na nyes pa che ste/ ma gsang sbrul dang chom rkun dang / /sa spyod me yis sdug bsngal byed/ /gsungs/ des na sngags rnams kyis sha chang bud med la longs spyod mi rung / dper na seng ge mchongs sar wa lding ba dang 'dwa zer na/ deng sang khye lding sar bya la lding na rked pa e chag ltos/ seng ge dang wa yang de dang 'dra/ rked pa chag dogs med/ sngags kyi rnal 'byor pa dpe 'di la bzhag pa mi 'byor ni rab 'byor btags pa yin/ dpe 'di dang 'dra dogs med/ dper na seng ge'i phrug gu dang 'dra/ seng ma'e lad mo seng phrug gis byas na skyon med pa ltar/ sngon gyi skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis lad mo sngags kyi rnal 'byor pa rab kyis byas kyang skyon med/559

sngon gyi skyes bu dam pa rnams kyang sngags nyams su len dus so skyes yin/ sangs rgyas min/ sangs rgyas shig yang sangs rgya ci la dgos/ sangs rgyas kyi sprul ba zhig ma gtogs gsang sngags nyams su mi lon/ len mi rung na sngags lam gsungs nas ci byed/ sems can la phan pa med par ma zad gnod par 'gyur na ma gsungs pa drag sngon gyi rgyal ba rnams dang rgya bod kyi mkhas grub rnams kyis rjes 'jug sngags kyi rnal 'byor pa rnams la khyed tshos kyang 'di bzhin gyis gsungs pa ma sa/togs/ khyed tshos nged tsho'i lad mo byed mi rung seng ge mchongs sar wa lding ba dang 'dra ma gsungs/ de ma gsungs khong rnams kyi rnam thar dang gsung ba ltar byed dgos/ rang bzo zhig dang yid gnyis the tshom byas sngags 'grub par ma gsungs pas/ de ltar byed mi rung snyam nas log lta dang the tshom byed lhag par mi rung / bla ma dang sangs rgyas kyi gsung bzhin bsgrubs nas dmyal bar song yang 'gyod pa med/'jig rten pas kyang 'gran sangs rgyas la tshugs spra ba ltar/rgyal ba sras bcas kyi lad mo byas de dang mnyam pa zhig e 'ong blta dgos/ de e 'ong blta na rnam thar dang gsung ltar mi byed pa'i thabs med byed dgos/ 'o na mi rung ba de gang yin 560

zer na/ sngon gyi sangs rgyas byang sems ltar 'dod yon lam gyi grogs su 'khyer mi nus bzhin du bsten mi rung / gzhan gyi rnam shes yar 'dren mi nus bzhin du sems/ can gsod mi rung / sha chang bud med sogs 'dod yon gyi phyir sdig pa mi dge ba gang yang byed mi rung / 'on kyang gsang sngags kyi lam nyams su blangs nas sangs rgya ba thag chod na/ lam bsgrub pa'i mthun rkyen du zas nor sogs ma byen par blangs/ mtshan ldan gyi bu mo rku 'phrog g.yo sgyus blangs/ srin bu sogs sems can phra mo shi yang phyis sangs rgyas dus phan thogs po /nga bas skyon med/ sngon rje mi las ser ba phab dus srog chags bgrangs kyis mi lang ba shi ba mthong nas bshums pas bla ma rngog ston chos rdor gyis/de tsam sdug mi dgos/ gsang sngags nyams su longs dang 'tshang rgya/ sangs rgyas na bde chen gyi zhing du drangs chogagasungs/gsang sngags kyi rnal 'byor pa bzang pos 'dod yon bsten pa'i dus la bab tshe/ sdig dang ma 'dres pa'i sha chang bud med la ci tsam spyad kyang dmyal bar mi 'gro bar ma zad ma bsten na rang la sdig ste/ lho brag mar bas/ rang lus rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor shes/ /rtsa rlung thig le rgyas pa'i phyir/ /sha chang mi bsten rang la sdig /gzhan lus lam du slong tsa na/ /561

las kyi phyag rgya'i gdams pa yod/ /phyag rgya mi bsten rang la sdig /gsungs/ sha chang bud med la nyes dmigs mtha' yas pa gsungs 'dug pas na spyad tshad dmyal bar 'gro zer na/chos ma byas rang dgar spyad na dug 'thung nas sman mi bsten pa ltar ngan 'gror skye srid kyang / chos byas na dug bdud rtsir bsgyur ba ltar skyon gyis mi gos/ de yin rung nyes dmigs mtha' yas pa gsungs 'dug pas dmyal bar 'gro nges zer na/bod lung bar chang mi 'thung ba gcig med/ pho skyes bud med thams cad kyis 'thung / de thams cad 'gro dgos/ bud med la mi spyod pa yang med/ de rnams kyang dmyal bar 'gro dgos/ sha zos tshad dmyal bar 'gro na bla ma skyes bu dam pa rgyal ba paṇa chen man chad 'gro dgos/ 'gro zer na/ de yin na yar 'gro ba gcig mi snang / chos byas pas su la phan/ mdo sngags nyams su blangs pa'i phan yon phar zhog thos pa'i phan yon de yang phar zhog gzungs sngags gcig bton pa'i phan yon/ tha na gzungs mchog rgyal po pad+mo tī ṣa'i 'og tu lan gcig 'dzul bas bskal pa stong du bsags pa'i sdig pa 'dag gsungs pa'i phan yon rnams gang du song / de rdzun yin zer ram/ rang gi bsam sbyor gang yang med par gzhan gyis bsad 562

nas 'tshong ba'i sha dang / rang ka shi b.re sha sogs mdo sngags kyi lam gang yin yang nyams su len pas gzhan phan gyi bsam pa bzang po'i sgo nas longs spyad na nyes par mi 'gyur/ bla ma skyes bu dam pa zhig yin na 'brel thogs mang na phyis 'dren nus pas lhag par bzang / gsang sngags kyi rnal 'byor pa bzang pos 'dod yon lnga la longs spyod ces gsang sngags kyi bdag po rdo rje 'chang sogs rgyal ba rnams kyis gnang ba dgyes bzhin byen yod pas/ gzhan gyis ster dgos pa smos ci dgos/ 'dod yon la ci bder spyod bzhin nyin mtshan med par gsang sngags kyi bskyed rdzogs zab mo gzhung bzhin nyams su blangs na/ 'dod yon gyi skyon gyis ri/ gos par ma zad rgyan du 'gyur ba gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i chos kyi khyad chos yin pas go bar gyis/ 'o na sngags gzhung du ma na thig le yungs 'bru tsam yang nyams su mi 'jug par rang gi srog ltar gces par bsrung dgos zhes gsungs/ tre+e 'o bas/ thabs dang shes rab byen rlabs snyoms par 'jug /dbab cing bskyil la ldog cing drangs pa dang / /gnas su bskyal zhing lus la khyab pa'o/ /tshe ring mgyogs la skyon rnams mtha' dag sel/ /skra dkar med cing rang lus zla ltar rgyas/ /mdangs gsal stobs 'phel ci 563

'dod las la sbyor/ /thun mong myur 'grub mchog la brtson par 'gyur/ /gsungs kyang / deng sang gsang sngags nyams su len pa rnams kyis thig le ci yod rnag khrag bzhin bcir nas 'phud pa mang / thig le yar drangs pa'i rtags gang yang med par mar phud pa'i rtags su ngo mdangs shor/ phrug gu mang bo bzhag yong / de ltar byas na/ bde gshegs bka' las 'das pa ni/ /lhung ba gnyis pa yin par brjod/ /gsungs pas/ rtsa ltung gnyis pa 'phog pa yin/ rtsa ltung phog na/ gzhan du dam tshig las nyams na/ /nyams pa bdud kyis bzung bar bgyi/ /de nas sdug bsngal myong 'gyur zhing / /thur du bltas te dmyal bar 'gro/ /gsungs pas na/ deng sang gi gsang sngags pa rnams mig btsums nas dmyal bar mchongs pa yin zer na/dus rgyun tu thig le mi gtong bar dbab bzung ldog 'grems byed dgos pa khyod bden te/ 'on kyang sngags kyi rnal 'byor pa rtogs pa mthon po pa rnams la dgag bya ba la dgos pa gtso bas/ snod ldan gyi slob ma la gsang sngags kyi dngos dbang bskur dus dang / 'gro don nus pa'i sprul sku 'jog pa'i dus sogs dgos pa khyad par can gyi tshe btang yang nyes pa med dmigs bsal yod/ dge slong sdom ldan ma gtogs gzhan 564

sngags nyams su len pa'i rnal 'byor pa las rgya dang ldan pa rnams kyis rig ma la sbyar dus thig le phab nas 'dzin ma nus par rang dbang med par shor 'gro dus dang / thig le 'dzin nus rung 'dren 'grems ma nus par gsang gnas kyi rtsa 'khor rnams su 'khyil nas bsdad pa rul nas/ na zug byung bsgom mi nus par 'chi la nye ba'i dus sogs su yang / rang gzhan gyi lus lhar gsal ba'i yum gyi sku'i gsang ba sogs sku'i cha shas thams cad du rtsa ba gsum gyi lha tshogs til gyi gang bu kha phye ba lta bur gsal btab nas/ de dag la zag med bde ba chen po'i mchod pa phul ba'i tshul du btang 'a/nga nyes pa med par bla ma dam pa'i gsung sgros las byung / 'o na thig le mar btang nas yar ldog 'grems ma byas na bde stong du sbyor rgyu ci yod/de yin na gsang sngags pa khyim pa dang khra/da par med par 'gyur/ khyem pa pho mo dang / dbyar gyi bru/nga dang ston gyi khyi yan chad kyis bde stong phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob par 'gyur zer na/ de dper na mdzo 'bri gcig tsam ma gtogs bzho rgyu gzhan mang po med pas/ 'o ma phor ba byas 'thung na 'o ma sgrogs nas mar len rgyu med pa ltar/ sngags kyi rnal 'byor pa rtsa rlung thig le ma rgyas par/ thig le btang na/565

yar 'dren rgyu dang bde stong du sbyor rgyu med pa khyod bden mod/'on kyang mdzo 'bri mang po bzho rgyu che bas 'o ma phor ba gang re rang gzhan gyi 'dod pa skong phyir 'thung bzhag rung / 'o ma sgogs nas mar len rgyu la mi gnod pa ltar/ rtsa rlung thig le rgyas pa'i sngags kyi rnal 'byor pa bzang po'i sku lus 'o rkyal bzhin byang sems kyis gang yod pas/ 'phud rgyu dang 'dren rgyu gang 'dod 'dod yod pas/ thig le cung zad re nyams pas dbab bzung ldog 'grems byas bde stong du sbyor rgyu med par mi 'gyur bas skyon gyis mi gos/ lhag par dmigs pa mkhan gyis gar bzhugs zhing nas rtsa gsum lha tshogs dpag med kha ba bu yug 'tshub pa ltar spyan drangs yum gyi sku la bzhugs su gsol/ de rnams la bde stong mchod pa'i tshul du phul bas lha rnams mnyes pa'i sku las 'od zer 'phros yab yum gnyis kyi lus sems la zhugs/ tshe 'khor ba thog med nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib mun par nyi 'od phog pa ltar sbyangs/ lus dwangs gsal 'od kyi rang bzhin can du gyur/ tshe dang bsod nams lung rtogs kyi yon tan rnams yar ngo'i zla ba ltar rgyas/ khyad par lus 'pho med 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku/ ngag 'gags med tshangs pa'i dbyangs/ sems 'khrul med chos kyi sku'i go 'phang 566

mngon du byed pa'i skal ba rgyud la bzhag song snyam pa'i mos pa brtan po yun ring la shugs drag pa byas na spyir/ chos rnams thams cad rkyen bzhin du/ /'dun pa'i rtsa la rab tu gnas/ /gsungs pa yin zhing / sgos su gsang sngags mos lam gyi sgrub pa yin pas/ de 'dra'i rnal 'byor pa la khe min pham kha med de/gsang 'dus las/ dbang po gnyis kyi sbyor ba yi/ /bdag gi khu ba la sogs pas/ /cho ga bzhin du kun mchod na/ /sangs rgyas byang chub thob par 'gyur/ /gsungs so/ /gzhan yang sdom 'byung las/ yongs su rdzogs pa'i lus ldan zhing / /yan lag mdzes gzhon pad+ma'i rigs/ /bzar dang btung bas yang dag mchod/ /mkhas pas mchod yon phul nas ni/ /de yi mod la snyoms 'jug bya/ /phan tshun gyi ni shu kra blangs/ /zhes phan tshun gyi byang sems blangs nas mchod cing myang bar yang gsungs/ gal te gsang sngags bsgom yun thung nyon mongs par 'grogs yun ring shugs che bas na dbang du song nas ltung ba re phog song yang / gsang sngags kyi bka' chos 'di gser dang 'dra bas/ gser snod la gas chag cung zad re byung yang / mgar ba mkhas pas bcos na sngar dang khyad par med pa ltar/ bshags sdom rnam dag byas na dam tshig nyams chag 567

thams cad sor chud ces sngags kyi gzhung du ma nas gsungs/gsang sngags kyi chos 'di thabs mang dka' ba med pas/sngags kyi rnal 'byor pa tha mas kyang nyams chag cung zad re byung rung bshags sdom byas/ slar sngags kyi gzhung bzhin 'bad na zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang thob yong / des na thig le btang ba la rnam pa mang bas/ kun mtha' gcig tu bzung nas log lta byas khas gtong mi rung / khyed so thar gye sdom ldan rnams kyis tshul khrims bsrung ba legs kyang / bsrung ba'i sdug yus kyis gzhan sngags kyi rnal 'byor pa rtogs pa mchog dang ldan pas 'dod yon la ci bder spyad nas lam bde nas bde bar bsgod pa la sgro skur btab nas rang gi sdom pa 'chor gis 'jug par mi rigs/ sangs rgyas kyis/ nga dang nga lta bus ma gtogs gang zag gi tshod gang zag gis bzung bar mi bya'o gsungs pas/ kun mkhyen gyi go 'phang ma thob bar du pho tshod byas gzhan la kha btang byed pa 'di 'jog grogs gyis/ 'o na sngon gyi skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis las rgya bsten pa'i dus la bab tshe rgyud kyi dgongs don ltar phyag rgya ma brtags nas/ mtshan ldan gyi rig ma la dbang bskur byin gyis brlabs nas bsten pa yin kyang / deng sang sngags kyi nyams 568

len byed mkhan la/ gang rnyed rnyed kyis chog pa 'di ya mtshan zer na/ dang po rig ma brtags nas mtshan ldan bsten dgos pa khyod bden kyang / phyi'i rtsa rlung theg le cher rgyas nas ma brtags par brgya stong la spyad kyang skyon gyis mi gos te/ rgyud brtag pa gnyis pa las/ dang po rigs/ la brtags pa bya/ /de nas rigs la rigs mi 'byed/ /gsungs/ dper na me kha gso dus shing bskams rlon la brtags nas skam po 'jog dgos pa bden kyang / me cher 'bar dus ma brtags par shing bskams rlon gnyis ka bzhag kyang me yi grogs su 'gyur ba dang 'dra'o//sngags kyi rnal 'byor pas rig ma la dbang bskur byen gyis brlabs nas bsten dgos pa khyod bden kyang dbang la rnam pa mang bas/ spros bcas kyi dbang bskur ma nus rung /spros med ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bskur byen gyis brlabs pas kyang chog des na chos dang rgya mtsho gnyis kyi gting dpag dka' bas/ gsung rab kyi dgongs ba ma lon bzhin gzhan khas mi len par chos logs su bzung / chos dang gang zag la brnyas smod byed pa 'di chos spong gi lar/ ngan pa yin/ rgyal ba rnams kyis dus nam yang dzun gyi tshig dang chos log cig ston mi srid de/ khyod ni mi bden pa yi tshig mi gsungs/ /zhes pa 569

dang / don med don log ston par mi srid pas/ gsungs pa sogs la thugs bsam legs par gtong bar zhu/ rgyal ba'i gsung rab phal cher legs par bzung / phal cher log par bzung nas nyams gi bcug na bstan bshig zer ba gzhan na yod par ma sems/ yang zas nor longs spyod dug ltar spongs/khab skud tsam yang bdag tu ma 'dzin gsungs pa/ 'dod yon longs spyod gang la chags zhen ser sna che/ steng nas chos mi 'ong bar las ngan pa gsog na dug ltar spongs/ rang gis mkho ba'i yo byad gang 'dzin yang 'di la brten nas byang chub bsgrub/'gro don bya snyam gzhan phan gyi bsam pas ma gtogs rang don du dmigs nas khab skud tsam yang bdag tu ma 'dzin gsungs pa yin gyis/ 'dod yon ci tsam byung yang de la chags zhen dang ser sna med/ sgo gsum gyis rtsol sgrub cher mi dgos par 'bad med lhun grub tu byung / byung ba rnams de ma thag tu dug ltar ma spangs par rang gi thugs dam gyi chas ka byas na dge sbyor 'phel nas byang chub 'thob pa'i grogs su song / rim gyis chos phyogs su btang na gzhan bstan 'gro la 'phral phugs phan pa'i dgos pa chen po 'byung na/ 'phral du zas nor la gsog 'jog mdzad kyang skyon gyis mi gos/ skyon gyis mi gos 570

pa tsam du ma zad/ zas nor longs spyod dug ltar de ma thag spangs pa las brgya lhag gis chos ldan gyi bya ba mang po 'grub yong / de lta bu'i gang zag bzang po la dug ltar de ma thag tu spongs/ khab skud tsam yang ma 'dzin gsungs pa'i tshig tu 'khrul bar mi bya/ bdag tu 'dzin mi rung ba bden gyi/ chos pa rnams kyis mkho ba'i yo byad 'dzin ri/ rung bar ga la 'gyur/de yin na sangs rgyas kyis chos gos rnam gsum sogs mkho ba'i yo byad 'dzin dgos gsungs pa dang / rnal 'byor rol pa'i dga' ston sogs gsang sngags kyi gzhung mang po nas/rnal 'byor pa'i chas bdun dang gzhan mkho ba'i yo byad 'dzin dgos zhes yang yang gsungs pa mang por 'gal la/ khab skud tsam yang 'dzin mi rung na/ chos gos snam sbyar dang / rnal 'byor pa'i yo byad sogs de las che ba rnams 'dzin mi rung ba sgos ci dgos/ de yin na ston pa'i gsung ltar byed na rjes 'jug kun gcer nyal bya dgos/ de ltar byas pas chos mi dgos 'jig rten kyang mi 'ong bar 'chi nyes byas 'chi dgos/de mi 'phrod/ des na sangs rgyas kyi gsung gang gi dgongs pa lon dgos/ ma lon na chos la brten nas chos min byed srid/'o na sangs rgyas la yang chags zhen ga la mnga'/ 'khor nyan 571

thos dgra bcom pa rnams la yang bdag 'dzin spu tsam mi mnga'/ de bzhin du sngon gyi skyes bu dam pa thams cad la yang chags zhen 'khrul ba zhig gtan nas mi mnga' ste/ khong rnams kyis zas nor gsog 'jog lo zlar 'dangs pa phar zhog nyin zhag gsum bzhi tsam la 'dangs pa yang tshags ma mdzad/sangs rgyas kyis gzhan rjes 'jug 'o skol chags zhen yod med yongs la zhag lon dang / byin len ma byas par za mi rung ba yan chad kyi bcas pa mdzad pa yin pas/ khyed rnams chags zhen med pa sangs rgyas sras bcas kyi yan zhig min/ de dang mnyam pa'am de las man zhig yin na sangs rgyas kyi rnam thar gsung ltar bsgrub dgos zer na/ de skad gsungs pa khyod bden bden te/ chos zer ba 'di yul dus mi dang bstun nas bsgrub shes dgos/ deng sang dus ngan bskal pa snyigs dus 'dir sngon sangs rgyas kyi dus ltar chos pa rnams kyis gsog 'jog cung zad re ma byas/ nyin re bzhin du 'khar gsil lhung bzed khur nas khyim pa rnams kyi sgor rgyugs na/ chos 'ong mi dgos lto yang 'grangs pa mi thob/ rang sdug la gzhan gyis 'phya ba'i gnas su 'gyur/ ngas ston pa'i rnam thar bzung gsung ltar sgrub pa yin/ chos rnam dag bya na 'di ltar bya dgos zhes 572

smras na/ tshig de khyem pa rnams kyi su yin rung rna ba'i nang mi dgos phyi skyi la yang mi 'gro/ khyed kyis sangs rgyas kyi rnam thar bzung ba yin gyi cha med/ kho bo tshos bltas na sprang bo'i rnam thar gtsang ma red ces ha bgad di ri ri byas yong / yang sangs rgyas kyi gsung 'dul ba na gos ha cang bzang ba ma yin ha cang sdug pa ma yin/ mtha' gnyis su ma lhung ba gyon gsungs/gzhan skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis chos snying nas byed na/ chos pas gos dug hrul ro gos ngan ngon lhags pa thub tsam lus dro ba tsam gang rnyed gyon kyang chog gsungs te/ deng sang yul bod yul/ dus snyigs dus/ mi dad pa chung /'i dbang gis/ sa skya paṇa chen gyis/ nang na yon tan kun rdon yang / /cha lugs ngan na kun gyis brnyas/ /pags bye'u mkhas kyang sru med pas/ /'dab chags phal gyis spangs zhes grags/ /gsungs pa ltar/ nang na yon tan kun ldan yang phyi gos ngan/ ngo na sha rgyags pa med na deng sang bod na sprang bo ka skyugs bro bo mar rgyugs zhes lto ster mi dgos/ mig gis mthong sa'i nas kyang sdod du mi 'jug pa mang / de ltar byas na chos pas sangs rgyas kyi gsung ltar gos ngan gyon pas legs te/ lto ma rnyed na sangs rgyas kyi gsung na sgrub pa rnam dag gyis gsungs pa mi 573

'ong bas 'gal bar 'gyur/ sgrub pa shor na gos ngan ngon gyon pas thams cad mkhyen pa 'thob mi 'ong / de bas phyi la chos gos rnam gsum sogs chos pa'i cha lugs gang yin rung / de ga'i gos mdzes pa re gyon/ mgo la sgom zhwa mdzes pa re mnabs/lag tu 'khar gsil dang sba dbyug gang rung re thogs nas bsod snyoms byas na khyim pa pho mo sus mthong na yar shog ces dad gus byas mthun rkyen 'bul/ mthun rkyen 'dzom pas sgom sgrub 'phel/ myur du thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang 'thob/'brel thogs thams cad la phan thogs rgya chen po 'byung /sangs rgyas kyi gsung gang bsgrubs kyang yul dus dang bstun nas khe gang che nyen gang chung ltos/ khe che ba dang nyen chung ba de bsgrub dgos/ sangs rgyas kyi gsung re re tsam gyi dgongs pa ma lon par de ltar u tshugs byas bsgrub na skabs 'ga' re khyim pa pho mo sogs gzhan rnams la khong khro sogs nyon mongs bslang dad pa yal/ rang gi dge sbyor yal/ bstan 'gro'i don chen po 'ong ba yang mi 'ong bar gegs su 'gyur dus 'byung /des na blo gros can gyis sangs rgyas kyis gnang bkag mi 'dra ba gsungs pa'i dgongs don rnams sems can thams cad la phan bde 'byung ba dad gus 'phel ba/ rjes su yi rang byed pa/574

chos pa rnams la chos yong ba/ 'gro don 'phel ba/ kun gnas skabs su bde ba/ mthar thug sangs rgya ba'i ched du gsungs par go nas/ bstan 'gro yongs la phan pa'i thabs su gang 'gro ba de gyis dang / don gyis sangs rgyas kyi gsung thams cad dang ma 'gal bar bsgrub pa yin/ skyes bu dam pa thams cad kyi rnam thar bzung ba yin pas de lugs gyes/ yang rgyal ba sras bcas kyis zas nor bsags pa la snying po med/ sdig pa'i rtsa ba rang yin gsungs pa yang khyim pa pho mo 'ga' zhig gis sdig sdug gtam ngan thams cad khyad du bsad nas/ zas nor longs spyod bsags nas ser sna byas chos phyogs su gang yang ma btang / zas nor gyi steng nas chags sdang nyon mongs langs mi dge ba byas na lto rgyab skyid po byung nas/ tshe 'dir lus bde srog bzung nas bsdad pa tsam ma gtogs/ tshe 'dir 'tsho skyong gi sdug bsngal dang / phyi mar 'khor ba ngan song gi sdug bsngal myong bas na de skad gsungs pa yin gyi/ khyim pa pho mo sogs chos pa 'jig rten pa su yin rung / dang po zas nor gsog dus shes bzhin sdig dang ma 'dres par bsags/ bar du bsags pa de rang gis chos bsgrub pa'i mthun rkyen dang /gzhan bla ma dge bshes sogs dge 'dun pa'i thugs dam gyi 575

chas sha dbul bo rnams kyi lus srog 'tsho ba'i lto gos sogs chos phyogs su btang / mthar bsngo ba smon lam gyis mtshams sbyor byas na tshe 'dir bde skyid snyan gsum/ phyi mar mtho ris thar pa'i go 'phang thob nas bde bas na/ de ltar byed pa rnams la zas nor la snying po med sdig pa'i rtsa ba yin gsungs pa'i tshig tu 'khrul bar mi bya/ de ltar byas kyang snying po med na sangs rgyas kyis zas nor chos phyogs su thongs snying po longs gsungs pa de rdzun yin zer dgos/ deng sang bla ma gsog 'jog mi mdzad pa med/ de rnams kyis sdig pa'i rtsa ba rang bsags nas shi na dmyal bar 'gro ba yin zhes bla ma thams cad la skur pa 'debs dgos pas/ de mi 'grigs/ bla ma rnams kyis khyim pa phal ba ltar sdig pa dang bcas longs spyod bsags/ de la chags zhen ser sna skye mi rung yang / rang 'dod chags zhen gye dbang gis ma yin par/ gzhan la phan 'dogs kyi bsam pas sdig dang ma 'dres pa'i longs spyod gsog dgos/de ci'i phyir zhe na/ sangs rgyas kyis bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams la thabs mkhas bsdu bzhi'i sgo nas 'gro don mdzod gsungs pas na/ gsog 'jog cig ma byas par bsdu bzhi'i lag len byed tshul med pa'i phyir ro/ /bsdu bzhi'i yang dang po 576

mkho ba sbyin rgyu ma mchis na 'gro don rgya chen ga la 'byung /'jig rten na ma zag med la bu mi 'khya zer ba ltar/ bla ma la mkho ba sbyin rgyu med pas chos mang po nushad kyang nyan mkhan dang gsung ltar sgrub pa nyung / bla ma zas nor can gyis thog mar gdul bya la zas gos sogs mkho ba byen nas drin 'og tu bcug de nas snyan par smra/ don mthun/ don spyod gsum byas na sems can grangs med smin grol gyi lam la 'god nus/gal te chos min byed pa re gnyis byung na sngar drin che bas drin 'dren byas bsdigs nas tshar bcad/ de nas tshur bsdus nas legs lam la bkod na yong / des na gzhan don byed pa'i bla ma rnams kyis sbyin bdag dad can gyis gang phul brtse bas bzhes na sbyin bdag gi tshogs rdzogs/ des zas nor gang phul de rnams kyis bsdu bzhi'i lag len byas na bstan 'gro yongs la phan/ de'i bsod nams kyis khong gis kyang tshogs gnyis rdzogs sgrib gnyis byang sku gnyis kyi go 'phang mngon du byas/don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub pas na gsog 'jog ltar snang re mdzad pa'i bla ma rnams la skyon gyis rtsi/ gos pa tsam du ma zad/de la brten nas bstan 'gro'i don rgya chen byung rang don shugs kyis 'grub pas na/ bla ma rnams la khas gtong mi rung 577

ba tsam du ma zad/ de ltar mdzad mkhan gyi deng sang bla ma rnams 'gro ba yongs la thugs rje che zhes lhag par dad gus khyad par can byed dgos/ khyad par sngags kyi rnal 'byor pa zhig yin na thog mar sngags kyi sgor ma zhugs gong nas mthun rkyen rnams phun sum tshogs par bsgrub dgos zhes sngags gzhung mang po nas gsungs/ de yi rgyu mtshan ni/ gsang sngags kyi smin byed kyi dbang dang grol byed kyi khrid zhu dus su yang dbang yon gtor tshogs gsol zas sogs/ 'bul ba zhabs tog bzang po 'bul dgos/ o rgyan rin po ches/ bla ma sangs rgyas dngos su mthong nas ci gsung gi bka' sgrub cing lus srog la mi 'phangs pa ci yod chags med du 'bul zhing bla ma mnyes na/ snying dang mig 'bul yang mi chags pa zhig dgos gsungs/ de ltar phul na phan yon mtha' yas te/ rdo rje ro langs kyi rgyud las/ gang gis bla ma rdo rje 'chang / /bza' btung phud kyis rtag tu mchod/ /'dir yang bza' btung 'phel ba dang / /'khor los sgyur rgyal thob par gsungs/ /ye shes rgya mtsho'i rgyud las/ rang gi rdzas dang yo byad kyis/ /bla ma mnyes par sus byas pa/ /'dis ni khams gsum 'khor ba las//sprul sku'i zhing du dbugs dbyung ste/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i sar 578

gshegs so/ /gsungs/ rang la med btsal nas ma rnyed na ma gtogs/ rang la yod rnyed nas bsags te ma phul na/ bla ma lha dang mkha' 'gro chos skyong brnyas pa dang / gsang sngags kyi gdams pa zab mo brnyas len byas pa yin pas nyes pa che/dngos grub gang yang mi thob ste/ dam tshig rdo rje'i rnam bshad las/ bla mar ci 'byor longs spyod ma phul bar/ /'dod pas chos zhus bkren chags dbul bor skye/ /gsungs/ bla ma bsten dus tsam du ma zad bka' bzhin dben par nyams len byed dus kyang lus gso ba'i lto gos/ rdo rje drel bu sogs mkho ba'i yo byad gang bsgrub dgos pa thams cad bsags nas yo byad kun dang ldan par bya dgos te/ klong gsal las/ gsang sngags thabs kyi lam yin phyir/ /rten 'brel yo byad rdzas rnams bsags/ /phyag rten me tog dbang po/na gtor tshogs rgyu/ /nyams len dus su khams kyi rten gso btsal/ /sgrub pa'i yo byad kun dang ldan par bya/ /rten 'brel rdzas med dngos grub yal bar dor/ /gsungs/ des na mthun rkyen dka' tshegs med par rnyed na phun sum tshogs pa bsgrub dgos/ mthun rkyen 'dod yon ci tsam bzang ba de tsam gyi mchog thun gyi dngos grub gang bsgrubs kyang 'grub pa la myur khyad che ste/ rgyud las/ 'dod 579

pa'i yon tan lnga rnams la/ /brten na myur du 'grub par 'gyur/ /gsungs/ des na sngags kyi rnal 'byor pas gsang sngags kyi lam nyams su len pa'i thog mtha' bar gsum gang du yang / sdig dang ma 'dres pa'i 'dod yon 'bad med lhun 'grub tu byung na gang gis gang bzang thams cad bsten chog pas khas gtong mi rung / 'o na skyes bu dam pa mang pos gsang sngags pas kyang / 'dod yon spong dgos bsten mi rung gsungs pa de ci yin zer na/ de 'dod yon la brten nas gsang sngags kyi bskyed rdzogs nyams su mi lon par khyim pa rnams ltar 'dod sred cher song zhe sdang me ltar 'bar/ las ngan pa mtsho ltar bsags/ sngags kyi gzhung bzhin mi spyod par log par spyad nas/ dmyal ba'i gting rdo byed pa rnams kyis 'dod yon bsten mi rung ba bden pas de skad gsungs pa yin gyi/ sngags kyi rnal 'byor pa rab kyis 'dod yon sred pas bsten pa ma yin par/ 'gro kun don du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i lam sgrub pa'i grogs su mthong nas/ de la dmigs nas bsten/ 'dod yon lnga la brten nas las nyon mi ldang ba tsam du ma zad/ 'dod yon la brten nas sngags kyi lam bsgoms nas las dang nyon mongs pa thams cad rim gyis 580

gtan zad du btang / nyams rtogs yon tan gong 'phel du btang nas tshe gcig gam bar do dang / skye ba phyi ma'i rten de la zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang thob gi 'jug pa rnams la spongs gsungs pa'i tshig tu 'khrul bar mi bya/ yid kyis chags zhen spong ba ma gtogs dngos su spong mi dgos nga/ra ma zad/sdig dang ma 'dres pa'i longs spyod gso1ga dgos pa'i rtags su/nyin re bzhin du dus drug tu/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /zhes sngags kyi dam tshig tu gsungs/ sbyin pa byed dgos na ma bsags par spangs nas ci gtong / spyir mngon mtho nges legs kyi bde skyid thams cad tshogs bsags pa las byung ba yin pas/ sangs rgyas kyis bsod nams ye shes kyi tshogs rgya chen po gsog ces gsungs/ des na spongs gsungs pa de gang zag su la gsung ba yin gyi bye brag shes dgos/ spongs zhes gsungs pa thams cad 'dod yon la brten nas chos yong ba dang mi yong ba'i gang zag thams cad 'a/ gsungs snyam nas 'khrul bar mi bya/ longs spyod bas/gas nas chos phyogs su btang na su yin rung mi de la tshe blos btang chos pa bzang po zer dgos/ 'phral du gsog 'jog jusgros khyim pa pho mo lta bur snang yang phugs su chos dang mthun pas khas gtong rgyu spu tsam 581

med/ de ltar sangs rgyas kyi gsung gang gi dbye ba shes na chos re re dang mi mthun pa yang med la/ chos dang mthun mi mthun de shes kyang da ga' bar 'dug snyam brnyas smod khyad gsod skur 'debs sun 'byin sogs byed pa'i nyes pa kun khegs nas/dad gus dag snang sogs legs pa kun gyi 'go tshugs pas/ blo gros can gyis 'di lta bu'i rgyal ba'i gsung la brtag dpyad byas dgongs pa btsal nas ma 'khrul pa'i nges pa rnyed par bya'o/ /yang las kyi rnam par smin pa sangs rgyas kyis kyang skyob tu med gsungs pa de yang dper na sman pa bzang rung nad par ma 'phrad na nad la mi phan pa dang / nyi ma gsal rung brag phug kha byang bstan nang du mi 'char ba ltar/ sangs rgyas la sems can skyob pa'i yon tan kun dang ldan rung / gdul bya gang zag de la las kyi rnam smin ngan pa de las skyob pa'i las bzang gis 'brel ba gtan nas med pa'i sems can rnams kyi las kyi rnam par smin pa las bskyabs nas yar 'dren mi nus gsungs pa yin gyi/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ dper na byang bstan brag phug tu nyi ma mi 'char ba de nyi ma la 'od gsal ba med pa ma yin te/ brag phug kho rang la nyi ma 'char ba'i go skabs med pa ltar/ las kyi rnam par smin pa las sangs rgyas kyis skyob mi 582

nus pa de sangs rgyas la de skyob pa'i nus pa med pa ma yin te/gdul bya de la las kyi rnam smin skyob pa'i las dang skal ba med pa'i phyir ro/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhal mthong gsung thos dad pa thob/'brel ba che chung thogs pa'i las dang skal bar ldan pa rnams kyis las kyi rnam smin ngan pa chen po rnams kyang dkon mchog gsum gyis skyob nus te/ sngon sor dzang gis mi dgu brgya dgu bcu go dgu bsad kyang phyis sangs rgyas dang mjal nas gsung ltar bsgrubs pas lus kyi rnam smin myong ma dgos/ lha'i bu zhig tshe 'phos nas las kyi dbang gis sha za mo phag mgo can gyi mngal du skye ba shes nas/ sangs rgyas pa skyabs su song bas de ru ma skyes par slar lha yul du skyes/ rgyal po gsal rgyal gyi bu mo sngon las kyi dbang gis bzhin mi sdu ga pas/ sangs rgyas la dad mos byas pas 'phral du gzugs me sdug pa dang bral nas mdzes par gyur/ sngon rgyal ba'i blo gros zhes bya ba'i ma shi ma thag gshin rje gshed kyi bskyed rim la zhugs/ dmag drangs nas 'chi bdag gshin rje'i lag tu chung pa yang yar 'phrog byung / lha lcam pad+ma gsal shi ba o rgyan chen pos slar gsos nas dbang bskur ba sogs byas/ ras chung ba zhag bdun gyi tshe min med pa/ ma cig grub pa'i rgyal mos dgong lo brgyad cu'i 583

bar du tshe bsrings/ mi tshe zad pa de ring lta bur 'chi ba la grub chen rwa lo tsā bas bsrung 'khor zhig bsgom nas zhag po bdun du tshe bsring nus pa yin skad/ de lta bu'i gtam rgyud mang / da lta yang nad ngan pas bzung ba rnams dkon mchog gsum gyi mthu la brten nas grol ba mang / 'on kyang 'phral rkyen bzlog pa las sla yang sngon las bzlog dka' bas/ sdig pa'i las srog la bab kyang mi byed pa gces/ sngar byas dang phyin chad nyon mongs pa'i dbang gis cung zad re byas song na yang / dkon mchog gsum la snying thag pa nas skyabs su 'gro ba dang ci 'byor gyis mchod bstod bkur nas 'brel ba rgya chen po 'jog dgos/ 'o na deng sang nad pa la sku rim bsrung ba byas kyang mi phan par 'chi ba de ci yin zer na/ de kho rang la phan thogs pa'i las 'brel med pa'i phyir ro/ /las 'brel brgya yod rung 'phral gyi 'gal rkyen bar chad ma gtogs sngon gyi las ngan pa las skyob tu sangs rgyas kyis med ces mdo na thag rbad kyis bcad 'dugade bzhin du lho brag mar bas kyang / sems can gyi las slebs tshe sangs rgyas kyi mthu rdugs gsungs/ grub thob 'brug pa kun legs kyis/ sems can gcig gi las slebs tshe/ sangs rgyas stong ge mthu rdugs gsungs/ bsam pa lhun 'grub las/ tshe 584

zad ma yin bar chad nges par sel gsungs zer na/ de sdug bsngal las skyob pa'i las 'brel gtan nas med pa la phan pa med par dgongs nas de skad gsungs pa yin te/ las ngan pa las skyob pa'i las 'brel bzang po sngar yod da lta mi 'khyob/ da lta bzhag kyang phyi mar mi 'khyob gsungs pa'i tshig tu 'khrul bar mi bya/ de yin na sangs rgyas rnams kyang skyon kun zad yon tan kun ldan yin pa bud/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ las ngan rnams skyob pa'i yon tan ma mchis pa'i phyir ro/ /las ngan pa zhig las sangs rgyas kyis bskyab na kun gyib/ snyam mod/ las bzang po can zhig sangs rgyas kyis ma bskyab kyang drag kho rang gis rang mgo thon yong / sems can las ngan pa las skyob mi nus na sangs rgyas pa la yang dgos pa cher med la/ sdig can gyis gsol ba btab pa yang rang ngal ba tsa ma ma gtogs dgos pa med par 'gyur/ sangs rgyas kyi sku gsung thugs kyi sgo nas 'od zer re re tsam spros pas sems can mang po sngar smin grol gyi lam la bkod/ phyi rabs sangs rgyas pas kyang 'god nus gsungs pa dang / sdig can mang po las kyi rnam smin las bskyabs pa'i gtam rgyud dang / bsngags bstod las/khyod kyis gang las 'gro ba dag /ma drangs rgud pa de gang mchis/ /585

gsungs pa rnams kyang rdzun yin zer dgos/ skyabs 'gro'i phan yon na/ las ngan sdig sgrib byang zhing dag nas myur du sangs rgya ba sogs phan yon mang po gsungs pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan gzungs mang po'i phan yon na/ 'di tshar gcig bklags na mtshams med pa lnga'i las byas pa 'dag cing myang 'das thob gsungs pa sogs la dgos pa ci yang ma byung /de yin na skyabs 'gro dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan sogs brjod nas ci bya/ da lta bla ma skyes bu dam pa la sdig can rnams kyis skyob tu re nas las 'brel bzhag pa rnams la yang dgos pa med par 'gyur ba sogs mi 'phrod pa mang po 'byung /des na mtha' gcig tu bzung bar mi bya'o/ /'o na rdzogs chen gyi rnal 'byor pa snang bzhi mthar phyin pas las 'brel yod med su yin yang rung / mtshams med lnga'i las byas pa'i sdig can brgya stong yod kyang dus gcig la btsan thabs su 'tshang rgya bar byed nus par gsungs pas/ theg dgu'i yang rtse rdzogs pa chen po 'di khyad chos che zer na/ mtshams med lnga'i las byas pa'i sdig can yin yang las la bzang ngan med par thams cad 'dren nus gsungs yod pa khyod bden te/ de la yang mi zhal mthong ngam gsung thos sam dngos po che chung gang rung 586

zhig gis las 'brel lta bu dgos par 'gyur/ de mi dgos zer na deng sang bla ma la 'brel zhog skyes bu dam pa la 'brel ba med na 'dren mi nus gsungs pa dang 'gal la/ rdzogs chen pas sems can thams cad btsan thabs su 'tshang rgya ru 'jug na sngar rdzogs chen sgo nas sangs rgyas pa mang / de rnams kyis sems can thams cad btsan thabs rna / 'tshang rgya ru bcug na chog ste/ cang mdzad srol mi gda'/ de ltar mdzad nus na sangs rgyas mang po mi dgos sangs rgyas gcig la yang 'khor ba dong nas sprugs pa'i yon tan yod de/ de dka' ba zhig byung ba yin/ de ltar mdzad nus na sangs rgyas su yin rung btang snyoms su skad cig tsam yang 'dug don med/ bsdad na sngar sems bskyed pa yang nyams shing sems/ can la brtse ba'i yon tan ma mchis par 'gyur/ de 'dra'i sangs rgyas shig yod par ma gsungs/ des na sangs rgyas rnams/ kyis kyang gang 'dul gyi skur sprul/ 'brel 'jog gis bcug chos bstan nas rim gyis yar thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang la 'god dgos/ de ltar ma byas glo bur du sangs rgyas rnams kyis sems can gyi sdig pa chus bkrus pa bzhin 'od zer gyis dag gis bcug sdug bsngal me long gi rdul phyis pa ltar bsal/ yon 587

tan rnams zas nor bzhin byen nas smin grol gyi lam la skad cig rer 'god dka' ste/ thub rnams sdig pa chu yis mi 'khru zhing / /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal phyag gis mi sel la/ /nyid kyi rtogs pa gzhan la 'pho mi nus/ /chos nyid bden pa bstan nas grol phyir ro/ /gsungs/ 'o na sangs rgyas thams cad la sems cad thams cad kyi las 'brel dgos na ci la med/ sems can rnams kyi tshe 'khor ba thog ma ma mchis pas tshe sngon sangs rgyas kun sangs ma rgyas pa'i sngon rol tu sems can rnams kyi pha ma ma byas pa gcig pha ma byas dus su mtho ba rta dang glang po dma' ba khab dang / skud pa yan chad byen nas phan tshad med btags/ gnod pa tshad med pa las bskyabs pa yin pas 'brel de bas che ba zhig sus 'jog nus/ 'brel de tsam zhig bzhag rung 'dren mi nus na cung zad cig gis 'brel bas 'dren mi nus pa smos ci dgos/ khyed tshos sangs rgyas rnams kyis tshe sngon yang yang drin gyis bskyangs nas/ pha ma sems can rnams da dung las 'brel zhig ma bzhag bar du 'dren mi nus pa de ya mtshan kho bo rdzogs chen pa sogs gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i sgo nas sangs rgyas pa rnams kyis sangs rgyas nas bzung da bar du sems can dpag tu med pa 'dren gi yod 588

rung / bka' thang las/khyad par 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang gis/ /'gro ba dpag med 'khor ba'i mtsho las bsgral/ /pho brang po ta la yi rtse mor byon/ /sems can gcig kyang med snyam gzigs pa yi/ /'gro la mthar thug mi 'dug snga ma bzhin/ /gsungs pa dang / rje btsun mi las/ za ma mkha' ma zad bar du sems can la 'dzad rgyu med gsungs nga/ ltar sems can la 'dzad rgyu ma byung ba yin na ma gtogs// nyung nyung zhig yin na da tsam 'khor ba dong nas sprugs yod tshod yin/ da dung yang sangs rgyas re res sprul pa bye ba phrag brgya 'gyed nas sems can dpag tu med pa smin grol gyi lam la 'god nges/ nam zhig 'khor ba dong nas sprugs te 'phrin las mthar phyin par mdzad pa yin zer na/ da de 'dra chags po 'a dug sangs rgyas rnams la dad gus skye ba la phan pas/ de 'a/ lan mi 'debs de tsam gyis zhog la thongs/ 'o na sdig pa chu yis 'khru mi nus na/ rnam 'joms sgo nas khrus byas pa'i phan yon la/ sdig pa thams cad byang byas nas/ /sdug bsngal thams cad med par byed/ /ces pa dang / sdig pa kun las rnam par grol/ /sogs phan yon mang po gsungs pa rdzun yin nam zer na/ thub rnams sdig pa chu yis mi 'khru zhing / /gsungs pa de sangs rgyas kyi chos la ma brten 589

par rang dgar 'gro ba'i sdig pa chu yis 'khru mi nus par dgongs nas de skad gsungs pa yin/ rnam 'joms na sdig pa kun las rnam par grol/ /gsungs pa de sngags dang ting nge 'dzin sogs dam pa'i chos kyi sgo nas chu byen gyis brlabs nas chu yis bkrus na 'dag pas na/ de la dgos nas de skad gsungs pa yin pas de ltar go na 'gal ba med/ 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal phyag gis mi sel gsungs pa yang / sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal mi sel na thang yang / sel nus pa re gnyis yod srid dar/ sngon paṇa chen nā ro bas tī lo ba'i drung du dka' chen bcu gnyis spyad dus/ na nas ro ltar gyur yod tshe/grub chen tī lo ba byon nas phyag gis byil ba re mdzad pas na tsha zug rngu thams cad sangs nas sngar ltar byed pa byung / nyid kyi rtogs pa gzhan la mi 'pho gsungs pa yang sems can thams cad la mi 'pho rung / skal ldan dad gus can gyi gdul bya la 'pho srid de/ sngon ma cig lab sgron mnyam bzhag la bzhugs na nye 'khor na yod tshad kyi rtog tshogs rang 'gag la song nab / mi rtog pa'i ngang du lhan lhan 'gro ba yin skad/ sngon jo bo chen pos rgya gar gyi slob ma zhig la sgom 'ong gi med pa ye shes kyi sbyan gyis gzigs nas khong gis bsgom byas tshe/ bod kyi 590

bu slob 'ga' res bla mas bsgoms pas slob mar phan nam zhus pas/ bla mas bsgoms pas slob mar mi phan na bla ma bsten nas ci bya gsungs skad/ gzhan yang sngon bla ma'i rtogs pa slob ma la 'phos nas rtogs grol dus gcig tu byung ba'i lo rgyus mang / yang las ma byas pa dang ri/ 'phrad/gsungs pa yang sems can rnams kyis rang rang gis las ma byas pa dang 'phrad mi srid pas de skad gsungs pa yen gyi/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyis sems can thams cad la gang 'dod sprul nas phun sum tshogs pa'i bde ba dang sprod pa yin pas/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi mthu las byung ba dang 'phrad srid/ sngon yi dwags 'ga' zhig la sangs rgyas dang / sangs rgyas kyi 'khor mo'u 'gal gye bu sogs dgra bcom byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis sngags dang ting nge 'dzin gyi byen gyis brlabs pas zas skom gnang bas/ bkres skom gyi sdug bsngal zhi bar byas pa'i gtam rgyud snang / des na bsngags bstod las/gang dang 'jig rten ma sprad pa'i/ /phun tshogs de yang gang zhig mchis/ /gsungs/ 'o na sangs rgyas kyis gnang ba de la 'phrad pa la yang las 'brel zhig dgos zer na/ de la gzhan mi dgos dad gus mos pa tsam byas pas chog go /des na sangs rgyas kyi mthu las 591

byung ba'i zas skom sogs kyi rgyus las bzang po yi dwags kho rang gis ma bsags par 'phrad byung ba yin pas/ las ma byas pa dang 'phrad pa yin zer dgos/ dkon mchog brtsegs pa las/ chos rnams thams cad rkyen bzhin te/ /'dun pa'i rtsa la rab tu gnas/ /gang gis smon lam ci btab pa/ /'bras bu de 'dra smin par 'gyur/ /gsungs pa'i don ltar sa thob kyi byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis sdug bsngal myong ba'i rgyu las ngan pa ma bsags kyang gzhan gye sdug bsngal mthong na snying rje skyes/gzhan gyi sdug bsngal tshur rang steng du 'byung ba'i 'dun pa drag po byas pas bla ma 'ga' res sdug bsngal dngos su blangs nas myang ba yang yod srid/ sngon mi gcig gis khyi rkun zhig la rdo rgyag pa bla ma zhig gis gzigs nas/ sdug bsngal dang len byas pas khyi la rdo brgyab pa na tsha ma byung bar/ bla ma'i sku rgyab spangs nas na ba byung ba sogs de 'dra'i gtam rgyud mang / de yang las ma byas pa 'dun pa byas 'phrad pa yin no/ /'o na sa thob kyi sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyis sems can gyi bde skyid 'phrog sdug bsngal dang sprod nus sam zer na/ de byed don med pas byed mi srid pa ma gtogs/ byed dgos pa byung na de yang byed nus/ byed mi thub pa gang yang med/ de ci'i phyir zhe 592

na/ skyon kun zad yon tan kun ldan sangs rgyas kyi khyad chos yin pa'i phyir ro/ /sngon grub chen nyi ma 'dzin sogs grub chen mang pos nyi ma stod la mnan/ o rgyan chen pos ri brag mang po gnas gcig nas gcig tu spos/ rwa los sa steng gi sems dpa' bcu gsum bgrongs na gzhan phal ba smos ci dgos/ rje btsun mi las/ dge bshes rtsag phub la bsnyun nad spos nas 'chi tshad pa byung / dgon pa zhig gi grwa pa rnams kyis khong la brdungs pas/ na tsha thams cad nang na brdung zer mkhan zhig yod pa de'i steng du byung nas 'chi tshad pa byung / sems can la phan na sangs rgyas byang sems bdud dang gnod sbyin rgyal gdon sogs su sprul nas/ dmu rgod sems can rnams 'dul ba yin te/ la la bdud kyi cha byad kyis/ /sems can rnams ni 'dul bar mdzad/ /'jig rten rnams kyis rtogs mi nus/ /gsungs/ sngon rkun ma 'ga' zhig gis mi rkang ba zha ba gcig gson por bsad nas khong rig tsho la lha gnod sbyin zhig yod pa der mchod snyam nas gsod grabs byas tshe/ mi rkang zha de skrag nas bya thabs gzhan ma byung / sangs rgyas la skyabs 'gro byas pas/ sangs rgyas gnod sbyin de 'dra zhig tu sprul nas 'ong mi 'di da res nga la gson por phul na dgos pa che zhes gsungs 593

tshe/ rkun ma rnams kyis gnod sbyin mngon sum du phebs pa yin snyam dga' bzhin phul ba/ tshur yul du khrid 'ong bas tshe thar pa byung / des na bla ma 'ga' res/ gdon sangs rgyas kyi rnam 'phrul yin zhes gsungs pa yin/ gzhan yang sems can la phan na sangs rgyas byang sems rnams stag dang seng ge dug sbrul chu chen/ ri brag sa chu me rlung nam mkha' sogs su sprul nas 'gro ba'i don mdzad par gsungs pas na/ spyir phyi snod nang bcud skye 'gro sems can bzang ngan 'bring gsum thams cad la sangs rgyas byang sems kyi 'du shes bzhag nas dad gus dag snang sbyongs pa gces/ khas gtong mi rung / yang mdo las/ lus can dag gi las rnams ni/ /bskal pa brgyar yang chud mi za/ /zhes las byas pa chud mi za gsungs pa yang dge sdig gi las gang yin yang rkyen bzang ngan gang gis kyang ma bcom na/ nam yang chud zos su mi 'gro bar skabs shig steng du smin nges pa la dgongs nas de skad gsungs pa yin gyi/ dper na gro nas btab pa nam zhig skyes nas 'bras bu smin pa bden kyang / than pas tshig pa'am phyugs kyis zos pa'am ser bas brdungs pa sogs 'gal rkyen dang 'phrad na 'bras bu mi smin pa ltar/ las dge ba byas pa la 'bras bu bde ba smin pa bden 594

kyang / zhe sdang skad cig gcig gis kyang / /bskal pa stong gi dge rtsa 'joms/ /gsungs pa ltar zhe sdang drag po skyes pa dang /gzhan yang nga rgyal rloms sems skyes dge ba gang byas mi la ngoms/ gzhan dge ba de las lhag byas pa la phrag dog skyes mi dge bcu sogs las ngan pa'i rkyen gyis bcoms na/ dge ba chud zos su song nas 'bras bu bde ba smin rgyu nam yang mi 'byung / dper na dug khong bar song na nam zhig na zug 'byung ba bden kyang / dug gsod pa'i rdzas sngags sman nus pa can rkyen dang 'phrad na na zug mi 'byung ba ltar/ las sdig pa'i 'bras bu sdug bsngal 'byung ba bden kyang / stobs bzhi'i bshags pa/ khyad par stong nyid kyi lta ba sogs gnyen po chos kyis bcoms na/ sdig pa yang chud zos su song nas nam yang 'bras bu sdug bsngal mi 'byung bar 'gyur te/ mdo las/ sngon chad bag med dbang du song na yang / /phyi nas bag dang ldan par gyur de la/ /dga' bo sor 'phreng mthong ldan bde byed bzhin/ /zla ba sprin bral bzhin du rnam par mdzes/ /gsungs/'on kyang sdig pa byas pa dge ba'i stobs kyis chud zos su gtong nus/ gang zag snying rus can sor 'phreng dang / rje btsun mi la lta bu re gnyis yin gyi/ gzhan gyis de ltar dka' 595

bas sdig pa'i las la 'dzem pa gces/ gal te bag med pa'i dbang gis cung zad re byas song na yang / dug khong du song ba lta bu'i gnong 'gyod kyis stobs bzhi'i bshags pa shugs drag la rgyun ring ba zhig bya dgos so/ /'o na las kyi 'bras bu gnyen pos bcoms nas chud zos su 'gro ba de bden na/ sngon byon skyes bu dam pa mang pos las kyi rnam smin ldog ma nus par myang ba'i lo rgyus mang po snang / de rnams kyis gnyen po mi shes ma bsten zer rgyu ci yod/ de rnams la khyod kyis ci byung ba yin zer na/ de ni so skye rnams la las rgyu 'bras kyi 'bras bu nam yang mi bslu bar 'byen nges pas/ srog la bab kyang sdig pa'i las la 'jem dgos zhes de lta bu'i tshul bstan pa tsam yin gyis/ nges par khong rnams sangs rgyas kyang myang ba yin snyams nas 'khrul bar mi bya/ de yin na bla ma skyes bu dam pa la yang las kyi rnam smin ldog pa'i nus pa ma mchis zhes skur pa btab par 'gyur/ de yin na dge ba zhe sdang sogs kyi rkyen gyis 'joms pa dang / sdig pa bshags pas 'dag gsungs pa sogs dang 'gal bas mi 'grigs pa mang po 'byung / de lta bu'i gsung rab kyi dgongs pa ma lon na 'khrul gzhi chen po 'byung bas blo gros can gyis rgyal ba'i gsung rab kyi dgongs 596

don 'tshol ba la 'bod/ tshad ldan gyi mkhas grub rnams kyi gsung la brten nas 'khrul med kyi nges pa rnyed pa gces/yang rgyal ba rnams thabs mkhas la thugs rje che ba yin pas/sems can rnams kyi khams dang bstun nas gang 'dul gyi skur sprul/ blo la gang phan gyi chos ston pa yin/ sdig can sangs rgyas kyis skyob nus/ sdig pa dge ba'i stobs kyis chud zos su gtong nus gsungs na/ 'ga' res sangs rgyas la 'brel bzhag chos byas na sdig pa'i skyon gyis mi gos par 'dug snyam nas sdig pa byed pa'i rigs la de skad mi gsungs par/ sdig can sangs rgyas kyis skyob nus rung mi skyob/ sdig pa gnyen po chos kyis chud gzan nus rung chud mi za zhes gsungs srid de/de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de skad gsungs na gang zag des sdig pa byas na sangs rgyas kyis mi skyobs shing sdig pa'i 'bras bu chud mi za bar sdug bsngal 'byung bar 'dug snyam/ sdig pa'i las srog la bab kyang mi byed par dge ba kho na bsgrub pa'i phyir ro/ /yang sdig can gyis sangs rgyas la 'brel ba bzhag rung skyob mi nus sdig pa'i 'bras bu dge bas bcoms nas chud zos su gtong mi nus zhes gsungs na/ sdig can 'ga' res da ci byas rung phyi mar song na bde ba zhig med snyam/ dge ba dor nas 597

sdig pa 'ba' zhig byed de/ sngon rgad po zhing lo zer ba zhig la gzhan gyis/ a byes/ thugs rje chen po la gsol ba thob ma ṇi re thon zhes bshad tshe/ 'o a myes thugs rje chen pos skyob sa med/ a byes las ngan/ ma ṇi gcig gis 'dag sa med gshin rje chos rgyal mdun du song na dbur dbur ra zhig yod zer/ ma ṇi yang mi 'don par rgas rung sdig pa byas/ tshe 'di'i bde ba bsgrub pa zhig byung / de 'dra'i rigs la sdig can sangs rgyas kyis skyob mi nus rung skyob nus/ chos byas nas sdig pa chud zos su gtong mi nus rung gtong nus zhes gsungs srid de/ sngon sangs rgyas kyi drung du pha ma bsad pa 'ga' re 'gyod nas 'ong ba la/ thog mar nyes dmigs gsung na bshags pa yang byed khom med par gsung de thos ma thag tu snying gas nas shi ste/ dmyal bar 'gro ba mkhyen nas thog mar/pha dang ma ni bsad bya yin gsungs nas bag phebs su bcugade nas chos kyi phan yon gsungs pas yid spro bar byas/ de nas bshags thabs gnyen po bstan pa'i lo rgyus mdo na yod/de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de skad gsungs na sdig can de yid dga' nas sdig 'phro rbad kyis bcad/ dkon mchog gsum la bcos ma ma yin pa'i dad gus khyad par can skyes/de nas bzung chos 598

kho na la 'bad pa'i phyir ro/ /mdor na rgyal ba sras bcas kyis sems can la gang phan pa de gsungs/ phan na chos min zhes blun po ma gtogs mkhas pa su zhig gis smra/ mdo rgyud dang bla ma dam pa'i gsung sgos na 'di lta bu'i tshig gi 'gal ba can mang yang / gsung de rnams kyi kha cig gis gang zag spyi la ma phan rung 'ga'u zhig la phan/ gsung kha cig gis gang zag 'ga' zhig la mi phan rung gzhan spyi la phan thogs pa yong /sems can la mi phan pa zhig gsungs mi srid/ des na thams cad la khas gtong mi rung dag snang sbyongs la rang rgyud la gang phan pa'i chos de nyams su longs/ rgyal ba rnams kyis 'o skol rnams la byes pa so so'i skye bo zhes byis pa'i ming btags/ 'o skol sems can rnams mngon mtho nges legs kyi go 'phang la 'god thabs su 'khor ba ngan song gi sdug bsngal khyad par 'dod yon gyi nyes dmigs gsungs nas skrag bslang / mtho ris thar pa'i bde ba khyad par chos byas pa'i phan yon gsungs nas teb bslang / drang don gyi chos sna tshogs bstan nas mgo g.yogs nas nges don du yar thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang la 'god pa yin/ chos gcig gsungs pas sems can kun thul bar dka'/ dper na byes 599

pa gcig yar bde sa zhig tu 'khrid pa la pha ma sogs mi rgan bsam shes gcig gis thabs sna tshogs pa'i mgo ma g.yogs na/nges nges gcig bshad pas kha la mi nyan pa la ltos dang ha go yong / des na rgyal ba rnams kyis byis pa so so'i skye bo rnams 'dul thabs su/ gang la gang 'dul de la der ston pa/ /gsungs pa ltar/ gang 'dul gyi thabs chos mi 'dra ba sna tshogs pa gsungs pa yin/ 'o na mi rgan gyis byes pa'i mgo g.yogs pa ltar/ rgyal ba rnams kyis chos sna tshogs bstan nas sems can gyi mgo g.yogs pa yin na/ sangs rgyas kyis kyang rdzun gsungs pa yin nam zer na/ pha ma sems can 'phral yun du bde thabs su dper na gsod pa 'tshol du 'gro ba la mthong rung ma mthong smra ba lta bu/ las dang po pa theg pa la gsar du zhugs pa nges don la skrag pa skye ba la re zhig gi bar du/ chos thams cad la bdag med pa yod gsungs pa lta bu'i phan pas rdzun smra srid de/ rje mi las/ mi mngon nam mkha'i dbyings shed na/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas zhal rdzun mkhan/ /gsungs/sangs rgyas kyis kyang chos thams cad sgyu ma rmi lam ltar dzun pa bslu ba'i rang bzhin yin pas/ des na nga yang rdzun du smra'o/ /gsungs/ dzun gsung na/ nam mkha'i khams ni rnam pa gzhan 600

gyur kyang / /khyod ni mi bden pa yi tshig mi gsung / /zer ba de rdzun yin nam zer na/ sems can thams cad mngon mtho nges legs kyi bde ba dang sprod pa'i thabs su rdzun ltar snang tsam gsungs pa ma gtogs/ de 'dra'i don med par rang dgar dang / sems can rnams bslu ba'i dzun tshig gtan nas smra mi srid pas na/ de la dgongs nas de skad gsungs pa yin pas dgongs don lon dgos/ de dang de 'dra ba'i kha mi mthun pa rgyal ba'i gsung rab mdo rgyud bstan bcos na brgya stong snang bas/ de dag la blun po rnams kyis tshig gi ngos nas dpyad na 'gal ba ltar snang yang / mkhas pas don gyi dgongs pa gang yin dpyad na/ sems can rnams la 'phral phugs su nyes skyon mi 'ong bar yon tan bskyed pa'i thabs sha stag yin pas/ don gyi ngos nas 'gal ba yang spu tsam med/ rgyal ba rnams kyis chos thams cad mkhyen cing 'gro ba kun la nye ring med par brtse bas sems can rnams kyi phyed la phan pa'i chos dang / phyed la gnod pa'i log chos shig ston mi srid pas/ des na rgyal ba'i gsung rab kyi dgongs pa lon na legs/ gal te ma lon rung gzhan chos dang gang zag la skyon yod par ma zad drud gis 'gro yang / kun mkhyen ma thob bar du de kun skyon yin 601

nam yon tan yin shes dka' bas/ pho tshod byas gzhan la khas gtong gtan nas mi rung bas/ gang la dad gus dag snang sbyongs la rang nyid gang mos chos de nyams su longs la sdod dang / de gdams ngag kun gyi nang nas zab shos shig yin pas kun gyis thugs la 'dzin par zhu/smras pa/ tshe yi lha mchog mgon po tshe dpag med/ /shes rab lha mchog rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /nor gyi lha mchog mgon po dzam bha la/ /lha mchog gsum gyis rtag tu bu bzhin skyongs/ /mi khom gnas su bskal pa brgyad khri'i bar/ /btsal kyang rnyed dka'i mi lus thob dus 'dir/ /dam pa'i chos kyi glu dbyangs len la spro/ /skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams dga' bas nyon/ /yid bzhin nor bur thun mong dngos grub rigs/ /'byung yang mchog gi dngos grub 'byung mi 'gyur/ /mi lus la brten mdo sngags chos byas na/ /mchog thun dngos grub char bzhin 'bab pa mtshar/ /dal 'byor tshang ba'i mi lus rin po che/ /yid bzhin nor las lhag pa thob dus 'dir/ /sdug bsngal 'byung gnas khyim du gnas byas na/ /nor bu mi gtsang 'dam du 'phangs pa 'dra/ /nor bu rgyal mtshan rtser bzhag mchod pa ltar/ /dben pa'i gnas su mdo sngags nyams blangs 602

na/ /lha mi yongs kyis smon pa'i gnas yin pas/ /smon gnas thog tu slebs dus ma 'chug cig /dgra jag gcan gzan me chu g.yangs la sogs/ /lus 'di don med chud zos btang gyur na/ /phye leb mar mer mchongs dang khyad par med/ /de 'dra'i snying med spyon pa ma byed cig /rten bzang yun ring 'tsho phyir tshe sgrub dang / /tshe thar srog blu sprang bor sbyin gtong dang / /tshe yi bar chad sel ba'i sku rim dang / /bla ma lha la skyabs 'jug zhu ba gces/ /sngon gyi skyes bu dam pa thams cad kyis/ /tshe 'di blos thongs gsungs pa ma gtogs pa/ /lus 'di chud zos thongs zhes ma gsungs pas/ /de phyir lus 'di 'tsho ba mkhas pa'i lugs/ /sa rlan nyal dang chu rul 'thung ba sogs/ /lus la tshe mjug nad gcong 'jug pa'i rgyu/ /thams cad spangs nas sa chu 'phrod nges kyi/ /dben pa'i gnas su zab lam bsgom par mdzod/ /gsang sngags lugs la phung lnga rigs lnga ru/ /bltas nas mchod pa'i tshul du zas gos sogs/ /phul na des kyang bsod nams tshogs rdzogs 'gyur/ /bsam bzhin lus la brnyas smod byed mi rung / /lus la nad tsha sdug bsngal mi gtong bar/ /shin tu dar du bcug nas gsang sngags la/ /spyad na bde stong rtogs pa khyad par can/ /skyes nas lam la sa chod 603

chen po yong / /seng ma'i rjes su seng phrug 'brangs pa bzhin/ /mkhas grub gong ma'i rnam thar rjes 'brangs nas/ /'dod yon glu gar rol mo'i sgra dang bcas/ /gsang sngags bskyed rdzogs spyod la rjes yi rang / /'dod yon ma spangs rgyan du rol bzhin du/ /tshe gcig sangs rgyas sa ru bsgod pa yi/ /rnal 'byor pholo kha yis gtong mi rung / /dad gus dag snang byed bzhin mchod bstod bkur/ /shes rab can gyis mdo sngags gang gi skabs/ /gnang bkag so mtshams shes nas nyams blangs na/ /'gal ba phar zhog gcig grogs gcig gis byas/ /myur du sangs rgyas thob pa'i grogs su 'gyur/ /byang chub sems dpas thabs mkhas mdzad pa'i skabs/ /chos dang 'jig rten gnyis ka zung 'brel kyang / /'gal ba phar zhog gcig grogs gcig gyur nas/ /bstan dang 'gro don rlabs chen 'byung ba mtshar rtsa rlung mkhan gyi thig le rgyas skabs su/ /yungs 'bru tsam yang ma nyams bsrung dgos kyang / /ma thub shor na pad+mar lha tshogs bsgoms/ /mchod par mos na nyes med tshogs rdzogs gsungs//grub thob 'ga' res dngos dbang bskur dus dang / /bstan dang 'gro ba yongs la phan pa'i phyir/ /rigs bzang bkug nas gdung brgyud spel ba la/ /sngags la lam khyer dmigs pa mang 604

ba'i phyir/ /de dag gang la ma smod dag snang sbyongs/ /mdor na gzhan gyi chos dang gang zag la/ /skyon 'dra yod par ma zad drud 'gro yang / /mngon shes med pas skyon dang yon tan gnyis/ /gang yin mi shes snyam du dag snang gyis/ /bdag kyang deng nas tshe rabs kun tu yang / /dal 'byor rten thob bla ma bzang dang mjal/ /gang la dad gus dag snang sbyongs bzhin du/ /mdo sngags lam bzang nyams su len par sgon/ /'di 'dra'i glu la zad pa mi 'dug ste/ /ha cang mang na kun gyi rna ba sun/ /skabs 'dir de ka tsam gyis chog par byas/ /smra bsam brjod 'das ngang la 'jog par bya/ /glu 'di thos tshad rnal 'byor pho mo kun/ /dga' spro dad gus dag snang byed bzhin du/ /gsang sngags bskyed rdzogs nyams su blangs pa'i mthus/ /zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang dbang myur thob shog /ces pa bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /da ni sngar gyi gang bshad pa rnams la yid ches nges shes lhag par skye ba'i phyir du bla na med pa'i mdo sngags kyi lung dang / rgya bod kyi mkhas grub tshad ldan rnams kyi gsung rdo rje tshig rnams lung du drangs/ rigs pas kyang bsgrubs nas slar yang rgya cher bshad par bya ste/ de yang ji skad du/ bla ma'i yon 605

tan yongs su bzung ba'i rgyud las/ bsod nams don du bud med ni/ /zla ba ltar dkar bzhin bzang ma/ /lha yi dri bzang gis bgos nas/ /dad pas slob dpon la phul na/ /rgyal po zla ba'i 'byor ba dang / /thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes dag /bram ze btsun mos mchod las byung / /zhes dang / nā ro bas/ltos med bla ma sangs rgyas la/ /shes rab yon phul rnal 'byor bde/ /zhes dang / tshe ring mched lngas rje btsun la/ bka' rgyud sde bla na med pa nas/ /lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin gyi/ /bu mo 'gug ces gsungs pas na/ /bsnyen bkur rnams kyi nang nas kyang / /phyag rgya ya mtshan che'o gsungs/ /de phyir bdag cag 'dir mchis so/ /da mkhyen par mdzod cig rnal 'byor pa/ /gcer bu'i lus la gzi mdangs can/ /zhes zhus pas/ rje btsun mi la'i zhal nas/ mchod pa rnams kyi nang nas kyang / /mtshan ldan phyag rgya 'bul ba 'di/ /khyad par 'phags pa'i 'bul ba yin/ /gsungs nas las kyi phyag rgyar bzhes/ grub thob sa ra has/ mda' mkhan gyi bu mo phyag rgyar bzhes nas/ da snga phan chad dge slong min/ /de ring dus nas dge slong ste/ /tshangs par spyod na dge slong yin/ /he ru ka dpal dge slong mchog /gsungs/ gzhan yang gsang dbang ni/ bla ma yab 606

yum gyi sbyor mtshams nas byang sems babs pa slob ma'i lces len par bshad/ slob ma rtog pa che na rdzas gzhan dang bsres nas ster bar bshad/ rdo rje gur las/ rdo rje sor mo rab sbyar gyis/ /rdo rje sa gzhir rab bskul te/ /rdo rje sems su rnam byung ba/ /rdo rje lce yis bza' bar bya/ /zhes dang / brtag gnyis las/ brten pa de las gang byung bas/ /mthe bong srin lag dag gis ni/ /slob ma'i kha ru ltung bar bya/ /gsungs/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi dus su/ phyag rgya'i lag g.yon bla ma'i g.yas kyis bzung nas slob ma la gtad la/ 'dir ni khyod kyi dpang bo yin/ /bdag gis 'di la 'di gtad do/ /lha mo phyag rgya chen po ni/ /dpag med bde ba rab ster ba/ /bu yis kun nas blangs nas ni/ /bla na med pa'i mchod pa gyis/ /thabs gzhan gyis ni 'tshang mi rgya/ /de bas rig pa 'di mchog yin/ /chos kun gnyis su med pa la/ /dngos po gnyis su btags pa yin/ /de bas 'khor ba rnams bral bar/ /rtag tu khyod kyis mi bya'o/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /rig pa'i brtul zhugs bla med pa'o/ /rmongs pa gang zhig 'das gyur na/ /dngos grub mchog kyang 'grub mi 'gyur/ /zhes byin nas/ phyag rgyas/dpa' bo bu ni bla ma med/ /dpa' bo khyod ni spro'am ci/ /bshang 607

ba gci ba bza' ba dang / /sha dang khu khrag de bzhin te/ /bu khyod ci dgar spro gyur tam/ /bud med rtag tu gus pa dang / /bdag gi pad+mar 'o byed pa/ /bu khyod ci bzhed bden par spros/ /zhes 'dri ba la/ khu khrag la sogs bza' ba dang / /bud med rnams la rtag gus dang / /bha ga'i pad+mar 'o byed pa/ /lha mo ci phyir bdag mi spro/ /zhes brjod pas rig ma de dgyes nas skra bkrol/ gos dang bral bar byas te/ chu skyes phye nas gsal bar ston cing / e ma bdag gi pad+ma ni/ /bde ba thams cad yang dag ldan/ /gang zhig cho gas bsten byed pa/ /de yi mdun na bdag gnas so/ /sangs rgyas bsten pa la sogs pa/ /pad+mar bya ba ji bzhin gyis/ /bde chen rgyal po rang nyid ni/ /'di nyid du ni rtag tu zhugs/ /blun po gang zhig 'di spong ba/ /de la mchog gi dngos grub med/ /ces brjod pa'i mthar gnyis ka snyoms par zhugs/ lhan skyes kyi dga' ba mngon du byas nas lha mo de dgyes nas rkang pa g.yon pa mgo la bzhag nas/ de ring phan chad bu khyod kyis/ /ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar/ /rmi lam bzhin du sems can gyi/ /bla na med pa'i don byos shig /bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pa yi/ /'di ni man ngag las ni shes/ /rig pa 'di ni dor byas na/ /thabs gzhan gyis ni 608

sangs mi rgya/ /brtul zhugs rnams kyi mchog gi mchog /rig ma'i brtul zhugs bu yis spyod/ /ces gsang dbang bskur tshul rgyas par gsang 'dus sogs nas bshad do/ /mkha' 'gro snyan brgyud kyi dbang chog las kyang / rig ma'i brtul zhugs kyi dbang bskur tshul ni/ shes rab kyi lag pa slob ma'i lag par sbyin/ de gnyis rang gi g.yon pas bzung nas/ 'dir ni khyed rnams dpang po yin/ /bdag gis 'di la 'di gtad do/ /zhes sangs rgyas thams cad dpang po byas nas slob ma la 'di bsgo/ thabs gzhan gyis ni sangs rgyas min/ /'gro gsum 'di yang dag pa yin/ /de phyir 'di dang bral bar ni/ /khyod kyis nam yang ma byed cig /'di ste sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /rig ma'i brtul zhugs bla na med/ /rmongs pa gang zhig 'da' byed na/ /de la mchog gi dngos grub med/ /gsungs/ gsang dbang bskur dus/ phyag rgya rdo rje phag mo de'i lag pa nas bla mas bzung ste/ lha mo 'di ni phyag rgya che/ /bde ba mtha' yas ster byed ma/ /blangs nas bu yis dus kun tu/ /bla na med pa'i mchod pa gyis/ /zhes gtad/ phyag rgya des/ dpa' bo bu khyod ci la spro/ /byang chub sems ni bza' ba dang / /rigs lnga las ni rab tu byung / /rig ma gus pas yang dag mchod/ /bshang gci 609

stobs dang dri chen sogs/ /de ni so sor bza' ba dang /gzhan yang mjes pa'i dam tshig rnams/ /ji ltar spro ba bu yis smos/ /zhes dri ba la/ ji ltar gsung ba'i dam tshig rnams/ /lha mo ci phyir bdag mi spro/ /dam tshig thams cad bskyangs pa'i phyir/ /pad+ma rtag tu cis mi mchod/ /de nas des rang gi bha ga rgyas pa lag gis phye/ e ma nga yi pad+ma 'di/ /bde ba thams cad kyi ni gnas/ /gang zhig cho ga bzhin bsten na/ /bdag ni de yi mdun gnas te/ /bde ba'i cho ga thams cad ni/ /ji ltar bya ba pad+mas bgye/ /zhes brjod cing snyoms par zhugs pas dga' ba bzhi'i bde stong gi ye shes mngon sum du myong dgos par gsungs so/ /gzhan yang sam bu ṭa las/shin tu bzhin bzang mig yangs ma/ /rang gi dbang bskur snying rje can/ /rdo rje bu mo 'di khyer la/ /spyod par bya ba rtog par bya/ /zhes dang / rdo rje 'phreng ba'i rgyud las/ de nas bla ma dam pa yis/ /slob ma de la phyag rgya gtad/ /hūṃ dang phaṭa kyis nor bu'i sgor/ /bkod de rdo rje rab bskyod bya/ /zhes dang / phyag rgya lam rdzogs su/ ma dang bu mo sring mo yang / /khyad par can gyis bsten gyur na/ /yon tan 'byung gi skyon du min/ /zhes dang / lo tshad kyang / bcu gcig ma dang bcu gnyis ma/ /bcu drug ma dang nyi shu ma/ /nyi 610

shu bzhi lon bar du bsten/ /ces gsungs/ yon tan yang rje mi las/ phyag rgya bzhi la mtshan nyid 'tshal/ /pad can mdangs ldan bde ba rgyas/ /dung can nyams dga' bde ba myur/ /ri mo gting zab zag pa med/ /glang pos dngos po'i gnas lugs rtogs/ /de phyir chags lam sbyor ba yis/ /khyod kyang nges par thar pa 'thob/ /nga yang skye med btsan sa zin/ /skal bar ldan no mtshan ldan ma/ /gsungs/ gzhan yang / bcu gnyis ma bsten na dus gsum gyi mkha' 'gro ma thams cad kyis byen gyis rlobs/ bcu drug mas 'dod pa'i dngos grub chen po ster/nyi shu mas nam mkha' 'phur ba'i dzu 'phrul ster/ nyi shu rtsa bzhi mas rang byin gyis brlabs pa thob par bshad/ nā ros/ des kyang bsgoms bskyed ma byung zhing / /ting 'dzin brtan par ma gyur na/ /las kyi phyag rgya mtshan ldan la/ /lam lnga 'bras bu thob par gyis/ /gsungs/ dam pa dang po'i rgyud las/ chags bral lta bu'i sdig pa med/ /bde las gzhan pa'i bsod nams med/ /ces dang / brtag gnyis las/ mchog thob pa yi bud med gang / /rtog pa thams cad yang dag spangs/ /yang na bdag gi nus pa yis/ /lha dang lha ma yin rnams dang / /gnod sbyin mi'am ci las kyang / /phyag rgya bkug la rab tu brtag /de 611

yang khyer la spyod pa bya/ /zhes dang / sdom 'byung las/ pad+ma mchog la reg byed pas/ /lo gcig bar du ma byas na/ /sgrub pa'i dam tshig spangs byas nas/ /nyin re'am ni zla re 'am/ /yang na de bzhin lo re la/ /ji bzhin byin gyis brlabs byas na/ /phyag rgya'i dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / slob dpon chen pos/ gzhan gyis grol bar mi 'gyur te/ /gzhan lus phyag rgya bsten gyur na/ /phung po lhag med sangs rgyas thob/ /ces dang / pha dam pa'i zhal nas/ mchog gi dngos grub 'dod na las kyi phyag rgya bsten dgos gsungs/ yang gtum mo zla gcig bsgoms pa bas kyang / las rgya nub gcig bsten pa bogs che gsungs/ til+lis/ phyag rgya la brten bde stong ngang gis 'char/ /tshe ring mgyogs la skyon rnams mtha' dag sel/ /skra dkar med cing rang lus zla ltar rgyas/ /mdangs gsal stobs 'phel ci 'dod las la sbyor/ /thun mong myur 'grub mchog la brtson par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / nā ros/ gdol ba'i bu mo bkug nas ni/ /brtul zhugs spyod pa bskyang par bya/ /dngos grub tshe 'dir nges par 'grub/ /ces dang / rje mar bas/rang lus rgyas pa'i dkyil 'khor shes/ /rtsa rlung thig le rgyas pa'i phyir/ /sha chang mi bsten rang la sdig /gzhan lus lam du 612

slongs tsa na/ /las kyi phyag rgya'i gdams ngag yod/ /phyag rgya mi bsten rang la sdig /gsungs/ rje mi las/ zag bcas lus kyi bde ba las/ /zag med sems la rtog pa 'char/ /lam pho nya'i bgrod pa ngo mtshar che/ /zhes dang / dwags po lha rjes/ gsung rab tshar gcig bzhengs pa las/ rlung thun gcig bsgom pa dang / las rgya nub gcig bsten pa bsod nams che gsung skad/dpal phag mo grub pas kyang / rang bzhin bde la 'dod gyur cing / /gzhan gyi don du 'gyur ba na/ /khams gsum gang ba'i bu mo la/ /rang nyid longs spyod bya dus yin/ /zhes dang / rje gling ras pas/ tshe gcig lus gcig la sangs rgya bar 'dod na las kyi phyag rgya'i gdams ngag dgos/ zhes yang yang gsungs/rje rgya ras kyis/ bde stong lam du 'khyer tsa na/ /las kyi phyag rgya'i gdams ngag yod/ /ces dang / rje rdzing kha rtogasi ldan gyis/chags lam pad+ma'i tshal na bung ba nga / /bde stong sbrang rtsis myos shing glu 'di 'then/ /gsungs/ gsang 'dus las/ dka' thub dka' spyad mi zad pas/ /bsten na 'grub par mi 'gyur gyi/ /'dod pa kun la longs spyod pas/ /bsten na myur du 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / dgyes rdor las/ 'dod chags kyis bskyed 'jig rten pa/ /'dod chags spangs na brlag par 613

'gyur/ /rdo rje chags pa yongs shes na/ /yid ni rdo rje sems dpar 'gyur/ /chags pa'i zhags pas rnam bcings pas /'jig rten chags pas myos par bshad/ /chags dang bral ba'i byang chub ni/ /chags pa mchog ldan rnams kyis smad/ /ces dang / lce spyang tshogs rol gyi rgyud las/ snang ba thams cad zil gyis gnon/ /ngo tsha gtsang sbra'i rtog pa bral/ /kun kyang gcer bu'i cha lugs kyis/ /kun tu rgyu yi mchod pa bya/ /zhes dang / sgyu 'phrul dra ba las/ mchod pa chen po 'dod chags che/ /sems can thams cad dga' bar byed/ /ces dang / rdo rje gur las/ bdag nyid he ru gar bsgom la/ /rang gi btsun mo lhar bsgoms te/ /chags chen gyis ni 'dod byed pa/ /de rnams la ni nga mnyes 'gyur/ /zhes dang / brtag gnyis las/ 'dod chags chen po rjes chags pa/ /g.yung mos sku la 'khyud pa nyid/ /ces dang / sam bu ṭa las/ rgod dang blta dang lag bcings dang / /gnyis gnyis 'khyud dang rnam pa bzhi/ /srin bu'i tshul gyis rgyud bzhir gnas/ /zhes dang / phyag rgya'i dngos grub dngos grub che/ /dngos grub kun gyi gong na med/ /ces dang /snyan rgyud las/ des na rdo rje'i lus la gnad du bsnun/ /tshe 'dir sangs rgyas ster bar the tshom med/ /ces dang / lwa ba 614

bas kyang / gnyid dang chang dang bud med gsum/ /dbang po dman pas spangs byed kyang / /rnal 'byor pa yi lam mchog yin/ /zhes dang / rdo rje 'phreng ba'i rgyud las/ snyigs ma lnga zhes bya ba'i dus/ /sems can myur du dngos grub 'dod/ /snod du bya ba 'dod pa yin/ /zhes dang / nā ros/ yon tan can gyis dben gnas su/ /shes pa skyo yang bsten du rung / /gsungs/gsang 'dus rtsa rgyud las/ chags can ye shes 'dod pa yis/ /rtag tu 'dod pa'i yon tan bsten/ /gsungs/ brtag gnyis kyi spyod pa'i skabs las/ gal te dga' bas glu blangs te/ /de tshe rdo rje mchog ldan no/ /gal te dga' ba skyes pa na/ /thar pa'i rgyur ni gar bya ste/ /de tshe rdo rje rkang bas gar/ /yo gis mnyam par bzhag pas byed/ /ces dang / rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ rang bzhin lam la brten nas ni/ /thams cad byas kyang grol bar 'gyur/ /zhes dang / mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho las/ chags med sbyad bya rnal 'byor pa/ /dngos po kun la thams cad che/ /'khor ba'i 'dam gyi dbus su yang / /gos med mya ngan 'das par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /'od bsrung gis zhus pa'i mdo las/ 'od bsrung 'di lta ste/ dper na sngags dang sman gyis yongs su zin pa'i dug gis ni 'chi bar byed mi nus so/ /'od 615

bsrung de bzhin du shes rab dang thabs mkhas pas yongs su zin pa'i nyon mongs pas kyang log par ltung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /gsungs/ sasbu ṭa las/ bza' dang bca' ba ci snyed pa/ /rnal 'byor pas ni bza' bar bya/ /ro ni thal bas bsgos byas shing / /ro yi gos kyang bgo bar bya/ /zhes dang / brtag gnyis las/ de la ga bur rgyu yi phyir/ /sha ni bza' ba nyid du bya/ /khyad par du yang chang nyid do/ /zhes dang / gsang 'dus las/ phyi ru nyan thos spyod pa skyongs/ /nang du 'dus pa'i don la dga'/ /zhes dang / slob dpon chen pos/ phyi ltar lag len mdo sde'i lugs su spyad/ /rgyu 'bras spang blang zhib pa'i dgos pa yod/ /nang ltar gsang sngags thun mong lugs su spyod/ /bskyed rdzogs don dang 'brel ba'i dgos pa yod/ /gsang ba gsang chen a ti'i lugs su spyod/ /tshe gcig 'od skur grol ba'i dgos pa yod/ /gsungs/ sems kyi sgrib sbyong las/ rnam shes ngan pas bsten byas na/ /'dod pas 'ching ba nyid du 'gyur/ /de nyid mkhas pas bsten byas na/ /'dod pas thar pa rab tu sgrub/ /ces dang / rang lhar sbyor ba'i bdag nyid kyis/ /'gro ba'i don byed brtson ldan pas/ /rnal 'byor 'dod yon longs spyod kyang / /grol 'gyur gos par mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang / ye shes 616

rgyas pa'i mdo las/ ji ltar sgyu ma'i mkhan po dag /rang gis sprul ba'i sgyu ma la/ /dge dang mi dge 'du byed pa/ /nyes pa gang gis mi gos ltar/ /thabs la mkhas pas rnam par spyod/ /ces dang / phal po che las/ gang dag sems can don 'gyur ba'i/ /thabs de rgyal sras bslab pa'i mchog /sprin las char chen babs pa yis/ /lo tog phun sum tshogs par byed/ /gsungs/btsun mo do ha las/ rang gi bu mo sring mo tsha mo ma dang ni/ /g.yung mo tshos ma smad 'tshong gos ras kyis 'tsho ba/ /sngo bsang dang ni dkar dmar ser sham smug nag ma/ /sme sha can la rgyud sbyangs blangs pa'i phyag rgya ni/ /bcu drug lo lon rab tu mdzes shing skra ser li/ /kha las dris khyab nu ma sra mkhregs sked pa phra/ /smad kyi zheng rgyas bha ga rub cing chags pa'i mdangs/ /rgyangs ma dang bcas gsang thub gus pas rab tu gzhol/ /dad pa rab tu brtan cing rtogs pa chung gyur dang / /rtags gsum ldan pa'i phyag rgya dbang gis smin par byas/ /yon tan bzung nas rang gi rig pa'i ye shes sbyin/ /skabs su ro snyoms spyod pa'i phyag rgyas bzung / /zhes dang / yang btsun mo do ha chung ngu las/ /rig ma mchog la lhan cig skyes pa yang yang smin pa ni/ /thabs kyi mchog tu bla ma dam pas gsungs pas na/ /gang skyes lhan 617

cig skyes pa yin no gzhan ma gcig kyang med/ /ma mchu'i ro btung bde chen gnyug ma mchog /de ltar rgyun du yid la sā ra nga yis byas/ /rgyan dang gre bzang ro mchog rol mo dang / /reg bya mchog dang gar dang rdo rje'i glu/ /bdud rtsi lnga dang sgron ma tha ma dang / /'dod chags la sogs tshim pas yid kyis spyad/ /ces dang / ka kha do ha las/ ka ni yum gyi pad+ma'i nang du gnas pa ste/ /lus rnams bcings shing bdud rtsi 'dzag /mgul nas 'khyud pa'i gdol ba'i gzhon nu ma/ /byang sems 'dzag cing 'di ni dbyed ga'i yal kha yin/ /zhes dang / lhan skyes mchog ni gang gis 'ching mi nus/ /ha ni kye ho rgod pa yi/ /rtse ba sna tshogs kyis ni tshim/ /rmongs pas ma 'phrog de dang de nyid de/ /dbang phyug dbyibs med kha dog dus gsum med/ /ku re rtsed mos bla med legs par 'grub par 'gyur/ /gsungs/ rje mi las/ ras chung ba la/ phyag rgya mtshan ldan grogs su gces/ /nyams myong bde ba sems la gces/ /gsungs/ pha dam pas/bla ma char chung ba la/ las kyi phyag rgya brten na bde stong rgyun chad med do bu/ /zhes dang / ding ri brgyad cu las/ bde stong 'phrul 'khor pi wang khong rgyus 'dra/ /mthun rkyen las kyis sbyor ro ding ri ba/ /gsungs/ bde mchog rā li las/ bum pa'i 618

dbang thob dge bsnyen de/ /gsang ba'i dbang thob dge tshul yin/ /shes rab ye shes dge slong ste/ /rdzogs pa dge slong chen po yin/ /zhes dang / dus 'khor las/ khyed ni rtag tu bud med rnams dang sbyor yang dkar po mi 'dor tshangs par spyod pa ste/zhes dang / dgyes rdor las/ btsun mo'i bha ga bde chen du/ /ston pa sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan/ /gtso bo dpe byad brgyad cus spras/ /khu ba zhes byar rnam par grags/ /de med pas ni bde med 'gyur/ /nus pa med phyir ltos dang bcas/ /zhes bde stong sku dang ye shes mtshan dang dpe byad thams cad kyang phyag rgya ma la brten nas thig le ma nyams par spel ba la ltos dgos so/ /kye rdor gyi rgyud las/ rigs su skye dang dam tshig can/ /smyo med kye yi rdo rje ston/ /bla ma la gus snying rje can/ /skye zhing skye bar 'gyur bar shog /lag pas rdo rje dril bu 'khrol/ /zab mo'i chos ni klog pa dang / /btsun mo'i khu ba mnyam zas can/ /skye zhing skye bar 'gyur bar shog /ces smon lam kyang 'debs dgos na khas gtong ga la rung / yang rgyud de nyid las/ tshal dang skye bo med gnas dang / /bdag gi khyem gyi nang du yang / /gcer bu phyag rgya che byas nas/ /rnal 'byor rig pas rtag tu mchod/ /tsum+bha 'khyud pa byas nas ni/ /de bzhin bha gar reg pa 619

nyid/ /skyes pa'i sna ni gzhib pa nyid/ /ma mchu'i sbrang rtsi btung ba nyid/ /rtag tu myos pa'i mtshan ma las/ /bo la ldan pas lag pas bya/ /khyogs dang brla zhes bya ba dang / /de bzhin shin tu bkal ba nyid/ /yang yang rdo rjes 'dod par bya/ /steng dang 'og tu lta ba nyid/ /dngos grub rgyas pa thob pa ste/ /sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam par 'gyur/ /gsungs/ 'grel chen las/ pho mtshan steng du gnas pa dang / /mdun du rgyab nas mi mo yis/ /rim pas rked pa 'degs par bya/ /mi mo'i khyogs su rab tu grags/ /mi mo'i pus mo'i mthil blangs nas/ /g.yas dang g.yon gyi dpung ba yis/ /sbyar te steng gi ka ra na/ /gnyis ka steng du phyogs par gnas/ /brla zhes bya ba'i mtshan nyid do/ /ngang ba'i gshog pa mtshungs rnam pa/ /gan rkyal pa ru rab tu grags/ /rkang ba rab tu brkyangs gyur pa/ /gnyis kyis rab tu brkyangs pa'o/ /zhes pa la sogs pa gsungs so/ /sngags rim chen mo las/ gnas khyad par can du rig ma nyi shu dang lhan cig tu lag pas phyag rgya dang glu'i mchod pa dang / gar la sogs pa'i sbyor bas nyin mtshan du rol nas phyag rgya chen po'i go 'phang sgrub pa ste/ rgyal po in+t+ra zu nyis/ 'di la brten nas phyag rgya chen po grub par spyod bsdus las gsungs so/ /gsungs/620

gzhan yang gsang ba'i gnas rje bdag nyid chen po'i gsungs mkhas grub rjes zin bris mdzad pa las/ 1bla ma dang rdo rje 'chang gi zhabs la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /'dir rgyud sde nas lan cig ma yin par yang yang gsungs pa'i phyag rgya'i srog rtsol gyi gnad mthar thug pa/rje btsun bla ma'i legs bshad thun mong ma yin pa gsang ba las kyang ches gsang ba'i gnad rnams brjed byang du bri bar 'tshal na/ bla ma dang yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams kyis gnang ba mdzad nas bde chen mchog gi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ de la las rgya la brten pa'i dgos pa ni/ de brten pas srog rtsol dbu mar zhugs te/ yas babs dang mas brtan gyi dga' bzhi bskyed pa'i ched yin no/ /des na thabs kyi mchog 'di bshad pa la gsum/ las kyi phyag rgya'i mtshan nyid/ srog rtsol du 'gro ba'i gdams ngag dngos/thabs de la brten nas dga' bzhi bskyed cing bde stong sbyor tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ rnal 'byor bzhi rim sogs nas gsungs pa'i pad+ma can la sogs pa bzhi'i don ni/ rtsa'i dbyibs mi 'dra ba sogs bzhi'i sgo nas btags pa yin la/ de yang dhu tī'i mas sna'i dbang du byas pa yin/ de'i rnam pa ji bzhin pa ni yas sna kun rdzob kyis mtshon par byed do/ /des na glang po can gyi rtsa'i 621

mar sna g.yon nas g.yas su cung zad 'khyil ba'i rnam par yod la/ de'i rtags rtsa de'i yas sna yod phyogs kyi bud med de'i sna g.yas su 'khyil ba'i rnam pa can la sogs pa'i las kyi phyag rgya de glang po can gyi rigs su gtogs pa yin no/ /dung can ma ni rtsa de'i mas sna dung dkar gyi kha lta bu 'khyil zhing sbubs ring ba zhig yod pas/ de'i rtags la rtsa'i yas sna yod phyogs kyi skra dang sna yang ring ba la sogs pa'i las rgya de dung can ma'i rigs su shes par bya'o/ /ri dwags can ma ni rtsa de'i mas sna ri dwags gla ba'i lte ba 'dra ba kha rtsub cing gor mo'i rnam pa can du yod pa'i rtsa de'i kha shin tu 'tshol dka' bas/des na rnal 'byor pas sen mos btsal dgos pa sogs gsungs so/ /de'i rtags la yas sna'i phyogs kyi sna la ri mo yod la/ der ma zad lus gzhan las sbom pa sogs yin no/ /pad+ma can ni mas sna me tog pad+ma'i dbyebs lta bur yod pa'i/ rtsa de'i kha btsal sla zhing 'byed par sla bas phyag rgya'i mchog tu gsu ngas pa yin no/ /de'i rtsa'i mas sna'i phyogs de'i sna ni dza ba'i me tog ltar yod par gsungs pa yin no/ /de ltar phyag rgya bzhi'i rtsa la mi 'dra ba'i khyad par de ltar yod pa'i sgo nas pad+ma can sogs su bzhag pa'i don de nyid rang gi bla ma kho na'i man 622

ngag yin pas/ rang kho nas snying la bcings rgyu yin gsungs/de'i rgyu mtshan chags lam la shin tu mkhas par grags pa'i bod kyi bla ma thams cad kyis/ rgyud nas gsungs pa'i phyag rgya rigs bzhi'i khyad par sna g.yon g.yas su 'khyil ba dang / zhes sogs rtsa'i dbyibs la brtags pa'i don la blo kha tsam yang ma phyogs shing / rtsa la mi 'dra ba yod pa'i gnad ma rtogs pa sha stag yin pas/ phyogs 'di la kha bo ji ltar che yang mkhas pa'i bzhad gad kyi gnas 'ba' zhig yin gsungs so/ /gnyis pa srog rtsol du gtong ba'i thabs dngos ni/ rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma'i/ /rtsa ni nye bar btsal byas te/ /byed pa bcings pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /zhes pas bstan/ de'i don rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma'i rtsa ni bud med kyi rnyu tī yin la/ nye bar btsal bya zhes pa ni/ rnal 'byor pas rtsa de'i mar sna btsal bar byas la/ de yang bya rog gdong zhes pa ni/ 'jig rten pa la bya ler grags pa de la zer ba yin zhing / dbu ma'i mas sna rtsa de'i dbus nas 'byung ngo / /de la skyes pa'i rnyu tī ni sbom zhing thung bar gnas pas/ nor bu'i bu ga las phyir nar nas yong ba mi srid la/ bud med kyi dhu tī phra zhing ring bas/bya rog gdong las phyi nar 'ong ba srid pa'i skabs yod pas/623

snyoms 'jug gi tshe bud med kyi rtsa de rnal 'byor pa'i rtsa'i mas sna'i nang du 'jug pa'i sbyor ba byed pa yin te/ de'i phyir du phyag rgya'i dhu tī'i rigs mi 'dra ba bzhi'i gnas tshul shes nas tshol ba dang / kha 'byed pa'i man ngag gis shes rab kyi rtsa sad par bya'o/ /de nas phyag rgya'i rtsa de rang gi rtsa'i nang du bcug nas/ byed pa dam du bcings pa'i sbyor ba bya/ de ltar byas pas phyag rgya'i rtsa'i nang nas rlung byung ste/ rang gi rtsa'i nang du slebs pa na/ snyoms 'jug gi bde ba sogs gzhan las kyang lhag pa'i bde ba skye la/ rlung de rang gi dhu tī'i nang du brgyus pas/ rang gis thur sel gyi rlung gyen du log ste/ phyag rgya'i rlung des yar sna 'dren byas nas/ dbu mar zhugs shing brgyus pas drod 'bar nas/ spyi bo'i haṃ yig zhu zhing byang sems dhu tī'i mar snar slebs pa na/ phyag rgya'i yang khu ba zhu nas dhu tī'i lam nas byung ste/ rang gi rtsa'i nang du 'phrad pa na/ thabs shes zung du 'brel ba'i gnad kyis snga ma'i bde ba las kyang ches che ba'i bde ba zhig byung zhing / de nas man nga ga gis gyen du bzlog pa'i sbyor ba byas pas/ thig le de lte bar slebs pa na/rgyu mthun gyi tshul gyi dga' ba/ snying gar slebs pa na/ rnam smin gyi tshul gyi mchog dga'/ mgrin par slebs pa na/ skyes bu byed 624
