pa'i tshul gyi khyad dga'/ gtsug tor du slebs pa na/ dri ma dang bral ba'i lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba ste/ shin tu rnal 'byor bsgom par bya'o/ /gsum pa bde stong sbyor tshul ni/ de 'dra ba'i yas babs dang mas brtan gyi dga' bzhi skyes pa de'i tshe/ dbu ma'i lta ba mthar thug dang sbyar nas bskyangs pas/ srid pa'i sdug bsngal thams cad gzhom par byed do/ /gzhan yang rdo rje lte bas pad+ma mnan pa dang / skyil krung zhes sogs kyi don yang /yum gyi rtsa'i mas sna yab kyi rtsa'i mas sna'i nang du bcug pa des/don gyi rdo rje skyil krung g.yas g.yon gnyis kyi ro rkyang gi rlung dbu ma'i nang du zhugs pa 'byung zhing / de'i tshe rnal 'byor pa'i sems nor bu'i nang gi dhu tī'i nang du song ba la/ ye shes kyi ngo bo lhan skyes 'byung ngo / /de dga' ba gzhan gsum yang yin no/ /pad+ma can gyi bgrod tshul ni/ pad+ma'i byed pa zhes pa phal ba ltar steng nas bgrod pa'o/ /glang po can ma'i bgrod tshul ni/ dud 'gro ltar rgyab nas bgrod pa'o/ /dung can ma'i bgrod tshul ni/ ga ha ra ti'i sbyor ba zhes bya ba/ rkang ba gnyis phrag pa la bkal te 'og nas bgrod pa'o/ /ri dwags can ma'i bgrod tshul ni/ bi ma sa'i bcings pa zhes bya ba/ rdo rje sems dpa' ltar skyil krung bcas la bgrod par bya ba yin no/ /rtags kyi rtsa 625

gnyis mi 'bral bar byed pa shin tu gal che la/ de ni rnal 'byor pa'i lag pas byed dgos par rgyud las bshad do/ /zhal gyi gdams pa shin tu gsang ngo / /bla ma dam pa'i zhal 'ba' zhig las byung ba/ gzhan la med pa'i khyad chos zab bo/ /gsang ba las kyang ches gsang ba'i man ngag gser khur bo khyer nas/sa steng thams cad du btsal kyang rnyed pa ma yin no/ /'di'i dpe su la ma ston/ bstan na de la mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i bka' chad kyis dam tshig nyams pas/ shin tu dam par bya'o/ hwa/ sno/ sa ma ya/ rgya rgya rgya/ zhes rje blo bzang grags pa yab sras kyi gsung rdo rje'i tshig 'di kho nas kyang nges shes 'drongs nas/ sngags la dad gus dag snang 'bad med lhun 'grub tu skye bar gdon mi za'o/ /de'i rgyu mtshan rje rin po ches gsang sngags kyi rdzogs rim skabs kyi zab gnad 'di dang 'di 'dra ba gsungs drags pas/ nam mkha' nas mkha' 'gro ma mang pos/ ga 'dra zhig ma gsungs na ang snyam sngags la ser sna shor/ zhes dam pa gong ma rnams gsungs/ pha dam pa'i zhal chems 'das yig chen mo las/ spyir chos ma byas par sangs rgyas pa bzhi yod de/gcig ni skye ba snga ma la sbyangs pas 'phro tshe 'dir sad pas lam gyi rtogs pa rang byung du rgyud la skyes pa'i 626

gang zag yin/ gcig de bzhin gshegs pa'i ring bsrel gyis 'pho ba'i sbyor ba shes nas sangs rgyas pa'i gang zag yin/gcig phyag rgya ma rtsa pad+ma can/ khrag dang khu ba 'o mar 'bab pa'i mtshan bzang po can/ de la slob dpon mkhas grub nyams su len shes pa'i dga' ba bzhi lam du 'khyer shes pa/ phyag rgya bzhi'i go ba 'khyer ba'i gang zag gis/ rgyud bde ba'i nyams rtogs gus pas phul bas/ ma bsgoms par pho dang mo gnyis gar sangs rgyas pa'o/ /de ci ste zhe na/ rtsa dang rlung dang thig le'i gnad kyis so/ /gcig skye ba bdun pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i sha zos na sdig po che yang sangs rgya ba yin no/ /gsungs/des na phyag rgya mtshan ldan bsten shes na gnad che bas khas gtong mi rung ngo / /gzhan yang / rje mi la'i gsang ba'i mgur drug las/ shes rab rang bzhin bud med 'di/ /lhan skyes dang sgyu ma sgrub pa'i rgyu/ /spyir dman par nam yang mi blta zhing / /sgos phag mor ltos la gsol ba thob/ /ces dang / rgyud brtag pa gnyis pa nas gsungs pas rdo rje glu'i skad gnyis shan sbyor kun mkhyen pad dkar gyis bsgyur ba las/ bde ba can gnas rdo rje ni/ /lte ba ru ni pad+ma yi/ /rgyun tu 'bod pa cang te'u brdungs/ /rtsod par mi bya snying rje bas/ /de la sha ni bza' ba 627

dang / /chang ni shin tu btung ba ste/ /kye ho skal ldan gzhug par bya/ /skal ba med pa spangs nas su/ /bshang ba dang ni gci ba rngul/ /khu ba rnams ni sbyar bar bya/ /tshod ma dang ni sha chen po/ /de la mang po bza' ba yin/ /'ong ba dang ni 'gro bar bya/ /dag dang ma dag mi dmigs pas/ /rus rgyan yan lag rnams la gdags/ /de ru ro ni gzhug par bya/ /'dus par dbang gnyis sbyor 'jug pa/ /reg min de la spang bya min/ /grub pa'i legs bshad ji bzhin tu/ /blo gsal pad+ma dkar por bsgyur/ /gsungs so/ /rdo rje thod pa'i sbyor ba las/ skye bo gang dang gang rnams kyis/ /sha ni mkhas pas bza' bya ba/ /sems can re re dbang du 'gyur/ /zhes dang / rgyud gzhan las/ rdo rje chos dang sangs rgyas dang / /rnal 'byor ma dang mi mo yis/ /glu dang gar ni 'di dag gis/ /legs par glu blangs gar yang bya/ /zhes dang / 'dus par yang / chags can ye shes 'dod pa yis/ /rtag tu 'dod pa'i yon tan bsten/ /ces dang / kun mkhyen pad+ma dkar pos/ rdo rje mkha' 'gror bshad pa'i 'dod pa'i sgyu rtsal drug cu rtsa bzhi/ brtag gnyis su bshad pa'i bzhi la sogs pa'i 'dod pa'i bstan bcos kyi rigs shes par bya'o/ /gsungs/ 'dod pa'i sgyu rtsal drug cu rtsa bzhi ni/ 'o byed pa/628

'khyud pa/ so 'debs pa/ sen mo 'debs pa/ yang dag par bskyod pa/ sid kyi sgra sgogs pa/ skyes pa'i bya ba byed pa/ steng na 'dug pa/ de brgyad po re re la yang brgyad brgyad phye bas drug cu rtsa bzhi'o/ /sam bu ṭa las/ nges par thams cad ma skyes pa'i/ /rnam pa yis ni rnal 'byor gyis/ /khye dang bong bu rnga mong dang / /glang po la sogs khrag 'thung nas/ /sha ni rtag tu bza' bar bya/ /sha chen khrag gis gos pa ni/ /thams cad khyad par du ni lta/ /dman pa'i sha ni thams cad dang / /srog chags 'bum phrag brgya ldan bza'/ /rnam snang shin tu rul ba ni/ /srin bu brgya phrag zir zir ldan/ /khye dang mi sgyugs bsres nas ni/ /sha ni rdo rje chur gos ldan/ /rnal 'byor pa ni spro ba yis/ /rnam snang bsres nas bza' bar bya/ /rdo rje'i chu ni btung ba'o/ /zhes dang / de ltar bza' ba sna tshogs dang / /chang dang nya dang yang dag ldan/ /dga' ba'i longs spyod skal bza' bas/ /dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpa' sgrub/ /ces dang / mkha' 'gro ma kun spyod las/ gnyis med ye shes sems ldan pas/ /mi bya ba ni ci yang med/ /mi rtog bdag nyid sems skyes ni/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga la spyod/ /ces dang / gzhan yang theg pa chen pa'i lugs la gzhan don du 'gyur na pham pa bzhi spyad 629

kyang dge bar 'gyur ba la dgongs nas/ spyod 'jug las/thugs rje mnga' bas rings gzigs nas/ /bkag pa rnams kyang de la gnang / /zhes dang / don de nyid thugs yul du bzhag nas/ 'jam dbyangs sa paṇa gyis kyang / gzhan gyi don gyi sems brtan pas/ /pham pa bzhi po spyad na yang / /byang chub sems dpa'i dge chen 'gyur/ /zhes sogs rgyas par 'byung pas theg chen gyi lugs la bsam pa rgya chen po dang ldan na sbyor ba mi dge ba ltar snang ba dag kyang / dge ba rgya chen por song ba ded dpon snying rje chen pos tshong phrug mang po zhig bskyabs pa'i ched du tshong ba g.yo can bsad pas bskal pa dgu khri'i sdig byang nas/ bsod nams rgya chen po thob pa lta bu nyan thos la bkag pa/ byang chub sems dpa' la gnang ba sogs skabs thob shes dgos so/ /rje rin po ches mdzad pa'i sngags rim chen mo las/ cha lugs mi nyams shing bzung ba'i dam tshig gi yan lag rdo rje dang dril bu dang / dgang blug dang / rgyan drug dang / ḍā ma ru dang / ka pā la dang / kha ṭ+wāṃ ka la sogs pa ji ltar bya ba dang / de ltar byas pa rnams bcing ba'i tshul rnams kyang / sngags pas kun spyod dag pa'i thabs su shin tu gal che gsungs/ de la dgongs nas mkhas grub rjes/ rdo rje 630

theg pa'i lam gyi yan lag mi 'bral ba dang / bsten par bya ba'i dam tshig gi rdzas med du mi rung ba dag gi mtshan nyid dang / ji ltar bcang ba'i tshul la sogs pa rnam par bshad pa/ rnal 'byor rol ba'i dga' ston zhes bya ba sngar med pa'i legs bshad zla med de mdzad pa lags/ de'i sdom ni/ rdo rje dril bu cang te'u bgrang phreng dang / /lus rgyan kha ṭ+wāṃ ka dang btung ba'i snod/ /bgo ba'i gos dang stan la sogs pa gzhan/ /rnam pa 'di bdun bshad bya'i dngos po yin/ /gsungs/ de yang tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i tshe/ rnal 'byor pho mo rnams gdan ji lta bu la gnas par 'chad pa ni/ brtag gnyis las/ ro yi gzugs can dgu dang ni/ /yang na stag gi pags pa nyid/ /dur khrod ras ni de bzhin no/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ro gdan dang / stag lpags dang / dur khrod kyi ras kyi gdan byed par gsungs/ sdom gsum rgyan las/ yo byad longs spyod mnyam bzhag rjes spyod bzhin/ /bsdus nas rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya drug /kha ṭ+wāṃ cang te'u pad+ma'i snod bgrang 'phreng / /bris sku glegs bam mchod phyir thogs dang gzhan/ /glang chen lpags sogs yo byad dam tshig yin/ /zhes dang / yang de nyid las/'dod pa lnga dang sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga/ /btung ba lnga dang phyag 631

rgya lnga longs spyod/ /bdun cu rtsa gnyis sha yang mchod dus bsten/ /gsungs/ gzhan yang mkhas grub rjes/ bla med dang phar phyin gyi theg pa'i lta ba'i skyong tshul ye mi 'dra zhing / zhi lhag gi go rim dang / lta ba bskyangs pa'i byed las sogs la khyad par shin tu che ba dang / rdzogs rim dang / phar phyin theg pa las/ stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa myur bul gyi khyad par nyi zla'i 'gros dang / ba lang gi 'gros las kyang shin tu che ba yod tshul dang / de ltar 'ong ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis gnad shin tu zab gsungs/ sngags bla med la lam gang gi skabs su'ang /mchog tu bsngags pa phyag rgya'i lam yin la/ rje nyid kyis phyag rgya srog rtsol du 'gro ba'i gnad che ba yang yang gsungs pa/de'i gnad rnams zhib par bris pa/ phyag rgya bzhi'i lam gsal bar byed pa'i yig chung zhes dang / gsang dbang dngos dbang bskur ba lta bu la/ rin po che lta bu'i gang zag mchog 'ga' zhig la/ dge slong yin yang dang po nas dngos dbang bskur ba'i skabs yod kyi/ de ma gtogs pa'i nus pa ma thob pa'i dge slong la gsang dbang sogs dngos dbang du bskur mi rung gsungs/ zhi byed kyi rgyud las/ sha za ba la snying rje med/ /sha ni snying rje can gyis za/ /zhes dang / dus 'khor rtsa rgyud las/ ma 632

bslangs snod du lhung gyur pa/ /de nyid kha na ma tho med/ /srog chags gcig gi sha dag ni/ /mang po rnams kyis zos pa mchog /ces dang / dus kyi 'khor lo'i 'grel chen las/'dir yul gang na 'jig rten pa rnams kyis gang bza' ba ma yin pa dang / gang btsongs pa ma yin pa/ ko ku la sogs pa rang gi las kyis shi ba dang / g.yul du las ngan pa 'am/rang gi skyon gyis chom rkun la sogs pas bsad pa de dag thams cad rnal 'byor pas bza' bar de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs so/ /zhes dang / yang rgyud 'grel las/ sngags kyi theg par rnal 'byor pa rnams kyis sha bza' bar bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs/ zhes dang / nad gso ba'i slad du ni/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la yang gnang ba yin te/ bslab btus las/ na ba'i gsos sman ni/ bdag gi don dang tshangs par spyod pa la gnas par bya ba'i phyir nyan thos kyi 'dul ba las bsten par bya ba nyid dang / lhung bzed dang chos gos kyang btsongs la lus bzung ngo zhes gsungs na/ skye bo dpag tu med pa yongs su bskyab pa'i rgyu byang chub sems dpa'i lus lta ci smos/ zhes sogs gsungs/ ye shes ldan gyi le'u las/ sha za ba gang 'byung ba de ni don chen po sgrub pa'i phyir nyes pa med 633

de/ de las 'di skad du 'byung ngo / /dge slong de ni 'chi ba'i dus bgyis nas/ /'dzam bu gling du ting 'dzin sgra yang ni/ /sems can rnams la rtag tu nub par 'gyur/ /'di sos pas ni ting 'dzin rnams kyang 'thob/ /ces gsungs so/ /de ni snying rje chen po la mngon par brtson pa ste/ de la byams pa med pa nyid du mi dogs pas nyes pa med do zhes gsungs pas/ gzhan don du dge ba la shin tu brtson pa'i byang chub sems dpas lus gso ba'i dgos pa khyad par can dang ldan pa'i tshe/ sha za na yang snying rje chen po dang 'gal bar dogs pa'i gnyen po dang sred pa skye ba'i gnyen por bu'i sha dang mtshungs pa'i 'du shes dang / lus gso ba'i sman gyi 'du shes nye bar bzhag nas za ba yinate/ lang shar gshegs pa las/ ngas kha zas ni bu'i sha dang sman bzhin bshad la zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /mkhyen brtse rin po che'i rnam thar las/ sngon 'phags pa ka t+yā ya na/khyem bdag zhig gi sgor bsod snyoms la byon tsa na/ khyim bdag des bu chung zhig pang bar bzung / nya sha zhig zhim zhim ltar bza'/ khyi mo zhig rus pa bza' ba la brdeg cing bsrung ba gzigs pa/ 'phags pas mngon shes kyis dpyad pas/ skye ba de kha'i pha nyar skyes pa'i sha bza'/ ma khyer skyes pa la rdo brdeg634

rang nyid gsod pa'i dgra bo bur skyes pa pang na 'tsho bar mkhyen pas thugs shin tu mug ste/ tshigs su bcad pa/ pha sha bza' zhing ma la brdeg /las ngan dgra bo pang na bzung / /chung mas khyo yi rus pa 'cha'/ /'khor ba'i chos la gad mo bro/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ skye ba snga phyi'i lus stabs 'gyur ba 'dis pha ma'i sha bza' ba la tsham tshom med pa'i snying khams 'di yi re mug snyam nas/ snying rtse shum shum yod tsa na snying rje chen po'i gshis stong ba nyid kyi brtul zhugs su shar nas/ ga re da bsad zin pa la yi mug bsgoms pa kho nas mi phan/ rgyal ba thabs mkhas la thugs rje'i 'jug pa tshad med pa'i phyir/ rdo rje theg pa la sdug bsngal bde bar bsgyur ba'i man ngag kyang yod pa'i phyir/ bsnyen bsgrub zab mo tshad du ni 'khrol/ lta ba rnam par dag pa ni yid dpyod pho tshod la mi re bar/ phyogs lhung dang bral bar rtogs/ de la nyan thos theg pa lta bu'i gu dogs dang / skye bo phal ba lta bu'i bag med pa'i bza' btung gis rang nyid la sgrib pa'i phung bo mi bzad par bskyed cing /gzhan la phan pa med pa'i thabs la rmongs pa de 'dra ni ma yin snyam nas gzungs sngags kyis btab/ stong nyid rgyu 'bras su shar ba'i bden pa mi 'gog phyir sdig bshags la dmigs nas/635

lo ltar lug gnyis gsum ci 'grub dang nye'u brgya dang drug cu kha yan re'i srog skyob pa'i dam bca' lhur blangs/ gsang sngags kyi dam tshig khyad du mi gsod pa'i phyir chos nyid la chos nyid kyi rol ba'i gsal snang bza' ba'i rnal 'byor du shar bas/ sems can de'i lus kyi 'brel bas tshogs rdzogs par byas te/ bsngo smon gyi mtshams sbyor drag pos rnam pa kun tu rgyas 'debs pa yin gsungs/ des na de lta bu'i thabs kyis zin na sha la sogs pa'i 'dod yon gang la longs spyod kyang nyes pa med pa'i khar tshogs kyang rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas rdo rjes longs spyod kyi dam tshig rnam bshad zag med bde ba'i dpal ster las/ de la re zhig gsang chen gyi spyod pa blor mi shong ba'i skal dman kha cig gis snying la 'di ltar sems te/ gang dag 'dod yon sna tshogs pa'i rtse dga' la mngon par rol ba dag ni/ kun nas nyon mongs pa'i blo can yin pa'i phyir 'khor ba'i btson ra mi zad par bcings pa'i zhags pa sra ba kho na'o zhes bsam zhing ngag tu'ang smra'o/ /de ni zab mos ma smin pa'i gtam 'ba' zhig tu zad pas rna ba dgab par bya la yang na ci ltar 'os pa'i lung rigs kyis sun dbyung bar rigs so/ /de yang mdo las/ ji ltar grong khyer skye 636

bo'i mi gtsang lud/ /de ni bu ram shing ba'i zhing la phan/ /de bzhin byang chub sems dpa'i nyon mongs lud/ /de ni sangs rgyas chos rnams bskyed la phan/ /zhes gsungs te thabs la mkhas pa'i dbang gis so/ /de ltar yang mdo sde rgyan las/thabs chen rnams dang ldan pa la/ /nyon mongs byang chub yan lag 'gyur/ /zhes pas so/ /de bzhin du rgyud du'ang dpe dang bcas te gsungs te/ dug gi dum bu gang nyid kyis/ /skye bo thams cad 'chi bar 'gyur/ /dug gi de nyid shes pa yis/ /dug gis dug nyid 'bigs par byed/ /ji ltar rlung gis zin pa la/ /mon sran gre'u'i bza' ba sbyin/ /zlog pa'i sman ni btang ba yis/ /rlung gis rlung la bsnun par byed/ /ces sogs dpe mang po dang bcas pa'i mthar/ skye bo mi bzad pa yi las/ /gang dang gang gis 'ching 'gyur ba/ /thabs dang bcas na de nyid kyis/ /srid pa'i 'ching ba las grol 'gyur/ /chags pas 'jig rten 'ching 'gyur ba/ /'dod chags nyid kyis rnam grol 'gyur/ /zhes sogs rgyud sde'i lung bsam gyis mi khyab bo/ /rigs pa'ang yod de/ chags sogs nyon mongs pa rnams dam pa'i chos yin par ni skabs 'dir yang mi 'dod la/thabs la mkhas pa'i stobs kyis nyon mongs byang chub kyi lam 637

—du bsgyur ba ni mdor yang bshad de/ sdud par/ shes rab kyis ni chos kyi rang bzhin yongs shes nas/ /khams gsum ma lus pa las yang dag 'da' bar 'gyur/ /mi yi khyu mchog 'khor lo rin chen bskor byas nas/ /sdug bsngal zad par bya phyir 'gro la chos kyang ston/ /ces gsungs te/ thabs mkhas de ni rang bzhin yongs shes yin/ des zin pa'i gnad kyis nyon mongs pas mi 'ching ba tsam du ma zad grol ba'i thabs mchog tu'ang 'gyur/ dper na byang chub sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags de nyid btsun mo'i 'khor rgya chen po dang lhan cig 'dod pa'i yon tan la spyod pa'ang byang chub kyi spyod par bzhag pa de lta bu ste/ de 'dra ba shin tu mang ngo / /de lta bas na gzhan gyis byas na ngan 'gro ba'i las mi bzad pa'ang / phyin ci ma log pa'i thabs kyis zin na sangs rgyas kyi rgyur 'gro ba ni nges par bden te/ gang gis blun po 'ching 'gyur ba/ /'di des mkhas rnams rnam par grol/ /zhes rdzun mi gsungs pa'i skyes mchog rdo rje 'chang des gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar dogs pa'i mtha' la dpyad nas/ longs spyad bya'i 'dod pa lnga dang por smos te/gzugs dang sgra dang dri dang ro dang reg bya lnga ni mig sogs dbang po lnga'i spyod yul lo/ /sha lnga'i ming thog gi yi ge go ku da 638

ha na/ de yang go zhes pa don dgu 'am bcu la 'jug kyang 'dir ba lang / kuklu khye/ dadha mche ba can te 'dir glang po/ha ya rta na ra mi'i skad dod/ de rnams kyi sha ni sha lnga/ bdud rtsi lnga'i ming thog gi yi ge ni/ bi mu ma ra shu ste/ biṣ+ṭa bshang ba/mu ṭa gci ba/ masta ka klad pa/ rak+ta khrag ste rdul/ shu kra khu ba ste lnga/sha lnga ni bza' ba'i bye brag yin pas/ sasnar/ bza' ba 'di dag yang dag brtsams zhes dang / brtag gnyis su/ bza' ba mi 'chi bcud phyed do/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /btung ba lnga ni/ sbrang rtsi/ bu ram/ 'bras bu'i bcud/ shing las skyes/ bcos ma'i chang ste lnga/ mnyam sbyor las/ sgeg mo dang ni na chung dang / /myos dang de bzhin bdud rtsi dang / /gcig tu dpa' dang 'dod chags dang / /g.yo can de bzhin bran mo dang / /zhes myos byed brgyad dgongs pa'i skad kyis gsungs so/ /phyag rgya lnga ni/ rdo rje rigs kyi bud med/ 'khor lo'i rigs kyi/ pad+ma'i rigs kyi/ rin po che'i rigs kyi/ ral gri'i rigs te lnga/ de dag brtag thabs kyi mtshan ma ni/ gang gi srin lag rtsa ba na/ /rdo rje rtse dgu bar gyur pa/ /mi bskyod pa yi rigs mchog nyid/ /ces sogs dang / de nyid mtshungs par rnal 'byor pa brtags thabs kyang / rnal 'byor pa gang nag po nyid/ /de yi lha ni mi 639

bskyod pa/ /zhes sogs dang / de bzhin du dus 'khor du'ang /rnal 'byor pa ni seng ge ri dwags rta ru 'gyur te khyu mchog glang po rigs kyi dbye ba las/ /zhes sogs gsungs te rgya cher rtogs par bya'o/ /de dag ni cho ga bzhin du byen gyis brlabs te rgyun du bsten par bya lags/ ston mo dang tshogs mchod la sogs pa'i skabs su bsten par bya ba'i longs spyod ni sha sna bdun cu rtsa gnyis te/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud las/ khye rta ba lang glang po lug dang ra dang ri dwags bong bu phag dang rnga mo 'di dag phyogs/ /kum+bha ra dang mgron bu ku lī ra dang nya dar ma ka ra dang sbal ba rus sbal dung / /bse dang stag dang dom dang ne'u le dang bcas 'bri dang lce spyang dang ni sram dang bye la dang / /'brog dgon khye dang seng ge dang bcas nor dang bcu ste 'di ni 'byung bo skyes dang khro bo skyes/ /go dhā byi ba sha li dz+ra ste spre'u dang ni ri bong gzungs mo idu rtsang pa brgyad/ /khengs ldan 'dab chags dang ni ne tso khu byug dag dang ri skyegs rab tu gsal bar chu yi gter/ /lā ba phug ron gzhan ni bya dkar zhes bya tsa ṭa ka dang ngur ba dang ni ngang ba dang / /dpa' ldan khrung khrung khu byug mig dang dza ki dang ni bha ga wa rī ti ti ri dang bzhad/ /chu la 'jug pa dang ni chu skyar ro dang bcas pa'i nor 640

rnams rim pa yis ni rig par bya/ /bya rog bya rgod 'ug pa ri dwags dgra dang gtsug phud can dang bya gag snye tra gha ra dang / /hor pa ljon shing dgra ni gzhan te bcu po khro bo las skyes khro bo yi ni rigs su 'gyur/ /mig sngon dpal ldan tsa ko ra dang a ni ma dang gu da mu kha bug ki rkang ste ri nyal/ /bhe tu ṣ+ṭa dang i pā ri ka brgyad pa mchog gi 'dab chab/sa su 'gyur mi yi bdag po kye/ /sum cu rtsa drug rigs kyi dngarnye bas sa yi srid pa la gnas sa spyod mkha' la spyod rnams kyis/ /rigs su gyur pa'i dam tshig mtha' dag rnams ni mchod pa'i dus su rnal 'byor pa yis bza' bar bya/ /rmongs pas gti mug dag las gal te spangs na mi yi bdag po myur du nyams pa nyid du 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /'o na dus kyi 'khor phor/ za ba po med na gsod pa po mi 'byung ba'i rigs pas sha /bkag pa dang ji ltar mi 'gal zhe na/ dgyes rdor gyi nā ro rnagrel chen du/gang las ched du bya ba kha na ma tho ba dang bcas / bar gyur na srog gcod par 'gyur ro/ /de'i phyir rnal 'byor pas ched du byas pa ma yin pa kha na ma tho ba med pa'i go ku la sogs pa'i bza' ba bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs so/ /zhes drangs pa'i lung rigs 'di dpyad gzhir bzhag ste dpyad na/ (snang 'dir/gang las ched du 641

bya ba kha na ma tho ba dang bcas par gyur na/ zhes dang / lang gshegs kyi mdor gsungs pa dang mtshungs te/ de nyid du/ khe yi phyir ni sems can gsod/ /sha yi phyir ni nor sbyin byed/ /de dag gnyis ka sdig las can/ /zhes gsungs te/ de'i don ni/gang zag gang su yang rung bas rang nyid bza' ba'i phyir du 'ga' zhig la rin sbyin par khas blangs nas sha nyo bar zhugs/'tshong ba po des kyang rin gyi khe'i ched du nyo ba pos rin sbyin par khas blangs pa'i rkyen gyes sems can bsad pa'i sha de nyo ba pos kyang rang gis rin sbyin par khas blangs pa'i rkyen gyis bsad pa yin par shes bzhin du/ rin sbyin nas nyos pa gnyis ka la srog gcod pa'i sdig pa mnyam por 'byung zhes pa'i don te/ sdig pa mi dge ba bgyis pa dang / bgyid du bstsal ba dang /bgyis pa la rjes su yi rang ba/ zhes gsungs pa ltar te/ ched du bya ba kha na ma tho ba ni de dang de lta bu gzhan dag kyang ngo / /'chad lugs 'di ltar ma byas na/ za ba po med na gsod pa po mi 'byung ba'i rigs pa 'di gcer bu pa'i grub mthar thal ba'i nyes pa yod do/ /kho bo'i lugs la/ rang nyid la bye brag bsngos pa'i mthong thos dogs gsum med kyang / gzhan gyi bza' ba'i ched du gzhan gyis bsad pa'i sha rang gis nyo ba 642

dang longs spyod pa la sdig yod par smra ba'i blo rtse'i gtad so ni/srog gcod pa po dang sha bza' ba po 'dra bar rang bzhin gyi kha na ma tho ba yin te/ sha'i phyir ga grod du 'jug pa po dang za ba po gnyis ka srog gi bar chad byed pa'i gang zag 'dra ba'i phyir te/ za ba po'i gang zag yod ‘/'i rgyu mtshan gyis gsad pa'i phyir dang / za ba po yod pas gsad kyi/ med na mi gsod pa'i phyir/ des na 'di lta bu nyo ba dang bza' ba ni rten gang gis byas kyang byas pa tsam gyis sdig tu 'gyur ba'i phyir ro snyam pa ni 'dod pa'i rtsa ba yin no/ /lugs de sun 'byen pa la gtan tshigs ma nges pa dang dam bca' ma nges pa gnyis 'byung ba'i dang po/ khyod kyi gtan tshigs de tsam gyis za ba po dang gsod pa po sdig pa mnyam par rtogs pa byed na/ bre srang la g.yo byed pa po dang nyo ba po sdig pa mnyam pa sogs skyon mang po 'jug ste/ 'di ltar/ kun dga' ra ba khron pa dzing / /der ni lus can shi gyur na/ /byed pa'i bskyed byed yin pa'i phyir/ /de la skyon ni yod par 'gyur/ /gas/da bya yod pas gsod yod kyi/ /gang phyir med na ma yin no/ /des na gsad bya gsod pa gnyis/ /sdig pa mnyam par thob par 'gyur/ /mthong dang thos dang bsnams pa dang / /reg dang dran pa nyid dang ni/ /sha la 643

byas na'ang chos min 'brel/ /'di lta bur ni 'gyur ba yin/ /gsal bar byed pa'i nyi ma dang / /skye ba'i rgyu yi pha dag dang / /skyong ba byed pa'i mi bdag rnams/ /gos byed pa yis ji ltar na/ /zas kyi bya ba'ang mi rigs te/ /gang phyir skyon ni gnyis 'byung ba/ /ma zos pa la ma yin te/ /zos las srog chags skye 'gyur zhing / /de dag thur du 'byung bar 'gyur/ /skyes pa mnyam 'gyur ma zos na/ /ma skyes skye bar mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs la/ skyon gnyis ni/ zas zos pas lus kyi srog chags ma skyes pa skye ba dang / skyes pa nyams pa'i rkyen byed pa'i phyir zas kyi bya ba gang yang mi rigs par 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa'o/ /gal te rang gis ma bsad na zos pa la skyon de 'ong don med do zhe na/ khyod rang gi rtsa ba'i rigs pa khyod nyid kyis bkag par 'gyur ro/ /gal te gzhan gyi rgyu mtshan gyis/ /skyon de khyod ni mi 'dod na/ /gzhan gyis gsad par gyur pa yi/ /sdig de spyod pa ga la 'ong / /zhes pas so/ /khyod kyi dam bca' de yang ma nges pa kho na re srog chags de gsod pa la lus kyis brdeg pa sogs dang /ngag dang yid kyis gnang ba sbyin pa sogs gang du yang ma gtogs pa'i za ba pos de'i sha zos tsam la srog gcod du gtogs pa'i sdig pa yod don med de/ srog gcod de dang 644

'brel ba'i bya ba gang yang ma byas pa'i phyir/ de'i phyir nyan thos rnams la de lta bu'i sha za ba gnang ba la skyon med pa nyid do 'chad pa la/ gang phyir mi bza/ga gnang mi sbyin/ /des na sdig de yod ma yin/ /de phyir sha sogs rjes gnang ba/ /skyon med par ni bzung bar bya/ /sha za ba ni skyon bcas min/ /de tshe srog chags gnod min phyir/ /mu rte ga rma bya'i sgo sogs dang / /'bras dang chu yi dgos pa bzhin/ /zhes sogs bshad de/ lung de rnams rtog ge 'bar ba'i yin byo // /de ltar bshad pa'i grub don ni/ kha na ma tho ba'i rdzas la longs spyod pa bkag nas/ kha na ma tho ba med pa'i rdzas dang yo byad bsten par gnang ba yin no/ /bshad pa'i 'phrul de 'dra ba sga 'gal med du mi sgrub par/'grel chen dri med 'od las/ gal te za ba po med na gsod pa po yang mi 'byung ngo / /zhes zad byed pa'i lugs bkod pa rang gi khungs su 'dren pa yang mthong 'a / de la 'phyas gdags pa'i yi ge'i snang bas/ phyin chad dus 'khor dang sdom gsum rgyan 'chad pa dag gis phyogs snga phyi'i kazhung dbyes phyed pa gal che bar gda'o/ /zhes gsungs/ yang kha cig na re/ 'o na 'od dpag med dang spyan ras gzigs 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi rnam 'phrul skyabs mgon rgyal ba yab sra ga/ gnam bskos gong ma 645

rgyal bo sogs bla chen rgyal blon mang po dang / grub thob kyi brgyud pa yin zer ba'i gsang sngags kyi rnal 'byor pa grub thob pho mo ji snyed cig mchis pa rnams kyi nang nas/ re gnyis tsam ma gtogs phal che ba zhig gis sdig zas pha ma sems can gyi sha za ba 'di spong ba phar zhog sha khrag 'di'i don du nyin re bzhin ra lug g.yag gsum sogs sems can brgya stong mang po bshan pa sogs la gsod du 'jug pa 'di ci 'dra zhig yin sangs rgyas kyi bcas pa 'di la mtho dman la khyad e yod/btsan po rnams kyis bsrung mi dgos gnyom chung gis bsrung dgos pa 'dra e yin/yang na skyon gyis mi gos pa'i gdengs ci zhig yod/ rang la skyon gyis mi gos na yang / gzhan pha ma sems can rnams sha yi phyir du bshan pa sogs la gsod du 'jug phod dam/ sems can de dag gsod pa'i dus sdug bsngal pyong ba mthong zhing thos bzhin du snying mi rje 'am/ snying rje med na chos kyi rtsa ba rul gsungs pa de bden na/ chos kyi rtsa ba 'di nas 'dzugs dgos pas/ des snying rje chen po'i sgo nas nyes skyon thams cad kyi rtsa ba sdig zas pha ma'i sha khrag za ba 'di gtan nas dug bzhin du spong bar rigs so zer na/ de yi rgyu mtshan cung zad tsam zhig bshad kyis legs par nyon cig646

'gro ba yongs kyi sngon nas ma 'dris pa'i mdza' bshes chen po ston pa sangs rgyas thugs rje can ni thabs mkhas la thugs rje che ba yin pas/ chos kyang sems can rnams kyi blo kha dang 'tsham par bstan nas sems can rnams bde la 'god pa yin la/ de yang byes pa so so'i skye bo sgo nag pa tha chad bshan pa lta bu zhig la/ khyod kyis sha ma za che/sa gsungs na gtan nas mi nyan par ma zad/ sha yi phyir du khyod kyis lag brdar nas srog ma gcod ces bshad na yang mi nyan pa'i rigs kyang yal bar mi 'dor bar de'i tshod kyi chos bstan nas rjes su 'dzin tshul ni/ thog mar bshan pa de la mkho ba sbyin/ snyan par smras nas sems dga' bar byas/ de nas nga/zhin 'dzum/ zhal nas spyir sdig pa sna re spangs pa dang / datha/ ba sna re bsgrub na yang phan yon che tshul dang / khyad par ten re tsam la srog gcod pa spangs na yang tshe 'dir tshe ring nad med bde skyid phun sum tshogs shing / mthar thug sangs sbyo1 sa tshe dpag med lta bu'i go 'phang thob pas/ khyod kyis du yi rgyun du sha dang srog gcod spong ma nus na yang / bca lnga 'am // gnam gang / tshes brgyad tsam rer srog gcod ma byed dang nga/zang zhes gsungs nas/ de tsam gyis dge ba la bkod nas rgyud la rnam dkar gye dge ba 647

'jog pa yin/ de bas blo mtho ba la bsnyen gnas yan lag brgyad pa'i sdom pa ster/ de las drags tsam la skyabs 'gro tsam gyi dge bsnyen sna gcig gam/ sna 'ga' tsam dang / yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen tsam ster/ yang khyem nas rab tu byung ba dang / dge tshul dang / dge slong gi sdom pa blangs nas bsrung nus pa rnams la de rnams kyi gang rung byin nas bsrung du 'jug de'i dus su sha gtan nas za mi rung zhes bcas pa mdzad na/ sha'i sred pa can rnams kyis sha za rgyu med na rab tu byung mi thub snyam bstan pa la mi 'jug gis dogs nas/ thog mar rmig zlum dang mi sha la sogs pa'i sha kha shas ma gtogs/gzhan rmig pa kha phrag sogs kyi sha zos chog ces sha'i bcas pa de tsam las ma mdzad/ de nas yang blo mthor song ba rnams la rmig pa kha phrag sogs gang yin na yang / mthong thos dogs pa med pa ste rnam gsum dag pa'i sha ma gtogs gzhan dmigs sha dang / nyin sha sogs zos mi chog pa'i bcas pa mdzad/ de nas yang mtho ba theg pa chen po'i rigs can snying rje chen po can rnams la 'gro drug tshe sngon gyi pha ma yin zhes theg chen sems bskyed len du bcug nas/ sha thams cad pha ma'i sha yin pas rang gar shi ba'i sha yang za mi rung zhes sha gtan nas 648

zos mi chog pa'i bcas pa mdzad nga/ yin la/ de lta bu'i theg chen byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis sems can gzhan la phan phyir snying rje chen pos yid ba skyod nas sha gtan nas mi za ba yin no/ /des na sangs rgyas ༷/nyi bcas pa ni gang zag gi blo kha'i che chung gi dbang gis skas kyi sdem pa bzhin bcas pa la mtho dman mang po yod pa shes dbo/sa pa yin/ de la yang so thar byang sems sngags sdom gang gi skabs su dmigs bsal yod de/ dper na dge slong rgan pa rlung gis 'chi ba dang /byang chub sems dpa'i sku bsnyung 'u/sa zungs zad nas gshegs la nye ba dang / gsang sngags kyi nol 'byor pa rtsa rlung las su rung nas bde stong gi grogs su song nas/ mchog gi dngos grub la sbyor ba rnams la dmigs bsal yod par gsungs pas zos na skyon med do/ /des na gnang ba7kag gi sa mtshams shes na sha za dgos dus zos chog mi dgos/ dus su bzhag na yang yong bas/ gu dogs po de 'dra mdzad pe dgos/ lhag par rgyal ba yab sras lta bu'i sa thob kyi byang chu nu sems dpa' rnams dang /bla ma grub thob rnams la sangs rgyas kyi bcas pa mdzad pa ma yin/ rang re so so'i skye bo nyo na mongs rang dgar spyod pa rnams la de mi rung zhes bcas pa ma/ dzad pa yin pas/ khong 649

rnams kyis gang mdzad la dad gus dag snang ma byung na yang khas gtong mi rung / yang khong tshos de 'dra mdzad na nged tsho smos ci dgos/ zhes seng ge mchongs sar wa skyes mchongs mi rung bas gzab 'tshal/ gzhan yang rang 'dod kyi 'khris med pa'i byang chub sems dpa' la sangs rgyas kyis sha gnang ba tsam du ma zad/ skabs skabs gzhan la phan na lus ngag gi las bdun yang gnang ba'i skabs kyang yod pas/ deng sang sa thob kyi byang chub sems dpa' phal che ba zhig gis sha smos ci dgos/srog gcod ma byen len mi tshangs spyod rdzun phra ma tshig rtsub ngag 'khyal rnams la mi 'jem par spyod pa lta bu la yang gzhan la phan pa'i dgos pa gang yod mi shes snyam du log lta mi byed cing / de yi lad mo yang mi byed dgos/des na 'jam dbyangs dang sbyan ras gzigs 'od dpag med kyi rnam 'phrul gong ma rgyal po rgyal ba yab sras sogs la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' dang / sngags kyi sgo nas grub pa thob pa rnams gong phud du gtong dgos/ de ma yin pa'i so so'i skye bo nga dang nga lta bu'i gang zag gis sangs rgyas kyis bcas pa gang mdzad pa'i gnang bkag gi sa mtshams shes par byas nas 'dzol med du spyod dgos/ 'on kyang bla mas bya gsod na nye gnas kyis sgo nga 650

gcog zer ba'i dpe ltar/ deng sang bla mas ci mdzad phal cher slob mas kyang byas yong bas/ dub rga ngan 'dir sa thob kyi bla ma skyes chen grub thob rnams kyis kyang rjes 'jug rnams la phan phyir snying rje chen po'i sgo nas sem‘ ma can la 'phral phugs gang du phan pa'i mdzad bzang yang dag pa bstan du gsol zhes gsol ba 'debs pa lags so/ /04nga kha cig na re/ sngags pa rnams la dar ba'i sbyor sgol zer ba 'di chos log yin/ 'dod chags kyi sbyor ba byas nas sangs sbyo/ 7 na/ khye dang phag pa bong bu glang bu smad 'tshong ma dang rgad po 'dod chags can tsho sngon nas grol te ma grol 'dug srog chags bsgral bas sangs rgya na sngon la nya ba bshan pa 'jig rteca / na mi gsod rnams kyang sangs rgyas par gda'/ de 'dra'i chos log rnams rgyang ring du dor bar bya dgos so zer ro/ /de shā/ rgyu mtshan bshad par bya ste/de la gzhan la phan pa'i dgos pa re/da/ gsang sngags kyi thabs kyis ma zin par sbyor sgol spro/ ji bzhin par rang dgar 'jig rten pa ltar spyad na log pa yi/na la/ snying rje chen po'i sbyor ba ni byang chub sems dpas kya nga spyod pa yin te/ mdo las/ bram ze khye'u bla mas tshong dpon gyi bu mo 'dod chags kyis 'chi la nye ba la snying rje nas mi tshongs par spyad kyang tshul 651

khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rdzogs par bshad/ de 'dra'i rigs la mdo nas skyon med par gsungs la/ gsang sngags bla med kyi skabs su thabs kyis zin na/ rgyud las/ma dang sring mo bu mo la/ /bsgrod na myur du 'grub par 'gyur/ /ces sogs brgya dgos na stong 'dug pas mang po smos ci dgos/ yang snying rjes sgrol ba ni byang chub kyi lam yin te/ ded dpon snying rje chen pos mi nag mdung thung can bsad pas bskal pa mang po'i tshogs rdzogs par gsungs pas gsal lo/ /gsang sngags nas zhing bcu tshang ba'i bstan dgra ni bsgral bar gsung ste/gsang ba snying po las/ bdud rtsi lnga 'am zas lnga la/ /mtshan ma ming du bcas par bya/ /bkug la rdo rje phur pas gdab/ /sangs rgyas bsod nams sku yang 'jig /ces gsungs pa ltar/gzugs brnyan la dgra bo de'i bla bkugs nas sgol bar gsungs/ zhing bcu ni 'dren lugs mang yang / 'dir go bde ba ni/ klong rdol bla ma rin po ches/sangs rgyas bstan pa bshig dang gcig /dkon mchog dbu 'phang smad pa gnyis/ /dge 'dun dkor ni 'phrog pa gsum/ /theg chen smod cing sun 'byin bzhi/ /bla ma'i sku la brdo ba lnga/ /rdo rje spun sun 'byin pa drug /sgrub la bar chad byed pa bdun/ /brtse ba snying rje 652

gtan med brgyad/ /dam tshig sdo ma pa bral ba dgu/ /las 'bras log par lta ba bcu/ /de dag bsgral ba'i zhing bcu'o/ /gsungs/ 'o na de ci ltar sgol zeza na/ sngags pa zhe sdang can gyis rdzas ngan du mas sa sna chu sna hrul/ sde brgyad sogs la gtad nas rang gzhan gnyis phung byed pa lta bu ma yin gyi/sngags pa snying rje can gyis snying rje chen pos kun nas bslangs te lha sngags ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo nab 4 bsgral bar gsungs te/phur ba las/ snying rjes bsgral ba'i dam tshig ni/ /bsad cing mnan pa ma yin te/ /phung bo rdo rjer bstems byas nas/ /rnam par shes pa rdo rjer bsgoms/ /gsungs pa ltar/ byams snying rje sngon du btang nas rang lhar gsal/ phur ba sras mchog tu gsal/ de nas bka' sdod cho sa skyong rnams bkye nas dgra bgegs bkug nas bstims pas/ dgra bgegs dngos su gsal bar byas/ phur ba las 'o da zer dang bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ dgra bgegs kyi las nyon sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa sbyangs/ rnam shes āḥ da //ra po'i rnam par phur ba'i khong gseng brgyud nas yar drangs/ yi dam lha'i thugs gar 'phangs nas thugs chos kyi sku la nga) byer med du bstems nas lta ba'i dgongs pa la mnyam par ba(nag pas chos skur sangs 653

rgyas/ tshe bsod lhag ma dri yig gi rnam par tshur bsdus nas rang la bstims pas tshe dang bsod nams rgyas/ sha khrag rnams bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs nas/ dam can chos skyong la phul bas tshim song snyam pa'i dmigs pa la brten nas sgol bar gsungs la/ de ltar bsgral na nyes pa med par ma zad 'tshengs pa gsum 'byung ste/ rnam shes drangs pas dgra bgegs 'tshengs/ /sha khrag mchod pas chos skyong 'tshengs tshe bsod lhag mas rnal 'byor 'tshengs/ /'tshengs pa gsum zhes de la bshad/ /ces sngags 'chang rnams kyis bshad la/ de bzhin du dge bshes sog bzlog pas/ sbyor sgrol la sogs pa gsar rnying gnyis ka nas mthun par bshad pa ma sgrub kyang ro langs gser sgrub ces/ mkha' spyod la sogs pa'i grub chen brgyad gsar ma'i rgyud du byung / bdud rtsi'i ril bu sgrub pa la yang /rnying ma pa sman sgrub zer bas/ don du 'dra yang spyod tshul de rnams dngos grub sgrub pa la sogs pa'i skabs su dgos gsungs/ gzhan yang bka' thang las/ sngags pa bla mas dam tshig bsgrags pa dang / /rgyud nas ji skad bshad pa bzhin du gyis/ /skom du chang gsol dge 'dun dkor ma 'bags/ /zas su ci dgar longs spyod dug ma za/ /gos su dkar dmar 654

nag po sngags chas gyis/ /gnas su sgrub khang zungs la yon tan spel/ /bstan pa bsrung phyir sgrub pa dang du longs/ /zhes dang / mthu gtad bu lon bzhin du bsnyegs dus 'byung / /bstan pa bsrung phyir phyi rabs sngags pa rnams/ /sngags pa'i las ka 'di min gzhan ma yin/ / dgra mgo yan par btang na dam tshig nyams/ /lha 'dre ma rungab/ yid kyi gzugs can la/ /sha yi mi ngan mthil brlag gtong jusgrod na/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa dkar 'jam rgyas par 'gyur/ / sngags pa mthu med grong stong khyi dang 'dra/ /sus brdung 'dis brdung med de rdzas mi thub/ /las su mthu sgrubs bran du lha 'dre nga/skol/ /nor du rdzas gsog mtshon du klu gtad rgyob/ /srid du 'i/ṅga chos la mnan pa gyis/ /lto ru dgra zo gos su sgrub khang gyon/ /grogs su mkha' 'gro chos skyong dam can gsos/ /mthu dang chos su ldan pa'i 'gro don gyis/ /gsungs/ gzhan yang rje btsu na chen po tā ra na tha'i rnam thar ma bcos lhug pa'i rtogs brjod las/ yang 'di na gang dag bstod mi shes kyis bstod pa darwa / smad mi shes kyis smad pa zer ba de 'dra zhig yong shin gda'/ kho bo smad pa'i khungs kyis mngon spyod kyi las byas so zhes bstod smad 'di tsho na yang yang zer ba 'dug de rnams la smras pa/ re zhig ngan song 655

sbyong rgyud las/ glen pas dkon mchog gsum smod dang / /sangs rgyas bstan la gnod byed dang / /bla ma smod la brtson pa rnams/ /mkhas pas bsgrims te bsad par bya/ /chos min ldan dang sdig spyod dang / /rtag tu sems can gnod brtson dang / /dam tshig sdang rnams snying brtse ba'i/ /sngags mkhan gyis ni sngags kyis bsad/ /ces bsgral bar bya ba'i yul bdun la bsad las bya bar gsungs/ dgyes rdor las kyang / bstan la gnod pa byed pa dang / /bla ma sangs rgyas 'jig pa ni/ /bla ma thub pa la zhus nas/ /snying rjes bsad par bya ba nyid/ /ces gsungs/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa las kyang / ma dad smra ba'i sems can dang / /rdo rje slob dpon smod pa dang / /gdug pa'i sems can gzhan la yang / /rab tu bskul ba 'di bya'o/ /zhes dang / mgon po de yis bslu ba yis/ /lus can thams cad 'jig mdzad kyang / /ngan 'gror skye bar mi 'gyur zhing / /byang chub lam ni rnyed mi dka'/ /zhes gsungs/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs dpal rdo rje khro bo'i rgyud las/e ma ho gsod pa 'di ni bzang / /ji srid sdig pa dag las grol/ /sdig pa stong phrag byas pa yang / /mnar med la sogs mi skye'o/ /zhes mngon spyod kyi las ni gzhan phan 'gro don 656

mchog tu bshad/ byang chub sems dpa' sngags kyi spyod pa can rnams kyis thabs mkhas chen po byu ga yin/ rgyud sdom pa gsum pa las kyang / gdug pa rnams la bzlog ste bya/ /dngos su'am yang na sngags sam gzhan/ /'phrul 'khor dang ni ting nge 'dzin/ /sman gyis kyang ni bya ba /ste/ /de ltar mi byed de yis ni/ /nges par dam tshig nyams pa do 'gyur/ /gdon dang log 'dren dag gis kyang / /nges par ‘rnachi ste dmyal bar ni/ /yun ring sdug bsngal gyis gdungs te/ /de bas nan tan ldan pa ru/ /bzod pa mi bskyed snying rje yis/ /sngags kyis nges par bsad par bya/ /zhes ma rungs pa la drag las ma byas na dam tshig nyams 'gro bar bshad/ de baḍi/na du rgyud gzhan las kyang /rdo rje slob dpon smod pa dang / / rtseg pa chen por sun 'byen dang / /mi gang sngags kyi rgyud dag gi /sbyor ba la ni 'cha' byed pa/ /nan tan bskyed de bsang pa'am/ /yang na gnas nas bskrad par bya/ /zhes gsungs/ rtsa ltung bcu bzhi'i nang na/ gdug la rtag tu byams ldan pa/ /byed pa de ni bcu bar 'dod/ /ces bya ba cig mi gda' 'am/ gdug pa can la snying nye bar byas na rtsa lhung yin par bathad/ de'i shugs la mngon spyod ma byas na nyes pa dang / byas na phan yon 'byung zer ba 657

cig yod pa yin/ mi nag pa chos la sol phye las gnag pa/dbang 'dra yod pas dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang smod pa rnams/mngon spyod kyi yul yin pa smos ci dgos/ chos pa'am dge bshes su dzu ba/ bstan pa dang sems can la gnod pa rang byed pa 'di kun kyang bsgral bar bya ba'i yul yin te/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnyarma rak+ṣi tas kyang /bzang po lta bur kun gyis bcos na yang / /log lta'i nags su bdag lta 'khrug pa yis/ /stag mo bu zan lta bur 'jigs pa de/ /bka' sdod srung ma rnams kyis bsgral bya yin/ /ngur sprig gos can zhi dul mdzes gyur kyang / /byi la bzhin du bsam pa ma rungs pa'i/ /dam pa'i gzugs brnyan gso ru med pa de/ /ma mo rnams kyi kha ru gdab bya yin/ /khri phrag dgu yi gtso bor 'dug gyur kyang / /khyab 'jug bzhin du rang rgyud ma thul ba'i/ /chags sdang 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phro ba de/ /gshin rje gshed kyi zhal du gdab bya yin/ /khyim nas byung zhing bstan pa'i sgor zhugs kyang / /khyim pa bzhin du bya ba mtha' yas shing / /spang blang thams cad khyad du gsod pa de/ /drang srong rnams kyis dmod pas gdab bya yin/ /rtags dang ldan yang tshul khrims mi bsrung zhing / /'dod pa'i las la snang ba 658

'byams gyur nas/ /dam pa rnamab/ la sgo skur 'debs pa de/ /mkha' 'gro rnams kyis pha rol bsgral bya yin/ /rnyed pa'i ched du dam pa'i gzugs bzung nas/ /khyi phag bzhin du 'dod yon 'jol nyog byed/ /sngags su khas blangs thams cad bslu ba de/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i thab tu gzhug bya /pen/ /theg chen skad du las 'bras khyad gsod cing / /stong ba'i rbad kyis 'khor tshogs bslu ba yi/ /'gong bo bzhin du ci ru / rdzu ba de/ /dam tshig can gyi sngags kyis bsad bya yin/ /'di ltar so so thar pa phar zhog gi /rang nyid ngan 'gro chen por ‘rdogro dgos kyang / /bstan pa 'jig pa'i dgra bgegs mi sgrol ri/ /dam nyams pha rol dgra bgegs bsgral bar bya/ /zhes 'byung / gzhung 'di byang chub sems dpa'i blo sbyong gi gzhung yin/ byang chub sems kyi mnga' bdag bshes gnyen bka' gdams pa rnams kyi rtsis su mdzad pa yin pas/ mngon spyod dang sgrong chub kyi sems 'gal mi 'gal bsam mno thongs/ gal te jordo rje slob dpon rnams kyis mngon spyod byar mi rung na/ rgyud sde bzhi po thams cad nas bsad bskrad dbye ba rmongs rengs du/ra gdab kyi las mtha' yas pa zhig gsungs pa thams cad dgos med du thal bas ser rgyag gam ci/ kho bo cag ta/ da do ma mdo sde la sogs pa rdo 659

rje 'dzin pa'ang bcu gsum bsgral zer ba de'i mi brgyud yin/mtshan nyid pa skam po tsho yang mthu bsdig byed/ gdams ngag thor bu re zhus zhag shas mtshams tsam byas pa tsho yang / sngags nus kyi khur 'dra len na/ ngas mngon spyod byas rang byas na yang / pha tshe bu rabs kyi las ka srid pa bskos bskos pa de ka yin/ zhes gsungs pa sogs lung shin tu mang ngo / /des na chos kyi gnad shes na sngags pa hom khung kha'i yang sangs rgya par gsungs pas/ gang la yang khas mi gtong bar dag snang bya'o/ /tha na sdig can bshan pa thams cad la don dag gang yang med bzhin du spyi bsdus byas khas gtong mi rung ste/ de'i nang na yang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i sprul pa'ang yod srid de/ sngon rgyal sras thogs med rin po che dngul chu chos rdzong na bzhugs dus/ rgyal sras rin po che dang bla ma gzhan gcig gnyis ka dus mnyam du byung bas/ bla ma des yul phyogs kyi dkor thams cad bsdus nas slar 'chi dus su nga'i nor gyi cha gcig rgyal sras dngul chur phul zhes shi bas/ de ltar byas pas/ rgyal sras nye gnas kyis blangs nas phul bas/rgyal sras kyis de ma len zhig nga la 'dren skal med gsungs/nye gnas kyis ma nyan par rgyun ldan byu ru phyed tshal re byung ba 660

la dgyes bzhin du bsngo smon mdzang // da lan dngos po 'di tshan tsam yong ma myong bas/ bsngo smon bya /dzad dgos zhus pas/ bsngo smon rgya chen mdzad nas dngos po de kun lcags su bsgyur nas/sta re ste'u sogs lag cha mang du sta gon gyis shig ces bsgo bas/nye gnas kyis de bzhin tshar ba las// lo 'ga' lon nas yul de dang nye ba'i thang mtshams su / brag chen po zhig la phyag btsugs nas 'dir rna ba nyon dang gsungs pas/ nyan tsa na 'tsher sgra dang 'ur sgra che bas/ ci (pags zhus pas mi de rnams la brag 'di bsregs shig gsungs bsregs pas/ brag gi lto bar sdig pa mtho gang tsam la sdig nga/ de las chung ba stong phrag mang pos bskor nas 'ur chom gyis brag yur ba bzhin du zad pa mthong bas/ sdig pa gzhan rnams la ljags mchil btabs nas drangs/ sdig pa che ba 'di sdu cor bcug rgya btab nas gtsang ka ṇi sgo bzhi'i 'og bshan pa mi sdug pa 'jigs pa gcig lug gsod pa'i khong lag bta nga ba tsam du slebs pa yod pas/ myur bar song la de do 'phrod pa gyis zhes bsgos nas brdzangs pas ji bzhin ltar phar gang yang zer ma dgos par/ bang mi slebs ma thag nā/) nyer zhing 'dir khyer shog ces rwa co'i rgya bshig nas sdig pa'i mjug ma nas 'jus/ lug 661

gi khong nang gi khrag la yar bshar mar bshar re byas kha la bstabs nas zos so/ /de nas lug gi don snying lnga po de rgyal sras la bskur nas ngag nas thabs rdugs khyod 'di yang mi 'drongs pa ang / zhes brjod nas btang ngo / /de nas sdig pa de bshan pas drangs/ lug de'i 'dren skal rgyal sras la yod pas khong gis drangs skad/ des na de 'dra ba'i gtam rgyud mang po snang bas rang la mngon shes thogs med ma byung gi bar du dgon mtha' tsho na yod pa'i bshan pa sogs la yang khas mi gtong bar dad gus dag snang phyogs dang ris su ma chad par kun la sbyangs par bya'o/ /gzhan yang chos lugs rab 'bring tha gsum chos pa mchog dman bar gsum gang la yang dad gus dag snang rjes su yi rang byed pa dam pa gong ma'i rnam thar yin te/ rje sna tshogs rang grol gyis/sangs rgyas bstan pa ni mkha' ltar rgya re che/ /bstan 'dzin skyes bu ni nyi bzhin kun la khyab/ /theg pa'i 'jug sgo ni skar tshogs las kyang mang / /zab mo'i gdams pa ni rnying ma'i bka' gter phyug /spros bral phyag chen ni dwags pa bka' brgyud mkhas/ /dka' spyad snying rus ni dpal ldan 'brug pa che/ /snying rje byang sems ni bka' gdams slob brgyud bzang / /gzhung lugs bshad srol ni sa skya 'gran 662

zla bral/ /nyan thos 'dul khrizu 4sa ni dga' ldan slob brgyud brtson/ /rkyen ngan lam 'khyer ni zhi byed chos kyis byed/ /rnam rtog dngos 'dzin ni gcod yul zab mos 'joms/ /dus 'khor sbyor drug ni jo nang chos lu gas mkhas/ /e ma de sogs kyi chos lugs mtha' yas pa/ /ba dag sogs slob brgyud rnams yi rang zhes brjod do/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar chos dang gang zag mi gcig pa yongs la dad gus dab/ snang rjes su yi rang byed cing / ngag nas kyang de bzhin bajo rid cing mchod bstod bkur bar bya'o/ /mdor bsdu na/ khyica/ pa pho mo rnams kyis kyang tshe thung nam 'chi cha med bsams nas/ rang gis shes bzhin sdig pa mi byed par ma shes bzhin du rka nga bas srin 'bu brdzis nas bsad pa sogs sdig pa mi dge ba ba/nga byas chos byed nus na 'dag par shes nas/'tsho skyong zhing las sogs khyim gyi so nam la 'bad de zas nor bsags nas/ gos bzang gyon zas bzang zos nas nyal bsdad pa tsam gyes mi 'ong bar go nas/lus kyis phyag dang bskor ba/ nga ga gis kha ton bzlas brjod/sems kyis dad mos snying rje/ dkon mchog gsum la mchod 'bul/ bla ma rnams la zhabs tog dge 'dun rnams kyi chas / bya btang sgom chen pa'i sgrub za1 gas/ dbul bo rnams la 663

sbyin gtong sogs chos ci 'grub bya dgos/ de ltar byas na sdig pa las dge ba stobs che bar gyur nas sdig pa'i skyon gyis mi gos par ma zad/ dge stobs kyis tshe 'di phyir bde bas de lugs gyis/ chos pa rnams kyis sbyin bdag gi lag nas zas gos blangs nas khar zos rgyab tu gon pa'i nyes pa rnams chos rnam dag byas na 'dag par go nas/ sdig dang 'dres pa'i log pa'i 'tsho ba ma yin pas chos mthun gyi 'tsho ba rang bde ba'i thabs su bsgrub dgos te/ mdo sde rgyan las/ sa bzang ba dang grogs bzang ba/ /rnal 'byor bde ba'i yo byad ldan/ /zhes dang / byang gter las/ dben pa'i gnas su yo byad bsags/ /bde ba'i stan la 'dug par bya/ /zhes dang / o rgyan rin po ches/ gdams pa khyad par can zhu ba la/ yo byad tshang bar dgos te/ de ma tshang na mkha' 'gro'i chad pa 'byung bas tshang bar bsags na/ phyag rten dang / dbang yon dang /tshogs 'khor dang / gtor ma'i rgyu dang / rang gi (bams gso dang / dgos pa'i yo byad thams cad tshang bar bsag go /zhes gsungs/ de ltar mthun rkyen bsags nas chags zhen med par spyod bzhin du dam pa'i chos la thos bsam sgom gsum byas na gnas skabs su gdams pa lon cing / mthar thug 664

mchog thun gyi dngos grub thob pa‘rje dgos pa yod de/ o rgyan rin po ches/ de ltar bsag sa pa la dgos ched gnyis te/gnas skabs dang mthar thug go /gnas skabs su gdams pa lon cing / mthar thug dngos grub thams cad thob pa'o/ /gsungs so/ /des na da lta sha chang bud med sogs 'dod yon la longs spyod bzhin mdo sngags kyi chos byed pa'i chos pa mcho ga dman bar ba gang la yang kha/sa mi gtong bar/ dad gus dag snang sbyongs shing rang nyid la 'dod yon gyi skyon gyis mi gos pa'i gdengs med bzhin du gang dgar mi spyod par/ sdig dang ma 'dres pa'i zas nor la lo ras spyod mkhas po byas dam pa'i chos bzhin du byas na tshe 'di phyi gnyis ka la bde skyid nyi ma bzhin du 'char bar 'gyur ro//smras pa/ tshe yi mchog stsol lha phyo / rnam rgyal ma/ /shes rab mchog stsol lha mo dbyangs can ma/ /nor gyi mchog stsol lha mo nor rgyun ma/ /lha mo gsum gyis brje‘ bas 'bral med skyongs/ /rgya gar bod yul mkhas grub thams cad kyi/ /rnam thar rjes su kha mig yar blta byas/ /sngags la blo /ba mkhan rnal 'byor pho mo la/ /dad gus dag snang skye ba'i glu / byangs len/ /bla na med pa'i mdo dang rgyud sde dang / /sbyo/ bod mkhas grub tshad ldan 665

thams cad kyis/ /sngags kyi skabs su 'dod yon longs spyod ces/ /mgrin gcig dbyangs gcig bzhin du gsungs la ltos/ /khyad par chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha bas/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po gsang 'dus bde mchog sogs/ /gsang sngags bla med rdzogs rim mthon po'i skabs/ /thabs mchog las rgya'i bde ba chen po la/ /brten nas 'od gsal sgyu lus zung 'jug sku/ /sgrub tshul zab gnad shin tu gsal bar gsungs/ /de tshe nam mkha'i mkha' 'gro ma tshogs kyis/ /rgyud na gab sbas gcus dkrug byas pa rnams/ /'di 'dra'i rjen la phud nas gsungs pa zhig /sngar yang ma byung phyin chad mi 'byung zhes/ /phan tshun gleng zhing rjes su yi rang byung / /'on kyang mkha' 'gro'i snying khrag lta bu yi/ /gsang sngags zab mo ha cang rjen la phud/ /gsungs pa shin tu 'phang sems chen po skyes/ /phyin chad ha cang rjen par ma gsungs na/ /snyam nas sngags la ser sna shor ba byung / /de ltar gsungs pa rnams la yid ches na/ /phyin chad gsang sngags spyod la dad gus gyis/ /kha yis btang na mkha' 'gro'i bka' chad 'ong / /shi na chos spong las kyis dmyal bar skye/ /rang gis gsang sngags nyams su mi lon kyang / /gzhan gyis nyams su len pa'i rnal 'byor la/ /kha tsam min par dag 666

snang mdzod cig ces/ /tshogs dru ga rang grol kun la gsol ba 'debs/ /'di la 'gal 'khrul nyes pa ci mchis pa/ /bla ma yi dam ḍāk+ki'i spyan sngar bshags/ /mkha' 'gro'i snying gtam gsang ba bsgrags ches na/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la bzod par gsol/ /dbus kyi lhun po 'pho 'gyur ma byung bar/ /legs bshad 'di yang mi nyams sa steng 'dir/ /gnas nas nyi zla bzhin du phan thogs shing / /no do bu bzhin du dgos 'dod kun 'byung shog /dpe 'di 'dri zhing mthong thos dran reg gi /chos mdzad skyes bu thams cad thugs mthun zhing / /mdo sngags chos la mi phyed dad pa skyes/ /mi nub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin gyur cig /glegs/ bam gang du gnas pa'i sa phyogs su/ /mdo sngags zung 'brel bstan pa dar zhing rgyas/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams/ sprin bzhin 'khor/ /nyin mtshan g.yel ba med par grogs byed shog /bdag kyang deng nas tshe rabs thams cad du/ /chos (thugs gang la'ang dag snang 'byongs pa dang / /mdo sngags lam /bzang nyams su blangs pa'i mthus/ /ring bor mi thogs myur du 'tshang rgya shog /rdzogs sangs rgyas nas ston pa sangs rgyas lta/ra/ /nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i 'gro kun la/ /mdo sngags chos kyi 'khor lo 667

rab bskor nas/ /thams cad sangs rgyas sa la 'god par shog /nor bu dpag bsam shing dang bum bzang bzhin/ /'bad dang rtsol ba cung zad mi dgos par/ /'dod dgu'i 'byor ba dbyar gyi mtsho ltar 'khyil/ /bde skyid dpal la rol ba'i bkra shis shog /ces dag snang sprul ba'i glegs bam zhes bya ba 'di ni rang nyid rgyal khams mang por 'khyams tshe/ sa thob kyi sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i sprul ba bla ma skyes bu dam pa rnams dang /gsang sngags kyi rnal 'byor ba sha chang bud med 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga la ci dgar spyod pa rnams la/ chos pa 'jig rten pa phal che ba zhig gis khas gtong mkhan gyi rigs mang po mthong zhing thos pas rkyen byas rtsom 'dun yod pa'i khar/gsang sngags kyi rnal 'byor pa kun gyi mchog gyur rang gi bu chen grub dbang7pad+ma rang grol dang / dmag gsar mkha' 'gro/ sbas pa'i rnal 'byor pa chen po pad+ma rig 'dzin dang rin chen rdo rje/ rim gnyis nyams su len pa'i mthong sa'i mtshams pa dang slob bu 'jam dbyangs/ gzhan yang gsang sngags snga 'gyur gyi bstan pa rin po che 'dzin pa'i reb gong dang / zho 'ong gi sngags mang sogs dad can gyi rnal 'byor pho 668

mo brgya phrag du mas/ gsang sngab/sa kyi chos dang / gang zag 'dod yon la spyod pa rnams la phyo gas med kyi dad gus dag snang rtsol med du 'char ba'i sngar ped glegs bam zhig gis 'jog pa dgos zhes yang yang ba skul ba don yod par bya ba'i phyir/ phyi 'dul ba nang gsang sngags yang gsang bla na med pa'i rnal 'byor pa7tshogs drug rang grol lam ming gzhan yongs su grags pa zhabs dkar bla ma zhes dibod pas/ rgya gar rdo rje gdan gye byang phyogs/ dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing gi shar phyogs/ mdo smad tsong kha'i skyes ri'i lho phyogs/ grub chen skal ldan rgya mtsho'i 'khrungs yul/ reb gong grub pa thob pa'i gnas brgyad kyi thag nye/ nags tshal mang po rgyas pa'i gong rol/ spang gzhong me tog bkra ba'i 'dabs ro pa/ rong dang 'brog pa gnyis kyi so mtshams/ ri bo mtho tha yangs pa/ nyams dga' rig pa dwangs pa'i dben gnas ba ku shis 'khyil ba'i ri rtse nam mkha' mthong rgya che zhing / 'ong / gsal nyi 'od 'khyil ba'i lha khang bde ba can nas sbyar ba'o//669

༄༅ / /rdzogs rim 'od gsal mngon du byed pa'i thabs bde ba chen po bskyed tshul 'dod yon lha mo'i dga' ston zhes bya ba bzhugs so//na mo gu ru de ba ḍāk+ki ni ye/de yang gsang sngags bla med kyi rdzogs rim 'od gsal mngon du byed pa'i thabs bde ba chen po bskyed tshe/ gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya'i dngos po thams cad gzugs mdzes pa/ sgra snyan pa/ dri zhim pa/ ro mngar ba/reg bya 'jam pa'i mchod rdzas sna tshogs pa thogs pa'i 'dod yon lnga'i lha mo yid du 'ong ba blta bas chog mi shes/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs pas mdzes par bskyed nas/ rang nyid kyang lhar gsal ba la lha mo de dag rnams kyi mig gi yul du gzugs mjes pa/ rna ba'i yul du sgra snyan pa/ sna'i yul du dri zhim pa/ lce'i yul du ro mngar ba/ lus kyi yul du reg bya 'jam pa'i mchod pa'i bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab par phul bas/ de dag la longs spyad pa la brten nas rgyud la bde ba 670

kro na po bsam gyis mi khyab pa rgyas byung snyam pa dus rgyun du yid la byed dgos te/ rje bdag nying ) chen pos mdzad pa'i rim lnga gsal sgon las/ de yang phyi nang ke gzugs kyi skye mched thams cad yongs su gyur pa las/ ba/zugs rdo rje ma lag pa'i pad+ma 'jam pas me long bzung nas zhi ba'i mig gis blta zhing / mu tig gi chun po 'phyang ba/ nu ma rgyas shing 'bur la bar dog pa/gos cung zad grol zhing ro smad mjerdos par ston par bsams nas/ de'i gzugs la rgyun tu bltas pa las bde ba chen po byung bar bsam mo/ /de bzhin du sgra rdo rje ma glu snyan pa len cing pi wang gi sgra sgrogs pa bskyed pa dang / dri rnams dri rdo rje ma gar byed cing nor bu'i snod du byu/ra kum dang / a ka ru dang /tsan dan sbrul gyi snying po dang / ga bur la sogs pa'i dri bzang gis bkang ba/ phyogs bcur dri ba zang pos khyab par bskyed pa dang / ro rnams ro rdo rje ma gser dngul la sogs pa'i rin po che'i snod ro sna tshogs kyis bkang ba dang / lha'i bdud rtsis bkang bar bzung bar bskyed pa dang ri / reg bya rnams reg bya rdo rje ma mtshan thams cad kyis brgyan 4/ khro gnyer gsum gyis mdzes pa/ rked pa shin tu phra ba/ lte ba shin tu yangs shing g.yas su 'khyel ba/ ro smad dang 'doms sdug pa/ 'gros dal 671

zhing sgeg pa thams cad kyang bzhin 'dzums shing chags pa'i mig gis blta bar bskyed nas/ sgra dri ro la spyod pa dang / phan tshun 'khyud de reg bya la/ spyad pas bde ba chen po rgyas par bsam mo/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar bsgom pas bde ba rgyas tshe bde ba'i ngang nas 'od gsal bsgoms/ 'od gsal las sgyu lus su langs pas zung 'jug gi sku 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /slar yang tshigs su bcad nas dbyangs su blangs pa/bla ma lha dang ḍāk+ki la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /'od gsal mngon du byed pa'i thabs/ /bde ba rgyas bar byen gyis rlobs/ /phyi nang gzugs kyi skye mched kun/ /yongs dzogs gzugs kyi rdo rje ma/ /lag pad 'jam pas me long bzung / /mjes pa'i mig gis zur gyis blta/ /mu tig dkar po'i chun po 'phyang / /nu 'bur rgyas shing bar dog pa/ /cung zad gos grol ro smad kyi/ /mdzes pa'i pad+ma ston par bsam/ /de yi gzugs la bltas pa las/ /bde ba chen po byung bar mos/ /sgra rnams sgra yi rdo rje ma/ /snyan pa'i glu len pi wang gi /sgra snyan sgrogs par bskyed pa dang / /de yi sgra la nyan pa las/ /bde ba chen po byung bar mos/ /dri rnams dri yi rdo rje ma/ /gar byed nor bu'i snod mchog tu/ /gur kum bzang po a 672

ka ru/ /tsan dan ga bur la sogs pa'i/ /dri yis bkang ba'i dri zhim gyis/ /phyogs kun khyab pazari bskyed pa dang / /de yi dri la snom pa yis/ /bde ba chen po byung bar mos/ /ro rnams ro yi rdo rje ma/ /gser dngul la sogs rin po che'i/ /snod mchog ro rnams sna tshogs dang / /lha yi bdu da rtsis bkang bar bskyed/ /de yi ro rnams myang ba las/ /ba rdo ba chen po byung bar mos/ /reg rnams reg bya rdo rje ma/ /mtshan rnams kun gyis brgyan pa dang / /khro gnyer gsum mdzes rked pa phra/ /lte ba yangs shing g.yas su 'khyil/ /ro smad 'doms sdug 'gros kyang dal/ /sgeg cing so dkar bzhin 'dzums shing / /chags pa'i mig gis blta bar bskyed/ /phan tshun 'khyud de reg bya la/ /spyad pas sngar gyi de bas kyang / /bde ba chen po rgyas/ par bsam/ /bde ba rgyas tshe de nyid kyi/ /ngang nas 'od gsal sgyu lus bsgom/ /de ltar yang yang bsgom nus na/ /zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang dbang gi /go 'phang tshe 'dir thob par 'gyur/ /glu 'di thos tshad lus sems la/ /bde ba chen po rgyas pa da shog /ces pa 'di yang zhabs dkar bas sbyar ba'o//673

༄༅ / /ye shes kyi phyag rgya ma la brten nas bde stong gi ye shes bskyed tshul dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs zhes bya ba bzhugs so//oṃ steng phyogs mkha' spyod zhing na bzhugs pa yi/ /mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo nā ro mkha' spyod ma/ /khyed la nye ring chags sdang mi mnga' bas/ /mi mngon dbyengs nas bdag la brtse bas dgongs/ /o ṭi bi shwa bas mtha'i nags khrod du/ /khyed kyis rnal 'byor dbang phyug dril bu ba/ /'khyud dang tsum+bha'i bde bas rjes bskyangs te/ /kha sbyor mchog gi rol ba'i lo rgyus dang / /de bzhin ku sa li dang nā ro sogs/ /brtse bas rjes su bzung ba'i ngo mtshar gyi/ /lo rgyus mang po thos pas dga' zhing spro/ /bdag kyang de bzhin rjes su bzung du gsol/ /ngo bo rje btsun ma khyed yin pa la/ /rnam pa lha yi bu mo gzhon nu ma/ /sku mdog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags shing / /lang tsho bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod can/ /dar dang rin po che yi rgyan gyis mdzes/ /rang 674

'dra'i lha mo mang po'i 'khor gyis nga/skor/ /'od kyi lam la rol mo'i sgra dang bcas//du mar spro zhing gcig tu bsdud pa sogs/ /ngo mtshar rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs ston nga/zhin du/ /mi mngon dbyengs nas gnas 'dir gshegs su gso‘5/ /rin chen khri bzang mjes shing yangs pa'i thog /'bol gdan 'jam pa'i steng du dgyes bzhin bzhugs/ /rang nyi da lha ru gsal ba'i thugs ka nas/ /mchod pa'i lha dang lha mo mang ri po spros/ /de dag blta dang rgod dang lag bcing dang / /'khyud pa'i rnam 'gyur mang po ston bzhin du/ /gzugs mjes sgra snya na dri zhim ro mngar zhing / /reg bya 'jam pa'i mchod rdzas sna tsho‘gas dang / /sha chang bza' ba tshogs kyi 'khor lo 'bul/ / bzhes nas bde stong ye shes bskyed du gsol/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro'i mtshan rta gas ldan pa yi/ /pad+ma can gyi lha mo gzhon nu ma/ /yar langs/ gos grol sku lus rjen par bstan/ /rked phra nu 'bur bha ga mngo na par rgyas/ /zlum rgyas dro 'jam pad+ma dam zhing zab/ /dhu ti'i mar sna phyes pas sid sgra sgrogs/ /'dod pa'i sgyu rtsal drug sdo spyi bzhi la mkhas/ /chags pa'i rnam 'gyur mi 'dra mang po ston/ /gzugs mjes yid 'ong blta bas chog mi shes/ /ngag gi skad gdangs snyan pas yid 675

'gug cing / /lus dang kha yi dri zhim ngad pa 'thul/ /ma mchu lce yi sbrang rtsi mngar po ster/ /reg bya 'jam pas dga' bde 'bral mi phod/ /yid la dran pa tsam gyis bde ster ma/ /tshur la 'ong nas rang dang lhan cig 'khod/ /chags pa'i mig gis blta zhing dga' ba'i 'dzum/ /'jam mnyen lag pas 'khyud nas 'o byed cing / /brla gnyis bar phye rdo rje pad+mar rol/ /'jam pa'i sha sbyar nem pa'i nu 'jam glan/ /kha yi nang du lce bzhag 'jib tu 'jug /'og nas 'degs shing steng nas dal bus bsrub/ /dro 'jam pad+ma'i phugs su rdo rje bsnun/ /yar yar gtad nas kha sbyar 'khun bzhin du/ /dga' bzhi'i bde stong ye shes mchod par 'bul/ /de ltar phul bas shin tu thugs mnyes te/ /tshe rabs kun tu las kyi phyag rgya ma/ /mdzad nas bde stong phyag rgya chen po yi/ /mchog gi dngos grub bsgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cig /nam zhig 'chi tshe nā ro mkha' spyod ma/ /mngon sum byon nas 'dzum pa'i zhal bstan te/ /'jam pa'i phyag gis bdag gi lag nas drongs/ /mkha' spyod dag pa'i zhing du 'khrid du gsol/ /tshe rabs kun tu nā ro mkha' spyod mar/ /'bral med bde stong dpal la longs spyod cing / /sa lam yon tan mthar phyin sangs rgyas nas/ /'gro kun mkha' spyod zhing du 'khrid par 676

shog /snang srid rang grol sgyu ma rmi lam bzhin/ /bde ba chen po rgyun chad med pa'i nyams/ /yid la byar med stong gsal nam mkha'i ngang / /bze chen phyag rgya che da po'i bkra shis shog /oṃ nub phyogs bal bod gnyis kyi so mtshams su/ /mthon mthing rgyal mo zhes byar mtshan gsol ba'i/ /ngo mtshar bkra shis g.yang chags dpal gyi ri/ /phyi ni gangs ri nang ni gzhal yas khang / /nang na bod khams skyong b.re bstan bsrung ma/ /tshe ring mched lnga 'khor bcas rtag tu bzhugs/ /kun la mngon shes rdzu 'phrul mnga' bas na/ /gsang ga/1ma mi la ma bshad brtse bas dgongs/ /sngon tshe la phyi gangs kyi ra ba dang / /chung bar sman lung pho brang la sogs su/ /rje btsun bzhad pa rdo rje'i gsang yum du/ /bzhes dus yang yang byon pa'i lo rgyus dang / /de rjes rnal 'byor rus pa'i rgyan can gyis/ /phyag rgyar lnga gar bzhes/ pa'i ngo mtshar gyi/ /lo rgyus mang po thos pas dga' zhing spro/ /bdag kyang de bzhin rjes su bzung du gsol/ /ngo bo lha mo khyed rnams yin pa la/ /rnam pa mi yi bu mo gzhon nu ma/ /sku mdog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags shing / /lang tsho bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod can/ /dar dang rin po che yi rgyan gyis mjes/ /rang 'dra'i bu mo mang po'i 'khor gyis bskor/ /'od 677

kyi lam la rol mo'i sgra dang bcas/ /du mar spro zhing gcig tu bsdud pa sogs/ /ngo mtshar rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs ston bzhin du/ /mi mngon dbyings nas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /rin chen khri bzang mjes shing yangs pa'i thog /'bol gdan 'jam pa'i steng du dgyes bzhin bzhugs/ /rang nyid lha ru gsal ba'i thugs ka nas/ /mchod pa'i lha dang lha mo mang po spros/ /de dag blta dang rgod dang lag bcing dang / /'khyud pa'i rnam 'gyur mang po ston bzhin du/ /gzugs mdzes sgra snyan dri zhim ro mngar zhing / /reg bya 'jam pa'i mchod rdzas sna tshogs dang / /sha chang bza' ba tshogs kyi 'khor lo 'bul/ /bzhes nas bde stong ye shes bskyed du gsol//ye shes mkha' 'gro'i mtshan rtags ldan pa yi/ /pad+ma can gyi bu mo gzhon nu ma/ /yar langs gos grol sku lus rjen par bstan/ /rked phra nu 'bur bha ga mngon par rgyas/ /tshur la 'ong nas rang dang lhan cig 'khod/ /gzugs mdzes yid 'ong blta bas chog mi shes/ /ngag gis skad gdangs snyan pos chags pa'i gtam/ /shab shib smra bas yid kyang dbang med 'gugs/ /'jam mnyen lag pas 'khyud cing 'o byas pas/ /lus dang kha yi dri zhim ngad pa 'thul/ /brla gnyis 'khyud nas rdo rje pad+mar 678

drangs/ /blum rgyas dro 'jam pad+ma dam zhing zab/ /'jam pa'i sha sbyar nem pa'i nu 'jam glan/ /reg bya 'jam pas dga' bde 'bral mi phod/ /kha yi nang du lce bzhag 'jib res bya/ /ma mchu lce yi sbrang rtsi mngar po ster/ /'og nas 'degs shing steng nas dal bus bsrub/ /dro 'jam pad+ma'i phugs su rdo rje btang / /rdo rje'i rtsa ba pad+ma'i kha garta)sa sbyar/ /pad+ma btsums pas 'dod chags gting nas langs/ /dbang med 'gul bas lus rngul cag sgra 'byen/ /'dod pas gdungs pas tshur glan dam du 'khyud/ /yar yar gtad nas kha sbyar 'khun bzhin du/ /dga' bzhi'i bde stong ye shes mchod par 'bul/ /de ltar phul bas shin tu thugs mnyes te/ /tshe rabs kun tu las kyi phyag rgya ma/ /byas nas bde stong dpal la longs spyod cing / /sa lam yon tan mthar phyin sangs rgyas shog /snang srid rang grol sgyu ma rmi lam bzhin/ /bde ba chen po rgyun 6 da med pa'i nyams/ /yid la byar med stong gsal nam mkha'i ngang / /bde chen phyag rgya chen po'i bkra shis shog / ces ye shes kyi phyag rgya ma la brte /na nas lus sems la bde ba khyad par can bskyed de/ bde stong gi ngang la mnyam par bzhag nas/ mnyam bzhag gi ngang shā /sa ma g.yos bzhin sgyu lus 679

lha skur ldang bar bya'o/ /de ltar res mos byas/ tshe 'di nyid la phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub sgrub tshul 'di ni gzhan la shin tu gsang ba'i gnas yin pas/ su la yang bstan par mi bya'o/ /sa ma ya rgya rgya rgya/ bka' brgyud gong mas rgya/ mkha' spyod mas rgya/ tshe ring mched lngas rgya/ rgya gsum dang ldan pa'i gdams ngag zab mo 'di ni zhabs dkar bas sbyar ba'o// sarba maṅga lo//smras pa/ rnam kun mchog ldan don gyi rdo rje kun tu bzang / /rnam rol bshes gnyen mchog gi skur bstan drin can rje/ /rnam gsum dad pas rtse gcig gsol 'debs bdag rgyud la/ /rnam pa kun tu byen phobs 'bral med brtse bas skyongs/ /mtha' yas 'gro ba 'dul phyir gang 'dul skur bstan pa/ /gaṅgā'i rdul snyed grangs med zhing khams rab 'byams kyi/ /lha mchog yi dam zhi dang khro bo'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /mchog thun dngos grub stsol la bdag rgyud smin grol mdzod/ /brtan dang g.yo ba'i dngos kun ci dgar bsgyur nus shing / /rnal 'byor lam gyi grogs mdzad bar chad kun sel ba'i/ /gnas gsum mkha' 'gro ma sring ḍāk+ki'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /dga' bzhi'i bde chen sbor la sa lam mthar phyin mdzod/ /rgyal bstan rin 680

chen bsrung zhing de 'dzin skyong ma nga da pa'i/ /ma hā kā la e ka dza ṭi rā hu la/ /thig le rtsal sogab/ rdo rje chos srung tshogs rnams kyis/ /ma g.yel dus kun ga sgogs la rnal 'byor phrin las sgrubs/ /rim dgu'i gnad gas rdo rje theg pa yi/ /nye lam dmar khrid gsang ba'i yang zhun ra/chog /dag snang sprul ba'i glegs bam zhes bya 'di/ /skal 3/na las sad rnams kyi dpal du byon/ /skyabs mgon dam paḍi/ zhal gyi bum bzang las/ /rig 'dzin chen po mtha' bral rdo je/ la/ /bka' lung gnang zhing chos 'di'i bdag po ru/ /mnga' gsol dbugs dbyung zhal bkod rgyas par gnang / /'di nyid ji bzhin nyams su len nus pa'i/ /rjes 'jug skal ldan yod na longs shig dang / /rnam mkhyen rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas go 'phang mchog /ring min tshe 'di nyid la bde blag sgrob/ /sha chang la sogs bza' btung tshogs su rol/ /zhing sngags lhan skyes pho nya mgron du 'gugs/ /nyin mtshan dga' bde'i dpal la rtag rol ba'i/ /dpa' bo rig 'dzin tshogs rnams nyams re dga'/ /de lta'i gdams pa'i mthar thug yang nun 'di'i/ /mi zad par gyi mchod sbyin spel ba'i ched/ /bsngo smon dag pa'i mtshams sbyor sngon song zhing / /ris me ) bstan pa kun la dag snang 681

'byongs/ /dam pa'i gsung bzhin sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /bon rgya'i dpal mkhar rgyal gyis par yon dang / /'tsho ba sbyar nas 'dri bsko byed rnams kyis/ /nor 'khrul lhag chad ma byung legs par bskrun/ /'di yi dge ba'i legs tshogs gang mchis pa/ /rnam pa kun nas kun tu mi nyams shing / /dbyar gyi mtsho ltar gong du 'phel rgyas nas/ /drin can bla ma'i thugs dgongs yongs rdzogs shog /lus bskyed pha ma zhabs tog sri zhu'i ched/ /'o zho 'thung dang sha khrag zos la sogs/ /'di la sgo gsum 'brel ba gang thogs rnams/ /gtso byas mkha' mnyam 'gro kun sangs rgyas shog /bdag sogs deng nas skye ba'i phreng ba ru/ /mtshan ldan bshes gnyen mchog dang mi 'bral zhing / /rim gnyis lam gyi nyams len mthar phyin nas/ /gdod ma'i gnas lugs ji bzhin rtogs par shog /khyad par ma rgyud mkha' 'gro'i gdams pa mchog /rtsa thig rlung gi nyams len rtsal rdzogs shing / /mtshan ldan mu dra'i bogs 'byin la brten nas/ /kha sbyor bdun ldan go 'phang mngon gyur shog /gnas skabs su yang 'gal rkyen kun zhi zhing / /mthun rkyen legs tshogs 'bad rtsol med par 'grub/ /kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che/ /mi nyams phyogs dus kun tu 'phel 682

rgyas shog /yangs pa'i rgyal khams kun tu bde skyid 'phel/ /char chu dus babs lo phyugs rtag tu legs/ /nad mug 'khrug rtsod kun zhi chos 'phel ngos/ /rdzo /sa ldan dus bzhin skyid pa'i bkra shis shog /ces dag snang sprul ba'i glegs bam gyi par byang nyung bsdus 'di ni/ dad ldan dam byi7ga gtsang zhing bla ma'i bka' bzhin bsgrub pa'i gnyer ba rab byung dang / lha khang dbu mdzad gnyis kyis bskul ba don po /da par bya ba'i ched du/ khyung dgon sprul ming khyab brdal klong thangs su 'bod pas/ dben gnas bkra shis 'khyil ba'i yang tre bde ba can gyi lha khang nas sbyar ba dge'o/ /'dis kyang mdo sngags kyi chos dang gang zag yongs la dad gus dag snang 'bad med du skye bar gyur cig /683
